/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [debug].[ExportItemMessageStatus]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [debug].[ExportItemMessageStatus](@exportItemKey BIGINT)
RETURNS @result TABLE
(
    [ExportMessageKey] BIGINT,
    [Sent] BIT,
    [RequestKey] BIGINT,
    [RequestStatus] NVARCHAR(448)    
)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @falseFlag BIT,
        @requestTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @trueFlag BIT;

    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
        @requestTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');

    ;WITH [Message](MessageKey) AS
    (
        SELECT [item].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
        WHERE   [item].[ExportItemKey] = @exportItemKey
        UNION ALL
        SELECT [correlated].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey]
        FROM [Message] AS [anchor]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlated]
            ON  [anchor].[MessageKey] = [correlated].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    INSERT INTO @result
    (
        [ExportMessageKey],
        [Sent],
        [RequestKey],
        [RequestStatus]
    )
    SELECT 
        [message].[MessageKey],
        CASE
            WHEN [sent].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
            ELSE @falseFlag
        END,
        [request].[RequestKey],
        [requestStatus].[ValueString]
    FROM [Message] AS [message]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
        ON  [message].[MessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
        ON  [message].[MessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [requestStatus]
        ON  [request].[RequestKey] = [requestStatus].[ObjectKey]
        AND [requestStatus].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestTypeKey
        AND [requestStatus].[AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey
        AND [requestStatus].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag;
        
    RETURN;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [debug].[FormatRequestObjectNotFound]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [debug].[FormatRequestObjectNotFound]
(
    @requestKey         BIGINT,
    @requestIdentifier  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(2000)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
 
    DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000);

    SELECT @messageText = N'@requestIdentifier=' + ISNULL(CAST(@requestIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(36)), N'NULL') + ' and/or @requestKey= ' + ISNULL(CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(20)),N'NULL') + ' do not resolve to a valid Request Object.';

    RETURN @messageText;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [debug].[GetResourceIdentifierFromPortalUrl]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [debug].[GetResourceIdentifierFromPortalUrl]
    (@portalURL NVARCHAR (300))
RETURNS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    *  USAGE:
    *  When viewing resources in the Portal, you can click the little "clipboard" icon in the upper right
    *  of the webpage and this will copy the web page URL to the clipboard.  That URL has the id of the resource
    *  as part of the webpage path.  This function will parse that path and produce that id.
    *  
    *  Example: @portalURL = http://deano2k9/identitymanagement/aspx/Requests/RequestProperties.aspx?id=c7088f1d-94e5-4578-92fa-c2edf9071ba4&type=Request&_p=1
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

    DECLARE @start INTEGER;
    SELECT @start =CHARINDEX('id=', @portalURL);

    DECLARE @resourceIdentifier NVARCHAR(36);
    SELECT @resourceIdentifier = SUBSTRING(@portalURL, @start + 3, 36);

    RETURN CAST(@resourceIdentifier AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[CompareBindingTarget]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[CompareBindingTarget]
(
    @bindingTarget1 XML(CONTENT [fim].[DataWarehouseClassRelationshipSchemaCollection]),
    @bindingTarget2 XML(CONTENT [fim].[DataWarehouseClassRelationshipSchemaCollection])
)
RETURNS TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
    
    DECLARE 
        @attributeCount1 TINYINT, 
        @attributeCount2 TINYINT, 
        @attributeName NVARCHAR(448), 
        @attributeValue NVARCHAR(448);
    
    IF 
    (
        @bindingTarget1 IS NULL 
        OR @bindingTarget2 IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN 1;
    END    

    IF  
    (
        (SELECT @bindingTarget1.value('(local-name((/*)[1]))','NVARCHAR(448)')) !=
        (SELECT @bindingTarget2.value('(local-name((/*)[1]))','NVARCHAR(448)'))
    )
    BEGIN        
        RETURN 1;
    END	
    
    SET @attributeCount1 = @bindingTarget1.query('count(/*/@*)').value('.','TINYINT');
    SET @attributeCount2 = @bindingTarget2.query('count(/*/@*)').value('.','TINYINT');
    
    IF (@attributeCount1 != @attributeCount2)
    BEGIN
        RETURN 1;
    END
    
    SET @attributeCount2 = 1;
    WHILE (@attributeCount2 <= @attributeCount1)
    BEGIN

        SET @attributeName = @bindingTarget1.value('local-name((/*/@*[sql:variable("@attributeCount2")])[1])', 'NVARCHAR(448)');
        SET @attributeValue = @bindingTarget1.value('string((/*/@*[sql:variable("@attributeCount2")])[1])', 'NVARCHAR(448)');

        IF 
        (
            @bindingTarget2.exist('(/*/@*[local-name()=sql:variable("@attributeName")])[1]') = 0
        )
        BEGIN            
            RETURN 1;        
        END
                    
        IF  
        (
            @bindingTarget2.value('string((/*/@*[local-name()=sql:variable("@attributeName")])[1])', 'NVARCHAR(448)') != @attributeValue
        )
        BEGIN            
            RETURN 1;        
        END                

        SET @attributeCount2 = @attributeCount2 + 1;   

    END		
    
    RETURN 0;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[ConcatenateMembershipConditionCommonTableExpressions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[ConcatenateMembershipConditionCommonTableExpressions] 
(
	@commonTableExpressions				NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@additionalCommonTableExpressions	NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	RETURN
		CASE
			WHEN
			(
				(@commonTableExpressions IS NULL)
				AND
				(@additionalCommonTableExpressions IS NOT NULL)
			)THEN N''
			WHEN
			(
				(@commonTableExpressions IS NOT NULL)
				AND
				(@additionalCommonTableExpressions IS NOT NULL)
			)THEN @commonTableExpressions + N', '
			ELSE @commonTableExpressions
		END
		+ 
		CASE 
			WHEN
			(
				(@additionalCommonTableExpressions IS NOT NULL)
			)THEN @additionalCommonTableExpressions
			ELSE ''
		END
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[CreateRequestStatusDetail]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[CreateRequestStatusDetail] (
    @message        NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @detailLevel    NVARCHAR(16)   -- Error, Warning, Information
)
RETURNS XML

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @requestStatusDetail XML;

    --FROM SQL HELP...
    --FORMAT CODE 127  127(6, 7) ISO8601 with time zone Z. yyyy-mm-ddThh:mi:ss.mmmZ (no spaces)
    --The optional time zone indicator, Z, is used to make it easier to map XML datetime values that have time zone information to SQL Server datetime values that have no time zone. Z is the indicator for time zone UTC-0. Other time zones are indicated with HH:MM offset in the + or - direction. For example: 2006-12-12T23:45:12-08:00.
    --the char 'Z' is not included by SQL so add it.
    DECLARE @dateString NVARCHAR(448);
    SELECT @dateString = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETUTCDATE(), 127) + N'Z';

    SELECT @requestStatusDetail = CAST(N'<RequestStatusDetails><RequestStatusDetail xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" DetailLevel="' + @detailLevel + '" EntryTime="' + @dateString + '">' + @message + '</RequestStatusDetail></RequestStatusDetails>' AS XML);

    RETURN @requestStatusDetail;
    END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[DateTimeReplaceTime]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[DateTimeReplaceTime]
    (@dateTime DATETIME, @replaceTime DATETIME)
RETURNS DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    --This will replace the TIME part of @dateTime with the TIME part from @replaceTime
    -- SQL2005 does not support DATE so convert the existing DATETIME
    -- to a string using ANSI DATE
    DECLARE @date NVARCHAR(10);
    SELECT @date = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@dateTime,102)

    -- SQL2005 does not support TIME so convert the existing DATETIME
    -- to a string using TIME(hh.mi.sss.mmm)
    DECLARE @time  NVARCHAR(16);
    SELECT @time = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16),@replaceTime,114)

    RETURN CONVERT(datetime, (@date + ' ' + @time), 102);
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[DetermineFinalRequestStatusValue]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[DetermineFinalRequestStatusValue] (@requestStatus NVARCHAR(448), @workflowStatus NVARCHAR(448), @collateralRequestStatus NVARCHAR(448))

RETURNS NVARCHAR(448)

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @requestStatusValue NVARCHAR(448);

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * A. Check if Request is already final  
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    --if request is already in a final state return it.
    IF(@requestStatus IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN
        IF([fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFinal](@requestStatus) = 1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @requestStatusValue = @requestStatus;
            GOTO FinalExit;
        END
    END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * B. Evaluate Collateral Request Status 
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    --if collateral requests, use their status to set the result
    --DESIGN POINT:  since collateral requests are part of the parent request "ProcessingPostCommit" stage
    --the affect on the parentrequeststatus is limited to Post Commit Status types.
    --e.g.  if a collateral request has requestStatus = 'FailedCommit' the affect on the parent is just 'FailedProcessingPostCommit'
    IF(@collateralRequestStatus IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @requestStatusValue =
        CASE
            WHEN [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFailed](@collateralRequestStatus) = 1     THEN [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessingError]()
            WHEN [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeCanceled](@collateralRequestStatus) = 1   THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing]()
            WHEN [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeCompleted](@collateralRequestStatus) = 1  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]()
            ELSE NULL
        END; 

        IF(@requestStatusValue IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            GOTO FinalExit;
        END 
    END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * C. Evaluate Workflow Status 
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    IF(@workflowStatus IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN

        --if complete set overall to collateral results
        --if complete set overall to complete if no collateral results
        --if failed set overall to failed
        --if canceled set overall to canceledPostProcessing

        --NOTE: when a cancel request is processed, the final state of the request is determined at the time
        --of the commit and will always be 'oftypecanceled' even if some workflows had errors or completed successfully.
        SELECT @requestStatusValue =
        CASE
            WHEN [fim].    [IsWorkflowStatusOfTypeCompleted](@workflowStatus) = 1 
                        AND @requestStatusValue IS NOT NULL                         THEN @requestStatusValue
            WHEN [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusOfTypeCompleted](@workflowStatus) = 1
                        AND @requestStatusValue IS NULL                             THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]()
            WHEN [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusOfTypeFailed](@workflowStatus) = 1         THEN [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessingError]()
            WHEN [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusOfTypeCanceled](@workflowStatus) = 1       THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing]()
            ELSE NULL
        END; 

        IF(@requestStatusValue IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            GOTO FinalExit;
        END 
    END

    FinalExit:

    RETURN @requestStatusValue;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[DoesBindingExist]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[DoesBindingExist]
(
    @objectTypeKey SMALLINT,
    @attributeKey SMALLINT
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [fim].[BindingInternal]
        WHERE   [ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey
            AND [AttributeKey] =@attributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN 1;
    END
    
    RETURN 0;
    
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[FormatBindingCannotBeDeletedUsedInSetsException]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[FormatBindingCannotBeDeletedUsedInSetsException]
(
    @attributeName       NVARCHAR(448),
    @objectTypeName      NVARCHAR(448)
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(2000)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[FormatBindingInUseException]
(
    @bindingKey BIGINT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(2000)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

 DECLARE @attributeName NVARCHAR(448);
 DECLARE @objectTypeName NVARCHAR(448);
 
 SELECT
    @attributeName = [fim].AttributeNameFromKey(b.AttributeKey),
    @objectTypeName = [fim].ObjectTypeNameFromKey(b.ObjectTypeKey)
 FROM [fim].BindingInternal AS b
 WHERE b.[ObjectKey] = @bindingKey;
 
 IF((@attributeName IS NULL)OR(@objectTypeName IS NULL))
 BEGIN
  RETURN [fim].[FormatInvalidResourceKeyException](@bindingKey);
 END
 
 DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000);
 
 SET @messageText = N'There are instances of the binding of the attribute type, ' 
 + @attributeName + N', to the object type, ' 
 + @objectTypeName + N', so the binding cannot be deleted.';
 
 RETURN @messageText;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[FormatCancelRequestFinalRequestStatusPriorToCancel]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[FormatCancelRequestFinalRequestStatusPriorToCancel]
(
    @requestKey BIGINT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
 
    DECLARE @lastRequestStatus  NVARCHAR(448),
            @messageText        NVARCHAR(600),
            @time               DATETIME;

    IF EXISTS
    (            
        SELECT [rsc].[Status],
               [rsc].[Time]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestStatusChange] AS [rsc]
        ON      [r].[RequestKey] = [rsc].[RequestKey]
            AND [r].[Status] = [rsc].[Status]
        WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @lastRequestStatus = [fim].[GetRequestStatusName]([rsc].[Status]),
                @time = [rsc].[Time]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestStatusChange] AS [rsc]
        ON      [r].[RequestKey] = [rsc].[RequestKey]
            AND [r].[Status] = [rsc].[Status]
        WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
        SELECT @messageText = N' Last RequestStatus recorded prior to cancel: ' + @lastRequestStatus + ' at ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @time, 127) + ' UTC.';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = N'';
    END
    
    RETURN @messageText;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[FormatInvalidObjectTypeOperationException]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[FormatInvalidObjectTypeOperationException]
(
    @objectTypeKey SMALLINT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(2000)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

--This exception is meant to expose programming errors, not user errors, and is therefore not currently mapped to 
--a handler in the Data Access Exception Manager (DataAccessExceptionManager.cs).  If the exception is now to be 
--applied to a user-initiated error, then it should be mapped to handler in the Data Access Exception Manager.  

    DECLARE 
        @messageText        NVARCHAR(2000),
        @objectTypeName     NVARCHAR(448);

    SELECT @objectTypeName = [fim].[ObjectTypeNameFromKey](@objectTypeKey);
    
    SELECT @messageText = N'The operation is not valid for objects of this type: ' + @objectTypeName;
    RETURN @messageText;

CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[FormatInvalidTemporaryTableStateException]
(
    @tableName      NVARCHAR(448),
    @shouldExist    BIT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @trueFlag       BIT;
    DECLARE @messageText    NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    SELECT @messageText =   N'A temporary table was found to be in an invalid state.  The table, '    + 
                            @tableName                  +
                            CASE
                                WHEN @shouldExist = @trueFlag THEN N', was expected to have been created, but does not exist.'
                                ELSE N', was not expected to exist, but had already been created.'
                            END
    RETURN @messageText;
END

CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[FormatParameterName]

BEGIN

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionImmutableAttributeSQL]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionImmutableAttributeSQL] 
(
    @membershipConditionKey BIGINT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE 
        @andConjunctionString       NVARCHAR(5),
        @columnString               NVARCHAR(13),
        @conjunctionString          NVARCHAR(5),
        @falseFlag                  BIT,
        @index                      INT,
        @limit                      INT,
        @currentValue               BIGINT,
        @excludedOperatorString     NVARCHAR(2),
        @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @identifierColumnString     NVARCHAR(9),
        @includedOperatorString     NVARCHAR(1),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeColumnString     NVARCHAR(13),
        @operatorString             NVARCHAR(2),
        @orConjunctionString        NVARCHAR(4),
        @previousTabularFunctionkey INT,
        @result                     NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @tabularFunctionKey         INT,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;
    
    DECLARE @clause  TABLE
    (
        [Index]                 INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        [AttributeKey]          SMALLINT,
        [Value]                 BIGINT,
        [Excluded]              BIT DEFAULT(0),
        [TabularFunctionKey]    INT NULL
    );
    
    DECLARE @otherObjectTypeKey TABLE
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey]     SMALLINT NOT NULL,
        [Excluded]          BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT(0),
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [Excluded]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @tabularKey TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]             BIGINT NOT NULL,
        [TabularFunctionKey]    INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [TabularFunctionKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @tabularTypeKey TABLE
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey]         SMALLINT NOT NULL,
        [TabularFunctionKey]    INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [TabularFunctionKey]
        )
    );
    
    SELECT
        @andConjunctionString = N' AND ',
        @excludedOperatorString = N'!=',
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @identifierColumnString = N'ObjectKey',
        @includedOperatorString = N'=',
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
        @objectTypeColumnString = N'ObjectTypeKey',
        @orConjunctionString = N' OR ',
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [mcot].[ObjectTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [mcot]
        WHERE
                [mcot].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [mcot].[ObjectTypeKey] >= 0
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @clause
        (
            [AttributeKey],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @objectTypeAttributeKey,
            [mcot].[ObjectTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [mcot]
        WHERE
                [mcot].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [mcot].[ObjectTypeKey] >= 0;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [objectType]
            ON [statement].[LiteralValueString] = [objectType].[Name]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @otherObjectTypeKey
        (
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [Excluded]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [objectType].[Key],
            [statement].[OperatorInversion]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [objectType]
            ON [statement].[LiteralValueString] = [objectType].[Name]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NULL
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [other].[ObjectTypeKey]
            FROM @otherObjectTypeKey AS [other]
            INNER JOIN @clause AS [primary]
                ON  [other].[ObjectTypeKey] = [primary].[Value]
                AND [other].[Excluded] = [primary].[Excluded]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [other]
            FROM @otherObjectTypeKey AS [other]
            INNER JOIN @clause AS [primary]
                ON  [other].[ObjectTypeKey] = [primary].[Value]
                AND [other].[Excluded] = [primary].[Excluded];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [other].[ObjectTypeKey]
            FROM @otherObjectTypeKey AS [other]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @clause
            (
                [AttributeKey],
                [Value],
                [Excluded]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                @objectTypeAttributeKey,
                [other].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [other].[Excluded]
            FROM @otherObjectTypeKey AS [other]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
        END
        
        
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [value]
            ON  [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [type]
            ON  [value].[Value] = [type].[Name]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @tabularTypeKey
        (
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [TabularFunctionKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [type].[Key],
            [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [value]
            ON  [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [type]
            ON  [value].[Value] = [type].[Name]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [other].[ObjectTypeKey]
            FROM @tabularTypeKey AS [other]
            INNER JOIN @clause AS [primary]
                ON  [other].[ObjectTypeKey] = [primary].[Value]
            WHERE   [primary].[Excluded] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [other]
            FROM @tabularTypeKey AS [other]
            INNER JOIN @clause AS [primary]
                ON  [other].[ObjectTypeKey] = [primary].[Value]
            WHERE   [primary].[Excluded] = @falseFlag;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [other].[ObjectTypeKey]
            FROM @tabularTypeKey AS [other]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @clause
            (
                [AttributeKey],
                [Value],
                [Excluded],
                [TabularFunctionKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                @objectTypeAttributeKey,
                [other].[ObjectTypeKey],
                @falseFlag,
                [other].[TabularFunctionKey]
            FROM @tabularTypeKey AS [other]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
        END
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NULL
            AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN

        INSERT INTO @clause
        (
            [AttributeKey],
            [Value],
            [Excluded]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @identifierAttributeKey,
            [statement].[LiteralValueReference],
            [statement].[OperatorInversion]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NULL
            AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NULL
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [value]
            ON  [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN

        INSERT INTO @tabularKey
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [TabularFunctionKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [value].[Value],
            [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [value]
            ON  [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [other].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @tabularKey AS [other]
            INNER JOIN @clause AS [primary]
                ON  [other].[ObjectKey] = [primary].[Value]
            WHERE   
                    [primary].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                AND [primary].[Excluded] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [other]
            FROM @tabularKey AS [other]
            INNER JOIN @clause AS [primary]
                ON  [other].[ObjectKey] = [primary].[Value]
            WHERE   
                    [primary].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                AND [primary].[Excluded] = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [other].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @tabularKey AS [other]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @clause
            (
                [AttributeKey],
                [Value],
                [Excluded],
                [TabularFunctionKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                @identifierAttributeKey,
                [other].[ObjectKey],
                @falseFlag,
                [other].[TabularFunctionKey]
            FROM @tabularKey AS [other]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 132));
        END
        
        
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [clause].[AttributeKey]
        FROM @clause AS [clause]
    )
    BEGIN
 
        SELECT
            @index = 1,
            @limit = MAX([clause].[Index])
        FROM @clause AS [clause];
        
        WHILE @index <= @limit
        BEGIN
            
            SELECT @tabularFunctionKey = [clause].[TabularFunctionKey]
            FROM @clause AS [clause]
            WHERE       [clause].[Index] = @index;
            
            SELECT 
                @columnString =
                    CASE
                        WHEN [clause].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey THEN @objectTypeColumnString
                        ELSE @identifierColumnString
                    END,
                @currentValue = [clause].[Value],
                @conjunctionString = 
                    CASE
                        WHEN
                                @previousTabularFunctionkey IS NOT NULL
                            AND @tabularFunctionKey IS NOT NULL
                            AND @tabularFunctionKey = @previousTabularFunctionkey
                        THEN    @orConjunctionString
                        WHEN 
                            (       
                                    [clause].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey 
                                OR  [clause].[Excluded] = @trueFlag
                            )
                        THEN @andConjunctionString
                        ELSE @orConjunctionString
                    END,
                @operatorString =
                    CASE
                        WHEN [clause].[Excluded] = @trueFlag THEN @excludedOperatorString
                        ELSE @includedOperatorString
                    END
            FROM @clause AS [clause]
            WHERE       [clause].[Index] = @index;
                    
            SELECT @result = 
                CASE
                    WHEN((@result IS NULL)AND(@index = @limit))THEN                                                 N''
                    WHEN((@result IS NULL)AND(@index < @limit))THEN                                                 N'/*<BR>*/
    ('                                                                              
                    ELSE @result
                END                                                                                             +   N'/*<BR>*/' +
                CASE
                    WHEN(@index > 1)THEN 
N'      ' + @conjunctionString
                    ELSE N''
                END                                                                                             +   N' 
                [*].[' + @columnString + N'] ' + @operatorString + CAST(@currentValue AS NVARCHAR(20))          + 
                CASE
                    WHEN((@index > 1)AND(@index = @limit))THEN                                                      N'/*<BR>*/
    )'
                    ELSE                                                                                            N''
                END
                
            SELECT @previousTabularFunctionkey = @tabularFunctionKey;                
            
            SELECT @index = @index + 1;
        END
    END
    
    RETURN @result;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetBooleanSystemConfigurationSetting]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetBooleanSystemConfigurationSetting]
(
    @settingAttributeKey SMALLINT
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @createdTimeAttributeKey                        SMALLINT,
            @reportingLoggingEnabledAttributeKey            SMALLINT,            
            @systemConfigurationObjectTypeKey               BIGINT,                           
            @settingValue                                   BIT;

    SELECT  @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),            
            @systemConfigurationObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmSystemConfiguration');    
                    
     -- It is guaranteed that there will be a System Configuration setting object.    
    SELECT  TOP(1)
         @settingValue = [ValueBoolean]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean]
    WHERE   [ObjectTypeKey] = @systemConfigurationObjectTypeKey
        AND [AttributeKey] = @settingAttributeKey;   
    
    RETURN @settingValue;
END

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetCurrentWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetCurrentWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
(@workflowDefinitionObjectKey BIGINT)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    -- Only provide the latest key if the definition has not been deleted.
    -- otherwise we don't want to allow any more workflows to be created with this identifier

    DECLARE @Key INT;
    
    SELECT 
        @Key = [wd].[VersionKey]
    FROM [fim].[WorkflowDefinition] AS [wd]
    WHERE 
            [wd].[ObjectKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey
        AND [wd].[Deleted] = 0
    ORDER BY [wd].[VersionKey] DESC;

    RETURN @Key; 

END
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey] (@objectKey BIGINT)

RETURNS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
    
    SELECT @identifier = [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]

        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = 0;           -- The ObjectID attribute is always 0

    RETURN @identifier; 

END

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetMembershipConditionObjectKey]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetMembershipConditionObjectKey]
(
    @membershipConditionKey     INT
)
RETURNS BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    DECLARE 
        @result     BIGINT,
        @trueFlag   BIT;
        
    SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    SELECT TOP 1 @result = 
        [mcs].[LiteralValueReference] *
        CASE
            WHEN [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag THEN -1
            ELSE 1
        END
	FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
	INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
	    ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
	WHERE
	        [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
	    AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
	    
    RETURN @result;
END;
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetObjectTypeIdentifierFromObjectIdentifier]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetObjectTypeIdentifierFromObjectIdentifier]
(
	@objectIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER	
)
RETURNS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************	
	DECLARE 
	    @objectTypeKey BIGINT,
	    @objectTypeIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
	    
    -- get the object type key	    
    SELECT @objectTypeKey = [objects].[ObjectTypeKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
    WHERE [objects].[ObjectID] = @objectIdentifier;
    
    -- get the identifier for the key; Attribute Key 0 is for ObjectID
    SELECT @objectTypeIdentifier = [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
    WHERE 
            [ovi].[ObjectKey] = @objectTypeKey
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = 0;    	    
	
	RETURN @objectTypeIdentifier;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetRequestControlKey] 
(
    @statusName NVARCHAR(448)
)

RETURNS TINYINT

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    /* NOTE: Synchronize modifications to this function with modifications to the 
    *   Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices.WSResourceManagement.RequestControlType Enumeration in the server C# code, and 
    *   with the [fim].[GetRequestControlName] function.  
    */

    DECLARE @statusKey TINYINT;
    SELECT @statusKey = 
    CASE
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestControlNormal]()                   THEN  0
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestControlCancelOperation]()          THEN  1
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestControlCancelActionWorkflow]()     THEN  2
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestControlSystemCancelOperation]()    THEN  3
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestControlSystemTerminateOperation]() THEN  4
       
        ELSE NULL
    END;

    RETURN @statusKey;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetRequestControlName]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetRequestControlName] 
(
    @statusKey TINYINT
)

RETURNS NVARCHAR(32)

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    /* NOTE: Synchronize modifications to this function with modifications to the 
    *   Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices.WSResourceManagement.RequestControlType Enumeration in the server C# code, and 
    *   with the [fim].[GetRequestControlKey] function.
    */

    DECLARE @statusName NVARCHAR(32);

    SELECT @statusName =
    CASE
        WHEN @statusKey =  0  THEN [fim].[RequestControlNormal]()
        WHEN @statusKey =  1  THEN [fim].[RequestControlCancelOperation]()
        WHEN @statusKey =  2  THEN [fim].[RequestControlCancelActionWorkflow]()
        WHEN @statusKey =  3  THEN [fim].[RequestControlSystemCancelOperation]()
        WHEN @statusKey =  4  THEN [fim].[RequestControlSystemTerminateOperation]()
        ELSE NULL
    END;
    RETURN @statusName;

END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey] 
(
    @statusName NVARCHAR(448)
)

RETURNS SMALLINT

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    /* NOTE: Synchronize modifications to this function with modifications to the 
    *   Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices.WSResourceManagementRequestStatusType Enumeration in the server C# code, and 
    *   with the following SQL code:
    *   [fim].[GetRequestStatusName] function
    *   [fim].[RequestStatus*] constant string functions
    *   [fim].[IsRequestStatus*] boolean functions
    */

    DECLARE @statusKey SMALLINT;

    -- DESIGN POINT: The order of this list shows the order of events in the request dispatching pipe.
    SELECT @statusKey = 
    CASE
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusNotFound]()                 THEN  -1
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusDenied]()                   THEN   0   --Denied can be marked up until Committed()
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusValidating]()               THEN   1
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceling]()                THEN   2   --Canceling can be marked up until Completed if current state is not final.
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusValidated]()                THEN   3
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusAuthenticating]()           THEN   4
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusAuthenticated]()            THEN   5
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusAuthorizing]()              THEN   6
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusAuthorized]()               THEN   7
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusFailed]()                   THEN   8
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceled]()                 THEN   9   
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusCommitted]()                THEN  10
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing]()   THEN  11   -- Can be marked up until Completed if current state is not final.
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessing]()           THEN  12
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessingError]()      THEN  13
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]()                THEN  14
        ELSE NULL
    END;

    RETURN @statusKey;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetRequestStatusKeysOfTypeFinal]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetRequestStatusKeysOfTypeFinal] ()

RETURNS @result TABLE
(
	[RequestStatusKey]  SMALLINT
)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
	
	INSERT @result
	SELECT 0 -- [RequestStatusDenied]() 
	UNION
	SELECT 8 -- [RequestStatusFailed]() 
	UNION 
	SELECT 9 -- [RequestStatusCanceled]()               
	UNION
	SELECT 11 -- [RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing]() 
	UNION 
	SELECT 13 -- [RequestStatusPostProcessingError]() 
	UNION
	SELECT 14 -- [RequestStatusCompleted]() 

	RETURN;
END
GO

	[RequestStatusKey]  SMALLINT
)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
	
	INSERT @result
	SELECT 1 -- [RequestStatusValidating]() 
	UNION
	SELECT 2 -- [RequestStatusCanceling]()
	UNION 
	SELECT 3 -- [RequestStatusValidated]()               
	UNION
	SELECT 4 -- [RequestStatusAuthenticating]() 
	UNION 
	SELECT 5 -- [RequestStatusAuthenticated]()  
	UNION
	SELECT 6 -- [RequestStatusAuthorizing]()
	UNION 
	SELECT 7  -- [RequestStatusAuthorized]()  
	UNION
	SELECT 10 -- [RequestStatusCommitted]() 
	UNION 
	SELECT 12 -- [RequestStatusPostProcessing]() 

	RETURN;
END

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetRequestStatusName]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetRequestStatusName] 
(
    @statusKey SMALLINT
)

RETURNS NVARCHAR(32)

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    /* NOTE: Synchronize modifications to this function with modifications to the 
    *   Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices.WSResourceManagementRequestStatusType Enumeration in the server C# code, and 
    *   with the following SQL code:
    *   [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey] function
    *   [fim].[RequestStatus*] constant string functions
    *   [fim].[IsRequestStatus*] boolean functions
    */

    DECLARE @statusName NVARCHAR(32);

    -- DESIGN POINT: The order of this list shows the order of events in the request dispatching pipe.
    SELECT @statusName =
    CASE
        WHEN @statusKey =  -1  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusNotFound]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   0  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusDenied]()            --Denied can be marked up until Committed()
        WHEN @statusKey =   1  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusValidating]()        --Canceling can be marked up until Completed if current state is not final.
        WHEN @statusKey =   2  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCanceling]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   3  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusValidated]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   4  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusAuthenticating]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   5  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusAuthenticated]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   6  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusAuthorizing]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   7  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusAuthorized]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   8  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusFailed]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   9  THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCanceled]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   10 THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCommitted]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   11 THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing]()  -- Can be marked up until Completed if current state is not final.
        WHEN @statusKey =   12 THEN [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessing]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   13 THEN [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessingError]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   14 THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]()
        ELSE NULL
    END;
    RETURN @statusName;

END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetSetPartitionActivationThreshold]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetSetPartitionActivationThreshold]()
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @setPartitionActivationThresholdPropertyName NVARCHAR(448),
        @result INT,
        @numericValue FLOAT,
        @value NVARCHAR(MAX);
            
    SELECT 
        @setPartitionActivationThresholdPropertyName = N'SetPartitionActivationThreshold',
        @result = 1000;

    IF EXISTS
    (                
        SELECT [property].[PropertyName]
        FROM [fim].[SystemProperty] AS [property]
        WHERE        [property].[PropertyName] = @setPartitionActivationThresholdPropertyName
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @value = [property].[PropertyValue]
        FROM [fim].[SystemProperty] AS [property]
        WHERE        [property].[PropertyName] = @setPartitionActivationThresholdPropertyName;
        
        IF ISNUMERIC(@value) = 1
        BEGIN
            SELECT @numericValue = CAST(@value AS FLOAT);
            IF @numericValue <= 2147483647.0
            BEGIN
                SELECT @result = CAST(@numericValue AS INT);
            END
        END
    END

    RETURN @result;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetSetPartitionTolerance]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetSetPartitionTolerance]()
RETURNS TINYINT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @candidateResult TINYINT,
        @setPartitionTolerancePropertyName NVARCHAR(448),
        @result TINYINT,
        @numericValue FLOAT,
        @threshold TINYINT,
        @value NVARCHAR(MAX);
            
    SELECT 
        @setPartitionTolerancePropertyName = N'SetPartitionTolerance',
        @result = 10;

    IF EXISTS
    (                
        SELECT [property].[PropertyName]
        FROM [fim].[SystemProperty] AS [property]
        WHERE        [property].[PropertyName] = @setPartitionTolerancePropertyName
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @value = [property].[PropertyValue]
        FROM [fim].[SystemProperty] AS [property]
        WHERE        [property].[PropertyName] = @setPartitionTolerancePropertyName;
        
        IF ISNUMERIC(@value) = 1
        BEGIN
            SELECT @numericValue = CAST(@value AS FLOAT);
            IF @numericValue <= 100.0
            BEGIN
                SELECT @candidateResult = CAST(@numericValue AS TINYINT);
                
                SELECT @threshold = [fim].[GetSetPartitionThreshold]();
                IF @candidateResult <= @threshold
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @result = @candidateResult;
                END
            END
        END
    END

    RETURN @result;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetSystemResourceRetentionTimeInDays]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetSystemResourceRetentionTimeInDays]()
RETURNS BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @systemResourceRetentionConfigurationTypeKey SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @retentionPeriodAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    
    DECLARE @defaultRetentionPeriodInDays BIGINT;
    DECLARE @retentionPeriodInDays BIGINT;
    
    SELECT
        @systemResourceRetentionConfigurationTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'SystemResourceRetentionConfiguration'),
        @retentionPeriodAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RetentionPeriod'),
        @defaultRetentionPeriodInDays = [fim].[GetDefaultSystemResourceRetentionTimeInDays]();
  
    SELECT @retentionPeriodInDays = MAX(vi.[ValueInteger])
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS vi
    WHERE vi.[ObjectTypeKey] = @systemResourceRetentionConfigurationTypeKey
        AND vi.[AttributeKey] = @retentionPeriodAttributeKey;
  
    IF
    (
        (@retentionPeriodInDays IS NULL)
        OR
        (@retentionPeriodInDays < 0)
        OR
        (@retentionPeriodInDays > 365)
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @retentionPeriodInDays = @defaultRetentionPeriodInDays;
    END
 
 RETURN @retentionPeriodInDays;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey] 
(
    @statusName NVARCHAR(448)
)

RETURNS TINYINT

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    /* NOTE: Synchronize modifications to this function with modifications to the 
    *   Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices.WSResourceManagement.WorkflowInstanceResourceStatus Enumeration in the server C# code, and 
    *   with the following SQL code:
    *   [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusName] function
    *   [fim].[WorkflowStatus*] constant string functions
    *   [fim].[IsWorkflowStatus*] boolean functions
    */

    DECLARE @statusKey TINYINT;

    SELECT @statusKey = 
    CASE
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[WorkflowStatusRunning]()          THEN   0
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[WorkflowStatusCompleted]()        THEN   1
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[WorkflowStatusSuspended]()        THEN   2
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[WorkflowStatusTerminated]()       THEN   3
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[WorkflowStatusCreated]()          THEN   4
        --NOTE .NET enumeration WorkflowStatus  uses the first 5 noted above.
        --We are extending it as follows
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[WorkflowStatusPending]()          THEN 102
        WHEN @statusName = [fim].[WorkflowStatusCanceled]()         THEN 103
        When @statusName = [fim].[WorkflowStatusDidNotExecute]()    THEN 104
        ELSE NULL
    END;

    RETURN @statusKey;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusName]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusName] 
(
    @statusKey TINYINT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(32)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    /* NOTE: Synchronize modifications to this function with modifications to the 
    *   Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices.WSResourceManagement.WorkflowInstanceResourceStatus Enumeration in the server C# code, and 
    *   with the following SQL code:
    *   [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey] function
    *   [fim].[WorkflowStatus*] constant string functions
    *   [fim].[IsWorkflowStatus*] boolean functions
    */

    DECLARE @statusName NVARCHAR(32);

    SELECT @statusName =
    CASE
        WHEN @statusKey =   0 THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusRunning]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   1 THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusCompleted]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   2 THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusSuspended]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   3 THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusTerminated]()
        WHEN @statusKey =   4 THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusCreated]()
        --NOTE .NET enumeration WorkflowStatus  uses the first 5 noted above.
        --We are extending it as follows
        WHEN @statusKey = 102 THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusPending]()
        WHEN @statusKey = 103 THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusCanceled]()
        WHEN @statusKey = 104 THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusDidNotExecute]()
        ELSE NULL
    END;

    RETURN @statusName;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[HasReportingInitialSynchronizationCompleted]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[HasReportingInitialSynchronizationCompleted]()
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE @defaultDataWarehouseSubscriptionKey    SMALLINT,
            @hasInitialSynchronizationCompleted     BIT,
            @falseFlag                              BIT,
            @trueFlag                               BIT;

    SELECT 
        @defaultDataWarehouseSubscriptionKey    = 1,
        @falseFlag                              = CONVERT(BIT, 0),
        @trueFlag                               = CONVERT(BIT, 1),
        @hasInitialSynchronizationCompleted     = @falseFlag;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [fim].[ExportSubscription] AS [es]
        WHERE 
                [es].[LastInitialized] IS NOT NULL
          AND   [es].[SubscriptionKey] = @defaultDataWarehouseSubscriptionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @hasInitialSynchronizationCompleted = @trueFlag; 
    END

    RETURN @hasInitialSynchronizationCompleted;
END

        WHEN @typeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Approval') THEN 1

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[IsGroupOfTypeDeferred]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[IsGroupOfTypeDeferred] (@groupKey BIGINT)

RETURNS BIT

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE 
        @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                          BIT,
        @groupObjectTypeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @result                             BIT,
        @trueFlag                           BIT;
        
    SELECT
        @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmDeferredEvaluation'),
        @falseFlag                      =   CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @groupObjectTypeKey             =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Group'),
        @result                         =   CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag                       =   CONVERT(BIT,1);

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb]
        WHERE [ovb].[ObjectKey] = @groupKey
          AND [ovb].[ObjectTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey
          AND [ovb].[AttributeKey] = @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @result = [ovb].[ValueBoolean]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb]
        WHERE [ovb].[ObjectKey] = @groupKey
          AND [ovb].[ObjectTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey
          AND [ovb].[AttributeKey] = @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey
    END

    RETURN @result;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[IsObjectTypeSynchronized]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[IsObjectTypeSynchronized]
(
	@objectTypeKey SMALLINT
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    
    DECLARE @result BIT;
    DECLARE @synchronizationFilterObjectID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
 

    --Get the SyncObjectFilterKey.
    SELECT @synchronizationFilterObjectID = [fim].[GetSynchronizationFilterObjectID]();

    
    --Select 0 or 1 indicating if the ObjectType key is filtered
    SELECT @result = SIGN(COUNT([i].[Key])) 
    FROM 
        [fim].[Objects] AS [o] 
    INNER JOIN
        [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [t]
	        ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [t].[Key] 
    INNER JOIN
        [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [r] 
	        ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = r.ObjectTypeKey
    INNER JOIN
        [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [i]
	        ON [i].[ObjectKey] = [r].[ValueReference] 
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectID] = @synchronizationFilterObjectID
        AND [i].[Key] = @objectTypeKey;
 

    RETURN @result;
    
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[IsPrimaryReplica]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[IsPrimaryReplica] 
(
	@DatabaseName sysname
)

RETURNS TINYINT

BEGIN
	-- SQL Server 2008 does not support Always on High Availability feature thus always primary
	IF OBJECT_ID(N'sys.dm_hadr_availability_replica_state', N'FN') IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RETURN 1;
	END
	
	-- This function supported from SQL Server 2014
	IF OBJECT_ID(N'sys.fn_hadr_is_primary_replica', N'FN') IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		RETURN [sys].[fn_hadr_is_primary_replica]( @DatabaseName );
	END
	
    DECLARE @HadrRole TINYINT;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [sys].[databases] WHERE name = @DatabaseName)
    BEGIN
        -- Return role status from sys.dm_hadr_availability_replica_states
        SELECT @HadrRole = ars.role
        FROM [sys].[dm_hadr_availability_replica_states] ars
        INNER JOIN [sys].[databases] dbs
            ON ars.replica_id = dbs.replica_id
        WHERE dbs.name = @DatabaseName;
        -- @DatabaseName exists but does not belong to an AG so return 1
        IF @HadrRole IS NULL RETURN 1;
        RETURN @HadrRole;
    END
	-- @DatabaseName does not exist so return 0
    RETURN 0;
END;
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeCommittedOrFailed] (@requestStatus NVARCHAR(448))
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @result BIT;

    SELECT @result = 
    CASE
        WHEN @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusDenied]()                 THEN 1
        WHEN @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusFailed]()                 THEN 1
        WHEN @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceled]()               THEN 1
        WHEN @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing]() THEN 1
        WHEN @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusCommitted]()              THEN 1
        WHEN @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]()              THEN 1
        WHEN @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessing]()         THEN 1
        WHEN @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessingError]()    THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END;

    RETURN @result;
END

GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[IsServiceBrokerEnabled] 
(
    @databaseName NVARCHAR(128)
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE 
        @falseFlag  BIT,
        @result     BIT,
        @trueFlag   BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    SELECT @result = @falseFlag    
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [name] 
        FROM [sys].[databases]
        WHERE
                [name] = @databaseName
            AND [is_broker_enabled] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @result = @trueFlag;
    END    

    RETURN @result;
END

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[NextRetryDateForWorkItem]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[NextRetryDateForWorkItem]
(
    @retryCount SMALLINT
)
RETURNS DATETIME
AS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Internal function to set next retry date for a work item
-- Used in EnqueueWorkItem.
-- Returns the date when work item execute attempt can be done.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
	DECLARE @minutes SMALLINT
	
	SELECT @minutes =
        CASE
            WHEN @retryCount < 2 THEN 0
            WHEN @retryCount < 3 THEN 2
            WHEN @retryCount < 4 THEN 60
            ELSE                      1440
        END;

    RETURN DATEADD(minute, @minutes, GETUTCDATE())
END
GO

GO

CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[ObjectIDFromObjectKey]
(@ObjectKey BIGINT)
RETURNS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER 
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @ObjectID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
    
    SELECT TOP 1 @ObjectID=[o].[ValueIdentifier]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
    WHERE [o].[ObjectKey] = @ObjectKey;
    
    RETURN @ObjectID;
END
GO

GO
--********************************************************

--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName]
(
	@ObjectTypeName NVARCHAR(448)
)
RETURNS SMALLINT
AS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Internal function to get an object's object type key. 
-- Used when creating an object.
-- Returns NULL if the object does not exist.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
    DECLARE @ObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    
    SELECT	@ObjectTypeKey = oti.[Key] 
	FROM	[fim].ObjectTypeInternal AS oti
	WHERE	oti.[Name] = @ObjectTypeName;
	
    RETURN @ObjectTypeKey;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey]
(
	@ObjectKey BIGINT
)
RETURNS SMALLINT
AS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Function to get an object's object type key from the ObjectType row.
-- Used for attribute value add stored procs, where object already exists.
-- Returns NULL if the object does not exist.
-- This assumes that the ObjectType attribute key is 1, 
-- which is ensured in the ObjectSchemaPopulateFromConfig stored proc during setup.
-- For internal use.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
    DECLARE @ObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;

    SELECT	@ObjectTypeKey = o.ObjectTypeKey 
	FROM	Objects AS o 
	WHERE	ObjectKey = @ObjectKey;
    
    RETURN @ObjectTypeKey
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[OkToClearWorkflowInstanceHostMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[OkToClearWorkflowInstanceHostMessage] 
(
    @objectKey BIGINT
)

RETURNS BIT

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    DECLARE @result BIT;
    SELECT @result = 0;

    --DESIGN POINT: This function is meant to be called by all stored procedures that update
    --the [fim].WorkflowInstance table to update status except if the workflow is marked Finished
    --In that case, the WorkflowControlMessage field should remain unchanged because it may have affected the
    --outcome of the workflow so we may need it for audit purposes.
    --NOTE: If we have a cancel message leave it active, so that the host can attempt to cancel this
    --running workflow since it has not yet reached a final state.

    IF
    ( 
        EXISTS
        ( 
            SELECT 
                [wi].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi] WITH(UPDLOCK,ROWLOCK)
            WHERE 
                    [wi].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
                AND [wi].[Finished] = 0
                AND [wi].[WorkflowControlMessage] != [fim].[GetWorkflowControlMessageKey]([fim].[WorkflowControlMessageCancel]())
         )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @result = 1;
    END

    RETURN @result;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[ParseXmlBinary]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[ParseXmlBinary]
( 
 @base64String NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
RETURNS VARBINARY(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

 DECLARE @result VARBINARY(MAX)
 SELECT
  @result =
   cast(N'' as xml).value('xs:base64Binary(sql:variable("@base64String"))', 'VARBINARY(MAX)');

 RETURN @result;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[ParseXmlDate]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[ParseXmlDate]
( 
 @xmlDateString NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
RETURNS DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

 DECLARE @string NVARCHAR(MAX);
 SELECT
  @string = 
   CASE
    WHEN (SUBSTRING(@xmlDateString,LEN(@xmlDateString),1) = 'Z') THEN @xmlDateString
    ELSE @xmlDateString + 'Z'
   END;
 
 DECLARE @result DATETIME;
 SELECT
  @result = CAST(('<v>' + @string + '</v>') AS XML).value('xs:dateTime(/v[1])', 'datetime');

 RETURN @result;
END
GO
