/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[ShouldRetainRequestCache]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[ShouldRetainRequestCache] ()

RETURNS BIT

AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @retainRequestCachePropertyName NVARCHAR(448),
        @shouldRetainRequestCache BIT;
            
    SELECT 
        @retainRequestCachePropertyName = N'ShouldEnableRequestCacheRetention',
        @shouldRetainRequestCache = 0;

    -- if there is valid property in the SystemProperty table
    -- with a value of 1 return true; return false otherwise.            
    IF EXISTS
    (				
        SELECT 1
        FROM [fim].[SystemProperty]
        WHERE 
                [PropertyName] = @retainRequestCachePropertyName
            AND [PropertyValue] = N'1'
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @shouldRetainRequestCache = 1
    END

    RETURN @shouldRetainRequestCache;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [fim].[SplitString]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [fim].[SplitString] (@string NVARCHAR(MAX), @stringDelimiter NVARCHAR(32))
RETURNS @finalStrings TABLE
(
    [String] NVARCHAR(512)
)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    -- loop through the @string looking for the delimiter until you run out of delimiters.
    DECLARE @commaPosition INT,
            @lengthStringDelimiter INT,
            @startIndex INT;
            
    SELECT  @lengthStringDelimiter = LEN(@stringDelimiter),
            @startIndex = 0;
    
    WHILE(1 = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @commaPosition = CHARINDEX(@stringDelimiter, @string, @startIndex);
        IF(@commaPosition > 0)
        BEGIN
            INSERT @finalStrings
            SELECT SUBSTRING(@string, @startIndex, @commaPosition - @startIndex);
            
            -- Move the start of the next search to the first char past the delimiter
            -- of the previous word found.
            SELECT @startIndex = @commaPosition + @lengthStringDelimiter;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END
    END
    -- insert the final string
    INSERT @finalStrings
    SELECT SUBSTRING(@string, @startIndex, LEN(@string) - @startIndex + 1);
   
    RETURN;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]()
RETURNS BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @exportKey  BIGINT;
    
    SELECT TOP 1 @exportKey = [export].[ExportKey]
    FROM [sync].[Export] AS [export]
    ORDER BY
            [export].[ExportKey] DESC;
    
    RETURN @exportKey;
END
GO

)

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageKey]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageKey]
(
    @exportKey          BIGINT,
    @messageIdentifier  NVARCHAR(448)
)
RETURNS BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @exportMessageKey  BIGINT;
    
    SELECT TOP 1 @exportMessageKey = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
    WHERE
            [message].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
        AND [message].[MessageIdentifier] = @messageIdentifier;
    
    RETURN @exportMessageKey;
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [sync].[GetExportIdentifier]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/

CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[GetExportIdentifier]()
RETURNS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [sync].[GetExportItemProcessingProgress]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[GetExportItemProcessingProgress]
(
    @action NVARCHAR(448) = NULL
)
RETURNS BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE
        @completedItemTotal         BIGINT,
        @exportMessageTypeKey       SMALLINT,        
        @itemTotal                  BIGINT,
        @result                     BIGINT,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;
        
    SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);

    IF @action IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @exportMessageTypeKey = [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageTypeKey](@action);
            
        SELECT @itemTotal = COUNT([item].[ExportItemKey])
        FROM [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportItemKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [itemMessage].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE   
                [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKey
            AND [itemMessage].[Primary] = @trueFlag;
        
        SELECT @completedItemTotal = COUNT([item].[ExportItemKey])
        FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportItemKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [itemMessage].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE   
                [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKey
            AND [itemMessage].[Primary] = @trueFlag;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT @itemTotal = COUNT([item].[ExportItemKey])
        FROM [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [item];
        
        SELECT @completedItemTotal = COUNT([item].[ExportItemKey])
        FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [item];
    END
    
    SELECT @result =  @itemTotal - @completedItemTotal;
    
    IF @result < 0
    BEGIN
        SELECT @result = 0;
    END
    
    RETURN @result;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress]
(
    @action             NVARCHAR(448),
    @sentMessagesOnly   BIT = 0
)
RETURNS BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE
        @completedMessageTotal      BIGINT,
        @exportMessageTypeKey       SMALLINT,
        @messageTotal               BIGINT,
        @result                     BIGINT,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;
        
    SELECT
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    IF @action IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @exportMessageTypeKey = [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageTypeKey](@action);
    
        IF @sentMessagesOnly = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageTotal = COUNT([sent].[ExportMessageKey])
            FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
                ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey]  = @exportMessageTypeKey;
            
            SELECT @completedMessageTotal = COUNT([sent].[ExportMessageKey])
            FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
                ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey]  = @exportMessageTypeKey;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageTotal = COUNT([message].[ExportMessageKey])
            FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            WHERE       [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey]  = @exportMessageTypeKey;
            
            SELECT @completedMessageTotal = COUNT([completed].[ExportMessageKey])
            FROM [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
                ON  [completed].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey]  = @exportMessageTypeKey;
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN   
        IF @sentMessagesOnly = @trueFlag
        BEGIN     
            SELECT @messageTotal = COUNT([sent].[ExportMessageKey])
            FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent];
            
            SELECT @completedMessageTotal = COUNT([sent].[ExportMessageKey])
            FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey];
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageTotal = COUNT([message].[ExportMessageKey])
            FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message];
            
            SELECT @completedMessageTotal = COUNT([message].[ExportMessageKey])
            FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey];
        END
    END
    
    SELECT @result =  @messageTotal - @completedMessageTotal;
    
    IF @result < 0
    BEGIN
        SELECT @result = 0;
    END
    
    RETURN @result;
END
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[GetExportMessageTypeDescriptionByIdentifier]
(

AS
BEGIN

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [sync].[GetFullImportEndKey]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[GetFullImportEndKey]
(
)
RETURNS BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE 
        @lastObjectKey BIGINT,
        @synchronizationFilterObjectKey BIGINT,
        @synchronizeObjectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT;

    SELECT
        @synchronizationFilterObjectKey = [fim].[GetSynchronizationFilterObjectKey](),
        @synchronizeObjectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'SynchronizeObjectType');

    SELECT @lastObjectKey = MAX([objects].[ObjectKey])
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [types]
        ON  [objects].[ObjectTypeKey] = [types].[Key]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [references]
        ON  [types].[ObjectKey] = [references].[ValueReference]
    WHERE
            [references].[ObjectKey] = @synchronizationFilterObjectKey 
        AND [references].[AttributeKey] = @synchronizeObjectTypeAttributeKey;
    
	RETURN @lastObjectKey
END
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[HasExportAborted]()

BEGIN

--*                                                      *

(
    @messageIdentifier  NVARCHAR(448)

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [sync].[IsMultiTargetMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[IsMultiTargetMessage]
(
    @exportMessageKey   BIGINT
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE 
        @count      BIGINT,
        @falseFlag  BIT,
        @result     BIT,
        @trueFlag   BIT;
        
    SELECT
        @count = 0,
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);

    SELECT @count = COUNT([target].[TargetObjectKey]) 
    FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
    WHERE       [target].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey;
    
    SELECT @result = 
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(@count,0) > 1 THEN @trueFlag
         ELSE @falseFlag
        END
    
	RETURN @result;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [sync].[TransmissionExists]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[TransmissionExists]
(
    @exportMessageKey   BIGINT
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE 
        @falseFlag  BIT,
        @result     BIT,
        @trueFlag   BIT;
        
    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    SELECT @result = @falseFlag;
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [export].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [export]
        WHERE       [export].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @result = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    RETURN @result;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [sync].[ValidateExportedObject]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [sync].[ValidateExportedObject]
(
    @objectID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey    SMALLINT,
        @exportKey                  BIGINT,
        @result                     BIT;

    SELECT 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey](),
        @result = 0;
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [new].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportNewObject] AS [new]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            ON  [new].[ObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [new].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
            AND [object].[ObjectID] = @objectID
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [dateValue].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [dateValue]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            ON  [dateValue].[ObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
            AND [dateValue].[ObjectTypeKey] = [object].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [dateValue].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
            AND [dateValue].[SequenceID] = 0
            AND [dateValue].[Multivalued] = 0
            AND [object].[ObjectID] = @objectID
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @result = 1;
    END
    
    RETURN @result;
END
GO

/****** Object:  View [fim].[Attributes]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [fim].[Attributes]
AS
WITH DisplayNames ([ObjectKey], [ValueString]) AS
	(
		SELECT 
			s.[ObjectKey],
			s.[ValueString]		
		FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS s WITH (FORCESEEK)
		JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] ai
			ON ai.[Key] = s.[AttributeKey]
			AND ai.[Name] = N'DisplayName' 
	),
	Descriptions (ObjectKey, ValueString) AS
	(
		SELECT 
			s.ObjectKey,
			s.ValueString		
		FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS s WITH (FORCESEEK)
		JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] ai
			ON ai.[Key] = s.[AttributeKey]
			AND ai.[Name] = N'Description' 
	)
	SELECT
		ai.[Key],
		ai.[Name],
		ai.[ObjectKey],
		ai.[DataType],
		ai.[Multivalued],
		d1.[ValueString] AS [DisplayName],
		d2.[ValueString] AS [Description]
	FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS ai
	JOIN [fim].[Objects] o
	    ON o.[ObjectKey] = ai.[ObjectKey]
	LEFT JOIN DisplayNames AS d1
		ON ai.[ObjectKey] = d1.[ObjectKey]
	LEFT JOIN Descriptions AS d2
		ON ai.[ObjectKey] = d2.[ObjectKey];
GO

GO
CREATE VIEW [fim].[SchemaObject]
AS
(
    SELECT     
        oti.[Key] AS ObjectTypeKey, 
        oti.[Name]  AS Name, 
        s.[ValueString] AS DisplayName
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS oti		 
    JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] s 
		ON s.[ObjectKey] = oti.[ObjectKey]
    JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] ai 
		ON ai.[Key] = s.[AttributeKey]
		AND ai.[Name] = 'DisplayName'
);

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[DeleteInstance]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DeleteInstance]
 @id uniqueIdentifier,
 @hostId uniqueIdentifier,
 @lockTimeout int,
 @result int output
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

 SET NOCOUNT ON;

 DECLARE @now datetime;
 SET @now = getutcdate();

 DELETE FROM [dbo].[InstanceData]
  WHERE (id = @id) AND ((@lockTimeout < 0) OR ((lockOwner = @hostId) AND (lockExpiration >= @now)));

 IF @@rowcount = 1
  SET @result = 0; -- Success
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[InstanceData] WHERE id = @id)
   SET @result = 2; -- Could not acquire lock
  ELSE
   SET @result = 1; -- Instance not found
 END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[InsertCompletedScope]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[InsertCompletedScope]
@instanceID uniqueidentifier,
@completedScopeID uniqueidentifier,
@state image
As

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
SET NOCOUNT ON

  UPDATE [dbo].[CompletedScope] WITH(ROWLOCK UPDLOCK) 
      SET state = @state,
      modified = GETUTCDATE()
      WHERE completedScopeID=@completedScopeID 

  IF ( @@ROWCOUNT = 0 )
  BEGIN
   --Insert Operation
   INSERT INTO [dbo].[CompletedScope] WITH(ROWLOCK)
   VALUES(@instanceID, @completedScopeID, @state, GETUTCDATE()) 
  END

  RETURN
RETURN
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[InsertInstance]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[InsertInstance]
 @id uniqueidentifier,
 @instance image = NULL,
 @instanceXml xml = NULL,
 @unlockInstance bit,
 @hostId uniqueidentifier,
 @lockTimeout int,
 @result int OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

 SET NOCOUNT ON;

 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

 SET @result = 0;

 DECLARE @now datetime, @lockExpiration datetime, @newOwner uniqueidentifier;
 SET @now = getutcdate();
 
 IF @lockTimeout < 0 OR @unlockInstance = 'TRUE'
 BEGIN
  SET @lockExpiration = NULL;
  SET @newOwner = NULL;
 END
 ELSE 
 BEGIN
  SET @newOwner = @hostId;

  IF @lockTimeout = 0
   SET @lockExpiration = '9999-12-31T23:59:59';
  ELSE
   SET @lockExpiration = dateadd(second, @lockTimeout, @now);
 END

 INSERT INTO [dbo].[InstanceData] (id, instance, instanceXml, created, lastUpdated, lockOwner, lockExpiration)
  VALUES (@id, @instance, @instanceXml, @now, @now, @newOwner, @lockExpiration);

 IF @@rowcount = 0
 BEGIN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[InstanceData] WHERE id = @id)
   SET @result = 1; -- The instance already existed.
  ELSE
   SET @result = 2; -- Some other non-fatal error caused us not to insert
 END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[InsertInstanceState]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
Create Procedure [dbo].[InsertInstanceState]
@uidInstanceID uniqueidentifier,
@state image,
@status int,
@unlocked int,
@blocked int,
@info ntext,
@ownerID uniqueidentifier = NULL,
@ownedUntil datetime = NULL,
@nextTimer datetime,
@result int output,
@currentOwnerID uniqueidentifier output
As
    declare @localized_string_InsertInstanceState_Failed_Ownership nvarchar(256)
    set @localized_string_InsertInstanceState_Failed_Ownership = N'Instance ownership conflict'
    set @result = 0
    set @currentOwnerID = @ownerID
    declare @now datetime
    set @now = GETUTCDATE()

    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
    set nocount on

    IF @status=1 OR @status=3
    BEGIN
 DELETE FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] WHERE uidInstanceID=@uidInstanceID AND ((ownerID = @ownerID AND ownedUntil>=@now) OR (ownerID IS NULL AND @ownerID IS NULL ))
 if ( @@ROWCOUNT = 0 )
 begin
  set @currentOwnerID = NULL
      select  @currentOwnerID=ownerID from [dbo].[InstanceState] Where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID
  if ( @currentOwnerID IS NOT NULL )
  begin -- cannot delete the instance state because of an ownership conflict
   -- RAISERROR(@localized_string_InsertInstanceState_Failed_Ownership, 16, -1)    
   set @result = -2
   return
  end
 end
 else
 BEGIN
  DELETE FROM [dbo].[CompletedScope] WHERE uidInstanceID=@uidInstanceID
 end
    END
    
    ELSE BEGIN

       if not exists ( Select 1 from [dbo].[InstanceState] Where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID )
    BEGIN
     --Insert Operation
     IF @unlocked = 0
     begin
        Insert into [dbo].[InstanceState] 
        Values(@uidInstanceID,@state,@status,@unlocked,@blocked,@info,@now,@ownerID,@ownedUntil,@nextTimer) 
     end
     else
     begin
        Insert into [dbo].[InstanceState] 
        Values(@uidInstanceID,@state,@status,@unlocked,@blocked,@info,@now,null,null,@nextTimer) 
     end
    END
    
    ELSE BEGIN

    IF @unlocked = 0
    begin
     Update [dbo].[InstanceState]  
     Set state = @state,
      status = @status,
      unlocked = @unlocked,
      blocked = @blocked,
      info = @info,
      modified = @now,
      ownedUntil = @ownedUntil,
      nextTimer = @nextTimer
     Where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID AND ((ownerID = @ownerID AND ownedUntil>=@now) OR (ownerID IS NULL AND @ownerID IS NULL ))
     if ( @@ROWCOUNT = 0 )
     BEGIN
      -- RAISERROR(@localized_string_InsertInstanceState_Failed_Ownership, 16, -1)
      select @currentOwnerID=ownerID from [dbo].[InstanceState] Where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID  
      set @result = -2
      return
     END
    end
    else
    begin
     Update [dbo].[InstanceState]  
     Set state = @state,
      status = @status,
      unlocked = @unlocked,
      blocked = @blocked,
      info = @info,
      modified = @now,
      ownerID = NULL,
      ownedUntil = NULL,
      nextTimer = @nextTimer
     Where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID AND ((ownerID = @ownerID AND ownedUntil>=@now) OR (ownerID IS NULL AND @ownerID IS NULL ))
     if ( @@ROWCOUNT = 0 )
     BEGIN
      -- RAISERROR(@localized_string_InsertInstanceState_Failed_Ownership, 16, -1)
      select @currentOwnerID=ownerID from [dbo].[InstanceState] Where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID  
      set @result = -2
      return
     END
    end
    
    END


    END
  RETURN
Return
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[LoadInstance]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[LoadInstance]
 @id uniqueidentifier,
 @lockInstance bit,
 @hostId uniqueidentifier,
 @lockTimeout int,
 @result int output
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

 SET NOCOUNT ON;

 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

 DECLARE @createdTransaction bit;
 
 DECLARE @now datetime, @lockExpiration datetime;
 SET @now = getutcdate();
 SET @result = 0;

 IF (@lockTimeout < 0) OR (@lockInstance = 'FALSE')
 BEGIN
  SELECT 
   'instance' = instance,
   'instanceXml' = instanceXml,
   'isXml' = CASE
    WHEN instanceXml is NOT NULL THEN 1
    ELSE 0
   END
   FROM [dbo].[InstanceData]
   WHERE id = @id;

  IF @@rowcount = 0
   SET @result = 1; -- Instance not found
 END
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  IF @lockTimeout = 0
   SET @lockExpiration = '9999-12-31T23:59:59';
  ELSE 
   SET @lockExpiration = dateadd(second, @lockTimeout, @now);

  IF @@trancount = 0
  BEGIN
   SET @createdTransaction = 'TRUE';
   BEGIN TRANSACTION;
  END

  UPDATE [dbo].[InstanceData] SET
   lockOwner = @hostId,
   lockExpiration = @lockExpiration
   WHERE (id = @id) AND ((lockOwner is NULL) OR (lockOwner = @hostId) OR (lockExpiration < @now));

  IF @@rowcount = 1
  BEGIN
   SELECT 
    instance,
    instanceXml,
    'isXml' = CASE
     WHEN instanceXml is NOT NULL THEN 1
     ELSE 0
    END
    FROM [dbo].[InstanceData]
    WHERE id = @id;

   IF @@error <> 0
   BEGIN
    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
    RETURN
   END
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN 
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[InstanceData] WHERE id = @id)
    SET @result = 2; -- Could not acquire lock
   ELSE
    SET @result = 1; -- Instance not found
  END

  IF @createdTransaction = 'TRUE'
   COMMIT TRANSACTION
 END
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[RetrieveInstanceState]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
Create Procedure [dbo].[RetrieveInstanceState]
@uidInstanceID uniqueidentifier,
@ownerID uniqueidentifier = NULL,
@ownedUntil datetime = NULL,
@result int output,
@currentOwnerID uniqueidentifier output
As
Begin
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    declare @localized_string_RetrieveInstanceState_Failed_Ownership nvarchar(256)
    set @localized_string_RetrieveInstanceState_Failed_Ownership = N'Instance ownership conflict'
    set @result = 0
    set @currentOwnerID = @ownerID

 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ
 BEGIN TRANSACTION
 
    -- Possible workflow status: 0 for executing; 1 for completed; 2 for suspended; 3 for terminated; 4 for invalid

 if @ownerID IS NOT NULL -- if id is null then just loading readonly state, so ignore the ownership check
 begin
    Update [dbo].[InstanceState]  
    set ownerID = @ownerID,
    ownedUntil = @ownedUntil
    where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID AND (    ownerID = @ownerID 
              OR ownerID IS NULL 
              OR ownedUntil<GETUTCDATE()
             )
    if ( @@ROWCOUNT = 0 )
    BEGIN
   -- RAISERROR(@localized_string_RetrieveInstanceState_Failed_Ownership, 16, -1)
   select @currentOwnerID=ownerID from [dbo].[InstanceState] Where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID 
   if (  @@ROWCOUNT = 0 )
    set @result = -1
   else
    set @result = -2
   GOTO DONE
    END
 end
 
    Select state from [dbo].[InstanceState]  
    Where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID
    
 set @result = @@ROWCOUNT;
    if ( @result = 0 )
 begin
  set @result = -1
  GOTO DONE
 end
 
DONE:
 COMMIT TRANSACTION
 RETURN

End
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[RetrieveNonblockingInstanceStateIds]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[RetrieveNonblockingInstanceStateIds]
@ownerID uniqueidentifier = NULL,
@ownedUntil datetime = NULL,
@now datetime
AS
    SELECT uidInstanceID FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] WITH (TABLOCK,UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
    WHERE blocked=0 AND status<>1 AND status<>3 AND status<>2 -- not blocked and not completed and not terminated and not suspended
   AND ( ownerID IS NULL OR ownedUntil<GETUTCDATE() )
    if ( @@ROWCOUNT > 0 )
    BEGIN
        -- lock the table entries that are returned
        Update [dbo].[InstanceState]  
        set ownerID = @ownerID,
     ownedUntil = @ownedUntil
        WHERE blocked=0 AND status<>1 AND status<>3 AND status<>2
   AND ( ownerID IS NULL OR ownedUntil<GETUTCDATE() )
 
    END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[UnlockInstance]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[UnlockInstance]
 @id uniqueIdentifier,
 @hostId uniqueIdentifier,
 @lockTimeout int,
 @result int output
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

 SET NOCOUNT ON;

 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

 DECLARE @now datetime;
 SET @now = getutcdate();

 UPDATE [dbo].[InstanceData] SET
  lockOwner = NULL,
  lockExpiration = NULL
  WHERE (id = @id) AND ((@lockTimeout < 0) OR ((lockOwner = @hostId) AND (lockExpiration >= @now)));

 IF @@rowcount = 1
  SET @result = 0; -- Success
 ELSE
 BEGIN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[InstanceData] WHERE id = @id)
   SET @result = 2; -- Did not have lock
  ELSE
   SET @result = 1; -- Instance not found
 END
END
GO

--********************************************************

--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *

Create Procedure [dbo].[UnlockInstanceState]
@uidInstanceID uniqueidentifier,
@ownerID uniqueidentifier = NULL
As

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
set nocount on

  Update [dbo].[InstanceState]  
  Set ownerID = NULL,
   ownedUntil = NULL
  Where uidInstanceID = @uidInstanceID AND ((ownerID = @ownerID AND ownedUntil>=GETUTCDATE()) OR (ownerID IS NULL AND @ownerID IS NULL ))

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[UpdateInstance]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[UpdateInstance]
 @id uniqueidentifier,
 @instance image = NULL,
 @instanceXml xml = NULL,
 @unlockInstance bit,
 @hostId uniqueidentifier,
 @lockTimeout int,
 @result int OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

 SET NOCOUNT ON;

 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

 SET @result = 0;

 DECLARE @now datetime, @lockExpiration datetime, @newOwner uniqueidentifier;
 SET @now = getutcdate();
 
 IF @lockTimeout < 0 OR @unlockInstance = 'TRUE'
 BEGIN
  SET @lockExpiration = NULL;
  SET @newOwner = NULL;
 END
 ELSE 
 BEGIN
  SET @newOwner = @hostId;

  IF @lockTimeout = 0
   SET @lockExpiration = '9999-12-31T23:59:59';
  ELSE
   SET @lockExpiration = dateadd(second, @lockTimeout, @now);
 END

 UPDATE [dbo].[InstanceData] SET
  instance = @instance,
  instanceXml = @instanceXml,
  lastUpdated = @now,
  lockOwner = @newOwner,
  lockExpiration = @lockExpiration
  WHERE (id = @id) AND ((@lockTimeout < 0) OR ((lockOwner = @hostId) AND (lockExpiration >= @now)));

 IF @@rowcount = 0
 BEGIN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[InstanceData] WHERE id = @id)
   SET @result = 2; -- Did not have lock
  ELSE
   SET @result = 1; -- Instance was not found in the database for update
 END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[AddSetMembershipCondition]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[AddSetMembershipCondition]
	@membershipConditionKey INT,
	@setKey BIGINT
AS
/*
 *	This procedure associates a membership condition with the filtered resource identified by @setKey.  
 *	The procedure is programmed so as not assume that the membership condition is not already associated with the resource.  
 *	As such, it disassociates the membership condition from the resource before attempting to associate the membership
 *	condition with the resource.  
 */
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	BEGIN TRANSACTION
	
		DELETE [fim].[SetMembershipCondition]
		WHERE
		        [SetKey] = @setKey
			AND [MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
		
		INSERT INTO [fim].[SetMembershipCondition]
		(
			[SetKey],
			[MembershipConditionKey],
			[Time]
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@setKey,
			@membershipConditionKey,
			GETUTCDATE()
		);
		
	COMMIT TRANSACTION
	
END
GO

BEGIN
--********************************************************

    DECLARE

            @filterAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Filter'),
            @groupObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Group'),
            @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold = 1000,
            @largeGroupSizeCriteria = 5000,
            @largeSetSizeCriteria = 10000,
            @operationAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Operation'),
            @parentAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Parent'),
            @queryCount = 0,
            @querySystemUser = CAST(N'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER),
            @recentChangesLimit = 1000000,
            @requestCount = 0,
            @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
            @requestParameterAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestParameter'),
            @requestStatusDetailAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatusDetail'),
            @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ServicePartitionName'),
            @setObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Set'),
            @slowQueryThresholdInMilliseconds = 40000,
            @targetAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Target'),
            @targetObjectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'TargetObjectType'),

            @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowStatusDetail'),
            @const100 = CAST(100 AS DECIMAL(10,2));
    
            SELECT @maxObjectKey = MAX([ObjectKey])

    /****************************************************************************************************************
    *
    * 0. Setup

    ****************************************************************************************************************/

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OperationAnalysis]') IS NOT NULL

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_DataStoreObjects]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN

            END;

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_GroupMembership]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_Request]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_Request]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestSetCorrection]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestSetCorrection]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_SetMembership]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_SetMembership]
            END;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestSetCorrection]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestSetCorrection]
            END;
                        
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_SetCorrectionCounts]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_SetCorrectionCounts]
            END;
                        
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_OperationsLoad]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_OperationsLoad]
            END;            
           
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_OperationsPeakLoad]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_OperationsPeakLoad]
            END;  
                        
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_AverageLoad]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_AverageLoad]
            END;
                  
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_MaximumLoad]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_MaximumLoad]
            END;

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_TableSizeData]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN

            END;

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RecentRequestHistory]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RecentRequestHistory]
            END;

            IF(@dropTempTablesOnly = 1)
            BEGIN
                RETURN;
            END

            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 0.B Setup Table to record results of this execution
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            CREATE TABLE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Sequence] INT IDENTITY(1,1),
                [Name] NVARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
                [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX),
                [Comment] NVARCHAR(MAX),
                [DetailsXml] XML,
                [DataSource] NVARCHAR(128)
            );

    /****************************************************************************************************************
    *
    * 1. Run Information 
    *
    ****************************************************************************************************************/

            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 1.A Instructions
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'Instructions',
                    N'see [DetailsXml]',
                    N'[DetailsXml] column has information on how to use this stored procedure and its results',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OperationAnalysis]';
                                
            WITH Instructions
            (
                [Sequence],
                [Name],
                [Instruction]
            )
            AS
            (
                SELECT  1,
                    N'Arguments',
                    N'@startTimeUTC, @endTimeUTC -- @startTimeUTC and @endTimeUTC gives the timespan to use for analysis, recommended use @endTimeUTC - @startTimeUTC less than 24 hours for faster performance.  '
                UNION
                SELECT  2,
                    N'Arguments',
                    N'@includeDataStoreStatistics -- default = 0 (OFF); includes statistics (e.g. labeled with prefix DataStore-*) about the entire datastore in its current state. Recommend to set to 1 (ON) once per analysis session, then set to 0 (OFF) for faster execution of additional runs.'
                UNION
                SELECT  3,
                    N'Arguments',
                    N'@exportResultsToNewDB -- default = 0 (OFF); If set to 1 (ON), will create a new Database FIMService_OperationalStatistics. Two tables [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AND [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary] are copied so you can backup that small database for transfering the data easily. Must have permission to create a Database to turn on this flag.'
                UNION
                SELECT  4,
                    N'Arguments',
                    N'@dropTempTablesOnly -- default = 0 (OFF); If set to 1 (ON), will drop all work tables (prefixed with [debug].[_OA_*]) generated from previous runs. Recommend to run after you have completed your analysis to remove all the work tables generated by execution of this procedure.'
                UNION
                SELECT  5,
                    N'Results',
                    N'This table can be found at [debug].[_OperationAnalysis].  [DataSource] column is a hint on where the source of the data used to create the stats for the given row came from.  The prefix [debug].[_OA_*] indicates a work table was created as part of this procedure that was used to generate this data.  These tables may have additional useful data that is not rolled up into [debug].[_OperationAnalysis].'
                UNION
                SELECT  6,
                    N'Results',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary] contains a timeline that provides a count of Request and Query operations in one minute intervals.  Recommend to load this table into an Excel pivot table and graph it to see the load on the system over time and the source of the load: Use [TimeUTC] as Row and [ServicePartition], [Creator], [Type] as Columns; [Count] should be used as the Sum (may have to change pivot table property of this value to Sum instead of its default Count to get proper values in the pivot table.)'
                UNION
                SELECT  7,
                    N'Results',
                    N'This procedure creates some work tables with prefix [debug].[_OA_*] that contain more information than the summary provided in [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]. Recommend to use these in custom queries if you want more information about particular statistics.'
            )
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] =
            (
                SELECT
                    [Name] AS "@name",
                    [Instruction] AS "@instruction"
                FROM Instructions
                ORDER BY [Sequence]
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'Instructions';
        

            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 1.B Start and End Times
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            DECLARE @offsetDateTime NVARCHAR(36),
                    @offset NVARCHAR(6);
                    
            -- Example SYSDATETIMEOFFSET():  2012-03-03 02:26:50.6608030 -08:00                    
            SELECT  @offsetDateTime = CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AS NVARCHAR(36)),
                    @offset = LEFT(SUBSTRING(@offsetDateTime, LEN(@offsetDateTime)-5,6),6);

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'Report Generated Time UTC',
                    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32), GETUTCDATE() , 21),
                    N'Subtract ' + @offset + N' hours to convert UTC to local time',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OperationAnalysis]';


            IF(@startTimeUTC IS NULL)
            BEGIN 
                SELECT @startTimeUTC = DATEADD(day, -1, GETUTCDATE());
            END
            
            IF(@endTimeUTC IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @endTimeUTC = GETUTCDATE();
            END

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'StartTime UTC',
                    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32), @startTimeUTC , 21),
                    N'@startTimeUTC parameter can be passed in to this stored procedure to change the date range of the records processed',
                    N'',
                    N'User Entered';

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'EndTime UTC',
                    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32), @endTimeUTC , 21),
                    N'@endTimeUTC parameter can be passed in to this stored procedure to change the date range of the records processed',
                    N'',
                    N'User Entered';
                    
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 1.C Version
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            -- FIM Major
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'FIMVersion-Major',
                    [Version],
                    N'',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[Version]'
            FROM [fim].[Version];

            -- FIM Minor
            /*********************************************************************************************************************
            *   DESIGN POINT -- The BinaryVersion column was added during FIM 2010 R2.  For this to be backwards compatible for 
            *   FIM 2010, this check needs to use dynamic SQL or else you can't load this stored procedure on a FIM 2010 Database
            *
            *********************************************************************************************************************/
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1 FROM [sys].[tables] AS [t]
                INNER JOIN [sys].[columns] AS [c]
                ON [t].[object_id] = [c].[object_id]
                WHERE   [t].[name] = N'Version'
                    AND [c].[name] = N'BinaryVersion'
            )
            BEGIN   
                -- FIM Minor
                INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
                (
                    [Name],
                    [Value],
                    [Comment],
                    [DetailsXml],
                    [DataSource]
                )
                EXECUTE sp_executesql N'SELECT ''FIMVersion-Minor'',  CAST([BinaryVersion] AS NVARCHAR(448)), N'''', N'''', N''[fim].[Version]'' FROM [fim].[Version]'
            END

            -- SQL
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'SQLVersion',
                    N'',
                    CAST(@@VERSION AS NVARCHAR(448)),
                    N'',
                    N'@@VERSION';
            

    /****************************************************************************************************************
    *
    * 2. Query 
    *
    ****************************************************************************************************************/

    IF 
    (
        OBJECT_ID(N'[fim].[RecordQueryOperation]') IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'Query Recording Instructions',
                    N'see [DetailsXml]',
                    N'[DetailsXml] column has information on how to enable/disable recording query',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OperationAnalysis]';
    
            WITH QueryInstructions
            (
                [Sequence],
                [Name],
                [Instruction]
            )
            AS
            (
                SELECT  1,
                    N'Information',
                    N'You can record query data for diagnostic, reliability, and performance analysis.'
                UNION
                SELECT  2,
                    N'Information',
                    N'EXECUTE [debug].[DiagnosticsSetRecordQuery] @on=1 (@on default = 1 (ON)); turn recording on,  @on=0 (OFF) turns it off. By default the XPathFilter, ServiceId, User, StartTime and Duration is recorded.'
                UNION
                SELECT  3,
                    N'Information',
                    N'EXECUTE  [debug].[DiagnosticsSetRecordQuery] @on=1, @recordSql=1 (@recordSql default = 0 (OFF)); If @recordSql =1 (ON) then in addition to the default values noted above, the actual SQL statement that defines the query is also recorded.  This will cause the table to grow very large so you should only turn this on for short durations (hours) for advanced troubleshooting.'
                UNION
                SELECT  4,
                    N'Warning',
                    N'The table will grow unbounded so you have to do manual maintenance.'
                UNION
                SELECT  5,
                    N'Cleanup',
                    N'EXECUTE [debug].[DeleteRecordedQueries] @retentionInDays = 0 (@retentionInDays default = 0 Removes all Rows); or use @retentionInDays = XX to leave the last XX days of data only.'
            )
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] =
            (
                SELECT
                    [Name] AS "@name",
                    [Instruction] AS "@instruction"
                FROM QueryInstructions
                ORDER BY [Sequence]
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'Query Recording Instructions';
    
    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
            WHERE   [StartTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                AND [StartTime] <= @endTimeUTC
        )
        BEGIN
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 2.A Query Count
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            DECLARE @queryCountUser INT,
                    @queryCountSystem INT,
                    @queryPercentSystem Decimal(6,2),
                    @queryPercentUser Decimal(6,2);
            
            SELECT  @queryCountSystem = COUNT(*)
            FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
            WHERE   [StartTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                AND [StartTime] <= @endTimeUTC
                AND [User] = @querySystemUser;

            SELECT  @queryCount = COUNT(*)
            FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
            WHERE   [StartTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                AND [StartTime] <= @endTimeUTC

            SELECT @queryCountUser= @queryCount - @queryCountSystem;
            
            SELECT @queryPercentUser = CAST( ( (CAST(@queryCountUser AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@queryCount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) * CAST(100.00 AS Decimal(3,2))) AS Decimal(6,2));
            
            SELECT @queryPercentSystem = CAST(100.00 AS DECIMAL(3,2)) - @queryPercentUser;
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'QueryCount',
                    CAST(@queryCount AS NVARCHAR(16)),
                    N'Rights Check ' + CAST(@queryPercentUser AS NVARCHAR(6)) + N'%, No Rights Check ' + CAST(@queryPercentSystem AS NVARCHAR(6)) + N'%',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[RecordQueryOperation]';
            
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 2.B Query Summary
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance];
            END;
            
            WITH [QueryStats]
            (
                [DurationInMilliseconds],
                [DurationBucket],
                [UserType]
            )
            AS
            (
                SELECT [DurationMilliseconds],
                CASE 
                    WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] < 10 THEN N'01-10'
                    WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] < 100 THEN N'02-100'
                    WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] < 500 THEN N'03-500'
                    WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] < 1000 THEN N'04-1000'
                WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] < 5000 THEN N'05-5000'
                    WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] < 10000 THEN N'06-10000'
                    WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] < 20000 THEN N'07-20000'
                    WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] < 30000 THEN N'08-30000'
                    WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] < 40000 THEN N'09-40000'
                    WHEN [DurationMilliseconds] IS NULL THEN N'11-Timeout'
                    ELSE N'10-40000+'
                END AS [DurationBucket],
                CASE
                    WHEN [User] = @querySystemUser THEN N'System'
                    ELSE N'User'
                END
                FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
                WHERE    [StartTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                    AND [StartTime] <= @endTimeUTC
            )
            SELECT 
                [UserType],
                [DurationBucket] AS [SortKey],
                SUBSTRING([DurationBucket],4,50) AS [LessThanMilliseconds],
                COUNT(*) AS [Count],
                CASE
                    WHEN [UserType] = N'User' THEN
                        CAST( ((CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@queryCountUser AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100) AS Decimal(6,2)) 
                    ELSE
                        CAST( ((CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@queryCountSystem AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100) AS Decimal(6,2))
                END AS [PercentOfType],
                CAST( ((CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@queryCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100) AS Decimal(6,2))  AS [PercentOfTotal]
            INTO [debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]
            FROM [QueryStats]
            GROUP BY [UserType],[DurationBucket]
            ORDER BY [UserType],[DurationBucket];


            -- Total
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'QueryPerformance', 
                    CAST(SUM([PercentOfTotal])AS NVARCHAR(6)),
                    N'% of Queries <= 1 Second; Aggregate',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]
            WHERE    [LessThanmilliseconds] IN ( N'10', N'100', N'500', N'1000')
            
            -- System
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'QueryPerformance-NoRightsCheck', 
                    CAST(ISNULL(SUM([PercentOfType]),0)AS NVARCHAR(6)),
                    N'% of Queries <= 1 Second; No rights check, User = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]
            WHERE    [LessThanmilliseconds] IN ( N'10', N'100', N'500', N'1000')
                AND [UserType] = N'System';
                
            SET @result = 
            (
                    SELECT
                        [UserType] AS "@userType",
                        [LessThanMilliseconds] AS "@lessThanMilliseconds",
                        [Count] AS "@count",
                        [PercentOfType] AS "@percentOfType"
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]
                    WHERE [UserType] = N'System'
                    ORDER BY [SortKey]
                    FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            );
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] =CAST(@result AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHERE [Name] = N'QueryPerformance-NoRightsCheck';
                    
            -- User
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'QueryPerformance-WithRightsCheck', 
                    CAST(SUM([PercentOfType])AS NVARCHAR(6)),
                    N'% of Queries <= 1 Second; rights check',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]
            WHERE    [LessThanmilliseconds] IN ( N'10', N'100', N'500', N'1000')
                AND [UserType] = N'User';
            
            SET @result = 
            (
                    SELECT
                        [UserType] AS "@userType",
                        [LessThanMilliseconds] AS "@lessThanMilliseconds",
                        [Count] AS "@count",
                        [PercentOfType] AS "@percentOfType"
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_QueryPerformance]
                    WHERE [UserType] = N'User'
                    ORDER BY [SortKey]
                    FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            );
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] =CAST(@result AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHERE [Name] = N'QueryPerformance-WithRightsCheck';


            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 2.C Queries that are Slow
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'QueryPerformance-Slow', 
                    CAST (((CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@queryCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100 ) AS DECIMAL(6,2)),
                    N'% duration > ' + CAST(@slowQueryThresholdInMilliseconds AS NVARCHAR(7)) + N' milliseconds; Count ' + CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[RecordQueryOperation]'
            FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
            WHERE    [DurationMilliseconds] >= @slowQueryThresholdInMilliseconds
                AND [StartTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                AND [StartTime] <= @endTimeUTC;

            SET @result = 
            (
                    SELECT    
                        [rqo].[DurationMilliseconds] AS "@durationMilliseconds",
                        [rqo].[XPathFilter] AS "@xpathFilter",
                        [rqo].[User] AS "@user",
                        [sb].[ServiceName] AS "@serviceName",
                        [sp].[ServicePartitionName] AS "@servicePartitionName",
                        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32), [StartTime], 21) AS "@startTimeUTC"
                    FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation] AS [rqo]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [sb]
                        ON [rqo].[ServiceId] = [sb].[ServiceId]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ServicePartition] AS [sp]
                        ON [sb].[ServicePartitionId] = [sp].[ServicePartitionId]
                    WHERE 
                            [rqo].[DurationMilliseconds] >= @slowQueryThresholdInMilliseconds
                        AND [StartTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                        AND [StartTime] <= @endTimeUTC
                    ORDER BY [rqo].[DurationMilliseconds] DESC, [rqo].[XPathFilter], [rqo].[User]
                    FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            )
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] =CAST(@result AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHERE [Name] = N'QueryPerformance-Slow';
            
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 2.D Queries that Timed out
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'QueryReliability', 
                    CAST(100 AS DECIMAL(6,2)) - CAST (((CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@queryCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100 ) AS DECIMAL(6,2)),
                    N'% successful queries; TimedOut Count ' + CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[RecordQueryOperation]'
            FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
            WHERE    [DurationMilliseconds] IS NULL
                AND    [StartTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                AND [StartTime] <= @endTimeUTC;

            SET @result = 
            (
                    SELECT    
                        N'TimedOut' AS "@durationMilliseconds",
                        [XPathFilter] AS "@xpathFilter",
                        [User] AS "@user",
                        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32), [StartTime], 21) AS "@startTimeUTC"
                    FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
                    WHERE 
                            [DurationMilliseconds] IS NULL
                        AND    [StartTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                        AND [StartTime] <= @endTimeUTC                            
                    ORDER BY [DurationMilliseconds] DESC, [XPathFilter], [User]
                    FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            )
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] =CAST(@result AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHERE [Name] = N'QueryReliability';
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT 
                N'QuerySummary', 
                N'0',
                'No Queries issued during specified time interval.',
                N'',
                N'';
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT 
                N'QuerySummary', 
                N'0',
                N'Query Recording is not installed on your environment.',
                N'',
                N'';
    END

    /****************************************************************************************************************
    *
    * 3. Request
    *
    ****************************************************************************************************************/
            
            -- Always get this stat no matter what the user input is
            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.A Request ServicePartition
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'RequestServicePartition', 
                    CAST(COUNT([sp].[ServicePartitionId]) AS NVARCHAR(3)), 
                    N'TotalPartitions',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ServiceHearbeat], [fim].[ServicePartition]'
            FROM [fim].[ServicePartition] AS[sp]
                        
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT  
                        CAST(ISNULL([s].[RequestCount], 0) AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS "@requestsInFlight",
                        CAST(ISNULL([s].[Creator], N'N/A') AS NVARCHAR(24)) AS "@creator",
                        [sh].[ServiceName] AS "@serviceName",
                        [sp].[ServicePartitionName] AS "@servicePartitionName",
                        [sh].[LastPingTime] AS "@lastPingTimeUTC",
                        [sh].[LastRestartTime] AS "@lastRestartTimeUTC",
                        [sh].[ProcessSystemPartition] AS "@processSystemPartition"
                FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [sh]
                LEFT JOIN
                (SELECT
                    [r].[ServiceId],
                    CASE 
                        WHEN [r].[Creator] = [fim].[GetSynchronizationAccountObjectKey] () THEN N'FIM Synchronization'
                        WHEN [r].[Creator] = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey] () THEN N'FIM Service'
                        ELSE N'User'
                    END AS [Creator],
                    COUNT([r].[ServiceId]) AS [RequestCount]
                FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
                GROUP BY [r].[ServiceId],
                         CASE
                            WHEN [r].[Creator] = [fim].[GetSynchronizationAccountObjectKey] () THEN N'FIM Synchronization'
                            WHEN [r].[Creator] = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey] () THEN N'FIM Service'
                            ELSE N'User'
                         END)AS [s]
                    ON [sh].[ServiceId] = [s].[ServiceId]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ServicePartition] AS [sp]
                    ON [sh].[ServicePartitionId] = [sp].[ServicePartitionId]
                ORDER BY [sh].[PingIntervalSecs] DESC, [sh].[LastPingTime] DESC, [s].[RequestCount] DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'RequestServicePartition';


        -- Only get the following stats if the time range provided had new requests created in that time-frame.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
            WHERE    [ValueDateTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                AND [ValueDateTime] <= @endTimeUTC
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN


            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.B Range
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            SELECT @requestKeyStart = [ObjectKey] 
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            WHERE    [ObjectKey] = 
                    (
                        SELECT MIN([ObjectKey])
                        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
                        WHERE    [ValueDateTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                            AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                            AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                    )
                    AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'RequestFirstObjectKey', 
                    CAST(@requestKeyStart AS NVARCHAR(19)),
                    N'[CreatedTime] UTC ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32), [ValueDateTime] , 21),
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]'
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
            WHERE    [ObjectKey] = @requestKeyStart
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;


            SELECT @requestKeyEnd = [ObjectKey] 
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            WHERE    [ObjectKey] = 
                    (
                        SELECT MAX([ObjectKey])
                        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
                        WHERE    [ValueDateTime] <= @endTimeUTC
                            AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                            AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                    )
                    AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'RequestLastObjectKey', 
                    CAST(@requestKeyEnd AS NVARCHAR(19)),
                    N'[CreatedTime] UTC ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32), [ValueDateTime] , 21),
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]'
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
            WHERE    [ObjectKey] = @requestKeyEnd
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;


            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.C Total Requests
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_Request]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_Request];
            END;

            SELECT [ObjectKey]
            INTO [debug].[_OA_Request]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
            WHERE    [ObjectKey] >= @requestKeyStart
                AND [ObjectKey] <= @requestKeyEnd
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;

            SELECT @requestCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

            CREATE UNIQUE INDEX [IX__Request_ObjectKey] ON [debug].[_OA_Request] 
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            );

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'RequestCount', 
                    CAST(@requestCount AS NVARCHAR(16)),
                    N'Has [CreatedTime] between {StartTime UTC} and {EndTime UTC}',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]';


            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.D Requests by Sync
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            
            SELECT @syncAccount = [fim].[GetSynchronizationAccountObjectKey]();

            DECLARE @syncAccountRequests INT;
            
            
            SELECT @syncAccountRequests = COUNT(*)
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
            INNER JOIN [debug].[_OA_Request] AS [r]
                ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [r].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE   [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                AND [ValueReference] = @syncAccount;

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'RequestCountFromSync', 
                    CAST(@syncAccountRequests AS NVARCHAR(16)),
                    N'[Creator] = "Built-in Synchronization Account" "' + CAST([fim].[GetSynchronizationAccountIdentifier]() AS NVARCHAR(36)) + N'"',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueReference]';

            WITH Requests
            (
                [ServicePartitionName],
                [TargetObjectType],
                [Operation],
                [HasParent]
            )
            AS
            (
                SELECT  [ovs].[ValueString],
                        [ovs3].[ValueString],
                        [ovs2].[ValueString],
                        CASE
                            WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                FROM [debug].[_OA_Request] AS [r]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                    ON [r].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs2]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs2].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovs2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs2].[AttributeKey] = @operationAttributeKey
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs3]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs3].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovs3].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs3].[AttributeKey] = @targetObjectTypeAttributeKey
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr2]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovr2].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovr2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovr2].[AttributeKey] = @parentAttributeKey
                WHERE   [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                    AND [ovr].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount
            )
            UPDATE [oa]    
            SET [DetailsXml] =
            (
                SELECT  
                        [ServicePartitionName]  AS "@servicePartitionName",
                        [TargetObjectType]  AS "@targetObjectType",
                        [Operation] AS "@operation",
                        [HasParent] AS "@hasParent",
                        COUNT(*) AS "@count"
                FROM [Requests]
                GROUP BY [ServicePartitionName], [TargetObjectType], [Operation], [HasParent]
