                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'RequestCountFromSync';

            
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.E Requests by FIM Service
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            
            SELECT @fimServiceAccount = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey]();

            DECLARE @fimServiceAccountRequests INT;

            SELECT @fimServiceAccountRequests = COUNT(*)
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
            WHERE    [ObjectKey] >= @requestKeyStart
                AND [ObjectKey] <= @requestKeyEnd
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                AND [ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount;

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'RequestCountFromFimService', 
                    CAST(@fimServiceAccountRequests AS NVARCHAR(16)),
                    N'[Creator] = "Forefront Identity Manager Service Account=" "' + CAST([fim].[GetServiceAccountIdentifier]() AS NVARCHAR(36)) + N'"',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueReference]';

            WITH Requests
            (
                [ServicePartitionName],
                [TargetObjectType],
                [Operation],
                [HasParent]
            )
            AS
            (
                SELECT  [ovs].[ValueString],
                        [ovs3].[ValueString],
                        [ovs2].[ValueString],
                        CASE
                            WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                FROM [debug].[_OA_Request] AS [r]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                    ON [r].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs2]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs2].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovs2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs2].[AttributeKey] = @operationAttributeKey
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs3]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs3].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovs3].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs3].[AttributeKey] = @targetObjectTypeAttributeKey
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr2]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovr2].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovr2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovr2].[AttributeKey] = @parentAttributeKey
                WHERE   [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                    AND [ovr].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount
            )
            UPDATE [oa]    
            SET [DetailsXml] =
            (
                SELECT    
                        [ServicePartitionName]  AS "@servicePartitionName",
                        [TargetObjectType]  AS "@targetObjectType",
                        [Operation] AS "@operation",
                        [HasParent] AS "@hasParent",
                        COUNT(*) AS "@count"
                FROM [Requests]
                GROUP BY [ServicePartitionName], [TargetObjectType], [Operation], [HasParent]
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'RequestCountFromFimService';
            
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.F Requests by Users
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            
            SELECT @fimServiceAccount = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey]();

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT N'RequestCountFromUsers', 
                    CAST((@requestCount - @syncAccountRequests - @fimServiceAccountRequests) AS NVARCHAR(16)),
                    N'{RequestCount} - {RequestCountFromSync} - {RequestCountFromFimService}',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueReference]';


            WITH Requests
            (
                [ServicePartitionName],
                [TargetObjectType],
                [Operation],
                [HasParent]
            )
            AS
            (
                SELECT  [ovs].[ValueString],
                        [ovs3].[ValueString],
                        [ovs2].[ValueString],
                        CASE
                            WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs2]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs2].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovs2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs2].[AttributeKey] = @operationAttributeKey
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs3]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs3].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovs3].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs3].[AttributeKey] = @targetObjectTypeAttributeKey
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr2]
                    ON  [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovr2].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [ovr2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovr2].[AttributeKey] = @parentAttributeKey
                WHERE   [ovr].[ObjectKey] >= @requestKeyStart
                    AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] <= @requestKeyEnd
                    AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                    AND [ovr].[ValueReference] != @fimServiceAccount
                    AND [ovr].[ValueReference] != @syncAccount
            )
            UPDATE [oa]    
            SET [DetailsXml] =
            (
                SELECT    
                        [ServicePartitionName]  AS "@servicePartitionName",
                        [TargetObjectType]  AS "@targetObjectType",
                        [Operation] AS "@operation",
                        [HasParent] AS "@hasParent",
                        COUNT(*) AS "@count"
                FROM [Requests]
                GROUP BY [ServicePartitionName], [TargetObjectType], [Operation], [HasParent]
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'RequestCountFromUsers';


            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.G Requests Status Summary
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]
            END;

            CREATE TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]
            (
                [RequestKey] BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
                [Status] NVARCHAR(32),
                [Final] BIT,
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX__RequestSummary_Status] ON [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary] 
            (
                [Status]
            );

            INSERT [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [Status],
                [Final]
            )
            SELECT [ObjectKey],
                   [ValueString],
                   [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFinal]([ValueString])
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
            WHERE    [ObjectKey] >= @requestKeyStart
                AND [ObjectKey] <= @requestKeyEnd
                and [AttributeKey] = 158;
            
            -- Not Final
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT    N'RequestStatusNotFinalSummary', 
                    CAST (CAST (( ( CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@requestCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100) AS Decimal(6,2)) AS NVARCHAR(6)),
                    '% of Requests; Count ' + CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]
            WHERE [Final] = 0
            GROUP BY [Final];
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT
                    [Status] AS "@status",
                    COUNT(*) AS "@count"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]
                WHERE [Final] = 0
                GROUP BY [Status]
                FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            )
            WHERE [Name] = N'RequestStatusNotFinalSummary';
            
            -- Final
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'RequestStatusFinalSummary', 
                    CAST (CAST (( ( CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@requestCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS NVARCHAR(6)),
                    '% of Requests; Count ' + CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]
            WHERE [Final] = 1
            GROUP BY [Final];
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT
                    [Status] AS "@status",
                    COUNT(*) AS "@count"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]
                WHERE [Final] = 1
                GROUP BY [Status]
                FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            )
            WHERE [Name] = N'RequestStatusFinalSummary';
            

            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.H Requests Failure Analysis PostProcessingError
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]
            END;

            CREATE TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]
            (
                [Sequence] INT IDENTITY(1,1),
                [RequestKey] BIGINT,
                [ServicePartitionName] NVARCHAR(128),
                [Creator] BIGINT,
                [CreatorFiltered] NVARCHAR(32),
                [CreatedTime] DATETIME,
                [CompletedTime] DATETIME,
                [ErrorPattern] NVARCHAR(200),
                [WorkflowStatusDetailMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX),
                [RequestStatusDetail] XML,
                [RequestStatusDetailMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX)
            );

            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX__RequestStatusPostProcessingError_RequestKey] ON [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError] 
            (
                [RequestKey]
            );
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ServicePartitionName],
                [Creator],
                [CreatorFiltered],
                [CreatedTime],
                [CompletedTime],
                [WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],
                [RequestStatusDetail]
            )
            SELECT  [rs].[RequestKey],
                    [ovs].[ValueString],
                    [ovr2].[ValueReference],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount THEN N'FIMService'
                        WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount THEN N'Sync'
                        ELSE N'User'
                    END,
                    [ovdt1].[ValueDateTime],
                    [ovdt2].[ValueDateTime],
                    [ovtWsd].[ValueText],
                    [ovtRsd].[ValueText]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary] AS [rs]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorkflowInstanceAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovtWsd]
                ON  [ovr].[ValueReference] = [ovtWsd].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovtWsd].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovtWsd].[AttributeKey] = @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovtRsd]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovtRsd].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovtRsd].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovtRsd].[AttributeKey] = @requestStatusDetailAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt1]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovdt1].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovdt1].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt1].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt2]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovdt2].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovdt2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt2].[AttributeKey] = @completedTimeAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr2]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovr2].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovr2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovr2].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
            WHERE [rs].[Status] = N'PostProcessingError'
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]
            SET [RequestStatusDetailMessage] =
            [RequestStatusDetail].value('(RequestStatusDetail)[1]','varchar(max)')
            WHERE [RequestStatusDetail] IS NOT NULL;
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]
            SET [ErrorPattern] = SUBSTRING(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD'),0, 15) + SUBSTRING(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD'), LEN(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD')) - 15, 15) +
                                 SUBSTRING(ISNULL([WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],N'NoWSD'),0, 15) + SUBSTRING(ISNULL([WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],N'NoWSD'), LEN(ISNULL([WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],N'NoWSD')) - 15, 15);
        
            -- NOTE:  In some cases there are multiple WorkflowStatusDetail or RequestStatusDetail entries on a single Request
            -- which can produce multiple rows for the same request.  When counting the number of Requests with this
            -- Error Status one must de-dupe using RequestKey.

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  DISTINCT N'RequestStatusPostProcessingError-ErrorTotal', 
                    CAST(COUNT([RequestKey]) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    CAST (CAST (((CAST(COUNT([RequestKey]) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@requestCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100 ) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS NVARCHAR(6)) + N'% of total Requests',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError];

            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] =    
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [ServicePartitionName] AS "@servicePartitionName",
                    [CreatorFiltered] AS "@creator",
                    COUNT([RequestKey]) AS "@count"
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]
                    GROUP BY [ServicePartitionName], [CreatorFiltered]
                    ORDER BY [ServicePartitionName]
                    FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            ) 
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [oa].[Name] = N'RequestStatusPostProcessingError-ErrorTotal';


            -- In this case we are interested in all the errors that occur (including multiple on the same Request)
            -- so the counts here may not sum up to [Total] noted above.
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'RequestStatusPostProcessingError-ErrorCount', 
                    CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    [ErrorPattern],
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError] AS [rsppe]
            WHERE [rsppe].[Sequence] IN
            (
                SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError] AS [rsppe]
                GROUP BY [RequestKey]
            )
            GROUP BY [ErrorPattern]
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, [ErrorPattern]
            
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [Comment] = N'Sample RequestKey ' + CAST([RequestKey] AS NVARCHAR(19)) + 
                            N' RequestIdentifier ' + CAST([ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS NVARCHAR(36)) + N' ' +
                    ISNULL([rsppe].[RequestStatusDetailMessage], N'') + ISNULL([rsppe].[WorkflowStatusDetailMessage], N'') 
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            INNER JOIN [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError] AS [rsppe]
                ON [oa].[Comment] = [rsppe].[ErrorPattern]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
                ON [rsppe].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE [rsppe].[Sequence]
                IN
                (
                    SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]
                    GROUP BY [ErrorPattern]
                )
            AND [oa].[Name] = N'RequestStatusPostProcessingError-ErrorCount';
        

            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.I Requests Failure Analysis Failed
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
            END;

            CREATE TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
            (
                [Sequence] INT IDENTITY(1,1),
                [RequestKey] BIGINT,
                [ServicePartitionName] NVARCHAR(128),
                [Creator] BIGINT,
                [CreatorFiltered] NVARCHAR(32),
                [CreatedTime] DATETIME,
                [CompletedTime] DATETIME,
                [ErrorPattern] NVARCHAR(200),
                [RequestStatusDetail] XML,
                [RequestStatusDetailMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX)
            );

            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX__RequestStatusFailed_RequestKey] ON [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed] 
            (
                [RequestKey]
            );
            
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ServicePartitionName],
                [Creator],
                [CreatorFiltered],
                [CreatedTime],
                [CompletedTime],
                [RequestStatusDetail]
            )
            SELECT  [rs].[RequestKey],
                    [ovs].[ValueString],
                    [ovr2].[ValueReference],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount THEN N'FIMService'
                        WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount THEN N'Sync'
                        ELSE N'User'
                    END,
                    [ovdt1].[ValueDateTime],
                    [ovdt2].[ValueDateTime],
                    [ovtRsd].[ValueText]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary] AS [rs]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovtRsd]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovtRsd].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovtRsd].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovtRsd].[AttributeKey] = @requestStatusDetailAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt1]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovdt1].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovdt1].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt1].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt2]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovdt2].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovdt2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt2].[AttributeKey] = @completedTimeAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr2]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovr2].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovr2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovr2].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
            WHERE [rs].[Status] = N'Failed'
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
            SET [RequestStatusDetailMessage] =
            [RequestStatusDetail].value('(RequestStatusDetail)[1]','varchar(max)')
            WHERE [RequestStatusDetail] IS NOT NULL;
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
            SET [ErrorPattern] = SUBSTRING(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD'),0, 15) + SUBSTRING(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD'), LEN(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD')) - 15, 15);
                                 
        
            -- NOTE:  In some cases there are multiple WorkflowStatusDetail or RequestStatusDetail entries on a single Request
            -- which can produce multiple rows for the same request.  When counting the number of Requests with this
            -- Error Status one must de-dupe using RequestKey.
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  DISTINCT 
                    N'RequestStatusFailed-ErrorTotal', 
                    CAST(COUNT([RequestKey]) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    CAST (CAST (((CAST(COUNT([RequestKey]) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@requestCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100 ) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS NVARCHAR(6)) + N'% of total Requests',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed];


            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] =    
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [ServicePartitionName] AS "@servicePartitionName",
                    [CreatorFiltered] AS "@creator",
                    COUNT([RequestKey]) AS "@count"
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
                    GROUP BY [ServicePartitionName], [CreatorFiltered]
                    ORDER BY [ServicePartitionName]
                    FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            ) 
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [oa].[Name] = N'RequestStatusFailed-ErrorTotal';

            -- In this case we are interested in all the errors that occur (including multiple on the same Request)
            -- so the counts here may not sum up to [Total] noted above.
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'RequestStatusFailed-ErrorCount', 
                    CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    [ErrorPattern],
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed] aS [rsf]
            WHERE [rsf].[Sequence] IN
            (
                SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
                GROUP BY [RequestKey]
            )        
            GROUP BY [ErrorPattern]
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, [ErrorPattern]

            
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [Comment] = N'Sample RequestKey ' + CAST([rsd].[RequestKey] AS NVARCHAR(19)) + 
                            N' RequestIdentifier ' + CAST([ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS NVARCHAR(36)) + N' ' +
                    ISNULL([rsd].[RequestStatusDetailMessage], N'') 
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            INNER JOIN [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed] AS [rsd]
                ON [oa].[Comment] = [rsd].[ErrorPattern]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
                ON [rsd].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE [rsd].[Sequence]
                IN
                (
                    SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
                    GROUP BY [ErrorPattern]
                )
            AND [oa].[Name] = N'RequestStatusFailed-ErrorCount';
                
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.J Requests Failure Analysis Denied
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
            END;

            CREATE TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
            (
                [Sequence] INT IDENTITY(1,1),
                [RequestKey] BIGINT,
                [ServicePartitionName] NVARCHAR(128),
                [Creator] BIGINT,
                [CreatorFiltered] NVARCHAR(32),
                [CreatedTime] DATETIME,
                [CompletedTime] DATETIME,
                [ErrorPattern] NVARCHAR(200),
                [WorkflowStatusDetailMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX),
                [RequestStatusDetail] XML,
                [RequestStatusDetailMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX)
            );

            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX__RequestStatusDenied_RequestKey] ON [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied] 
            (
                [RequestKey]
            );
            
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ServicePartitionName],
                [Creator],
                [CreatorFiltered],
                [CreatedTime],
                [CompletedTime],
                [WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],
                [RequestStatusDetail]
            )
            SELECT  [rs].[RequestKey],
                    [ovs].[ValueString],
                    [ovr2].[ValueReference],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount THEN N'FIMService'
                        WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount THEN N'Sync'
                        ELSE N'User'
                    END,
                    [ovdt1].[ValueDateTime],
                    [ovdt2].[ValueDateTime],
                    [ovtWsd].[ValueText],
                    [ovtRsd].[ValueText]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary] AS [rs]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND 
                    (
                        [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @authenticationWorkflowInstanceAttributeKey
                    OR  [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @authorizationWorkflowInstanceAttributeKey
                    )
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovtWsd]
                ON  [ovr].[ValueReference] = [ovtWsd].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovtWsd].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovtWsd].[AttributeKey] = @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovtRsd]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovtRsd].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovtRsd].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovtRsd].[AttributeKey] = @requestStatusDetailAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt1]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovdt1].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovdt1].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt1].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt2]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovdt2].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovdt2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt2].[AttributeKey] = @completedTimeAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr2]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovr2].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovr2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovr2].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
            WHERE [rs].[Status] = N'Denied'
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
            SET [RequestStatusDetailMessage] =
            [RequestStatusDetail].value('(RequestStatusDetail)[1]','varchar(max)')
            WHERE [RequestStatusDetail] IS NOT NULL;
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
            SET [ErrorPattern] = SUBSTRING(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD'),0, 15) + SUBSTRING(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD'), LEN(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD')) - 15, 15) +
                                 SUBSTRING(ISNULL([WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],N'NoWSD'),0, 15) + SUBSTRING(ISNULL([WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],N'NoWSD'), LEN(ISNULL([WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],N'NoWSD')) - 15, 15);
                                 
        
            -- NOTE:  In some cases there are multiple WorkflowStatusDetail or RequestStatusDetail entries on a single Request
            -- which can produce multiple rows for the same request.  When counting the number of Requests with this
            -- Error Status one must de-dupe using RequestKey.
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  DISTINCT
                    N'RequestStatusDenied-ErrorTotal', 
                    CAST(COUNT([RequestKey]) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    CAST (CAST (((CAST(COUNT([RequestKey]) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@requestCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100 ) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS NVARCHAR(6)) + N'% of total Requests',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied];

            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] =    
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [ServicePartitionName] AS "@servicePartitionName",
                    [CreatorFiltered] AS "@creator",
                    COUNT([RequestKey]) AS "@count"
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
                    GROUP BY [ServicePartitionName], [CreatorFiltered]
                    ORDER BY [ServicePartitionName]
                    FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            ) 
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [oa].[Name] = N'RequestStatusDenied-ErrorTotal';


            -- In this case we are interested in all the errors that occur (including multiple on the same Request)
            -- so the counts here may not sum up to [Total] noted above.
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'RequestStatusDenied-ErrorCount', 
                    CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    [ErrorPattern],
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied] AS [rsd]
            WHERE [rsd].[Sequence] IN
            (
                SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
                GROUP BY [RequestKey]
            )
            GROUP BY [ErrorPattern]
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, [ErrorPattern]

            
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [Comment] = N'Sample RequestKey ' + CAST([rsd].[RequestKey] AS NVARCHAR(19)) + 
                            N' RequestIdentifier ' + CAST([ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS NVARCHAR(36)) + N' ' +
                    ISNULL([rsd].[RequestStatusDetailMessage], N'') + ISNULL([rsd].[WorkflowStatusDetailMessage], N'') 
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            INNER JOIN [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied] AS [rsd]
                ON [oa].[Comment] = [rsd].[ErrorPattern]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
                ON [rsd].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE [rsd].[Sequence]
                IN
                (
                    SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
                    GROUP BY [ErrorPattern]
                )
            AND [oa].[Name] = N'RequestStatusDenied-ErrorCount';
        
                            
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.K Requests with Status that is designed to be a short lived State.
            *     If the Request does not move from this state in a short period of time then it is
            *     Likely Stuck
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
                            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'RequestStatus-ShortLived-LikelyStuck', 
                    CAST (CAST (((CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@requestCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100 ) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS NVARCHAR(6)),
                    N'% of total Requests; Count ' + CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary]
            WHERE    [Final] = 0
                AND [Status] != N'Authorizing'
                AND [Status] != N'PostProcessing'
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] =    
            (
                SELECT  [RequestKey] AS "@requestKey",
                        [ValueIdentifier] AS "@requestIdentifier",
                        [Status] AS "@requestStatus"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary] AS [rs]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
                    ON [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE    [Final] = 0
                    AND [Status] != N'Authorizing'
                    AND [Status] != N'PostProcessing'
                FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            )
            WHERE [Name] = N'RequestStatus-ShortLived-LikelyStuck';
                            

            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.L Requests Still Processing Likely Stuck
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]
            END;

            CREATE TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]
            (
                [Sequence] INT IDENTITY(1,1),
                [RequestKey] BIGINT,
                [ServicePartitionName] NVARCHAR(128),
                [Creator] BIGINT,
                [CreatorFiltered] NVARCHAR(32),
                [CreatedTime] DATETIME,
                [CompletedTime] DATETIME,
                [ErrorPattern] NVARCHAR(200),
                [WorkflowStatusDetailMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX),
                [RequestStatusDetail] XML,
                [RequestStatusDetailMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX),
                [RequestStatus] NVARCHAR(448)
            );

            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX__RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck_RequestKey] ON [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck] 
            (
                [RequestKey]
            );
        
            INSERT [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ServicePartitionName],
                [Creator],
                [CreatorFiltered],
                [CreatedTime],
                [CompletedTime],
                [WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],
                [RequestStatusDetail],
                [RequestStatus]
            )
            SELECT  [rs].[RequestKey],
                    [ovs].[ValueString],
                    [ovr2].[ValueReference],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount THEN N'FIMService'
                        WHEN [ovr2].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount THEN N'Sync'
                        ELSE N'User'
                    END,
                    [ovdt1].[ValueDateTime],
                    [ovdt2].[ValueDateTime],
                    [ovtWsd].[ValueText],
                    [ovtRsd].[ValueText],
                    [rs].[Status]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary] AS [rs]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND 
                    (
                        [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorkflowInstanceAttributeKey
                    OR    [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @authenticationWorkflowInstanceAttributeKey
                    OR  [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @authorizationWorkflowInstanceAttributeKey
                    )
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovtWsd]
                ON  [ovr].[ValueReference] = [ovtWsd].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovtWsd].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovtWsd].[AttributeKey] = @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovtRsd]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovtRsd].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovtRsd].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovtRsd].[AttributeKey] = @requestStatusDetailAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt1]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovdt1].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovdt1].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt1].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt2]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovdt2].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovdt2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt2].[AttributeKey] = @completedTimeAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr2]
                ON  [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovr2].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovr2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovr2].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
            WHERE    [rs].[Final] = 0
                AND 
                    (    [rs].[Status] = N'Authorizing'
                    OR    [rs].[Status] = N'PostProcessing'
                    )
                AND 
                    (
                        [ovtWsd].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
                    OR [ovtRsd].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
                    )
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]
            SET [RequestStatusDetailMessage] =
            [RequestStatusDetail].value('(RequestStatusDetail)[1]','varchar(max)')
            WHERE [RequestStatusDetail] IS NOT NULL;
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]
            SET [ErrorPattern] = SUBSTRING(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD'),0, 15) + SUBSTRING(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD'), LEN(ISNULL([RequestStatusDetailMessage],N'NoRSD')) - 15, 15) +
                                 SUBSTRING(ISNULL([WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],N'NoWSD'),0, 15) + SUBSTRING(ISNULL([WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],N'NoWSD'), LEN(ISNULL([WorkflowStatusDetailMessage],N'NoWSD')) - 15, 15);
                                 
        
            -- NOTE:  In some cases there are multiple WorkflowStatusDetail or RequestStatusDetail entries on a single Request
            -- which can produce multiple rows for the same request.  When counting the number of Requests with this
            -- Error Status one must de-dupe using RequestKey.
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  DISTINCT
                    N'RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck', 
                    CAST (CAST (((CAST(COUNT([RequestKey]) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(@requestCount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ) * @const100 ) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS NVARCHAR(6)),
                    N'% of total Requests; Count ' +CAST(COUNT([RequestKey]) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck];

            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] =
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [ServicePartitionName] AS "@servicePartitionName",
                    [CreatorFiltered] AS "@creator",
                    [RequestStatus] AS "@requestStatus",
                    [RequestKey] AS "@requestKey",
                    [ValueIdentifier] AS "@requestIdentifier"
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck] AS [rsls]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
                        ON [rsls].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
                    ORDER BY [ServicePartitionName], [CreatorFiltered], [RequestStatus]
                    FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            ) 
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [oa].[Name] = N'RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck';


            -- In this case we are interested in all the errors that occur (including multiple on the same Request)
            -- so the counts here may not sum up to [Total] noted above.
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck-ErrorCount', 
                    CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    [ErrorPattern],
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck] AS [rsll]
            WHERE [rsll].[Sequence] IN
            (
                SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]
                GROUP BY [RequestKey]
            )
            GROUP BY [ErrorPattern]
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, [ErrorPattern]

            
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [Comment] = N'Sample RequestKey ' + CAST([rsd].[RequestKey] AS NVARCHAR(19)) + 
                            N' RequestIdentifier ' + CAST([ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS NVARCHAR(36)) + N' ' +
                    ISNULL([rsd].[RequestStatusDetailMessage], N'') + ISNULL([rsd].[WorkflowStatusDetailMessage], N'') 
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            INNER JOIN [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck] AS [rsd]
                ON [oa].[Comment] = [rsd].[ErrorPattern]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
                ON [rsd].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE [rsd].[Sequence]
                IN
                (
                    SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck]
                    GROUP BY [ErrorPattern]
                )
            AND [oa].[Name] = N'RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck-ErrorCount';
        

            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.M Set Correction Requests
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RequestSetCorrection]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RequestSetCorrection]
            END;

            SELECT [RequestKey],
                   [ovdt].[ValueDateTime]
            INTO [debug].[_OA_RequestSetCorrection]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSummary] AS [rs]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                ON [rs].[RequestKey] = [ovs].ObjectKey
            AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
                ON [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE   [ovs].ValueString LIKE N'Set Correction%'
                AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'SetCorrections', 
                    CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'Number of sets corrected',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[ObjectValueString]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSetCorrection];


            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_SetCorrectionCounts]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_SetCorrectionCounts]
            END;


            SELECT  [rsc].[RequestKey], 
                    COUNT(*) AS [Count]
            INTO [debug].[_OA_SetCorrectionCounts]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestSetCorrection] AS [rsc]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
                ON [rsc].[RequestKey] = [ovt].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE   [ovt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @requestParameterAttributeKey
            GROUP BY [rsc].[RequestKey]
      
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] =
            (
                SELECT  [scc].[RequestKey] AS "@requestKey",
                        [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([scc].[RequestKey]) AS "@requestIdentifier",
                        [ovr].[ValueReference] AS "@setKey",
                        [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([ovr].[ValueReference]) AS "@setIdentifier",
                        [ovs].[ValueString] AS "@setName",
                        [scc].[Count] AS "@numberOfCorrections",
                        [ovdt].[ValueDateTime] AS "@dateTimeUTC"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_SetCorrectionCounts]  AS [scc]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                    ON [scc].[RequestKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                    ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
                    ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @targetAttributeKey
                    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
                    AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                ORDER BY [ovdt].[ValueDateTime]
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [oa].[Name] = N'SetCorrections';
            
            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 3.N Expired Request statistics
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            DECLARE @dateTime DATETIME;

            SELECT @dateTime = GETUTCDATE();

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-ExpiredRequests', 
                    CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'if > 0, run FIM_DeleteExpiredSystemObjectsJob SQL Agent Job to Delete',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]'
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
            WHERE [AttributeKey] = @expirationTimeAttributeKey
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ValueDateTime] <= @dateTime;
            
            
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT 
                N'RequestSummary', 
                N'',
                N'No Requests issued during specified time interval.',
                N'',
                N'';
    END            
            
    /****************************************************************************************************************
    *
    * 4. Operations Timeline
    *
    ****************************************************************************************************************/

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            END;

            CREATE TABLE [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            (
                [TimeUTC] NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
                [ServicePartition] NVARCHAR(128),
                [Creator] NVARCHAR(32),
                [Type] NVARCHAR(64),
                [Count] INT
            );


            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 4.A Query Timeline
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            
            IF @queryCount > 0
            BEGIN    
                
                WITH QueryConcurrency
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User]
                )
                AS
                (
                    SELECT
                        DATENAME(month, [StartTime]) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(Day([StartTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2) + ' ' + CAST(Year([StartTime]) AS NVARCHAR) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(hour,[StartTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2)  + ':' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(minute,[StartTime]) AS NVARCHAR),2), -- used to group items per minute
                        [sp].[ServicePartitionName],
                        CASE WHEN [User] = @querySystemUser THEN N'System'
                            ELSE N'User'
                        END
                    FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation] AS [rqo]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [sh]
                        ON [rqo].[ServiceId] = [sh].[ServiceId]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ServicePartition] AS [sp]
                        ON [sh].[ServicePartitionId] = [sp].[ServicePartitionId]
                    WHERE [StartTime] >= @startTimeUTC
                    AND [StartTime] <= @endTimeUTC
                )
                INSERT [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartition],
                    [Creator],
                    [Type],
                    [Count]
                )
                SELECT
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User],
                    N'Query',
                    COUNT(*)
                FROM QueryConcurrency 
                GROUP BY [TimeUTC], [ServicePartitionName], [User];
            END;


            IF @requestCount > 0
            BEGIN
                /****************************************************************************************************************
                *
                * 4.B Request Timeline
                *
                ****************************************************************************************************************/

                WITH RequestConcurrency
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User]
                )
                AS
                (
                    SELECT
                        DATENAME(month, [ovdt].[ValueDateTime]) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(Day([ovdt].[ValueDateTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2) + ' ' + CAST(Year([ovdt].[ValueDateTime]) AS NVARCHAR) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(hour,[ovdt].[ValueDateTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2)  + ':' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(minute,[ovdt].[ValueDateTime]) AS NVARCHAR),2), -- used to group items per minute
                        [ovs].[ValueString],
                        CASE
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount THEN N'FIMService'
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount THEN N'Sync'
                        ELSE N'User'
                        END
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                        ON  [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                    LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]  -- Not All Requests have ServicePartitionName since that was added to FIM 2010 Update 1
                        ON  [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
                    WHERE   [ovdt].[ObjectKey] >= @requestKeyStart
                        AND [ovdt].[ObjectKey] <= @requestKeyEnd
                        AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] >= @requestKeyStart
                        AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] <= @requestKeyEnd
                        AND [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                )
                INSERT [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartition],
                    [Creator],
                    [Type],
                    [Count]
                )
                SELECT
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User],
                    N'Request',
                    COUNT(*)
                FROM RequestConcurrency 
                GROUP BY [TimeUTC], [User], ServicePartitionName;
            
        
                /****************************************************************************************************************
                *
                * 4.C Request Errors Post-Processing Timeline
                *
                ****************************************************************************************************************/

                WITH RequestErrors
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User]
                )
                AS
                (
                    SELECT
                        CASE 
                            WHEN [rsppe].[CompletedTime] IS NOT NULL THEN  DATENAME(month, [rsppe].[CompletedTime]) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(Day([rsppe].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2) + ' ' + CAST(Year([rsppe].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(hour,[rsppe].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2)  + ':' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(minute,[rsppe].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR),2) -- used to group items per minute
                            ELSE DATENAME(month, [rsppe].[CreatedTime]) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(Day([rsppe].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2) + ' ' + CAST(Year([rsppe].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(hour,[rsppe].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2)  + ':' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(minute,[rsppe].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR),2) -- used to group items per minute
                        END,
                        [ovs].[ValueString],
                        CASE
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount THEN N'FIMService'
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount THEN N'Sync'
                        ELSE N'User'
                        END
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError] AS [rsppe]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                        ON  [rsppe].[RequestKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                        ON  [rsppe].[RequestKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
                    WHERE [rsppe].[Sequence] IN
                    (
                        SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                        FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusPostProcessingError]
                        GROUP BY [RequestKey]
                    )
                )
                
                INSERT [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartition],
                    [Creator],
                    [Type],
                    [Count]
                )
                SELECT
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User],
                    N'Error-PostProcessingError',
                    COUNT(*)
                FROM RequestErrors 
                GROUP BY [TimeUTC], [User], [ServicePartitionName];

                /****************************************************************************************************************
                *
                * 4.D Request Errors Failed Timeline
                *
                ****************************************************************************************************************/

                WITH RequestErrorsFailed
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User]
                )
                AS
                (
                    SELECT
                        CASE 
                            WHEN [rsf].[CompletedTime] IS NOT NULL THEN  DATENAME(month, [rsf].[CompletedTime]) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(Day([rsf].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2) + ' ' + CAST(Year([rsf].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(hour,[rsf].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2)  + ':' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(minute,[rsf].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR),2) -- used to group items per minute
                            ELSE DATENAME(month, [rsf].[CreatedTime]) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(Day([rsf].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2) + ' ' + CAST(Year([rsf].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(hour,[rsf].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2)  + ':' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(minute,[rsf].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR),2) -- used to group items per minute
                        END,
                        [ovs].[ValueString],
                        CASE
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount THEN N'FIMService'
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount THEN N'Sync'
                        ELSE N'User'
                        END
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed] AS [rsf]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                        ON  [rsf].[RequestKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                        ON  [rsf].[RequestKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
                    WHERE [rsf].[Sequence] IN
                    (
                        SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                        FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusFailed]
                        GROUP BY [RequestKey]
                    )
                )
                
                INSERT [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartition],
                    [Creator],
                    [Type],
                    [Count]
                )
                SELECT
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User],
                    N'Error-Failed',
                    COUNT(*)
                FROM RequestErrorsFailed
                GROUP BY [TimeUTC], [User], [ServicePartitionName];


                /****************************************************************************************************************
                *
                * 4.E Request Errors Denied Timeline
                *
                ****************************************************************************************************************/

                WITH RequestErrorsDenied
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User]
                )
                AS
                (
                    SELECT
                        CASE 
                            WHEN [rsd].[CompletedTime] IS NOT NULL THEN  DATENAME(month, [rsd].[CompletedTime]) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(Day([rsd].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2) + ' ' + CAST(Year([rsd].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(hour,[rsd].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2)  + ':' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(minute,[rsd].[CompletedTime]) AS NVARCHAR),2) -- used to group items per minute
                            ELSE DATENAME(month, [rsd].[CreatedTime]) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(Day([rsd].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2) + ' ' + CAST(Year([rsd].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(hour,[rsd].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2)  + ':' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(minute,[rsd].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR),2) -- used to group items per minute
                        END,
                        [ovs].[ValueString],
                        CASE
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount THEN N'FIMService'
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount THEN N'Sync'
                        ELSE N'User'
                        END
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied] AS [rsd]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                        ON  [rsd].[RequestKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                        ON  [rsd].[RequestKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
                    WHERE [rsd].[Sequence] IN
                    (
                        SELECT MIN([Sequence])
                        FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatusDenied]
                        GROUP BY [RequestKey]
                    )
                )
                
                INSERT [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartition],
                    [Creator],
                    [Type],
                    [Count]
                )
                SELECT
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User],
                    N'Error-Denied',
                    COUNT(*)
                FROM RequestErrorsDenied 
                GROUP BY [TimeUTC], [User], [ServicePartitionName];


                /****************************************************************************************************************
                *
                * 4.F Request Errors RequestStatusNotFinal-LongLived Timeline
                * 
                ****************************************************************************************************************/

                WITH RequestErrorsNotFinal
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User]
                )
                AS
                (
                    SELECT
                        DATENAME(month, [rsnfls].[CreatedTime]) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(Day([rsnfls].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2) + ' ' + CAST(Year([rsnfls].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR) + ' ' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(hour,[rsnfls].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR), 2)  + ':' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEPART(minute,[rsnfls].[CreatedTime]) AS NVARCHAR),2), -- used to group items per minute
                        [ovs].[ValueString],
                        CASE
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @fimServiceAccount THEN N'FIMService'
                            WHEN [ovr].[ValueReference] = @syncAccount THEN N'Sync'
                        ELSE N'User'
                        END
                    FROM [debug].[_OA_RequestStatus-LongLived-LikelyStuck] AS [rsnfls]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                        ON  [rsnfls].[RequestKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                    LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]  -- some requests may not have ServicePartitionName since this was added in FIM 2010 Update1
                        ON  [rsnfls].[RequestKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
                )
                
                INSERT [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
                (
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartition],
                    [Creator],
                    [Type],
                    [Count]
                )
                SELECT
                    [TimeUTC],
                    [ServicePartitionName],
                    [User],
                    N'Error-RequestStatusNotFinal-LongLived',
                    COUNT(*)
                FROM RequestErrorsNotFinal 
                GROUP BY [TimeUTC], [User], [ServicePartitionName];
            END 
            
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 4.G Set Up TimeLine Baseline To help Map Events (Maintains the 1 minute slots in a graph)
            *     so when comparing multiple graphs to each other the event times match up visually (vertically).
            *
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            (
                [TimeUTC],
                [ServicePartition],
                [Creator],
                [Type],
                [Count]
            )
            SELECT
                [TimeUTC],
                N'TimeLine',
                N'TimeLine',
                N'TimeLine',
                0
            FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            GROUP BY [TimeUTC];
                        
    /****************************************************************************************************************
    *
    * 5. Load Analysis
    * 
    ****************************************************************************************************************/
        
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 5.A Total Load
            * 
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            DECLARE @averageOperationsPerInterval INT,
                    @numberOfIntervalsWithLoad INT,
                    @totalOperations INT;
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_OperationsLoad]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_OperationsLoad]
            END;
            
            SELECT
                SUM([Count]) AS LoadCount
            INTO [debug].[_OA_OperationsLoad]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            WHERE   [Type] = N'Request'
                OR  [Type] = N'Query'
            GROUP BY [TimeUTC]

            SELECT  @averageOperationsPerInterval = AVG([LoadCount]),
                    @numberOfIntervalsWithLoad = COUNT(*),
                    @totalOperations = SUM([LoadCount])
            FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationsLoad]
                    
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'TotalLoad-RequestAndQuery', 
                    CAST(@totalOperations AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'Number of 1 Minute Intervals with Load ' + CAST(@numberOfIntervalsWithLoad AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]';
            
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 5.B Peak Load
            * 
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            DECLARE @peakLoadTimeUTC NVARCHAR(32);

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_OperationsPeakLoad]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_OperationsPeakLoad]
            END;

            SELECT    
                [TimeUTC],
                SUM([Count]) AS PeakLoadCount
            INTO [debug].[_OA_OperationsPeakLoad]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            WHERE   [Type] = N'Request'
                OR  [Type] = N'Query'
            GROUP BY [TimeUTC]

            SELECT @peakLoadTimeUTC = [TimeUTC]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationsPeakLoad]
            WHERE [PeakLoadCount] =
            (
                SELECT MAX([PeakLoadCount])
                FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationsPeakLoad]
            )

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'PeakLoad', 
                    CAST(SUM([Count]) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'Operations; UTC Time ' + @peakLoadTimeUTC,
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            WHERE    [TimeUTC] = @peakLoadTimeUTC
                AND 
                (    
                   [Type] = N'Request'
                OR [Type] = N'Query'
                )
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] =    
            (
                SELECT 
                    [ServicePartition] AS "@servicePartition",
                    [Creator] AS "@creator",
                    [Type] AS "@type",
                    [Count] AS "@count"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
                WHERE    [TimeUTC] = @peakLoadTimeUTC
                    AND 
                    (
                        [Type] = N'Request'
                    OR  [Type] = N'Query'
                    )
                GROUP BY [ServicePartition], [Creator], [Type], [Count]
                FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            )
            WHERE [Name] = N'PeakLoad';
                                    
            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 5.C Average Load
            * 
            ****************************************************************************************************************/

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'AverageLoadPerOperationInterval', 
                    CAST(@averageOperationsPerInterval AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'Operation Interval is 1 minute.',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]';
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_AverageLoad]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_AverageLoad]
            END;

            SELECT 
                [ServicePartition],
                [Creator],
                [Type],
                COUNT(*) AS NumberIntervals,
                SUM([Count]) AS AvgLoadCount
            INTO [debug].[_OA_AverageLoad]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            WHERE   [Type] = N'Request'
                OR  [Type] = N'Query'
            GROUP BY [ServicePartition], [Creator], [Type]

            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] =    
            (
                SELECT 
                    [ServicePartition] AS "@servicePartition",
                    [Creator] AS "@creator",
                    [Type] AS "@type",
                    [NumberIntervals] AS "@numberOfOperationIntervals",
                    [AvgLoadCount] AS "@operations",
