                    [AvgLoadCount]/[NumberIntervals] AS "@averageLoadDuringOperationInterval"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_AverageLoad] 
                FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            )
            WHERE [Name] = N'AverageLoadPerOperationInterval';

            /****************************************************************************************************************
            *
            * 5.D Maximum Load Per Operation Type
            * 
            ****************************************************************************************************************/
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_MaximumLoad]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_MaximumLoad]
            END;
                        
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'MaxLoadPerOperationType', 
                    N'see [DetailsXml]',
                    N'Operations over a 1 minute interval',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]';
  
            SELECT 
                [ServicePartition],
                [Creator],
                [Type],
                MAX([Count]) AS MaxLoadCount
            INTO [debug].[_OA_MaximumLoad]
            FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]
            WHERE   [Type] = N'Request'
                OR  [Type] = N'Query'
            GROUP BY [ServicePartition], [Creator], [Type]

            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] =
            (
                SELECT 
                    [os].[ServicePartition] AS "@servicePartition",
                    [os].[Creator] AS "@creator",
                    [os].[Type] AS "@type",
                    [os].[Count] AS "@count",
                    [os].[TimeUTC] AS "@timeUTC"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_MaximumLoad]   AS [ml]
                INNER JOIN [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary] AS [os]
                    ON  [ml].[ServicePartition] = [os].[ServicePartition]
                    AND [ml].[Creator] = [os].[Creator]
                    AND [ml].[Type] = [os].[Type]
                    AND [ml].[MaxLoadCount] = [os].[Count]
                FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            )
            WHERE [Name] = N'MaxLoadPerOperationType';


    /****************************************************************************************************************
    *
    * 6. Database Statistics
    *
    ****************************************************************************************************************/

    IF @includeDataStoreStatistics = 1
    BEGIN
    
            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.A FIMService Database Size
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-Database', 
                    N'',
                    N'Size in MB; if maxsize = -1 then AutoGrow',
                    N'',
                    N'sysfiles';
          

            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [Value] = 
            (
                SELECT  SUM([size]*8)/1000
                FROM [sysfiles]
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-Database';
                        
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT  [size]*8/1000 AS "@sizeInMB",
                        [maxsize] AS "@maxsize",
                        [growth] AS "@growth",
                        [name] AS "@name",
                        [fileName] AS "@filename"
                FROM [sysfiles]
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-Database';
            
            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.B FIMService Table sizes
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_TableSizeData]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_TableSizeData]
            END;

            
            CREATE TABLE [debug].[_OA_TableSizeData]
            (
             [name] NVARCHAR(MAX),
             [rows] NVARCHAR(MAX),
             [reserved] NVARCHAR(MAX),
             [data] NVARCHAR(MAX),
             [index_size] NVARCHAR(MAX),
             [unused] NVARCHAR(MAX)
            )

            EXEC sp_MSforeachtable @command1="INSERT [debug].[_OA_TableSizeData] EXEC sp_spaceused '?'"; 
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-Tables', 
                    CAST(COUNT([name]) AS NVARCHAR(4)),
                    N'Count; see [DetailsXml] for sizes',
                    N'',
                    N'EXEC sp_spaceused'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_TableSizeData];
                        
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT  
                        CAST(SUBSTRING([data], 0, CHARINDEX(N' ', [data], 0)) AS INT) +
                        CAST(SUBSTRING([index_size], 0, CHARINDEX(N' ', [index_size], 0)) AS INT) AS "@total",
                        [data] AS "@data",
                        [index_size] AS "@index_size",
                        [name] AS "@name",
                        [reserved] AS "@reserved",
                        [unused] AS "@unused"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_TableSizeData]
                ORDER BY 
                    CAST(SUBSTRING([data], 0, CHARINDEX(N' ', [data], 0)) AS INT) +
                    CAST(SUBSTRING([index_size], 0, CHARINDEX(N' ', [index_size], 0)) AS INT) DESC,
                    [name]
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-Tables';
            
            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6 C. Active Object statistics, per objectType
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_DataStoreObjects]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_DataStoreObjects]
            END;    
            
            CREATE TABLE [debug].[_OA_DataStoreObjects]
            (
                [ObjectTypeName] NVARCHAR(448),
                [Count] BIGINT
            )

            DECLARE @totalObjects BIGINT;

            SELECT @totalObjects = COUNT(*)
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
            WHERE [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;


            INSERT [debug].[_OA_DataStoreObjects]
            (
                [ObjectTypeName],
                [Count]
            )
            SELECT    [oti].Name,
                    COUNT(*)
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
                ON [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key]
            WHERE [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
            GROUP BY [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey], [oti].[Name]

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-Objects', 
                    CAST(@totalObjects AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'Total objects; see [DetailsXml] for count per object type',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_DataStoreObjects]';
            
            UPDATE [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            SET [DetailsXml] =    
            (
                SELECT 
                    [Count] AS "@value",
                    [ObjectTypeName] AS "@name"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_DataStoreObjects]
                ORDER BY [Count] DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root ('data')
            )
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-Objects';

            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.D Schema - Custom Object Types
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal]
                WHERE [key] >@minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
                (
                    [Name],
                    [Value],
                    [Comment],
                    [DetailsXml],
                    [DataSource]
                )
                SELECT  N'DataStore-SchemaCustomObjectTypes', 
                        CAST(COUNT([key]) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                        N'Total Custom Objects',
                        NULL,
                        N'[fim].[ObjectTypeInternal]'
                FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal]
                WHERE [key] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold;
            
                UPDATE [oa]
                SET [DetailsXml] = 
                (
                    SELECT  [key] AS "@key",
                            [name] AS "@name"
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal]
                    WHERE [key] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold
                    ORDER BY [key] DESC
                    FOR XML PATH , root('data')
                )
                FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
                WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-SchemaCustomObjectTypes';
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
                (
                    [Name],
                    [Value],
                    [Comment],
                    [DetailsXml],
                    [DataSource]
                )
                SELECT  N'DataStore-SchemaCustomObjectTypes', 
                        CAST(0 AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                        N'Total Custom Objects',
                        N'',
                        N'[fim].[ObjectTypeInternal]';
            END
            
            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.E Schema - Attributes
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal]
                WHERE [key] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold
            )
            BEGIN            
                INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
                (
                    [Name],
                    [Value],
                    [Comment],
                    [DetailsXml],
                    [DataSource]
                )
                SELECT  N'DataStore-SchemaCustomAttributes', 
                        CAST(COUNT([key]) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                        N'Total Attributes',
                        N'',
                        N'[fim].[AttributeInternal]'
                FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal]
                WHERE [key] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold;
            
                    
                UPDATE [oa]
                SET [DetailsXml] = 
                (
                    SELECT  [key] AS "@key",
                            [name] AS "@name",
                            [datatype] AS "@dataType",
                            [multivalued] AS "@multivalued"
                    FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal]
                    WHERE [key] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold
                    ORDER BY [key] DESC
                    FOR XML PATH , root('data')
                )
                FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
                WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-SchemaCustomAttributes';
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
                (
                    [Name],
                    [Value],
                    [Comment],
                    [DetailsXml],
                    [DataSource]
                )
                SELECT  N'DataStore-SchemaCustomAttributes', 
                        CAST(0 AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                        N'Total Custom Attributes',
                        N'',
                        N'[fim].[AttributeInternal]'
            END
            
            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.F Schema - Bindings
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM [fim].[BindingInternal]
                WHERE  [ObjectTypeKey] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold
                    OR [AttributeKey] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold
            )
            BEGIN            
                INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
                (
                    [Name],
                    [Value],
                    [Comment],
                    [DetailsXml],
                    [DataSource]
                )
                SELECT  N'DataStore-SchemaCustomBindings', 
                        CAST(COUNT([ObjectTypeKey]) AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                        N'Total Custom Bindings',
                        N'',
                        N'[fim].[BindingInternal]'
                FROM [fim].[BindingInternal]
                WHERE  [ObjectTypeKey] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold
                    OR [AttributeKey] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold

                    
                UPDATE [oa]
                SET [DetailsXml] = 
                (
                    SELECT  
                            [ObjectTypeKey] AS "@objectTypeKey",
                            [AttributeKey] AS "@attributeKey",
                            [ObjectType] AS "@objectType",
                            [AttributeName] AS "@attributeName",
                            [Required] AS "@required"
                    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal]
                    WHERE  [ObjectTypeKey] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold
                        OR [AttributeKey] > @minCustomSchemaKeyThreshold
                    ORDER BY [ObjectTypeKey] DESC, [AttributeKey] DESC
                    FOR XML PATH , root('data')
                )
                FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
                WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-SchemaCustomBindings';
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
                (
                    [Name],
                    [Value],
                    [Comment],
                    [DetailsXml],
                    [DataSource]
                )
                SELECT  N'DataStore-SchemaCustomBindings', 
                        CAST(0 AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                        N'Total Custom Bindings',
                        N'',
                        N'[fim].[BindingInternal]';
            END
            
            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.G Sets
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_SetMembership]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_SetMembership]
            END;
            
            DECLARE @setMembership INT;
            
            SELECT  [ovr].[ObjectKey],
                    COUNT(*) AS [Count],
                    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(16)) AS [SizeDistribution]
            INTO [debug].[_OA_SetMembership]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
                ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE   [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
            GROUP BY [ovr].[ObjectKey];

            SELECT @setMembership = @@ROWCOUNT;

            CREATE UNIQUE INDEX [IX__SetMembership_ObjectKey] ON [debug].[_OA_SetMembership] 
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            );
            

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-Sets', 
                    CAST(@setMembership AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                    N'Total Sets',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_SetMembership]';

            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT  [oasm].[Count] AS "@memberCount",
                        CAST([ovt].[ValueText] AS XML).value('(//text())[1]', 'nvarchar(max)' ) AS "@filter",
                        [ovs].[ValueString] AS "@displayName"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_SetMembership] AS [oasm]
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
                    ON [oasm].[ObjectKey] = [ovt].[ObjectKey]
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                    ON [oasm].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE   [ovt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
                    AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
                ORDER BY [oasm].[Count] DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-Sets';

            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.H Set membership statistics
            *
            *****************************************************************************/

            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-SetMembership', 
                    AVG([Count]),
                    N'Avg Membership; Total Members '+ CAST(SUM([Count]) AS NVARCHAR(11)),
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueReference]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_SetMembership];
                
            -- Alpha prefix (e.g. A.) is for sorting.
            UPDATE [sm]
            SET [SizeDistribution] =
                    CASE
                        WHEN [Count] <= 5 then 'A.0-5'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 10 then 'B.6-10'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 25 then 'C.11-25'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 50 then 'D.26-50'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 100 then 'E.51-100'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 1000 then 'F.101-1000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 5000 then 'G.1001-5000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 10000 then 'H.5001-10000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 20000 then 'I.10001-20000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 50000 then 'J.20001-50000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 100000 then 'K.50001-100000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 500000 then 'L.100001-500000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 1000000 then 'M.500001-1000000'
                        ELSE  N'N.1000000+'
                    END
            FROM [debug].[_OA_SetMembership] AS [sm]
            
            
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT SUBSTRING([SizeDistribution],3,LEN([SizeDistribution])-2) AS "@sizeDistribution",
                       COUNT(*) AS "@count"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_SetMembership]
                GROUP BY [SizeDistribution]
                ORDER BY [SizeDistribution] DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-SetMembership';

            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.I Sets with Large membership
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-LargeSets', 
                    COUNT(*),
                    N'Total Sets with membership >' + CAST(@largeSetSizeCriteria AS NVARCHAR(9)) + N' members',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueReference]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_SetMembership]
            WHERE [Count] >= @largeSetSizeCriteria;
                        
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT  [Count] AS "@count",
                        [ovs].[ValueString] AS "@displayName",
                        [sm].[ObjectKey] AS "@setKey",
                        [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS "@setIdentifier"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_SetMembership] AS [sm]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                    ON [sm].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
                    ON [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE   [Count] >= @largeSetSizeCriteria
                    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
                ORDER BY [Count] DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-LargeSets';

            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.J Groups
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_GroupMembership]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership]
            END;
            
            DECLARE @groupMembershipRowCount INT;
            
            SELECT  [ovr].[ObjectKey],
                    COUNT([ovr].[ObjectKey]) AS [Count],
                    0 AS [IsDynamic],
                    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(16)) AS [SizeDistribution]
            INTO [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
                ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]   -- LEFT join because not all Groups have a Filter
                ON  [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = [ovt].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey 
            WHERE   [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey 
                AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND [ovt].[ValueText] IS NULL
            GROUP BY [ovr].[ObjectKey]
            
            UNION
            
            SELECT  [ovr].[ObjectKey],
                    COUNT([ovr].[ObjectKey]) AS [Count],
                    1 AS [IsDynamic],
                    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(16)) AS [SizeDistribution]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
                ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]      -- LEFT join because not all Groups have a Filter
                ON  [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = [ovt].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey 
            WHERE [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey 
                AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND [ovt].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY [ovr].[ObjectKey];

            SELECT @groupMembershipRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

            CREATE UNIQUE INDEX [IX__GroupMembership_ObjectKey] ON [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership] 
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            );

            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-Groups', 
                    CAST(ISNULL(@groupMembershipRowCount,0) AS NVARCHAR(7)),
                    N'Total Groups, see [DetailsXml] for dynamic group ratio',
                    N'',
                    N'[debug].[_OA_GroupMembership]';
            
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT  [oagm].[IsDynamic] AS "@isDynamic",
                        [oagm].[Count] AS "@memberCount",
                        CAST([ovt].[ValueText] AS XML).value('(//text())[1]', 'nvarchar(max)' ) AS "@filter",
                        [ovs].[ValueString] AS "@displayName"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership] AS [oagm]
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
                    ON [oagm].[ObjectKey] = [ovt].[ObjectKey]
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                    ON [oagm].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE   [ovt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
                    AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
                ORDER BY [oagm].[IsDynamic] DESC, [oagm].[Count] DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-Groups';
            
            

            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.K Group membership statistics
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-GroupMembership', 
                    ISNULL(AVG([Count]),0),
                    N'Avg Membership; Total Members '+ CAST(ISNULL(SUM([Count]),0) AS NVARCHAR(11)),
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueReference]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership];
                                    
            -- Alpha prefix (e.g. A.) is for sorting.
            UPDATE [gm]
            SET [SizeDistribution] =
                    CASE
                        WHEN [Count] <= 5 then 'A.0-5'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 10 then 'B.6-10'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 25 then 'C.11-25'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 50 then 'D.26-50'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 100 then 'E.51-100'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 1000 then 'F.101-1000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 5000 then 'G.1001-5000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 10000 then 'H.5001-10000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 20000 then 'I.10001-20000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 50000 then 'J.20001-50000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 100000 then 'K.50001-100000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 500000 then 'L.100001-500000'
                        WHEN [Count] <= 1000000 then 'M.500001-1000000'
                        ELSE  N'N.1000000+'
                    END
            FROM [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership] AS [gm];
            
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT [IsDynamic] AS "@isDynamic",
                       SUBSTRING([SizeDistribution],3,LEN([SizeDistribution])-2) AS "@sizeDistribution",
                       COUNT(*) AS "@count"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership]
                GROUP BY [IsDynamic],[SizeDistribution]
                ORDER BY [IsDynamic] DESC, [SizeDistribution] DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-GroupMembership';


            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.L Groups with Large membership
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-LargeGroups', 
                    COUNT(*),
                    N'Total Groups with membership >' + CAST(@largeGroupSizeCriteria AS NVARCHAR(9)) + N' members',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueReference]'
            FROM [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership]
            WHERE [Count] >= @largeGroupSizeCriteria;
                        
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT  [Count] AS "@count",
                        [ovs].[ValueString] AS "@displayName",
                        [gm].[ObjectKey] AS "@groupKey",
                        [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS "@groupIdentifier"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_GroupMembership] AS [gm]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                    ON [gm].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
                    ON [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE   [Count] >= @largeGroupSizeCriteria
                    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
                ORDER BY [Count] DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-LargeGroups';

            /*****************************************************************************
            *
            * 6.M Recent Request History
            *
            *****************************************************************************/
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[_OA_RecentRequestHistory]') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN 
                DROP TABLE [debug].[_OA_RecentRequestHistory]
            END;
            
            DECLARE @recentRequestHistoryRowCount INT;
            
            SELECT  [ObjectKey],
                    DATEPART(dy,ValueDateTime) AS [DayOfYear]
            INTO [debug].[_OA_RecentRequestHistory]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            WHERE    
                    [ObjectKey] >= @maxObjectKey - @recentChangesLimit
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;
            
            SELECT @recentRequestHistoryRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX__RecentRequestHistory_DayOfYear] ON [debug].[_OA_RecentRequestHistory] 
            (
                [DayOfYear]
            );

            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-RecentRequests', 
                    N'Last ' + CAST(@recentRequestHistoryRowCount AS NVARCHAR(7)) + N' Requests',
                    N'Count per day; see [DetailsXml]',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]';
                

            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT  CAST([DayOfYear] AS NVARCHAR(8)) AS "@dayOfYear",
                        COUNT(*) AS "@count"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_RecentRequestHistory]
                GROUP BY [DayOfYear]
                ORDER BY [DayOfYear] DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-RecentRequests';


            INSERT [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
            (
                [Name],
                [Value],
                [Comment],
                [DetailsXml],
                [DataSource]
            )
            SELECT  N'DataStore-RecentRequestsPerObjectType', 
                    N'Last ' + CAST(@recentRequestHistoryRowCount AS NVARCHAR(7)) + N' Requests',
                    N'ObjectTypes targeted by these requests; see [DetailsXml]',
                    N'',
                    N'[fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]';
            
            UPDATE [oa]
            SET [DetailsXml] = 
            (
                SELECT   COUNT([ovs].[ValueString]) AS "@count",
                        ISNULL([ovs].[ValueString], N'DELETED_TARGET') AS "@objectType"
                FROM [debug].[_OA_RecentRequestHistory] AS [orrh]
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                    ON [orrh].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE [AttributeKey] = @targetObjectTypeAttributeKey
                GROUP BY [ValueString]
                ORDER BY COUNT([ovs].[ValueString]) DESC
                FOR XML PATH , root('data')
            )
            FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis] AS [oa]
            WHERE [Name] = N'DataStore-RecentRequestsPerObjectType';
         
    END
   
    /****************************************************************************************************************
    *
    * 7. Export Results to another Database
    *
    ****************************************************************************************************************/
    
    IF(@exportResultsToNewDB = 1)
    BEGIN
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [name]
            FROM [sys].[databases]
            WHERE [name] = N'FIMService_OperationalStatistics'
        )
        BEGIN
            DROP DATABASE [FIMService_OperationalStatistics];
        END
        
        CREATE DATABASE [FIMService_OperationalStatistics];
        
        -- Requires Dynamic Query because parser fails if the [FIMService_OperationalStatistics] database does not exist.
        EXECUTE sp_executesql N'SELECT * INTO [FIMService_OperationalStatistics].[dbo].[_OperationAnalysis] FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]';
        EXECUTE sp_executesql N'SELECT * INTO [FIMService_OperationalStatistics].[dbo].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary] FROM [debug].[_OA_OperationTimelineSummary]';
        
    END
    
    /****************************************************************************************************************
    *
    * 8. Display Results
    *
    ****************************************************************************************************************/
    SELECT
        [Name],
        [Value],
        [Comment],
        [DetailsXml],
        [DataSource]
    FROM [debug].[_OperationAnalysis]
    ORDER BY Sequence;

END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[CalculateSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[CalculateSetTransitions]
    @requestKey BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @trueFlag BIT;
    
    SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    SELECT 'Initial Request Output'
    EXECUTE [debug].[DisplayRequestOutput] @requestKey;

    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] 
    WHERE       [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] 
    WHERE       [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateRequestOutput] 
        @requestKey = @requestKey, 
        @trace = @trueFlag;        
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    SELECT 'Regenerated Output'
    EXECUTE [debug].[DisplayRequestOutput] @requestKey;

    DECLARE @start DATETIME;

    SET @start = GETDATE();

    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitions]
        @requestKey = @requestKey, 
        @trace = @trueFlag;  

    SELECT 'Time to Execute:',DATEDIFF(ms,@start,GETDATE());    
        
    EXECUTE [debug].[DisplayRequest] @requestKey;            
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[CalculateSetTransitionsByRequestIdentfier]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[CalculateSetTransitionsByRequestIdentfier]
    @requestIdentifier  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @requestKey BIGINT;
    
    SELECT @requestKey = [object].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
    WHERE
            [object].[ObjectId] = @requestIdentifier;
            
    EXECUTE [debug].[CalculateSetTransitions] @requestKey;  	        
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[Cleaner]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[Cleaner]
@topKey BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @conversationHandle             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
    
    DECLARE @obsoleteKey                    TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]                         BIGINT
    );
    
    DECLARE @obsoleteObjectType             TABLE
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey]                     SMALLINT
    );
    
    DECLARE @obsoleteAttribute              TABLE
    (
        [AttributeKey]                      SMALLINT
    );
    
    DECLARE @obsoleteRule                   TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]                         BIGINT
    );
    
    DECLARE @obsoleteRequest                TABLE
    (
        [RequestKey]                         BIGINT
    );
    
    DECLARE @obsoleteMembershipCondition    TABLE
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]            INT
    );
    
    DECLARE @obsoleteStatement              TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey]                      INT
    );
    
    DECLARE @obsoleteTabularFunction        TABLE
    (
        [TabularFunctionKey]                INT PRIMARY KEY
    );
    
    INSERT INTO @obsoleteKey
    (
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT [o].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
    WHERE
            [o].[ObjectKey] > @topKey;
    
    INSERT INTO @obsoleteKey
    (
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT [o].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
    WHERE
            [o].[ObjectKey] NOT IN
            (
                SELECT [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                WHERE
                        [ovr].[AttributeKey] = 0
            )
        AND [o].[ObjectKey] NOT IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            );
    
    INSERT INTO @obsoleteObjectType
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey]
    )
    SELECT [oti].[Key]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
    WHERE
            [oti].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            );
            
    INSERT INTO @obsoleteAttribute
    (
        [AttributeKey]
    )
    SELECT [ai].[Key]
    FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
    WHERE
            [ai].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            );
            
    INSERT INTO @obsoleteRule
    (
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT [mpr].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [mpr]
    WHERE
            [mpr].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [mpr].[PrincipalSet] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [mpr].[ResourceCurrentSet] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [mpr].[ResourceFinalSet] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [mpr].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] IN
            (
                SELECT [oa].[AttributeKey] 
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [oa]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [sync].[EventRequest];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[EventExport];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[Event];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[RetriedExportMessage];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ExportMessageRequest];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[CompletedExportMessage];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ExportMessage];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ExportMessageType];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[AcceptedExportItem];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ExportItem];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ExportNewObject];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[AbortedExport];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ConcludedExport];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[SentExportItemAcknowledgement];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[Export];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[ObjectSynchronizationError];
    DELETE FROM [sync].[SynchronizationError];    
    
    WHILE 1=1 
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @conversationHandle = [endpoints].[conversation_handle] 
        FROM [sys].[conversation_endpoints] AS [endpoints];
        
        IF @@rowcount <= 0
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END

        END CONVERSATION @conversationHandle WITH CLEANUP;
    END

    WHILE EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM [sys].[transmission_queue]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @conversationHandle = [queue].[conversation_handle] 
        FROM [sys].[transmission_queue] AS [queue] ;
        
        END CONVERSATION @conversationHandle WITH CLEANUP;
    END
               
    
    DELETE FROM [fim].[UserSecurityIdentifiers]
    WHERE
            [UserObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            );

    DELETE FROM [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] 
    WHERE
            [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            );

            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute]
    WHERE
            [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRule AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ActionParameterKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [oa].[AttributeKey] 
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [oa]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation]
    WHERE
            [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRule AS [or]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal]
    WHERE
            [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRule AS [or]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute]
    WHERE
            [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRule AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ActionParameterKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [oa].[AttributeKey] 
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [oa]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule]
    WHERE
            [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRule AS [or]
            );
            
    INSERT INTO @obsoleteRequest
    (
        [RequestKey]
    )
    SELECT [r].[RequestKey] 
    FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [TargetKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [TargetObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            );
    
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
        
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
    
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
    
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputIdentifier]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
        
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputInteger]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
        
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ValueReference] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
        
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
        
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
        
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputXml]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
    
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDuplicateString]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
     
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDuplicateText]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ok].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [ok]
            )
        OR  [ObjectTypeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ot].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteObjectType AS [ot]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ai].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [ai]
            );
       
    DELETE FROM [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking] 
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] 
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestStatusChange] 
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] 
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestParameter] 
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [or].[RequestKey]
                FROM @obsoleteRequest AS [or]
            )
        OR  [AttributeKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [oa].[AttributeKey]
                FROM @obsoleteAttribute AS [oa]
            )
        OR  [ObjectKey] IN 
            (
                SELECT [o].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @obsoleteKey AS [o]
            );
            
    DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestPolicyRule]
    WHERE
            [RequestKey] IN
            (

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[CountPendingRequests]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[CountPendingRequests]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    -- DESIGN POINT: This stored procedure was built for CITRunner to assist with test cleanup/restore
    -- operations.  Do not change this for any other purpose.
    -- A pending Request in CITRunner is defined as one that does not have an ExpirationTime 
    -- Attribute on it.
    DECLARE @expirationTimeKey          SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @objectIdentifierKey        SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @requestTypeKey             SMALLINT;
    
    SELECT 
        @expirationTimeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ExpirationTime'),
        @objectIdentifierKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectID'),
        @requestTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'Request');        

    SELECT COUNT([ovi].[ObjectKey]) 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
        ON  [ovi].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @expirationTimeKey 
    WHERE 
            [ovi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestTypeKey 
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey
        AND [ovdt].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[CreateSetPartitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[CreateSetPartitions]
	@setIdentifier     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @statementKey INT;
    
    DECLARE [addPartitionCursor] CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT DISTINCT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON      [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            ON      [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN  [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            ON      [set].[SetKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE       [object].[ObjectID] = @setIdentifier
            
    OPEN [addPartitionCursor];
    WHILE(1 = 1)
    BEGIN
        SET @statementKey = NULL;
      
        FETCH NEXT FROM [addPartitionCursor] INTO 
            @statementKey
        
        IF @statementKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END

        BEGIN TRANSACTION
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions] 
                @statementKey = @statementKey;
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    END;
    CLOSE [addPartitionCursor];
    DEALLOCATE [addPartitionCursor];
    
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DeleteObjectRemainders]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DeleteObjectRemainders]
    @batchToDelete            INT           = 500
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
--Top level
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT OFF;

/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  After fim.DeleteObject or fim.DeleteExpiredSystemObjects sproc processing some
 *  deleted objects data persists in fim.Object and fim.ObjectValueIdentifier tables.
 *  This procedure wipes out these operational (requests + workflows) object`s remains
 *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    DECLARE @count INT;
    SET @count = 1;

    -- Temporary table to collect ObjectKeys of deleted operational 
    -- objects for subsequent total removal

    DECLARE @ObjectsToWipeOut TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]  BIGINT
    );

    WHILE @count > 0
    BEGIN

      BEGIN TRANSACTION;

      INSERT INTO @ObjectsToWipeOut
      (
        [ObjectKey]
      )
      SELECT DISTINCT TOP (@batchToDelete) [O].[ObjectKey]
      FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [O]
      LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [OVDT]
          ON [O].[ObjectKey] = [OVDT].[ObjectKey]
      LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [OVB]
          ON [O].[ObjectKey] = [OVB].[ObjectKey]
      LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [OVBoolean]
          ON [O].[ObjectKey] = OVBoolean.[ObjectKey]
      LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [OVI]
          ON [O].[ObjectKey] = OVI.[ObjectKey]
      LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [OVR]
          ON [O].[ObjectKey] = OVR.[ObjectKey]
      LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [OVS]
          ON [O].[ObjectKey] = OVS.[ObjectKey]
      LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [OVT]
          ON [O].[ObjectKey] = OVT.[ObjectKey]
      WHERE
              [OVDT].[ObjectKey] IS NULL AND [OVB].[ObjectKey] IS NULL AND [OVBoolean].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
          AND [OVI].[ObjectKey] IS NULL AND [OVS].[ObjectKey] IS NULL AND [OVT].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
          AND ([O].[ObjectTypeKey] = 26 OR [O].[ObjectTypeKey] = 36);

      DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier]
      WHERE
            [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT [ObjectKey] FROM @ObjectsToWipeOut)

      DELETE FROM [fim].[Objects]
      WHERE
            [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT [ObjectKey] FROM @ObjectsToWipeOut)

      SET @count = @@ROWCOUNT;

      DELETE FROM @ObjectsToWipeOut;

      COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    END

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DeleteRecordedQueries]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DeleteRecordedQueries]
    @retentionInDays INTEGER = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE @now DATETIME,
            @maxLogKey BIGINT,
            @retentionDate DATETIME;

    SELECT  @now = GETUTCDATE();
    SELECT  @retentionDate = DATEADD(day, -1 * @retentionInDays, @now);

    IF(@retentionInDays = 0)
    BEGIN
        TRUNCATE TABLE [fim].[RecordQueryOperation];
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT @maxLogKey = MAX([LogKey]) 
        FROM [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
        WHERE [StartTime] <= @retentionDate;

        DELETE [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
        WHERE [LogKey] <= @maxLogKey;
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DiagnosticsSetRecordQuery]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DiagnosticsSetRecordQuery]
(
    @on BIT = 1,
    @recordSql BIT = 0
)

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE 
            @enableRecordQuery                      BIT,
            @enableRecordQueryGeneratedSql          BIT,
            @systemPropertyRecordQuery              NVARCHAR(64),
            @systemPropertyRecordQueryGeneratedSql  NVARCHAR(64);
    
    SELECT  
            @enableRecordQuery = 0,
            @enableRecordQueryGeneratedSql = 0,
            @systemPropertyRecordQuery = [fim].[SystemPropertyRecordQuery](),
            @systemPropertyRecordQueryGeneratedSql = [fim].[SystemPropertyRecordQueryGeneratedSql]();
    

    /* DESIGN POINT:  you must turn recording on, before you can add the optional capture of generated SQL */
    IF(@on = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @enableRecordQuery = 1;
        
        IF(@recordSql = 1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @enableRecordQueryGeneratedSql = 1;
        END
    END

    IF(@enableRecordQuery = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXEC [fim].[SetSystemProperty]
            @propertyName = @systemPropertyRecordQuery,
            @propertyValue = N'True';
           
        PRINT N'Record query set to ON';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        EXEC [fim].[SetSystemProperty]
            @propertyName = @systemPropertyRecordQuery,
            @propertyValue = N'False';
                
        PRINT N'Record query set to OFF';
    END
    
    IF(@enableRecordQueryGeneratedSql = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXEC [fim].[SetSystemProperty]
            @propertyName = @systemPropertyRecordQueryGeneratedSql,
            @propertyValue = N'True';
                       
        PRINT N'Record query generated sql set to ON';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
    
        EXEC [fim].[SetSystemProperty]
            @propertyName = @systemPropertyRecordQueryGeneratedSql,
            @propertyValue = N'False';
                
        PRINT N'Record query generated sql set to OFF';
    END
    
END
GO
