CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayExportStatus]
    @summaryOnly            BIT    = 1,
    @exportItemKey          BIGINT = NULL,
    @exportMessageKey       BIGINT = NULL,
    @showCorrelations       BIT    = 0
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @actionCreate                               NVARCHAR(448),
        @actionDelete                               NVARCHAR(448),
        @actionPut                                  NVARCHAR(448),
        @attributeKeyRequestStatus                  SMALLINT,
        @baseExportMessageKey                       BIGINT,
        @currentExportKey                           BIGINT,
        @currentExportSessionIdentifier             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @acceptedExportItemCount                    BIGINT,
        @acknowledgedExportItemCount                BIGINT,
        @falseFlag                                  BIT,
        @objectTypeKeyRequest                       SMALLINT,
        @pendingCreateItemCount                     BIGINT,
        @pendingDeleteItemCount                     BIGINT,
        @pendingUpdateItemCount                     BIGINT,
        @completedMessageCount                      BIGINT,
        @completedSentMessageCount                  BIGINT,
        @sentMessageCount                           BIGINT,
        @pendingCreateMessageCount                  BIGINT,
        @pendingDeleteMessageCount                  BIGINT,
        @pendingUpdateMessageCount                  BIGINT,
        @pendingSentCreateMessageCount              BIGINT,
        @pendingSentDeleteMessageCount              BIGINT,
        @pendingSentUpdateMessageCount              BIGINT,
        @trueFlag                                   BIT;
        
    DECLARE @message TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey] BIGINT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    );
        
    SELECT
        @actionCreate               = N'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2004/09/transfer/Create',
        @actionDelete               = N'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2004/09/transfer/Delete',
        @actionPut                  = N'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2004/09/transfer/Put',
        @attributeKeyRequestStatus  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
        @objectTypeKeyRequest       = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @falseFlag                  = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag                   = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    IF
    (
            @exportItemKey IS NOT NULL
        OR  @exportMessageKey IS NOT NULL
        OR  @showCorrelations = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @summaryOnly = @falseFlag;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [debug].[GetExportStatus]
        @createAction                               = @actionCreate,
        @deleteAction                               = @actionDelete,
        @updateAction                               = @actionPut,
        @currentExportKey                           = @currentExportKey                         OUTPUT,
        @currentExportSessionIdentifier             = @currentExportSessionIdentifier           OUTPUT,
        @acceptedExportItemCount                    = @acceptedExportItemCount                  OUTPUT,
        @acknowledgedExportItemCount                = @acknowledgedExportItemCount              OUTPUT,
        @pendingCreateItemCount                     = @pendingCreateItemCount                   OUTPUT,
        @pendingDeleteItemCount                     = @pendingDeleteItemCount                   OUTPUT,
        @pendingUpdateItemCount                     = @pendingUpdateItemCount                   OUTPUT,
        @sentMessageCount                           = @sentMessageCount                         OUTPUT,
        @completedMessageCount                      = @completedMessageCount                    OUTPUT,
        @completedSentMessageCount                  = @completedSentMessageCount                OUTPUT,
        @pendingCreateMessageCount                  = @pendingCreateMessageCount                OUTPUT,
        @pendingDeleteMessageCount                  = @pendingDeleteMessageCount                OUTPUT,
        @pendingUpdateMessageCount                  = @pendingUpdateMessageCount                OUTPUT,
        @pendingSentCreateMessageCount              = @pendingSentCreateMessageCount            OUTPUT,
        @pendingSentDeleteMessageCount              = @pendingSentDeleteMessageCount            OUTPUT,
        @pendingSentUpdateMessageCount              = @pendingSentUpdateMessageCount            OUTPUT;
    
    SELECT
        N'Calculated Export Status',
        @currentExportKey                           AS N'Export Key',
        @currentExportSessionIdentifier             AS N'Export Session Identifier',
        @acceptedExportItemCount                    AS N'Accepted Item Count',
        @acknowledgedExportItemCount                AS N'Acknowledged Item Count',
        @pendingCreateItemCount                     AS N'Pending Create Item Count',
        @pendingDeleteItemCount                     AS N'Pending Delete Item Count',
        @pendingUpdateItemCount                     AS N'Pending Update Item Count',
        @sentMessageCount                           AS N'Sent Message Count',
        @completedMessageCount                      AS N'Completed Message Count',
        @completedSentMessageCount                  AS N'Completed Sent Message Count',
        @pendingCreateMessageCount                  AS N'Pending Create Message Count',
        @pendingDeleteMessageCount                  AS N'Pending Delete Message Count',
        @pendingUpdateMessageCount                  AS N'Pending Update Message Count',
        @pendingSentCreateMessageCount              AS N'Pending Sent Create Message Count',
        @pendingSentDeleteMessageCount              AS N'Pending Sent Delete Message Count',
        @pendingSentUpdateMessageCount              AS N'Pending Sent Update Message Count';
        
    IF @summaryOnly = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
        
    IF @sentMessageCount > 0
    AND @completedSentMessageCount >= @sentMessageCount
    BEGIN
        SELECT N'ALL SENT MESSAGES HAVE BEEN COMPLETED!';
        
        SELECT N'Items that have not been acknowledged, but which appear to have been completed:'
        
        SELECT DISTINCT [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completed]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [completed].[ExportItemKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [acknowledged]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey]
        WHERE   [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey] IS NULL;
    END
        
    SELECT N'Exports:'
    SELECT 
        [export].[ExportKey],
        CASE
            WHEN [concluded].[ExportKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
            ELSE @falseFlag
        END AS N'Concluded?',
        CASE
            WHEN [aborted].[ExportKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
            ELSE @falseFlag
        END AS N'Aborted?'
    FROM [sync].[Export] AS [export]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ConcludedExport] AS [concluded]
        ON  [export].[ExportKey] = [concluded].[ExportKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[AbortedExport] AS [aborted]
        ON  [export].[ExportKey] = [aborted].[ExportKey];
    
    
    IF @exportItemKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @baseExportMessageKey = [item].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
        WHERE       
                [item].[ExportItemKey] = @exportItemKey
            AND [item].[Primary] = @trueFlag;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF @exportMessageKey IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT @baseExportMessageKey = @exportMessageKey;
        END
    END
    
    IF  @baseExportMessageKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        ;WITH [Correlation]([ExportMessageKey])
        AS
        (
            SELECT @baseExportMessageKey
            UNION ALL
            SELECT [correlated].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey]
            FROM [Correlation] AS [anchor]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlated]
                ON  [anchor].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlated].[ExportMessageKey]
        )
        INSERT INTO @message
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [correlation].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [Correlation] AS [correlation];
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [correlation].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            WHERE   [correlation].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey] = @baseExportMessageKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @message
            (
                [ExportMessageKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [correlation].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            WHERE   [correlation].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey] = @baseExportMessageKey;
        END
    END
    
    SELECT N'Items:'
    
    IF @exportMessageKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [item].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
            [item].[ExportItemKey] AS N'Item Key',
            [item].[SynchronizationSequenceIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
            [item].[SequenceNumber] AS N'Sequence Number',
            [item].[Operation] AS N'Operation',
            CASE
                WHEN [accepted].[ExportItemKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Accepted?',
            CASE
                WHEN [completed].[ExportItemKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Completed?',
             [completingMessage].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Completing Message',
            CASE
                WHEN [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Acknowledged?',
            CASE
                WHEN [message].[ExportItemKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [message].[ExportMessageKey]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Primary Message'
        FROM [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [message].[ExportItemKey]
            AND [message].[Primary] = @trueFlag
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [accepted]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [accepted].[ExportItemKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completed]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [completed].[ExportItemKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [completingMessage]
            ON  [completed].[MessageIdentifier] = [completingMessage].[MessageIdentifier]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [acknowledged]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey]
        WHERE
                @exportItemKey IS NULL
            OR
                (
                        @exportItemKey IS NOT NULL
                    AND [item].[ExportItemKey] = @exportItemKey
                )
        ORDER BY 
            [item].[ExportKey],
            [item].[ExportItemKey];
            
        IF @exportItemKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT N'Accepted Items Pending Acknowledgement:'
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [item].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
                [item].[ExportItemKey] AS N'Item Key',
                [item].[SynchronizationSequenceIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
                [item].[SequenceNumber] AS N'Sequence Number',
                [item].[Operation] AS N'Operation',
                CASE
                    WHEN [completed].[ExportItemKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END AS N'Completed?',
               CASE
                    WHEN 
                            [message].[ExportItemKey] IS NOT NULL 
                        AND [sentMessage].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL 
                    THEN [message].[ExportMessageKey]
                    ELSE NULL
                END AS N'Message'
            FROM [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [message]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [message].[ExportItemKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sentMessage]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sentMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [accepted]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [accepted].[ExportItemKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completed]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [completed].[ExportItemKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [acknowledged]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey]
            WHERE [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey] IS NULL
            ORDER BY 
                [item].[ExportKey],
                [item].[ExportItemKey];
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [item].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
            [item].[ExportItemKey] AS N'Item Key',
            [item].[SynchronizationSequenceIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
            [item].[SequenceNumber] AS N'Sequence Number',
            [item].[Operation] AS N'Operation',
            CASE
                WHEN [accepted].[ExportItemKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Accepted?',
            CASE
                WHEN [completed].[ExportItemKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Completed?',
            [completingMessage].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Completing Message',
            CASE
                WHEN [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Acknowledged?',
            [message].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Primary Message'
        FROM [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [message].[ExportItemKey]
            AND [message].[Primary] = @trueFlag
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [accepted]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [accepted].[ExportItemKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completed]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [completed].[ExportItemKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [completingMessage]
            ON  [completed].[MessageIdentifier] = [completingMessage].[MessageIdentifier]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [acknowledged]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey]
        WHERE   [message].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
        ORDER BY 
            [item].[ExportKey],
            [item].[ExportItemKey];
    END
        
    SELECT N'Sent Messages:'
    
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @message AS [message]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [message].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
            [message].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Message Key',
            [message].[MessageIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
            [type].[Description] AS N'Type',
            CASE
                WHEN [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Pending Transmission?',
            CASE
                WHEN [request].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [request].[RequestKey]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request',
            CASE
                WHEN [requestStatus].[ObjectKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [requestStatus].[ValueString]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request Status',
            CASE
                WHEN [completed].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Completed?'
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]        
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmitted]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [requestStatus]
            ON  [request].[RequestKey] = [requestStatus].[ObjectKey]
            AND [requestStatus].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyRequestStatus
            AND [requestStatus].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKeyRequest
            AND [requestStatus].[SequenceID] = 0
            AND [requestStatus].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
        ORDER BY 
            [message].[ExportKey],
            [message].[ExportMessageKey];      
            
        SELECT 'Incomplete Sent Messages:'
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [message].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
            [message].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Message Key',
            [message].[MessageIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
            [type].[Description] AS N'Type',
            CASE
                WHEN [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Pending Transmission?',
            CASE
                WHEN [request].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [request].[RequestKey]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request',
            CASE
                WHEN [requestStatus].[ObjectKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [requestStatus].[ValueString]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request Status'
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]        
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmitted]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [requestStatus]
            ON  [request].[RequestKey] = [requestStatus].[ObjectKey]
            AND [requestStatus].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyRequestStatus
            AND [requestStatus].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKeyRequest
            AND [requestStatus].[SequenceID] = 0
            AND [requestStatus].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       [completed].[ExportMessageKey] IS NULL
        ORDER BY 
            [message].[ExportKey],
            [message].[ExportMessageKey]; 
          
    END 
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [message].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
            [message].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Message Key',
            [message].[MessageIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
            [type].[Description] AS N'Type',
            CASE
                WHEN [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Pending Transmission?',
            CASE
                WHEN [request].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [request].[RequestKey]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request',
            CASE
                WHEN [requestStatus].[ObjectKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [requestStatus].[ValueString]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request Status',
            CASE
                WHEN [completed].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Completed?'
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN @message AS [selectedMessage]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [selectedMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]        
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmitted]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [requestStatus]
            ON  [request].[RequestKey] = [requestStatus].[ObjectKey]
            AND [requestStatus].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyRequestStatus
            AND [requestStatus].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKeyRequest
            AND [requestStatus].[SequenceID] = 0
            AND [requestStatus].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
        ORDER BY 
            [message].[ExportKey],
            [message].[ExportMessageKey];  
    END
    
    SELECT N'Failed Messages:'
    
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @message AS [message]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [message].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
            [message].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Message Key',
            [message].[MessageIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
            [type].[Description] AS N'Type',
            CASE
                WHEN [request].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [request].[RequestKey]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request'
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]        
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [requestStatus]
            ON  [request].[RequestKey] = [requestStatus].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE   
                [requestStatus].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyRequestStatus
            AND [requestStatus].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKeyRequest
            AND [requestStatus].[SequenceID] = 0
            AND [requestStatus].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag    
            AND [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFailed]([requestStatus].[ValueString]) = @trueFlag
        ORDER BY 
            [message].[ExportKey],
            [message].[ExportMessageKey];      
    END 
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [message].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
            [message].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Message Key',
            [message].[MessageIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
            [type].[Description] AS N'Type',
            CASE
                WHEN [request].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [request].[RequestKey]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request'
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN @message AS [selectedMessage]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [selectedMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]        
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [requestStatus]
            ON  [request].[RequestKey] = [requestStatus].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [requestStatus].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyRequestStatus
            AND [requestStatus].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKeyRequest
            AND [requestStatus].[SequenceID] = 0
            AND [requestStatus].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
            AND [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFailed]([requestStatus].[ValueString]) = @trueFlag
        ORDER BY 
            [message].[ExportKey],
            [message].[ExportMessageKey];  
    END
        
    SELECT N'Messages:'

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @message AS [message]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [message].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
            [message].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Message Key',
            [message].[MessageIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
            [type].[Description] AS N'Type',
            CASE
                WHEN [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Pending Transmission?',
            CASE
                WHEN [sent].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Sent?',
            CASE
                WHEN [request].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [request].[RequestKey]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request',
            CASE
                WHEN [requestStatus].[ObjectKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [requestStatus].[ValueString]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request Status',
            CASE
                WHEN [completed].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Completed?'
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmitted]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [requestStatus]
            ON  [request].[RequestKey] = [requestStatus].[ObjectKey]
            AND [requestStatus].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyRequestStatus
            AND [requestStatus].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKeyRequest
            AND [requestStatus].[SequenceID] = 0
            AND [requestStatus].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE
                    @exportMessageKey IS NULL
                OR
                    (
                            @exportMessageKey IS NOT NULL
                        AND [message].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
                    )
        ORDER BY 
            [message].[ExportKey],
            [message].[ExportMessageKey];
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [message].[ExportKey] AS N'Export Key',
            [message].[ExportMessageKey] AS N'Message Key',
            [message].[MessageIdentifier] AS N'Identifier',
            [type].[Description] AS N'Type',
            CASE
                WHEN [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Pending Transmission?',
            CASE
                WHEN [sent].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Sent?',
            CASE
                WHEN [request].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [request].[RequestKey]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request',
            CASE
                WHEN [requestStatus].[ObjectKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [requestStatus].[ValueString]
                ELSE NULL
            END AS N'Request Status',
            CASE
                WHEN [completed].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END AS N'Completed?'
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN @message AS [selectedMessage]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [selectedMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmitted]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [requestStatus]
            ON  [request].[RequestKey] = [requestStatus].[ObjectKey]
            AND [requestStatus].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyRequestStatus
            AND [requestStatus].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKeyRequest
            AND [requestStatus].[SequenceID] = 0
            AND [requestStatus].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE
                    @exportMessageKey IS NULL
                OR
                    (
                            @exportMessageKey IS NOT NULL
                        AND [message].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
                    )
        ORDER BY 
            [message].[ExportKey],
            [message].[ExportMessageKey];
    END
    
    IF @showCorrelations = @trueFlag
    BEGIN        
        SELECT N'Message Correlations:'
        
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @message AS [message]
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [item].[ExportItemKey],
                [message].[ExportMessageKey],
                [type].[Description],
                [message].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey],
                CASE
                    WHEN [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END AS N'Pending Transmission?',
                CASE
                    WHEN [sent].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END AS N'Sent?'
            FROM [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [message]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [detail]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [detail].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
                ON  [detail].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [item].[ExportMessageKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmitted]
                ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
                ON [message].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]
            ORDER BY
                [message].[ExportMessageKey],
                [message].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey];
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [item].[ExportItemKey],
                [message].[ExportMessageKey],
                [type].[Description],
                [message].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey],
                CASE
                    WHEN [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END AS N'Pending Transmission?',
                CASE
                    WHEN [sent].[ExportMessageKey] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END AS N'Sent?'
            FROM [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [message]
            INNER JOIN @message AS [selectedMessage]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [selectedMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [detail]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [detail].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
                ON  [detail].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [item].[ExportMessageKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmitted]
                ON [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmitted].[ExportMessageKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
                ON [message].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]
            ORDER BY
                [message].[ExportMessageKey],
                [message].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey];
        END
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DisplayExportUpdateReadiness]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayExportUpdateReadiness]
    @exportMessageKey       BIGINT = NULL
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey        SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                      BIT,
        @invalidTargetCount             BIGINT,
        @pendingTargetCount             BIGINT;
    
    SELECT
        @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @pendingTargetCount = 0,
        @invalidTargetCount = 0;
    
    DECLARE @target TABLE
    (
        [TargetObjectKey]       BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @failedMessage TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]      BIGINT NOT NULL,
        [TargetObjectKey]       BIGINT NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey],
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @invalidTarget TABLE
    (
        [TargetObjectKey]       BIGINT NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
        WHERE       [target].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @target
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
        WHERE       [target].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @failedMessage
        (
            [TargetObjectKey],
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [target].[TargetObjectKey],
            [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag;
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [failed].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @failedMessage AS [failed]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [retried]
                ON  [failed].[ExportMessageKey] = [retried].[RetriedExportMessageKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [failed]
            FROM @failedMessage AS [failed]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [retried]
                ON  [failed].[ExportMessageKey] = [retried].[RetriedExportMessageKey]
        END
    END
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [failed].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @failedMessage AS [failed]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @invalidTarget
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [failed].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @failedMessage AS [failed]
        
        DELETE [target]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN @invalidTarget AS [invalid]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [invalid].[TargetObjectKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [time]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [time].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE       [time].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE @target
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [time]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [time].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE       [time].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;
    END
    
    SELECT @invalidTargetCount = COUNT([target].[TargetObjectKey])
    FROM @invalidTarget AS [target]
    
    SELECT @pendingTargetCount = COUNT([target].[TargetObjectKey])
    FROM @target AS [target]
    
    IF
    (
            @pendingTargetCount <= 0
        AND	@invalidTargetCount <= 0
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT N'Ready to send'
    END         
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT 
            @pendingTargetCount AS [Pending Target Count],
            @invalidTargetCount AS [Invalid Target Count];
            
        SELECT N'Pending Targets:'
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @target AS [target];
        
        SELECT N'Invalid Targets:'
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @invalidTarget AS [target]
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DisplayMembershipCondition]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayMembershipCondition]
    @membershipConditionKey	INT
AS 
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @displayNameAttributeKey    SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                  BIT,
        @targetReferentIdentifier   INT,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
        @targetReferentIdentifier = [fim].[GetMembershipConditionTargetReferentIdentifier](),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    SELECT 'Statements:'
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'Membership Condition',
        [mcs].[StatementKey] AS N'Statement',
        [mcs].[XPath] AS N'XPath',
        CASE 
            WHEN 
                [mcs].[ReferentKey] = @targetReferentIdentifier 
                OR [mcs].[ReferentKey] IS NULL 
            THEN N'Target Referent'
            ELSE CAST([mcs].[ReferentKey] AS NVARCHAR(64))
        END AS N'Referent',
        ai.[Name] AS 'Attribute',
        CASE 
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @falseFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag))THEN N'='
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @falseFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag))THEN N'!='
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag))THEN N'>'
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag))THEN N'<='
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag))THEN N'LIKE'
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag))THEN N'NOT LIKE'
            ELSE N'?'
        END AS N'Relation',
        CASE 
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal Boolean Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal DateTime Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueInteger] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal Integer Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal Reference Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal String Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Function Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Dereferenced Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursionFrom] = @trueFlag)THEN N'Recursion from dereferenced value'
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursionTo] = @trueFlag)THEN N'Recursion to dereferenced value'
            ELSE N'?'
        END AS N'Type',
        CASE 
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL)THEN CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL)THEN CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueInteger] IS NOT NULL)THEN CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueInteger] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL)THEN 
                CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueReference] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN [referenced].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL THEN  ': ' + [referenced].[ValueString]
                        ELSE N'?'
                    END
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN [mcs].[LiteralValueString]
            WHEN(([mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL)AND([mcfv].[Function] IS NOT NULL))THEN [mcfv].[Function]
            WHEN(([mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL)AND([mcfv].[Function] IS NULL))THEN N'Unknown Function'
            WHEN([mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'<Dereferenced Value>'
            ELSE N'?'
        END AS N'Value',
        [mcs].[MissingValue] AS N'Match on missing values?',
        CASE
            WHEN [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [dereferenced].[ValueString]
            ELSE N'<None>'
        END AS N'Dereferenced Object',
        CASE
            WHEN([mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN [dereferencedAttribute].[Name]
            ELSE N'<None>'
        END AS N'Dereferenced Attribute',
        CASE
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN [recursiveAttribute].[Name]
            ELSE N'<None>'
        END AS N'Recursive Attribute'
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
        ON [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
        AND [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [mcfv]
        ON [mcs].[FunctionValueKey] = [mcfv].[FunctionValueKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [dereferencedAttribute]
        ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedAttribute].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS recursiveAttribute
        ON [mcs].[RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey] = [recursiveAttribute].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [referenced]
        ON [mcs].[LiteralValueReference] = [referenced].[ObjectKey]
        AND [referenced].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [dereferenced]
        ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferenced].[ObjectKey]
        AND [dereferenced].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    ORDER BY [mcs].[StatementKey];
    
    SELECT N'Partitioning:';
    SELECT DISTINCT [partition].[StatementKey]
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
    WHERE       [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
        
    SELECT N'Membership Condition Statement Truth:'
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mcmcs.MembershipConditionKey	AS N'Membership Condition',
        mcst.StatementKey				AS N'Statement',
        mcst.[ResourceKey]			    AS N'Matching Resource Identifier',
        v.[ValueString]					AS N'Resource Name'
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS mcs
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS mcst
    ON
    (
        (mcs.StatementKey = mcst.StatementKey)
    )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS mcmcs
    ON
    (
        (mcmcs.MembershipConditionKey = @membershipConditionKey)
        AND
        (mcs.StatementKey = mcmcs.StatementKey)
    )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS v
    ON
    (
        (mcst.[ResourceKey] = v.[ObjectKey])
        AND
        (v.[AttributeKey] = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'DisplayName'))
    )
    ORDER BY mcst.StatementKey;
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayMembershipConditionStatement]
    @statementKey	INT
AS 
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @displayNameAttributeKey    SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                  BIT,
        @targetReferentIdentifier   INT,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @targetReferentIdentifier = [fim].[GetMembershipConditionTargetReferentIdentifier](),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [mcs].[StatementKey] AS N'Statement',
        [mcs].[XPath] AS N'XPath',
        CASE 
            WHEN 
                [mcs].[ReferentKey] = @targetReferentIdentifier 
                OR [mcs].[ReferentKey] IS NULL 
            THEN N'Target Referent'
            ELSE CAST([mcs].[ReferentKey] AS NVARCHAR(64))
        END AS N'Referent',
        ai.[Name] AS 'Attribute',
        CASE 
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @falseFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag))THEN N'='
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @falseFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag))THEN N'!='
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag))THEN N'>'
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag))THEN N'<='
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag))THEN N'LIKE'
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag))THEN N'NOT LIKE'
            ELSE N'?'
        END AS N'Relation',
        CASE 
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal Boolean Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal DateTime Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueInteger] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal Integer Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal Reference Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal String Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Function Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Dereferenced Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursionFrom] = @trueFlag)THEN N'Recursion from dereferenced value'
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursionTo] = @trueFlag)THEN N'Recursion to dereferenced value'
            ELSE N'?'
        END AS N'Type',
        CASE 
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL)THEN CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL)THEN CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueInteger] IS NOT NULL)THEN CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueInteger] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL)THEN 
                CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueReference] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN [referenced].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL THEN  ': ' + [referenced].[ValueString]
                        ELSE N'?'
                    END
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN [mcs].[LiteralValueString]
            WHEN(([mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL)AND([mcfv].[Function] IS NOT NULL))THEN [mcfv].[Function]
            WHEN(([mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL)AND([mcfv].[Function] IS NULL))THEN N'Unknown Function'
            WHEN([mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'<Dereferenced Value>'
            ELSE N'?'
        END AS N'Value',
        [mcs].[MissingValue] AS N'Match on missing values?',
        CASE
            WHEN [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [dereferenced].[ValueString]
            ELSE N'<None>'
        END AS N'Dereferenced Object',
        CASE
            WHEN([mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN [dereferencedAttribute].[Name]
            ELSE N'<None>'
        END AS N'Dereferenced Attribute',
        CASE
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN [recursiveAttribute].[Name]
            ELSE N'<None>'
        END AS N'Recursive Attribute'
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [mcfv]
        ON [mcs].[FunctionValueKey] = [mcfv].[FunctionValueKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [dereferencedAttribute]
        ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedAttribute].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS recursiveAttribute
        ON [mcs].[RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey] = [recursiveAttribute].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [referenced]
        ON [mcs].[LiteralValueReference] = [referenced].[ObjectKey]
        AND [referenced].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [dereferenced]
        ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferenced].[ObjectKey]
        AND [dereferenced].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    WHERE       [mcs].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
    
    SELECT N'Partitioning:';
    SELECT DISTINCT [partition].[MembershipConditionKey]
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
    WHERE       [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
    
    SELECT DISTINCT [partition].[SetKey]
    FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
    WHERE       [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
        
    SELECT N'Membership Condition Statement Truth:'
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mcst.StatementKey				AS N'Statement',
        mcst.[ResourceKey]			    AS N'Matching Resource Identifier',
        v.[ValueString]					AS N'Resource Name'
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS mcs
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS mcst
    ON
    (
        (mcs.StatementKey = mcst.StatementKey)
    )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS v
    ON
    (
        (mcst.[ResourceKey] = v.[ObjectKey])
        AND
        (v.[AttributeKey] = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'DisplayName'))
    )
    WHERE
    (
        ([mcs].[StatementKey] = @statementKey)
    );

END

--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayOrganization]
    @managerDisplayName NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @personKey	BIGINT
	SELECT @personKey = v.[ObjectKey]
	FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] v
	WHERE v.[ValueString] = @managerDisplayName
        AND v.[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName');

    WITH   Organization (ObjectKey, ManagerKey)
    AS     (SELECT v.[ObjectKey],
                   v.[ValueReference]
            FROM   [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS v
            WHERE  v.[ObjectKey] = @personKey
                   AND v.[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Manager')
            UNION ALL
            SELECT v.[ObjectKey],
                   v.[ValueReference]
            FROM   [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS v
                   INNER JOIN
                   Organization AS o
                   ON o.[ObjectKey] = v.[ValueReference]
            WHERE  v.[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Manager'))
    SELECT s.[ValueString] AS 'Employee',
           m.[ValueString] AS 'Manager'
    FROM   Organization AS o
           INNER JOIN
           [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS s
           ON o.[ObjectKey] = s.[ObjectKey]
           INNER JOIN
           [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS m
           ON o.[ManagerKey] = m.[ObjectKey]
    WHERE  s.[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName')
           AND m.[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName');


END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DisplayRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayRequest]
	@key	BIGINT
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	SELECT
		N'Target:',
		[r].[TargetKey],
		N'Operation:',
		[r].[Operation]
	FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
	WHERE
	        [r].[RequestKey] = @key;
	
	SELECT N'Parameters:'
	SELECT DISTINCT
		[rp].[AttributeName]	AS N'Attribute Name',
		[rp].[AttributeValue]	AS N'Value',
		[rp].[Mode]				AS N'Mode'
	FROM [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
	WHERE
	(
		([rp].[RequestKey] = @key)
	);
	
	SELECT N'Ancillary Parameters:'
	SELECT DISTINCT
		[rap].[Name]	AS N'Attribute Name',
		[rap].[Value]	AS N'Value'
	FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
	WHERE
	(
		(rap.[RequestKey] = @key)
	);
	
	SELECT N'Output:'
	EXECUTE [debug].[DisplayRequestOutput] @requestKey = @key
	
	SELECT N'Statement Evaluation:'
	SELECT DISTINCT
		[mcs].[StatementKey]			AS N'Statement',
		[mcs].[XPath]					AS N'XPath',
		[rmcso].[True]					AS N'True?',		
		[rmcso].[ObjectKey]	        AS N'Resource',
		CASE 
			WHEN(v.[ValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN v.[ValueString]
			ELSE N''
		END							    AS N'Resource Name'
	FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
	INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
	    ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].StatementKey
	LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [v]
	    ON [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [v].[ObjectKey]
		AND [v].[AttributeKey] = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'DisplayName')
	WHERE
	        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @key
	ORDER BY
		[mcs].[StatementKey];
		
	SELECT N'Membership Condition Evaluation:'
	SELECT DISTINCT
		[rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]	AS N'Condition',
		[mc].[StatementCount]          AS N'Statement Count',
		[rmco].[TrueStatementCount]		AS N'True Statement Count',		
		[rmco].[ObjectKey]	            AS N'Resource',
		CASE 
			WHEN(v.[ValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN v.[ValueString]
			ELSE N''
		END							    AS N'Resource Name'
	FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [rmco]
	INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
	    ON [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
	LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [v]
	    ON [rmco].[ObjectKey] = [v].[ObjectKey]
		AND [v].[AttributeKey] = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'DisplayName')
	WHERE
	        [rmco].[RequestKey] = @key
	ORDER BY
		[rmco].[MembershipConditionKey];
	
	SELECT N'Statement Truth:'
	SELECT DISTINCT
		[mcs].[StatementKey]			AS N'Statement',
		[mcs].[XPath]					AS N'XPath',
		[rmcst].[True]					AS N'True?',		
		[rmcst].[ResourceKey]	        AS N'Resource',
		CASE 
			WHEN(v.[ValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN v.[ValueString]
			ELSE N''
		END							AS N'Resource Name'
	FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
	INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
	ON
	(
		(rmcst.[RequestKey] = @key)
		AND
		(rmcst.StatementKey = mcs.StatementKey)
	)
	LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [v]
	ON
	(
		(rmcst.[ResourceKey] = [v].[ObjectKey])
		AND
		(v.[AttributeKey] = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'DisplayName'))
	)
	ORDER BY
		[mcs].[StatementKey];
	
	SELECT N'Set Transitions:'
	SELECT DISTINCT
		CASE 
			WHEN([setTransition].[Deleted] = 0)THEN N'Joining'
			ELSE N'Leaving'
		END AS N'Join or Leave?',
		[setTransition].[ValueReference] AS N'Member',
		CASE
			WHEN([member].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN [member].[ValueString]
			ELSE N''
		END	AS N'Member Name',
		[setTransition].[ObjectKey] AS N'Set',
		CASE
			WHEN([displayName].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN [displayName].[ValueString]
			ELSE N''
		END	AS N'Set Name'
	FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [setTransition]
	INNER JOIN [fim].[Set] AS [set]
	    ON [setTransition].[ObjectKey] = [set].[SetKey]
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [displayName]
	    ON [setTransition].[ObjectKey] = [displayName].[ObjectKey]
	    AND [displayName].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName')
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [member]
	    ON [setTransition].[ValueReference] = [member].[ObjectKey] 
	    AND [member].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName')
	WHERE
	        [setTransition].[RequestKey] = @key
	    AND [setTransition].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');
	
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *

--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayRequestOutput]
	@requestKey	BIGINT
AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @displayNameAttributeKey SMALLINT;
	SET @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName');
	
	SELECT DISTINCT
		CASE 
			WHEN([resourceDisplayName].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN [resourceDisplayName].[ValueString]
			ELSE N''
		END AS 'Target',
		CASE 
			WHEN([ro].[Deleted] = 0)THEN N'Set:'
			ELSE N'Removed'
		END AS 'Operation',
		[ai].[Name] AS 'Attribute',
		[ai].DataType,
		CASE	
			WHEN([ai].[DataType] = N'Binary')THEN CAST(ro.ValueBinary AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
			WHEN([ai].[DataType] = N'Boolean')THEN CAST(ro.ValueBoolean AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
			WHEN([ai].[DataType] = N'DateTime')THEN CAST(ro.ValueDateTime AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
			WHEN([ai].[DataType] = N'Integer')THEN CAST(ro.ValueInteger AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
			WHEN([ai].[DataType] = N'Reference')THEN CAST(ro.ValueReference AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
			WHEN([ai].[DataType] = N'String')THEN CAST(ro.ValueString AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
			WHEN([ai].[DataType] = N'Text')THEN CAST(ro.ValueText AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
			ELSE NULL
		END AS 'Value',
		CASE 
			WHEN([referenceDisplayName].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN [referenceDisplayName].[ValueString]
			ELSE N''
		END AS 'Reference'
	FROM 
	(
	    SELECT
	        [rov].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
	        [rov].[AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey],
	        [rov].[ValueBinary] AS [ValueBinary],
	        NULL AS [ValueBoolean],
	        NULL AS [ValueDateTime],
	        NULL AS [ValueInteger],
	        NULL AS [ValueReference],
	        NULL AS [ValueString],
	        NULL AS [ValueText],
	        [rov].[Deleted]
	    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [rov]
	    WHERE
	            [rov].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	    UNION
	    SELECT
	        [rov].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
	        [rov].[AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey],
	        NULL AS [ValueBinary],
	        [rov].[ValueBoolean] AS [ValueBoolean],
	        NULL AS [ValueDateTime],
	        NULL AS [ValueInteger],
	        NULL AS [ValueReference],
	        NULL AS [ValueString],
	        NULL AS [ValueText],
	        [rov].[Deleted]
	    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [rov]
	    WHERE
	            [rov].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	    UNION
	    SELECT
	        [rov].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
	        [rov].[AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey],
	        NULL AS [ValueBinary],
	        NULL AS [ValueBoolean],
	        [rov].[ValueDateTime] AS [ValueDateTime],
	        NULL AS [ValueInteger],
	        NULL AS [ValueReference],
	        NULL AS [ValueString],
	        NULL AS [ValueText],
	        [rov].[Deleted]
	    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [rov]
	    WHERE
	            [rov].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	    UNION
	    SELECT
	        [rov].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
	        [rov].[AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey],
	        NULL AS [ValueBinary],
	        NULL AS [ValueBoolean],
	        NULL AS [ValueDateTime],
	        [rov].[ValueInteger] AS [ValueInteger],
	        NULL AS [ValueReference],
	        NULL AS [ValueString],
	        NULL AS [ValueText],
	        [rov].[Deleted]
	    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [rov]
	    WHERE
	            [rov].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	    UNION
	    SELECT
	        [rov].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
	        [rov].[AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey],
	        NULL AS [ValueBinary],
	        NULL AS [ValueBoolean],
	        NULL AS [ValueDateTime],
	        NULL AS [ValueInteger],
	        [rov].[ValueReference] AS [ValueReference],
	        NULL AS [ValueString],
	        NULL AS [ValueText],
	        [rov].[Deleted]
	    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [rov]
	    WHERE
	            [rov].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	    UNION
	    SELECT
	        [rov].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
	        [rov].[AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey],
	        NULL AS [ValueBinary],
	        NULL AS [ValueBoolean],
	        NULL AS [ValueDateTime],
	        NULL AS [ValueInteger],
	        NULL AS [ValueReference],
	        [rov].[ValueString] AS [ValueString],
	        NULL AS [ValueText],
	        [rov].[Deleted]
	    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [rov]
	    WHERE
	            [rov].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	    UNION
	    SELECT
	        [rov].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
	        [rov].[AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey],
	        NULL AS [ValueBinary],
	        NULL AS [ValueBoolean],
	        NULL AS [ValueDateTime],
	        NULL AS [ValueInteger],
	        NULL AS [ValueReference],
	        NULL AS [ValueString],
	        [rov].[ValueText] AS [ValueText],
	        [rov].[Deleted]
	    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [rov]
	    WHERE
	            [rov].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	) AS [ro] 
	INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
	    ON [ro].AttributeKey = [ai].[Key]
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [resourceDisplayName]
	    ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [resourceDisplayName].[ObjectKey]
		AND [resourceDisplayName].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [referenceDisplayName]
	    ON [ro].[ValueReference] = [referenceDisplayName].[ObjectKey]
		AND [referenceDisplayName].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
	ORDER BY
		[ai].[Name];
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DisplayResource]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayResource]
    @objectKey BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @typeName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
    DECLARE @typeKey  AS SMALLINT
    DECLARE @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;

    SELECT 
        @typeName = [t].[Name],
        @typeKey = [t].[Key],
        @identifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([o].[ObjectKey])
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [t]
        ON [t].[Key] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey

    SELECT 
        [o].[ObjectKey] AS ObjectKey,
        [o].[ObjectTypeKey] AS 'Type Key',
        @typeName  AS 'Type Name',
        [ovs].[ValueString] AS 'Display Name',
        @identifier AS 'Object Guid'
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName')
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey;        

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueBoolean] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'boolean' AS 'type',
        0 AS [SequenceID],
        NULL AS [LocaleKey]  
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueDateTime] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'datetime' AS 'type',
        [o].[SequenceID],
        NULL AS [LocaleKey]  
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueInteger] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'integer' AS 'type',
        [o].[SequenceID],
        NULL AS [LocaleKey]  
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueReference] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'reference' AS 'type',
        0 AS [SequenceID],
        NULL AS [LocaleKey]  
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueString] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'string' AS 'type',
        [o].[SequenceID],
        [o].[LocaleKey]  
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueText] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'text' AS 'type',
        [o].[SequenceID],
        [o].[LocaleKey]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueXml] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'xml' AS 'type',
        [o].[SequenceID],
        NULL AS [LocaleKey]  
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey;

	EXECUTE [debug].[DisplaySetMemberships] @memberKey = @objectKey

    IF 
    (
        (@typeName = N'Set')
        OR
        (@typeName = N'Group')
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [debug].[DisplaySet] @setKey = @objectKey
    END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayResourceByDisplayName]
    @displayName NVARCHAR(448)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @displayNameAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @key                    BIGINT;
        
    SELECT @displayNameAttributeKey  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName');
    
    SELECT @key = [o].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [o]
    WHERE
            [o].[ValueString] = @displayName
        AND [o].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey;
        
    EXECUTE [debug].[DisplayResource] @key;
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplayResourceByIdentifier]
    @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @identifierAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @key                    BIGINT;
        
    SELECT @identifierAttributeKey  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    
    SELECT @key = [o].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]

            [o].[ValueIdentifier] = @identifier
        AND [o].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey;
        
    EXECUTE [debug].[DisplayResource] @key;
