/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DisplaySet]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplaySet]
    @setKey BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @displayNameAttributeKey    SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                  BIT,
        @filter	                    XML,
        @filterXPath                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @targetReferentIdentifier   INT,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @targetReferentIdentifier = [fim].[GetMembershipConditionTargetReferentIdentifier](),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    SELECT @filter = CAST([v].[ValueText] AS XML)
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [v]
    WHERE 
            [v].[ObjectKey] = @setKey;
    
    SELECT @filterXPath = 	
        Root.filter.value(
            'declare namespace enumeration="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2004/09/enumeration"; ./enumeration:Filter[1]',
            'NVARCHAR(448)')
    FROM @filter.nodes('/') Root(filter);
    
    SELECT 
        N'Filter:',
        @filterXPath,
        [sql].[SQL]
    FROM [fim].[SetFilter] AS [sql]
    WHERE
            [sql].[SetKey] = @setKey;
    
    SELECT N'Members:'
    EXECUTE [debug].[DisplaySetMembers] @setKey = @setKey;
    
    SELECT N'Membership Conditions:';
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mcmcs.MembershipConditionKey AS N'Membership Condition',
        mcs.StatementKey AS N'Statement',
        [mcs].[XPath] AS N'XPath',
        CASE 
            WHEN 
                [mcs].[ReferentKey] = @targetReferentIdentifier 
                OR [mcs].[ReferentKey] IS NULL 
            THEN N'Target Referent'
            ELSE CAST([mcs].[ReferentKey] AS NVARCHAR(64))
        END AS N'Referent',
        ai.[Name] AS 'Attribute',
        CASE 
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @falseFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag))THEN N'='
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @falseFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag))THEN N'!='
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag))THEN N'>'
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag))THEN N'<='
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag))THEN N'LIKE'
            WHEN(([mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag)AND([mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag))THEN N'NOT LIKE'
            ELSE N'?'
        END AS N'Relation',
        CASE 
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal Boolean Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal DateTime Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueInteger] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal Integer Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal Reference Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Literal String Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Function Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'Dereferenced Value'
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursionFrom] = 1)THEN N'Recursion from dereferenced value'
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursionTo] = 1)THEN N'Recursion to dereferenced value'
            ELSE N'?'
        END AS N'Type',
        CASE 
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL)THEN CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL)THEN CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueInteger] IS NOT NULL)THEN CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueInteger] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL)THEN 
                CAST([mcs].[LiteralValueReference] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN [referenced].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL THEN  ': ' + [referenced].[ValueString]
                        ELSE N'?'
                    END
            WHEN([mcs].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL)THEN [mcs].[LiteralValueString]
            WHEN(([mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL)AND([mcfv].[Function] IS NOT NULL))THEN [mcfv].[Function]
            WHEN(([mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL)AND([mcfv].[Function] IS NULL))THEN N'Unknown Function'
            WHEN([mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN N'<Dereferenced Value>'
            ELSE N'?'
        END AS N'Value',
        [mcs].[MissingValue] AS N'Match on missing values?',
        CASE
            WHEN [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL THEN [dereferenced].[ValueString]
            ELSE N'<None>'
        END AS N'Dereferenced Object',
        CASE
            WHEN([mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN [dereferencedAttribute].[Name]
            ELSE N'<None>'
        END AS N'Dereferenced Attribute',
        CASE
            WHEN([mcs].[RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL)THEN [recursiveAttribute].[Name]
            ELSE N'<None>'
        END AS N'Recursive Attribute'
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
        ON [smc].[SetKey] = @setKey
        AND [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = [smc].[MembershipConditionKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS mcfv
        ON [mcs].[FunctionValueKey] = [mcfv].[FunctionValueKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [dereferencedAttribute]
        ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedAttribute].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS recursiveAttribute
        ON [mcs].[RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey] = [recursiveAttribute].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [referenced]
        ON [mcs].[LiteralValueReference] = [referenced].[ObjectKey]
        AND [referenced].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [dereferenced]
        ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferenced].[ObjectKey]
        AND [dereferenced].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    ORDER BY 
        [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey], 
        [mcs].[StatementKey];
        
    SELECT N'Partitioning:';
    SELECT DISTINCT [partition].[StatementKey]
    FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
    WHERE       [partition].[SetKey] = @setKey;
    
    SELECT N'Membership Condition Statement Truth:';
    
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mcmcs.MembershipConditionKey	AS N'Membership Condition',
        mcst.StatementKey				AS N'Statement',
        mcst.[ResourceKey]				AS N'Matching Resource Identifier',
        v.[ValueString]					AS N'Resource Name'
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS mcs
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS mcst
    ON
    (
        (mcs.StatementKey = mcst.StatementKey)
    )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS mcmcs
    ON
    (
        (mcs.StatementKey = mcmcs.StatementKey)
    )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS smc
    ON
    (
        (smc.[SetKey] = @setKey)
        AND
        (mcmcs.MembershipConditionKey = smc.MembershipConditionKey)
    )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS v
    ON
    (
        (mcst.ResourceKey = v.[ObjectKey])
        AND
        (v.[AttributeKey] = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'DisplayName'))
    )
    ORDER BY mcmcs.MembershipConditionKey, mcst.StatementKey;
END
GO

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplaySetMembers]
	@setKey BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	SELECT DISTINCT
		[member].[ObjectKey]	AS N'ObjectKey',
		[type].[Name]			AS N'Type',
		[member].[ValueString]	AS N'Display Name'
	FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
	INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [member]
	ON 
	(
		([set].[ValueReference] = [member].[ObjectKey])
	)
	INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [type]
    ON 
    (
		([member].[ObjectTypeKey] = [type].[Key])
	)
	INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [computedMember]
	ON
	(
		([set].[AttributeKey] = [computedMember].[Key])
	)
	INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [displayName]
	ON
	(
		([member].[AttributeKey] = [displayName].[Key])
	)
	WHERE 
	(
		([set].[ObjectKey] = @setKey)
		AND
		([computedMember].[Name] = N'ComputedMember')
		AND
		([displayName].[Name] = N'DisplayName')
	);
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DisplaySetMemberships]
	@memberKey	BIGINT
AS 
BEGIN
	SELECT DISTINCT
		@memberKey	    AS N'Member Key',
		sm.[ObjectKey]	AS N'Set Key',
		v.[ValueString]	AS N'Display Name'
	FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS sm
	JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS v
	    ON sm.[ObjectKey] = v.[ObjectKey] 
	    AND sm.[ObjectTypeKey] = v.[ObjectTypeKey] 
	WHERE sm.[ValueReference] = @memberKey
	AND v.[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName')
	AND sm.[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DoBulkTerminateWorkflow]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DoBulkTerminateWorkflow]
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN

    DECLARE @messageText    NVARCHAR(2000),
            @falseFlag      BIT;
    
    SELECT @falseFlag   = CONVERT(BIT,0);

    BEGIN TRY
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @falseFlag;

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Initialize locals
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @acquiredLock               INTEGER,
                @lockName                   NVARCHAR(64),               
                @reason                     NVARCHAR(MAX),
                @requestIdentifier          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @requestStatusMessage       NVARCHAR(448),
                @workflowInstanceIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @workflowStatusKey          TINYINT,
                @workflowTypeName           NVARCHAR(448);

        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @lockName = N'BulkTerminateWorkflow',
                @workflowStatusKey  = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusTerminated]());

                
        -- We only want a single instance of this running at a time so get a Session lock.
        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockName,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session',
            @LockTimeout = 30000;   -- wait 30 seconds before giving up.

        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END        
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Cancel Identified Requests
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#bulkTerminateWorkflow') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = N'Procedure requires tempdb..#bulkTerminateWorkflow table as input.';
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #bulkTerminateWorkflow
        )
        BEGIN

            DECLARE bulkTerminateWorkflowCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT
                [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier],
                [Reason]                
            FROM #bulkTerminateWorkflow

            OPEN bulkTerminateWorkflowCursor;
            WHILE(1 = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT  @reason = NULL,
                        @workflowInstanceIdentifier = NULL;
                        
                FETCH NEXT FROM bulkTerminateWorkflowCursor INTO 
                    @workflowInstanceIdentifier,
                    @reason

                IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
                BEGIN
                    -- No More Records
                    BREAK;
                END
               
                BEGIN TRY
                
                    IF(@reason IS NULL)
                    BEGIN
                        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Reason must not be NULL.  The WorkflowInstance object should contain a meaningful reason to document this non-standard code path was applied.');
                        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    END
                
                    EXECUTE [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusFinal]
                        @identifier = @workflowInstanceIdentifier,
                        @workflowStatusKey  = @workflowStatusKey,
                        @workflowStatusDetail = @reason,
                        @workflowTypeName = @workflowTypeName OUTPUT,
                        @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT,
                        @requestStatusMessage = @requestStatusMessage OUTPUT;    
                       
                    UPDATE #bulkTerminateWorkflow
                    SET [DidTerminate] = 1
                    WHERE [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier] = @workflowInstanceIdentifier;
                       
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                    
                    UPDATE #bulkTerminateWorkflow
                    SET [DidTerminate] = 0,
                        [Error] = ERROR_MESSAGE()
                    WHERE [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier] = @workflowInstanceIdentifier;
                  
                END CATCH
                
            END
            CLOSE bulkTerminateWorkflowCursor;
            DEALLOCATE bulkTerminateWorkflowCursor; 
        END        
   
    -- Display Results of items processed
    SELECT  [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier],
            [DidTerminate],
            [Error]
    FROM #bulkTerminateWorkflow
    WHERE [DidTerminate] IS NOT NULL;
    
    -- Release the Session lock.
    IF(@acquiredLock >= 0)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
            @Resource = @lockName,
            @LockOwner = N'Session';
    END        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        -- Release the Session lock.
        IF(@acquiredLock >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockName,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DoCheckInTestCleanup]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DoCheckInTestCleanup]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @tableExists            INT;
        DECLARE @topKey                 BIGINT;    

        SELECT @tableExists=COUNT(*) 
        FROM 
            [sys].[objects]
        WHERE 
                [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[TestBaseObjectCount]') 
            AND type IN (N'U');
        
        IF (@tableExists <= 0)
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR ('Cannot find TestBaseObjectCount table', 0, 0);
            RETURN;
        END       
        
        SELECT TOP 1 @topKey=BaseObjectCount 
        FROM [debug].[TestBaseObjectCount];    

        EXECUTE [debug].[Cleaner] 
            @topKey = @topKey;
        DROP TABLE [debug].[TestBaseObjectCount];
        
        EXECUTE [debug].[ToggleAgentSchedules] @on = 1;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DoMaintainSet]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DoMaintainSet]
    @setKey                             BIGINT,
    @reportOnly                         BIT                 = 0,
    @setIdentifier                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL,
    @setTypeKey                         SMALLINT            = NULL,
    @setTypeName                        NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL,
    @falseFlag                          BIT                 = NULL,
    @trueFlag                           BIT                 = NULL,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey         SMALLINT            = NULL,
    @explicitMemberAttributeKey         SMALLINT            = NULL
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  This procedure ensures that changes to sets accomplished via the CITS\
 *  ConfigurableTestDriver are in conformity with the results of executing 
 *  a query with the same filter as the modified sets.  The reason that the 
 *  set membership may not match the query otherwise is that the 
 *  ConfigurableTestDriver circumvents the code that puts sets and requests and
 *  workflow instances into sets.  
 *
 *  This version of the procedure differs from the one in the fim schema by not
 *  creating any request to cover set membership changes, and by not notifying 
 *  the service of those changes.  
 *
 *  This procedure compares the actual membership of a resource of which the 
 *  membership is defined by a filter--the de facto membership--to what the 
 *  membership ought to be, as specified by the filter--the de jure membership.  
 *  If there is any discrepancy between the de facto and de jure membership, 
 *  the discrepancy is corrected, and a notification of the correct is sent.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    DECLARE 
        @ancillaryParameters	                NVARCHAR(448),
        @batchEnd                               BIGINT,
        @batchStart                             BIGINT,
        @correctionCount                        INTEGER,
        @message                                NVARCHAR(2000),
        @memberIdentifier                       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @memberKey                              BIGINT,
        @nestedSetKey                           BIGINT,
        @rowIndex                               BIGINT,
        @rowLimit                               BIGINT,
        @objectTypeKey                          SMALLINT,
        @sql                                    NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
        
    IF @setIdentifier IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @setIdentifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectkey](@setKey);
    END
        
    IF @setTypeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @setTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey](@setKey);
    END
   
    IF @setTypeName IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @setTypeName = [fim].[ObjectTypeNameFromKey](@setTypeKey);
    END
          
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');
    END
    
    IF @explicitMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember');
    END
  
    SELECT  @ancillaryParameters = N'<AncillaryParameters><RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>true</Calculated><Target>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000</Target><PropertyName>SetCorrection</PropertyName><Value xsi:type=''xsd:string''>True</Value><Operation>Put</Operation></RequestParameter></AncillaryParameters>',
            @correctionCount = 0;
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* A.   Correct the membership of any nested first.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             

    DECLARE @nested TABLE
    (
        [NestedSetKey]  BIGINT
    );
    
    INSERT INTO @nested
    (
        [NestedSetKey]
    )
    SELECT [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
        ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
        ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
    WHERE
            [set].[SetKey] = @setKey
    ORDER BY [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey];
                
    DECLARE nestedCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
    SELECT [nested].[NestedSetKey]
    FROM @nested AS [nested]
    
    OPEN nestedCursor;
    WHILE(1=1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @nestedSetKey = NULL;
        
        FETCH NEXT FROM nestedCursor INTO 
            @nestedSetKey;
            
        IF @nestedSetKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END
        
        EXECUTE [debug].[DoMaintainSet] @nestedSetKey;
        
    END
    CLOSE nestedCursor;
    DEALLOCATE nestedCursor;   
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.   Populate a temporary table with the explicit members of the set.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [explicit].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicit]
        WHERE
                [explicit].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [explicit].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [explicit].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetExplicitMember') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #maintainSetExplicitMember;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT [explicit].[ValueReference] AS [MemberKey]
        INTO #maintainSetExplicitMember
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicit]
        WHERE
                [explicit].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [explicit].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [explicit].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
        ORDER BY [explicit].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetExplicitMember]
        ON #maintainSetExplicitMember
        (
            [MemberKey]
        ); 
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* C.   Populate a temporary table with the de jure members of the set.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    SELECT @sql = [filter].[SQL]
    FROM [fim].[SetFilter] AS [filter]
    WHERE
            [filter].[SetKey] = @setKey;
            
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetDeJureMember') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #maintainSetDeJureMember;
    END            
            
    CREATE TABLE #maintainSetDeJureMember
    (
        [MemberKey] BIGINT
    );
    
    INSERT INTO #maintainSetDeJureMember
    (
        [MemberKey]
    )
    EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql;   
    
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeJureMember]
    ON #maintainSetDeJureMember
    (
        [MemberKey]
    ); 

    -- Add Explicit members
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetExplicitMember') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [explicit].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetExplicitMember AS [explicit]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                ON [explicit].[MemberKey] = [deJure].[MemberKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [explicit]
            FROM #maintainSetExplicitMember AS [explicit]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                ON [explicit].[MemberKey] = [deJure].[MemberKey]
        END  
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [explicit].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetExplicitMember AS [explicit]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #maintainSetDeJureMember
            (
                [MemberKey]
            )
            SELECT [explicit].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetExplicitMember AS [explicit]
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* D.   Populate a temporary table with the de facto members of the set.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetDeFactoMember') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #maintainSetDeFactoMember;
    END            
            
    CREATE TABLE #maintainSetDeFactoMember
    (
        [MemberKey] BIGINT
    );    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
        WHERE
                [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #maintainSetDeFactoMember
        (
            [MemberKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
        WHERE
                [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        ORDER BY [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeFactoMember]
        ON #maintainSetDeFactoMember
        (
            [MemberKey]
        ); 
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* E.   Identify any de facto members of the set that are not de jure
*      members (invalid members)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                ON [notDeJure].[MemberKey] = [deJure].[MemberKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                ON [notDeJure].[MemberKey] = [deJure].[MemberKey];
        END
    END
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* F.   Identify any de jure members that are not de facto members (missing members)
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [deJure].[MemberKey]
        FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
            ON [deJure].[MemberKey] = [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember
        FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
            ON [deJure].[MemberKey] = [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
    END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* F.   Correction
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF(@reportOnly = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @setKey AS N'SetKey',
                [defacto].[ValueReference] AS N'Invalid Member'
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
                ON [deFacto].[ValueReference] = [notDeJure].[MemberKey]
            WHERE
                    [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
                AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
                AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [deJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @setKey AS N'SetKey',
                [deJure].[MemberKey] AS N'Missing Member'
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure];
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        -- Create a new table that records the members to be removed
        -- up to the throttle limit.
        CREATE TABLE #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection
        (
            [MemberIdentifier] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
        );   
              
        -- Create a new table that records the members to be added
        -- up to the throttle limit.
        CREATE TABLE #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection
        (
            [MemberIdentifier] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
        );        
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
        )
        BEGIN      
            INSERT #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection
            (
                [MemberIdentifier]
            )
            SELECT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [notDeJure].[MemberKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        
        
            CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection]
            ON #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection
            (
                [MemberIdentifier]
            ); 
 
            DECLARE setCursorRemove CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
            SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberIdentifier]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection AS [notDeJure]
           
            OPEN setCursorRemove;
            WHILE(1=1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT  @memberIdentifier = NULL;
                
                FETCH NEXT FROM setCursorRemove INTO
                    @memberIdentifier;
                    
                IF @memberIdentifier IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
                
            END
            CLOSE setCursorRemove;
            DEALLOCATE setCursorRemove;
            
            -- Number of corrections made so far
            SELECT @correctionCount = COUNT([notDeJure].[MemberIdentifier])
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection AS [notDeJure];
            
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [deJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        )
        BEGIN      
            INSERT #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection
            (
                [MemberIdentifier]
            )
            SELECT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [deJure].[MemberKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
       
            CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection]
            ON #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection
            (
                [MemberIdentifier]
            ); 
        
            DECLARE setCursorAdd CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
            SELECT [deJure].[MemberIdentifier]
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection AS [deJure]
            
            OPEN setCursorAdd;
            WHILE(1=1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @memberIdentifier = NULL;
                
                FETCH NEXT FROM setCursorAdd INTO 
                    @memberIdentifier;
                    
                IF @memberIdentifier IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
                
            END
            CLOSE setCursorAdd;
            DEALLOCATE setCursorAdd;            
        END
        
        
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[DumpRequestProcessingState]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[DumpRequestProcessingState]
(
   @requestIdentifier  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL,
   @requestKey         BIGINT              = NULL
)
AS
-- Top Level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),
                @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;

        SELECT
            @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
            
        IF(@requestIdentifier IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            IF(@requestKey IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageText = N'both @requestIdentifier and @requestKey were NULL.';
                RAISERROR(@messageText, 16 ,1);

            END
            
            SELECT @requestIdentifier = [o].[ObjectID]
            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            WHERE [o].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey;
        END
        
        IF
        (
                @requestIdentifier IS NULL
        )
        OR NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            WHERE [o].[ObjectID] = @requestIdentifier
                AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey

        ) 
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [debug].[FormatRequestObjectNotFound](@requestKey, @requestIdentifier);
            RAISERROR(@messageText, 16 ,1);
        END
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Find internal state for RequestProcessingState.
        *    Select columns are provided to assist with diagnostics around why a Request
        *    is in a specific state.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestIdentifier AS [ObjectValueIdentifier],
                [r].[RequestKey] AS [RequestKey],
                [r].[ServiceId] AS [RequestServiceId],
                [r].[ServicePartitionId] AS [RequestServicePartitionId],
                [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([r].[TargetKey]) AS [RequestTarget],
                [TargetObjectTypeName] AS [RequestTargetObjectTypeName],
                [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([r].[Creator]) AS [RequestCreator],
                [r].[Operation] AS [RequestOperation],
                [fim].[GetRequestStatusName]([r].[Status]) AS [RequestStatus],
                [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([r].[Cause]) AS [RequestCause],
                [r].[Time]AS [RequestTime],
                [r].[CommittedTime] AS [RequestCommittedTime],
                [r].[ReEvaluated] AS [RequestReEvaluated],
                [wi].[Identifier] AS [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier],
                [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeName]([wi].[WorkflowType]) AS [WorkflowInstanceWorkflowType],
                [wi].[Finished] AS [WorkflowInstanceFinished],
                [wi].[ServiceId] AS [WorkflowInstanceServiceId],
                [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusName]([wi].WorkflowStatus) AS [WorkflowInstanceWorkflowStatus],
                [wi].[WorkflowControlMessage] AS [WorkflowInstanceWorkflowControlMessage],
                [wi].[RequestUpdateFailed] AS [WorkflowInstanceRequestUpdateFailed],
                [is].[blocked] AS [InstanceStateblocked],
                [is].[modified] AS [InstanceStatemodified],
                [is].[nextTimer] AS [InstanceStatenextTimer],
                [is].[ownedUntil] AS [InstanceStateownedUntil],
                [is].[ownerID] AS [InstanceStateownerID],
                [is].[unlocked] AS [InstanceStateunlocked],
                [wisq].[ServiceHostName] AS [WorkItemSchedulerQueueServiceHostName],
                [wisq].[Created] AS [WorkItemSchedulerQueueCreated],
                [wisq].[LockExpiration] AS [WorkItemSchedulerQueueLockExpiration],
                [wisq].[LockOwner] AS [WorkItemSchedulerQueueLockOwner],
                [wisq].[RetryCount] AS [WorkItemSchedulerQueueRetryCount],
                [wisq].[NextRetry] AS [WorkItemSchedulerQueueNextRetry],
                [sh].[LastPingTime] AS [ServiceHeartbeatLastPingTime],
                [sh].[ServiceName] AS [ServiceHeartbeatServiceName],
                [sh].[ServiceId] AS [ServiceHeartbeatServiceId],
                [sh].[ServicePartitionId] AS [ServiceHeartbeatServicePartitionId],
                [sh].[LastRestartTime] AS [ServiceHeartbeatRestartTime],
                [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionName]([rm].ActionType) AS [RequestMonitorActionType],
                [rm].[DateAdded] AS [RequestMonitorDateAdded],
                [rm].[NextActionDate] AS [RequestMonitorNextActionDate],
                [rm].[ActionsAttempted] AS [RequestMonitorActionsAttempted],
                [fim].[GetRequestStatusName]([rm].RequestStatusKey) AS [RequestMonitorRequestStatusKey],
                [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([rct].[CauseKey]) AS [RequestCancelTrackingCauseKey],
                [rct].[RequestStatusCurrent] AS [RequestCancelTrackingRequestStatusCurrent],
                [rct].[RequestStatusFinal] AS [RequestCancelTrackingRequestStatusFinal],
                [rct].[AddTime] AS [RequestCancelTrackingAddTime],
                [rct].[FinalizeCancelRequest] AS [RequestCancelTrackingFinalizeCancelRequest],
                [rctCause].[RequestKey] AS [RequestCancelTrackingRequestKey],
                [crt].[CollateralWorkflowCount] AS [CollateralRequestTrackingCollateralWorkflowCount],
                [crt].[AddTime] AS [CollateralRequestTrackingAddTime],
                [crt].[TrackingStatus] [CollateralRequestTrackingTrackingStatus],
                [crt].[NextCheckTime] [CollateralRequestTrackingNextCheckTime],                
                [pa].[TargetKey] AS [PolicyApplicationTargetKey],
                [pa].[ServiceId] AS [PolicyApplicationServiceId],
                [pa].[DispatchTime] AS [PolicyApplicationDispatchTime],
                [pa].[IsCanceled] AS [PolicyApplicationIsCanceled],
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETUTCDATE(), 127) + N'Z'  AS [CurrentTime]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
        ON [r].[RequestKey] = [wi].[RequestKey]
        LEFT JOIN [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]
        ON [wi].[Identifier] = [is].[uidInstanceID]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [wisq]
        ON [wisq].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = [wi].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON [r].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [sh]
        ON      [r].[serviceId] = [sh].[serviceId]            
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[RequestMonitor] AS [rm]
        ON [r].[RequestKey] = [rm].[RequestKey]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[RequestCancelTracking] AS [rct]
        ON [r].[RequestKey] = [rct].[RequestKey]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[RequestCancelTracking] AS [rctCause]
        ON [r].[RequestKey] = [rctCause].[CauseKey]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking] AS [crt]
        ON [r].[RequestKey] = [crt].[RequestKey]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[PolicyApplication] AS [pa]
        ON [r].[RequestKey] = [pa].[RequestKey]
        WHERE [ovi].ValueIdentifier = @requestIdentifier
        FOR XML RAW, ELEMENTS ;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException]
    END CATCH
 END
GO
