/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[GetActiveRequestsSummary]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[GetActiveRequestsSummary]
AS
-- Called by other stored procedures
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     *      This script can be used to find all Requests that are still "in-process"
     *      and provide information on which ServiceId/ServicePartitionId they
     *      are tied to along with the LastPingTime for when a FIMService was running
     *      that could service each ServiceId/ServicePartitionId. 
     *
     *      If there is no running FIMService (the LastPingTime is not recent), 
     *      for a particular ServiceId/ServicePartitionId, this is likely the main reason these Requests are still 
     *      "in-process".  Requests can only finish processing on the same ServiceId/ServicePartitionId
     *      that created them.  This script will advise of this situation
     *      by indicating a ServiceId/ServicePartitionId Health "NEEDS IMPERSONATION"
     *
     *      If "NEEDS IMPERSONATION" is returned, the operator can do this by
     *      configuring an operational FIMService to temporarily override or set attributes in the 
     *      FIMService config file (Microsoft.ResourceManagement.Service.exe.config) 
     *      <resourceManagementService  serviceName=""  servicePartitionName=""> 
     *      that allow any operational FIMService to impersonate another.  This strategy
     *      can be used if one of the ServiceId/ServicePartitionId returned in the query
     *      is no longer operational and the operator just wants to clear out the "in-process"
     *      Requests to clean up the database.
     *
     *      NOTE:  Operators should setup a new temporary instance of a FIMService to perform IMPERSONATION work 
     *      to ensure that no new Requests are generated by this instance during the maintenance window.
     *      OR
     *      If this is not an option and an operator wants to use an existing FIMService instance then
     *      operators should disable all processes that could generate new Requests in
     *      FIM during this maintenance period so that no new Requests are created on the ServiceID/
     *      ServicePartitionId that the operator is trying to IMPERSONATE.  SQL jobs related to FIM, end user
     *      traffic via FIM Portal,  FIM SynchronizationService FIM MA Exports and any other custom clients should be disabled.
     *      The last thing you want are "new" Requests on an old ServiceId/ServicePartitionId because you may
     *      end up in a never ending cycle.
     *
     *      WARNING:  If you choose to IMPERSONATE, any Request will be allowed to perform its intended 
     *      operations which could Add/Update/Delete data in FIM.  Since it is likely that this Request is very
     *      old, or possibly was created on a ServiceId/ServicePartitionId that may have been used to TEST the product
     *      you could get undesireable results.  If your intent is to just clean the Database of Old Requests, then you should
     *      first CANCEL all such requests before doing IMPERSONATION.
     *      
     *      CANCEL:  If you need to Cancel the requests, you can use the FIM Portal to search for all Requests
     *      that have the same ServicePartitionName attribute that you are trying to IMPERSONATE, and then Cancel these
     *      requests. 
     * 
     *      To perform IMPERSONATION, the operator would first stop their operational FIMService, 
     *      set the serviceName and ServicePartitionName
     *      values, then start the FIM Service and let it run for several minutes.  A re-run
     *      of this query would show whether or not all Requests associated with that
     *      ServiceId/ServicePartitionId have finished (The query would no longer show that
     *      ServiceId/ServicePartitionId in its result set, since all requests tied to it are now finished).
     *
     *      If after waiting a few minutes, you still see the ServiceId/ServicePartitionId then this
     *      indicates that you would likely have to CANCEL the remaining Requests (if you ignored the previous WARNING)
     *      for them to be finished.  In this case, you should see the ServiceId/servicePartitionId
     *      show "GOOD" for the [ServiceId/ServicePartitionId Health] column which means that you have properly
     *      impersonated this ServiceId/ServicePartitionId
     *
     *      If instead after waiting a few minutes, your ServiceId/ServicePartitionId still shows up on the list and the
     *      [Request Status] = "Canceling" then the customer should contact FIM customer service to get additional 
     *      help in clearing out the "stuck" requests.
     *      
     *      An operator would repeat the above process for every combination of ServiceId/ServicePartitionId
     *      that exists from the below query.
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
     
     DECLARE @createdTimeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
             @lastRequestCreatedTime  DATETIME,
             @lastRequestIdentifier   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
             @lastRequestObjectKey    BIGINT,   
             @requestObjectTypeKey    SMALLINT;

     SELECT @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
            @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
    
     SELECT 
        @lastRequestObjectKey = MAX([o].[ObjectKey])
     FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
     INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
     WHERE [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;
        

     SELECT 
        @lastRequestCreatedTime = ValueDateTime,
        @lastRequestIdentifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([ObjectKey])
     FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
     WHERE  [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
        AND [ObjectKey] = @lastRequestObjectKey;
     
    SELECT @lastRequestObjectKey AS [LastRequestCreatedObjectKey],
           @lastRequestIdentifier AS [Identifier],
           CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @lastRequestCreatedTime, 127) + N'Z' AS [CreatedTime];


    SELECT
        [r].[ServicePartitionId],
        [sp].[ServicePartitionName],
        [r].[ServiceId],
        [sb2].[ServiceName],
        COUNT(*) as N'Number of Requests',
        [fim].[GetRequestStatusName]([r].[Status]) AS N'Request Status',
        [sb2].[LastPingTime] AS N'Last Ping Time of FIMService that supports this ServiceId',
        CASE
            -- if a serviceId/ServicePartitionId is no longer registered as a pair and not the System Partition, then its possible that requests it used to process are stuck
            WHEN [sb].[ServiceId] IS NULL AND [r].[ServicePartitionId] !=0 THEN N'NEEDS IMPERSONATION'
            -- Request is not registered to the System Partition and the last serviceId that processed this request is no longer running so the request is likely stuck
            WHEN [r].[ServicePartitionId] !=0 AND DATEDIFF(n, [sb2].[LastPingTime], @lastRequestCreatedTime) > 0 THEN N'NEEDS IMPERSONATION'
            ELSE N'GOOD'
        END AS N'ServiceId/ServicePartitionId Health'
    FROM [fim].[Request] as [r]
    LEFT JOIN [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] as [sb]
    ON      [r].[ServiceId] = [sb].[ServiceId]
        AND [r].[ServicePartitionId] = [sb].[ServicePartitionId]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ServicePartition] as [sp]
    ON [r].[ServicePartitionId] = [sp].[ServicePartitionId]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [sb2]
    ON [r].[ServiceId] = [sb2].[ServiceId]
    GROUP BY [r].[ServicePartitionId], [sb].[ServicePartitionId], [sp].[ServicePartitionName], [r].[ServiceId], [sb].[ServiceId], [sb2].[ServiceName], [r].[Status], [sb2].[LastPingTime]
    ORDER BY [r].[ServicePartitionId], [r].[Status], [sb2].[LastPingTime];
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[GetAllSystemObjectsForRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[GetAllSystemObjectsForRequest]
(
    @requestKey BIGINT = NULL,
    @requestIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @returnRecordset BIT = 0
)
AS
-- Called by other stored procedures
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
    
        DECLARE 
            @commitTime DATETIME,
            @displayNameAttributeKey SMALLINT,            
            @index INT,
            @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),
            @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @parentRequestAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
            @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @result  XML;                        

 
        SELECT
            @commitTime = GETUTCDATE(),
            @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
            @index = -1,
            @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
            @parentRequestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ParentRequest'),
            @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
            @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus');
            
        DECLARE @objectValues TABLE
        (
            [ObjectKey] BIGINT,
            [Name] NVARCHAR(448),
            [DataType] NVARCHAR(64),
            [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX)
        )

        DECLARE @objectSet  TABLE
        (
            [ObjectKey]    BIGINT
        );
        
                
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#systemObjects') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #systemObjects;
        END  
        
        CREATE TABLE #systemObjects
        (
            [Order]        INT     IDENTITY(0,1)   PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
            [ObjectKey]   BIGINT                  NOT NULL
        );
        
        CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_SystemObjects_ObjectKey]
        ON #systemObjects
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        );

        IF(@requestIdentifier IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            IF(@requestKey IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageText = N'both @requestIdentifier and @requestKey were NULL.';
                RAISERROR(@messageText, 16 ,1);

            END
            
            SELECT @requestIdentifier = [o].[ObjectID]
            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            WHERE [o].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey;
        END
        
        IF
        (
                @requestIdentifier IS NULL
        )
        OR NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            WHERE [o].[ObjectID] = @requestIdentifier
                AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey

        ) 
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [debug].[FormatRequestObjectNotFound](@requestKey, @requestIdentifier);
            RAISERROR(@messageText, 16 ,1);
        END
        

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @requestIdentifier,
            @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @requestKey OUTPUT;
            
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Find all System Objects that are tied to the @requestKey 
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        INSERT #systemObjects
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )   
        SELECT @requestKey
        FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        WHERE [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        IF(@@ROWCOUNT = 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = N'@requestkey ' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(20)) + ' is not a valid RequestKey';
            RAISERROR(@messageText, 16 ,1);
        END
        
        WHILE (1=1)
        BEGIN            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                -- If this does NOT return anything we know we've processed all
                -- applicable requests. @index is incremented to the last object
                -- after every iteration.
                SELECT TOP 1 [request].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #systemObjects AS [request]
                WHERE [request].[Order] >= @index
            )
            BEGIN
                -- insert all the objects that haven't been processed yet. We find this
                -- by finding the items added since the last index was stored.
                INSERT INTO @objectSet
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT [request].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #systemObjects AS [request]
                WHERE
                        [request].[Order] > @index;
                    
                -- We want to find all system objects
                INSERT INTO @objectSet
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                INNER JOIN @objectSet AS [rs]
                    ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [rs].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE       [fim].[IsSystemTypeKey]([ovr].[ObjectTypeKey]) = 1
                UNION
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [ovr].[ValueReference]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                INNER JOIN @objectSet AS [rs]
                    ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [rs].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
                    ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [o].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE       [fim].[IsSystemTypeKey]([o].[ObjectTypeKey]) = 1;
               
                    
                -- Note that at this time, @objectSet may contain keys that
                -- we've already processed. Use an inner join with the temp table
                -- to delete these references.
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM @objectSet AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #systemObjects AS [duplicate]
                        ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE FROM @objectSet
                    FROM @objectSet AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #systemObjects AS [duplicate]
                        ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                END
                
                
                -- At this time the only things in @objectSet are keys that
                -- we have not yet processed.  Must be merged into 
                -- #systemObjects. 
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM @objectSet AS [candidate]
                )
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @index = MAX([set].[Order])
                    FROM #systemObjects AS [set];
                
                    INSERT INTO #systemObjects
                    (
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM @objectSet AS [candidate];
                    
                    -- clear the temporary cache since we already know that these
                    -- objects are a part of the chain.
                    DELETE FROM @objectSet;
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END
        END -- WHILE(1=1)


    /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * B. Get Attribute Values for all Identififed Objects
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        --Binary
        INSERT @objectValues
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Name],
            [DataType],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
                [ovb].[ObjectKey],
                [ai].[Name],
                [ai].[DataType],
                CAST([ovb].[ValueBinary] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ovb]
        INNER JOIN #systemObjects AS [o]
        ON [ovb].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovb].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key];

        --Boolean
        INSERT @objectValues
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Name],
            [DataType],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
                [ovb].[ObjectKey],
                [ai].[Name],
                [ai].[DataType],
                CAST([ovb].[ValueBoolean] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb]
        INNER JOIN #systemObjects AS [o]
        ON [ovb].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovb].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key];

        --DateTime
        INSERT @objectValues
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Name],
            [DataType],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
                [ovdt].[ObjectKey],
                [ai].[Name],
                [ai].[DataType],
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), [ovdt].[ValueDateTime], 127) + N'Z'
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
        INNER JOIN #systemObjects AS [o]
        ON [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key];

        -- Identifer (Not necessary)

        -- Integers
        INSERT @objectValues
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Name],
            [DataType],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
                [ovi].[ObjectKey],
                [ai].[Name],
                [ai].[DataType],
                CAST([ovi].[ValueInteger] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ovi]
        INNER JOIN #systemObjects AS [o]
        ON [ovi].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovi].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key];


        -- References
        INSERT @objectValues
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Name],
            [DataType],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
                [ovr].[ObjectKey],
                CASE WHEN [ai].[Name] = N'ObjectID' THEN N'ObjectKey' ELSE [ai].[Name] END,
                [ai].[DataType],
                CAST([ovr].[ValueReference] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
        INNER JOIN #systemObjects AS [o]
        ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovr].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key];

        -- Strings
        INSERT @objectValues
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Name],
            [DataType],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
                [ovs].[ObjectKey],
                [ai].[Name],
                [ai].[DataType],
                CAST([ovs].[ValueString] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        INNER JOIN #systemObjects AS [o]
        ON [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovs].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key];

        -- Text
        INSERT @objectValues
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Name],
            [DataType],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
                [ovt].[ObjectKey],
                [ai].[Name],
                [ai].[DataType],
                CAST([ovt].[ValueText] AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
        INNER JOIN #systemObjects AS [o]
        ON [ovt].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovt].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key];

        -- Xml (not used)

        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Get DisplayName and ObjectType for all References that are not System Objects
        *    and include them in the results.
        *-------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        INSERT @objectValues
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Name],
            [DataType],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [ovs].[ObjectKey],
            [ai].[Name],
            [ai].[DataType],
            [ovs].[ValueString]
        FROM @objectValues AS [o]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON [o].[Value] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovs].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        WHERE [o].[DataType] = N'Reference'
            AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = 66;
        	
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D. Get Identifiers in case you need to query from portal.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        INSERT @objectValues
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Name],
            [DataType],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [ovi].[ObjectKey],
            N'ObjectID',
            N'Reference',
            [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]
        FROM @objectValues AS [o]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE [o].[Name] = N'DisplayName'
            AND [o].[DataType] = N'String';

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * E. Return Results;
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF @returnRecordset = 1
        BEGIN
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ov].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
                [oti].[Name] AS [ObjectType],
                [ov].[Name] AS [AttributeName],
                [Value] AS [Value],
                [DataType] AS [DataType]
            FROM @objectValues AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
            ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key]
            ORDER BY [ov].[ObjectKey], [ov].[Name]
        END
        ELSE BEGIN
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ov].[ObjectKey] AS "@objectKey",
                [oti].[Name] AS "@objectType",
                [ov].[Name] AS "@attributeName",
                [Value] AS "@value",
                [DataType] AS "@dataType"
            FROM @objectValues AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
            ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key]
            ORDER BY [ov].[ObjectKey], [ov].[Name]
            FOR XML PATH
        END
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException]
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[GetCachedWorkflowDefinitionAndInstancesSummary]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[GetCachedWorkflowDefinitionAndInstancesSummary]
AS
-- Top level
BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        
         /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * This procedure will find all WorkflowDefinitions, their versions, and the
         * references to these versions.  References can be in three locations:
         *      [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition]
         *      [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
         *      [fim].[PolicyApplication]
         *
         * A specific version will continue to be cached in [fim].[WorkflowDefinition]
         * until there are 0 rows in the above 3 tables that reference the [VersionKey].
         * When a FIMService starts, it looks for in-active versions and then removes
         * them from the cache.
         * 
         * The output of this stored procedure may be useful to identify specific
         * workflowDefinitions, Versions, or Instances that would be the target for 
         * cancelation in order to purge the system of non-useful WorkflowDefinitions
         *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        
        DECLARE @createdTimeAttributeKey                                    SMALLINT,
                @displayNameAttributeKey                                    SMALLINT,
                @sqlPolicyApplicationTemplate                               NVARCHAR(2000),
                @sqlRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionTemplate    NVARCHAR(2000),
                @sqlWorkflowInstanceTemplate                                NVARCHAR(2000),
                @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey                            SMALLINT,
                @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey                              SMALLINT
        
        SELECT  @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
                @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
                @sqlPolicyApplicationTemplate =
                    N'SELECT [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([r].[RequestKey]) AS [RequestIdentifier],
                        [r].[Time] AS [RequestCreatedTime] 
                        FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication] AS [pa] 
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r] 
                        ON [pa].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey] 
                        WHERE [pa].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = {0} 
                        ORDER BY [r].[Time];',
                @sqlRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionTemplate =
                    N'SELECT [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([r].[RequestKey]) AS [RequestIdentifier],
                        [r].[Time] AS [RequestCreatedTime] 
                        FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [rstawd] 
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r] 
                        ON [rstawd].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey] 
                        WHERE [rstawd].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = {0} 
                        ORDER BY [r].[Time];',
                @sqlWorkflowInstanceTemplate = 
                    N'SELECT [wi].[Identifier] AS [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier], 
                        [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([r].[RequestKey]) AS [RequestIdentifier],
                        [r].[Time] AS [RequestCreatedTime] 
                        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi] 
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r] 
                        ON [wi].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey] 
                        WHERE [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = {0} 
                        ORDER BY [r].[Time];',
                @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition'),
                @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowInstance');


        WITH [RunningWorkflows]
        (
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [WorkflowInstanceCount],
            [TableLocation],
            [SQLToFindInstances],
            [CancelOptions]
        )
        AS
        (
            SELECT [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                    COUNT(*),
                    N'WorkflowInstance',
                    REPLACE(@sqlWorkflowInstanceTemplate, N'{0}', CAST([WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] AS NVARCHAR(10))),
                    N'WorkflowInstance or Request'
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            WHERE [Finished] = 0
            GROUP BY [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

            UNION

            SELECT [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                    COUNT(*),
                    N'PolicyApplication',
                    REPLACE(@sqlPolicyApplicationTemplate, N'{0}', CAST([WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] AS NVARCHAR(10))),
                    N'Request'
            FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication]
            GROUP BY [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

            UNION

            SELECT [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                    COUNT(*),
                    N'RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition',
                    REPLACE(@sqlRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionTemplate, N'{0}', CAST([ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] AS NVARCHAR(10))),
                    N'Request'
            FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition]
            WHERE [ActionWorkflowInstanceIdentifier] IS NULL
            GROUP BY [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

        )
        , [WorkflowInstanceDateRange]
        (
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [MinimumObjectKey],
            [MaximumObjectKey]
        )
        AS
        (
            SELECT [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                    MIN(ObjectKey),
                    MAX(ObjectKey)
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            WHERE [Finished] = 0
            GROUP BY [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
        )
        SELECT
            [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS [WorkflowDefinitionIdentifier],
            [ovs].[ValueString] AS [WorkflowDefinitionDisplayName],
            [wd].[VersionKey] AS [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [rw].[TableLocation],
            [rw].[WorkflowInstanceCount],
            [wd].[Xoml] AS [CachedXoml],
            CASE 
                WHEN [wd].[Deleted] = 0 THEN N'True'
                ELSE 'False'
            END AS [DoesWorkflowDefinitionStillExist],
            [ovdtMin].[ValueDateTime] AS [OldestWorkflowInstanceUTC],
            [ovdtMax].[ValueDateTime] AS [NewestWorkflowInstanceUTC],
            [rw].[CancelOptions],
            [rw].[SQLToFindInstances]
        FROM [RunningWorkflows] AS [rw]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[WorkflowDefinition] AS [wd]
        ON [rw].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = [wd].[VersionKey]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON [wd].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] as [ovs]
        ON      [ovi].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
            AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey 
        LEFT JOIN [WorkflowInstanceDateRange] AS [widr]
        ON [rw].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = [widr].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdtMin]
        ON      [widr].[MinimumObjectKey] = [ovdtMin].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ovdtMin].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey
            AND [ovdtMin].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdtMax]
        ON      [widr].[MaximumObjectKey] = [ovdtMax].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ovdtMax].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey
            AND [ovdtMax].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
        ORDER BY [rw].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey];

        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END CATCH 
        END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[GetExportStatus]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[GetExportStatus]
    @createAction                               NVARCHAR(448),
    @deleteAction                               NVARCHAR(448),
    @updateAction                               NVARCHAR(448),
    @currentExportKey                           BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @currentExportSessionIdentifier             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    OUTPUT,
    @acceptedExportItemCount                    BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @acknowledgedExportItemCount                BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingCreateItemCount                     BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingDeleteItemCount                     BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingUpdateItemCount                     BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @completedMessageCount                      BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @completedSentMessageCount                  BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @sentMessageCount                           BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingCreateMessageCount                  BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingDeleteMessageCount                  BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingUpdateMessageCount                  BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingSentCreateMessageCount              BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingSentDeleteMessageCount              BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingSentUpdateMessageCount              BIGINT              OUTPUT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE
        @acceptedCount      BIGINT,
        @completedCount     BIGINT,
        @falseFlag          BIT,
        @trueFlag           BIT;
        
    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);        
    
    DECLARE @pending TABLE
    (
        [ExportItemKey]     BIGINT,
        [Operation]         NVARCHAR(448)
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @accepted TABLE
    (
        [Type]      NVARCHAR(448),
        [Count]     BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [Type]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @completed TABLE
    (
        [Type]      NVARCHAR(448),
        [Count]     BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [Type]
        )
    );
    
    INSERT INTO @accepted
    (
        [Type],
        [Count]
    )
    SELECT 
        [type].[Description],
        COUNT([item].[ExportItemKey])
    FROM [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [item]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
        ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportItemKey]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON  [itemMessage].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    INNER JOIN  [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
        ON  [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
    WHERE       [itemMessage].[Primary] = @trueFlag            
    GROUP BY
        [type].[Description];
        
    INSERT INTO @completed
    (
        [Type],
        [Count]
    )
    SELECT 
        [type].[Description],
        COUNT([item].[ExportItemKey])
    FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [item]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
        ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportItemKey]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON  [itemMessage].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    INNER JOIN  [sync].[ExportMessageType] AS [type]
        ON  [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = [type].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
    WHERE       [itemMessage].[Primary] = @trueFlag
    GROUP BY
        [type].[Description]; 
    
    SELECT @currentExportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();
    
    SELECT 
        @acceptedCount = 0,
        @completedCount = 0;
    
    SELECT @acceptedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @accepted AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[Type] = @createAction;
    
    SELECT @completedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @completed AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[Type] = @createAction;
    
    SELECT @pendingCreateItemCount = COALESCE(@acceptedCount - @completedCount,0);
    
    SELECT 
        @acceptedCount = 0,
        @completedCount = 0;
    
    SELECT @acceptedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @accepted AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[Type] = @deleteAction;
    
    SELECT @completedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @completed AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[Type] = @deleteAction;
    
    SELECT @pendingDeleteItemCount = COALESCE(@acceptedCount - @completedCount,0);
    
    SELECT 
        @acceptedCount = 0,
        @completedCount = 0;
    
    SELECT @acceptedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @accepted AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[Type] = @updateAction;
    
    SELECT @completedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @completed AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[Type] = @updateAction;
    
    SELECT @pendingUpdateItemCount = COALESCE(@acceptedCount - @completedCount,0);   
    
    SELECT            
        @pendingCreateMessageCount = [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress](@createAction,@falseFlag),
        @pendingDeleteMessageCount = [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress](@deleteAction,@falseFlag),
        @pendingUpdateMessageCount = [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress](@updateAction,@falseFlag),
        @pendingSentCreateMessageCount = [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress](@createAction,@trueFlag),
        @pendingSentDeleteMessageCount = [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress](@deleteAction,@trueFlag),
        @pendingSentUpdateMessageCount = [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress](@updateAction,@trueFlag);
        
    SELECT @currentExportSessionIdentifier = [sync].[GetExportIdentifier]();
    
    SELECT @acceptedExportItemCount = COUNT([accepted].[ExportItemKey])
    FROM [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [accepted]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        ON  [accepted].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
    WHERE       [item].[ExportKey] = @currentExportKey;
        
    SELECT @acknowledgedExportItemCount = COUNT([acknowledged].[ExportItemKey])
    FROM [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [acknowledged]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        ON  [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
    WHERE       [item].[ExportKey] = @currentExportKey;        
    
    SELECT @sentMessageCount = COUNT([sent].[ExportMessageKey])
    FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    WHERE   [message].[ExportKey] = @currentExportKey;
    
    SELECT @completedSentMessageCount = COUNT([sent].[ExportMessageKey])
    FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
        ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    WHERE   [message].[ExportKey] = @currentExportKey;
    
    SELECT @completedMessageCount = COUNT([completed].[ExportMessageKey])
    FROM [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON  [completed].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    WHERE   [message].[ExportKey] = @currentExportKey;
    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[MakeCurrentUserAdministrator]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[MakeCurrentUserAdministrator]

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE 
        @administratorsSetKey           BIGINT,
        @displayNameKey                 SMALLINT,
        @groupAdministratorsSetKey      BIGINT,
        @nonAdministratorsSetKey        BIGINT,
        @setObjectTypeKey               SMALLINT,
        @userKey                        BIGINT;        

    SELECT 
        @displayNameKey     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Description'),
        @setObjectTypeKey   = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'Set');

    SELECT @userKey = [UserObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[UserSecurityIdentifiers]
    WHERE [SecurityIdentifier] = SUSER_SID();

    SELECT @administratorsSetKey = [ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
    WHERE 
            [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameKey
        AND [ovs].[ValueString] = N'Administrators';

    SELECT @nonAdministratorsSetKey = [ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
    WHERE 
            [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameKey
        AND [ovs].[ValueString] = N'All Non-Administrators';

    SELECT @groupAdministratorsSetKey = [ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
    WHERE 
            [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameKey
        AND [ovs].[ValueString] = N'Group Administrators';

    IF 
    (
            @userKey IS NULL 
        OR  @administratorsSetKey IS NULL
        OR  @nonAdministratorsSetKey IS NULL
        OR @groupAdministratorsSetKey IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR (N'Unable to find one more more required objects', 16, 1);
        RETURN;        
    END

    EXECUTE [debug].[RemoveSetMember]
        @setKey = @administratorsSetKey,
        @memberKey = @userKey;

    EXECUTE [debug].[AddSetMember]
        @setKey = @administratorsSetKey,
        @memberKey = @userKey;

    EXECUTE [debug].[RemoveSetMember]
        @setKey = @groupAdministratorsSetKey,
        @memberKey = @userKey;

    EXECUTE [debug].[AddSetMember]
        @setKey = @groupAdministratorsSetKey,
        @memberKey = @userKey;
        
    EXECUTE [debug].[RemoveSetMember]
        @setKey = @nonAdministratorsSetKey,
        @memberKey = @userKey;
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[NormalizeTableObjectValueBinaryForReview]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @displayNameAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'DisplayName');

    SELECT 
        [oti].[Name] as ObjectType,
        [o].[ObjectID] as ObjectIdentifier, 
        [ovDisplayName].[ValueString] as DisplayName,
        [ai].[Name] as AttributeName,
        [ov].[ValueBinary] as Value
    FROM 
    [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ov]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
        ON [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovDisplayName]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovDisplayName].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [ovDisplayName].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    ORDER BY
        [oti].[Name],
        [o].[ObjectID], 
        [ovDisplayName].[ValueString],
        [ai].[Name],
        [ov].[ValueBinary];
        
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[NormalizeTableObjectValueReferenceForReview]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[NormalizeTableObjectValueReferenceForReview]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @displayNameAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'DisplayName');

    SELECT 
        [oti].[Name] as ObjectType,
        [o].[ObjectID] as ObjectIdentifier, 
        [ovDisplayName].[ValueString] as DisplayName,
        [ai].[Name] as AttributeName,
        [otiReference].[Name] as ReferencedObjectType,
        [oReference].[ObjectID] as ReferencedObjectIdentifier,
        [ovDisplayNameReference].[ValueString] as ReferencedObjectDisplayName
    FROM 
    [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ov]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
        ON [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovDisplayName]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovDisplayName].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [ovDisplayName].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [oReference]
        ON [ov].[ValueReference] = [oReference].[ObjectKey] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [otiReference]
        ON [oReference].[ObjectTypeKey] = [otiReference].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovDisplayNameReference]
        ON [oReference].[ObjectKey] = [ovDisplayNameReference].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [ovDisplayNameReference].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    ORDER BY
        [oti].[Name],
        [o].[ObjectID], 
        [ovDisplayName].[ValueString],
        [ai].[Name],
        [otiReference].[Name],
        [oReference].[ObjectID],
        [ovDisplayNameReference].[ValueString];

        
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[NormalizeTableObjectValueStringForReview]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @displayNameAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'DisplayName');

    SELECT 
        [oti].[Name] as ObjectType,
        [o].[ObjectID] as ObjectIdentifier, 
        [ovDisplayName].[ValueString] as DisplayName,
        [ai].[Name] as AttributeName,
        [li].[Name] as Locale,
        [ov].[ValueString] as Value
    FROM 
    [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ov]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
        ON [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[LocaleInternal] as [li]
        ON [ov].[LocaleKey] = [li].[Key] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovDisplayName]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovDisplayName].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [ovDisplayName].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    ORDER BY
        [oti].[Name],
        [o].[ObjectID], 
        [ovDisplayName].[ValueString],
        [ai].[Name],
        [li].[Name],
        [ov].[ValueString];
        
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[NormalizeTableObjectValueTextForReview]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @displayNameAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'DisplayName');

    SELECT 
        [oti].[Name] as ObjectType,
        [o].[ObjectID] as ObjectIdentifier, 
        [ovDisplayName].[ValueString] as DisplayName,
        [ai].[Name] as AttributeName,
        [li].[Name] as Locale,
        [ov].[ValueText] as Value
    FROM 
    [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ov]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
        ON [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[LocaleInternal] as [li]

    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovDisplayName]

        AND [ovDisplayName].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    ORDER BY
        [oti].[Name],
        [o].[ObjectID], 
        [ovDisplayName].[ValueString],
        [ai].[Name],
        [li].[Name],
        [ov].[ValueText];
        
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[PrepareCheckInTest]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    EXECUTE [debug].[ToggleAgentSchedules] @on = 0;

    DECLARE @tableExists INT;
    
    SELECT @tableExists=COUNT(*) 
    FROM 
        [sys].[objects]
    WHERE 
            [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'[debug].[TestBaseObjectCount]') 
        AND type in (N'U');
        
    IF (@tableExists > 0)
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE [debug].[TestBaseObjectCount];
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE [debug].[TestBaseObjectCount]
    (
        BaseObjectCount BIGINT
    );
    
    INSERT INTO [debug].[TestBaseObjectCount] 
    (
        BaseObjectCount
    )
    SELECT MAX(ObjectKey) FROM [fim].[Objects];
END

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[PurgeObjectsOfType]
	@typeName NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DELETE [fim].[ObjectValueBinary]
    WHERE  [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT o.[ObjectKey]
                           FROM   [fim].[Objects] AS o
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS ot
                                  ON ot.[Key] = o.[ObjectTypeKey]
                           WHERE  ot.[Name] = @typeName);


        
    DELETE [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean]
    WHERE  [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT o.[ObjectKey]
                           FROM   [fim].[Objects] AS o
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS ot
                                  ON ot.[Key] = o.[ObjectTypeKey]
                           WHERE  ot.[Name] = @typeName);

        
    DELETE [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
    WHERE  [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT o.[ObjectKey]
                           FROM   [fim].[Objects] AS o
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS ot
                                  ON ot.[Key] = o.[ObjectTypeKey]
                           WHERE  ot.[Name] = @typeName);
                           
    DELETE [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier]
    WHERE  [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT o.[ObjectKey]
                           FROM   [fim].[Objects] AS o
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS ot
                                  ON ot.[Key] = o.[ObjectTypeKey]
                           WHERE  ot.[Name] = @typeName);

    DELETE [fim].[ObjectValueInteger]
    WHERE  [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT o.[ObjectKey]
                           FROM   [fim].[Objects] AS o
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS ot
                                  ON ot.[Key] = o.[ObjectTypeKey]
                           WHERE  ot.[Name] = @typeName);

    DELETE [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
    WHERE  [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT o.[ObjectKey]
                         FROM   [fim].[Objects] AS o
                                INNER JOIN
                                [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS ot
                                ON ot.[Key] = o.[ObjectTypeKey]
                         WHERE  ot.[Name] = @typeName);

    DELETE [fim].[ObjectValueString]
    WHERE  [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT o.[ObjectKey]
                           FROM   [fim].[Objects] AS o
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS ot
                                  ON ot.[Key] = o.[ObjectTypeKey]
                           WHERE  ot.[Name] = @typeName);

    DELETE [fim].[ObjectValueText]
    WHERE  [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT o.[ObjectKey]
                           FROM   [fim].[Objects] AS o
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS ot
                                  ON ot.[Key] = o.[ObjectTypeKey]
                           WHERE  ot.[Name] = @typeName);


    DELETE [fim].[Objects]
    WHERE  [ObjectKey] IN (SELECT o.[ObjectKey]
                           FROM   [fim].[Objects] AS o
                                  INNER JOIN
                                  [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS ot
                                  ON ot.[Key] = o.[ObjectTypeKey]
                           WHERE  ot.[Name] = @typeName);

    


END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[RemoveSetMember]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[RemoveSetMember]
	@setKey     BIGINT, 
	@memberKey  BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @setObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SET @setObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'Set');
    DECLARE @explicitMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SET @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ExplicitMember');
    DECLARE @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SET @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ComputedMember');

    DELETE [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
    WHERE [ObjectKey] = @setKey
        AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
        AND (([AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey) OR ([AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey))
        AND [ValueReference] = @memberKey;

    
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[ReplayRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[ReplayRequest]
    @originalRequestKey BIGINT,
    @evaluate           BIT     =   1,
    @process            BIT     =   0,
    @clean              BIT     =   0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE
        @accountNamePropertyName NVARCHAR(40), 
        @calculatedTargetFalse NVARCHAR(448),
        @calculatedTargetTrue NVARCHAR(448),
        @committedRequestStatusKey SMALLINT,
        @committedTime DATETIME, 
        @compositeObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @creatorKey BIGINT,
        @creatorAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @creatorIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @defaultLocaleKey SMALLINT,
        @displayName NVARCHAR(448),
        @displayNameAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @displayNameTemplate NVARCHAR(448),
        @elementKey BIGINT,
        @elementAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @elementsString NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @elementsStringXml XML,
        @elementTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @exception NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @falseFlag BIT,
        @newCompositeKey BIGINT,
        @newElementIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @newElementIdentifierString NVARCHAR(448),
        @newElementKey BIGINT,
        @operation NVARCHAR(448),
        @operationAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @originalElementIdentifierString NVARCHAR(448),
        @originalParameterString NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @originalTargetKey BIGINT,
        @originalTargetIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @originalTargetIdentifierString NVARCHAR(448),
        @originalTargetDisplayName NVARCHAR(448),
        @originalTargetTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @originalTargetTypeName NVARCHAR(448),
        @parameter NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @parameters XML,
        @parameterString NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @requestDependencyKey TINYINT,
        @requestIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @requestMarker UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,    
        @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @requestParameterAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @serviceIdentifier SMALLINT,
        @servicePartitionIdentifier SMALLINT,
        @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @targetAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @targetCalculatedFalse NVARCHAR(448),
        @targetCalculatedTrue NVARCHAR(448),
        @targetCloseTag NVARCHAR(10),
        @targetIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @targetObjectTypeName NVARCHAR(448),
        @targetOpenTag NVARCHAR(8),
        @targetString NVARCHAR(448),
        @targetTags NVARCHAR(448),
        @time DATETIME,
        @topKey BIGINT,
        @trueFlag BIT,
        @valueCloseTag NVARCHAR(9);
        
    SELECT TOP 1 @topKey = [object].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
    ORDER BY 
        [object].[ObjectKey] DESC;
        
    SELECT
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
        
    IF @process = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @evaluate = @trueFlag;
    END
        
    SELECT
        @accountNamePropertyName = N'<PropertyName>AccountName</PropertyName>',
        @calculatedTargetFalse = N'<Calculated>false</Calculated><Target>',
        @calculatedTargetTrue = N'<Calculated>true</Calculated><Target>',
        @compositeObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'msidmCompositeType'),
        @creatorAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Creator'),
        @defaultLocaleKey = [fim].[GetDefaultLocaleKey](),
        @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
        @elementAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmElement'),
        @operationAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Operation'),
        @requestMarker = NEWID(),
        @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @requestParameterAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestParameter'),
        @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ServicePartitionName'),
        @targetAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Target'),
        @targetCalculatedFalse = N'</Target><Calculated>false</Calculated>',
        @targetCalculatedTrue = N'</Target><Calculated>true</Calculated>',
        @targetCloseTag = N'</Target>',
        @targetOpenTag = N'<Target>',
        @valueCloseTag = N'</Value>';
       
    SELECT @displayName = [request].[ValueString]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [request]
    WHERE
            [request].[ObjectKey] = @originalRequestKey
        AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
        AND [request].[SequenceID] = 0;
        
    SELECT @operation = [request].[ValueString]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [request]
    WHERE
            [request].[ObjectKey] = @originalRequestKey
        AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @operationAttributeKey
        AND [request].[SequenceID] = 0
        AND [request].[LocaleKey] = @defaultLocaleKey;
        
    SELECT @servicePartitionIdentifier = [partition].[ServicePartitionId]
    FROM [fim].[ServicePartition] AS [partition]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [request]
        ON  [partition].[ServicePartitionName] = [request].[ValueString]
    WHERE
            [request].[ObjectKey] = @originalRequestKey
        AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey
        AND [request].[SequenceID] = 0
        AND [request].[LocaleKey] = @defaultLocaleKey;
        
    SELECT @serviceIdentifier = [service].[ServiceId]
    FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [service]
    WHERE    
            [service].[ServicePartitionId] = @servicePartitionIdentifier;
            
    SELECT @creatorKey = [request].[ValueReference]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [request]
    WHERE
            [request].[ObjectKey] = @originalRequestKey
        AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey;

    SELECT @creatorIdentifier = [object].[ObjectID]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
    WHERE
            [object].[ObjectKey] = @creatorKey;         
            
    SELECT @originalTargetKey = [request].[ValueReference]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [request]
    WHERE
            [request].[ObjectKey] = @originalRequestKey
        AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @targetAttributeKey;
        
    SELECT 
        @originalTargetIdentifier = [object].[ObjectID],
        @originalTargetTypeKey = [object].[ObjectTypeKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
    WHERE
            [object].[ObjectKey] = @originalTargetKey; 
    SELECT @originalTargetIdentifierString = CAST(@originalTargetIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(448));  
            
    IF @operation = N'Create'
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @targetIdentifier = NEWID();
        
        IF @originalTargetTypeKey = @compositeObjectTypeKey
        BEGIN
            SELECT @elementsString = N'';
            
            DECLARE elementCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
                SELECT 
                    [object].[ObjectKey],
                    [object].[ObjectTypeKey]                
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [composite]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                    ON  [composite].[ValueReference] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [composite].[ObjectKey] = @originalTargetKey
                    AND [composite].[ObjectTypeKey] = @originalTargetTypeKey
                    AND [composite].[AttributeKey] = @elementAttributeKey;
                    
            OPEN elementCursor;
            WHILE(1=1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT 
                    @elementKey = NULL,
                    @newElementKey = NULL;
                
                FETCH NEXT FROM elementCursor INTO 
                    @elementKey,
                    @elementTypeKey;
                    
                IF @elementKey IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END

                SELECT @newElementIdentifier = NEWID();
                EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                    @objectID = @newElementIdentifier,
                    @objectTypeKey = @elementTypeKey OUTPUT, 
                    @objectKey = @newElementKey OUTPUT;                

                SELECT @elementsString = @elementsString + N'<v>' + CAST(@newElementIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(448)) + N'</v>'
            END
            CLOSE elementCursor;
            DEALLOCATE elementCursor; 

            SET @elementsStringXml = CAST(@elementsString AS XML);

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoCompositeTypeCreation]
                @compositeTypeIdentifier = @targetIdentifier,
                @creator = @creatorIdentifier,
                @values = @elementsStringXml;

            SELECT @newCompositeKey = [object].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            WHERE
                    [object].[ObjectID] = @targetIdentifier
                AND [object].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeObjectTypeKey;
                
        END
    END        
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT @targetIdentifier = @originalTargetIdentifier;
    END
    SELECT @targetString = CAST(@targetIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(448));                
            
    SELECT @originalTargetDisplayName =  [target].[ValueString]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [target]
    WHERE
            [target].[ObjectKey] = @originalTargetKey
        AND [target].[ObjectTypeKey] = @originalTargetTypeKey
        AND [target].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
        AND [target].[SequenceID] = 0;     
        
    SELECT @originalTargetTypeName = [type].[Name]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [type]
    WHERE
            [type].[Key] = @originalTargetTypeKey;
            
    SELECT @displayNameTemplate = REPLACE(REPLACE(@displayName,@originalTargetTypeName,N'{0}'),@originalTargetDisplayName,N'{1}');            

    DECLARE parameterCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
        SELECT [request].[ValueText]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [request]
        WHERE
                [request].[ObjectKey] = @originalRequestKey
            AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @requestParameterAttributeKey
            AND [request].[LocaleKey] = @defaultLocaleKey;
        
    SELECT 
        @originalParameterString = N'',
        @parameterString = N'';
                
    OPEN parameterCursor;
    WHILE(1=1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @parameter = NULL;
        
        FETCH NEXT FROM parameterCursor INTO 
            @parameter;
            
        IF @parameter IS NULL
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END

        SELECT @originalParameterString = @originalParameterString + @parameter;
        
        IF CHARINDEX(@accountNamePropertyName, @parameter) > 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT @parameter = REPLACE(@parameter,@valueCloseTag,CAST(NEWID() AS NVARCHAR(448)) + @valueCloseTag);
        END
        
        IF CHARINDEX(@targetCalculatedFalse, @parameter) > 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT @parameter = REPLACE(
                REPLACE(@parameter,@targetCalculatedFalse,@targetCloseTag),
                @targetOpenTag,@calculatedTargetFalse);
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF CHARINDEX(@targetCalculatedTrue, @parameter) > 0
            BEGIN
                SELECT @parameter = REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(@parameter,@targetCalculatedTrue,@targetCloseTag),
                    @targetOpenTag,@calculatedTargetTrue);
            END
        END

        SELECT @parameterString = @parameterString + @parameter;

    END
    CLOSE parameterCursor;
    DEALLOCATE parameterCursor; 

    SELECT @parameterString = REPLACE(@parameterString,@originalTargetIdentifierString,@targetString);

    IF
            @operation = N'Create' 
        AND @originalTargetTypeKey = @compositeObjectTypeKey
    BEGIN
        DECLARE oldElementCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
            SELECT CAST([object].[ObjectID] AS NVARCHAR(448))
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [composite]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                ON  [composite].[ValueReference] = [object].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [composite].[ObjectKey] = @originalTargetKey
                AND [composite].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeObjectTypeKey
                AND [composite].[AttributeKey] = @elementAttributeKey
            ORDER BY 
                [object].[ObjectKey];
                
        OPEN oldElementCursor;
        
        DECLARE newElementCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
            SELECT CAST([object].[ObjectID] AS NVARCHAR(448))
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [composite]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                ON  [composite].[ValueReference] = [object].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [composite].[ObjectKey] = @newCompositeKey
                AND [composite].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeObjectTypeKey
                AND [composite].[AttributeKey] = @elementAttributeKey
            ORDER BY 
                [object].[ObjectKey];
                
        OPEN newElementCursor;
        
        WHILE(1=1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT 
                @originalElementIdentifierString = NULL,
                @newElementIdentifierString = NULL;
            
            FETCH NEXT FROM oldElementCursor INTO 
                @originalElementIdentifierString;
                
            IF @originalElementIdentifierString IS NULL
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END                
                
            FETCH NEXT FROM newElementCursor INTO 
                @newElementIdentifierString;

            SELECT @parameterString = REPLACE(@parameterString,@originalElementIdentifierString,@newElementIdentifierString);
        END
        CLOSE oldElementCursor;
        DEALLOCATE oldElementCursor; 
    END

    SELECT 
        @parameterString = N'<RequestParameters>' + @parameterString + N'</RequestParameters>',
        @originalParameterString = N'<RequestParameters>' + @originalParameterString + N'</RequestParameters>';
    SELECT @parameters = CAST(@parameterString AS XML);
    
    SELECT 
        CAST(@originalParameterString AS XML) AS [Original Parameters],
        @parameters AS [Replay Parameters];

    IF @evaluate = @falseFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT N'Creating ... '
        EXECUTE [fim].[CreateRequest]
            @serviceId              =   @serviceIdentifier,
            @servicePartitionId     =   @servicePartitionIdentifier,
            @targetIdentifier       =   @targetIdentifier,
            @creator                =   @creatorIdentifier,
            @anonymous              =   @falseFlag,
            @operation              =   @operation,
            @parameters             =   @parameters,
            @displayNameTemplate    =   @displayNameTemplate,
            @cause                  =   @creatorIdentifier,
            @requestMarker          =   @requestMarker,
            @trace                  =   @trueFlag,
            @requestIdentifier      =   @requestIdentifier              OUTPUT,
            @displayName            =   @displayName                    OUTPUT,
            @targetObjectTypeName   =   @targetObjectTypeName           OUTPUT,
            @time                   =   @time                           OUTPUT;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT N'Creating and evaluating ... '
        EXECUTE [fim].[EvaluateNewRequest]
            @serviceId              =    @serviceIdentifier,
            @servicePartitionId     =    @servicePartitionIdentifier,
            @targetIdentifier       =    @targetIdentifier,
            @creator                =    @creatorIdentifier,
            @anonymous              =    @falseFlag,
            @operation              =    @operation,
            @parameters             =    @parameters,
            @cause                  =    @creatorIdentifier,
            @displayNameTemplate    =    @displayNameTemplate,
            @requestMarker          =    @requestMarker,
            @trace                  =    @trueFlag,
            @requestIdentifier      =    @requestIdentifier              OUTPUT,
            @displayName            =    @displayName                    OUTPUT,
            @targetObjectTypeName   =    @targetObjectTypeName           OUTPUT,
            @time                   =    @time                           OUTPUT;
    END

    SELECT 
        @requestIdentifier AS [Request Identifier],
        @displayName AS [Display Name],
        @targetObjectTypeName AS [Target Object Type Name],
        @time AS [Time],
        @exception AS [Exception];
   
    SELECT N'Request:'     
    EXECUTE [debug].[DisplayResourceByIdentifier] @requestIdentifier;
    SELECT N'Target:'
    EXECUTE [debug].[DisplayResourceByIdentifier] @targetIdentifier;
    
    IF @process = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT N'Processing ... '
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
            EXECUTE [fim].[ProcessRequest]
                @requestIdentifier          =   @requestIdentifier,
                @trace                      =   @trueFlag,
                @reevaluationRequired       =   @falseFlag,
                @resourceIdentifier         =   @targetIdentifier           OUTPUT,
                @requestDependencyKey       =   @requestDependencyKey       OUTPUT,
                @committedRequestStatusKey  =   @committedRequestStatusKey  OUTPUT,
                @committedTime              =   @committedTime              OUTPUT; 
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
        
        SELECT N'Target:'
        EXECUTE [debug].[DisplayResourceByIdentifier] @targetIdentifier;
    END
    
    IF @clean = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT N'Cleaning ... '
        EXECUTE [debug].[Cleaner] @topKey = @topKey;
    END
    
END
GO
