/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[RetryFailedDeferredGroupEvaluation]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[RetryFailedDeferredGroupEvaluation]
    @compositeTypeObjectId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE 
        @displayNameAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @elementAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @groupKey BIGINT,
        @groupName NVARCHAR(448),
        @compositeTypeKey BIGINT;

    SELECT
        @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
        @elementAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmElement');

    SELECT @compositeTypeKey = [ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects]
    WHERE [ObjectID] = @compositeTypeObjectId;

    DECLARE @errors TABLE
    (
        [GroupName] NVARCHAR(MAX),
        [ErrorMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX)
    );

    DECLARE elementCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
    SELECT
        [elements].[ValueReference],
        [name].[ValueString]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [elements]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [name]
        ON [elements].[ValueReference] = [name].[ObjectKey]
       AND [name].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
    WHERE [elements].[ObjectKey] = @compositeTypeKey
        AND [elements].[AttributeKey] = @elementAttributeKey;
        
    OPEN elementCursor;
    WHILE (1 = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @groupKey = NULL;
        
        FETCH NEXT FROM elementCursor INTO 
            @groupKey,
            @groupName;
            
        IF @groupKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END
        
        BEGIN TRY
            PRINT 'Evaluating group "' + @groupName + '"';
            
            EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions] @setKey = @groupKey;
            
            PRINT 'Group "' + @groupName + '" was processed successfully';
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            SET @errorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();
            PRINT 'Error evaluating group "' + @groupName + '"';
            
            INSERT INTO @errors
            (
                [GroupName],
                [ErrorMessage]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @groupName,
                @errorMessage
            );
        END CATCH
    END

    CLOSE elementCursor;
    DEALLOCATE elementCursor;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM @errors
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT 'Groups failed in evaluation'
        SELECT
            [GroupName],
            [ErrorMessage]
        FROM @errors;
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[TerminateStuckWorkflows]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[TerminateStuckWorkflows]
    @workflowDefinitionIdentifier   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL,
    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey   INTEGER             = NULL,
    @workflowInstanceIdentifier     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL,
    @reason                         NVARCHAR(MAX)
    
AS
-- Top level
BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        
        DECLARE @acquiredLockBulkTerminateWorkflow  INTEGER,
                @lockNameBulkTerminateWorkflow      NVARCHAR(40),
                @messageText                        NVARCHAR(2000),
                @workflowDefinitionObjectKey        BIGINT,
                @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey    SMALLINT;
        		
        SELECT  @acquiredLockBulkTerminateWorkflow = -1,
                @lockNameBulkTerminateWorkflow = N'BulkTerminateWorkflow',
                @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');
        
        IF(@reason IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Reason must not be NULL.  The WorkflowInstance object should contain a meaningful reason to document this non-standard code path was applied.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get Exclusive lock
        *    DESIGN POINT We want to ensure only one instance of this procedure can run at a time
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        EXECUTE @acquiredLockBulkTerminateWorkflow = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockNameBulkTerminateWorkflow,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session',
            @LockTimeout = 10000;  -- wait for up to 10 seconds to get the lock

        IF(@acquiredLockBulkTerminateWorkflow < 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockNameBulkTerminateWorkflow + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#bulkTerminateWorkflow') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #bulkTerminateWorkflow;
        END
        
        CREATE TABLE #bulkTerminateWorkflow
        (
            [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier]    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            [Reason]                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
            [DidTerminate]                  BIT,
            [Error]                         NVARCHAR(MAX)
        )
        

        IF(@workflowInstanceIdentifier IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            INSERT #bulkTerminateWorkflow
            (
                [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier],
                [Reason]
            )
            SELECT  [Identifier],
                    @reason
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            WHERE 
                    [Finished] = 0
                AND [Identifier] = @workflowInstanceIdentifier;
        END	            
        ELSE IF(@workflowDefinitionVersionKey IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            INSERT #bulkTerminateWorkflow
            (
                [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier],
                [Reason]
            )
            SELECT  [Identifier],
                    @reason
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            WHERE 
                    [Finished] = 0
            AND [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey;
        END
        ELSE IF(@workflowDefinitionIdentifier IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            
            INSERT #bulkTerminateWorkflow
            (
                [WorkflowInstanceIdentifier],
                [Reason]
            )
            SELECT  [Identifier],
                    @reason
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [wi].[WorkflowDefinitionKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE 
                    [wi].[Finished] = 0
                AND [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] = @workflowDefinitionIdentifier;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #bulkTerminateWorkflow
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [debug].[DoBulkTerminateWorkflow];
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT N'There are 0 active WorkflowInstance Identifiers that match your criteria.';
        END
        
        
        IF(@acquiredLockBulkTerminateWorkflow >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameBulkTerminateWorkflow,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF(@acquiredLockBulkTerminateWorkflow >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameBulkTerminateWorkflow,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [debug].[ToggleAgentSchedules]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [debug].[ToggleAgentSchedules]
	@on BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
    DECLARE scheduleCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
    SELECT [s].[schedule_id] 
    FROM [msdb].[dbo].[sysschedules] AS [s]
    WHERE 
            LEFT([s].[name],4)=N'FIM_';
            
    DECLARE @scheduleIdentifier INT;
    
    OPEN scheduleCursor;
    WHILE 1=1
    BEGIN
        SELECT @scheduleIdentifier = NULL;
        
        FETCH NEXT FROM scheduleCursor 
        INTO @scheduleIdentifier;
        
        IF @scheduleIdentifier IS NULL
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END
        
        EXECUTE [msdb].[dbo].[sp_update_schedule]
            @schedule_id = @scheduleIdentifier, 
            @enabled = @on;        
    END
    CLOSE scheduleCursor;
    DEALLOCATE scheduleCursor;

END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[AddExportLog]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called by other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[AddExportLog]
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection]),
    @trace      BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    
    -- It's important to note that a request may have multiple targets. A lot of action processors
    -- do this. In most cases, there won't be multiple targets though.
    DECLARE 
        @startTime DATETIME,
        @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @committedTime DATETIME,
        @committedTimeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @requestTargetDetailObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    
    DECLARE @exportLogObjectTypesAndAttributes TABLE 
    ( 
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT,
        [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT
    ); 
    
    DECLARE @exportLogObjects TABLE 
    ( 
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT
    );    
    
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    SELECT 
        @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember'),
        @committedTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CommittedTime'),
        @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @requestTargetDetailObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmRequestTargetDetail');
        
    --Get the committed time of the request
    SELECT @committedTime = [ovdt].[ValueDateTime]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
    WHERE 
            [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @committedTimeAttributeKey;
                       
    INSERT INTO @exportLogObjectTypesAndAttributes
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        [elb].[ObjectTypeKey], 
        [elb].[AttributeKey]
    FROM [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [elb];
        
    INSERT INTO @exportLogObjects
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT [ebl].[ObjectTypeKey]
    FROM [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [ebl];
            
    -- There can be multiple targets on the request. A lot of action processors perform
    -- multi target requests. We need to get every non deleted target in the request.
    -- These are the targets that we want to log everything for.
    DECLARE @nonDeletedObjectKeys TABLE 
    ( 
        [ObjectKey] BIGINT 
    );
    
    -- grab all the object IDs targeted by this request
    INSERT INTO @nonDeletedObjectKeys
    ( 
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT 
        DISTINCT Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT')
    FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject);
        
    
    -- delete target IDs that correspond to delete object operations
    DECLARE @deletedObjectKeys TABLE 
    ( 
        [ObjectKey] BIGINT
    );
    
    INSERT INTO @deletedObjectKeys
    ( 
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT [ror].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ror]
    WHERE 
    (
            [ror].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ror].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
        AND [ror].[Deleted] = 1
    );
        
    
    -- update nonDeleteObjectIDs to get rid of the deleted objects
    DELETE FROM [nonDeletedKeys]
    FROM @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedKeys]
    INNER JOIN @deletedObjectKeys AS [deletedKeys]
        ON [nonDeletedKeys].[ObjectKey] = [deletedKeys].[ObjectKey]

    --For each type of request object value, insert the request values into the RequestLog.
    --You will see a join on @nonDeletedObjectKeys. This is because we only want to add all
    --the delta rows if we are not a delete object operation. 
    --For deleted objects, the deletion row for ObjectID is sufficient.

    --Reference - Provide just the uniqueidentifier of the object.
    --If the object is of a dynamic type we must only write rows for ComputedMember. We ignore
    --ExplicitMember. If the object is not a dynamic type we must write rows for both 
    --ComputedMember and ExplicitMember attribute changes.
    --below captures references to the object itself like objectid
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]    
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [ValueReferenceKey],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],            
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [or].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[ValueReference],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [or]
            ON [ro].[ValueReference] = [or].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @exportLogObjects AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeKey] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [or].[ValueIdentifier] = [o].[ValueIdentifier]
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.
    END 

    --Binary
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]    
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueBinary],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],            
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueBinary],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @exportLogObjectTypesAndAttributes AS [filter]
            ON 
            (
                    [filter].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [filter].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            )
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.
    END
        
    --Boolean
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]    
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueBoolean],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],            
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueBoolean],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
                [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @exportLogObjectTypesAndAttributes AS [filter]
            ON 
            (
                    [filter].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [filter].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            )
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.
    END
    
    --DateTime
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]    
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueDateTime],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],            
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueDateTime],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @exportLogObjectTypesAndAttributes AS [filter]
            ON 
            (
                    [filter].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [filter].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            )
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.    
    END
        
    --Integer
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]    
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueInteger],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],            
            [o].[ObjectID],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueInteger],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @exportLogObjectTypesAndAttributes AS [filter]
            ON 
            (
                    [filter].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [filter].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            )
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.     
    END 


     --String
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]    
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueString],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],            
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueString],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @exportLogObjectTypesAndAttributes AS [filter]
            ON 
            (
                    [filter].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [filter].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            )
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.
    END 

    --Text
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]    
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueText],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],            
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueText],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @exportLogObjectTypesAndAttributes AS [filter]
            ON 
            (
                    [filter].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [filter].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            )
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.     
    END     

    --Reference - added last to ensure that objects appear in the log before the are referenced.
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]    
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [ValueReferenceKey],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],            
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [or].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[ValueReference],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [or]
            ON [ro].[ValueReference] = [or].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @exportLogObjectTypesAndAttributes AS [filter]
            ON 
            (
                    [filter].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [filter].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            )
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [or].[ValueIdentifier] <> [o].[ValueIdentifier]
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] <> @explicitMemberAttributeKey -- Assumption: we will never have ExplicitMember bound without the other dyanmic filter attributes.
                                                                   -- This implies that anyone with ExplicitMember is a dynamic object and thus we should be importing from
                                                                   -- ComputedMember instead. We can safely ignore ExplicitMember for import.
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated (deleted then inserted) order is preserved.    
    END 

    --For object delete operations, we only insert the ObjectID row
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ObjectKey]
        FROM    @deletedObjectKeys
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [ValueReferenceKey],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            @requestKey,
            [deletedObjects].[ObjectKey],            
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [o].[ObjectTypeKey],
            @objectIDAttributeKey,
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [o].[ObjectKey],
            @committedTime,
            0  -- represents a delete
        FROM @deletedObjectKeys AS [deletedObjects]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [deletedObjects].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @exportLogObjects AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeKey] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey];
    END     
    
    --add request to the export log if bindings are defined for them
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [ebl].[ObjectTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [ebl]
        WHERE [ebl].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddRequestToExportLog]
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @committedTime = @committedTime,
                @trace = @trace;
    END
    
    --add request target details to the export log if bindings are defined for them
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [ebl].[ObjectTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [ebl]
        WHERE [ebl].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestTargetDetailObjectTypeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddRequestTargetDetailToExportLog]
            @requestKey = @requestKey,
            @committedTime = @committedTime,
            @trace = @trace;
    END
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'AddExportLog';
    END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[AddExportRequest]
    @requestKey           BIGINT,
    @action               NVARCHAR(448),
    @creatorKey           BIGINT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[AddObject]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[AddObject]
	@objectTypeKey		SMALLINT,
	@objectID			UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT,  --INPUT and OUTPUT
	@objectKey			BIGINT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @objectID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @objectID = NEWID();
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        -- WARNING:  @objectID is an INPUT and OUTPUT param, must set its value for SR0013 to pass
        SELECT @objectID = @objectID; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    END
       
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1; 

	INSERT INTO [fim].[Objects] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
    (
        ObjectTypeKey,
        ObjectID
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @objectTypeKey,
        @objectID 
    );
    
    SET @objectKey = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
    (
        ObjectKey,
        ObjectTypeKey,
        AttributeKey,
        ValueIdentifier
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @objectKey,
        @objectTypeKey,
        0,
        @objectID
    );
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[AddObjectValueBinary] 
    @objectKey      BIGINT,
    @attributeKey   SMALLINT,
    @value			VARBINARY(MAX),
    @objectTypeKey	SMALLINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
	IF (@objectTypeKey IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @objectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey](@objectKey);
	END

	DECLARE @sequenceID SMALLINT;
	
	SET @sequenceID =
	(
		SELECT MAX ([SequenceID])
		FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary]
		WHERE [ObjectKey] = @objectKey
		AND [AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
	);
	
	IF (@sequenceID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @sequenceID = 0;
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @sequenceID = @sequenceID + 1;
	END
	
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueBinary]
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [SequenceID],
        [ValueBinary],
        [Multivalued]
    )
    SELECT
        @objectKey,
        @objectTypeKey,
        @attributeKey,
        @sequenceID,
        @value,
        [ai].[Multivalued]
    FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
    WHERE [ai].[Key] = @attributeKey;

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[AddRequestLog]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called by other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[AddRequestLog]
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection]),
    @trace      BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    -- It's important to note that a request may have multiple targets. A lot of action processors
    -- do this. In most cases, there won't be multiple targets though.
    DECLARE 
        @synchronizationFilterObjectID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @synchronizeObjectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @startTime DATETIME,
        @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @committedTime DATETIME,
        @committedTimeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
	    SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    SELECT 
        @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @synchronizationFilterObjectID = [fim].[GetSynchronizationFilterObjectID](),
        @synchronizeObjectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'SynchronizeObjectType'),
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember'),
        @committedTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CommittedTime'),
        @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
        
    --Get the committed time of the request
    SELECT @committedTime = [ovdt].[ValueDateTime]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
    WHERE 
            [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @committedTimeAttributeKey;
    
    --Determine which object types should be synchronized.
    --Note it is assumed that you cannot bind a ComputedMember attribute onto an object type
    --definition without having bound Filter and ExplicitMember.
    DECLARE @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs TABLE 
    ( 
        ObjectTypeID SMALLINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectTypeID]
        )
    );

    INSERT @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs
    (
        [ObjectTypeID]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT [i].[Key]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o] 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [t]
        ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [t].[Key] 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [r]
        ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [r].[ObjectTypeKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [i]
        ON [i].[ObjectKey] = [r].[ValueReference] 
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectID] = @synchronizationFilterObjectID
        AND [r].[AttributeKey] = @synchronizeObjectTypeAttributeKey;
            
    -- There can be multiple targets on the request. A lot of action processors perform
    -- multi target requests. We need to get every non deleted target in the request.
    -- These are the targets that we want to log everything for.
    DECLARE @nonDeletedObjectKeys TABLE 
    ( 
        [ObjectKey] BIGINT 
    );
    
    -- grab all the object IDs targeted by this request
    INSERT INTO @nonDeletedObjectKeys
    ( 
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT 
        DISTINCT Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT')
    FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject);
        
    
    -- delete target IDs that correspond to delete object operations
    DECLARE @deletedObjectKeys TABLE 
    ( 
        [ObjectKey] BIGINT
    );
    
    INSERT INTO @deletedObjectKeys
    ( 
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT [ror].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ror]
    WHERE 
    (
            [ror].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ror].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
        AND [ror].[Deleted] = 1
    );
        
    
    -- update nonDeleteObjectIDs to get rid of the deleted objects
    DELETE FROM [nonDeletedKeys]
    FROM @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedKeys]
    INNER JOIN @deletedObjectKeys AS [deletedKeys]
        ON [nonDeletedKeys].[ObjectKey] = [deletedKeys].[ObjectKey]

    --For each type of request object value, insert the request values into the RequestLog.
    --You will see a join on @nonDeletedObjectKeys. This is because we only want to add all
    --the delta rows if we are not a delete object operation. 
    --For deleted objects, the deletion row for ObjectID is sufficient.

    --Reference - Provide just the uniqueidentifier of the object.
    --If the object is of a dynamic type we must only write rows for ComputedMember. We ignore
    --ExplicitMember. If the object is not a dynamic type we must write rows for both 
    --ComputedMember and ExplicitMember attribute changes.
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]	
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [or].[ValueIdentifier],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [or]
            ON [ro].[ValueReference] = [or].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [or].[ValueIdentifier] = [o].[ValueIdentifier]
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.
    END 

    --Binary
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]	
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueBinary],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueBinary],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.
    END
        
    --Boolean
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]	
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueBoolean],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueBoolean],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
                [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.
    END
	
    --DateTime
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]	
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueDateTime],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueDateTime],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.	
    END
        
    --Integer
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]	
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueInteger],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ObjectID],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueInteger],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.	 
    END 


     --String
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]	
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueString],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueString],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.	 
    END 

    --Text
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]	
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueText],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueText],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.	 
    END 
  

    --XML
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputXml] AS [ro]	
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueXML],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueXML],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputXml] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated(deleted then inserted) order is preserved.	 
    END 

    --Reference - added last to ensure that objects appear in the log before the are referenced.
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]	
        WHERE   [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [ro].[RequestKey],
            [ro].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [or].[ValueIdentifier],
            @committedTime,
            1 - [ro].[Deleted]    --Convert [RequestValueX].[Deleted] to added for RequestLog.
        FROM 
            [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN @nonDeletedObjectKeys AS [nonDeletedObjects]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [nonDeletedObjects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [or]
            ON [ro].[ValueReference] = [or].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [or].[ValueIdentifier] <> [o].[ValueIdentifier]
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] <> @explicitMemberAttributeKey -- Assumption: we will never have ExplicitMember bound without the other dyanmic filter attributes.
                                                                   -- This implies that anyone with ExplicitMember is a dynamic object and thus we should be importing from
                                                                   -- ComputedMember instead. We can safely ignore ExplicitMember for import.
        ORDER BY
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[Deleted] DESC;    --Ensures that when single value attributes are updated (deleted then inserted) order is preserved.	
    END 

    --For object delete operations, we only insert the ObjectID row
    IF EXISTS
    (   
        SELECT  TOP 1 [ObjectKey]
        FROM    @deletedObjectKeys
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            @requestKey,
            [deletedObjects].[ObjectKey],	        
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            @objectIDAttributeKey,
            [o].[ValueIdentifier],
            @committedTime,
            0  -- represents a delete
        FROM @deletedObjectKeys AS [deletedObjects]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [deletedObjects].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs AS [filter]
            ON [filter].[ObjectTypeID] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
    END 
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
	    EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'AddRequestLog';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[AddRequestTargetDetailToExportLog]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[AddRequestTargetDetailToExportLog]
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @committedTime DATETIME,
    @trace      BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @attributeTypeKeyAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
        @attributeTypeIDAttributeKey                SMALLINT,
        @attributeValueAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @isReferenceAttributeKey                    SMALLINT,
        @modeAttributeKey                           SMALLINT,
        @objectIdentifierAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey                     SMALLINT,
        @requestAttributeKey                        SMALLINT,        
        @targetAttributeKey                         SMALLINT,
        @targetObjectTypeAttributeKey               SMALLINT,      
        @targetObjectTypeIdentifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @targetObjectTypeIdentifier                 UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @requestTargetDetailObjectKey               SMALLINT,        
        @sequenceIdentifierAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
        @startTime                                  DATETIME;

    DECLARE @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes TABLE 
    (
        [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT
    );      
    
    DECLARE @insertedValueOutput TABLE
    (    
        [ObjectKey] BIGINT,
        [ObjectID] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
    );
    
    DECLARE @uniqueRequestParameters TABLE
    (
        [ObjectID] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        [RequestKey] BIGINT,
        [RequestParameterIndex] INT
    );
    
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    SELECT
        @attributeTypeKeyAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmAttributeTypeKey'),
        @attributeTypeIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmAttributeTypeID'),
        @attributeValueAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmAttributeValue'),
        @isReferenceAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmIsReference'),
        @modeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmMode'),
        @objectIdentifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
        @requestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Request'),        
        @targetAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Target'),          
        @targetObjectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'TargetObjectType'),
        @targetObjectTypeIdentifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmTargetObjectTypeIdentifier'),
        @requestTargetDetailObjectKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmRequestTargetDetail'),
        @sequenceIdentifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmSequenceID');
    
    -- figure out the unique request target detail object type - attribute pairs
    INSERT INTO @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes
    (
        [AttributeKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT [elb].[AttributeKey]
    FROM [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [elb]
    WHERE [elb].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestTargetDetailObjectKey;
    
    -- generate new ids of each request parameter object
    INSERT INTO @uniqueRequestParameters
    (
        [ObjectID],
        [RequestKey],
        [RequestParameterIndex]
    )
    SELECT
        NEWID(),
        [rp].[RequestKey],
        [rp].[RequestParameterIndex]
    FROM [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
    WHERE [rp].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;    
    
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ReportObjects]
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [ObjectID]
    )
    OUTPUT inserted.ObjectKey, inserted.ObjectID INTO @insertedValueOutput
    SELECT
        @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
        [urp].[ObjectID]
    FROM @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp];

    --if there is a mapping to the object type attribute
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueString],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @objectTypeAttributeKey,
            N'msidmRequestTargetDetail',
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        ON 
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex]
    END

    --if there is a mapping to the sequence identifier attribute
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @sequenceIdentifierAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueInteger],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @sequenceIdentifierAttributeKey,
            [urp].[RequestParameterIndex],
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        ON 
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex]
    END

    --if there is a mapping to the request attribute (reference back to the parent)
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @requestAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [ValueReferenceKey],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @requestAttributeKey,
            [ovi].[ValueIdentifier],
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        ON 
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [rp].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey];
    END

    --if there is a mapping to the target attribute
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @targetAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [ValueReferenceKey],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @targetAttributeKey,
            [ovi].[ValueIdentifier],
            [rp].[ObjectKey],
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        ON 
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [rp].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey];
    END
    
    --if there is a mapping to the target object type identifier attribute
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @targetObjectTypeIdentifierAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [ValueReferenceKey],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @targetObjectTypeIdentifierAttributeKey,
            [ovi].[ValueIdentifier],
            [ovi].[ObjectKey],
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
            ON 
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex]                
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
            ON [rp].[ObjectKey] = [objects].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS  [oti]
            ON [objects].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [oti].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey];
    END

    --if there is a mapping to the attribute type key attribute
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @attributeTypeKeyAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueInteger],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @attributeTypeKeyAttributeKey,
            [rp].[AttributeKey],
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        ON 
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex];
    END
    
    --if there is a mapping to the attribute type ID attribute
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @attributeTypeIDAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @attributeTypeIDAttributeKey,
            [ovi].[ValueIdentifier],
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        ON 
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            ON [rp].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [ai].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
    END
    
    --if there is a mapping to the attribute value attribute
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @attributeValueAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueText],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @attributeValueAttributeKey,
            CASE [rp].[AttributeValue]
                WHEN NULL THEN N''
                ELSE COALESCE ([rp].[AttributeValueIdentifier], [rp].[AttributeValue])
            END,
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        ON 
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex];
    END
    
    --if there is a mapping to the mode attribute
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @modeAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueString],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @modeAttributeKey,
            [rp].[Mode],
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        ON 
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex];
    END
    
    --if there is a mapping to the isReference attribute
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [AttributeKey]
        FROM @recordedRequestTargetDetailAttributes AS [a]
        WHERE [a].[AttributeKey] = @isReferenceAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
        (
            [ExportLogIdentifier],
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectID],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueInteger],
            [EventTime],
            [Added]
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            [rp].[RequestKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectKey],
            [ivo].[ObjectID],
            @requestTargetDetailObjectKey,
            @isReferenceAttributeKey,            
            CASE [ai].[DataType]
                WHEN 'Reference' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END,            
            @committedTime,
            1 
        FROM @insertedValueOutput AS [ivo]
        INNER JOIN @uniqueRequestParameters AS [urp]
            ON [ivo].[ObjectID] = [urp].[ObjectID]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        ON
                [urp].[RequestKey] = [rp].[RequestKey]
            AND [urp].[RequestParameterIndex] = [rp].[RequestParameterIndex]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            ON [rp].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key];
    END
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'AddRequestTargetDetailToExportLog';
    END;
END

        @startTime DATETIME,

        @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT;   
        
    DECLARE @recordedRequestAttributes TABLE 
    (
        AttributeKey  SMALLINT
    );

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    SELECT @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
           @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
           @requestObjectIdentifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@requestKey);

    INSERT INTO @recordedRequestAttributes
    (
        [AttributeKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT [elb].[AttributeKey]
    FROM [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [elb]
    WHERE [elb].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey;

        [RequestKey],
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectID],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueBinary],
        [EventTime],
        [Added]
    )
    SELECT
        NEWID(),
        @requestKey,
        @requestKey,            
        @requestObjectIdentifier,
        @requestObjectTypeKey,
        [ov].[AttributeKey],
        [ov].[ValueBinary],
        @committedTime,
        1 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ov]
    INNER JOIN @recordedRequestAttributes AS [recordedRequestAttributes]
        ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [recordedRequestAttributes].[AttributeKey]    
    WHERE
            [ov].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey;
    
    -- handle attributes on the ObjectValueBoolean table
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
    (
        [ExportLogIdentifier],
        [RequestKey],
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectID],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueBoolean],
        [EventTime],
        [Added]
    )

        NEWID(),

        [ov].[ValueBoolean],
        @committedTime,
        1

        ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [recordedRequestAttributes].[AttributeKey]

            [ov].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey;
        
    -- handle attributes on the ObjectValueDateTime table
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLog]
    (
        [ExportLogIdentifier],
        [RequestKey],
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectID],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueDateTime],
        [EventTime],
        [Added]
    )
    SELECT
        NEWID(),
        @requestKey,
        @requestKey,            
        @requestObjectIdentifier,
        @requestObjectTypeKey,
        [ov].[AttributeKey],
        [ov].[ValueDateTime],
        @committedTime,
        1 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ov]
    INNER JOIN @recordedRequestAttributes AS [recordedRequestAttributes]
        ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [recordedRequestAttributes].[AttributeKey]

            [ov].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
