/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[AreWorkflowInstancesFinished]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[AreWorkflowInstancesFinished]
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @workflowTypeKey TINYINT,
    @workflowResultsStatus NVARCHAR(448) OUTPUT
AS
-- Read Only
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON

    SELECT  @workflowResultsStatus = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    BEGIN TRY BEGIN

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;        
        
        DECLARE @acquiredLock INT,
                @allHaveFinished BIT, 
                @anyHaveTerminated BIT, 
                @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),        
                @workflowTypeName NVARCHAR(32);

        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @allHaveFinished = 0,
                @anyHaveTerminated = 0,
                @workflowTypeName = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeName](@workflowTypeKey);

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get Exclusive lock
        *  DESIGN POINT:  Requests may have multiple workflows that finish at the same time so we need to make sure
        *  that a check is done sequentially to avoid a race condition.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        --NOTE:  postive return values mean a lock was granted according to the sp_getapplock API

        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @requestKey;
        
        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatNotAbleToObtainLockOnRequestKey](@requestKey);
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END


        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Check to see if all Workflows of the given type are finished for this requestId 
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF
        (
            NOT EXISTS
            (
                -- Select workflows that are not finished
                SELECT
                    [wi].[ObjectKey] 
                FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
                WHERE 
                        [wi].[RequestKey]=@requestKey
                    AND [wi].[WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeKey
                    AND [wi].[Finished] = 0
            )
        )
        BEGIN   
            -- True if all workflows for this request are finished
            SELECT @allHaveFinished = 1;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- All Action Workflows must finish before we set a status so exit early
            IF(@workflowTypeName = [fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]())
            BEGIN
                GOTO FinalExit;
            END
        END

        -- only check for failed if all have finished OR not Action (AuthN, AuthZ allow early exit status)
        IF(@allHaveFinished = 1 OR @workflowTypeName != [fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]())
        BEGIN
            --Determine if any have failed
            IF
            (
                EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT
                        [wi].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
                    WHERE 
                            [wi].[RequestKey]=@requestKey 
                        AND [wi].[Finished] = 1
                        AND [wi].[WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeKey
                        AND [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusKeyOfTypeFailed](wi.WorkflowStatus) = 1
                )
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @anyHaveTerminated = 1;
            END

            -- If any Terminate, we can set result status (since request will be denied - no need to wait for others
            -- All must complete before we set a result status of Completed
            SELECT @workflowResultsStatus = 
            CASE
                WHEN (@anyHaveTerminated = 1)   THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusTerminated]()    -- if any terminate we deny the request
                WHEN (@allHaveFinished = 1)     THEN [fim].[WorkflowStatusCompleted]()     -- if all complete we can continue the request
                ELSE NULL
            END;
        END

    FinalExit: 

    END END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END END CATCH

END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
    @tableName      NVARCHAR(448),
	@shouldExist    BIT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @tableIdentifier    INT;
    DECLARE @trueFlag           BIT;
    DECLARE @messageText        NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    SELECT 
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @tableIdentifier = OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..' + @tableName);
    
    IF
    (
            @tableIdentifier IS NULL 
        AND @shouldExist = @trueFlag
    )
    OR 
    (
            @tableIdentifier IS NOT NULL
        AND @shouldExist != @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidTemporaryTableStateException](@tableName,@shouldExist);
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
    RETURN;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext]
	@requireTransaction BIT 
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    IF (
        (@requireTransaction = 1) AND (XACT_STATE() = 0)
        OR
        (@requireTransaction = 0) AND (XACT_STATE() != 0)
       )
    BEGIN
	    DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000)
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidTransactionalContextException](@requireTransaction);
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions]
    @setKey BIGINT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
/*
This sproc traverses the groups marked for deferred evaluation, compares its de juro memberships
with de facto memberships, generates the list of changes that have to be applied to the system and
executes the requests to make the membership changes. If @setKey is provided the above mentioned
mechanism happens on the specified group only.

Algorithm:
1) Create the temp tables needed for calculations
2) Call the sproc that validates the membership and fills the temp table with necessary changes on a group ([fim].[DoCalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions])
    a) if @setKey is provided then on that group
    b) if @setKey is not provided then on every group marked for deferred evaluation in loop
3) Transform the table with changes that need to happen into a better form for it to be consumed
4) Call the sproc that does request generation and execution ([fim].[ProcessDeferredGroupMembershipChanges])
*/
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @computedMemberAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @groupObjectTypeKey             SMALLINT,
        @trueFlag                       BIT;

    SELECT
        @computedMemberAttributeKey     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmDeferredEvaluation'),
        @groupObjectTypeKey             = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Group'),
        @trueFlag                       = CONVERT(BIT,1);

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#membershipModifications') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #membershipModifications;
    END

    CREATE TABLE #membershipModifications
    (
        [Id] INT IDENTITY (1, 1),
        [SetKey] BIGINT,
        [MemberToAdd] BIGINT,
        [MemberToRemove] BIGINT
    );

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#membershipModificationsIds') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #membershipModificationsIds;
    END

    CREATE TABLE #membershipModificationsIds
    (
        [Id] INT IDENTITY (1, 1),
        [SetKey] BIGINT,
        [MemberKey] BIGINT,
        [ToRemove] BIT
    );

    -- If @setKey is not provided, calculate the changes for all the deferred groups. Otherwise only for the provided @setKey
    IF @setKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        DECLARE setCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT
            [sf].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetFilter] AS [sf]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb]
        ON      [sf].[SetKey] = [ovb].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ovb].[AttributeKey] = @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey
            AND [ovb].[ValueBoolean] = @trueFlag
        WHERE [sf].[SetTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey;

        OPEN setCursor;
        WHILE (1 = 1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @setKey = NULL;
            
            FETCH NEXT FROM setCursor INTO 
                @setKey;
                
            IF @setKey IS NULL
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END
            
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoCalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions]
                @setKey = @setKey;
        END
        
        CLOSE setCursor;
        DEALLOCATE setCursor;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoCalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions]
                @setKey = @setKey;
    END

    -- Groom the collected membership change data into more convenient representation
    INSERT INTO #MembershipModificationsIds
    (
        [SetKey],
        [MemberKey],
        [ToRemove]
    )
    SELECT
        [mm].[SetKey],
        CASE
            WHEN [mm].[MemberToAdd] IS NOT NULL THEN [mm].[MemberToAdd]
            ELSE [mm].[MemberToRemove]
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN [mm].[MemberToAdd] IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END
    FROM #MembershipModifications AS [mm]

    -- Issue the requests to apply the membership changes
    EXECUTE [fim].[ProcessDeferredGroupMembershipChanges];
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateMembershipConditionAttributeSignature]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateMembershipConditionAttributeSignature] 
    @membershipConditionKey INT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE
        @falseFlag    BIT,
        @trueFlag    BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
        INNER JOIN
        (
                SELECT 
                    [documentCondition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                    [documentAttribute].[AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey]
                FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [documentCondition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementAttribute] AS [documentAttribute]
                    ON    [documentCondition].[StatementKey] = [documentAttribute].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [documentStatement]
                    ON    [documentCondition].[StatementKey] = [documentStatement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [documentAttributeDetail]
                    ON    [documentAttribute].[AttributeKey] = [documentAttributeDetail].[Key]
            ) AS [Attributes]
            ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [Attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE        [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionAttributeSignature]
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [AttributeSignature]
        )
        SELECT 
            [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
            CAST
            (
                ( 
                    SELECT 
                    N'',                    
                    (
                        SELECT    [documentAttribute].[AttributeKey] AS [Key]
                        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [documentCondition]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementAttribute] AS [documentAttribute]
                            ON    [documentCondition].[StatementKey] = [documentAttribute].[StatementKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [documentStatement]
                            ON    [documentCondition].[StatementKey] = [documentStatement].[StatementKey]
                        WHERE        [documentCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        ORDER BY
                                [documentAttribute].[AttributeKey]
                        FOR XML PATH (N'Attribute'), TYPE
                    )
                    FOR XML PATH (N'Condition')
                )
                AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
            ) AS [AttributeSignature]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
        WHERE        [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;            
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @creating                   BIT,
    @deleting                   BIT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @explicitMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @filterAttributeKey         SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                    DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @anyTypeFlag        = -1;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
    END
    
    IF @explicitMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember')
    END
    
    IF @filterAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @filterAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Filter')
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID')
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.   For any resource that is not being created or deleted, for
 *      each set that is not being created or deleted
 *      of which a resource is a member, if a statement of a 
 *      membership condition of that set is now false, then identify all 
 *      of the statements of any other membership conditions of that set.  
 *      Only if all of the statements of one of those other membership 
 *      conditions is true, will the resource remain in the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1  Identify the set members whose membership is jeopardized by the 
 *      falsification of a membership condition statement, where there is 
 *      an alternate condition that the resource might satisfy, and where
 *      the resource is of a type that can satisfy the condition.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [falseStatement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [falseStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [falseCondition]
            ON [falseStatement].[StatementKey] = [falseCondition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setFalseCondition]
            ON [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setFalseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
            ON [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
            AND [falseStatement].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setAlternateCondition]
            ON [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [setAlternateCondition].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [otherStatement]
            ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [otherStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
            ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE 
                [falseStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [falseStatement].[True] = @falseFlag
            AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] != [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND
                (
                        [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                    OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] IN
                        (
                            SELECT [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
                            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [member]
                            WHERE
                                    [member].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
                        )
                )
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [set].[ObjectKey] AS N'SetKey',
            [set].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'SetTypeKey',
            [falseStatement].[ObjectKey] AS N'MemberKey',
            [otherStatement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [falseStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [falseCondition]
            ON [falseStatement].[StatementKey] = [falseCondition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setFalseCondition]
            ON [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setFalseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
            ON [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
            AND [falseStatement].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setAlternateCondition]
            ON [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [setAlternateCondition].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [otherStatement]
            ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [otherStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
            ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE 
                [falseStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [falseStatement].[True] = @falseFlag
            AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] != [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND
                (
                        [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                    OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] IN
                        (
                            SELECT [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
                            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [member]
                            WHERE
                                    [member].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
                        )
                )
            ORDER BY 
                [set].[ObjectKey],
                [falseStatement].[ObjectKey],
                [otherStatement].[StatementKey]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions_SetKey_SetTypeKey_MemberKey_StatementKey]
        ON #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions
        (
            [SetKey],
            [SetTypeKey],
            [MemberKey],
            [StatementKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions_StatementKey_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions
        (
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2  Exclude resources that are being created or deleted
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        IF @creating = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MemberKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
            END

        END
        
        IF @deleting = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MemberKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3  Exclude sets that are being deleted.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            END

        END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.4  Exclude cases where the filter of the set is being updated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                   
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [filterUpdate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [filterUpdate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [filterUpdate].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [filterUpdate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [filterUpdate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [filterUpdate].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@filterAttributeKey = 84));
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.5  Exclude cases where the member is an explicit member of the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                   
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicitMembership]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [explicitMembership].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [explicitMembership].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicitMembership]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [explicitMembership].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [explicitMembership].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.6  Exclude sets in different partitions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[SetPartition] AS [set]
                ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                ON    [set].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [partition].[True] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[SetPartition] AS [set]
                ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                ON    [set].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [partition].[True] = @falseFlag
        END        

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.7  Exclude cases that have already been identified.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.8  Finalize the remaining cases.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                     
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[MemberKey],
                NULL,
                0
            FROM #calculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        END
        
    END
          
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @creating                   BIT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @objectTypeAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END

    DECLARE 
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT,
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                    DATETIME;        
        
    SELECT @anyTypeFlag        = -1;
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL 
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID')
    END
    
    IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType')
    END
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    New resources automatically join sets with filters, but
 *        no membership conditions  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1    For each resource that is being created, for each set that has no 
 *      membership conditions, add a record to a temporary table to indicate
 *      that the resource is to be added to the table.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [s].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[Set] AS [s]
        WHERE        [s].HasMembershipConditions = 0
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional;
        END
    
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [s].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
            [c].[ObjectKey] AS N'MemberKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [c]
        CROSS JOIN [fim].[Set] AS [s]
        WHERE       [s].[HasMembershipConditions] = 0;
                
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional]
        ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional
        (
            [SetKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2    If the addition of a newly-created resource to a set with no membership
 *      conditions has already been indicated by an entry in the 
 *      RequestOutputReference table, then delete the entry for that resource
 *      and that set from the temporary table.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [uc].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional AS [uc]
            INNER JOIN [RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                ON [uc].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [uc].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional AS [uc]
            INNER JOIN [RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                ON [uc].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [uc].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));       
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3    Add any remaining entries in the temporary table to the 
 *      RequestOutputReference table.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [uc].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional AS [uc]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted]
            )
            SELECT
                @requestKey,
                [uc].[SetKey],
                [o].[ObjectTypeKey],
                @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                [uc].[MemberKey],
                @falseFlag
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinUnconditional AS [uc]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
                ON [uc].[SetKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END

    END

 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   New resources automatically join sets defined solely by partitions
 *      to which they belong.  
 *
 *      So, for each resource that is being created, for each set that has no 
 *      membership condition statements, but is partitioned, add a record to 
 *      a temporary table to indicate that the resource is to be added 
 *      to the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [object].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [object]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
            ON    [object].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
            ON    [truth].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [truth].[True] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition;
        END
    
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS [MembershipConditionKey],
            [object].[ObjectKey] AS [MemberKey]
        INTO #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [object]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
            ON    [object].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
            ON    [truth].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [truth].[True] = @trueFlag;
                
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition]
        ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [partition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition AS [partition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [partition]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition AS [partition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [partition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition AS [partition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
                ON    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                AND   [partition].[MemberKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [truth].[True] = @falseFlag                
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [partition]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition AS [partition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
                ON    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                AND   [partition].[MemberKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [truth].[True] = @falseFlag;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition AS [condition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet;
            END
            
            SELECT 
                [set].[SetKey],
                [condition].[MemberKey]
            INTO #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartition AS [condition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
            ORDER BY
                    [set].[SetKey],
                    [condition].[MemberKey];
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet]
            ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet
            (
                [SetKey],
                [MemberKey]
            );
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [partition].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet AS [partition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetPartition] AS [set]
                    ON    [partition].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                    ON    [set].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                    AND   [partition].[MemberKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                            [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [truth].[True] = @falseFlag                
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [partition]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet AS [partition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetPartition] AS [set]
                    ON    [partition].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                    ON    [set].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                    AND   [partition].[MemberKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                            [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [truth].[True] = @falseFlag;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [partition].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet AS [partition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                    ON    [partition].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND    [partition].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [partition]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet AS [partition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                    ON    [partition].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND    [partition].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey;
            END
 
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [partition].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet AS [partition]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [ObjectTypeKey],
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference],
                    [Deleted]
                )
                SELECT
                    @requestKey,
                    [partition].[SetKey],
                    [set].[ObjectTypeKey],
                    @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                    [partition].[MemberKey],
                    @falseFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinPartitionSet AS [partition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [set]
                    ON [partition].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
            END
        END
    END    

 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.   New resources automatically join sets defined solely in terms of values of 
 *      the immutable ObjectID and ObjectType attributes.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1    First consider sets that are restricted solely by statements of the 
 *      form, ObjectID!=X.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1.a    Identify any sets that are unrestricted by the ObjectType attribute
 *          and restricted by ObjectID.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/  
 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT[setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setMembershipConditions]
            ON    [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [set]
            ON [setMembershipConditions].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [immutable].[ByObjectIdentifier] = @trueFlag
            AND    [immutable].[ByObjectType] = @falseFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
            [setMembershipConditions].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
            [set].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'SetTypeKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setMembershipConditions]
            ON    [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [set]
            ON [setMembershipConditions].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [immutable].[ByObjectIdentifier] = @trueFlag
            AND    [immutable].[ByObjectType] = @falseFlag
        ORDER BY 
            [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [setMembershipConditions].[SetKey],
            [set].[ObjectTypeKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier]
        ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [SetKey],
            [SetTypeKey]
        );
        
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1.b    Exclude any sets that are restricted to a particular ObjectID
 *          value or values, for the ObjectID values of the newly-created
 *          resources cannot possibly have been referred to by a membership
 *          condition statement that was created earlier.  Also exclude any
 *          sets that are restricted by anything besides ObjectID.  The only
 *          sets that should remain are those with conditions of the form, 
 *          ObjectID!=X.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/  
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [identifierSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier AS [identifierSet]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [identifierSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE        [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
        )  
        BEGIN         
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier AS [identifierSet]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [identifierSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE        [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag;
        END
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1.c    Every newly-created resource is a candidate to join any of the 
 *          sets that have been identified, so identify all of the 
 *          transitions of those resources into those sets.      
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [identifierSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier AS [identifierSet]
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate;
            END
        
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [identifierSet].[SetKey] AS [SetKey],
                [identifierSet].[SetTypeKey] AS [SetTypeKey],
                [creating].[ObjectKey] AS [MemberKey],
                [identifierSet].[MembershipConditionKey] AS [MembershipConditionKey]
            INTO #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            CROSS JOIN #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinIdentifier AS [identifierSet]
            ORDER BY
                [identifierSet].[SetKey],
                [identifierSet].[SetTypeKey],
                [creating].[ObjectKey],
                [identifierSet].[MembershipConditionKey];                
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate]
            ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate
            (
                [SetKey],
                [SetTypeKey],
                [MemberKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate_MembershipCondition]
            ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [MemberKey]
            );
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1.d    Exclude transitions into other partitions.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/  
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
                    ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                    ON      [condition].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                    AND     [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [partition].[True] = @falseFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
                    ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                    ON      [condition].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                    AND     [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [partition].[True] = @falseFlag;                    
            END            
            
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1.e    Exclude any transitions that have already been identified.        
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                  
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [ro].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [ro].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                    
            END
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1.f    Finalize the remaining transitions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                  
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [ObjectTypeKey],
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference],
                    [Deleted]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[SetKey],
                    [candidate].[SetTypeKey],
                    @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                    [candidate].[MemberKey],
                    @falseFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinCandidate AS [candidate]
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                    
            END
            
        END
            
    END

 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2    Next, consider sets that are restricted by the ObjectID
 *        and ObjectType attributes, and which will accept the values of the
 *        ObjectType attributes of the newly-created resources.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2.a    Identify sets that meet those criteria.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setMembershipConditions]
            ON    [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedObjectTypes]
            ON [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedObjectTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            ON [acceptedObjectTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE        [immutable].[ByObjectType] = @trueFlag        
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable;
        END
    
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
            [setMembershipConditions].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setMembershipConditions]
            ON    [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedObjectTypes]
            ON [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedObjectTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            ON [acceptedObjectTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE        [immutable].[ByObjectType] = @trueFlag        
        ORDER BY 
            [setMembershipConditions].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [setMembershipConditions].[SetKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable]
        ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [SetKey]
        );
        
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2.b    Again, exclude any sets that are restricted to a particular ObjectID
 *          value or values, for the ObjectID values of the newly-created
 *          resources cannot possibly have been referred to by a membership
 *          condition statement that was created earlier.  Also exclude any
 *          sets that are restricted by attributes other than the ObjectID
 *          and ObjectType attributes.  The only sets that should remain are
 *          ones with restrictions of the form, ObjectID!=X, ObjectType='a', 
 *          and ObjectType!='b.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [identifierTypeSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable AS [identifierTypeSet]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
                ON    [identifierTypeSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [identifierTypeSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                        [immutable].[ByObjectIdentifier] = @trueFlag
                    AND  
                        (
                                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                            AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                        )
        )  
        BEGIN         
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable AS [identifierTypeSet]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
                ON    [identifierTypeSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [identifierTypeSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                        [immutable].[ByObjectIdentifier] = @trueFlag
                    AND  
                        (
                                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                            AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                        )
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
        END
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2.c    Identify candidates to join the sets that are defined solely 
 *          in terms of values of the ObjectID and ObjectKey attributes.  
 *          Any newly-created resource that is of one of the types 
 *          accepted by the set is a candidate.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/      
 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [identifierTypeSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable AS [identifierTypeSet]
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate;
            END
        
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [identifierTypeSet].[SetKey] AS [SetKey],
                [identifierTypeSet].[MembershipConditionKey] AS [MembershipConditionKey],
                [creating].[ObjectKey] AS [MemberKey]
            INTO #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutable AS [identifierTypeSet]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setMembershipCondition]
                ON [identifierTypeSet].[SetKey] = [setMembershipCondition].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedType]
                ON [setMembershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedType].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [acceptedType].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            ORDER BY
                [identifierTypeSet].[SetKey],
                [identifierTypeSet].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [creating].[ObjectKey];                
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate]
            ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate
            (
                [SetKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [MemberKey]
            );
            
            CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate_MembershipConditionKey]
            ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [MemberKey],
                [SetKey]
            );
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2.d    Exclude any transitions into different partitions, or
 *          that have already been identified.        
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [partition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                    ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE   
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey    
                    AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [partition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                    ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE   
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey    
                    AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag;
            END
             
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
                    ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [partition].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                    ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE   
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey    
                    AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
                    ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [partition].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                    ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE   
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey    
                    AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag;
            END
                  
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableResult') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableResult;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [candidate].[SetKey] AS [SetKey],
                    [object].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [SetTypeKey],
                    [candidate].[MemberKey] AS [MemberKey]
                INTO #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableResult
                FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableCandidate AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                    ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                ORDER BY
                    [candidate].[SetKey],
                    [object].[ObjectTypeKey],
                    [candidate].[MemberKey];
                
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableResult]
                ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableResult
                (
                    [SetKey],
                    [SetTypeKey],
                    [MemberKey]
                );
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [result].[SetKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableResult AS [result]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                        ON [result].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [result].[SetTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                        AND [result].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [result]
                    FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableResult AS [result]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                        ON [result].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [result].[SetTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                        AND [result].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                        
                END
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2.e    Finalize the remaining transitions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                  
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [result].[SetKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableResult AS [result]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
                    (
                        [RequestKey],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [ObjectTypeKey],
                        [AttributeKey],
                        [ValueReference],
                        [Deleted]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @requestKey,
                        [result].[SetKey],
                        [result].[SetTypeKey],
                        @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                        [result].[MemberKey],
                        @falseFlag
                    FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinImmutableResult AS [result]
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                        
                END
            END
            
        END
    END    

    IF (@trace = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitions';
    END
END
