--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestAutomaticLeaveSetTransitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @creating                   BIT,
    @deleting                   BIT,
    @modifying                  BIT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @deleting != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;      
    
    IF (@trace = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID')
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Deleted resources automatically leave any sets to which they 
 *        belong.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                        
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1    Identify the sets out of which the deleted resources will transition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [membership].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [membership]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleted]
            ON [membership].[ValueReference] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE        [membership].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitionsLeave') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitionsLeave;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [membership].[ObjectKey] AS N'SetKey',
            [membership].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'SetTypeKey',
            [membership].[ValueReference] AS N'MemberKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitionsLeave
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [membership]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleted]
            ON [membership].[ValueReference] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE        [membership].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        ORDER BY 
            [membership].[ObjectKey],
            [membership].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [membership].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitionsLeave_SetKey_SetTypeKey_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitionsLeave
        (
            [SetKey],
            [SetTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2    Exclude any departures that may have already been identified.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [departing].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitionsLeave AS [departing]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                 ON [departing].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                 AND [departing].[SetTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                 AND [departing].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [departing]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitionsLeave AS [departing]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                 ON [departing].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                 AND [departing].[SetTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                 AND [departing].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3    Finalize the remaining departures.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [departing].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitionsLeave AS [departing]
        )
        BEGIN        
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [departing].[SetKey],
                [departing].[SetTypeKey],
                @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                [departing].[MemberKey],
                @trueFlag
            FROM #calculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitionsLeave AS [departing]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
    END    
            
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestAutomaticLeaveSetTransitions';
    END
END

--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestAutomaticSetTransitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @creating                   BIT,
    @deleting                   BIT,
    @modifying                  BIT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @objectTypeAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                    DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID')
    END
    
    IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType')
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Identify automatic transitions into sets.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestAutomaticJoinSetTransitions]
        @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
        @creating                   = @creating,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
        @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey     = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
        @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
        @trace                      = @trace;
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Identify automatic transitions out of sets.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestAutomaticLeaveSetTransitions]
        @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
        @creating                    = @creating,
        @deleting                   = @deleting,
        @modifying                    = @modifying,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
        @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
        @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
        @trace                      = @trace;
            
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestAutomaticSetTransitions';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions]
    @requestKey                     BIGINT,
    @creating                       BIT,
    @deleting                       BIT,
    @modifying                      BIT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey         SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                       BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                      BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                          BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey    SMALLINT,
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;

    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END

    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 
        
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID')
    END
    
    SELECT @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime');
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  This procedure identifies dereferencing statements of which the truth 
 *  will be altered by a request.  
 *
 *  A dereferencing statement is a statement like this one: 
 *
 *  Manager        =    /Set[ObjectID='X']/ComputedMember]
 *  |_____|        |    |________________| |____________|    
 *     |           |            |                 |
 *  Attribute Operator      Dereferenced      Dereferenced 
 *                          Statement          Attribute
 *  |_______________________________________________________|
 *                                |
 *                    Dereferencing Statement
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 1.   Identify any current set memberships.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/   
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [request].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [setY]
            ON [request].[ObjectKey] = [setY].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [setY].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [setY].[ObjectKey]      AS N'SetKey',
            [setY].[ObjectTypeKey]  AS N'SetTypeKey',
            [setY].[ValueReference] AS N'MemberKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [setY]
            ON [request].[ObjectKey] = [setY].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [setY].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        ORDER BY 
            [setY].[ObjectKey],
            [setY].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [setY].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_#CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships]
        ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships
        (
            [SetKey],
            [SetTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_#CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships_SetKey_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships
        (
            [SetKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2.   Consider statements like Manager=/Set[ObjectID=X]/ComputedMember.  
 *      
 *      There are two sets to take into account.  The first is the set to
 *      which the statement refers, Set X.  The other set is the set for which
 *      the truth of this statement may be a condition for membership.  This 
 *      latter set will be referred to as Set Y.  
 *
 *      In the case of this particular statement, the first attribute to which
 *      the statement refers is the attribute, Manager.  That attribute will be
 *      referred to as the Attribute A.  
 *
 *      If the current request is to modify the Attribute A of a resource that is
 *      NOT already a member of the Set Y, and the modification is to make the 
 *      value of the Attribute A refer to a member of the Set X, then the 
 *      statement will be true for the resource in question.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2.a    Identify the candidate resources.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipCondition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [membershipCondition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setMembershipCondition]
            ON [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setMembershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                    [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedObject') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedObject;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
            [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedObject
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipCondition]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [membershipCondition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setMembershipCondition]
            ON [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setMembershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                    [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            [statement].[StatementKey],
            [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedObject]
        ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedObject
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey]
        );
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT
                [statement].[StatementKey],
                [SetX].[ObjectKey],
                [SetX].[ObjectTypeKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [SetX]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedObject AS [statement]
                ON [SetX].[ObjectKey] = [statement].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [SetX].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND    [SetX].[SequenceID] = @falseFlag
                AND    [SetX].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
        
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [SetX].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [SetX].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [SetX]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedObject AS [statement]
                    ON [SetX].[ObjectKey] = [statement].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [SetX].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND    [SetX].[SequenceID] = @falseFlag
                AND    [SetX].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
            ORDER BY
                [statement].[StatementKey],
                [SetX].[ObjectKey],
                [SetX].[ObjectTypeKey]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@createdTimeAttributeKey = 53));
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet]
            ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey]
            );
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [dereferenced].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet AS [dereferenced]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [dereferenced].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
                    ON  [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                    ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
            )
            BEGIN
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet_Reference') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet_Reference;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [dereferenced].[ObjectKey] AS N'SetXObjectKey',
                    [dereferenced].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'SetXObjectTypeKey',
                    [request].[ValueReference] AS N'TargetValueReference',
                    [request].[ObjectKey] AS N'TargetKey',
                    [dereferenced].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                    [set].[SetKey] AS N'SetYObjectKey'
                INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet_Reference
                FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet AS [dereferenced]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [dereferenced].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
                    ON  [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                    ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
                ORDER BY
                    [dereferenced].[ObjectKey],
                    [dereferenced].[ObjectTypeKey],
                    [request].[ValueReference],
                    [request].[ObjectKey],
                    [dereferenced].[StatementKey],
                    [set].[SetKey]
                    
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet_Reference]
                ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet_Reference
                (
                    [SetXObjectKey],
                    [SetXObjectTypeKey],
                    [TargetValueReference],
                    [TargetKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [SetYObjectKey]
                );
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [dereferencedSets].[SetXObjectKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet_Reference AS [dereferencedSets]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [SetX]
                        ON  [dereferencedSets].[SetXObjectKey] = [SetX].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [dereferencedSets].[SetXObjectTypeKey] = [SetX].[ObjectTypeKey]
                        AND [dereferencedSets].[TargetValueReference] = [SetX].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [SetX].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin;
                    END
                    
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [dereferencedSets].[SetYObjectKey] AS N'SetKey',
                        [dereferencedSets].[TargetKey] AS N'MemberKey',
                        [dereferencedSets].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
                    INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin
                    FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet_Reference AS [dereferencedSets]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [SetX]
                        ON  [dereferencedSets].[SetXObjectKey] = [SetX].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [dereferencedSets].[SetXObjectTypeKey] = [SetX].[ObjectTypeKey]
                        AND [dereferencedSets].[TargetValueReference] = [SetX].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [SetX].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    ORDER BY 
                        [dereferencedSets].[SetYObjectKey],
                        [dereferencedSets].[TargetKey],
                        [dereferencedSets].[StatementKey]
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                
                    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin_SetKey_MemberKey_StatementKey]
                    ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin
                    (
                        [SetKey],
                        [MemberKey],
                        [StatementKey]
                    );
                    
                    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin_MemberKey]
                    ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin
                    (
                        [MemberKey]
                    );
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2.b  Eliminate resources that are being deleted.  For resources that are 
 *      being deleted, the resulting membership changes will be automatic.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
                    IF @deleting = 1
                    BEGIN 
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [potentialJoin].[SetKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                                ON [potentialJoin].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                                ON [potentialJoin].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey];
                        END
                        
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [potentialJoin].[MemberKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                                ON [potentialJoin].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                                ON [potentialJoin].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey];
                        END
                    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2.c  Eliminate the resources that are already members of the sets that they
 *      might join.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [potentialJoin].[SetKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships AS [existingMember]
                                ON [potentialJoin].[SetKey] = [existingMember].[SetKey]
                                AND [potentialJoin].[MemberKey] = [existingMember].[MemberKey]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships AS [existingMember]
                                ON [potentialJoin].[SetKey] = [existingMember].[SetKey]
                                AND [potentialJoin].[MemberKey] = [existingMember].[MemberKey];                 
                        END
                    END
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [potentialJoin].[SetKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [existingMember]
                            ON [potentialJoin].[SetKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectKey]
                            AND [potentialJoin].[MemberKey] = [existingMember].[ValueReference]
                        WHERE
                                [existingMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [existingMember]
                            ON [potentialJoin].[SetKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectKey]
                            AND [potentialJoin].[MemberKey] = [existingMember].[ValueReference]
                        WHERE
                                [existingMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));                    
                    END
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                            ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE [candidate] 
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                            ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2.d  For the remainder, record the fact that a statement that might qualify
 *      a resource for membership in a set, is now true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [potentialJoin].[SetKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                        (
                            [RequestKey],
                            [StatementKey],
                            [ObjectKey],
                            [True],
                            [Iteration]
                        )
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            @requestKey,
                            [potentialJoin].[StatementKey],
                            [potentialJoin].[MemberKey],
                            NULL,
                            0
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialJoin AS [potentialJoin];
                    END
                END                
            END            
        END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.   Using the same terminology as was used to describe the case, 3, above, 
 *      if the current request is to modify the Attribute A of a resource that 
 *      IS a member of the Set Y, and the modification is to modify the 
 *      value of the Attribute A to NOT refer to a member of the Set X, then the 
 *      statement is false for the resource in question.  
 *
 *      Consequently, the resource will not longer satisfy any membership 
 *      condition of Set Y that includes the statement.  Therefore, the 
 *      resource may have to be removed from Set Y.  
 *
 *      The resource will only qualify to remain in Set Y if it satisfies the 
 *      statements of any OTHER membership condition of Set Y, if Set Y has
 *      any other membership conditions.  Therefore, all the other statements
 *      of any other membership conditions of Set Y will have to be 
 *      evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
 
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.a    Identify the candidate resources.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/   
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [member].[MemberKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships AS [member]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                    ON  [member].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                    ON  [set].[SetKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    ON  [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet AS [dereferenced]
                    ON  [condition].[StatementKey] = [dereferenced].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [dereferenced].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
                    ON  [member].[MemberKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] != [statement].[OperatorInversion]
            )
            BEGIN
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships_Dereferenced') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships_Dereferenced;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [member].[SetKey] AS N'SetYKey',
                    [object].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'SetYTypeKey',
                    [member].[MemberKey] AS N'SetYMemberKey',
                    [request].[ValueReference] AS 'SetYMemberAttributeValue',
                    [dereferenced].[ObjectKey] AS 'SetXKey',
                    [dereferenced].[ObjectTypeKey] AS 'SetXTypeKey',
                    [dereferenced].[StatementKey] AS 'FalseStatementKey'
                INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships_Dereferenced
                FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships AS [member]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                    ON  [member].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                    ON  [set].[SetKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    ON  [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions_DereferencedSet AS [dereferenced]
                    ON  [condition].[StatementKey] = [dereferenced].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [dereferenced].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
                    ON  [member].[MemberKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] != [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                ORDER BY
                    [member].[SetKey],
                    [object].[ObjectTypeKey],
                    [member].[MemberKey],
                    [request].[ValueReference],
                    [dereferenced].[ObjectKey],
                    [dereferenced].[ObjectTypeKey],
                    [dereferenced].[StatementKey];
                    
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships_Dereferenced]
                ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships_Dereferenced
                (
                    [SetYKey],
                    [SetYTypeKey],
                    [SetYMemberKey],
                    [SetYMemberAttributeValue],
                    [SetXKey],
                    [SetXTypeKey],
                    [FalseStatementKey]
                );
            
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [dereferenced].[SetYKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships_Dereferenced AS [dereferenced]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [setX]
                        ON  [dereferenced].[SetXKey] = [setX].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [dereferenced].[SetXTypeKey] = [setX].[ObjectTypeKey]
                        AND [dereferenced].[SetYMemberAttributeValue] = [setX].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [setX].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave;
                    END
                    
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [dereferenced].[SetYKey] AS N'SetKey',
                        [dereferenced].[SetYTypeKey] AS N'SetTypeKey',
                        [dereferenced].[SetYMemberKey] AS N'MemberKey',
                        [dereferenced].[FalseStatementKey] AS N'FalseStatementKey'
                    INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave
                    FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsCurrentMemberships_Dereferenced AS [dereferenced]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [setX]
                        ON  [dereferenced].[SetXKey] = [setX].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [dereferenced].[SetXTypeKey] = [setX].[ObjectTypeKey]
                        AND [dereferenced].[SetYMemberAttributeValue] = [setX].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [setX].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    ORDER BY
                        [dereferenced].[SetYKey],
                        [dereferenced].[SetYTypeKey],
                        [dereferenced].[SetYMemberKey],
                        [dereferenced].[FalseStatementKey]
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));   
                    
                    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave]
                    ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave
                    (
                        [SetKey],
                        [SetTypeKey],
                        [MemberKey],
                        [FalseStatementKey]
                    );
                    
                    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave_FalseStatementKey_SetKey_MemberKey]
                    ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave
                    (
                        [FalseStatementKey],
                        [SetKey],
                        [MemberKey]
                    );
                    
                    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave_FalseStatementKey_MemberKey]
                    ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave
                    (
                        [FalseStatementKey],
                        [MemberKey]
                    );
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.b  Exclude cases where the resource that might leave a set has 
 *      already been identified as changing its membership of the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [leave].[SetKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [leave]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [knownChange]
                            ON [leave].[SetKey] = [knownChange].[ObjectKey]
                            AND [leave].[SetTypeKey] = [knownChange].[ObjectTypeKey]
                            AND [leave].[MemberKey] = [knownChange].[ValueReference]
                        WHERE
                                [knownChange].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [knownChange].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave 
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [leave]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [knownChange]
                            ON [leave].[SetKey] = [knownChange].[ObjectKey]
                            AND [leave].[SetTypeKey] = [knownChange].[ObjectTypeKey]
                            AND [leave].[MemberKey] = [knownChange].[ValueReference]
                        WHERE
                                [knownChange].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [knownChange].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40)); 
                    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.c  Identify the subset of those candidates for which an alternative
 *      value of a multi-valued attribute qualified them for remaining in the
 *      set.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[MemberKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                            ON [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                            ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [attribute].[Key]
                        WHERE
                                [attribute].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            [candidate].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
                            [candidate].[SetTypeKey] AS N'SetTypeKey',
                            [candidate].[MemberKey] AS N'MemberKey',
                            [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
                        INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                            ON [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                            ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [attribute].[Key]
                        WHERE
                                [attribute].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
                        ORDER BY
                            [candidate].[SetKey],
                            [candidate].[SetTypeKey],
                            [candidate].[MemberKey],
                            [candidate].[FalseStatementKey];
                            
                        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay]
                        ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay
                        (
                            [SetKey],
                            [SetTypeKey],
                            [MemberKey],
                            [StatementKey]
                        );
                        
                        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay_StatementKey_MemberKey]
                        ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay
                        (
                            [StatementKey],
                            [MemberKey]
                        );
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.c.i    Remove those resource that might qualify to remain from among the 
 *          resources for which a set membership condition is now false.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
                        DELETE FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [leave]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay AS [stay]
                            ON  [leave].[SetKey] = [stay].[SetKey]
                            AND [leave].[SetTypeKey] = [stay].[SetTypeKey]
                            AND [leave].[MemberKey] = [stay].[MemberKey]
                            AND [leave].[FalseStatementKey] = [stay].[StatementKey];
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.c.ii   Exclude, from among the statements that have to be re-evaluated for  
 *          the resources that might qualify to remain, statements that have 
 *          already been identified for re-evaluation.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [potentialStay].[StatementKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay AS [potentialStay]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [knownStatement]
                                ON [potentialStay].[StatementKey] = [knownStatement].[StatementKey]
                                AND [potentialStay].[MemberKey] = [knownStatement].[ObjectKey]
                            WHERE
                                    [knownStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay 
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay AS [potentialStay]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [knownStatement]
                                ON [potentialStay].[StatementKey] = [knownStatement].[StatementKey]
                                AND [potentialStay].[MemberKey] = [knownStatement].[ObjectKey]
                            WHERE
                                    [knownStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                        END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.c.iii  For the remainder of the resources that might still qualify to remain, 
 *          record the fact that a statement that might allow a resource to remain 
 *          in a set must be evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                  
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [potentialStay].[SetKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay AS [potentialStay]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                            (
                                [RequestKey],
                                [StatementKey],
                                [ObjectKey],
                                [True],
                                [Iteration]
                            )
                            SELECT DISTINCT
                                @requestKey,
                                [potentialStay].[StatementKey],
                                [potentialStay].[MemberKey],
                                NULL,
                                0
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsStay AS [potentialStay]
                        END       
                    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.d      Identify the subset of those candidates for which a replacement
 *          value that might satisfy the condition is provided.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[FalseStatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [falseStatement]
                            ON  [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] = [falseStatement].[StatementKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [replacement]
                            ON  [candidate].[MemberKey] = [candidate].[MemberKey]
                            AND [falseStatement].[AttributeKey] = [replacement].[AttributeKey]
                        WHERE
                                [replacement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [replacement].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement') IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave;
                        END
                        
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            [candidate].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
                            [candidate].[SetTypeKey] AS N'SetTypeKey',
                            [candidate].[MemberKey] AS N'MemberKey',
                            [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
                        INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [falseStatement]
                            ON  [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] = [falseStatement].[StatementKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [replacement]
                            ON  [candidate].[MemberKey] = [candidate].[MemberKey]
                            AND [falseStatement].[AttributeKey] = [replacement].[AttributeKey]
                        WHERE
                                [replacement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [replacement].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                        ORDER BY
                            [candidate].[SetKey],
                            [candidate].[SetTypeKey],
                            [candidate].[MemberKey],
                            [candidate].[FalseStatementKey];   
                    
                        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement]
                        ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement
                        (
                            [SetKey],
                            [SetTypeKey],
                            [MemberKey],
                            [StatementKey]
                        );
                        
                        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement_StatementKey_MemberKey]
                        ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement
                        (
                            [StatementKey],
                            [MemberKey]
                        );
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.d.i    Remove those resource that might qualify to remain from among the 
 *          resources for which a set membership condition is now false.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
                        DELETE FROM [leave]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [leave]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement AS [replace]
                            ON [leave].[SetKey] = [replace].[SetKey]
                            AND [leave].[SetTypeKey] = [replace].[SetTypeKey]
                            AND [leave].[MemberKey] = [replace].[MemberKey];
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.d.ii   Exclude, from among the statements that have to be re-evaluated for  
 *          the resources that might qualify to remain, statements that have 
 *          already been identified for re-evaluation.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [replace].[StatementKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement AS [replace]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [knownStatement]
                                ON [replace].[StatementKey] = [knownStatement].[StatementKey]
                                AND [replace].[MemberKey] = [knownStatement].[ObjectKey]
                            WHERE
                                    [knownStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM [replace]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement AS [replace]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [knownStatement]
                                ON [replace].[StatementKey] = [knownStatement].[StatementKey]
                                AND [replace].[MemberKey] = [knownStatement].[ObjectKey]
                            WHERE
                                    [knownStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                        END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.d.iii  For the remainder of the resources that might still qualify to remain, 
 *          record the fact that a statement that might allow a resource to remain 
 *          in a set must be evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [replace].[SetKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement AS [replace]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                            (
                                [RequestKey],
                                [StatementKey],
                                [ObjectKey],
                                [True],
                                [Iteration]
                            )
                            SELECT DISTINCT
                                @requestKey,
                                [replace].[StatementKey],
                                [replace].[MemberKey],
                                NULL,
                                0
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsReplacement AS [replace]
                        END       
                    
                    END   
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.e      Identify the subset of those candidates for which an alternative
 *          membership condition for remaining in a set might be true.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[FalseStatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [falseStatementFalseConditions]
                            ON [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] = [falseStatementFalseConditions].[StatementKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [falseCondition]
                            ON [falseStatementFalseConditions].[MembershipConditionKey] = [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            AND [candidate].[SetKey] = [falseCondition].[SetKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [alternateCondition]
                            ON [falseCondition].[SetKey] = [alternateCondition].[SetKey]
                            AND [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] != [alternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [alternateStatements]
                            ON [alternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [alternateStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave') IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave;
                        END
                        
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            [candidate].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
                            [candidate].[SetTypeKey] AS N'SetTypeKey',
                            [candidate].[MemberKey] AS N'MemberKey',
                            [alternateStatements].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
                        INTO #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [falseStatementFalseConditions]
                            ON [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] = [falseStatementFalseConditions].[StatementKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [falseCondition]
                            ON [falseStatementFalseConditions].[MembershipConditionKey] = [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            AND [candidate].[SetKey] = [falseCondition].[SetKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [alternateCondition]
                            ON [falseCondition].[SetKey] = [alternateCondition].[SetKey]
                            AND [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] != [alternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [alternateStatements]
                            ON [alternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [alternateStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        ORDER BY
                            [candidate].[SetKey],
                            [candidate].[SetTypeKey],
                            [candidate].[MemberKey],
                            [alternateStatements].[StatementKey];   
                    
                        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave]
                        ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave
                        (
                            [SetKey],
                            [SetTypeKey],
                            [MemberKey],
                            [StatementKey]
                        );
                        
                        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave_StatementKey_MemberKey]
                        ON #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave
                        (
                            [StatementKey],
                            [MemberKey]
                        );
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.e.i    Remove those resource that might qualify to remain from among the 
 *          resources for which a set membership condition is now false.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
                        DELETE FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [leave]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave AS [potentialLeave]
                            ON [leave].[SetKey] = [potentialLeave].[SetKey]
                            AND [leave].[SetTypeKey] = [potentialLeave].[SetTypeKey]
                            AND [leave].[MemberKey] = [potentialLeave].[MemberKey];
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.e.ii   Exclude, from among the statements that have to be re-evaluated for  
 *          the resources that might qualify to remain, statements that have 
 *          already been identified for re-evaluation.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [potentialLeave].[StatementKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave AS [potentialLeave]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [knownStatement]
                                ON [potentialLeave].[StatementKey] = [knownStatement].[StatementKey]
                                AND [potentialLeave].[MemberKey] = [knownStatement].[ObjectKey]
                            WHERE
                                    [knownStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave 
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave AS [potentialLeave]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [knownStatement]
                                ON [potentialLeave].[StatementKey] = [knownStatement].[StatementKey]
                                AND [potentialLeave].[MemberKey] = [knownStatement].[ObjectKey]
                            WHERE
                                    [knownStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                        END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.e.iii  For the remainder of the resources that might still qualify to remain, 
 *          record the fact that a statement that might allow a resource to remain 
 *          in a set must be evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [potentialLeave].[SetKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave AS [potentialLeave]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                            (
                                [RequestKey],
                                [StatementKey],
                                [ObjectKey],
                                [True],
                                [Iteration]
                            )
                            SELECT DISTINCT
                                @requestKey,
                                [potentialLeave].[StatementKey],
                                [potentialLeave].[MemberKey],
                                NULL,
                                0
                            FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsPotentialLeave AS [potentialLeave]
                        END       
                    
                    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 3.f  Submit any statements identified in 4.a that were not excluded by 
 *      in by 4.b - 4.e, for evaluation.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[FalseStatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                            ON  [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    )           
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE FROM [candidate]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                            ON  [candidate].[FalseStatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                    END
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[FalseStatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                    )           
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                        (
                            [RequestKey],
                            [StatementKey],
                            [ObjectKey],
                            [True],
                            [Iteration]
                        )
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            @requestKey,
                            [candidate].[FalseStatementKey],
                            [candidate].[MemberKey],
                            NULL,
                            0
                        FROM #calculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitionsLeave AS [candidate]
                    END
                END
            END  
        END
    END 

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions]
	@requestKey                 BIGINT,
	@deleting                   BIT,
	@modifying                  BIT,
	@computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
	@explicitMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
	@filterAttributeKey         SMALLINT    = NULL,
	@identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
	@trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
	@falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
	@trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE
	    @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
	    @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
	    @startTime				    DATETIME;	    
	    
	IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
	    SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @anyTypeFlag        = -1;
    		
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.	Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
	IF @requestKey IS NULL
	OR NOT EXISTS
	(
		SELECT r.[RequestKey]
		FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
		WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
	
	IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
	END
	
	IF @explicitMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember')
	END
	
	IF @filterAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @filterAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Filter')
	END
	
	IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID')
	END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.   For any resource that is not being created or deleted, for
 *      each set that is not being created or deleted
 *      of which a resource is a member, if a statement of a 
 *      membership condition of that set is now false, then identify all 
 *      of the statements of any other membership conditions of that set.  
 *      Only if all of the statements of one of those other membership 
 *      conditions is true, will the resource remain in the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1  Identify the set members whose membership is jeopardized by the 
 *      falsification of a membership condition statement, where there is 
 *      an alternate condition that the resource might satisfy, and where
 *      the resource is of a type that can satisfy the condition.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [falseStatement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [falseStatement]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            ON [falseStatement].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [falseCondition]
            ON [falseStatement].[StatementKey] = [falseCondition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setFalseCondition]
            ON [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setFalseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
            ON [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
            AND [falseStatement].[ResourceKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setAlternateCondition]
            ON [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [setAlternateCondition].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [otherStatement]
            ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [otherStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
            ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE 
                [falseStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [falseStatement].[True] = @falseFlag
            AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] != [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND
                (
                        [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                    OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] IN
                        (
                            SELECT [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
