                            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [member]
                            WHERE
                                    [member].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
                        )
                )
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions') IS NOT NULL
	    BEGIN
	        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions;
	    END
	    
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [set].[ObjectKey] AS N'SetKey',
            [set].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'SetTypeKey',
            [falseStatement].[ResourceKey] AS N'MemberKey',
            [otherStatement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [falseStatement]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            ON [falseStatement].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [falseCondition]
            ON [falseStatement].[StatementKey] = [falseCondition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setFalseCondition]
            ON [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setFalseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
            ON [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
            AND [falseStatement].[ResourceKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setAlternateCondition]
            ON [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [setAlternateCondition].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [otherStatement]
            ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [otherStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
            ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE 
                [falseStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [falseStatement].[True] = @falseFlag
            AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] != [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND
                (
                        [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                    OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] IN
                        (
                            SELECT [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
                            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [member]
                            WHERE
                                    [member].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
                        )
                )
            ORDER BY 
                [set].[ObjectKey],
                [falseStatement].[ResourceKey],
                [otherStatement].[StatementKey]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions_SetKey_SetTypeKey_MemberKey_StatementKey]
        ON #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions
        (
            [SetKey],
            [SetTypeKey],
            [MemberKey],
            [StatementKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions_StatementKey_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2  Exclude sets that are being deleted.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	        
        IF @deleting = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            END

        END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3  Exclude cases where the filter of the set is being updated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	               
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [filterUpdate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [filterUpdate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [filterUpdate].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [filterUpdate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [filterUpdate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [filterUpdate].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@filterAttributeKey = 84));
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.4  Exclude cases where the member is an explicit member of the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	               
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicitMembership]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [explicitMembership].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [explicitMembership].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicitMembership]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [explicitMembership].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [explicitMembership].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.5  Exclude cases that have already been identified.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	         
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.7  Finalize the remaining cases.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	                 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[MemberKey],
                NULL,
                0
            FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        END
        
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Now do the same for any case where an object is being removed from a
 *      partition of a membership condition of a set to which it belongs, where
 *      the set has an alternate condition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.1  Identify the set members whose membership is jeopardized by the 
 *      removal from the partition of a membership condition, where there is 
 *      an alternate condition that the resource might satisfy, and where
 *      the resource is of a type that can satisfy the condition.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [falseStatement].[StatementKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [falseStatement]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON  [falseStatement].[ObjectKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [falseCondition]
                ON  [falseStatement].[StatementKey] = [falseCondition].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setFalseCondition]
                ON  [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setFalseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
                ON  [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
                AND [falseStatement].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [falseStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [falseStatement].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [set].[ObjectKey] AS [SetKey],
                [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS [MembershipConditionKey],
                [set].[ValueReference] AS [MemberKey],
                [set].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [SetTypeKey]
            INTO #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [falseStatement]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON  [falseStatement].[ObjectKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [falseCondition]
                ON  [falseStatement].[StatementKey] = [falseCondition].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setFalseCondition]
                ON  [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setFalseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
                ON  [setFalseCondition].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
                AND [falseStatement].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [falseStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [falseStatement].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            ORDER BY 
                [set].[ObjectKey],
                [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [set].[ValueReference],
                [set].[ObjectTypeKey]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition]
            ON #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition
            (
                [SetKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [MemberKey],
                [SetTypeKey]
            );
            
            CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionType]
            ON #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition
            (
                [SetKey],
                [SetTypeKey],
                [MemberKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            );
            
            CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionMember]
            ON #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition
            (
                [SetKey],
                [MemberKey],
                [SetTypeKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            );
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [filterUpdate]
                    ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                WHERE
                        [filterUpdate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [filterUpdate].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [filterUpdate]
                    ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                WHERE
                        [filterUpdate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [filterUpdate].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@filterAttributeKey = 84));
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN  [fim].[SetPartition] AS [set]
                    ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN  [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                    ON      [set].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                    AND     [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                            [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND     [partition].[True] = @falseFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN  [fim].[SetPartition] AS [set]
                    ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN  [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                    ON      [set].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                    AND     [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                            [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND     [partition].[True] = @falseFlag;
            END 
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicitMembership]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [explicitMembership].[ValueReference]
                WHERE       [explicitMembership].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicitMembership]
                    ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [explicitMembership].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [explicitMembership].[ValueReference]
                WHERE       [explicitMembership].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                    ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setAlternateCondition]
                    ON [set].[SetKey] = [setAlternateCondition].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [otherStatement]
                    ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [otherStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
                    ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE 
                        [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] != [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND
                        (
                                [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                            OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] IN
                                (
                                    SELECT [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [member]
                                    WHERE       [member].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[MemberKey]
                                )
                        )
            )
            BEGIN
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                    [candidate].[MemberKey] AS [MemberKey],
                    [otherStatement].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
                    [otherStatement].[MembershipConditionKey] AS [MembershipConditionKey]
                INTO #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate
                FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                    ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setAlternateCondition]
                    ON [set].[SetKey] = [setAlternateCondition].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [otherStatement]
                    ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [otherStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
                    ON [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE 
                        [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] != [setAlternateCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND
                        (
                                [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                            OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] IN
                                (
                                    SELECT [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [member]
                                    WHERE       [member].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[MemberKey]
                                )
                        )
                ORDER BY
                    [candidate].[MemberKey],
                    [otherStatement].[StatementKey],
                    [otherStatement].[MembershipConditionKey];
                
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate]
                ON #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate
                (
                    [MemberKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [MembershipConditionKey]
                );
                
                CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternateCondition]
                ON #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [MemberKey],
                    [StatementKey]
                );
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN  [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
                        ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN  [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                        ON      [condition].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                        AND     [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE
                                [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND     [partition].[True] = @falseFlag
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [candidate]
                    FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN  [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
                        ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN  [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                        ON      [condition].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                        AND     [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE
                                [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND     [partition].[True] = @falseFlag;
                END 
        
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                        ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                        AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE
                            [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [candidate]
                    FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                        ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                        AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE
                            [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                END

                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate AS [candidate]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                    (
                        [RequestKey],
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [True],
                        [Iteration]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @requestKey,
                        [candidate].[StatementKey],
                        [candidate].[MemberKey],
                        NULL,
                        0
                    FROM #calculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitionsPartitionAlternate AS [candidate]
                END
            END
        END        
    END        
     			
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
	    EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @creating               BIT,
    @modifying              BIT,
    @trueFlag               BIT     = NULL,
    @falseFlag              BIT     = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT     = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END        

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Statements about resources that are being deleted are always treated
 *      as false, so if the request is only to delete resources, then
 *      no further processing is necessary here.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Identify the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources, for 
 *      membership condition statements that are true if no value is assigned
 *      to the attribute to which the statements are true, will be true for
 *      the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE @unassigned TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT,
        [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [statement].[DataTypeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE        
                    [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 1
                AND    [statement].[LiteralValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @unassigned
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [creating].[ObjectKey],
                [creating].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [statement].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE        
                        [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 1
                    AND    [statement].[LiteralValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL;
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [u].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM @unassigned
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
        END
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.   Determine how the truth of statements about boolean attributes might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    ;WITH [ImpliedOutput]
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueBoolean],
        [Deleted],
        [Initialized]
    )
    AS
    (
        SELECT
            [u].[ObjectKey],
            [u].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [u].[AttributeKey],
            NULL,
            @falseFlag,
            @trueFlag
        FROM @unassigned AS [u]
        UNION
        SELECT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueBoolean],
            [ro].[Deleted],
            @trueFlag
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [c]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [c].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [c].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        UNION
        SELECT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueBoolean],
            [ro].[Deleted],
            CASE 
                WHEN [ov].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [m].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ov]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
    (
        [RequestKey],
        [ResourceKey],
        [StatementKey],
        [True]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @requestKey,
        [io].[ObjectKey],
        [mcs].[StatementKey],
        CASE 
            WHEN
            (
                (
                    /* The statement is positive, and currently, it is false. */
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                        OR
                        [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    /* The statement is negative, and is true for missing values. */
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        [io].[ValueBoolean] != [mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean]
                        OR
                        [io].[ValueBoolean] IS NULL
                    )
                )
            )
            THEN @trueFlag
            ELSE @falseFlag
        END
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
    INNER JOIN [ImpliedOutput] AS [io]
        ON [io].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcsns]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcsns].[NegativeStatementKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positiveStatementTruth]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [positiveStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [inverseStatementTruth]
        ON [mcsns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [inverseStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE
            [mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL                    
            AND
            (
                (
                    [io].[ValueBoolean] = [mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean]                           --A new attribute value matches the value specified by the statement
                    AND                                                                         --So, the truth of the statement is changing if ... 
                    (
                        (                                                                       --(
                            [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag                              --    The statement asserts that a match exists
                            AND
                            (
                                [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL                 --  and the statement was not true before
                                OR                                                              --  OR
                                (                                                               --  (
                                   [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL          --      the statement was true before
                                    AND                                                         --      AND
                                    [io].[Deleted] = @trueFlag                                  --      the request is to delete a value
                                )                                                               --  )
                            )
                        )                                                                       --)
                        OR                                                                      --OR
                        (                                                                       --(
                            [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag                               --  The statement denies that a match exists
                            AND                                                                 --  AND
                            [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag                                    --  The statement is true if no value is present
                            AND                                                                 --  AND
                            [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL                      --  The statement was false before, because the inverse of the statement was false before
                        )                                                                       --)                                                        
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    [io].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
                    AND
                    [io].[ValueBoolean] != [mcs].[LiteralValueBoolean]
                    AND        
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND
                    [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND
                    [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                    AND
                    [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                )
                OR
                (
                    [io].[ValueBoolean] IS NULL
                    AND        
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                        OR
                        [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    AND
                    [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                )
            );
                
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.    Extra reasoning with respect to negative statements.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the 
 *      negative statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN   
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [creating].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [creating].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [creating].[ObjectKey];    
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.2  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is not changing, yet the statement refers to an
 *      attribute to which a value is being assigned, then the statement is 
 *      true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.3  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the negative
 *      statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey];
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.4  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is NOT changing, and there was no value for the 
 *      attribute to which the statement refers previously, and the statement 
 *      is not true if no value is assigned to the attribute, then the 
 *      negative statement is true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                        
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions';
    END
                
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @creating               BIT,
    @modifying              BIT,
    @trueFlag               BIT     = NULL,
    @falseFlag              BIT     = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT     = 0
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Statements about resources that are being deleted are always treated
 *      as false, so if the request is only to delete resources, then
 *      no further processing is necessary here.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Identify the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources, for 
 *      membership condition statements that are true if no value is assigned
 *      to the attribute to which the statements are true, will be true for
 *      the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE @unassigned TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT,
        [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [statement].[DataTypeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE        
                        [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 2
                    AND    
                        (
                                [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                            OR    [statement].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
                        )
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @unassigned
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [creating].[ObjectKey],
                [creating].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [statement].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE        
                        [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 2
                    AND    
                        (
                                [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                            OR    [statement].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
                        )
                    
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [u].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM @unassigned
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
        END
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.   Determine how the truth of statements about datetime attributes might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
 
    ;WITH [ImpliedOutput]
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueDateTime],
        [Deleted],
        [Initialized]
    )
    AS
    (
        SELECT
            [u].[ObjectKey],
            [u].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [u].[AttributeKey],
            NULL,
            @falseFlag,
            @trueFlag
        FROM @unassigned AS [u]
        UNION
        SELECT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueDateTime],
            [ro].[Deleted],
            @trueFlag
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [c]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [c].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        UNION
        SELECT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueDateTime],
            [ro].[Deleted],
            CASE 
                WHEN [ov].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [m].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ov]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
    (
        [RequestKey],
        [ResourceKey],
        [StatementKey],
        [True]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @requestKey,
        [io].[ObjectKey],
        [mcs].[StatementKey],
        CASE 
            WHEN
            (
                (
                    /* The statement is positive, and currently, it is false. */
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                        OR
                        [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    /* The statement is negative, and true for missing values. */
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        (
                                [io].[ValueDateTime] != [mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime]
                            AND
                                (
                                        [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
                                    OR
                                        (
                                                [mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag
                                            AND [io].[ValueDateTime] < [mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime]
                                        )
                                        
                                )
                        )
                        OR
                        [io].[ValueDateTime] IS NULL
                    )
                )
            )
            THEN @trueFlag
            ELSE @falseFlag
        END
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
    INNER JOIN [ImpliedOutput] AS [io]
        ON [io].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [mcfv]
        ON [mcs].[FunctionValueKey] = [mcfv].[FunctionValueKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcsns]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcsns].[NegativeStatementKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positiveStatementTruth]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [positiveStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [inverseStatementTruth]
        ON [mcsns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [inverseStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE
            (
                --NOTE 1: If both of these are NULL then the Attributes changed via this Request
                --        are not tied to any DateTime Membership statements so this select will yield 0 results.
                [mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                OR
                [mcs].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
            )
            AND
            (
                (
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            [io].[ValueDateTime] = ISNULL([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime],[mcfv].Value)
                            -- NOTE 2:  Both can't be NULL (refer to NOTE 1), so ISNULL() picks the column that is NOT NULL to use in the comparison.
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            [io].[ValueDateTime] > ISNULL([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime],[mcfv].Value)
                        )
                    )
                    AND
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                            AND
                            (
                                [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                                OR
                                (
                                    [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                                    AND
                                    [io].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                                )
                            )
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                        )
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    [io].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                    AND
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
                            
                            AND
                            [io].[ValueDateTime] != ISNULL([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime],[mcfv].Value)
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            [io].[ValueDateTime] <= ISNULL([mcs].[LiteralValueDateTime],[mcfv].Value)
                        )
                    )
                    AND
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND
                    [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND 
                    [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                    AND 
                    [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                )
                OR
                (
                    [io].[ValueDateTime] IS NULL
                    AND
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                        OR
                        [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    AND
                    [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                )
            );

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.   Accommodate the possibility that a value that satisfies a greater-than
 *      condition that is being removed may be replaced by another value that 
 *      satisfies the same condition, or that another value that is not being 
 *      removed might satisfy the condition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1    Greater-than statements satisfied by existing values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN       
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [existing]
                ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [request].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [truth].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [existing].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [existing].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
                [existing].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
                [existing].[ValueDateTime] AS N'Value'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [existing]
                ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [request].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            ORDER BY
                [truth].[StatementKey],
                [existing].[ObjectKey],
                [existing].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [existing].[AttributeKey];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting_Secondary]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            );
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueDateTime]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
