                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueDateTime]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                    AND 
                        (
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] > [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime]

                            )
                            OR
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] < [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime]

                            )
                        )                
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [truth]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                    AND 
                        (
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] > [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime]

                            )
                            OR
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] < [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime]

                            )
                        );
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [function]
                    ON  [statement].[FunctionValueKey] = [function].[FunctionValueKey]
                WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND 
                        (
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] > [function].[Value]

                            )
                            OR
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] < [function].[Value]

                            )
                        )                
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [truth]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [function]
                    ON  [statement].[FunctionValueKey] = [function].[FunctionValueKey]
                WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND 
                        (
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] > [function].[Value]

                            )
                            OR
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] < [function].[Value]

                            )
                        );
            END
                
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.2    Greater-than statements satisfied by new values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [truth].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [request].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [request].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
                [request].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
                [request].[ValueDateTime] AS N'Value'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            ORDER BY
                [truth].[StatementKey],
                [request].[ObjectKey],
                [request].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [request].[AttributeKey];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew_Secondary]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueDateTime]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueDateTime]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            END

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                    AND 
                        (
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] > [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime]

                            )
                            OR
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] < [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime]

                            )
                        )                
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [truth]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                    AND 
                        (
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] > [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime]

                            )
                            OR
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] < [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime]

                            )
                        );
            END

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [function]
                    ON  [statement].[FunctionValueKey] = [function].[FunctionValueKey]
                WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND 
                        (
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] > [function].[Value]

                            )
                            OR
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] < [function].[Value]

                            )
                        )                
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [truth]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitionsDateTimeGreaterNew AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [function]
                    ON  [statement].[FunctionValueKey] = [function].[FunctionValueKey]
                WHERE
                        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND 
                        (
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] > [function].[Value]

                            )
                            OR
                            (
                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND 
                                [candidate].[Value] < [function].[Value]

                            )
                        );
            END
                
        END    
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.    Extra reasoning with respect to negative statements.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.1  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the 
 *      negative statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [creating].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [creating].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [creating].[ObjectKey];    
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.2  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is not changing, yet the statement refers to an
 *      attribute to which a value is being assigned, then the statement is 
 *      true. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.3  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the negative
 *      statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey];
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.4  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is NOT changing, and there was no value for the 
 *      attribute to which the statement refers previously, and the statement 
 *      is not true if no value is assigned to the attribute, then the 
 *      negative statement is true. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                        
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions';
    END
END
