--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @creating               BIT,
    @modifying              BIT,
    @identifierAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag               BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag              BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Statements about resources that are being deleted are always treated
 *      as false, so if the request is only to delete resources, then
 *      no further processing is necessary here.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 
        
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Identify the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources, for 
 *      membership condition statements that are true if no value is assigned
 *      to the attribute to which the statements are true, will be true for
 *      the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE @unassigned TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT,
        [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [statement].[DataTypeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 4
                AND    [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
                AND [binding].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @unassigned
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [creating].[ObjectKey],
                [creating].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [statement].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 4
                AND    [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
                AND [binding].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
                    
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [u].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM @unassigned
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
        END
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.   Determine how the truth of statements about reference attributes might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_CreatingTruth') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_CreatingTruth;
    END
        
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_CreatingTruth
    (
        [ObjectKey]         BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey]     SMALLINT,
        [AttributeKey]      SMALLINT,
        [ValueReference]    BIGINT
    );
    
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [c]
                ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [c].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [c].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_CreatingTruth
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                [ro].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [c]
                ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [c].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [c].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
            ORDER BY 
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                [ro].[ValueReference]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_CreatingTruth]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_CreatingTruth
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference]
            );
        END
    END
    
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_ModifyingTruth') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_ModifyingTruth;
    END
        
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_ModifyingTruth
    (
        [ObjectKey]         BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey]     SMALLINT,
        [AttributeKey]      SMALLINT,
        [ValueReference]    BIGINT,
        [Deleted]           BIT,
        [Initialized]       BIT 
    );
    
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsmodifying AS [c]
                ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [c].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [c].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_ModifyingTruth
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted],
                [Initialized]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                [ro].[ValueReference],
                [ro].[Deleted],
                @trueFlag
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
                ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [m].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
            ORDER BY 
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                [ro].[ValueReference],
                [ro].[Deleted]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_ModifyingTruth]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_ModifyingTruth
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted]
            );
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]            
                FROM [#calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_ModifyingTruth] AS [m]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ov]
                    ON [m].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [m].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [m].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                UPDATE [m]
                    SET [Initialized] = @falseFlag
                FROM [#calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_ModifyingTruth] AS [m]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ov]
                    ON [m].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [m].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [m].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
            END
        END
    END
    
    ;WITH [ImpliedOutput]
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference],
        [Deleted],
        [Initialized]
    )
    AS
    (
        SELECT
            [u].[ObjectKey],
            [u].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [u].[AttributeKey],
            NULL,
            @falseFlag,
            @trueFlag
        FROM @unassigned AS [u]
        UNION
        SELECT
            [c].[ObjectKey],
            [c].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [c].[AttributeKey],
            [c].[ValueReference],
            @falseFlag,
            @trueFlag
        FROM [#calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_CreatingTruth] AS [c]
        UNION
        SELECT
            [m].[ObjectKey],
            [m].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [m].[AttributeKey],
            [m].[ValueReference],
            [m].[Deleted],
            [m].[Initialized]
        FROM [#calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_ModifyingTruth] AS [m]
    )
    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
    (
        [RequestKey],
        [ResourceKey],
        [StatementKey],
        [True]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @requestKey,
        [io].[ObjectKey],
        [mcs].[StatementKey],
        CASE 
            WHEN
            (
                (
                    /* The statement is positive, and currently, it is false. */
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                        OR
                        [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    /* The statement is negative, is true for missing values.*/
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        [io].[ValueReference] != [mcs].[LiteralValueReference]
                        OR
                        [io].[ValueReference] IS NULL
                    )
                )
            )
            THEN @trueFlag
            ELSE @falseFlag
        END
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
    INNER JOIN [ImpliedOutput] AS [io]
        ON [io].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcsns]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcsns].[NegativeStatementKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positiveStatementTruth]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [positiveStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [inverseStatementTruth]
        ON [mcsns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [inverseStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE
            [mcs].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                (
                    [io].[ValueReference] = [mcs].[LiteralValueReference]
                    AND
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                            AND
                            (
                                [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                                OR
                                (
                                    [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                                    AND
                                    [io].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                                )
                            )
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                        )
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    [io].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                    AND
                    [io].[ValueReference] != [mcs].[LiteralValueReference]
                    AND
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND
                    [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND 
                    [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                    AND 
                    [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                )
                OR
                (
                    [io].[ValueReference] IS NULL
                    AND
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                        OR
                        [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    AND
                    [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                )
            );    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.    Extra reasoning with respect to negative statements.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the 
 *      negative statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [creating].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL                
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [creating].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL                                
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [creating].[ObjectKey]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));    

            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.2  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is not changing, yet the statement refers to an
 *      attribute to which a value is being assigned, then the statement is 
 *      true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Creating AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.3  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the negative
 *      statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
                AND [value].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
                AND [value].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));    
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.4  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is NOT changing, and there was no value for the 
 *      attribute to which the statement refers previously, and the statement 
 *      is not true if no value is assigned to the attribute, then the 
 *      negative statement is true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                        
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Modifying AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions';
    END                
                
END
GO

--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitions]
	@requestKey             BIGINT,
	@modifying              BIT         = NULL,
	@trueFlag               BIT         = NULL,
	@falseFlag              BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @startTime				    DATETIME;
	
	IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
	    SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

	DECLARE @messageText				NVARCHAR(MAX);

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.	The purpose of this procedure is to identify statements about attributes
 *      of which all of the values have been removed from a resource without the
 *      resource having been deleted.  
 *
 *      Consequently, only statements about modified resources are interesting.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/		
    IF @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.	Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
	IF @requestKey IS NULL
	OR NOT EXISTS
	(
		SELECT r.[RequestKey]
		FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
		WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	)
	BEGIN
		SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.	Get the names of all of the attributes that are being removed from 
 *      modified resources.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/		    
    DECLARE @removedAttribute   TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]             BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey]         SMALLINT,
        [AttributeKey]          SMALLINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @candidateTrueNegative      TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey]                  INT,
        [ObjectKey]                     BIGINT,
        [AttributeKey]                  SMALLINT,
        [True]                          BIT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [True]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @removedAttribute
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [m].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @removedAttribute
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [m].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @removedAttribute
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [m].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @removedAttribute
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [m].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @removedAttribute
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [m].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @removedAttribute

            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]

            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.	Identify any negative statements of which the positive counterparts
 *      were falsified by the removal of an attribute.  Such statements may
 *      be true.  For instance, if a statement is X != a, and a resource had 
 *      a, b and c as values for X, and X is removed, then the positive 
 *      statement, X = a will now have been made false.  That is a cue for
 *      anticipating that the negative statement, X != A, which had previously
 *      been false, is now true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [removed].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @removedAttribute AS [removed]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            ON  [removed].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negativeStatement]
            ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatement].[PositiveStatementKey]
        WHERE
                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [truth].[True] = @falseFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @candidateTrueNegative
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [negativeStatement].[NegativeStatementKey],
            [removed].[ObjectKey],
            [removed].[AttributeKey],
            @falseFlag
        FROM @removedAttribute AS [removed]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [removed].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
            AND [removed].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negativeStatement]
            ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatement].[PositiveStatementKey]
        WHERE
                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [truth].[True] = @falseFlag;
                
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM @candidateTrueNegative AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
            WHERE 
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [candidate]
            FROM @candidateTrueNegative AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
            WHERE 
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
            
    END

                    [ro].[RequestKey] IS NULL

                AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [ra].[AttributeKey]

                AND [ra].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueText] = [ro].[ValueText]
                AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] IS NULL
                AND [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag;
                
            DELETE FROM @removedAttribute
            FROM @removedAttribute AS [ra]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ov]
                ON [ra].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ra].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ra].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueText] = [ro].[ValueText]
                AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] IS NULL
        END
    END   

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.	Now, if there are indeed attributes of which all of the values have
 *      been removed, determine the implications of that for the truth of any
 *      statements about those attributes.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ra].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @removedAttribute AS [ra]
    )  
    BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.1	Any positive statements about the removed attribute of the object
 *      that was true, is now false.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @removedAttribute AS [removedAttribute]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [removedAttribute].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                ON [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
                AND [statement].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL            
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive') IS NOT NULL
	        BEGIN
	            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive;
	        END
	        
	        SELECT DISTINCT
	            [truth].[ResourceKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
	            [truth].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
	        INTO #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive
            FROM @removedAttribute AS [removedAttribute]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [removedAttribute].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                ON [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
                AND [statement].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
            ORDER BY
                [truth].[ResourceKey],
                [truth].[StatementKey];
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive]
	        ON #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive
	        (
	            [ObjectKey],
	            [StatementKey]
	        );
	        
	        IF EXISTS
	        (
	            SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive AS [candidate]
	            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
	                ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
	                AND [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
	            WHERE
	                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	        )
	        BEGIN
	            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive AS [candidate]
	            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
	                ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
	                AND [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
	            WHERE
	                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
	        END
	        
	        IF EXISTS
	        (
	            SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive AS [candidate]
	        )
	        BEGIN
	            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	            (
	                [RequestKey],
	                [ResourceKey],
	                [StatementKey],
	                [True]
	            )
	            SELECT DISTINCT
	                @requestKey,
	                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
	                [candidate].[StatementKey],
	                @falseFlag
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsPositive AS [candidate];
	        END
            
        END    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.2	Any negative statements about the removed attribute of the object
 *      that was true, is now false, unless the statement becomes true if all
 *      of the values of an attribute are deleted.  In either case, the negative 
 *      statement was true if its positive counterpart was not true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @removedAttribute AS [removedAttribute]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [removedAttribute].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [positiveCounterpart]
                ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [positiveCounterpart].[NegativeStatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL            
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative') IS NOT NULL
	        BEGIN
	            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative;
	        END
	        
	        SELECT DISTINCT
	            [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
	            [positiveCounterpart].[NegativeStatementKey] AS N'NegativeStatementKey',
	            [positiveCounterpart].[PositiveStatementKey] AS N'PositiveStatementKey',
	            [statement].[MissingValue] AS 'MissingValue'
	        INTO #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative
            FROM @removedAttribute AS [removedAttribute]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [removedAttribute].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [positiveCounterpart]
                ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [positiveCounterpart].[NegativeStatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL 
            ORDER BY
                [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey],
	            [positiveCounterpart].[NegativeStatementKey],
	            [positiveCounterpart].[PositiveStatementKey],
	            [statement].[MissingValue];

            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative]
	        ON #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative
	        (
	            [ObjectKey],
	            [NegativeStatementKey],
	            [PositiveStatementKey],
	            [MissingValue]
	        );
	        
	        IF EXISTS
	        (
	            SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative AS [candidate]
	            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truePositive]
	                ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truePositive].[ResourceKey]
	                AND [candidate].[PositiveStatementKey] = [truePositive].[StatementKey]
	                AND [candidate].[MissingValue] = @falseFlag
	        )
	        BEGIN
	            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative AS [candidate]
	            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truePositive]
	                ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truePositive].[ResourceKey]
	                AND [candidate].[PositiveStatementKey] = [truePositive].[StatementKey]
	                AND [candidate].[MissingValue] = @falseFlag
	        END

            IF EXISTS
	        (
	            SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative AS [candidate]
	            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
	                ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
	                AND [candidate].[NegativeStatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
	            WHERE
	                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	        )
	        BEGIN
	            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative AS [candidate]
	            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
	                ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
	                AND [candidate].[NegativeStatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
	            WHERE
	                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
	        END
	        
	        IF EXISTS
	        (
	            SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative AS [candidate]
	        )
	        BEGIN
	            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	            (
	                [RequestKey],
	                [ResourceKey],
	                [StatementKey],
	                [True]
	            )
	            SELECT DISTINCT
	                @requestKey,
	                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
	                [candidate].[NegativeStatementKey],
	                CASE 
	                    WHEN [candidate].[MissingValue] = @falseFlag THEN @falseFlag
	                    ELSE @trueFlag
	                END
	            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitionsNegative AS [candidate];
	        END
            
        END    
    END  
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G.	If there are any negative statements of which the positive counterpart
 *      was made false by the removal of an attribute, and those statements
 *      are now true, record that state of affairs.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	         
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM @candidateTrueNegative AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
        WHERE
                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )    
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [candidate]
        FROM @candidateTrueNegative AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
        WHERE
                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM @candidateTrueNegative AS [candidate]
        WHERE
                [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
    )    
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [candidate]
        FROM @candidateTrueNegative AS [candidate]
        WHERE
                [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM @candidateTrueNegative AS [candidate]
    )    
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [StatementKey],
            [ResourceKey],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @requestKey,
            [candidate].[StatementKey],
            [candidate].[ObjectKey],
            @trueFlag
        FROM @candidateTrueNegative AS [candidate];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ra].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @removedAttribute AS [ra]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [ra].[ObjectKey],
            [ra].[AttributeKey]
        FROM @removedAttribute AS [ra]
        ORDER BY 
            [ra].[ObjectKey],
            [ra].[AttributeKey];
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        );
            
    END
 
            
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
	    EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitions';
    END

	
END
GO

--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralSetTransitions]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @creating               BIT         = NULL,
    @modifying              BIT         = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @objectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag               BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag              BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @startTime                    DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    DECLARE @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX);

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Statements about resources that are being deleted are always treated
 *      as false, so if the request is only to delete resources, then
 *      no further processing is necessary here.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
        
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END
    
    IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Record the data types of the attributes bound to any resources that are 
 *      being created.  In the case of resources that are being created, 
 *      statements that are true when the value of an attribute is not 
 *      assigned must be evaluated regardless of whether the attribute is 
 *      assigned a value or not.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
    DECLARE @createdType    TABLE
    (
        [DataTypeKey]          TINYINT    PRIMARY KEY
    );
    
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @createdType
        (
            [DataTypeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [statement].[DataTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
            ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [statement].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0, @objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
    END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.    Determine how the truth of statements about boolean attributes might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [type].[DataTypeKey]
        FROM @createdType AS [type]
        WHERE        [type].[DataTypeKey] = 1
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralBooleanSetTransitions] 
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @creating = @creating,
            @modifying = @modifying,
            @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
            @trace = @trace;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.    Determine how the truth of statements about datetime attributes might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [type].[DataTypeKey]
        FROM @createdType AS [type]
        WHERE        [type].[DataTypeKey] = 2
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralDateTimeSetTransitions] 
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @creating = @creating,
            @modifying = @modifying,
            @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
            @trace = @trace;
    END    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G.    Determine how the truth of statements about integer attributes might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [type].[DataTypeKey]
        FROM @createdType AS [type]
        WHERE        [type].[DataTypeKey] = 3
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions] 
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @creating = @creating,
            @modifying = @modifying,
            @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
            @trace = @trace;
    END 
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * H.    Determine how the truth of statements about reference attributes might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [type].[DataTypeKey]
        FROM @createdType AS [type]
        WHERE        [type].[DataTypeKey] = 4
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions] 
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @creating = @creating,
            @modifying = @modifying,
            @identifierAttributeKey = @identifierAttributeKey,
            @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
            @trace = @trace;
    END        
           
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * I.    Determine how the truth of statements about string or text
 *      attributes might be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [type].[DataTypeKey]
        FROM @createdType AS [type]
        WHERE        [type].[DataTypeKey] = 5
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions] 
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @creating = @creating,
            @modifying = @modifying,
            @objectTypeAttributeKey = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
            @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
            @trace = @trace;
    END 
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [type].[DataTypeKey]
        FROM @createdType AS [type]
        WHERE        [type].[DataTypeKey] = 6
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [m].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
            ON  [m].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions] 
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @creating = @creating,
            @modifying = @modifying,
            @objectTypeAttributeKey = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
            @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
            @trace = @trace;
    END 
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestTabularFunctionSetTransitions]
        @requestKey = @requestKey,
        @creating = @creating,
        @modifying = @modifying,
        @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
        @trace = @trace;   
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralRemovedAttributeSetTransitions]
        @requestKey = @requestKey,
        @modifying  = @modifying,
        @trueFlag   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag  = @falseFlag,
        @trace      = @trace;
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestLiteralSetTransitions';
    END

    
END
GO

--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @creating               BIT,
    @modifying              BIT,
    @objectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag               BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag              BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Statements about resources that are being deleted are always treated
 *      as false, so if the request is only to delete resources, then
 *      no further processing is necessary here.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 
        
    IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Identify the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources, for 
 *      membership condition statements that are true if no value is assigned
 *      to the attribute to which the statements are true, will be true for
 *      the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE @unassigned TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT,
        [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [statement].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString] AS [string]
                ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [string].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 5
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
