                AND [binding].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @unassigned
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [creating].[ObjectKey],
                [creating].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [statement].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString] AS [string]
                ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [string].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 5
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
                AND [binding].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 0));
                    
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [u].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM @unassigned
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.   Determine how the truth of statements about string
 *      attributes might be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    ;WITH [ImpliedOutput]
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueString],
        [Deleted],
        [Initialized]
    )
    AS
    (
        SELECT
            [u].[ObjectKey],
            [u].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [u].[AttributeKey],
            NULL,
            @falseFlag,
            @trueFlag
        FROM @unassigned AS [u]
        UNION
        SELECT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueString],
            [ro].[Deleted],
            @trueFlag
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [c]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [c].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [c].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
        UNION
        SELECT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueString],
            [ro].[Deleted],
            CASE 
                WHEN [ov].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [m].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ov]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
    )
    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
    (
        [RequestKey],
        [ResourceKey],
        [StatementKey],
        [True]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @requestKey,
        [io].[ObjectKey],
        [mcs].[StatementKey],
        CASE 
            WHEN
            (
                (
                    /* The statement is positive, and currently, it is false. */
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND
                    (
                                [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                        OR        [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    /* The statement is negative, and if true for missing values. */
                            [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND        [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                    AND        [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[DataTypeKey] = 5
                            AND
                            (
                                (
                                    (
                                            [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
                                        AND    [io].[ValueString] != [stringValue].[LiteralValueString]
                                    )
                                    OR
                                    (
                                            [mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                                        AND    [io].[ValueString] NOT LIKE [stringValue].[LiteralValueString]
                                    )
                                )
                                OR    [io].[ValueString] IS NULL
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
            THEN @trueFlag
            ELSE @falseFlag
        END
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString] AS [stringValue]
        ON    [mcs].[StatementKey] = [stringValue].[StatementKey]
    INNER JOIN [ImpliedOutput] AS [io]
        ON [io].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcsns]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcsns].[NegativeStatementKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positiveStatementTruth]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [positiveStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [inverseStatementTruth]
        ON [mcsns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [inverseStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE   
            [stringValue].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                (
                    (
                        (
                                    [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
                            AND        [io].[ValueString] = [stringValue].[LiteralValueString]
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                                [mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                            AND    [io].[ValueString] LIKE [stringValue].[LiteralValueString]
                        )
                    )
                    AND
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                            AND
                            (
                                [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                                OR
                                (
                                        [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                                    AND    [io].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                                )
                            )
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                                [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                            AND    [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                            AND    [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                        )
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            (
                                    [io].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
                                AND    [io].[ValueString] != [stringValue].[LiteralValueString]
                            )
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            (
                                    [io].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
                                AND    [io].[ValueString] NOT LIKE [stringValue].[LiteralValueString]
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    AND    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND    [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND    [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                    AND [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                )
                OR
                (
                        [io].[ValueString] IS NULL
                    AND    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND    [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    (
                            [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                        OR    [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    AND    [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                )
            )
    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.   Accommodate the possibility that a value that satisfies a LIKE condition
 *      that is being removed may be replaced by another value that satisfies
 *      the same condition, or that another value that is not being removed 
 *      might satisfy the condition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1    LIKE statements satisfied by string values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1.a    LIKE statements satisfied by existing string values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [existing]
                ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [request].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [truth].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [existing].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [existing].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
                [existing].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
                IDENTITY(BIGINT,1,1) AS N'Identity',
                [existing].[ValueString] AS N'Value'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [existing]
                ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [request].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            ORDER BY
                [truth].[StatementKey],
                [existing].[ObjectKey],
                [existing].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [existing].[AttributeKey];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [Identity]
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting_Secondary]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            );
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueString]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueString]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString] AS [valueString]
                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [valueString].[StatementKey]
                    AND    [candidate].[Value] LIKE [valueString].[LiteralValueString]
                WHERE        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [truth]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString] AS [valueString]
                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [valueString].[StatementKey]
                    AND    [candidate].[Value] LIKE [valueString].[LiteralValueString]
                WHERE        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
                
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1.b    LIKE statements satisfied by new string values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag        
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [truth].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [request].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [request].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
                [request].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
                IDENTITY(BIGINT,1,1) AS N'Identity',
                [request].[ValueString] AS N'Value'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            ORDER BY
                [truth].[StatementKey],
                [request].[ObjectKey],
                [request].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [request].[AttributeKey];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [Identity]
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew_Secondary]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueString]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueString]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            END

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString] AS [valueString]
                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [valueString].[StatementKey]
                    AND    [candidate].[Value] LIKE [statement].[LiteralValueString]
                WHERE        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [truth]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitionsStringLikeNew AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString] AS [valueString]
                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [valueString].[StatementKey]
                    AND    [candidate].[Value] LIKE [statement].[LiteralValueString]
                WHERE        [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
                
                
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.   Extra reasoning with respect to negative statements about string 
 *      attributes.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.1  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the 
 *      negative statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    

    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [creating].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [creating].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [creating].[ObjectKey]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 0));    
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.2  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is not changing, yet the statement refers to an
 *      attribute to which a value is being assigned, then the statement is 
 *      true. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_CreatingString AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.3  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the negative
 *      statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag       
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
                AND [value].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN

            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
                AND [value].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 0));    
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.4  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is NOT changing, and there was no value for the 
 *      attribute to which the statement refers previously, and the statement 
 *      is not true if no value is assigned to the attribute, then the 
 *      negative statement is true. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                        
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_ModifyingString AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END   

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions';
    END
                
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @creating               BIT,
    @modifying              BIT,
    @objectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag               BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag              BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Statements about resources that are being deleted are always treated
 *      as false, so if the request is only to delete resources, then
 *      no further processing is necessary here.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag; 
        
    IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Identify the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources, for 
 *      membership condition statements that are true if no value is assigned
 *      to the attribute to which the statements are true, will be true for
 *      the unassigned attributes of newly-created resources.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE @unassigned TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT,
        [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [statement].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 6
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
                AND [statement].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL
                AND [binding].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @unassigned
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [creating].[ObjectKey],
                [creating].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [statement].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                ON [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DataTypeKey] = 6
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
                AND [statement].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL
                AND [binding].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 0));
                    
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [u].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM @unassigned
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [u].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
                    ON [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM @unassigned
                FROM @unassigned AS [u]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
                    ON    [u].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                    AND    [u].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND    [u].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.   Determine how the truth of statements about string and text 
 *      attributes might be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    ;WITH [ImpliedOutput]
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueText],
        [Deleted],
        [Initialized]
    )
    AS
    (
        SELECT
            [u].[ObjectKey],
            [u].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [u].[AttributeKey],
            NULL,
            @falseFlag,
            @trueFlag
        FROM @unassigned AS [u]
        UNION
        SELECT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueText],
            [ro].[Deleted],
            @trueFlag
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [c]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [c].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [c].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        UNION
        SELECT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueText],
            [ro].[Deleted],
            CASE 
                WHEN [ov].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [m]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [m].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ov]
            ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
    (
        [RequestKey],
        [ResourceKey],
        [StatementKey],
        [True]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @requestKey,
        [io].[ObjectKey],
        [mcs].[StatementKey],
        CASE 
            WHEN
            (
                (
                    /* The statement is positive, and currently, it is false. */
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND
                    (
                                [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                        OR      [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    /* The statement is negative, and if true for missing values. */
                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[DataTypeKey] = 6
                            AND
                            (
                                (
                                    (
                                                [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
                                        AND     [io].[ValueText] != [mcs].[LiteralValueString]
                                    )
                                    OR
                                    (
                                                [mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                                        AND     [io].[ValueText] NOT LIKE [mcs].[LiteralValueString]
                                    )
                                )
                                OR    [io].[ValueText] IS NULL
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
            THEN @trueFlag
            ELSE @falseFlag
        END
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
    INNER JOIN [ImpliedOutput] AS [io]
        ON [io].[AttributeKey] = [mcs].[AttributeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcsns]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcsns].[NegativeStatementKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positiveStatementTruth]
        ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [positiveStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [inverseStatementTruth]
        ON [mcsns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
        AND [inverseStatementTruth].[ResourceKey] = [io].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE   
            [mcs].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                (
                    (
                        (
                                    [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
                            AND     [io].[ValueText] = [mcs].[LiteralValueString]
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                                    [mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                            AND     [io].[ValueText] LIKE [mcs].[LiteralValueString]
                        )
                    )
                    AND
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                            AND
                            (
                                [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                                OR
                                (
                                            [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                                    AND     [io].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                                )
                            )
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                                    [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                            AND     [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                            AND     [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NULL
                        )
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    (
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            (
                                    [io].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
                                AND [io].[ValueText] != [mcs].[LiteralValueString]
                            )
                        )
                        OR
                        (
                            [mcs].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                            AND
                            (
                                    [io].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
                                AND [io].[ValueText] NOT LIKE [mcs].[LiteralValueString]
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    AND [positiveStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                    AND [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                )
                OR
                (
                        [io].[ValueText] IS NULL
                    AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    AND [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                    AND
                        (
                                [io].[Initialized] = @trueFlag
                            OR  [inverseStatementTruth].[StatementKey] IS NOT NULL
                        )
                    AND [io].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                )
            );


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.   Accommodate the possibility that a value that satisfies a LIKE condition
 *      that is being removed may be replaced by another value that satisfies
 *      the same condition, or that another value that is not being removed 
 *      might satisfy the condition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1    LIKE statements satisfied by text values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1.a    LIKE statements satisfied by existing text values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [existing]
                ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [request].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [truth].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [existing].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [existing].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
                [existing].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
                IDENTITY(BIGINT,1,1) AS N'Identity',
                [existing].[ValueText] AS N'Value'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [existing]
                ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [request].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            ORDER BY
                [truth].[StatementKey],
                [existing].[ObjectKey],
                [existing].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [existing].[AttributeKey];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [Identity]
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting_Secondary]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            );
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueText]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueText]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] LIKE [statement].[LiteralValueString]
                WHERE       [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [truth]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] LIKE [statement].[LiteralValueString]
                WHERE       [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
                
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1.b    LIKE statements satisfied by new text values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [truth].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [request].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [request].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
                [request].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
                IDENTITY(BIGINT,1,1) AS N'Identity',
                [request].[ValueText] AS N'Value'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                ON [truth].[ResourceKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [request]
                ON  [truth].[RequestKey] = [request].[RequestKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            ORDER BY
                [truth].[StatementKey],
                [request].[ObjectKey],
                [request].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [request].[AttributeKey];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [Identity]
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew_Secondary]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueText]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [request].[ValueText]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            END

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [truth].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] LIKE [statement].[LiteralValueString]
                WHERE       [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [truth]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitionsTextLikeNew AS [candidate]
                    ON  [truth].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[ResourceKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [truth].[True] = [statement].[OperatorInversion]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] LIKE [statement].[LiteralValueString]
                WHERE       [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END 
        END    
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.   Extra reasoning with respect to negative statements about text 
 *      attributes.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.1  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the 
 *      negative statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    

    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [creating].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [creating].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [value]
                ON  [creating].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [creating].[ObjectKey];    
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
