                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.2  For newly-created resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is not changing, yet the statement refers to an
 *      attribute to which a value is being assigned, then the statement is 
 *      true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_CreatingText AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.3  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is changing, then modify the truth of the negative
 *      statement accordingly.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [modifying].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [value]
                ON  [modifying].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                AND [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [value].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [value].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY
                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectKey],
                    [modifying].[ObjectTypeKey];    
                    
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText]
            ON #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [positive].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                        ELSE @trueFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positive]
                    ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positive].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [positive].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [positive].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.4  For modified resources, if the truth of a positive counterpart to
 *      a negative statement is NOT changing, and there was no value for the 
 *      attribute to which the statement refers previously, and the statement 
 *      is not true if no value is assigned to the attribute, then the 
 *      negative statement is true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                        
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE       [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE       [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [value]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [value].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [value].[AttributeKey] 
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #calculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions_ModifyingText AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END   

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestLiteralTextSetTransitions';
    END
                
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:18 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @iteration                  INT,
    @creating                   BIT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                    DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Add the statements of the membership conditions of nesting sets into 
 *       the list of statements to be evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1  Sets defined in terms of the membership of other sets.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1.a    Sets defined in terms of the membership of other sets by 
 *          statements like, ObjectID=/Set[ObjectID=X]/ComputedMember.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
            ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nestingSet]
            ON [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [nestingSet].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
            [nestedSet].[ValueReference] AS N'MemberKey',
            [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
            ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nestingSet]
            ON [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
        ORDER BY
            [nestingSet].[SetKey],
            [nestedSet].[ValueReference],
            [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40, @identifierAttributeKey = 0));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey_SetKey_MemberKey_StatementKey]
        ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey
        (
            [SetKey],
            [MemberKey],
            [StatementKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey_StatementKey_ObjectKey]
        ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [processed]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [processed].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [processed].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [processed].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [processed].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [processed]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [processed].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [processed].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [processed].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [processed].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey AS [candidate]            
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[MemberKey],
                NULL,
                @iteration
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey AS [candidate];
            
        END
        
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1.b    Sets defined in terms of the membership of other sets by 
 *          statements like, Manager=/Set[ObjectID=X]/ComputedMember.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/      
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1.b.i  Cases where the attribute referred to by the statement is being
 *          updated by the request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/  
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
            ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nestingSet]
            ON [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttributeNestedSet') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttributeNestedSet;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
            [statement].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
            [nestedSet].[ValueReference] AS N'ValueReference',
            [nestedSet].[ObjectKey] AS N'NestedSetKey',
            [nestingSet].[SetKey] AS N'NestingSetKey'         
        INTO #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttributeNestedSet
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
            ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nestingSet]
            ON [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
        ORDER BY
            [statement].[StatementKey],
            [statement].[AttributeKey],
            [nestedSet].[ValueReference],
            [nestedSet].[ObjectKey],
            [nestingSet].[SetKey]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40, @identifierAttributeKey = 0));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttributeNestedSet]
        ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttributeNestedSet
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [NestedSetKey],
            [NestingSetKey]         
        ); 
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttributeNestedSet_Attribute]
        ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttributeNestedSet
        (
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [NestedSetKey]            
        );
        
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [nestedSet].[AttributeKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttributeNestedSet AS [nestedSet]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [referenceToNestedSetMember]
                ON  [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = [referenceToNestedSetMember].[AttributeKey]
                AND [nestedSet].[ValueReference] = [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [referenceToNestedSetMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [referenceToNestedSetMember].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [referenceToNestedSetMember].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [nestedSet].[NestedSetKey] AS N'NestedSetKey',
                [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ObjectKey] AS N'MemberKey',
                [nestedSet].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [nestedSet].[NestingSetKey] AS N'NestingSetKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttributeNestedSet AS [nestedSet]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [referenceToNestedSetMember]
                ON  [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = [referenceToNestedSetMember].[AttributeKey]
                AND [nestedSet].[ValueReference] = [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [referenceToNestedSetMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [referenceToNestedSetMember].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [referenceToNestedSetMember].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
            ORDER BY
                [nestedSet].[NestedSetKey],
                [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ObjectKey],
                [nestedSet].[StatementKey],
                [nestedSet].[NestingSetKey]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute_SetKey_MemberKey_StatementKey]
            ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute
            (
                [NestedSetKey],
                [MemberKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [NestingSetKey]
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute_StatementKey_MemberKey]
            ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [MemberKey]
            );
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute_StatementKey_NestingSetKey_MemberKey]
            ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute
            (
                [NestingSetKey],
                [MemberKey]
            );

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[NestingSetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [processed]
                    ON [candidate].[NestingSetKey] = [processed].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [processed].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [processed].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [processed].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute
                FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [processed]
                    ON [candidate].[NestingSetKey] = [processed].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [processed].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [processed].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [processed].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
            END

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute
                FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute AS [candidate]            
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [True],
                    [Iteration]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [candidate].[StatementKey],
                    [candidate].[MemberKey],
                    NULL,
                    @iteration
                FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyNewAttribute AS [candidate];
                
            END 
              
        END
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1.b.ii Cases where a value was previously assigned to the attribute 
 *          referred to by the statement.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/          
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
            ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [referenceToNestedSetMember]
            ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [referenceToNestedSetMember].[AttributeKey]
            AND [nestedSet].[ValueReference] = [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ValueReference]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nestingSet]
            ON [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [referenceToNestedSetMember].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsObjectKey;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [nestingSet].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
            [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ObjectKey] AS N'MemberKey',
            [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'MemberTypeKey',
            [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ValueReference] AS N'ValueReference',
            [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
            ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [referenceToNestedSetMember]
            ON [statement].[AttributeKey] = [referenceToNestedSetMember].[AttributeKey]
            AND [nestedSet].[ValueReference] = [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ValueReference]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nestingSet]
            ON [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [referenceToNestedSetMember].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
        ORDER BY
            [nestingSet].[SetKey],
            [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ObjectKey],
            [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [referenceToNestedSetMember].[ValueReference],
            [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40, @identifierAttributeKey = 0));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute_SetKey_MemberKey_MemberTypeKey_ValueReference_StatementKey]
        ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute
        (
            [SetKey],
            [MemberKey],
            [MemberTypeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [StatementKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute_StatementKey_MemberKey_MemberTypeKey_ValueReference]
        ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [MemberKey],
            [MemberTypeKey],
            [ValueReference]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute_StatementKey_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [obsoleteReference]
                ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [obsoleteReference].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberTypeKey] = [obsoleteReference].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [obsoleteReference].[AttributeKey]
                AND [candidate].[ValueReference] = [obsoleteReference].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [obsoleteReference].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [obsoleteReference].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [obsoleteReference]
                ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [obsoleteReference].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberTypeKey] = [obsoleteReference].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [obsoleteReference].[AttributeKey]
                AND [candidate].[ValueReference] = [obsoleteReference].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [obsoleteReference].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [obsoleteReference].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [processed]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [processed].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [processed].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [processed].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [processed].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [processed]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [processed].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [processed].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [processed].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [processed].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute AS [candidate]            
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[MemberKey],
                NULL,
                @iteration
            FROM #calculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitionsAnyAttribute AS [candidate];
            
        END
    END  

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Handle the special case of the membership of newly-created resources
 *      in nesting sets that are defined in terms of the sets to which
 *      the newly-created resources do NOT belong.  Such nesting sets have 
 *      filters like, /Set[ObjectID!=/Set[ObjectID='X']/ComputedMember].  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @creating = 1
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitions]
            @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
            @iteration                  = @iteration,
            @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
            @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
            @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
            @trace                      = @trace;    
	END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitions';
    END
END

--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @iteration                  INT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *      This procedure handles the special case of the membership of 
 *      newly-created resources in nesting sets that are defined in terms of the 
 *      sets to which the newly-created resources do NOT belong.  Such nesting 
 *      sets have filters like, /Set[ObjectID!=/Set[ObjectID='X']/ComputedMember].  
 *
 *      The code in the calling procedure handles the case of membership in a 
 *      nesting set being altered by a set transition that has been detected.  
 *      However, in the case of a newly-created resource, and a set with a filter 
 *      like, /Set[ObjectID!=/Set[ObjectID='X']/ComputedMember], if the newly-created
 *      resource is to belong to that set, then it is precisely because it will 
 *      NOT have transitioned into the set X.  
 *
 *      So, instead of finding statements of which the truth would be affected
 *      by transitions that HAVE BEEN detected, this case required identifying
 *      statements of which the truth is affected by transitions that MIGHT 
 *      HAVE happened, but did not.  
 *
 *      The truth of these statements can only be ascertained after 
 *      the initial set transitions have been determined.  So, this step is only
 *      taken after the initial iteration.  
 *
 *      For the initial iteration, the procedure is to identify the nesting 
 *      of sets that are not themselves nesting sets.  
 *      
 *      For subsequent iterations, the procedure is only to act when all other 
 *      set transitions have been determined.  Then, any negative nesting statements 
 *      that have no dependency on unevaluated statements are added.  If there are any 
 *      negative nesting statements that do depend on unevaluated statements, 
 *      then those unevaluated statements are added instead.  Since regular 
 *      positive nesting statements may depend on negative nesting statements, 
 *      subsequent iterations may ensue before, once again, all set transitions
 *      have been determined, and the thread returns to ask whether there are 
 *      negative nesting statements that remain to be evaluated.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @dependencyCount            INT,
        @index                      INT,
        @previousIndex              INT,
        @initialDependencyCount     INT,
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @anyTypeFlag        = -1;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END

    IF @iteration > 0                                                   --if #i
    AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [c].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [c]
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingAttribute') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingAttribute;
        END
        
        SELECT 
            [creatingAttribute].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
            [creatingAttribute].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
            [creatingAttribute].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingAttribute
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [creatingAttribute]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            ON [creatingAttribute].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
            AND [creatingAttribute].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [creatingAttribute].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [creatingAttribute].[ObjectKey] = [creatingAttribute].[ValueReference]
        ORDER BY 
            [creatingAttribute].[ObjectKey],
            [creatingAttribute].[AttributeKey],
            [creatingAttribute].[ObjectTypeKey];
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingAttribute]
        ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingAttribute
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        ); 
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.  Initial Iteration
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
        IF @iteration = 1                                               -- if #ii   
        BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1      Identify all nesting conditions that a creating resource could 
 *          satisfy.  
 *
 *          Let those conditions be referred to as '0.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/   
 
            IF EXISTS                                                   -- if #iii
            (
                SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [condition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                CROSS JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [newResource]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND
                        (
                                [condition].[ObjectTypeKey] = [newResource].[ObjectTypeKey]
                            OR  [condition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                        )            
            )
            BEGIN
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
                    [newResource].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
                INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition
                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [condition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                CROSS JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [newResource]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND
                        (
                                [condition].[ObjectTypeKey] = [newResource].[ObjectTypeKey]
                            OR  [condition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                        )
                ORDER BY 
                    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                    [newResource].[ObjectKey];
                        
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition]
                ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                );

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2      Identify the members of '0' that consist exclusively
 *          of negative nesting statements.  
 *
 *          Let those be referred to as '1.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/   
                IF EXISTS                                               -- if #iv
                (
                    SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition AS [condition]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                )
                BEGIN
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative;
                    END
                    
                    SELECT DISTINCT 
                        [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
                        [condition].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
                    INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative
                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition AS [condition]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                    ORDER BY 
                        [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                        [condition].[ObjectKey];
                            
                    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative
                    (
                        [MembershipConditionKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    );
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative AS [condition]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                            ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                            ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                        WHERE
                                [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                            AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE [condition]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative AS [condition]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                            ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                            ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                        WHERE
                                [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                            AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag;
                    END
                END                                                     -- if #iv

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3      Identify the members of '0' that do not solely consist of 
 *          negative statements, by excluding from '0' anything in '1'
 *
 *          Let the remainder be referred to as '2.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionPositive') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionPositive;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
                    [condition].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
                INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionPositive
                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition AS [condition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                    AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                ORDER BY 
                    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                    [condition].[ObjectKey];
                        
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionPositive]
                ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionPositive
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                );   
                
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionPositive AS [condition]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative AS [negativeCondition]
                            ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [negativeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            AND [condition].[ObjectKey] = [negativeCondition].[ObjectKey]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE FROM [negativeCondition]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionPositive AS [condition]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative AS [negativeCondition]
                            ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [negativeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            AND [condition].[ObjectKey] = [negativeCondition].[ObjectKey]
                    END
                END
                
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.4      Identify all nesting sets that a creating resource could 
 *          join.  Let those sets be referred to as '3.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet;
                END
                
                IF EXISTS                                               -- if #v
                (
                    SELECT [newResource].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition AS [newResource]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                        ON [newResource].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [set].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
                        [newResource].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
                    INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet
                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition AS [newResource]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                            ON [newResource].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    ORDER BY 
                        [set].[SetKey],
                        [newResource].[ObjectKey];
                                                
                    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet
                    (
                        [SetKey],
                        [ObjectKey]                        
                    );
                    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.5      Identify all the sets that are nested by statements of sets in '3.'  
 *          Let those sets be referred to as '4.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet;
                    END
                    
                    IF EXISTS                                           -- if #vi
                    (
                        SELECT [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
                        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                            ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statements].[StatementKey]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition AS [nestingCondition]
                            ON [statements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                            ON  [statements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet AS [nestingSet]
                            ON  [condition].[SetKey] = [nestingSet].[SetKey]
                        WHERE
                                [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet') IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet;
                        END
                        
                        SELECT DISTINCT 
                            [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] AS N'SetKey',
                            [nestingSet].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
                        INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet
                        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                            ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statements].[StatementKey]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition AS [nestingCondition]
                            ON [statements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                            ON  [statements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet AS [nestingSet]
                            ON  [condition].[SetKey] = [nestingSet].[SetKey]
                        WHERE
                                [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                        ORDER BY
                            [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey],
                            [nestingSet].[ObjectKey];
                            
                        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet]
                        ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet
                        (
                            [SetKey],
                            [ObjectKey]                        
                        );

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.6      Identify all of the nested sets that are not nesting sets, by 
 *          removing from '4' anything in '3.'  Let the result be 
 *          referred to as '5.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [nested].[SetKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nested]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet AS [nesting]
                                ON [nested].[SetKey] = [nesting].[SetKey]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM [nested]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nested]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet AS [nesting]
                                ON [nested].[SetKey] = [nesting].[SetKey];
                        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.7      Remove from '5,' any sets of which the new resource is actually a 
 *          member.  The the result is nested sets that are not themselves nesting
 *          sets, of which the new resource is not a member.  
 *
 *          Let the result be referred to as '6.'  Later, the table containing
 *          the members of '6' will be expanded to include any other sets of
 *          which the new resource could not possibly be a member.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                         
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [nested].[SetKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nested]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [membership]
                                ON  [nested].[SetKey] = [membership].[ObjectKey]
                                AND [membership].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                            WHERE
                                    [membership].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                AND [membership].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM [nested]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nested]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [membership]
                                ON  [nested].[SetKey] = [membership].[ObjectKey]
                                AND [membership].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                                AND [nested].[ObjectKey] = [membership].[ValueReference]
                            WHERE
                                    [membership].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                AND [membership].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
                        END


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.8      Define a number of working tables.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                       
                        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition') IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition;
                        END
                        
                        CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition
                        (
                            [MembershipConditionKey]    INT,
                            [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT
                        );
                        
                        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition]
                        ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition
                        (
                            [MembershipConditionKey],
                            [ObjectKey]                        
                        );
                        
                        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet') IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet;
                        END
                        
                        CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet
                        (
                            [SetKey]                    BIGINT,
                            [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT
                        );
                        
                        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet]
                        ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet
                        (
                            [SetKey],
                            [ObjectKey]                        
                        );
                        
                        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition') IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition;
                        END
                        
                        CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition
                        (
                            [MembershipConditionKey]    INT,
                            [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT
                        );
                        
                        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition]
                        ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition
                        (
                            [MembershipConditionKey],
                            [ObjectKey]                        
                        );
                        
                        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition') IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition;
                        END
                        
                        CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition
                        (
                            [MembershipConditionKey]    INT,
                            [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT
                        );
                        
                        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition]
                        ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition
                        (
                            [MembershipConditionKey],
                            [ObjectKey]                        
                        );
                        
                        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet') IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet;
                        END
                        
                        CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet
                        (
                            [SetKey]                    BIGINT,
                            [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT
                        );
                        
                        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet]
                        ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet
                        (
                            [SetKey],
                            [ObjectKey]                        
                        );

                        WHILE 1 = 1                                     -- while #i
                        BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.9      Identify any positive statement of a nesting condition in 0 
 *          that refers to a nested set in 6.  These are nesting conditions 
 *          that are certainly false.  
 *          Let the result be referred to as '7.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition AS [buffer]
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition;
                            END

                            IF EXISTS                                   -- if #vii
                            (
                                SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition AS [condition]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                    ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nestedSet]
                                    ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[SetKey]
                                WHERE
                                        [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                            )
                            BEGIN

                                INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition
                                (
                                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                                    [ObjectKey]
                                )
                                SELECT DISTINCT
                                    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                                    [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingCondition AS [condition]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                    ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nestedSet]
                                    ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[SetKey]
                                WHERE
                                        [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                ORDER BY
