                                    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                                    [nestedSet].[ObjectKey];

                                IF EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition AS [buffer]
                                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition AS [nestingCondition]
                                        ON  [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                        AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [nestingCondition].[ObjectKey]
                                )   
                                BEGIN
                                    DELETE FROM [buffer]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition AS [buffer]
                                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition AS [nestingCondition]
                                        ON  [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nestingCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                        AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [nestingCondition].[ObjectKey];
                                END  

                                IF EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition AS [buffer]
                                )  
                                BEGIN
                                    INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition
                                    (
                                        [MembershipConditionKey],
                                        [ObjectKey]                                        
                                    )
                                    SELECT
                                        [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey],
                                        [buffer].[ObjectKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferCondition AS [buffer];
                                END 
                                ELSE
                                BEGIN
                                    BREAK;
                                END                        
                            END                                         -- if #vii

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.10     Identify any nesting condition in 0 that is not in 7, nor in 
 *          1.  Those are nesting conditions that may still be true.  If any 
 *          non-nesting condition was true, then the resource would already
 *          have been made a member of the set, on iteration 0.   
 *
 *          Let the result of this step be referred to as '8.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT [notFalse].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition AS [notFalse]
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition;
                            END
                            
                            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition
                            (
                                [MembershipConditionKey],
                                [ObjectKey]
                            )
                            SELECT
                                [nestingCondition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                                [nestingCondition].[ObjectKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionPositive AS [nestingCondition];
                            
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT [notFalse].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition AS [notFalse]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition AS [false]
                                    ON  [notFalse].[MembershipConditionKey] = [false].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                    AND [notFalse].[ObjectKey] = [false].[ObjectKey]
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                DELETE FROM [notFalse]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition AS [notFalse]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition AS [false]
                                    ON  [notFalse].[MembershipConditionKey] = [false].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                    AND [notFalse].[ObjectKey] = [false].[ObjectKey];
                            END

                            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative') IS NOT NULL
                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition
                                (
                                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                                    [ObjectKey]
                                )
                                SELECT
                                    [allNegativeNestingCondition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                                    [allNegativeNestingCondition].[ObjectKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingConditionNegative AS [allNegativeNestingCondition];
                            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.11     Identify anything in 3 that has a condition in 8.  The result
 *          is nesting sets that the new resource might still join.   
 *          Let that result be referred to as '9.'
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                        
                            IF EXISTS                                   -- if #viii
                            (
                                SELECT [notFalse].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition AS [notFalse]
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                IF EXISTS                               -- if #ix 
                                (
                                    SELECT [nestingSet].[SetKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet AS [nestingSet]
                                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [conditions]
                                        ON [nestingSet].[SetKey] = [conditions].[SetKey]
                                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition AS [notFalse]
                                        ON  [conditions].[MembershipConditionKey] = [notFalse].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                        AND [nestingSet].[ObjectKey] = [notFalse].[ObjectKey]
                                )
                                BEGIN
                                    IF EXISTS
                                    (
                                        SELECT [buffer].[SetKey]
                                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                    )
                                    BEGIN
                                        DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet;
                                    END
                                    
                                    INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet
                                    (
                                         [SetKey],
                                         [ObjectKey]                            
                                    )
                                    SELECT DISTINCT
                                        [nestingSet].[SetKey],
                                        [nestingSet].[ObjectKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet AS [nestingSet]
                                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [conditions]
                                        ON [nestingSet].[SetKey] = [conditions].[SetKey]
                                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNotFalseCondition AS [notFalse]
                                        ON  [conditions].[MembershipConditionKey] = [notFalse].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                        AND [nestingSet].[ObjectKey] = [notFalse].[ObjectKey]
                                        
                                    IF EXISTS
                                    (
                                        SELECT [buffer].[SetKey]
                                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet AS [potential]
                                            ON  [buffer].[SetKey] = [potential].[SetKey]
                                            AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [potential].[ObjectKey]
                                    )
                                    BEGIN
                                        DELETE [buffer]
                                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet AS [potential]
                                            ON  [buffer].[SetKey] = [potential].[SetKey]
                                            AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [potential].[ObjectKey]
                                    END
                                    
                                    IF EXISTS
                                    (
                                        SELECT [buffer].[SetKey]
                                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                    )
                                    BEGIN
                                        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet
                                        (
                                            [SetKey],
                                            [ObjectKey]                                
                                        )
                                        SELECT
                                            [bufferSet].[SetKey],
                                            [bufferSet].[ObjectKey]
                                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [bufferSet]
                                    END
                                    
                                END                                     -- if #ix
                                
                            END                                         -- if #viii
                            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.12     Add to 6 anything in 3 that has a condition in 7 that 
 *          is not in 9.  These are additional sets to which the new resource 
 *          certainly does not belong.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                             
                            IF EXISTS                                   -- if #x
                            (
                                SELECT [nestingSet].[SetKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet AS [nestingSet]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                                    ON [nestingSet].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition AS [falseCondition]
                                    ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                    AND [nestingSet].[ObjectKey] = [falseCondition].[ObjectKey]
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                IF EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT [buffer].[SetKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                )
                                BEGIN
                                    DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet;
                                END
                            
                                INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet
                                (
                                    [SetKey],
                                    [ObjectKey]                                
                                )
                                SELECT DISTINCT
                                    [nestingSet].[SetKey],
                                    [nestingSet].[ObjectKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNestingSet AS [nestingSet]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                                    ON [nestingSet].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsFalseCondition AS [falseCondition]
                                    ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                    AND [nestingSet].[ObjectKey] = [falseCondition].[ObjectKey]
                                
                                IF EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT [buffer].[SetKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet AS [potentialSet]
                                        ON  [buffer].[SetKey] = [potentialSet].[SetKey]
                                        AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [potentialSet].[ObjectKey]
                                )
                                BEGIN
                                    DELETE FROM [buffer]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsPotentialSet AS [potentialSet]
                                        ON  [buffer].[SetKey] = [potentialSet].[SetKey]
                                        AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [potentialSet].[ObjectKey]
                                END
                                
                                IF EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT [buffer].[SetKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nonMember]
                                        ON  [buffer].[SetKey] = [nonMember].[SetKey]
                                        AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [nonMember].[ObjectKey]
                                )
                                BEGIN
                                    DELETE FROM [buffer]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nonMember]
                                        ON  [buffer].[SetKey] = [nonMember].[SetKey]
                                        AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [nonMember].[ObjectKey]
                                END
                                
                                IF EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT [buffer].[SetKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer]
                                )
                                BEGIN
                                    INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet
                                    (
                                        [SetKey],
                                        [ObjectKey]
                                    )
                                    SELECT 
                                        [buffer].[SetKey],
                                        [buffer].[ObjectKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsBufferSet AS [buffer];
                                    
                                END                                
                                
                            END                                         -- if #x
                            
                        END                                             -- while #i  

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.13     Submit any negative nesting statements that refer to sets in 6
 *          for evaluation.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         
                        IF EXISTS                                       -- if #xi
                        (
                            SELECT [nonMember].[SetKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nonMember]
                        ) 
                        BEGIN
                            IF EXISTS                                   -- if #xii
                            (
                                SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
                                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                                    ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedType]
                                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedType].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nonMember]
                                    ON  [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nonMember].[SetKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                                    ON [nonMember].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                                WHERE
                                        [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                                    AND 
                                        (   
                                                [acceptedType].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                            OR  [acceptedType].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                                        )
                            )
                            BEGIN                                       
                                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase') IS NOT NULL
                                BEGIN
                                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase;
                                END
                                
                                SELECT DISTINCT
                                    [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                                    [nonMember].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
                                INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase
                                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                                    ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedType]
                                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedType].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsNonMemberSet AS [nonMember]
                                    ON  [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nonMember].[SetKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                                    ON [nonMember].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                                WHERE
                                        [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                                    AND 
                                        (   
                                                [acceptedType].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                            OR  [acceptedType].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                                        )
                                ORDER BY
                                    [statement].[StatementKey],
                                    [nonMember].[ObjectKey]
                                    
                                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase]
                                ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase
                                (
                                    [StatementKey],
                                    [ObjectKey]
                                ); 

                                IF EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase AS [candidate]
                                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                                        ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                                    WHERE
                                            [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                )
                                BEGIN
                                    DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase AS [candidate]
                                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                                        ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                                    WHERE
                                            [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                                END
                                
                                IF EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase AS [candidate]
                                )
                                BEGIN

                                    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                                    (
                                        [RequestKey],
                                        [StatementKey],
                                        [ObjectKey],
                                        [True],
                                        [Iteration]
                                    )
                                    SELECT DISTINCT
                                        @requestKey,
                                        [candidate].[StatementKey],
                                        [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                                        NULL,
                                        @iteration
                                    FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsCreatingBase AS [candidate];

                                END
                            END                                         -- if #xii
                            
                        END                                             -- if #xi
     
                    END                                                 -- if #vi                    
                                      
                END                                                     -- if #v                    
                                
            END                                                         -- if #iii
            
        END                                                             -- if #ii
        ELSE                                                            -- if #ii
        BEGIN                                                           -- if #iii
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.  Subsequent iterations
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.1  Determine if this would be the last iteration if there are no 
 *      negative nesting statements to be evaluated.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            IF NOT EXISTS                                               -- if #xiii
		    (
                SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                WHERE
		                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
		            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
		    )
		    BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.2  Identify all of the negative nesting statements of membership conditions
 *      that the newly-created resources might join.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 		    
		        IF EXISTS                                               -- if #xiv
                (
                    SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
                    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [statements].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [condition]
                        ON [statements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    CROSS JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [newResource]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                        AND
                            (
                                    [condition].[ObjectTypeKey] = [newResource].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                OR  [condition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                            )            
                )
                BEGIN
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative;
                    END
                    
                    SELECT DISTINCT 
                        [statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                        [newResource].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                        [newResource].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
                    INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative
                    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [statements].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [condition]
                        ON [statements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    CROSS JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [newResource]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                        AND
                            (
                                    [condition].[ObjectTypeKey] = [newResource].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                OR  [condition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                            )   
                    ORDER BY 
                        [statement].[StatementKey],
                        [newResource].[ObjectKey],
                        [newResource].[ObjectTypeKey];
                            
                    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative
                    (
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [ObjectTypeKey]
                    );
                    
                    CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative_Type]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative
                    (
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectTypeKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    );

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.3  Remove any negative nesting statements that have already been evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                     
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [evaluated]
                            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [evaluated].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [evaluated].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [evaluated].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [evaluated].[True] IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE FROM [candidate]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [evaluated]
                            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [evaluated].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [evaluated].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [evaluated].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [evaluated].[True] IS NOT NULL;
                    END
                    
                    IF NOT EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [candidate]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        RETURN;
                    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4  Find all of the statements of which the truth must be known in order
 *      to evaluate the truth of the negative nesting statements.  
 *
 *      An explicit loop is safer than a recursive query in this case, because
 *      the possibility of circular nesting statements cannot be excluded.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4.a    Define some working tables.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                                         
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies;
                    END
                    
                    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies
                    (
                        [NegativeNestingStatementKey]   INT,
                        [ObjectKey]                     BIGINT,
                        [ObjectTypeKey]                 SMALLINT,
                        [DependentStatementKey]         INT,
                        [Index]                         INT
                    );
                    
                    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies
                    (
                        [NegativeNestingStatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [ObjectTypeKey],
                        [DependentStatementKey],
                        [Index]
                    );
                    
                    CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies_Type]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies
                    (
                        [DependentStatementKey],
                        [ObjectTypeKey],
                        [Index],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                    );
                    
                    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies_Object]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies
                    (
                        [DependentStatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    );
                    
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer;
                    END
                    
                    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer
                    (
                        [NegativeNestingStatementKey]   INT,
                        [ObjectKey]                     BIGINT,
                        [ObjectTypeKey]                 SMALLINT,
                        [DependentStatementKey]         INT
                    );
                    
                    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer
                    (
                        [NegativeNestingStatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [ObjectTypeKey],
                        [DependentStatementKey]
                    );
                    
                    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer_StatementKey]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer
                    (
                        [DependentStatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    );
                    
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated;
                    END
                    
                    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated
                    (
                        [DependentStatementKey]         INT,
                        [ObjectKey]                     BIGINT
                    );
                    
                    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated]
                    ON #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated
                    (
                        [DependentStatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    );
                    
                    SELECT
                        @index                  = 0,
                        @dependencyCount        = 0,
                        @initialDependencyCount = 0;
                        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4.b    Iteratively identify any statements that a given nesting statement
 *          depends upon.  Put those into the primary buffer.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                         
                    WHILE 1 = 1                                         -- while #ii
                    BEGIN

                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [buffer].[NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer
                        END

                        IF @index = 0
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer
                            (
                                [NegativeNestingStatementKey],
                                [ObjectKey],
                                [ObjectTypeKey],
                                [DependentStatementKey]
                            )
                            SELECT DISTINCT 
                                [base].[StatementKey],
                                [base].[ObjectKey],
                                [base].[ObjectTypeKey],
                                [statements].[StatementKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [base]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                ON [base].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
                                ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [setCondition].[SetKey]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [type]
                                ON [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [type].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                                ON [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            WHERE
                                    (
                                            [type].[ObjectTypeKey] = [base].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                        OR  [type].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                                    )

                        END
                        ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT @previousIndex = @index - 1;
    
                            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer
                            (
                                [NegativeNestingStatementKey],
                                [ObjectKey],
                                [ObjectTypeKey],
                                [DependentStatementKey]
                            )
                            SELECT DISTINCT 
                                [base].[NegativeNestingStatementKey],
                                [base].[ObjectKey],
                                [base].[ObjectTypeKey],
                                [statements].[StatementKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [base]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                ON [base].[DependentStatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
                                ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [setCondition].[SetKey]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [type]
                                ON [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [type].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                                ON [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            WHERE
                                        [base].[Index] = @previousIndex
                                    AND
                                    (
                                            [type].[ObjectTypeKey] = [base].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                        OR  [type].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                                    );
                        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4.c    If any of the statements in the primary buffer is a negative 
 *          nesting statement itself--a negative nesting statement upon which 
 *          the truth of another negative nesting statement depends, then 
 *          add that statement to the Unevaluated buffer.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                         
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [buffer].[DependentStatementKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                ON  [buffer].[DependentStatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                            WHERE
                                    [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                                AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT [unEvaluated].[DependentStatementKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated AS [unEvaluated]
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated;
                            END
                            
                            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated
                            (
                                [DependentStatementKey],
                                [ObjectKey]
                            )
                            SELECT DISTINCT
                                [buffer].[DependentStatementKey],
                                [buffer].[ObjectKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                ON  [buffer].[DependentStatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                            WHERE
                                    [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                                AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4.d    Remove any statements in the unevaluated buffer that have in fact
 *          already been evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                                                         
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT [candidate].[DependentStatementKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated AS [candidate]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [evaluated]
                                    ON  [candidate].[DependentStatementKey] = [evaluated].[StatementKey]
                                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [evaluated].[ObjectKey]
                                WHERE
                                        [evaluated].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                    AND [evaluated].[True] IS NOT NULL
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                DELETE FROM [candidate]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated AS [candidate]
                                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [evaluated]
                                    ON  [candidate].[DependentStatementKey] = [evaluated].[StatementKey]
                                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [evaluated].[ObjectKey]
                                WHERE
                                        [evaluated].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                    AND [evaluated].[True] IS NOT NULL
                            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4.e    If any negative nesting statements selected in steps C.2 depend
 *          on a statement in the unevaluated buffer, remove those statements.  
 *          Such statements are negative nesting statements that cannot be 
 *          evaluated yet.  What will happen is that the 
 *          negative nesting statement upon which the superordinate negative
 *          nesting statement depends will remain in the list selected in 
 *          C.2, and it will be evaluated, if it is ready to be ... or its 
 *          dependent statements will be evaluated. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                       
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT [primary].[StatementKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [primary]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                                    ON  [primary].[StatementKey] = [buffer].[NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                                    AND [primary].[ObjectKey] = [buffer].[ObjectKey]
                                    AND [primary].[ObjectTypeKey] = [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated AS [unEvaluated]
                                    ON  [buffer].[DependentStatementKey] = [unevaluated].[DependentStatementKey]
                                    AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [unevaluated].[ObjectKey]
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                DELETE FROM [primary]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [primary]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                                    ON  [primary].[StatementKey] = [buffer].[NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                                    AND [primary].[ObjectKey] = [buffer].[ObjectKey]
                                    AND [primary].[ObjectTypeKey] = [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated AS [unEvaluated]
                                    ON  [buffer].[DependentStatementKey] = [unevaluated].[DependentStatementKey]
                                    AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [unevaluated].[ObjectKey]
                            END
                            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4.f    Also eliminate from the primary buffer any record of the 
 *          statements on which the negative nesting statements eliminated in 
 *          the previous step depend on.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                              
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT [buffer].[DependentStatementKey]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated AS [unEvaluated]
                                    ON  [buffer].[DependentStatementKey] = [unevaluated].[DependentStatementKey]
                                    AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [unevaluated].[ObjectKey]
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                DELETE FROM [buffer]
                                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeUnEvaluated AS [unEvaluated]
                                    ON  [buffer].[DependentStatementKey] = [unevaluated].[DependentStatementKey]
                                    AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [unevaluated].[ObjectKey]
                            END
                        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4.g    Eliminate from the primary buffer any statements that are already 
 *          in the table of dependencies.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [buffer].[NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [dependencies]
                                ON  [buffer].[NegativeNestingStatementKey] = [dependencies].[NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                                AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [dependencies].[ObjectKey]
                                AND [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey] = [dependencies].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                AND [buffer].[DependentStatementKey] = [dependencies].[DependentStatementKey]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            DELETE FROM [buffer]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [dependencies]
                                ON  [buffer].[NegativeNestingStatementKey] = [dependencies].[NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                                AND [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [dependencies].[ObjectKey]
                                AND [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey] = [dependencies].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                AND [buffer].[DependentStatementKey] = [dependencies].[DependentStatementKey];
                        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4.h    Copy statements from the primary buffer into the table of 
 *          dependencies.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [buffer].[NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer]
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies
                            (
                                [NegativeNestingStatementKey],
                                [ObjectKey],
                                [ObjectTypeKey],
                                [DependentStatementKey],
                                [Index]
                            )
                            SELECT DISTINCT
                                [buffer].[NegativeNestingStatementKey],
                                [buffer].[ObjectKey],
                                [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey],
                                [buffer].[DependentStatementKey],
                                @index
                            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeBuffer AS [buffer];
                        END

                        SELECT @dependencyCount = COUNT([dependencies].[NegativeNestingStatementKey])
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [dependencies]

                        IF @initialDependencyCount >= @dependencyCount
                        BEGIN
                            BREAK;
                        END
                        
                        SELECT 
                            @initialDependencyCount = @dependencyCount,
                            @index = @index + 1;
                    END                                                 -- while #ii
                    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.5  Eliminate, from the list of dependent statements, any of which the
 *      the truth is already known.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                      
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[DependentStatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                            ON  [candidate].[DependentStatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [truth].[True] IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE [candidate]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                            ON  [candidate].[DependentStatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [truth].[True] IS NOT NULL
                    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.6  Eliminate, from the list of negative nesting statements, any of which the
 *      the truth of the dependent statements remains to be decided.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                      
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [dependent]
                            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [dependent].[NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [dependent].[ObjectKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [dependent].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE [candidate]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [dependent]
                            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [dependent].[NegativeNestingStatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [dependent].[ObjectKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [dependent].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    END
                    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.5  Eliminate, from the list of dependent statements, any that are already
 *      in the list of statements to be evaluated.  Add the remainder to that
 *      list.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                      
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[DependentStatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                            ON  [candidate].[DependentStatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE [candidate]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                            ON  [candidate].[DependentStatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    END
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[DependentStatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [candidate]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                        (
                            [RequestKey],
                            [StatementKey],
                            [ObjectKey],
                            [True],
                            [Iteration]
                        )
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            @requestKey,
                            [candidate].[DependentStatementKey],
                            [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                            NULL,
                            @iteration
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegativeDependencies AS [candidate];
                    END
                    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.6  Eliminate, from the list of negative nesting statements, any of which the
 *      the truth of the dependent statements remains to be decided.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                      
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE [candidate]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
                            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                        WHERE
                                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    END
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [candidate]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                        (
                            [RequestKey],
                            [StatementKey],
                            [ObjectKey],
                            [True],
                            [Iteration]
                        )
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            @requestKey,
                            [candidate].[StatementKey],
                            [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                            NULL,
                            @iteration
                        FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitionsRemainingNegative AS [candidate];
                    END
                    
                END
		    END                                                         -- if #xiv
        
                        
        END                                                             -- if #ii
        
    END                                                                 -- if #i

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestNewResourceNestedSetStatementTransitions';
    END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitions]
	@requestKey                 BIGINT,
	@creating                   BIT,
	@identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,

	@falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,

AS
BEGIN

	    @startTime				    DATETIME;	    
	    
	IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
	    SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @anyTypeFlag        = -1;
    		
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.	Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
	IF @requestKey IS NULL
	OR NOT EXISTS

		SELECT r.[RequestKey]
		FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
		WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;

    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    IF EXISTS

                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[ObjectKey],

            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsLiteralStatements AS [candidate];
        END
            
    END

                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [assigned].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [assigned].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [assigned].[RequestKey] = @requestKey

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    IF EXISTS

            AND [negativeDereferencingStatement].[StatementKey] IN

            AND [assigned].[Deleted] = @falseFlag

            AND [negativeDereferencingStatement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3.b    Exclude cases where the initialized attribute refers to a resource

            WHERE
                    [creating].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [creating].[Deleted] = @falseFlag

        BEGIN

            INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsValidReference
