                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [dereferencedObject]
                ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey]
                AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [creating]
                ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [creating].[AttributeKey]
                AND [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] = [creating].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [creating].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [creating].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            ORDER BY
                [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey],
                [dereferencedObject].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey],
                [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsValidReference_ObjectKey_ObjectTypeKey_AttributeKey_ValueReference]
            ON #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsValidReference
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference]
                
            );

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.3.b.ii Exclude, from among those references, any references that are
 *          made invalid by the current request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                                    
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsValidReference AS [dereferencedObject]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [obsolete]
                    ON [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey] = [obsolete].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[ObjectTypeKey] = [obsolete].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey] = [obsolete].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] = [obsolete].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [obsolete].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [obsolete].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsValidReference
                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsValidReference AS [dereferencedObject]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [obsolete]
                    ON [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey] = [obsolete].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[ObjectTypeKey] = [obsolete].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey] = [obsolete].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] = [obsolete].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [obsolete].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [obsolete].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
            END

        END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3.b.iii    Identify references that made valid by the current request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [dereferencedObject]
                ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey]
                AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [creating]
                ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [creating].[AttributeKey]
                AND [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] = [creating].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [dereferencedObject].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [dereferencedObject].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [creating].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [creating].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsNewValidReference') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsNewValidReference;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
                [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] AS N'ValueReference'
            INTO #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsNewValidReference
            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [dereferencedObject]
                ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey]
                AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [creating]
                ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [creating].[AttributeKey]
                AND [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] = [creating].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [dereferencedObject].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [dereferencedObject].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [creating].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [creating].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            ORDER BY
                [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey],
                [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey],
                [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsNewValidReference_ObjectKey_AttributeKey_ValueReference]
            ON #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsNewValidReference
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference]
            );
        END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3.b.iv Now exclude the valid references from the list of negative 
 *          statements about those references.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/   
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsValidReference') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsValidReference AS [dereferencedObject]
                    ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [creating]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [creating].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] = [creating].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [creating].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes
                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsValidReference AS [dereferencedObject]
                    ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [creating]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [creating].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] = [creating].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [creating].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
        END
        
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsNewValidReference') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsNewValidReference AS [dereferencedObject]
                    ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [creating]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [creating].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] = [creating].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [creating].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes
                FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsNewValidReference AS [dereferencedObject]
                    ON [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedObject].[AttributeKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [creating]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = [creating].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [dereferencedObject].[ValueReference] = [creating].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [creating].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
        END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3.c    Exclude statements that have already been identified.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                                
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes
            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3.d    Record the truth of the remaining statements. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                                
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                1,
                0
            FROM #calculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitionsInitializedAttributes AS [candidate];
        END
                
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
	    EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitions';
    END
END
GO

--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions]
	@requestKey                 BIGINT,
	@creating                   BIT,
	@deleting                   BIT,
	@modifying                  BIT,
	@computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
	@falseFlag					BIT			= NULL,
	@trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
	@trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE
	    @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
	    @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
	    @startTime				    DATETIME;	    
	    
	IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
	    SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @anyTypeFlag        = -1;
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.	Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
	IF @requestKey IS NULL
	OR NOT EXISTS
	(
		SELECT r.[RequestKey]
		FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
		WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
	
	EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
	
	IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember')
	END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.   For each set of which the resource is not a member, if a statement
 *      of a membership condition of that set is now true for the resource, 
 *      and no other statement of that membership condition is obviously 
 *      false, then identify all of the statements of that membership 
 *      condition.  If all of the statements of the membership condition are 
 *      true for the resource, then the resource will join the set.  
 *          
 *      If a resource is being deleted, then there is no possibility of 
 *      it joining a set, so this step can be ignored in this case.  If
 *      a resource is being created, then this step also does not apply, 
 *      for this step is to identify statements that might already be 
 *      true for the resource, and which might help it qualify for 
 *      membership in a set, but in the case of a newly-created resource, 
 *      no statements are already true.  Indeed, all the statements that
 *      pertain to the resource will already have been identified as 
 *      statements about which the truth is changing for the newly-created
 *      resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1  Identify resources for which membership condition statements are 
 *      becoming true, and of which other statements of those conditions 
 *      may be true.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
	IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions;
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
    (
		[SetKey]		BIGINT,
        [MemberKey]     BIGINT,
        [StatementKey]	INT
    );
    
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions_SetKey_MemberKey_StatementKey]
    ON #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
    (
        [SetKey],
        [MemberKey],
        [StatementKey]
    );
    
    
    IF EXISTS
	(
		SELECT TOP 1 [allStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [trueStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [allStatements]
            ON [trueStatement].[StatementKey] = [allStatements].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
            ON [allStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [resource]
            ON [trueStatement].[ResourceKey] = [resource].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [trueStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [trueStatement].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND
            (
                        [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                    OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = [resource].[ObjectTypeKey]
            )
    )
    BEGIN
		IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestPotentialConditions') IS NOT NULL
	    BEGIN
	        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestPotentialConditions;
	    END

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			[allStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
            [trueStatement].[ResourceKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
            [trueStatement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestPotentialConditions
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [trueStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [allStatements]
            ON [trueStatement].[StatementKey] = [allStatements].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
            ON [allStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [resource]
            ON [trueStatement].[ResourceKey] = [resource].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [trueStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [trueStatement].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND
            (
                        [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                    OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = [resource].[ObjectTypeKey]
            )
        ORDER BY
				[allStatements].[MembershipConditionKey],
				[trueStatement].[ResourceKey],
				[trueStatement].[StatementKey];
    
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestPotentialConditions]
        ON #calculateRequestPotentialConditions
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [StatementKey]
        );
        
        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
		(
			[SetKey],
			[MemberKey],
			[StatementKey]
		)
		SELECT DISTINCT
			[set].[SetKey],
			[condition].[ObjectKey],
			[condition].[StatementKey]
		FROM #calculateRequestPotentialConditions AS [condition]
		INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
			ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey];

        IF EXISTS
        (
			SELECT TOP 1 [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
			FROM #calculateRequestPotentialConditions AS [condition]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [trueStatement]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [trueStatement].[StatementKey]
				AND	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [trueStatement].[ResourceKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
				AND	[trueStatement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
			WHERE
					[statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
				AND	[statementDetail].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
			IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnown') IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				DROP TABLE #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnown;
			END
			
			SELECT DISTINCT
				[set].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
				[condition].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
				[statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
			INTO #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnown
			FROM #calculateRequestPotentialConditions AS [condition]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [trueStatement]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [trueStatement].[StatementKey]
				AND	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [trueStatement].[ResourceKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
				AND	[trueStatement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
			WHERE
					[statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
				AND	[statementDetail].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
			ORDER BY
					[set].[SetKey],
					[condition].[ObjectKey],
					[statement].[StatementKey];
				
			CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnown]
			ON #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnown
			(
				[SetKey],
				[ObjectKey],
				[StatementKey]
			);
			
			IF EXISTS
			(
				SELECT TOP 1 [condition].[SetKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnown AS [condition]
				INNER JOIN #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [set]
					ON	[condition].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
					AND	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [set].[MemberKey]
					AND	[condition].[StatementKey] = [set].[StatementKey]
			)
			BEGIN
				DELETE [condition]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnown AS [condition]
				INNER JOIN #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [set]
					ON	[condition].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
					AND	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [set].[MemberKey]
					AND	[condition].[StatementKey] = [set].[StatementKey];
			END
			
			IF EXISTS
			(
				SELECT TOP 1 [condition].[SetKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnown AS [condition]
			)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
				(
					[SetKey],
					[MemberKey],
					[StatementKey]
				)
				SELECT DISTINCT
					[condition].[SetKey],
					[condition].[ObjectKey],
					[condition].[StatementKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnown AS [condition];
			END		
        END


        IF EXISTS
        (
			SELECT TOP 1 [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
			FROM #calculateRequestPotentialConditions AS [condition]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negativeStatement]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatement].[NegativeStatementKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
				AND	[negativeStatement].[NegativeStatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
			WHERE
					[statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
				AND	[statementDetail].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
			IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative') IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				DROP TABLE #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative;
			END
			
			SELECT DISTINCT
				[set].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
				[condition].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
				[statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
			INTO #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative
			FROM #calculateRequestPotentialConditions AS [condition]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negativeStatement]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatement].[NegativeStatementKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
				AND	[negativeStatement].[NegativeStatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
			WHERE
					[statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
				AND	[statementDetail].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
			ORDER BY
					[set].[SetKey],
					[condition].[ObjectKey],
					[statement].[StatementKey];
				
			CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative]
			ON #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative
			(
				[SetKey],
				[ObjectKey],
				[StatementKey]
			);	
			
			IF EXISTS
			(
				SELECT TOP 1 [candidate].[StatementKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative AS [candidate]
				INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
					ON	[candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
				INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [true]
					ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey]
					AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ResourceKey]
			)
			BEGIN
				DELETE #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative AS [candidate]
				INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negative]
					ON	[candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
				INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [true]
					ON  [negative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey]
					AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ResourceKey];
			END	
			
			IF EXISTS
			(
				SELECT TOP 1 [condition].[SetKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative AS [condition]
				INNER JOIN #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [set]
					ON	[condition].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
					AND	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [set].[MemberKey]
					AND	[condition].[StatementKey] = [set].[StatementKey]
			)
			BEGIN
				DELETE [condition]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative AS [condition]
				INNER JOIN #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [set]
					ON	[condition].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
					AND	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [set].[MemberKey]
					AND	[condition].[StatementKey] = [set].[StatementKey];
			END
			
			IF EXISTS
			(
				SELECT TOP 1 [condition].[SetKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative AS [condition]
			)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
				(
					[SetKey],
					[MemberKey],
					[StatementKey]
				)
				SELECT DISTINCT
					[condition].[SetKey],
					[condition].[ObjectKey],
					[condition].[StatementKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueKnownNegative AS [condition];
			END			
        END


        IF EXISTS
        (
			SELECT TOP 1 [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
			FROM #calculateRequestPotentialConditions AS [condition]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [operation]
				ON	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [operation].[ObjectKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
			WHERE		[statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
			IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueUpdate') IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				DROP TABLE #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueUpdate;
			END
			
			SELECT DISTINCT
				[set].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
				[condition].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
				[statement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
			INTO #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueUpdate
			FROM #calculateRequestPotentialConditions AS [condition]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [operation]
				ON	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [operation].[ObjectKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
				ON	[condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
			INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
				ON	[statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
			WHERE		[statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
			ORDER BY
					[set].[SetKey],
					[condition].[ObjectKey],
					[statement].[StatementKey];
				
			CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestPotentiallyTrueUpdate]
			ON #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueUpdate
			(
				[SetKey],
				[ObjectKey],
				[StatementKey]
			);	
			
			IF EXISTS
			(
				SELECT TOP 1 [condition].[SetKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueUpdate AS [condition]
				INNER JOIN #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [set]
					ON	[condition].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
					AND	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [set].[MemberKey]
					AND	[condition].[StatementKey] = [set].[StatementKey]
			)
			BEGIN
				DELETE [condition]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueUpdate AS [condition]
				INNER JOIN #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [set]
					ON	[condition].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
					AND	[condition].[ObjectKey] = [set].[MemberKey]
					AND	[condition].[StatementKey] = [set].[StatementKey];
			END
			
			IF EXISTS
			(
				SELECT TOP 1 [condition].[SetKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueUpdate AS [condition]
			)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
				(
					[SetKey],
					[MemberKey],
					[StatementKey]
				)
				SELECT DISTINCT
					[condition].[SetKey],
					[condition].[ObjectKey],
					[condition].[StatementKey]
				FROM #calculateRequestPotentiallyTrueUpdate AS [condition];
			END			
        END
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2  Delete any cases where the potential member of a set is being deleted, 
 *      or the set that it might join is being deleted.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF @deleting = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
            FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MemberKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
            FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey];
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3  Delete any cases where the potential member of a set is already a 
 *      member of the set, or has already been identified as transitioning
 *      in or out of the set as a result of the current request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
            ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
        FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
            ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
    END 
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [set]
            ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [set].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
        FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [set]
            ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [set].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
    END 

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.4  Delete any cases where the statement that is to be evaluated in order
 *      to decide whether the resource should join the set, has already been
 *      identified as having to be evaluated for that resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
            ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions
        FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
            ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END 

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.5  Submit any remaining cases of statements to be evaluated for resources
 *      via the RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject table.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [True],
            [Iteration]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @requestKey,
            [candidate].[StatementKey],
            [candidate].[MemberKey],
            NULL,
            0
        FROM #calculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions AS [candidate]
		OPTION (LOOP JOIN);
    END
        

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
	    EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions';
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @deleting                   BIT,
    @modifying                  BIT,
    @explicitMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @filterAttributeKey         SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                    DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @anyTypeFlag        = -1;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
    
    IF @explicitMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember')
    END
    
    IF @filterAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @filterAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Filter')
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.   Any explicit member that is not being deleted, but is being removed 
 *      from a set that is not being deleted, must be evaluated to determine
 *      whether it should remain as a computed member of the set by virtue of
 *      matching one of the set's membership conditions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1  Identify any explicit members that are being removed from sets 
 *      that have membership conditions that the members might satisfy.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [set].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [set]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            ON [set].[ObjectKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
            ON [set].[ObjectKey] = [smc].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
             ON [smc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [smc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [set].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
            AND [set].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            AND
                (
                        [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                    OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] IN
                        (
                            SELECT [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
                            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [member]
                            WHERE
                                    [member].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
                        )
                )
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions;
        END
    
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [set].[ObjectKey] AS [SetKey],
            [set].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [SetTypeKey],
            [set].[ValueReference] AS [MemberKey],
            [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] AS [MembershipConditionKey],
            [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey]
        INTO #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [set]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
            ON [set].[ObjectKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
            ON [set].[ObjectKey] = [smc].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [acceptedTypes]
             ON [smc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [acceptedTypes].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON [smc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [set].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
            AND [set].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            AND
                (
                        [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
                    OR  [acceptedTypes].[ObjectTypeKey] IN
                        (
                            SELECT [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
                            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [member]
                            WHERE
                                    [member].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference]
                        )
                )
        ORDER BY
            [set].[ObjectKey],
            [set].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [set].[ValueReference],
            [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
                
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions]
        ON #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions
        (
            [SetKey],
            [SetTypeKey],
            [MemberKey],
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [StatementKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions
        (
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions_StatementKey_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions_SetKey_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions
        (
            [SetKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions_MembershipConditionKey_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2  Exclude explicit members that are being deleted.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        IF @deleting = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MemberKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions
                FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            END

        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3  Exclude cases where the filter of the set is being updated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                   
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [filterUpdate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [filterUpdate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [filterUpdate].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [filterUpdate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [filterUpdate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [filterUpdate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [filterUpdate].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@filterAttributeKey = 84));
        END        
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.4  Exclude cases that have already been identified.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.5  Exclude sets in different partitions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/      
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
                ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [partition].[True] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
                ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [partition].[True] = @falseFlag
        END
       
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[SetPartition] AS [set]
                ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                ON    [set].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [partition].[True] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[SetPartition] AS [set]
                ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN    [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [partition]
                ON    [set].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[MemberKey] = [partition].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [partition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [partition].[True] = @falseFlag
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.6  Finalize the remaining cases.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                     
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[MemberKey],
                NULL,
                0
            FROM #calculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions AS [candidate]
        END
        
    END
                             
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions';
    END
END

--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetJoinTransitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @iteration                  INT,
    @deleting                   BIT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                    DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @deleting = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
            @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting',
            @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.        A resource joins a set if the set is only restricted by partitions, 
 *           and the resource is included in the partitions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            ON    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
            ON    [partition].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [type]
            ON    [set].[SetKey] = [type].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [truth].[Iteration] = @iteration
            AND [truth].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND [condition].[StatementCount] = 0
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [set].[SetKey] AS [SetKey],
            [type].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [ObjectTypeKey],
            [truth].[ObjectKey] AS [MemberKey]
        INTO #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            ON    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
            ON    [partition].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [type]
            ON    [set].[SetKey] = [type].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [truth].[Iteration] = @iteration
            AND [truth].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND [condition].[StatementCount] = 0
        ORDER BY
                [set].[SetKey],
                [type].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [truth].[ObjectKey];
                
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions]
        ON #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions
        (
            [SetKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        ); 
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions_MemberKey]
        ON #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions
        (
            [SetKey],
            [MemberKey]
        ); 
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT  [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
                ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [partition].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                ON  [candidate].[MemberKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
                ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [partition].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                ON  [candidate].[MemberKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
        IF @deleting = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
           
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            END
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions AS [candidate] 
        )
        BEGIN
           INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[SetKey],
                [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey],
                @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                [candidate].[MemberKey],
                @falseFlag,
                @iteration
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitionsPartitions AS [candidate]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));;
        END        
        
    END                        
                        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.       A resource joins a set if it is not a member of that set, 
 *          and the number of statements of any membership condition of that
 *          set is equal to the number of statements that are true for that
 *          resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [object].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            ON [object].[ObjectKey] = [set].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            ON [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [request]
            ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [request].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [request].[TrueStatementCount] = [condition].[StatementCount]
            AND [request].[TrueStatementCount] > 0
    )    
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [object].[ObjectKey] AS [SetKey],
            [object].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [ObjectTypeKey],
            [request].[ObjectKey] AS [MemberKey]
        INTO #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions
        FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            ON [object].[ObjectKey] = [set].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            ON [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [request]
            ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [request].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [request].[TrueStatementCount] = [condition].[StatementCount]
            AND [request].[TrueStatementCount] > 0
        ORDER BY
            [object].[ObjectKey],
            [object].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [request].[ObjectKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetJoinTransitions]
        ON #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions
        (
            [SetKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        ); 

        IF @deleting = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
           
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting AS [deleting]
                    ON [candidate].[MemberKey] = [deleting].[ObjectKey]
            END
        END
       
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existingMember]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [existingMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE       [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existingMember]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [existingMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE       [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions AS [candidate] 
        )
        BEGIN
           INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[SetKey],
                [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey],
                @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                [candidate].[MemberKey],
                @falseFlag,
                @iteration
            FROM #calculateRequestSetJoinTransitions AS [candidate]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));;
        END
        
    END    
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetJoinTransitions';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
