--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @iteration                  INT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @explicitMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,    
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                    DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');
    END
    
    IF @explicitMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember');
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.        Create the working tables
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions;
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions
    (
        [SetKey]                    BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey]             SMALLINT,
        [MemberKey]                 BIGINT,
        [ExplicitMember]            BIT
    );
    
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions]
    ON #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions
    (
        [SetKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [MemberKey],
        [ExplicitMember]
    ); 
    
    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions_ExplicitMember]
    ON #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions
    (
        [ExplicitMember]
    ); 
    
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsPartition') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsPartition;
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsPartition
    (
        [SetKey]                    BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey]             SMALLINT,
        [MemberKey]                 BIGINT
    );
    
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsPartition]
    ON #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsPartition
    (
        [SetKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [MemberKey]
    ); 
    
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition;
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition
    (
        [SetKey]                    BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey]             SMALLINT,
        [MemberKey]                 BIGINT,
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT
    );
    
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition]
    ON #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition
    (
        [SetKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [MemberKey],
        [MembershipConditionKey]
    ); 
    
    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition_SetKey_MembershipConditionKey_MemberKey]
    ON #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition
    (
        [SetKey],
        [MembershipConditionKey],
        [MemberKey]
    ); 
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.        A resource leaves a set if it is a member of that set, 
 *            and is no longer in the same partition as the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT    [partition].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
        INNER JOIN    [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
            ON    [partition].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [set]
            ON    [partition].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [member]
            ON    [set].[ObjectKey] = [member].[ObjectKey]
            AND    [set].[ObjectTypeKey] = [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND    [truth].[ObjectKey] = [member].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND    [truth].[Iteration] = @iteration
            AND    [truth].[True] = @falseFlag
            AND    [member].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND    [member].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
    )    
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsPartition
        (
            [SetKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [set].[ObjectKey],
            [set].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [member].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
        INNER JOIN    [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [truth]
            ON    [partition].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [set]
            ON    [partition].[SetKey] = [set].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [member]
            ON    [set].[ObjectKey] = [member].[ObjectKey]
            AND    [set].[ObjectTypeKey] = [member].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND    [truth].[ObjectKey] = [member].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [truth].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND    [truth].[Iteration] = @iteration
            AND    [truth].[True] = @falseFlag
            AND    [member].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND    [member].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
        ORDER BY
            [set].[ObjectKey],
            [set].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [member].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
    END    
                        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.        A resource leaves a set if it is a member of that set, 
 *            and the number of statements of any membership condition of that
 *          set is greater than the number of statements that are true for that
 *          resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
            ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [smc].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
            ON [smc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [rmco]
            ON [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [computedMember]
            ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [rmco].[ObjectKey] = [computedMember].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [computedMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [rmco].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmco].[Iteration] = @iteration
            AND [rmco].[TrueStatementCount] < [mc].[StatementCount]
    )    
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition
        (
            [SetKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [MemberKey],
            [MembershipConditionKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [o].[ObjectKey],
            [o].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [rmco].[ObjectKey],
            [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
            ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [smc].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
            ON [smc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [rmco]
            ON [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [computedMember]
            ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [rmco].[ObjectKey] = [computedMember].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [computedMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [rmco].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmco].[Iteration] = @iteration
            AND [rmco].[TrueStatementCount] < [mc].[StatementCount]
        ORDER BY
            [o].[ObjectKey],
            [o].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [rmco].[ObjectKey],
            [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [sameSet]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [sameSet].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] != [sameSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [sameResource]
                ON [sameSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [sameResource].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [sameResource].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [alternativeCondition]
                ON [sameSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [alternativeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [sameResource].[MembershipConditionKey] = [alternativeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [sameResource].[TrueStatementCount] = [alternativeCondition].[StatementCount]
            WHERE
                    [sameResource].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [sameSet]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [sameSet].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] != [sameSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [sameResource]
                ON [sameSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [sameResource].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [sameResource].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [alternativeCondition]
                ON [sameSet].[MembershipConditionKey] = [alternativeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [sameResource].[MembershipConditionKey] = [alternativeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [sameResource].[TrueStatementCount] = [alternativeCondition].[StatementCount]
            WHERE
                    [sameResource].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        END
    END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.        Combine the transitions identified for the two cases.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsPartition AS [candidate]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions
        (
            [SetKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [MemberKey],
            [ExplicitMember]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [candidate].[SetKey],
            [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [candidate].[MemberKey],
            @falseFlag
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsPartition AS [candidate];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [duplicate]
            ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
            AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND    [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[MemberKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [duplicate]
            ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
            AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND    [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[MemberKey];
    END    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition AS [candidate]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions
        (
            [SetKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [MemberKey],
            [ExplicitMember]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [candidate].[SetKey],
            [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [candidate].[MemberKey],
            @falseFlag
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitionsCondition AS [candidate];
    END 
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.        Exclude explicit members that are not being removed as explicit
 *            members.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicitMember]
            ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [explicitMember].[ObjectKey]
            AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [explicitMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [explicitMember].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [explicitMember].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        UPDATE #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions
        SET [ExplicitMember] = @trueFlag
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicitMember]
            ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [explicitMember].[ObjectKey]
            AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [explicitMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [explicitMember].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [explicitMember].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [explicitMember].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [explicitMember]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [removedExplicitMember]
                ON [explicitMember].[SetKey] = [removedExplicitMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [explicitMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [removedExplicitMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [explicitMember].[MemberKey] = [removedExplicitMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [removedExplicitMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [removedExplicitMember].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                AND [removedExplicitMember].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                AND [explicitMember].[ExplicitMember] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN 
            UPDATE #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions
            SET [ExplicitMember] = @falseFlag
            FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [explicitMember]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [removedExplicitMember]
                ON [explicitMember].[SetKey] = [removedExplicitMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [explicitMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [removedExplicitMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [explicitMember].[MemberKey] = [removedExplicitMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [removedExplicitMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [removedExplicitMember].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                AND [removedExplicitMember].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                AND [explicitMember].[ExplicitMember] = @trueFlag
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [candidate]
            WHERE
                    [candidate].[ExplicitMember] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN 
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions
            FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [candidate]
            WHERE
                    [candidate].[ExplicitMember] = @trueFlag
            
        END         
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.        Exclude any cases where a transition into or out of the set has 
 *          already been identified.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
            ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
            ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [candidate] 
    )
    BEGIN
       INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [Deleted],
            [Iteration]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @requestKey,
            [candidate].[SetKey],
            [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey],
            @computedMemberAttributeKey,
            [candidate].[MemberKey],
            @trueFlag,
            @iteration
        FROM #calculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions AS [candidate];
    END

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestSetPartitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetPartitions]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @creating                   BIT         = NULL,
    @modifying                  BIT         = NULL,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @objectTypeAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @startTime                    DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    DECLARE @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate the state.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    If the operation is to delete objects, then those objects will only
 *        be leaving any partition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            

    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
     
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    For any object that is being created or modified, copy the partitioning
 *        statements into the statement evaluation table.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/          
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
        
    IF @creating = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [Iteration],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @requestKey,
            [partition].[StatementKey],
            [request].[ObjectKey],
            0,
            NULL
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
        CROSS JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [request];

        UPDATE [rmcso]
            SET [True] = @falseFlag
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN 
        (SELECT [request].[RequestKey], [request].ObjectKey, [statement].[StatementKey] 
         FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [request].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey] 
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [object]
                ON    [request].[ObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                AND   [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [object].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE   [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ) [request]
        ON  [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
            AND  [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [request].[RequestKey] IS NULL;

    END
    
    IF @modifying = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [Iteration],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @requestKey,
            [partition].[StatementKey],
            [request].[ObjectKey],
            0,
            NULL
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
        CROSS JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [request];
            
        UPDATE [rmcso]
            SET [True] = @falseFlag
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN 
        (SELECT [request].[RequestKey], [request].ObjectKey, [statement].[StatementKey] 
         FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [request].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [binding]
                ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [binding].[AttributeKey] 
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [object]
                ON    [request].[ObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                AND   [binding].[ObjectTypeKey] = [object].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE   [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ) [request]
        ON  [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
            AND  [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [request].[RequestKey] IS NULL;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.    Have the statements in the statement evaluation table evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statement]
        WHERE
                [statement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND    [statement].[Iteration] = 0
            AND    [statement].[True] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluation]
            @requestKey = @requestKey,
            @iteration = 0,
            @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
            @identifierAttributeKey = @identifierAttributeKey,
            @objectTypeAttributeKey = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
            @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
            @trace = @trace;
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetPartitions';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
