CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitions]
    @requestKey         BIGINT,
    @trace              BIT         = 0
AS
--Called from other stored procedures.
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @falseFlag                  BIT,
        @startTime                  DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;
        
    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    DECLARE 
        @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @creating                   BIT,
        @deleting                   BIT,
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @falseCount                 INT,
        @filterAttributeKey         SMALLINT,
        @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @index                      INT,
        @indexBuffer                INT,
        @initialFalseCount          INT,
        @modifying                  BIT,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    SELECT
        @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember'),
        @filterAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Filter'),
        @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
        
    SELECT
        @creating = @falseFlag,
        @deleting = @falseFlag,
        @modifying = @falseFlag;
        
    DECLARE @nestingSet                     TABLE
    (
        [NestedSetKey]                      BIGINT,
        [NestingSetKey]                     BIGINT,
        [SimultaneousTransition]            BIT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [NestedSetKey],
            [NestingSetKey],
            [SimultaneousTransition]
        )
    );    
    
    DECLARE @nestingSetCandidate    TABLE
    (
        [NestedSetKey]              BIGINT,
        [NestingSetKey]             BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [NestedSetKey],
            [NestingSetKey]
        )
    );    
    
    DECLARE @nestingStatement       TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey]              INT,
        [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey]
        )
    );    
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE 
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
        WHERE
                [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcst].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
        WHERE 
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        WHERE
                [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Identify resources that are being created, deleted and modified.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating;
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT
    );
    
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting;
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDeleting
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT
    );
    
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying;
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT
    );
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionTargets] 
        @requestKey = @requestKey,
        @trueFlag   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag  = @falseFlag,
        @creating   = @creating     OUTPUT,
        @deleting   = @deleting     OUTPUT,
        @modifying  = @modifying    OUTPUT,
        @trace      = @trace;
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Identify statements of which the truth will be altered by 
 *        the request.  
 *
 *      In so doing, identify any attributes that are being entirely 
 *      removed from objects.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute;
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute
    (
        [ObjectKey]             BIGINT,
        [AttributeKey]          SMALLINT
    );
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestLiteralSetTransitions] 
        @requestKey             = @requestKey,
        @creating               = @creating,
        @modifying              = @modifying,
        @identifierAttributeKey = @identifierAttributeKey,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
        @trueFlag               = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag              = @falseFlag,
        @trace                  = @trace;
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestDereferencedSetTransitions] 
        @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
        @creating                   = @creating,
        @deleting                   = @deleting,
        @modifying                  = @modifying,
        @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
        @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
        @trace                      = @trace;
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetPartitions]
        @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
        @creating                   = @creating,
        @modifying                  = @modifying,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
        @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey     = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
        @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
        @trace                      = @trace;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.        Automatic set transitions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestAutomaticSetTransitions]
        @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
        @creating                   = @creating,
        @deleting                   = @deleting,
        @modifying                  = @modifying,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
        @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey     = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
        @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
        @trace                      = @trace;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcst].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND
                (
                        [ro].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    OR  [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                )
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.   Identify the statements pertinent to calculated set transitions. 
 *
 *      If the statement is false, and the resource
 *      for which it is false is a member of the set, then that resource
 *      may leave the set.  
 *
 *      If the statement is true, and the resource for which it is
 *      becoming true is not a member of the set, then that resource may
 *      join the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1      For any resource that is not being created or deleted, for
 *          each set that is not being created or deleted
 *          of which a resource is a member, if a statement of a 
 *          membership condition of that set is now false, then identify all 
 *          of the statements of any other membership conditions of that set.  
 *          Only if all of the statements of one of those other membership 
 *          conditions is true, will the resource remain in the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestInitialAlternateConditionSetTransitions]
            @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
            @deleting                   = @deleting,
            @modifying                  = @modifying,
            @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
            @explicitMemberAttributeKey = @explicitMemberAttributeKey,
            @filterAttributeKey         = @filterAttributeKey,
            @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
            @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
            @trace                      = @trace;

 
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2      Any explicit member that is not being deleted, but is being removed 
 *          from a set that is not being deleted, must be evaluated to determine
 *          whether it should remain as a computed member of the set by virtue of
 *          matching one of the set's membership conditions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions]
            @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
            @deleting                   = @deleting,
            @modifying                  = @modifying,
            @explicitMemberAttributeKey = @explicitMemberAttributeKey,
            @filterAttributeKey         = @filterAttributeKey,
            @falseFlag                    = @falseFlag,
            @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
            @trace                      = @trace;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.3          For each set of which the resource is not a member, if a statement
 *              of a membership condition of that set is now true for the resource, 
 *              and no other statement of that membership condition is obviously 
 *              false, then identify all of the statements of that membership 
 *              condition.  If all of the statements of the membership condition are 
 *              true for the resource, then the resource will join the set.  
 *          
 *              If a resource is being deleted, then there is no possibility of 
 *              it joining a set, so this step can be ignored in this case.  If
 *              a resource is being created, then this step also does not apply, 
 *              for this step is to identify statements that might already be 
 *              true for the resource, and which might help it qualify for 
 *              membership in a set, but in the case of a newly-created resource, 
 *              no statements are already true.  Indeed, all the statements that
 *              pertain to the resource will already have been identified as 
 *              statements about which the truth is changing for the newly-created
 *              resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestPotentialJoinSetTransitions]
            @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
            @creating                   = @creating,
            @deleting                   = @deleting,
            @modifying                  = @modifying,
            @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
            @falseFlag                    = @falseFlag,
            @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
            @trace                      = @trace;
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.4          If a resource is being created, then add the statements 
 *              pertaining to that resource to the list of statements to be
 *              taken into consideration in calculating the set memberships 
 *              of that resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                 
        EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestNewResourceSetTransitions]
            @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
            @creating                   = @creating,
            @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
            @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
            @trace                      = @trace;  

        SELECT @index = 0;

        WHILE 1=1
        BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.5    Add the statements of the membership conditions of nesting sets
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
            EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitions]
                @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
                @iteration                  = @index,
                @creating                   = @creating,
                @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
                @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
                @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
                @trace                      = @trace;
 
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.    For any membership condition of which any statement is to be evaluated,
 *      have all of the statements of that membership condition evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
            EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements]
                @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
                @iteration                  = @index,
                @creating                   = @creating,
                @modifying                  = @modifying,
                @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
                @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
                @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
                @trace                      = @trace;
                
            IF @index > 0
            AND NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            )
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END

            SELECT 
                @falseCount         = NULL,
                @initialFalseCount  = NULL;
            
            WHILE 1 = 1
            BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.   For any resource that is not being created or deleted, for
 *      each set that is not being created or deleted
 *      of which a resource is a member, if a statement of a 
 *      membership condition of that set is now false, then identify all 
 *      of the statements of any other membership conditions of that set.  
 *      Only if all of the statements of one of those other membership 
 *      conditions is true, will the resource remain in the set.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
                EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestAlternateConditionSetTransitions]
                    @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
                    @creating                   = @creating,
                    @deleting                   = @deleting,
                    @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                    @explicitMemberAttributeKey = @explicitMemberAttributeKey,
                    @filterAttributeKey         = @filterAttributeKey,
                    @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
                    @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
                    @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
                    @trace                      = @trace;                     
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G.   Statement evaluation 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/       
                SELECT @initialFalseCount = COUNT([rmcso].[RequestKey])
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rmcso].[True] = @falseFlag;
                                    
                EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluation]
                    @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
                    @iteration                  = @index,
                    @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                    @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
                    @objectTypeAttributeKey     = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
                    @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
                    @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
                    @trace                      = @trace;
                    
                SELECT @falseCount = COUNT([rmcso].[RequestKey])
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rmcso].[True] = @falseFlag;
                    
                IF @initialFalseCount >= @falseCount
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * H.   Membership Condition Evaluation
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTranstionsMembershipConditionEvaluation]
                @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
                @iteration                  = @index,
                @modifying                  = @modifying,
                @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
                @objectTypeAttributeKey     = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
                @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
                @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
                @trace                      = @trace;
                        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * I.   A resource joins a set if it is not a member of that set, 
 *      and the number of statements of any membership condition of that
 *      set is equal to the number of statements that are true for that
 *      resource.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetJoinTransitions]
                @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
                @iteration                  = @index,
                @deleting                   = @deleting,
                @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
                @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
                @trace                      = @trace;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * J.   A resource leaves a set if it is a member of that set, 
 *      and the number of statements of any membership condition of that
 *      set is greater than the number of statements that are true for that
 *      resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetLeaveTransitions]
                @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
                @iteration                  = @index,
                @computedMemberAttributeKey = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                @explicitMemberAttributeKey = @explicitMemberAttributeKey,
                @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
                @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
                @trace                      = @trace;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * K.   If membership in Set A depends on membership in Set B, then a transition
 *      with respect to Set A cannot occur in the same iteration as a transition
 *      with respect to B.  
 *
 *      That Set A depends on membership in Set B is determined by an explicit
 *      iteration rather than by a recursive query so as to avoid the possibility
 *      of a perpetual loop due to circular dependencies.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
            SELECT @indexBuffer = @index + 1;
 
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [nesting].[NestedSetKey]
                FROM @nestingSet AS [nesting]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM @nestingSet;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [transition].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [transition].[ObjectKey] = [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nesting]
                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nesting].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE
                        [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [transition].[Iteration] = @index
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @nestingSet
                (
                    [NestedSetKey],
                    [NestingSetKey],
                    [SimultaneousTransition]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [transition].[ObjectKey],
                    [nesting].[SetKey],
                    @falseFlag
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [transition].[ObjectKey] = [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nesting]
                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nesting].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE
                        [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [transition].[Iteration] = @index

            END

            WHILE 1=1
            BEGIN
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[NestedSetKey]
                    FROM @nestingSetCandidate AS [candidate]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE FROM @nestingSetCandidate;
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [nesting].[SetKey]
                    FROM @nestingSet AS [base]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON  [base].[NestingSetKey] = [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                        ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nesting]
                        ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nesting].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            
                )
                BEGIN

                    INSERT INTO @nestingSetCandidate
                    (
                        [NestedSetKey],
                        [NestingSetKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [base].[NestedSetKey],
                        [nesting].[SetKey]
                    FROM @nestingSet AS [base]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON  [base].[NestingSetKey] = [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                        ON [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [nesting]
                        ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [nesting].[MembershipConditionKey]
                END
                    
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[NestedSetKey]
                    FROM @nestingSetCandidate AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                        ON  [candidate].[NestedSetKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey]
                        AND [candidate].[NestingSetKey] = [nesting].[NestedSetKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE FROM [candidate]
                    FROM @nestingSetCandidate AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                        ON  [candidate].[NestedSetKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey]
                        AND [candidate].[NestingSetKey] = [nesting].[NestedSetKey];
                END
            
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[NestedSetKey]
                    FROM @nestingSetCandidate AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                        ON  [candidate].[NestedSetKey] = [nesting].[NestedSetKey]
                        AND [candidate].[NestingSetKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE FROM [candidate]
                    FROM @nestingSetCandidate AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                        ON  [candidate].[NestedSetKey] = [nesting].[NestedSetKey]
                        AND [candidate].[NestingSetKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey];
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[NestedSetKey]
                    FROM @nestingSetCandidate AS [candidate]
                    
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @nestingSet
                    (
                        [NestedSetKey],
                        [NestingSetKey],
                        [SimultaneousTransition]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [candidate].[NestedSetKey],
                        [candidate].[NestingSetKey],
                        @falseFlag
                    FROM @nestingSetCandidate AS [candidate];
                END                
                
                IF NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[NestedSetKey]
                    FROM @nestingSetCandidate AS [candidate]
                )
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
                
            END 

            IF EXISTS 
            (
                SELECT [transition].[ObjectKey]
                FROM  [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
                INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                    ON [transition].[ObjectKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey]
                WHERE
                        [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [transition].[Iteration] = @index
            )  
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [statement].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statement]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                        ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
                        ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestingTransition]
                        ON  [setCondition].[SetKey] = [nestingTransition].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [statement].[RequestKey] = [nestingTransition].[RequestKey]
                        AND [statement].[Iteration] = [nestingTransition].[Iteration]
                    INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                        ON [nestingTransition].[ObjectKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
                        ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
                    WHERE
                            [nestingTransition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [nestingTransition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                        AND [nestingTransition].[Iteration] = @index
                        AND [statement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [statement].[Iteration] = @index                             
                        AND [statementDetail].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                        AND [statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL 
                )
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                    SET
                        [True] = NULL,
                        [Iteration] = @indexBuffer
                    FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statement]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                        ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
                        ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestingTransition]
                        ON  [setCondition].[SetKey] = [nestingTransition].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [statement].[RequestKey] = [nestingTransition].[RequestKey]
                        AND [statement].[Iteration] = [nestingTransition].[Iteration]
                    INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                        ON [nestingTransition].[ObjectKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
                        ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
                    WHERE
                            [nestingTransition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [nestingTransition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                        AND [nestingTransition].[Iteration] = @index
                        AND [statement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [statement].[Iteration] = @index
                        AND [statementDetail].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                        AND [statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL 
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * L.   If a transition of an object with respect to a set is disallowed
 *      because membership in that set depends on membership in another set, 
 *      then ensure that all statements about that dependency, for that object, 
 *      are to be evaluated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [condition].[StatementKey]
                    FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
                        ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestingTransition]
                        ON  [setCondition].[SetKey] = [nestingTransition].[ObjectKey]
                    INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                        ON [nestingTransition].[ObjectKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey]
                    WHERE
                            [nestingTransition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [nestingTransition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                        AND [nestingTransition].[Iteration] = @index       
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL               
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @nestingStatement
                    (
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [condition].[StatementKey],
                        [nestingTransition].[ValueReference]
                    FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
                        ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestingTransition]
                        ON  [setCondition].[SetKey] = [nestingTransition].[ObjectKey]
                    INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                        ON [nestingTransition].[ObjectKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey]
                    WHERE
                            [nestingTransition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [nestingTransition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                        AND [nestingTransition].[Iteration] = @index       
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL                 
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [nestingStatement].[StatementKey]
                        FROM @nestingStatement AS [nestingStatement]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToEvaluate]
                            ON  [nestingStatement].[StatementKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey]
                            AND [nestingStatement].[ObjectKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE FROM [nestingStatement]
                        FROM @nestingStatement AS [nestingStatement]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToEvaluate]
                            ON  [nestingStatement].[StatementKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey]
                            AND [nestingStatement].[ObjectKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey]
                    END
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [nestingStatement].[StatementKey]
                        FROM @nestingStatement AS [nestingStatement]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                        (
                            [RequestKey],
                            [StatementKey],
                            [ObjectKey],
                            [True],
                            [Iteration]
                        )
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            @requestKey,
                            [nestingStatement].[StatementKey],
                            [nestingStatement].[ObjectKey],
                            NULL,
                            @index
                        FROM @nestingStatement AS [nestingStatement];
                        
                        DELETE FROM @nestingStatement;
                    END
                END
                
            
                DELETE FROM [transition]
                FROM  [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
                INNER JOIN @nestingSet AS [nesting]
                    ON [transition].[ObjectKey] = [nesting].[NestingSetKey]
                WHERE
                        [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [transition].[Iteration] = @index
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                    
            END 
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * M.   Prepare to re-evaluate the truth of any nesting statements pertaining
 *      to sets of which the membership has just been altered.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey] 
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                    ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
                    ON [rmcso].[RequestKey] = [nestedSet].[RequestKey]
                    AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [nestedSet].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[Iteration] = @index
            )
            BEGIN
                UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                SET
                    [True] = NULL,
                    [Iteration] = @indexBuffer
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                    ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
                    ON [rmcso].[RequestKey] = [nestedSet].[RequestKey]
                    AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [nestedSet].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[Iteration] = @index
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40))
            END

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                    ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
                    ON [rmcso].[RequestKey] = [nestedSet].[RequestKey]
                    AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [nestedSet].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [mcs].[LiteralValueReference] = [nestedSet].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                    AND [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[Iteration] = @index                    
            )
            BEGIN
                UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                SET
                    [True] = NULL,
                    [Iteration] = @indexBuffer
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                    ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
                    ON [rmcso].[RequestKey] = [nestedSet].[RequestKey]
                    AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [nestedSet].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [mcs].[LiteralValueReference] = [nestedSet].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                    AND [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [nestedSet].[Iteration] = @index    
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40))
            END 
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [condition].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [condition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statement]
                    ON  [condition].[RequestKey] = [statement].[RequestKey]
                    AND [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    
                WHERE
                        [condition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statement].[True] IS NULL
                    AND [statement].[Iteration] = @indexBuffer
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM [condition]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [condition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                    ON [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statement]
                    ON  [condition].[RequestKey] = [statement].[RequestKey]
                    AND [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    
                WHERE
                        [condition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statement].[True] IS NULL
                    AND [statement].[Iteration] = @indexBuffer
            END

            SELECT @index = @indexBuffer;

        END
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetTransitions';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @iteration                  INT,
    @creating                   BIT,
    @modifying                  BIT,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    DECLARE @object TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]    BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
        
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    For any membership condition of which any statement is to be evaluated,
 *      have all of the statements of that membership condition evaluated.  
 *
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1    Only de-referencing statements will have been 
 *      added to the list of statements that have to be evaluated, without all
 *      of the other statements of the same membership condition having been 
 *      added as well.  So, for each membership condition of which any 
 *      de-referencing statement is to be  evaluated, for each resource for which
 *      the statement is to be evaluated identify the other statements of that 
 *      membership condition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [otherStatements].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
            [statementToBeEvaluated].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToBeEvaluated]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
            ON [statementToBeEvaluated].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipCondition]
            ON [statementToBeEvaluated].[StatementKey] = [membershipCondition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [otherStatements]
            ON [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [otherStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND [membershipCondition].[StatementKey] != [otherStatements].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [statementToBeEvaluated].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND (
                    [statementToBeEvaluated].[Iteration] = @iteration 
                    OR
                    [statementToBeEvaluated].[Iteration] = @iteration - 1
                )
            AND (
                    [statementToBeEvaluated].[True] = @trueFlag
                    OR
                    [statementToBeEvaluated].[True] IS NULL
                )
            AND [statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [otherStatements].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
            [statementToBeEvaluated].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToBeEvaluated]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
            ON [statementToBeEvaluated].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipCondition]
            ON [statementToBeEvaluated].[StatementKey] = [membershipCondition].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [otherStatements]
            ON [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [otherStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND [membershipCondition].[StatementKey] != [otherStatements].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [statementToBeEvaluated].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND (
                    [statementToBeEvaluated].[Iteration] = @iteration 
                    OR
                    [statementToBeEvaluated].[Iteration] = @iteration - 1
                )
            AND (
                    [statementToBeEvaluated].[True] = @trueFlag
                    OR
                    [statementToBeEvaluated].[True] IS NULL
                )
            AND [statementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            [otherStatements].[StatementKey],
            [statementToBeEvaluated].[ObjectKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements_StatementKey_ObjectKey]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey]
        );  
        
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2    Exclude cases where the resource is being created, and the statement
 *      is of the form ObjectID != /Set[ObjectID='x']/ComputedMember].  This
 *      special case is managed by the 
 *      CalculateRequestNestedSetStatementTransitions procedure.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/       
        IF @creating = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                    AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                    AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
            END
        END


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3    Exclude cases where the statement has already been identified as 
 *      having to be evaluated for a resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
         IF EXISTS
         (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
            ON 
                [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
         )
         BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
            ON 
                [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.4    Put the remaining cases into the list for re-evaluation.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
         (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements AS [candidate]
         )
         BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                NULL,
                @iteration
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements AS [candidate]		
            OPTION (LOOP JOIN);
            
        END 
         
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    For any objects for which a statement is being evaluated, if the 
 *        partitioning statements have not already been evaluated, add those
 *        statements to the list.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    
    IF @iteration > 0
    AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
    )
    AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statement]
        WHERE        [statement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @object
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT    [statement].[ObjectKey] AS [objectKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statement]
        WHERE        
                [statement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND    [statement].[Iteration] = @iteration - 1;
            
        IF @creating = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [object].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @object AS [object]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [duplicate]
                    ON    [object].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [object]
                FROM @object AS [object]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [duplicate]
                    ON    [object].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            END
        END
        
        IF @modifying = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [object].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @object AS [object]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [duplicate]
                    ON    [object].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [object]
                FROM @object AS [object]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [duplicate]
                    ON    [object].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            END
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [object].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @object AS [object]
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsPartition') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsPartition;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [partition].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
                [object].[ObjectKey] AS [objectKey]
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsPartition
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
            CROSS JOIN @object AS [object]
            ORDER BY
                    [partition].[StatementKey] ASC,
                    [object].[ObjectKey] ASC;
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsPartition]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsPartition
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            ); 
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                    ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                    ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                    AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey];
            END            
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsPartition AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [Iteration],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [partition].[StatementKey],
                    [partition].[ObjectKey],
                    @iteration,
                    NULL
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsPartition AS [partition];
                    
            END
        END
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.       If an existing object is changing partitions, then add the statements
 *          of any sets in the new partition to the list.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF
    (
            @modifying = @trueFlag
        AND @iteration = 0
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [target]
                ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [target].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[True] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [request].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
                [request].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey]
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [target]
                ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [target].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[True] = @trueFlag;
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            ); 
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1      The truth of a positive statement is changing to true if there is no 
 *          existing record of its truth in the truth table.  So delete 
 *          any positive partitioning statements for which a record of its truth 
 *          already exists. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE       [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                        
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE       [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2      The truth of a negative statement is changing to true if there is 
 *          a record of the truth of its positive counterpart in the truth table.  
 *          That is also the case for negative "not" statements, which may become
 *          true if a new value is set or an existing one is removed, but, either
 *          way, the "not" statement would only newly-become true if the positive
 *          counterpart had been true before.
 *
 *          So delete any negative partitioning statements for which a record of 
 *          the truth of their positive counterparts does not exist in the 
 *          the truth table.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE       [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                        
            )
            BEGIN
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionNegative') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionNegative;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [candidate].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey]
                INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionNegative
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE       [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag;
                    
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionNegative]
                ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionNegative
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                ); 
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT  [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionNegative AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [counterpart]
                        ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [counterpart].[NegativeStatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                        ON  [counterpart].[PositiveStatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE  [candidate]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionNegative AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [counterpart]
                        ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [counterpart].[NegativeStatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
                        ON  [counterpart].[PositiveStatementKey] = [truth].[StatementKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ResourceKey];
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT  [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionNegative AS [excluded]
                        ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [excluded].[StatementKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [excluded].[ObjectKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [candidate]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionNegative AS [excluded]
                        ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [excluded].[StatementKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [excluded].[ObjectKey]
                END
            END            
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    ON  [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionStatement') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionStatement;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [condition].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey]
                INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionStatement
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                    ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                    ON  [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey];
                    
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionStatement]
                ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionStatement
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                ); 
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT  [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionStatement AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                        ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [candidate]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionStatement AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
                        ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [duplicate].[StatementKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT  [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionStatement AS [candidate]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                    (
                        [RequestKey],
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [Iteration],
                        [True]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @requestKey,
                        [candidate].[StatementKey],
                        [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                        @iteration,
                        NULL
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatementsChangePartitionStatement AS [candidate]                    
                END
            END
        END
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetTransitionsAssembleStatements';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementEvaluation]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
