--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementEvaluation]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @iteration                  INT,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime				    DATETIME;	    
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.	Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.	Evaluate dereferencing statements.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.1.  A new reference to a new de-referenced attribute value.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN	
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                ON [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] as [dereferenced]
                ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferenced].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferenced].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ro].[ValueReference] = [dereferenced].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
                AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [dereferenced].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [dereferenced].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN	
            DECLARE @newToNew TABLE
            (
                [StatementKey]  INT,
                [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                [True]          BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
            );
            
            INSERT INTO @newToNew
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rmcso].[StatementKey],
                [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
                CASE
                    WHEN [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                ON [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] as [dereferenced]
                ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferenced].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferenced].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ro].[ValueReference] = [dereferenced].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
                AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [dereferenced].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [dereferenced].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
                
            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            SET
                [True] = [candidate].[True],
                [Iteration] = @iteration
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
            INNER JOIN @newToNew AS [candidate]
                ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2  A new reference to a an existing de-referenced attribute value.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN	
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [statementToEvaluate].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToEvaluate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetails]
                ON [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey] = [statementDetails].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [referencingResource]
                ON [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey] = [referencingResource].[ObjectKey]
                AND [statementDetails].[AttributeKey] = [referencingResource].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] as [dereferencedResource]
                ON [statementDetails].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedResource].[ObjectKey]
                AND [statementDetails].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedResource].[AttributeKey]
                AND [referencingResource].[ValueReference] = [dereferencedResource].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [statementToEvaluate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statementToEvaluate].[True] IS NULL
                AND [referencingResource].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [referencingResource].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )	
        BEGIN   
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [dereferencedResource].[ObjectKey] AS N'DereferencedObjectKey',
                [dereferencedResource].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'DereferencedObjectTypeKey',
                [dereferencedResource].[AttributeKey] AS N'DereferencedAttributeKey',
                [dereferencedResource].[ValueReference] AS N'DereferencedValue',
                [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToEvaluate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetails]
                ON [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey] = [statementDetails].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [referencingResource]
                ON [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey] = [referencingResource].[ObjectKey]
                AND [statementDetails].[AttributeKey] = [referencingResource].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] as [dereferencedResource]
                ON [statementDetails].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedResource].[ObjectKey]
                AND [statementDetails].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedResource].[AttributeKey]
                AND [referencingResource].[ValueReference] = [dereferencedResource].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [statementToEvaluate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statementToEvaluate].[True] IS NULL
                AND [referencingResource].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [referencingResource].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            ORDER BY
                [dereferencedResource].[ObjectKey],
                [dereferencedResource].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [dereferencedResource].[AttributeKey],
                [dereferencedResource].[ValueReference],
                [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey],
                [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting
            (
                [DereferencedObjectKey],
                [DereferencedObjectTypeKey],
                [DereferencedAttributeKey],
                [DereferencedValue],
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            ); 
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting_StatementKey_ObjectKey]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );  
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[DereferencedObjectKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [deleted]
                    ON [candidate].[DereferencedObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedAttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedValue] = [deleted].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [deleted]
                    ON [candidate].[DereferencedObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedAttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedValue] = [deleted].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToEvaluate]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [statementToEvaluate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statementToEvaluate].[True] IS NULL
            )
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @newToExisting TABLE
                (
                    [StatementKey]  INT,
                    [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                    [True]          BIT,
                    PRIMARY KEY
                    (
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                );

                INSERT INTO @newToExisting
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey],
                    [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag THEN @trueFlag
                        ELSE @falseFlag
                    END
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementNewToExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToEvaluate]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statementToEvaluate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statementToEvaluate].[True] IS NULL;
                    
                UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                SET
                    [True] = [candidate].[True],
                    [Iteration] = @iteration
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
                INNER JOIN @newToExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;                    
            END
        END    
    END 	                

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3  An existing reference to a new de-referenced attribute value.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	                		    			
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                ON [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ovr].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] as [dereferenced]
                ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferenced].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferenced].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ovr].[ValueReference] = [dereferenced].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
                AND [dereferenced].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [dereferenced].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )	
        BEGIN 		
            DECLARE @existingToNew TABLE
            (
                [StatementKey]      INT,
                [ObjectKey]         BIGINT,
                [ObjectTypeKey]     SMALLINT,
                [AttributeKey]      BIGINT,
                [ValueReference]    BIGINT,
                [True]              BIT
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [ObjectTypeKey],
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference]
                )
            );

            INSERT INTO @existingToNew
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rmcso].[StatementKey],
                [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
                [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [mcs].[AttributeKey],
                [ovr].[ValueReference],
                CASE
                    WHEN [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END	
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                ON [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ovr].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] as [dereferenced]
                ON [mcs].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferenced].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferenced].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ovr].[ValueReference] = [dereferenced].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
                AND [dereferenced].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [dereferenced].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM @existingToNew AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [deleted]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ValueReference] = [deleted].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM [candidate]
                FROM @existingToNew AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [deleted]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ValueReference] = [deleted].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM @existingToNew AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN  
                UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                SET
                    [True] = [candidate].[True],
                    [Iteration] = @iteration
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
                INNER JOIN @existingToNew AS [candidate]
                    ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.4  An existing reference to an existing de-referenced attribute value.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	                		    			
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN	
        -- Join RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject, MembershipConditionStatement and Referencing Object
        -- from ObjectValueReference into a temporary table that we can then join to ObjectValueReference to 
        -- get the referenced resources.  We do this in 2 steps to avoid joining ObjectValueReference to
        -- itself in a single query.
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [statementDetails].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] AS N'DereferencedValueObjectKey',
            [statementDetails].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] AS N'DereferencedValueAttributeKey',
            [referencingResource].[ValueReference] AS N'ValueReference',
            [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
            [referencingResource].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
            [referencingResource].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
            [referencingResource].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToEvaluate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetails]
            ON [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey] = [statementDetails].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [referencingResource]
            ON [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey] = [referencingResource].[ObjectKey]
            AND [statementDetails].[AttributeKey] = [referencingResource].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE
                [statementToEvaluate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [statementToEvaluate].[True] IS NULL
        ORDER BY
            [statementDetails].[DereferencedValueObjectKey],
            [statementDetails].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey],
            [referencingResource].[ValueReference],
            [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey],
            [referencingResource].[ObjectKey],
            [referencingResource].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [referencingResource].[AttributeKey];
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference
        (
            [DereferencedValueObjectKey],
            [DereferencedValueAttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        ); 
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference_Left]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference]
        ); 
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [reference].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference AS [reference]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
                ON  [reference].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [reference].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [reference].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                AND [reference].[ValueReference] = [request].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [reference]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference AS [reference]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
                ON  [reference].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [reference].[ObjectTypeKey] = [request].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [reference].[AttributeKey] = [request].[AttributeKey]
                AND [reference].[ValueReference] = [request].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [reference].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference AS [reference]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] as [dereferencedResource]
                ON [reference].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedResource].[ObjectKey]
                AND [reference].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedResource].[AttributeKey]
                AND [reference].[ValueReference] = [dereferencedResource].[ValueReference]
        )
        BEGIN   
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting;
            END

            -- Join ObjectValueReference to the temporary table containing the request and referencing object details
            -- We do this in 2 steps to avoid joining ObjectValueReference to itself in a single query.
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [dereferencedResource].[ObjectKey] AS N'DereferencedObjectKey',
                [dereferencedResource].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'DereferencedObjectTypeKey',
                [dereferencedResource].[AttributeKey] AS N'DereferencedAttributeKey',
                [dereferencedResource].[ValueReference] AS N'DereferencedValue',
                [reference].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
                [reference].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] as [dereferencedResource]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExistingReference AS [reference]
                ON [reference].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedResource].[ObjectKey]
                AND [reference].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] = [dereferencedResource].[AttributeKey]
                AND [reference].[ValueReference] = [dereferencedResource].[ValueReference]
            ORDER BY
                [dereferencedResource].[ObjectKey],
                [dereferencedResource].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [dereferencedResource].[AttributeKey],
                [dereferencedResource].[ValueReference],
                [reference].[StatementKey],
                [reference].[ObjectKey];  

                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting
            (
                [DereferencedObjectKey],
                [DereferencedObjectTypeKey],
                [DereferencedAttributeKey],
                [DereferencedValue],
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            ); 
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting_StatementKey_ObjectKey]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );  
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[DereferencedObjectKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [deleted]
                    ON [candidate].[DereferencedObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedAttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedValue] = [deleted].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [deleted]
                    ON [candidate].[DereferencedObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedAttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[DereferencedValue] = [deleted].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToEvaluate]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [statementToEvaluate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statementToEvaluate].[True] IS NULL
            )
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @existingToExisting TABLE
                (
                    [StatementKey]  INT,
                    [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                    [True]          BIT,
                    PRIMARY KEY
                    (
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                );

                INSERT INTO @existingToExisting
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey],
                    [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey],
                    CASE
                        WHEN [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag THEN @trueFlag
                        ELSE @falseFlag
                    END	
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementExistingToExisting AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementToEvaluate]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [statementToEvaluate].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    AND [statementToEvaluate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [statementToEvaluate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [statementToEvaluate].[True] IS NULL;

                UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                SET
                    [True] = [candidate].[True],
                    [Iteration] = @iteration
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
                INNER JOIN @existingToExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
        
        END    
    
    END 	                            

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementEvaluation';
    END
END
GO

--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsImmutableStatementEvaluation]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @iteration                  INT,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @objectTypeAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,    
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END
    
    IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Apply knowledge of the truth of tabular function statements about 
 *      ObjectID and ObjectType.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [true].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [true]
            ON    [candidate].[RequestKey] = [true].[RequestKey]
            AND    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey]
            AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ResourceKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            AND    [true].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                    [candidate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [candidate].[True] IS NULL
                AND    [true].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [true].[True] = @trueFlag
                AND    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
                AND
                    (
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        OR    [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                    )
    )
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [candidate]
            SET 
                [True] = @trueFlag,
                [Iteration] = @iteration
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [true]
            ON    [candidate].[RequestKey] = [true].[RequestKey]
            AND    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey]
            AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ResourceKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            AND    [true].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                    [candidate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [true].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [true].[True] = @trueFlag
                AND    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
                AND
                    (
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        OR    [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                    );
    END
 
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Apply knowledge of the truth of statements about 
 *      ObjectID and ObjectType.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [mcs].[LiteralValueReference]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @matchByIdentifier TABLE
        (
            [StatementKey]  INT,
            [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
            [True]          BIT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @matchByIdentifier
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rmcso].[StatementKey],
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
            CASE
                WHEN [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [mcs].[LiteralValueReference]
         WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
        
        UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
        SET
            [True] = [candidate].[True],
            [Iteration] = @iteration
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
        INNER JOIN @matchByIdentifier AS [candidate]
            ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
            AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
     END
     
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @noMatchByIdentifier TABLE
        (
            [StatementKey]  INT,
            [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
            [True]          BIT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @noMatchByIdentifier
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rmcso].[StatementKey],
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
            CASE
                WHEN [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
         WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
        
        UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
        SET
            [True] = [candidate].[True],
            [Iteration] = @iteration
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
        INNER JOIN @noMatchByIdentifier AS [candidate]
            ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
            AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [mcs].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @matchByObjectType TABLE
        (
            [StatementKey]  INT,
            [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
            [True]          BIT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @matchByObjectType
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rmcso].[StatementKey],
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
            CASE
                WHEN [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag THEN @trueFlag
                ELSE @falseFlag
            END
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [mcs].[ObjectTypeKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
        
        UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
        SET
            [True] = [candidate].[True],
            [Iteration] = @iteration
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
        INNER JOIN @matchByObjectType AS [candidate]
            ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
            AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
     END
     
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @noMatchByObjectType TABLE
        (
            [StatementKey]  INT,
            [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
            [True]          BIT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @noMatchByObjectType
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rmcso].[StatementKey],
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
            CASE
                WHEN [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
         WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
        
        UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
        SET
            [True] = [candidate].[True],
            [Iteration] = @iteration
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
        INNER JOIN @noMatchByObjectType AS [candidate]
            ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
            AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
    END
                    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetTransitionsImmutableStatementEvaluation';
    END
END

--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluation]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @iteration                  INT,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Deduce the truth of the remaining negative statements.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
                
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1    Generally, a negative statement is true if the inverse is not true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
 
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1.a    A negative statement is true if the inverse is not true, and the 
 *          statement is true regardless of whether the resource has a value
 *          for the attribute to which the statement refers.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                AND [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
                AND [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
        )    
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @negativeNoPositiveAttributeOptional TABLE
            (
                [StatementKey]  INT,
                [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                [True]          BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
            );
            
            INSERT INTO @negativeNoPositiveAttributeOptional
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rmcso].[StatementKey],
                [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
                @trueFlag
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                AND [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
                AND [mcs].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag;
                
            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            SET
                [True] = [candidate].[True],
                [Iteration] = @iteration
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
            INNER JOIN @negativeNoPositiveAttributeOptional AS [candidate]
                ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1.b    A negative statement is true if the inverse is not true, and the 
 *          resource is being assigned has a value for the attribute to which
 *          the statement refers.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1.c    A negative statement is true if the inverse is not true, and the 
 *          resource has a value for the attribute to which the statement 
 *          refers and that value is not being removed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                AND [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ov]
                ON [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
        )    
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ov].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
                [ov].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
                [ov].[ValueBoolean] AS N'Value',
                [rmcso].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                AND [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ov]
                ON [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            ORDER BY
                [ov].[ObjectKey],
                [ov].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ov].[AttributeKey],
                [ov].[ValueBoolean],
                [rmcso].[StatementKey];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [Value],
                [StatementKey]
            ); 
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean_StatementKey_ObjectKey]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );  
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [deleted]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [deleted].[ValueBoolean]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [deleted]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [deleted].[ValueBoolean]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean AS [candidate]
                    ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            )
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @negativeNoPositiveBooleanAttributePreExisting TABLE
                (
                    [StatementKey]  INT,
                    [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                    [True]          BIT,
                    PRIMARY KEY
                    (
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                );
            
                INSERT INTO @negativeNoPositiveBooleanAttributePreExisting
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [rmcso].[StatementKey],
                    [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationBoolean AS [candidate]
                    ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL;
                    
                UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                SET
                    [True] = [candidate].[True],
                    [Iteration] = @iteration
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
                INNER JOIN @negativeNoPositiveBooleanAttributePreExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;  
                        
            END
        END
        
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]

                [AttributeKey],
                [StatementKey]
            ); 
            
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationText_StatementKey_ObjectKey]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationText
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );  
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [deleted]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [deleted].[ValueText]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationText
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationText AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [deleted]
                    ON [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [deleted].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [deleted].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[Value] = [deleted].[ValueText]
                WHERE
                        [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationText AS [candidate]
                    ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            )
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @negativeNoPositiveTextAttributePreExisting TABLE
                (
                    [StatementKey]  INT,
                    [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                    [True]          BIT,
                    PRIMARY KEY
                    (
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                );
            
                INSERT INTO @negativeNoPositiveTextAttributePreExisting
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [True]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [rmcso].[StatementKey],
                    [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluationText AS [candidate]
                    ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL;
                    
                UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
                SET
                    [True] = [candidate].[True],
                    [Iteration] = @iteration
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
                INNER JOIN @negativeNoPositiveTextAttributePreExisting AS [candidate]
                    ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;  
            END
            
        END
        
    END   
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2    The remaining negative literal statements are false.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
        )    
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @negativeRemainder TABLE
            (
                [StatementKey]  INT,
                [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                [True]          BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
            );
        
            INSERT INTO @negativeRemainder
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rmcso].[StatementKey],
                [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
                @falseFlag
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL;
                
            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            SET
                [True] = [candidate].[True],
                [Iteration] = @iteration
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
            INNER JOIN @negativeRemainder AS [candidate]
                ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;  
        END
    END
                
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluation';
    END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluation]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,
    @iteration                  INT,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @objectTypeAttributeKey     SMALLINT    = NULL,	
    @trueFlag                   BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @anyTypeFlag                SMALLINT, 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime				    DATETIME;	    
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END
    
    IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTemporaryTableState]
        @tableName = N'#calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute',
        @shouldExist = @trueFlag;
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.   Statement evaluation 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.1  Apply knowledge of the truth of statements about 
 *      ObjectID and ObjectType.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsImmutableStatementEvaluation]
        @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
        @iteration                  = @iteration,
        @identifierAttributeKey     = @identifierAttributeKey,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey     = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
        @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
        @trace                      = @trace;
                    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2  Apply knowledge of the truth of statements altered by this request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
                ON  [rmcso].[RequestKey] = [rmcst].[RequestKey]
                AND [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [rmcst].[StatementKey]
                AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [rmcst].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN	
            DECLARE @alteredTrue TABLE
            (
                [StatementKey]  INT,
                [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                [True]          BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
            );
            
            INSERT INTO @alteredTrue
