                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rmcso].[StatementKey],
                [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
                [rmcst].[True]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
                ON  [rmcso].[RequestKey] = [rmcst].[RequestKey]
                AND [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [rmcst].[StatementKey]
                AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [rmcst].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL;
                
            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            SET
                [True] = [candidate].[True],
                [Iteration] = @iteration
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
            INNER JOIN @alteredTrue AS [candidate]
                ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [negativeStatement].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [negativeStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [negativeStatementDetail]
            ON [negativeStatement].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatementDetail].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [positiveToNegative]
            ON [negativeStatementDetail].[StatementKey] = [positiveToNegative].[NegativeStatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [positiveStatement]
            ON  [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = [positiveStatement].[RequestKey]
            AND [positiveToNegative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positiveStatement].[StatementKey]
            AND [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [positiveStatement].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [negativeStatement].[True] IS NULL
            AND [negativeStatementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
            AND [positiveStatement].[True] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne;
        END
        
        SELECT 
            [negativeStatement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
            [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
            [negativeStatementDetail].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
            [negativeStatementDetail].[MissingValue] AS N'MissingValue',
            CASE 
                WHEN [positiveStatement].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END AS N'True'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne       
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [negativeStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [negativeStatementDetail]
            ON [negativeStatement].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatementDetail].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [positiveToNegative]
            ON [negativeStatementDetail].[StatementKey] = [positiveToNegative].[NegativeStatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [positiveStatement]
            ON [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = [positiveStatement].[RequestKey]
            AND [positiveToNegative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positiveStatement].[StatementKey]
            AND [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [positiveStatement].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [negativeStatement].[True] IS NULL
            AND [negativeStatementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
            AND [positiveStatement].[True] IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY 
            [negativeStatement].[StatementKey],
            [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey],
            [negativeStatementDetail].[AttributeKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        );  
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne_ObjectAttribute]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [MissingValue]
        );  
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [negativeStatement].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne AS [negativeStatement]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute AS [removedAttribute]
                ON  [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey]
                AND [negativeStatement].[AttributeKey] = [removedAttribute].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [negativeStatement].[MissingValue] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [negativeStatement]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne AS [negativeStatement]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute AS [removedAttribute]
                ON  [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey]
                AND [negativeStatement].[AttributeKey] = [removedAttribute].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [negativeStatement].[MissingValue] = @falseFlag
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [negativeStatement].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne AS [negativeStatement]
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            SET
                [True]      =   [negativeStatementTruth].[True],
                [Iteration] =   @iteration
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [negativeStatement]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeOne AS [negativeStatementTruth]
                ON [negativeStatement].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
                AND [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [negativeStatementTruth].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;        
        END
        
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [negativeStatement].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [negativeStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [negativeStatementDetail]
            ON [negativeStatement].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatementDetail].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [positiveToNegative]
            ON [negativeStatementDetail].[StatementKey] = [positiveToNegative].[NegativeStatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positiveStatement]
            ON  [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = [positiveStatement].[RequestKey]
            AND [positiveToNegative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positiveStatement].[StatementKey]
            AND [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [positiveStatement].[ResourceKey]
        WHERE
                [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [negativeStatement].[True] IS NULL
            AND [negativeStatementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo;
        END
        
        SELECT 
            [negativeStatement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
            [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
            [negativeStatementDetail].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
            [negativeStatementDetail].[MissingValue] AS N'MissingValue',
            CASE 
                WHEN [positiveStatement].[True] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END AS N'True'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo       
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [negativeStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [negativeStatementDetail]
            ON [negativeStatement].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatementDetail].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [positiveToNegative]
            ON [negativeStatementDetail].[StatementKey] = [positiveToNegative].[NegativeStatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [positiveStatement]
            ON  [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = [positiveStatement].[RequestKey]
            AND [positiveToNegative].[PositiveStatementKey] = [positiveStatement].[StatementKey]
            AND [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [positiveStatement].[ResourceKey]
        WHERE
                [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [negativeStatement].[True] IS NULL
            AND [negativeStatementDetail].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
        ORDER BY 
            [negativeStatement].[StatementKey],
            [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey],
            [negativeStatementDetail].[AttributeKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        ); 
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo_ObjectAttribute]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [MissingValue]
        );  
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [negativeStatement].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo AS [negativeStatement]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute AS [removedAttribute]
                ON  [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey]
                AND [negativeStatement].[AttributeKey] = [removedAttribute].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE 
                    [negativeStatement].[MissingValue] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [negativeStatement]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo AS [negativeStatement]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsRemovedAttribute AS [removedAttribute]
                ON  [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [removedAttribute].[ObjectKey]
                AND [negativeStatement].[AttributeKey] = [removedAttribute].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE 
                    [negativeStatement].[MissingValue] = @falseFlag
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [negativeStatement].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo AS [negativeStatement]
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            SET
                [True]      =   [negativeStatementTruth].[True],
                [Iteration] =   @iteration
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [negativeStatement]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluationNegativeTwo AS [negativeStatementTruth]
                ON [negativeStatement].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatementTruth].[StatementKey]
                AND [negativeStatement].[ObjectKey] = [negativeStatementTruth].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [negativeStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;        
        END
        
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3	Apply knowledge of the truth of positive statements unaltered 
 *      by this request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN  
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
                ON  [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
                AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN	
            DECLARE @unalteredTrue TABLE
            (
                [StatementKey]  INT,
                [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                [True]          BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
            );
        
            INSERT INTO @unalteredTrue
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rmcso].[StatementKey],
                [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
                @trueFlag
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
                ON  [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
                AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL;
                
            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            SET
                [True] = [candidate].[True],
                [Iteration] = @iteration
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
            INNER JOIN @unalteredTrue AS [candidate]
                ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.4	Apply knowledge of the truth of negative statements unaltered 
 *      by this request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
                ON [mcns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
                AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN	
            DECLARE @unalteredNegative TABLE
            (
                [StatementKey]  INT,
                [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
                [True]          BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
            );
        
            INSERT INTO @unalteredNegative
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rmcso].[StatementKey],
                [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
                @falseFlag
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
                ON [mcns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
                AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL;

            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            SET
                [True] = [candidate].[True],
                [Iteration] = @iteration
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
            INNER JOIN @unalteredNegative AS [candidate]
                ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
                AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.5	Evaluate statements about particular resources being members of sets.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	            
    IF @iteration > 0
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
                ON [rmcso].[RequestKey] = [nestedSet].[RequestKey]
                AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [nestedSet].[AttributeKey]
                AND [mcs].[LiteralValueReference] = [nestedSet].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                AND [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            SET 
                [True] = 
                    CASE
                        WHEN [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag AND [nestedSet].[Deleted] = @falseFlag THEN @trueFlag
                        WHEN [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag AND [nestedSet].[Deleted] = @trueFlag THEN @trueFlag
                        ELSE @falseFlag
                    END,
                [Iteration] = @iteration
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [nestedSet]
                ON [rmcso].[RequestKey] = [nestedSet].[RequestKey]
                AND [rmcso].[ObjectKey] = [nestedSet].[ObjectKey]
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [nestedSet].[AttributeKey]
                AND [mcs].[LiteralValueReference] = [nestedSet].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                AND [nestedSet].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [nestedSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.6	Deduce the truth of the remaining negative statements.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsNegativeStatementEvaluation]
        @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
        @iteration                  = @iteration,
        @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
        @trace                      = @trace;     
                
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.7	Evaluate dereferencing statements.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitionsDereferencingStatementEvaluation]
        @requestKey                 = @requestKey,
        @iteration                  = @iteration,
        @trueFlag                   = @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag                  = @falseFlag,
        @trace                      = @trace;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.8	Decide the truth of the remaining statements.    
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	            

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.8.a	The remaining positive statements are false.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	            
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @remainingPositive TABLE
        (
            [StatementKey]  INT,
            [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
            [True]          BIT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @remainingPositive
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rmcso].[StatementKey],
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
            @falseFlag
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag;	
            
        UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
        SET
            [True] = [candidate].[True],
            [Iteration] = @iteration
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
        INNER JOIN @remainingPositive AS [candidate]
            ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
            AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.8.b	The remaining negative statements are true.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN 
        DECLARE @remainingNegative TABLE
        (
            [StatementKey]  INT,
            [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
            [True]          BIT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @remainingNegative
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [True]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rmcso].[StatementKey],
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey],
            @trueFlag
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] IS NULL
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag;	
            
        UPDATE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
        SET
            [True] = [candidate].[True],
            [Iteration] = @iteration
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [target]
        INNER JOIN @remainingNegative AS [candidate]
            ON  [target].[StatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
            AND [target].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [target].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;	
    END
                
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetTransitionsStatementEvaluation';
    END
END

        SELECT DISTINCT
            [m].[ObjectKey],
            [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
        FROM @modified AS [m]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [m].[ObjectKey]
        
        ORDER BY [m].[ObjectKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionModifying_ObjectKey]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionModifying_ObjectTypeKey_ObjectKey]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying
        (
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        )
        INCLUDE
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        );
    END
            
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetTransitionTargets';
    END
END
GO

 * B.1  Identify any membership conditions that must be evaluated for the

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsAffectedSet') IS NOT NULL

        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [affectedStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [affectedCondition]

        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [affectedSet]
            ON  [affectedCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [affectedSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE       [affectedStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        
        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsAffectedSet

            [SetKey]

        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [affectedStatement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [affectedCondition]

            ON  [affectedCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [affectedSet].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE       [affectedStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
                [affectedSet].[SetKey];
    END
                
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsAffectedSet]
    ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsAffectedSet

    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT  [affectedSet].[SetKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsAffectedSet AS [affectedSet]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]

        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]

    )

            [MembershipConditionKey]

            ON  [affectedSet].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
            ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
        ORDER BY
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey];
    END

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition]

    IF @iteration = 0
    BEGIN

            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
                ON  [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[Iteration] = 0
                AND [request].[True] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionPartition') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionPartition;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS [MembershipConditionKey]
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionPartition
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
                ON  [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[Iteration] = 0
                AND [request].[True] = @trueFlag
            ORDER BY
                    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey];
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionPartition]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionPartition
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            );
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [duplicate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [duplicate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionPartition AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey]
                )
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionPartition AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    END
    
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionFalse') IS NOT NULL

    (

        SELECT DISTINCT
            [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],

        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
            ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [partition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
            ON  [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]

                [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag
        ORDER BY
                [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [request].[ObjectKey]
    END

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionFalse]
    ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionFalse
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey],
        [ObjectKey]
    );

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.2  Count the number of statements that are true for the resource.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmco].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [rmco]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
            ON [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [rmco].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND 
                (
                        [rmco].[TrueStatementCount] < [mc].[StatementCount]
                    OR  @iteration = 0
                )
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [RequestMembershipConditionObject]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [rmco]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
            ON [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [rmco].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND 
                (
                        [rmco].[TrueStatementCount] < [mc].[StatementCount]
                    OR  @iteration = 0
                );
    END


    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache;
    END
    
    CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL,
        [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT NOT NULL,

        [Iteration]                 INT NOT NULL

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [existing].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [existing]
        WHERE       [existing].[RequestKey] = @requestKey

    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [TrueStatementCount],
            [Iteration]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [existing].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [existing].[ObjectKey],
            [existing].[TrueStatementCount],
            [existing].[Iteration]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [existing]
        WHERE       [existing].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
                [existing].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [existing].[ObjectKey];

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache]

        [MembershipConditionKey],
        [ObjectKey]
    );     
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.3  All the statements of membership conditions that consist solely
 *      of a statement about an object's type, will be true for newly-
 *      created resources of that type.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [creating].[ObjectTypeKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [type]
            ON  [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [type].[ObjectTypeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
            ON  [type].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            ON [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE        
                    [condition].[StatementCount] = 1
                AND [immutable].[ByObjectType] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew;
        END
    
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
            [creating].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [type]
            ON  [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [type].[ObjectTypeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute] AS [immutable]
            ON  [type].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            ON [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE        
                    [condition].[StatementCount] = 1
                AND [immutable].[ByObjectType] = @trueFlag
        ORDER BY
            [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [creating].[ObjectKey];

                
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ObjectKey]
        ); 
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionFalse AS [false]
                ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [false].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [false].[ObjectKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionFalse AS [false]
                ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [false].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [false].[ObjectKey]
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [TrueStatementCount],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                1,
                @iteration
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNew AS [candidate]

        END
    END
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.4  Conversely, if a membership condition merely excludes all objects of a type
 *      then all of the statements of that membership condition are true if the 
 *      object is not of the excluded types.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [creating].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
    ) AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [condition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
            ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [condition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType;
        END
    
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
            [statement].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ExcludedObjectTypeKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [conditionType]
            ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [conditionType].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
            ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [conditionType].[ObjectTypeKey] = @anyTypeFlag
            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
        ORDER BY
            [condition].[membershipConditionKey],
            [statement].[ObjectTypeKey]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
        
                
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ExcludedObjectTypeKey]
        );
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
                OR  [statement].[OperatorInversion] != @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
                OR  [statement].[OperatorInversion] != @trueFlag
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
                [creating].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType AS [condition]
            CROSS JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
            ORDER BY
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [creating].[ObjectKey];

            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            );
              
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType AS [excluded]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [excluded].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [excluded].[ExcludedObjectTypeKey]
            ) 
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsCreating AS [creating]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [creating].[ObjectKey]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotType AS [excluded]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [excluded].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [creating].[ObjectTypeKey] = [excluded].[ExcludedObjectTypeKey]
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionFalse AS [false]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [false].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [false].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionFalse AS [false]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [false].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [false].[ObjectKey]
            END            

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [duplicate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            )  
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [duplicate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey];
            END 

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [TrueStatementCount],
                    [Iteration]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [condition].[StatementCount],
                    @iteration
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsNotTypeObject AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipconditionKey];

            END
        END
    END    


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.5  Membership conditions solely about immutable attributes remain true for 
 *      modified objects that satisfy them.  For example, if a membership
 *      condition is satisfied by simply being of a particular type, then, 
 *      because types don't change, any modified resource of the type in 
 *      question, continues to satisfy the condition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [affectedStatement]
        WHERE       [affectedStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObject') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObject;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObject
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [affectedStatement]
        WHERE       [affectedStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey];

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObject]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObject
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        ); 
        
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectDetail') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectDetail;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [type].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
            [type].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectDetail
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObject AS [object]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [type]
            ON  [object].[ObjectKey] = [type].[ObjectKey]
        ORDER BY
            [type].[ObjectKey],
            [type].[ObjectTypeKey];

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectDetail]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectDetail
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        ); 
        
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectStatement') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectStatement;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
            [affectedStatement].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectStatement
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [affectedStatement]
        WHERE       [affectedStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey],
            [affectedStatement].[StatementKey];

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectStatement]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectStatement
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [StatementKey]
        ); 

        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet;
        END

        SELECT DISTINCT
            [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
            [set].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectStatement AS [affectedStatement]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectDetail AS [objectDetail]
            ON  [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey] = [objectDetail].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
            ON  [affectedStatement].[StatementKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            ON  [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition AS [immutableCondition]
                ON  [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutableCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        ORDER BY 
            [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey],
            [set].[SetKey];

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [SetKey]
        ); 
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectStatement AS [affectedStatement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                ON  [affectedStatement].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                ON  [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition AS [immutableCondition]
                ON  [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutableCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                ON  [affectedStatement].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
                AND [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[True] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSetPartition') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSetPartition;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
                [set].[SetKey] AS [SetKey]
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSetPartition
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectStatement AS [affectedStatement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                ON  [affectedStatement].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                ON  [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition AS [immutableCondition]
                ON  [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutableCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                ON  [affectedStatement].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
                AND [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [request].[True] = @trueFlag
            ORDER BY
                    [affectedStatement].[ObjectKey],
                    [set].[SetKey];
             
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSetPartition]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSetPartition
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [SetKey]
            ); 
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSetPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet AS [duplicate]
                    ON      [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND     [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSetPartition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet AS [duplicate]
                    ON      [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND     [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSetPartition AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet
                (
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [SetKey]
                )
                SELECT 
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSetPartition AS [candidate]
            END
        END
    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [source].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet AS [source]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectDetail AS [objectDetail]
                ON  [source].[ObjectKey] = [objectDetail].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                ON  [source].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition AS [immutableCondition]
                ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutableCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [conditionDetail]
                ON  [immutableCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [conditionDetail].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [conditionDetail].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
                ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    (
                            [statementDetail].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        AND [statementDetail].[LiteralValueReference] = [objectDetail].[ObjectKey]
                    )
                    OR  
                    (
                            [statementDetail].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                        AND [statementDetail].[ObjectTypeKey] = [objectDetail].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    )
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable;
            END
              
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [conditionDetail].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
                [source].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [conditionDetail].[StatementCount] AS N'StatementCount'
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectSet AS [source]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsObjectDetail AS [objectDetail]
                ON  [source].[ObjectKey] = [objectDetail].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                ON  [source].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition AS [immutableCondition]
                ON  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutableCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [conditionDetail]
                ON  [immutableCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [conditionDetail].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [conditionDetail].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statementDetail]
                ON  [statement].[StatementKey] = [statementDetail].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    (
                            [statementDetail].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        AND [statementDetail].[LiteralValueReference] = [objectDetail].[ObjectKey]
                    )
                    OR  
                    (
                            [statementDetail].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                        AND [statementDetail].[ObjectTypeKey] = [objectDetail].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    )
            ORDER BY
                [conditionDetail].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [source].[ObjectKey]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0, @objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));


            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            ); 

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [falseCondition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [conditionStatement]
                    ON  [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [conditionStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [conditionStatement].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                    ON  [falseCondition].[ObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        (
                                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                            AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                            AND
                                (
                                        (
                                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                            AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] != [object].[ObjectKey]
                                        )
                                    OR  (
                                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                            AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                    OR  (
                                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                            AND
                                (
                                        (
                                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                            AND [statement].[ObjectTypeKey] != [object].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                        )
                                    OR  (
                                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                            AND [statement].[ObjectTypeKey] = [object].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                        )
                                )
                        )
            )
            BEGIN 
                DELETE FROM [falseCondition]   
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [falseCondition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [conditionStatement]
                    ON  [falseCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [conditionStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [conditionStatement].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                    ON  [falseCondition].[ObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE
                        (
                                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                            AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                            AND
                                (
                                        (
                                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                            AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] != [object].[ObjectKey]
                                        )
                                    OR  (
                                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                            AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                    OR  (
                                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                            AND
                                (
                                        (
                                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                                            AND [statement].[ObjectTypeKey] != [object].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                        )
                                    OR  (
                                                [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                                            AND [statement].[ObjectTypeKey] = [object].[ObjectTypeKey]
                                        )
                                )
                        )
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionFalse AS [false]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [false].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [false].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableConditionFalse AS [false]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [false].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [false].[ObjectKey]
            END

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [duplicate]
                    ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [duplicate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN    
                DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [duplicate]
                    ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [duplicate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey];
            END
            

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                    COUNT([trueStatement].[StatementKey]) AS N'Count'
                INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableTruth
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [trueStatement]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [trueStatement].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [statement].[StatementKey] = [trueStatement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [trueStatement].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                GROUP BY 
                    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                ORDER BY 
                    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey];  
                    

                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableTruth]
                ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableTruth
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                );  

                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableTruth AS [truth]
                        ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [truth].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE
                            [candidate].[StatementCount] != [truth].[Count]
                )
                BEGIN    
                    DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableTruth AS [truth]
                        ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [truth].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [truth].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE
                            [candidate].[StatementCount] != [truth].[Count];
                END 
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [TrueStatementCount],
                    [Iteration]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[StatementCount],
                    @iteration
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutable AS [candidate]
                
            END
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.6  Count the true statements about attributes other than ObjectID and
 *      ObjectType.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                                
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[Iteration] = @iteration
            AND [rmcso].[True] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN

        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount;
        END
      
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
            COUNT([rmcso].[StatementKey]) AS N'Count'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
            ON    [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND (
                        (
                                [mcs].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
                            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
                        )
                    OR  [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
                    OR    [mcs].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
                )
        GROUP BY 
            [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey]
        ORDER BY 
            [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0, @objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
