        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ObjectKey]
        ); 

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey];

        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.7  Count the true statements about ObjectID and ObjectType for any
 *      membership condition of which other statements are true.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable;
            END    

            SELECT DISTINCT
                [count].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
                [count].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                [object].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
                [count].[Count] AS N'Count'
            INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount AS [count]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                ON  [count].[ObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey];
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable]
            ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey]
            ); 
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition AS [immutable]
                    ON  [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [count]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsImmutableCondition AS [immutable]
                    ON  [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [immutable].[MembershipConditionKey]
            END

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                    ON  [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE        [condition].[StatementCount] = 1    
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [count]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                    ON  [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE        [condition].[StatementCount] = 1;
            END

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
            )
            BEGIN
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget;
                END    
                
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [count].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
                    [count].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey'
                INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                ORDER BY
                        [count].[ObjectKey],
                        [count].[ObjectTypeKey];
                
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget]
                ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget
                (
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [ObjectTypeKey]
                ); 
                
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey;
                END    
                
                CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey
                (
                    [ObjectKey]        BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    [StatementKey]    INT NOT NULL
                );
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [target].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget AS [target]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON [target].[ObjectKey] = [statement].[LiteralValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey
                    (
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [StatementKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [target].[ObjectKey],
                        [statement].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget AS [target]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON [target].[ObjectKey] = [statement].[LiteralValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                    ORDER BY
                            [target].[ObjectKey],
                            [statement].[StatementKey]
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
                END
                
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey]
                ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey
                (
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [StatementKey]
                );
                
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey;
                END                                          
                
                CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey
                (
                    [ObjectKey]        BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    [StatementKey]    INT NOT NULL
                );
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [target].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget AS [target]
                    CROSS JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                        AND    [target].[ObjectKey] != [statement].[LiteralValueReference]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey
                    (
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [StatementKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [target].[ObjectKey],
                        [statement].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget AS [target]
                    CROSS JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                        AND    [target].[ObjectKey] != [statement].[LiteralValueReference]
                    ORDER BY
                            [target].[ObjectKey],
                            [statement].[StatementKey]
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
                END
                
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey]
                ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey
                (
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [StatementKey]
                );

                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType;
                END    
                
                CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType
                (
                    [ObjectKey]        BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    [StatementKey]    INT NOT NULL
                );
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [target].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget AS [target]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON [target].[ObjectTypeKey] = [statement].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType
                    (
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [StatementKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [target].[ObjectKey],
                        [statement].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget AS [target]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON [target].[ObjectTypeKey] = [statement].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                    ORDER BY
                            [target].[ObjectKey],
                            [statement].[StatementKey]
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
                END
                
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType]
                ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType
                (
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [StatementKey]
                );

                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType;
                END
                                           
                CREATE TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType
                (
                    [ObjectKey]        BIGINT NOT NULL,
                    [StatementKey]    INT NOT NULL
                );
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [target].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget AS [target]
                    CROSS JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                        AND    [target].[ObjectTypeKey] != [statement].[ObjectTypeKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType
                    (
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [StatementKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [target].[ObjectKey],
                        [statement].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget AS [target]
                    CROSS JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                        AND [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                        AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                        AND    [target].[ObjectTypeKey] != [statement].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    ORDER BY
                            [target].[ObjectKey],
                            [statement].[StatementKey]
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
                END
                
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType]
                ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType
                (
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [StatementKey]
                );  
                
                INSERT INTO @immutableTruthCount
                (
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [Count]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                    [target].[ObjectKey],
                    0
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTarget AS [target];
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey AS [immutable]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @keyCount
                    (
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [Count]
                    )
                    SELECT
                        [immutable].[ObjectKey],
                        COUNT([immutable].[StatementKey])
                    FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey AS [immutable]
                        ON  [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    GROUP BY
                            [immutable].[ObjectKey];
                            
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT TOP 1 [count].[ObjectKey]
                        FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                        INNER JOIN @keyCount AS [immutable]
                            ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE @immutableTruthCount
                        SET [Count] = [count].[Count] + [immutable].[Count]
                        FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                        INNER JOIN @keyCount AS [immutable]
                            ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey];
                    END
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey AS [immutable]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @notKeyCount
                    (
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [Count]
                    )
                    SELECT
                        [immutable].[ObjectKey],
                        COUNT([immutable].[StatementKey])
                    FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey AS [immutable]
                        ON  [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    GROUP BY
                            [immutable].[ObjectKey];
                            
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT TOP 1 [count].[ObjectKey]
                        FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                        INNER JOIN @notKeyCount AS [immutable]
                            ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE @immutableTruthCount
                        SET [Count] = [count].[Count] + [immutable].[Count]
                        FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                        INNER JOIN @notKeyCount AS [immutable]
                            ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey];
                    END
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType AS [immutable]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @typeCount
                    (
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [Count]
                    )
                    SELECT
                        [immutable].[ObjectKey],
                        COUNT([immutable].[StatementKey])
                    FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType AS [immutable]
                        ON  [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    GROUP BY
                            [immutable].[ObjectKey];
                            
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT TOP 1 [count].[ObjectKey]
                        FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                        INNER JOIN @typeCount AS [immutable]
                            ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE @immutableTruthCount
                        SET [Count] = [count].[Count] + [immutable].[Count]
                        FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                        INNER JOIN @typeCount AS [immutable]
                            ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey];
                    END
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType AS [immutable]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @notTypeCount
                    (
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [Count]
                    )
                    SELECT
                        [immutable].[ObjectKey],
                        COUNT([immutable].[StatementKey])
                    FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType AS [immutable]
                        ON  [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    GROUP BY
                            [immutable].[ObjectKey];
                            
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT TOP 1 [count].[ObjectKey]
                        FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                        INNER JOIN @notTypeCount AS [immutable]
                            ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        UPDATE @immutableTruthCount
                        SET [Count] = [count].[Count] + [immutable].[Count]
                        FROM @immutableTruthCount AS [count]
                        INNER JOIN @notTypeCount AS [immutable]
                            ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey];
                    END
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN @immutableTruthCount AS [immutable]
                        ON  [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                        ON    [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE [condition].[StatementCount] > ([count].[Count] + [immutable].[Count])
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [count]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN @immutableTruthCount AS [immutable]
                        ON  [count].[ObjectKey] = [immutable].[ObjectKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                        ON    [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE [condition].[StatementCount] > ([count].[Count] + [immutable].[Count])
                END
                                      
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey AS [true]
                        ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ObjectKey]
                        AND    [statements].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable
                    SET [Count] = [Count] + 1
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetKey AS [true]
                        ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ObjectKey]
                        AND    [statements].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey];
                END

                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey AS [true]
                        ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ObjectKey]
                        AND    [statements].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable
                    SET [Count] = [Count] + 1
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotKey AS [true]
                        ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ObjectKey]
                        AND    [statements].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey];
                END

                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType AS [true]
                        ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ObjectKey]
                        AND    [statements].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable
                    SET [Count] = [Count] + 1
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetNotType AS [true]
                        ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ObjectKey]
                        AND    [statements].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey];
                END
                                          
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType AS [true]
                        ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ObjectKey]
                        AND    [statements].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable
                    SET [Count] = [Count] + 1
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                        ON [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipTargetType AS [true]
                        ON    [count].[ObjectKey] = [true].[ObjectKey]
                        AND    [statements].[StatementKey] = [true].[StatementKey];
                END

                UPDATE  #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount
                SET [Count] = [update].[Count]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount AS [count]
                INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipNotImmutable AS [update]
                    ON  [count].[MembershipConditionKey] = [update].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    AND [count].[ObjectKey] = [update].[ObjectKey];
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [partition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                UPDATE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount
                SET [count] = 0
                FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                    ON  [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [partition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [partition].[StatementKey] = [request].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag
            END
                    
            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [TrueStatementCount],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[Count],
                @iteration
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsCount AS [candidate]
        END

    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.8    False statements imply unsatisfied membership conditions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                                
    IF @iteration = 0
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rmcst].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
            WHERE
                    [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rmcst].[True] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [rmcst].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                    ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
                    ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
                    ON [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
                    ON [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = [smc].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                    ON [smc].[SetKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [rmcst].[ResourceKey] = [ovr].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rmcst].[True] = @falseFlag
                    
            )
            BEGIN
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalseLiteral') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalseLiteral;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
                    [rmcst].[ResourceKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
                INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalseLiteral
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                    ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
                    ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
                    ON [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
                    ON [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = [smc].[MembershipConditionKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                    ON [smc].[SetKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [rmcst].[ResourceKey] = [ovr].[ValueReference]
                WHERE
                        [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rmcst].[True] = @falseFlag
                ORDER BY
                    [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey],
                    [rmcst].[ResourceKey]
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));

                
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalseLiteral]
                ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalseLiteral
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [ObjectKey]
                ); 
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalseLiteral AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                        ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [candidate]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalseLiteral AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                        ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey];

                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalseLiteral AS [candidate]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache
                    (
                        [MembershipConditionKey],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [TrueStatementCount],
                        [Iteration]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
                        [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                        0,
                        @iteration
                    FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalseLiteral AS [candidate]

                END
                
            END
        END
        
        IF @modifying = @trueFlag
        BEGIN 
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [request].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                WHERE
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag 
                    AND [request].[Iteration] = @iteration
            )      
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [request].[RequestKey]
                    FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                        ON  [request].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                        ON  [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                        ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [membership]
                        ON  [set].[SetKey] = [membership].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [request].[ObjectKey] = [membership].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag
                        AND [request].[Iteration] = @iteration
                        AND [membership].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalsePartition') IS NOT NULL
                    BEGIN
                        DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalsePartition;
                    END
                    
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS [MembershipConditionKey],
                        [request].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey]
                    INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalsePartition
                    FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [request]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                        ON  [request].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                        ON  [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsModifying AS [modifying]
                        ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [modifying].[ObjectKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [membership]
                        ON  [set].[SetKey] = [membership].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [request].[ObjectKey] = [membership].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE
                            [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [request].[True] = @falseFlag
                        AND [request].[Iteration] = @iteration
                        AND [membership].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    ORDER BY
                        [partition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                        [request].[ObjectKey]
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                    
                    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalsePartition]
                    ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalsePartition
                    (
                        [MembershipConditionKey],
                        [ObjectKey]
                    ); 
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalsePartition AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                            ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE [candidate]
                        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalsePartition AS [candidate]
                        INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                            ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                            AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey];
                    END
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalsePartition AS [candidate]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache
                        (
                            [MembershipConditionKey],
                            [ObjectKey],
                            [TrueStatementCount],
                            [Iteration]
                        )
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
                            [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                            0,
                            @iteration
                        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalsePartition AS [candidate]

                    END
                END
            END
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcso].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[Iteration] = @iteration
            AND [rmcso].[True] = @falseFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [rmcso]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
            ON [rmcso].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
            ON [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcso].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcso].[True] = @falseFlag
        ORDER BY
            [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [rmcso].[ObjectKey];

            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ObjectKey]
        ); 
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [rmco]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmco].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [rmco].[ObjectKey];

        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [TrueStatementCount],
                [Iteration]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                0,
                @iteration
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsFalse AS [candidate]
        END
         
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.9  A membership condition never becomes false unless a statement
 *      is falsified
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [evaluation].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [evaluation]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            ON  [evaluation].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE        [evaluation].[TrueStatementCount] < [condition].[StatementCount]
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [evaluation].[MembershipConditionKey] AS N'MembershipConditionKey',
            [evaluation].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
        INTO #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [evaluation]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            ON  [evaluation].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE        [evaluation].[TrueStatementCount] < [condition].[StatementCount]
        ORDER BY
            [evaluation].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [evaluation].[ObjectKey];

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange]
        ON #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ObjectKey]
        ); 
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementEvaluation]
                ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statementEvaluation].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [statementEvaluation].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [statementEvaluation].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statementEvaluation].[True] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [statementEvaluation]
                ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statementEvaluation].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [statementEvaluation].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [statementEvaluation].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statementEvaluation].[True] = @falseFlag

        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [statementEvaluation]
                ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statementEvaluation].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [statementEvaluation].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [statementEvaluation].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statementEvaluation].[True] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [statementEvaluation]
                ON  [statements].[StatementKey] = [statementEvaluation].[StatementKey]
                AND [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [statementEvaluation].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [statementEvaluation].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [statementEvaluation].[True] = @falseFlag

        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [evaluation].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [evaluation]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange AS [candidate]
                ON  [evaluation].[MembershipConditionKey] = [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [evaluation].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [evaluation]
            FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [evaluation]
            INNER JOIN #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsApparentChange AS [candidate]
                ON  [evaluation].[MembershipConditionKey] = [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
                AND [evaluation].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey];
        END
         
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [cache].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [cache]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [existing]
            ON    [cache].[MembershipConditionKey] = [existing].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND    [cache].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE        [existing].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [cache]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [cache]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [existing]
            ON    [cache].[MembershipConditionKey] = [existing].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND    [cache].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE        [existing].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [cache].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [cache]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [TrueStatementCount],
            [Iteration]
        )
        SELECT
            @requestKey,
            [cache].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [cache].[ObjectKey],
            [cache].[TrueStatementCount],
            [cache].[Iteration]
        FROM #calculateRequestSetTransitionsEvaluateMembershipConditionsResultCache AS [cache]
		OPTION (LOOP JOIN);
    END        

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestSetTransitionsMembershipConditionEvaluation';
    END
END
