/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestTabularIntegerFunctionSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestTabularIntegerFunctionSetTransitions]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @creating               BIT,
    @modifying              BIT,
    @trueFlag               BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag              BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Statements about resources that are being deleted are always treated
 *      as false, so if the request is only to delete resources, then
 *      no further processing is necessary here.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Determine how the truth of tabular function statements might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
 
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.1  Generally, if a new or modified value matches a tabular function value
 *        then any statement referencing that function is true.  If a new or modified
 *        value does not match a tabular function value, then any such statement
 *        might be false.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
            ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
            AND    [value].[ValueInteger] = [function].[Value]
        WHERE
                [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [value].[ValueInteger] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [statement].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
            [value].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
            [value].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [ObjectTypeKey],
            CASE 
                WHEN [value].[Deleted] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END
            AS [True]
        INTO #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
            ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
            AND    [value].[ValueInteger] = [function].[Value]
        WHERE
                [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [value].[ValueInteger] IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
                [statement].[StatementKey],
                [value].[ObjectKey],
                [value].[ObjectTypeKey];

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions]
        ON #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [True]
        );
        
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.2  Only statements that are becoming true are interesting.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [known]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [known].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [known].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE        [candidate].[True] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE    [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [known]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [known].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [known].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE        [candidate].[True] = @trueFlag
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.3  A statement does not become false if some other new or modified value
 *        makes the statement true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueInteger] = [function].[Value]
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [alternate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [alternate].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE    [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueInteger] = [function].[Value]
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [alternate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [alternate].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4  A statement does not become false if some existing value that is not
 *        being deleted keeps the statement true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                         
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueInteger] = [function].[Value]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [deleted]
                ON    [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ValueInteger] = [alternate].[ValueInteger]
                AND    [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [deleted].[RequestKey] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE    [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueInteger] = [function].[Value]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [deleted]
                ON    [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ValueInteger] = [alternate].[ValueInteger]
                AND    [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [deleted].[RequestKey] IS NULL;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.    Emit the results.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/           
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ResourceKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[True]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralIntegerSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
        END
    END   

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestTabularIntegerFunctionSetTransitions';
    END                
                
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestTabularReferenceFunctionSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestTabularReferenceFunctionSetTransitions]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @creating               BIT,
    @modifying              BIT,
    @trueFlag               BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag              BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Statements about resources that are being deleted are always treated
 *      as false, so if the request is only to delete resources, then
 *      no further processing is necessary here.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Determine how the truth of tabular function statements might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
 
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.1  Generally, if a new or modified value matches a tabular function value
 *        then any statement referencing that function is true.  If a new or modified
 *        value does not match a tabular function value, then any such statement
 *        might be false.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [function]
            ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
            AND    [value].[ValueReference] = [function].[Value]
        WHERE
                [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [value].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [statement].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
            [value].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
            [value].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [ObjectTypeKey],
            CASE 
                WHEN [value].[Deleted] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END
            AS [True]
        INTO #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [function]
            ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
            AND    [value].[ValueReference] = [function].[Value]
        WHERE
                [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [value].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
                [statement].[StatementKey],
                [value].[ObjectKey],
                [value].[ObjectTypeKey];

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions]
        ON #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [True]
        );
        
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.2  Only statements that are becoming true are interesting.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [known]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [known].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [known].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE        [candidate].[True] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE    [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [known]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [known].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [known].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE        [candidate].[True] = @trueFlag
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.3  A statement does not become false if some other new or modified value
 *        makes the statement true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueReference] = [function].[Value]
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [alternate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [alternate].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE    [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueReference] = [function].[Value]
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [alternate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [alternate].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4  A statement does not become false if some existing value that is not
 *        being deleted keeps the statement true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                         
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueReference] = [function].[Value]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [deleted]
                ON    [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ValueReference] = [alternate].[ValueReference]
                AND    [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [deleted].[RequestKey] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE    [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueReference] = [function].[Value]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [deleted]
                ON    [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ValueReference] = [alternate].[ValueReference]
                AND    [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [deleted].[RequestKey] IS NULL;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.    Emit the results.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/           
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ResourceKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[True]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralReferenceSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
        END
    END   

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestTabularReferenceFunctionSetTransitions';
    END                
                
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CalculateRequestTabularStringFunctionSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CalculateRequestTabularStringFunctionSetTransitions]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @creating               BIT,
    @modifying              BIT,
    @trueFlag               BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag              BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                  DATETIME;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END    

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Statements about resources that are being deleted are always treated
 *      as false, so if the request is only to delete resources, then
 *      no further processing is necessary here.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @creating != @trueFlag
    AND @modifying != @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT r.[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
        WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Determine how the truth of tabular function statements might
 *      be changed.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
 
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.1  Generally, if a new or modified value matches a tabular function value
 *        then any statement referencing that function is true.  If a new or modified
 *        value does not match a tabular function value, then any such statement
 *        might be false.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [function]
            ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
            AND    [value].[ValueString] = [function].[Value]
        WHERE
                [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [value].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [statement].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
            [value].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
            [value].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [ObjectTypeKey],
            CASE 
                WHEN [value].[Deleted] = @trueFlag THEN @falseFlag
                ELSE @trueFlag
            END
            AS [True]
        INTO #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [value].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [function]
            ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
            AND    [value].[ValueString] = [function].[Value]
        WHERE
                [value].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [value].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
                [statement].[StatementKey],
                [value].[ObjectKey],
                [value].[ObjectTypeKey];

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CalculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions]
        ON #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [True]
        );
        
 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.2  Only statements that are becoming true are interesting.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [known]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [known].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [known].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE        [candidate].[True] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE    [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [known]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [known].[StatementKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [known].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE        [candidate].[True] = @trueFlag
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.3  A statement does not become false if some other new or modified value
 *        makes the statement true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueString] = [function].[Value]
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [alternate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [alternate].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE    [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueString] = [function].[Value]
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [alternate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [alternate].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4  A statement does not become false if some existing value that is not
 *        being deleted keeps the statement true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                         
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueString] = [function].[Value]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [deleted]
                ON    [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ValueString] = [alternate].[ValueString]
                AND    [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [deleted].[RequestKey] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE    [candidate]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [alternate]
                ON    [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [alternate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [function]
                ON    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                AND    [alternate].[ValueString] = [function].[Value]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [deleted]
                ON    [deleted].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ObjectTypeKey] = [alternate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[AttributeKey] = [alternate].[AttributeKey]
                AND    [deleted].[ValueString] = [alternate].[ValueString]
                AND    [deleted].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            WHERE        
                    [candidate].[True] = @falseFlag
                AND    [deleted].[RequestKey] IS NULL;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.    Emit the results.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/           
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT    [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ResourceKey],
                [StatementKey],
                [True]
            )
            SELECT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[StatementKey],
                [candidate].[True]
            FROM #calculateRequestLiteralStringSetTransitions_Functions AS [candidate]
        END
    END   

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'CalculateRequestTabularStringFunctionSetTransitions';
    END                
                
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CancelStuckRequests]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CancelStuckRequests]
    @requestMaximumActiveDurationOverrideInSeconds  INT = NULL,
    @serviceIsActiveIfLastPingInSeconds             INT = 15,
    @batchSize                                      INT = 10000,
    @extendedOutput                                 TINYINT = 0  -- 0 none, 1 data only, 2 data + messages
AS
-- Top Level
BEGIN

    IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON
    END
         
    BEGIN TRY
    
        --DESIGN POINT:  This stored procedure handles its own transaction requirements
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        *  BACKGROUND: Requests can become stuck due to a variety of issues.  Here are a few of the top reasons:
        *              Persisted workflow is in a state which can not resume.
        *              Request is tied to a ServicePartition which is no longer serviced by the ServiceName that last processed the
        *                 Request/Workflows
        *              Asynchronous operations are not working (sending mail, operations covered by [RequestMonitor],
        *                 [CollateralRequestTracking]
        *
        *              This stored procedure will look for Requests that have not reached a final state and have been active
        *              for "a long time" as defined by the SystemConfiguration object RequestMaximumActiveDuration
        *              and Cancel them.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         

        DECLARE @acquiredLockBulkCancelRequest                  SMALLINT,
                @commitTime                                     DATETIME,
                @didMarkForCancel                               BIT,
                @falseFlag                                      BIT,
                @lockNameBulkCancelRequest                      NVARCHAR(40),
                @messageText                                    NVARCHAR(2000),
                @recordRequestControlTrueFlag                   BIT,
                @requestKey                                     BIGINT,
                @requestMaximumActiveDuration                   BIGINT,
                @requestMaximumActiveDurationAttributeKey       SMALLINT,
                @requestMaximumActiveDurationDate               DATETIME,
                @requestMaximumActiveDurationMessage            NVARCHAR(32),
                @requestObjectTypeKey                           SMALLINT,  
                @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey         TINYINT,              
                @requestStatus                                  NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey                      SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusCancelingKey                      SMALLINT,                
                @requestStatusDetailLevelError                  NVARCHAR(16),                
                @serviceAccountObjectKey                        BIGINT,
                @serviceIsConsideredActiveDate                  DATETIME,                
                @systemServiceId                                SMALLINT,
                @systemServicePartitionId                       SMALLINT,
                @trueFlag                                       BIT;               

     
        SELECT  @acquiredLockBulkCancelRequest = -1,
                @commitTime = GETUTCDATE(),
                @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
                @lockNameBulkCancelRequest = N'BulkCancelRequest',
                @recordRequestControlTrueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
                @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey  = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlSystemCancelOperation]()),              
                @requestMaximumActiveDurationAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmRequestMaximumActiveDuration'),
                @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                @requestStatusCancelingKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusCanceling]()),                
                @requestStatusDetailLevelError = [fim].[RequestStatusDetailLevelError](),
                @serviceAccountObjectKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey](),
                @systemServiceId = [fim].[GetSystemServiceId](),
                @systemServicePartitionId = [fim].[GetSystemServicePartitionId](),
                @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get the value for how much time must pass before a Canceling Request can
        *    be terminated.  The primary location for this value is in a schema object
        *    SystemConfiguration.
        *
        *    For testing purposes, you can pass in an override as a parameter to this
        *    stored procedure.
        * 
        *    If the SystemConfiguration object does not exist and there is no
        *    override, a hard-coded value is used.  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF(@requestMaximumActiveDurationOverrideInSeconds IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT  @requestMaximumActiveDurationDate = DATEADD(s, -1 * @requestMaximumActiveDurationOverrideInSeconds,  @commitTime),   
                    @requestMaximumActiveDurationMessage = CAST(@requestMaximumActiveDurationOverrideInSeconds AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N' seconds';
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT  @requestMaximumActiveDuration = [fim].[GetIntegerSystemConfigurationSetting](@requestMaximumActiveDurationAttributeKey);

            SELECT  @requestMaximumActiveDurationDate = DATEADD(d, -1 * @requestMaximumActiveDuration,  @commitTime),
                    @requestMaximumActiveDurationMessage = CAST(@requestMaximumActiveDuration AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N' days';
        END

        SELECT  @serviceIsConsideredActiveDate = DATEADD(s, -1 * @serviceIsActiveIfLastPingInSeconds, @commitTime);
        
           
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Get Exclusive lock
        *    DESIGN POINT We want to ensure only one instance of this procedure can run at a time
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        EXECUTE @acquiredLockBulkCancelRequest = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockNameBulkCancelRequest,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session',
            @LockTimeout = 10000;  -- wait for up to 10 seconds to get the lock

        IF(@acquiredLockBulkCancelRequest < 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockNameBulkCancelRequest + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

       /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Setup Table that holds the Stuck Requests and their Reason
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#stuckRequest') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #stuckRequest;
        END
        
        CREATE TABLE #stuckRequest
        (
            [RequestKey]                            BIGINT,
            [RequestStatusKey]                      SMALLINT,
            [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered]  BIT,
            [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive]      BIT,
            [IsTiedToSystemServiceId]               BIT,   -- ServiceId = FIM SYSTEM
            [Reason]                                NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
            [ReasonIdentified]                      BIT           DEFAULT(0)
        )
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_StuckRequest_RequestKey]
        ON #stuckRequest
        (
            [RequestKey]
        );
       
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_StuckRequest_Reason_RequestKey]
        ON #stuckRequest
        (
            [ReasonIdentified],
            [RequestKey]
        );
 
 
        -- Get all non-final Requests that have exceeded the RequestMaximumActiveDuration
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT  [r].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[GetRequestStatusKeysOfTypeProcessing]() AS [grsk]
            ON [r].[Status] = [grsk].[RequestStatusKey]
            WHERE   [r].[Time] <= @requestMaximumActiveDurationDate       
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT #stuckRequest
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [RequestStatusKey],
                [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered],
                [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive],
                [IsTiedToSystemServiceId]
            )
            SELECT TOP(@batchSize)
                [r].[RequestKey],
                [r].[Status],
                CASE 
                    WHEN [sh].[ServiceId] IS NOT NULL THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END AS [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered],
                CASE 
                    WHEN [sh].[ServiceId] IS NOT NULL AND [sh].[LastPingTime] >= @serviceIsConsideredActiveDate THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END AS [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive],
                CASE 
                    WHEN [r].[ServiceId] IS NOT NULL AND [r].[ServiceId] = @systemServiceId THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END AS [IsTiedToSystemServiceId]
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[GetRequestStatusKeysOfTypeProcessing]() AS [grsk]
            ON [r].[Status] = [grsk].[RequestStatusKey]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [sh]
            ON  [r].[ServiceId] = [sh].[ServiceId]
            AND [r].[ServicePartitionId] = [sh].[ServicePartitionId]
            WHERE   [r].[Time] <= @requestMaximumActiveDurationDate
            ORDER BY [r].[RequestKey];
                
            -- Remove Requests that are already in a Canceling State
            DELETE #stuckRequest
            WHERE [RequestStatusKey] = @requestStatusCancelingKey;
        END
        
        
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D.  Determine why each Request is likely to be stuck so we can add specific reason information
        *     to RequestStatusDetail to help with diagnostics and understanding of why a Request
        *     was canceled. 
        *----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
       
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D.1 ServicePartitionId and ServiceId combo no longer registered
        *     If a ServiceName is moved to another ServicePartition, it registers itself as processing
        *     Requests for its new ServicePartition.  Requests that were still active before the move
        *     no longer have a running service to process them.
        *------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM #stuckRequest
            WHERE   [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @falseFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sr]
            SET [Reason] = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonServicePartitionInvalidConfiguration](@requestMaximumActiveDurationMessage, [sr].[RequestKey]),
                [ReasonIdentified] = @trueFlag
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            WHERE   [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @falseFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag;
        END

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D.2 SystemServicePartition Not Serviced  (no FIMService is running that services the System Partition)
        *     As soon as any FIMService processes a Request that was created by the System, its [r].[ServiceId]
        *     is updated to match the ServiceId of that FIMService so will no longer be set to @systemServiceId
        *     and no longer satisfies this logic.  FIMServices can override the default logic which is to allow
              Them to always process any Request that was generated by FIM SYSTEM so an ITPro would have had to
        *     do this explicitly in order for this state to occur.
        *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM #stuckRequest
            WHERE   [IsTiedToSystemServiceId] = @trueFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sr]
            SET [Reason] = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonSystemServicePartitionInvalidConfiguration](@requestMaximumActiveDurationMessage, [sr].[RequestKey]),
                [ReasonIdentified] = @trueFlag
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            WHERE   [IsTiedToSystemServiceId] = @trueFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag;
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D.3 ServicePartitionId and ServiceId combo registered but not active
        *     This would be a case where a Service was shut-down permanently and all Active Requests
        *     are no longer processed that were tied to this Service on its ServicePartition
        *------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM #stuckRequest
            WHERE   [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive] = @falseFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sr]
            SET [Reason] = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonServiceIsNotRunning](@requestMaximumActiveDurationMessage, [sr].[RequestKey]),
                [ReasonIdentified] = @trueFlag
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            WHERE   [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive] = @falseFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag;
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D.4 ServicePartitionId and ServiceId combo is active, workflow not completed
        *     The Request still has workflows that have not reached a final state.
        *------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [sr].[RequestKey]
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            ON [sr].[RequestKey] = [wi].[RequestKey]
            WHERE   
                    [wi].[Finished] = @falseFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive] = @trueFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sr]
            SET [Reason] = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonWorkflowNotCompleted](@requestMaximumActiveDurationMessage, [sr].[RequestKey]),
                [ReasonIdentified] = @trueFlag
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            ON [sr].[RequestKey] = [wi].[RequestKey]
            WHERE   
                    [wi].[Finished] = @falseFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive] = @trueFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag;
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D.5 ServicePartitionId and ServiceId combo is active, workflow completed
        *     The Request has workflows that all have completed, but the Request has not been finalized
        *     with the workflow results.  May be waiting for CollateralRequests
        *------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [sr].[RequestKey]
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            ON [sr].[RequestKey] = [wi].[RequestKey]
            WHERE   
                    [wi].[Finished] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive] = @trueFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sr]
            SET [Reason] = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonWorkflowCompletedRequestNotFinalized](@requestMaximumActiveDurationMessage, [sr].[RequestKey]),
                [ReasonIdentified] = @trueFlag
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            ON [sr].[RequestKey] = [wi].[RequestKey]
            WHERE   
                    [wi].[Finished] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive] = @trueFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag;
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D.6 ServicePartitionId and ServiceId combo is active, no workflows
        *     This type of Request should have completed processing all in a single synchronous 
        *     execution path so possibly had a time out or a service interruption that left it in 
        *     a stuck state.  It may also be waiting on CollateralRequests to complete.
        *------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [sr].[RequestKey]
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            WHERE   
                    [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive] = @trueFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sr]
            SET [Reason] = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonUnknown](@requestMaximumActiveDurationMessage, [sr].[RequestKey]),
                [ReasonIdentified] = @trueFlag
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            WHERE   
                    [PartitionAndServiceComboIsRegistered] = @trueFlag
                AND [PartitionAndServiceComboIsActive] = @trueFlag
                AND [ReasonIdentified] = @falseFlag;
        END

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * E.  This part does the actual Cancel operation
        *     NOTE:  This temporary table is shared between two stored procedures
        *        The reason for this is to separate the Detection from the Cancel
        *        so that other stored procedures could be written in the future
        *        to provide different detection logic, and then share the bulk Cancel code.
        *----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#bulkCancelRequest') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #bulkCancelRequest;
        END

        SELECT
            [RequestKey],			
            @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey AS [RequestControlKey],		
            @serviceAccountObjectKey AS [CauseKey],				
            [Reason],				
            @requestStatusDetailLevelError AS [ReasonDetailLevel],		
            @recordRequestControlTrueFlag AS [RecordRequestControl],
            NULL AS [DidMarkForCancel],
            NULL AS [Error]
        INTO #bulkCancelRequest
        FROM #stuckRequest;

        EXECUTE [fim].[DoBulkCancelRequest];
        
        IF(@extendedOutput >= 1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [sr].[RequestKey],                           
                [sr].[RequestStatusKey],                     
                [sr].[Reason],
                [br].[DidMarkForCancel],
                [br].[Error]
            FROM #stuckRequest AS [sr]
            LEFT JOIN #bulkCancelRequest AS [br]
            ON [sr].[RequestKey] = [br].[RequestKey];
        END

        IF(@acquiredLockBulkCancelRequest >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameBulkCancelRequest,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF(@acquiredLockBulkCancelRequest >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameBulkCancelRequest,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CheckAndUpdateReportingJobStatus]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CheckAndUpdateReportingJobStatus]    
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************  

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @baseTimeForComparison              DATETIME,
            @createdTimeAttributeKey            SMALLINT,
            @currentTime                        DATETIME,
            @currentReportingJobKey             BIGINT,
            @customExpirationTimeoutInDays      INT,
            @defaultExpirationTimeoutInDays     INT,
            @defaultTimeOutPeriod               INT,
            @expirationTime                     DATETIME,
            @expirationTimeAttributeName        NVARCHAR(448),
            @expirationTimeoutCustomValue       NVARCHAR(MAX),            
            @jobExpirationTimeoutSystemProperty NVARCHAR(448),
            @latestReportingJobHeartBeat        DATETIME,
            @reportingJobErrorStatusString      NVARCHAR(448),
            @reportingJobDetailString           NVARCHAR(448),
            @reportingJobDetailsAttributeName   NVARCHAR(448),
            @reportingJobIdentifier             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,           
            @reportingJobStatusAttributeName    NVARCHAR(448);

    SELECT        
        @createdTimeAttributeKey            = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @currentTime                        = GETUTCDATE(),        
        @defaultExpirationTimeoutInDays     = 30,                    
        @defaultTimeOutPeriod               = 35,
        @expirationTimeAttributeName        = N'ExpirationTime',
        @jobExpirationTimeoutSystemProperty = N'CompletedReportingJobExpirationDuration',                 
        @reportingJobErrorStatusString      = N'Error',
        @reportingJobDetailString           = N'This reporting job has been cancelled because the FIM Service instance handling the job has failed to respond within the pre-configured timeout window.',        
        @reportingJobDetailsAttributeName   = N'msidmReportingJobDetails',
        @reportingJobStatusAttributeName    = N'msidmReportingJobStatus';
                
    IF EXISTS
    (
       SELECT 1
       FROM [fim].[ReportingJobs] WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)      
    )                    
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
            BEGIN TRANSACTION
            
            -- get the current reporting job object key and last heart beat time
            SELECT 
                @currentReportingJobKey         = [rpj].[JobIdentifierKey],
                @latestReportingJobHeartBeat    = [rpj].[LastHeartBeat]
            FROM [fim].[ReportingJobs] AS [rpj];

            -- if the job has no HeartBeat set it has not either started running
            -- or not completed atleast one batch of ETL. In these cases use the 
            -- createdTime of the job to determine if the job is making progress
            IF( @latestReportingJobHeartBeat IS NULL)
            BEGIN

                -- Get the createdTime for the ReportingJob object
                SELECT @baseTimeForComparison = [ovt].[ValueDateTime]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovt]
                WHERE   [ovt].[ObjectKey] = @currentReportingJobKey
                    AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey				  
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT @baseTimeForComparison = @latestReportingJobHeartBeat;
            END
            
            -- if the job is running and has been so for more than 35 minutes terminate and
            -- release the semaphore.          
            IF ( DATEDIFF( minute, 0, GETUTCDATE() - @baseTimeForComparison) > @defaultTimeOutPeriod )               
            BEGIN              
                SELECT @reportingJobIdentifier          = [fim].[ObjectIDFromObjectKey](@currentReportingJobKey),
                       @expirationTimeoutCustomValue    = [fim].[GetSystemProperty](@jobExpirationTimeoutSystemProperty),
                       @expirationTime                  = DATEADD(day, @defaultExpirationTimeoutInDays, @currentTime);
                      
                EXECUTE [fim].[DoSetReportingJobStringAttribute]
                    @reportingJobObjectIdentifier =  @reportingJobIdentifier,  
                    @attributeName = @reportingJobStatusAttributeName, 
                    @value = @reportingJobErrorStatusString;         
                                                
                EXECUTE [fim].[DoSetReportingJobTextAttribute] 
                    @reportingJobObjectIdentifier =  @reportingJobIdentifier,  
                    @attributeName = @reportingJobDetailsAttributeName,                     
                    @value = @reportingJobDetailString;                                             
                
                -- if there is a valid custom expiration time set then use that.                    
                IF(@expirationTimeoutCustomValue IS NOT NULL)                
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @customExpirationTimeoutInDays  = CAST(@expirationTimeoutCustomValue as INT);
                    
                    IF(@customExpirationTimeoutInDays > 0)
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @expirationTime = DATEADD(day, @customExpirationTimeoutInDays , @currentTime);
                    END                    
                END
                
                -- Set the expiration time for the reporting job object
                EXECUTE [fim].[DoSetReportingJobDateTimeAttribute] 
                    @reportingJobObjectIdentifier = @reportingJobIdentifier,
                    @attributeName = @expirationTimeAttributeName, 
                    @value = @expirationTime;                                   
                    
                -- Release the job lock
                EXECUTE [fim].[DoRemoveReportingJob]
                    @reportingJobObjectKey = @currentReportingJobKey;
            END              
                        
            COMMIT TRANSACTION              
        END TRY        
        BEGIN CATCH       
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END 
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];                  
        END CATCH  
    END    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CheckCollateralRequestsStatus]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CheckCollateralRequestsStatus] 
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @collateralWorkflowCount INT,
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 1,  -- 0 none, 1 data only, 2 data + messages
    @collateralRequestProcessingStatus NVARCHAR(448) OUTPUT,
    @collateralRequestStatusFinalResult NVARCHAR(448) OUTPUT,
    @requestStatusDetail XML OUTPUT
AS
-- Read Only
BEGIN

    -- This is READ ONLY so not enforcing any type of AssertTransactionalContext 
    IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
    END 
    
    SELECT  @requestStatusDetail = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    DECLARE @operationAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @parentRequestAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
            @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @requestStatusDetailLevelError NVARCHAR(16),
            @requestStatusPostProcessing NVARCHAR(448);
            
    SELECT  @operationAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Operation'),
            @parentRequestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ParentRequest'),
            @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
            @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
            @requestStatusDetailLevelError = [fim].[RequestStatusDetailLevelError](),
            @requestStatusPostProcessing = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessing]();
  
    SELECT @collateralRequestProcessingStatus = [fim].[CollateralRequestTrackingPending]();

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * A. Check to see if all Collateral Requests have been dispatched
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

    --Only continue if all are created and dispatched 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication]
        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @collateralRequestProcessingStatus = [fim].[CollateralRequestTrackingDispatching]();
        GOTO FinalExit;
    END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * B. Get all the requests and see if they are all finished.
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

    -- All requests are now created in the system.
    
    -- If a CollateralRequest is not final, it will have a Row in the [Request] table with a non-final status so do a quick check to see if any are
    -- in this state and if so exit quickly.
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE 
                [r].[Cause] = @requestKey
            AND [r].[Operation] = N'SystemEvent'
            AND [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeProcessing]([fim].[GetRequestStatusName]([r].[Status])) = 1
     )
     BEGIN
        SELECT @collateralRequestProcessingStatus = [fim].[CollateralRequestTrackingDispatched]();
        GOTO FinalExit;
     END
     
    -- All Requests are Final so capture all of the different RequestStatus values.
    DECLARE @collateralRequestTable TABLE
    (
        [CollateralRequestStatus] NVARCHAR(448),
        [Count] INTEGER
    );

    INSERT @collateralRequestTable
    (
        [CollateralRequestStatus],
        [Count]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ovs].[ValueString],
        COUNT([ovs].[ValueString])
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
        ON  [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs2]
        ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovs2].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE 
            [ovr].[ObjectKey] > @requestKey -- CollateralRequests always have higher value than the parent
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey
        AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @parentRequestAttributeKey
        AND [ovr].[ValueReference] = @requestKey
        AND [ovs2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovs2].[AttributeKey] = @operationAttributeKey
        AND [ovs2].[ValueString] = N'SystemEvent'
    GROUP BY [ovs].[ValueString];
            
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * C. Generate an overall status result for all collateral requests
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    -- all are done, check results

    SELECT @collateralRequestProcessingStatus =  [fim].[CollateralRequestTrackingFinished]();

    DECLARE @collateralResult NVARCHAR(448);

    --Check for results in this order (Cancel, Fail, Complete) and use the first one found
    --for overall result calculations

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM @collateralRequestTable
    )
    BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP(1) @collateralResult = [CollateralRequestStatus]
        FROM @collateralRequestTable
        WHERE [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeCanceled]([CollateralRequestStatus]) = 1;

        IF( @collateralResult IS NULL)
        BEGIN

            SELECT TOP(1) @collateralResult = [CollateralRequestStatus]
            FROM @collateralRequestTable
            WHERE [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFailed]([CollateralRequestStatus]) = 1;
        END

        IF( @collateralResult IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            -- If still null, then all requests completed successfully so just grab the top record.
            SELECT TOP(1) @collateralResult = [CollateralRequestStatus]
            FROM @collateralRequestTable;
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT @collateralResult = [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]();
    END
    
    SELECT @collateralRequestStatusFinalResult = [fim].[DetermineFinalRequestStatusValue](NULL, NULL, @collateralResult);

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * D. Do a process check to make sure the total number expected is equal to the total
    *    number that executed.
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

    DECLARE @totalWorkflowsCompleted INT;

    SELECT @totalWorkflowsCompleted = SUM([Count])
    FROM @collateralRequestTable

    IF(@collateralWorkflowCount != @totalWorkflowsCompleted)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @collateralRequestStatusFinalResult = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessingError]();
        -- IMT 26510 The following user facing string is hard-coded and should be localizable.
        SELECT @requestStatusDetail = [fim].[CreateRequestStatusDetail](N'Number of workflows required do not match number completed.', @requestStatusDetailLevelError);
    END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * E. Allow early exit
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

FinalExit:

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CheckRequestExistingByRequestMarker]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CheckRequestExistingByRequestMarker]    
        @requestMarker UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @servicePartitionId SMALLINT,
    @targetIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @creator UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @operation NVARCHAR(448),
    @parameters XML,
    @ancillaryParameters XML,
    @exists BIT OUTPUT,
    @requestID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT,
    @canBeRecovered BIT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @requestKey BIGINT = NULL,
            @requestStatus SMALLINT = NULL,
            @rowCount SMALLINT = NULL,
            @mprAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @authenticationWorkflowAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @authorizationWorkflowAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @actionWorkflowAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @serviceIdStored SMALLINT,
            @servicePartitionIdStored SMALLINT,
            @targetIdentifierStored UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            @targetKeyStored BIGINT,
            @creatorStored UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            @creatorKeyStored BIGINT,
            @operationStored NVARCHAR(448),
			@filterSQLAncillaryParameterName NVARCHAR(16);

    SELECT @exists = 0, 
           @requestID = NULL,
           @canBeRecovered = 1;

    SELECT @mprAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ManagementPolicy'),
           @authenticationWorkflowAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthenticationWorkflowInstance'),
           @authorizationWorkflowAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthorizationWorkflowInstance'),
           @actionWorkflowAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ActionWorkflowInstance'),
		   @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName = [fim].[GetFilterSQLAncillaryParameterName]();

    SELECT @exists = 1, 
           @requestKey = [r].[RequestKey], 
           @requestStatus = [r].[Status],
           @serviceIdStored = [r].[serviceId],
           @servicePartitionIdStored = [r].[servicePartitionId],
           @targetKeyStored = [r].[targetKey],
           @creatorKeyStored = [r].[creator],
           @operationStored = [r].[operation]
    FROM [fim].[Request] [r]
    WHERE  [r].[RequestMarker] = @requestMarker;

    SET @rowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

    SELECT @targetIdentifierStored = [fim].[ObjectIDFromObjectKey](@targetKeyStored);
    SELECT @creatorStored = [fim].[ObjectIDFromObjectKey](@creatorKeyStored);

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *   Request can't be recovered if it is not in validation status  
 *   Also main attributes of request should be equal to store atrributes in Request table
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

    IF (@requestStatus != 1 OR @rowCount != 1 OR @exists != 1 OR @requestKey IS NULL 
        OR @serviceId != @serviceIdStored OR @servicePartitionId != @servicePartitionIdStored OR @targetIdentifier != @targetIdentifierStored
        OR @creator != @creatorStored OR @operation != @operationStored)
    BEGIN
       SET @canBeRecovered = 0;
       RETURN
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *   Checking parameters
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    DECLARE @attribute TABLE
    (
         [ValueText]        NVARCHAR(MAX)
    ); 
    DECLARE @requestParameterAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @requestParameterAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestParameter');

    IF(@parameters IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN
        WITH XMLNAMESPACES 
        (
            'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance' AS [xsi],
            'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'          AS [xsd],
            'http://microsoft.com/wsdl/types/'          AS [q1]
        )
