        INSERT INTO @attribute
        SELECT DISTINCT
            (
                SELECT 
                    requestParameter.value('@xsi:type',                     'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS '@xsi:type',
                    requestParameter.value('(Target/text())[1]',                    'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Target',
                    requestParameter.value('(Calculated/text())[1]',                'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Calculated',
                    requestParameter.value('(PropertyName/text())[1]',              'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'PropertyName',
                    requestParameter.value('(Value/@xsi:type)[1]',                  'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Value/@xsi:type',
                    requestParameter.value('(Value/text())[1]',                     'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Value',
                    requestParameter.value('(Operation/text())[1]',                 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Operation',
                    requestParameter.value('(Mode/text())[1]',                      'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Mode',
                    requestParameter.value('(WorkflowDefinition/Value/@xsi:type)[1]','NVARCHAR(MAX)')   AS 'WorkflowDefinition/Value/@xsi:type',
                    requestParameter.value('(WorkflowDefinition/Value/text())[1]',  'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'WorkflowDefinition/Value'
                FOR XML PATH('RequestParameter')
            )
        FROM @parameters.nodes('/RequestParameters/RequestParameter') Root(requestParameter);
    END

    IF EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM @attribute [parameter]
             FULL JOIN 
            ( 
                 SELECT DISTINCT
                    [ValueText]
                 FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] [r]
                 WHERE [r].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey AND
                       [r].[AttributeKey] = @requestParameterAttributeKey
            ) [parameterStored] ON [parameter].[ValueText] = [parameterStored].[ValueText]
        WHERE [parameter].[ValueText] IS NULL OR [parameterStored].[ValueText] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @canBeRecovered = 0;
        RETURN
    END


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *   Checking ancillary parameters. We skip @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName parameter
     as it is computed
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    DECLARE @ancillaryParameterTable TABLE
    (
        [requestKey] BIGINT,
        [name] NVARCHAR(448),
        [value] NVARCHAR(MAX)
    );

    IF(@ancillaryParameters IS NOT NULL)    
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @ancillaryParameterTable
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [Name],
            Value
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @requestKey,
            Root.ancillaryParameter.value('(PropertyName/text())[1]','NVARCHAR(448)'),
            Root.ancillaryParameter.value('(Value/text())[1]','NVARCHAR(MAX)')
        FROM @ancillaryParameters.nodes('/AncillaryParameters/RequestParameter') Root(ancillaryParameter);
    END

    IF EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM @ancillaryParameterTable [parameter]
             FULL JOIN 
            ( 
                 SELECT DISTINCT
                    [RequestKey],
                    [Name],
                    Value
                 FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] [r]
                 WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
				       AND [r].[Name] != @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName
            ) [parameterStored] ON [parameter].[requestKey] = [parameterStored].[RequestKey] AND 
                               [parameter].[Name] = [parameterStored].[Name] AND
                               [parameter].[Value] = [parameterStored].[Value]
        WHERE [parameter].[requestKey] IS NULL OR [parameterStored].[RequestKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @canBeRecovered = 0;
        RETURN
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *   Request can't be recovered if it has computed membership conditions 
 *   we do not check RequestOutputReference with ComputedMember attribute key
 *   because it can be populated before validation stage and
 *   no duplicates inserted on validation stage
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF 
    (
        EXISTS
        (
           SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
           FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] [r]
           WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        OR EXISTS 
        (
           SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
           FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] [r]
           WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        OR EXISTS 
        (
           SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
           FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] [r]
           WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
    )
    BEGIN
       SET @canBeRecovered = 0;
       RETURN
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *   Request can't be recovered if it has computed MPR's or assosiated workflows
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

     IF 
    (
        EXISTS 
        (
           SELECT [ovr].[ObjectKey]
           FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] [ovr]
           WHERE [ovr].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                 AND 
                 (
                       [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @mprAttributeKey
                    OR [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @authenticationWorkflowAttributeKey
                    OR [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @authorizationWorkflowAttributeKey
                    OR [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorkflowAttributeKey
                 )
        )
        OR EXISTS 
        (
           SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
           FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] [r]
           WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        OR EXISTS 
        (
           SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
           FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] [r]
           WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
    )
    BEGIN
       SET @canBeRecovered = 0;
       RETURN
    END


    IF (@exists = 1)
    BEGIN
       SELECT @requestID = [fim].[ObjectIDFromObjectKey](@requestKey);
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CreateCollateralRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CreateCollateralRequest] 
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @servicePartitionId SMALLINT,
    @targetIdentifier  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @creator    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @anonymous    BIT,
    @operation    NVARCHAR(448),
    @parameters    XML     = NULL,
    @ancillaryParameters XML     = NULL,
    @displayNameTemplate NVARCHAR(448),
    @locale     NVARCHAR(448)  = NULL,
    @cause     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @requestMarker    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @isChildRequest   BIT     = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT                 = 0,
    @requestIdentifier  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER   OUTPUT,
    @displayName   NVARCHAR(448)    OUTPUT,
    @targetObjectTypeName NVARCHAR(448)    OUTPUT,
    @time     DATETIME     OUTPUT
AS
-- Top level
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    SET NOCOUNT ON

    SELECT  @displayName = NULL,            -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @requestIdentifier = NULL,      -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @targetObjectTypeName = NULL,   -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @time = NULL;                   -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    BEGIN TRY

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Create the Request  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        --NOTE:  [fim].[DoRequestCreation] handles its own Transaction.
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoRequestCreation]
            @serviceId,
            @servicePartitionId = @servicePartitionId,
            @targetIdentifier = @targetIdentifier OUTPUT,
            @creator = @creator,
            @anonymous = @anonymous,
            @operation = @operation,
            @parameters = @parameters,
            @ancillaryParameters = @ancillaryParameters,
            @displayNameTemplate = @displayNameTemplate, 
            @locale = @locale,
            @doSetTransitions = 1,
            @cause = @cause,
            @requestMarker = @requestMarker,
            @isChildRequest = @isChildRequest,
            @trace = @trace,
            @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT,
            @displayName = @displayName OUTPUT,
            @targetObjectTypeName = @targetObjectTypeName OUTPUT,
            @time = @time OUTPUT;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Process the special SystemEventRequst Parameters  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        
        DECLARE 
                @actionWorkflowInstanceAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @acquiredLock SMALLINT,
                @cancelCauseKey BIGINT,
                @causeKey BIGINT,
                @didMarkForCancel BIT,
                @isCanceled BIT,
                @lockName NVARCHAR(32),
                @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),
                @requestCancelReasonMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),                
                @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning NVARCHAR(16),
                @requestControlCancelActionWorkflowKey TINYINT,
                @requestKey BIGINT,    
                @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @trueFlag BIT;

        SELECT  
                @actionWorkflowInstanceAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ActionWorkflowInstance'),
                @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @isCanceled = 0,
                @lockName = N'PolicyApplication',
                @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning = [fim].[RequestStatusDetailLevelWarning](),
                @requestControlCancelActionWorkflowKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlCancelActionWorkflow]()),
                @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
                

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @requestIdentifier,
            @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @requestKey OUTPUT;

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
           @objectID = @cause,
            @objectKey = @causeKey OUTPUT;

        --DESIGN POINT:  @operation = N'SystemEvent' to allow us to bypass rights checks

        DECLARE @systemEventRequestParameter TABLE
        (
            [WorkflowDefinition] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
        );

        IF(@parameters IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @systemEventRequestParameter
            (
                [WorkflowDefinition]
            )
            SELECT Root.requestParameter.value('.', 'UNIQUEIDENTIFIER')
            FROM @parameters.nodes('/RequestParameters/RequestParameter/WorkflowDefinition/Value') Root(requestParameter);

            IF( @@ROWCOUNT >0)
            BEGIN
                --DESIGN POINT:  Need to lock [fim].PolicyApplication from Canceling until we finish processing this request
                EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                    @Resource = @lockName,
                    @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                    @LockOwner = N'Transaction'
                    
                IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
                    RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                END
                
                DECLARE workflowDefinitionCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
                SELECT 
                    [WorkflowDefinition]
                FROM @systemEventRequestParameter 

                DECLARE @workflowDefinitionIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
                DECLARE @workflowDefinitionKey BIGINT;

                DECLARE @workflowDefinitionVersionKey INT;
                
                DECLARE @workflowInstanceIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
                DECLARE @workflowInstanceKey BIGINT;
                        
                DECLARE @workflowDefinitionObjectKey SMALLINT;
                SELECT @workflowDefinitionObjectKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');
                
                DECLARE @managementPolicyKey BIGINT;
                
                DECLARE @managementPolicyAttributeKey SMALLINT;
                SELECT @managementPolicyAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ManagementPolicy');
                
                DECLARE @creatorKey BIGINT;
                EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                    @objectID = @creator,
                    @objectKey = @creatorKey OUTPUT;
                              
                DECLARE @targetKey BIGINT;
                EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                    @objectID = @targetIdentifier,
                    @objectKey = @targetKey OUTPUT;
            
                 DECLARE @workflowTypeAction TINYINT;
                 SELECT @workflowTypeAction = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey]([fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]());
            

                OPEN workflowDefinitionCursor;
                WHILE(1=1)
                BEGIN 
                    SELECT @workflowDefinitionIdentifier = NULL;
                    SELECT @workflowInstanceIdentifier = NULL;

                    FETCH NEXT FROM 
                    workflowDefinitionCursor 
                    INTO @workflowDefinitionIdentifier;

                    IF(@workflowDefinitionIdentifier IS NULL)
                    BEGIN
                        BREAK;
                    END

                    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                        @objectID = @workflowDefinitionIdentifier,
                        @objectTypeKey = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey,
                        @objectKey = @workflowDefinitionKey OUTPUT;

                    --DESIGN POINT:  The PolicyApplication table data was used to create this request
                    -- so we are just trying to match up the two

                    SELECT 
                        @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = [pa].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                        @managementPolicyKey = [pa].[ManagementPolicyRuleKey],
                        @isCanceled = [pa].[IsCanceled]
                    FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication] AS [pa]
                    WHERE
                            [pa].[WorkflowDefinitionKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey
                        AND [pa].[TargetKey] = @targetKey
                        AND [pa].[RequestKey] = @causeKey
                        AND [pa].[ServiceId] IS NOT NULL

                    IF(@workflowDefinitionVersionKey IS NULL)
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Workflow definition version key ' + CAST(@workflowDefinitionVersionKey AS NVARCHAR(9)) + ' no longer exists in PolicyApplication Table.');
                        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    END
                        
                    INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
                    (
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [ObjectTypeKey],
                        [AttributeKey],
                        [ValueReference],
                        [Multivalued]
                    )
                    VALUES
                    (
                        @requestKey,
                        @requestObjectTypeKey,
                        @managementPolicyAttributeKey,
                        @managementPolicyKey,
                        @trueFlag -- ManagementPolicy is Multivalued, no need for lookup
                    );
     
                    EXECUTE [fim].[DoCreateWorkflowInstance] 
                        @workflowDefinitionKey = NULL,
                        @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey,
                        @requestKey = @requestKey,
                        @principalKey = @creatorKey,  -- @creator must be the ParentRequest Creator so the workflow has the same rights as the original request.
                        @targetKey = @targetKey,
                        @workflowType = @workflowTypeAction,
                        @processingTime = @time,
                        @workflowInstanceKey = @workflowInstanceKey OUTPUT,
                        @workflowInstanceIdentifier = @workflowInstanceIdentifier OUTPUT;

                    -- Remove the entry from PolicyApplication since this workflow is now committed in the database
                    DELETE [fim].[PolicyApplication]
                    WHERE 
                            [RequestKey] = @causeKey
                        AND [WorkflowDefinitionKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey
                        AND [TargetKey] = @targetKey
                        AND [ServiceId] IS NOT NULL

                END
                CLOSE workflowDefinitionCursor;
                DEALLOCATE workflowDefinitionCursor;
            END
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C.1 Commit it  
        *     By design we are skipping the [doEvaulateRequest] call that
        *     a normal request goes through because we don't want setTransitions to occur
        *     and we only want a single ActionWorkflow to be created.        
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @requestDependencyKey TINYINT;
        DECLARE @committedRequestStatusKey SMALLINT;
        DECLARE @committedTime DATETIME;

        
        DECLARE @resourceKey BIGINT;
    
        -- We are good to go so commit this change.
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoProcessRequest]      
            @requestKey = @requestKey,
            @includeResourceInActionWorkflowCreation = 0,
            @instantiateWorkflowInstances = 0,
            @resourceKey = @resourceKey OUTPUT,
            @requestDependencyKey = @requestDependencyKey OUTPUT,
            @committedRequestStatusKey = @committedRequestStatusKey OUTPUT,
            @committedTime = @committedTime OUTPUT;
      
        --ProcessRequest will stamp the Request CommittedTime to the same time that it stamps the creation of the object
        --so update the output var of this procedure to match this time. 
        SELECT @time = @committedTime

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C.2 If the parent request is canceled, then cancel this Request so the
        *     Workflow does not execute.  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF(@isCanceled = 1)
        BEGIN
        
            -- By design the input arg to this stored procedure (@cause) is the ParentRequest.
            -- If @isCanceled is true, this means that another Request has Canceled the ParentRequest.
            -- Therefore we need to cancel this CollateralRequest and pass in the Request that canceled the parentRequest
            -- as the @causeKey value.  We can look up this value as follows:  
            SELECT @cancelCauseKey = [CauseKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking]
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @causeKey;

            SELECT @requestCancelReasonMessage = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonParentRequestWasCanceled](@requestKey);                          

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoCancelRequest] 
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @requestControlKey = @requestControlCancelActionWorkflowKey, -- This Request is post commit.
                @causeKey = @cancelCauseKey,
                @reason = @requestCancelReasonMessage,
                @reasonDetailLevel = @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning,
                @recordRequestControl = 1,
                @didMarkForCancel = @didMarkForCancel OUTPUT;

            SELECT @committedRequestStatusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([ValueString])
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
            WHERE
                    [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey;
            
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D. Provide data to middle Tier to pick-up the new workflow Instance
        * and/or the current State of this request so it can dispatch it properly.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        --This matches the format of [fim].EvaluateRequest 
        SELECT
            NULL AS [RuleIdentifier],
            [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([reference].[ValueReference]) AS [ActionWorkflowInstanceIdentifier] 
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [reference]
        WHERE
                [reference].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [reference].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [reference].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorkflowInstanceAttributeKey;

        --NOTE A collateral Request has no dependencies so not returning it as 2nd column below.
        SELECT @committedRequestStatusKey;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH

        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END

        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH     
        
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CreateExpectedRuleEntry]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CreateExpectedRuleEntry]
    @serviceId                      SMALLINT,
    @servicePartitionId             SMALLINT,
    @expectedRuleEntryIdentifier    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @creatorIdentifier              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @parentRequestIdentifier        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @displayNameTemplate            NVARCHAR(448),
    @parameters                     XML
AS
    -- Top level
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON

    BEGIN TRY

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Declare and initialize variables.  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        DECLARE @requestIdentifier                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @requestMarker                          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @causeComputedValue                     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @isChildRequestComputedValue            BIT,
                @requestKey                             BIGINT,
                @expectedRuleEntryKey                   BIGINT,
                @expectedRuleEntryObjectTypeKey         SMALLINT,
                @createdTimeAttributeKey                SMALLINT,        
                @requestObjectTypeKey                   SMALLINT, 				
                @committedTime                          DATETIME,
                @committedStatus                        NVARCHAR(448),
                @completedStatus                        NVARCHAR(448), 
                @targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection]);      

        SELECT
            @createdTimeAttributeKey        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
            @expectedRuleEntryObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'ExpectedRuleEntry'),            
            @requestObjectTypeKey           = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),             
            @committedStatus                = [fim].[RequestStatusCommitted](),
            @completedStatus                = [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]();
            
        IF 
        (
            @parentRequestIdentifier IS NULL
            OR @parentRequestIdentifier = [fim].[GetEmptyGuid]()
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @causeComputedValue = @creatorIdentifier,
                @isChildRequestComputedValue = NULL;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @causeComputedValue = @parentRequestIdentifier,
                @isChildRequestComputedValue = 1;
        END        
            
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Create Expected Rule Entry object key
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
               
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID       = @expectedRuleEntryIdentifier,
            @objectTypeKey  = @expectedRuleEntryObjectTypeKey,
            @objectKey      = @expectedRuleEntryKey OUTPUT;     
            

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Create request object & cache resource parameters
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/       
        SELECT @requestMarker = NEWID();

        EXECUTE [fim].[DoRequestCreation]
            @serviceId              = @serviceId,
            @servicePartitionId     = @servicePartitionId,
            @targetIdentifier       = @expectedRuleEntryIdentifier OUTPUT,
            @creator                = @creatorIdentifier,
            @anonymous              = 0,
            @operation              = N'Create',
            @parameters             = @parameters,
            @displayNameTemplate    = @displayNameTemplate,
            @doSetTransitions       = 1,
            @cause                  = @causeComputedValue,        
            @requestMarker          = @requestMarker,     
            @isChildRequest         = @isChildRequestComputedValue,
            @requestIdentifier      = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT;        
                                     
   
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;        
           
            EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                @objectID           = @requestIdentifier,
                @objectTypeKey      = @requestObjectTypeKey,
                @objectKey          = @requestKey OUTPUT; 
                            
             
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
             * D. Set ExpectedRuleEntry Created Time to Committed Time. 
             *    (From [fim].[DoProcessRequest]          
             *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/  
                             
            SET  @committedTime    = GETUTCDATE();
            
            UPDATE  [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime]
            SET     [ValueDateTime] = @committedTime
            WHERE   [AttributeKey]  = @createdTimeAttributeKey
            AND     [ObjectKey]     = @expectedRuleEntryKey
            AND     [RequestKey]    = @requestKey;    

                
                
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * E. Move cached parameters from cache tables to persistent data tables.
            *    (From [fim].DoProcessRequest) 
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                 
                                             
            EXECUTE [fim].[UpdateResource]        
                @requestKey         = @requestKey,
                @resourceKey        = @expectedRuleEntryKey,
                @localeKey          = NULL,
                @time               = NULL;  
                
 
             /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
             * F. Mark Request object as Committed and set Committed Time to match Created Time of
             *    ExpectedRuleEntry. 
             *    This ensures the date-time stamp on the target matches the Request Committed
             *    date-time stamp for searches. 
             *    (From [fim].[DoProcessRequest]          
             *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                            
            
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest] 
                @requestKey     = @requestKey,
                @targetKey      = NULL,
                @committedTime  = @committedTime,
                @status         = @committedStatus,
                @causeKey       = NULL;          
                
              
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * G. Trigger any necessary set transitions for the ExpectedRuleEntry resource. 
            *    (From [fim].[PostProcessUpdate] 
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
             
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoSystemObjectSetTransitions]
                @objectKey      = @expectedRuleEntryKey,
                @objectTypeKey  = @expectedRuleEntryObjectTypeKey;            
                
                
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * H. Log request creation.  
            *    (From [fim].[PostProcessUpdate]         
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/  
            EXEC [fim].[GetTargetObjectsForRequest] 
                @requestKey = @requestKey, 
                @targetObjects = @targetsXml OUTPUT;
                                         
            EXECUTE [fim].[AddRequestLog]
                @requestKey = @requestKey,  
                @targetsXml = @targetsXml;        
                
                
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * I. Mark request as completed
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/             
       
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest] 
                @requestKey     = @requestKey,
                @targetKey      = NULL,
                @committedTime  = NULL,
                @status         = @completedStatus,
                @causeKey       = NULL;
                  
                
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * J. Commit the transaction.  
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
         
       COMMIT TRANSACTION;
       
    END TRY
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * K. Handle any errors that might have occured.  
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
          ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CreateMembershipCondition]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CreateMembershipCondition] 
    @membershipCondition    NVARCHAR(MAX), 
    @membershipConditionKey INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
            @falseFlag                          BIT,
            @identifierAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
            @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @objectTypeAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
            @sql                                NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @requestTimeSQL                     NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @statementKeyString                 NVARCHAR(448),
            @trueFlag                           BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @membershipConditionKey = NULL;
    
    IF(@membershipCondition IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'membershipCondition');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    DECLARE @membershipConditionDocument XML
    SET @membershipConditionDocument = CAST(@membershipCondition AS XML)

    IF(@membershipConditionDocument IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'membershipCondition');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),        
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);


    DECLARE @invalidStatement TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey] INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );
    
    DECLARE @partitioningStatementKey TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey] INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );
    
    DECLARE @statementBuffer TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey] INT
    );
    
    DECLARE @statementKey TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey] INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );
    
    DECLARE @type TABLE
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );
    
    DECLARE @tabularType TABLE
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );

    INSERT INTO @statementBuffer
        SELECT 
            Statements.statementKey.value('.','INT')
        FROM @membershipConditionDocument.nodes('/MembershipCondition/Statements/Key') Statements(statementKey);
        
    IF  NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM @statementBuffer AS [statement]
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'membershipCondition');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @statementKey
        (
            [StatementKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [buffer].[StatementKey]
        FROM @statementBuffer AS [buffer];
    END
    
    INSERT INTO @invalidStatement
    (
        [StatementKey]
    )
    SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
    FROM @statementKey AS [statement];
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM @invalidStatement AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM @invalidStatement AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM @invalidStatement AS [statement]
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'membershipCondition');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    -- The ordered concatenated statement keys uniquely define membership condition
    SELECT @statementKeyString  = 
    (
        SELECT [statements].[StatementKey] AS 's'
        FROM @statementKey AS [statements]
        ORDER BY  [statements].[StatementKey]
        FOR XML PATH('')
    );

    -- Prevent silent truncation in the unlikely case that there are more than 40 statements
    IF (LEN(@statementKeyString) > 448)
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'membershipCondition');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    SELECT @membershipConditionKey = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
    FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [mc]
    WHERE [mc].[MembershipConditionStatements] = @statementKeyString;
    
    IF @membershipConditionKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM @statementKey AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
            ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @partitioningStatementKey
        (
            [StatementKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM @statementKey AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
            ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey];
            
        DELETE [statement]
        FROM @statementKey AS [statement]
        INNER JOIN @partitioningStatementKey AS [partition]
            ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey];
    END

    INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipCondition]
    (
        [StatementCount],
        [MembershipConditionStatements]
    )
    SELECT 
        COUNT([sk].[StatementKey]),
        @statementKeyString
    FROM @statementKey AS [sk];
    
    SET @membershipConditionKey = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM @partitioningStatementKey AS [statement]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition]
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [StatementKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @membershipConditionKey,
            [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM @partitioningStatementKey AS [statement];
    END
    
    INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement]
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey],
        [StatementKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @membershipConditionKey,
        [sk].StatementKey
    FROM @statementKey AS [sk]; 
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [mcot].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [mcot]
        WHERE [mcot].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [mcot]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [mcot]
        WHERE [mcot].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [oti].[Key]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mc] 
            ON  [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mc].StatementKey
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
            ON  [mcs].[LiteralValueString] = [oti].[Name]
        WHERE   
                [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[LiteralValueString] IS NOT NULL
            AND [mcs].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @type
        (
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [oti].[Key]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mc] 
            ON  [mcs].StatementKey = [mc].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
            ON  [mcs].[LiteralValueString] = [oti].[Name]
        WHERE   
                [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NULL;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [oti].[Key]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mc] 
            ON  [mcs].StatementKey = [mc].StatementKey
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [value]
            ON  [mcs].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
            ON  [value].[Value] = [oti].[Name]
        WHERE   
                [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @tabularType
        (
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [oti].[Key]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mc] 
            ON  [mcs].StatementKey = [mc].StatementKey
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [value]
            ON  [mcs].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
            ON  [value].[Value] = [oti].[Name]
        WHERE   
                [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL;
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT  [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            FROM @tabularType AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN @type AS [duplicate]
                ON  [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM @tabularType AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN @type AS [duplicate]
                ON  [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT  [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            FROM @tabularType AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @type
            (
                [ObjectTypeKey]
            )
            SELECT  [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            FROM @tabularType AS [candidate]
        END
    END

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [t].[ObjectTypeKey]
        FROM @type AS [t]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType]
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @membershipConditionKey,
            -1
        );
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType]
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        )
            SELECT
                @membershipConditionKey,
                [t].[ObjectTypeKey]
            FROM @type AS [t];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND    
                (
                        [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                    OR  
                        (
                                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                            AND [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                            AND [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NULL
                        )
                )
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND 
                (   
                        (
                                [statement].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
                            AND [statement].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
                        )
                    OR
                        (
                                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                            AND    
                                (
                                        [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
                                    OR  [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                                )
                        )
                )
    )
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                        [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
                    AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute]
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [ByObjectIdentifier],
                [ByObjectType]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @membershipConditionKey,
                @trueFlag,
                @falseFlag
            );
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                WHERE
                            [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
                        AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute]
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [ByObjectIdentifier],
                    [ByObjectType]
                )
                VALUES
                (
                    @membershipConditionKey,
                    @falseFlag,
                    @trueFlag
                );
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute]
                (
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [ByObjectIdentifier],
                    [ByObjectType]
                )
                VALUES
                (
                    @membershipConditionKey,
                    @trueFlag,
                    @trueFlag
                );
            END
        END
    END    
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateMembershipConditionAttributeSignature] 
        @membershipConditionKey = @membershipConditionKey;
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CreateMembershipConditionReferent]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CreateMembershipConditionReferent] 
	@baseReferentKey		INT, 
	@baseReferentAttribute	NVARCHAR(448),
	@referentKey			INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000);
	DECLARE @attributeKey SMALLINT;
	
	IF(@baseReferentAttribute IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			@attributeKey = a.[Key]
		FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS a
		WHERE a.[Name] = @baseReferentAttribute;
	END
	
	IF((@baseReferentKey IS NULL)OR(@baseReferentAttribute IS NULL)OR(@attributeKey IS NULL))
	BEGIN
		IF(@baseReferentKey IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'baseReferentKey');
			RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
			RETURN;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'baseReferentAttribute');
			RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
			RETURN;
		END
	END
	
	SELECT 
		@referentKey = a.ReferentKey
	FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionReferent] AS a
	WHERE 
	(
		(a.BaseReferentKey = @baseReferentKey)
		AND
		(a.AttributeKey = @attributeKey)
	);
	
	IF(@referentKey IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		RETURN;
	END

	INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionReferent]
	(
		BaseReferentKey,
		AttributeKey
	)
	VALUES
	(
		@baseReferentKey, 
		@attributeKey
	);
	SET @referentKey = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CreateMembershipConditionStatement]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CreateMembershipConditionStatement]
    @xpath                                      NVARCHAR(MAX), 
    @referentKey                                INT, 
    @attribute                                  NVARCHAR(448), 
    @operatorEqual                              BIT, 
    @operatorGreater                            BIT, 
    @operatorLike                               BIT, 
    @operatorInversion                          BIT, 
    @literalValueBoolean                        BIT                 =   NULL, 
    @literalValueDateTime                       DATETIME            =   NULL, 
    @literalValueInteger                        BIGINT              =   NULL, 
    @literalValueReference                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    =   NULL, 
    @literalValueString                         NVARCHAR(MAX)       =   NULL, 
    @functionValue                              NVARCHAR(MAX)       =   NULL, 
    @missingValue                               BIT                 =   0, 
    @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys   NVARCHAR(MAX)       =   NULL, 
    @dereferencedValueAttribute                 NVARCHAR(448)       =   NULL, 
    @recursivelyDereferencedAttribute           NVARCHAR(448)       =   NULL, 
    @recursionFrom                              BIT, 
    @recursionTo                                BIT, 
    @attributes                                 NVARCHAR(MAX), 
    @trace                                      BIT                 =   0, 
    @statementKey                               INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @attributesDocument                 XML,
        @currentDay                         DATETIME,
        @dataTypeKey                        TINYINT,
        @dereferencedValueAttributeKey      SMALLINT,
        @dereferencedValueObjectKey         BIGINT,
        @functionValueKey                   INT,
        @identifierAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
        @indexedString                      NVARCHAR(448),
        @membershipConditionKeysDocument    XML,
        @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeKey                      SMALLINT,
        @targetReferentKey                  INT,
        @trueFlag                           BIT,
        @falseFlag                          BIT,
        @attributeKey                       SMALLINT,    
        @literalValueReferenceKey           BIGINT,
        @positiveCounterpartStatementKey    INT,
        @startTime                          DATETIME;
        
    SELECT
        @trueFlag   =   CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @falseFlag  =   CONVERT(BIT,0);
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    IF @literalValueReference IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID=@literalValueReference, 
            @objectKey=@literalValueReferenceKey OUTPUT;
    END    
        
    SELECT
        @currentDay = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS DECIMAL(12, 5))) AS DATETIME),
        @targetReferentKey = [fim].[GetMembershipConditionTargetReferentKey](),
        @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *    A.    Validate input
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
    IF @xpath IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'xpath');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    IF @referentKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'referentKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *    B.    Determine if this statement already exists
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
     SELECT
        @statementKey = [stmt].[StatementKey]
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [stmt]
    WHERE 
            [stmt].[XPath] = @xpath
        AND 
        (
            (
                @referentKey = @targetReferentKey
                AND
                [stmt].[ReferentKey] IS NULL
            )
            OR
            (
                [stmt].[ReferentKey] IS NOT NULL
                AND
                [stmt].[ReferentKey] = @referentKey
            )
        )
        AND [stmt].[OperatorInversion] = @operatorInversion
        AND [stmt].[MissingValue] = @missingValue;
    
    IF @statementKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *    C.    Validate the statement
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                

    IF @referentKey != @targetReferentKey
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [mcr].[ReferentKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionReferent] AS [mcr]
            WHERE
                    [mcr].[ReferentKey] = @referentKey
                AND [mcr].[BaseReferentKey] = @targetReferentKey
        )
        BEGIN
            --This condition enforces a restriction against complex referents to facilitate simplification
            --of membership condition evaluation.  
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidMembershipConditionStatementReferentException]();
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END
        
        SELECT TOP 1 @attributeKey = [mcr].[AttributeKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionReferent] AS [mcr]
        WHERE
                [mcr].[ReferentKey] = @referentKey;
        
    END
    
    SELECT @referentKey = NULL;
    
    IF @attributes IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'attributes');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    SELECT @attributesDocument = CAST(@attributes AS XML)

    IF @attributesDocument IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'attributes');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    DECLARE @attributeName TABLE
    (
        AttributeName NVARCHAR(448)
    );

    INSERT INTO @attributeName
        SELECT DISTINCT
            Attributes.attribute.value('.','NVARCHAR(448)')
        FROM @attributesDocument.nodes('/Statement/Attributes/Attribute') Attributes(attribute);
    
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT a.AttributeName
        FROM @attributeName AS a
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'attributes');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT a.AttributeName
        FROM @attributeName AS a
        WHERE 
                a.AttributeName NOT IN
                (
                    SELECT [ai].[Name]
                    FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                )
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'attributes');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @attribute IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF @attribute = N'ComputedMember'
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidMembershipConditionStatementAttributeException](@attribute);
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END
            
        IF @attributeKey IS NOT NULL 
        BEGIN
            --The attribute key was derived from the referent.  
            IF @attribute != N'ObjectID'
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidMembershipConditionStatementReferentException]();
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                RETURN;
            END
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @attributeKey = [a].[Key]
            FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [a]
            WHERE [a].[Name] = @attribute;
        END
    END

    IF @attributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'attributes');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @attributeKey = @objectTypeAttributeKey
    BEGIN
        SELECT @objectTypeKey = [oti].[Key]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
        WHERE
                [oti].[Name] = @literalValueString;
        
        IF @objectTypeKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'attributes');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END
    END
    
    SELECT @dataTypeKey = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromAttributeKey](@attributeKey);

    IF
    (
        @operatorEqual IS NULL 
        OR
        @operatorGreater IS NULL
        OR
        @operatorLike IS NULL
        OR
        @operatorInversion IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'operator');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    IF(
        (
            (
                @operatorEqual = @falseFlag
                AND
                @operatorGreater = @falseFlag
                AND
                @operatorLike = @falseFlag
            )
        )
        OR
        (
            @operatorEqual = @trueFlag
            AND
            (
                @operatorGreater = @trueFlag
                OR
                @operatorLike = @trueFlag
            )
        )
        OR
        (
            @operatorGreater = @trueFlag
            AND
            (
                @operatorEqual = @trueFlag
                OR
                @operatorLike = @trueFlag
            )
        )
        OR
        (
            @operatorLike = @trueFlag
            AND
            (
                @operatorEqual = @trueFlag
                OR
                @operatorGreater = @trueFlag
            )
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'operator');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    IF(
        (
            @literalValueBoolean IS NULL
            AND
            @literalValueDateTime IS NULL
            AND
            @literalValueInteger IS NULL
            AND
            @literalValueReferenceKey IS NULL
            AND
            @literalValueString IS NULL
            AND
            @functionValue IS NULL
            AND
            @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
            @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueReferenceKey IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @functionValue IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
        OR
        (
            @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueReferenceKey IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @functionValue IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
        OR
        (
            @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL 
                OR
                @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueReferenceKey IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @functionValue IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
        OR
        (
            @literalValueReferenceKey IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @functionValue IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
        OR
        (
            @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueReferenceKey IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @functionValue IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
        OR
        (
            @functionValue IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                (
                    @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL
                    OR
                    @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL
                    OR
                    @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL
                    OR
                    @literalValueReferenceKey IS NOT NULL
                    OR
                    @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
                    OR
                    @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys IS NOT NULL
                )
                OR
                (
                    (LEN(@functionValue) > [fim].[MaximumIndexedUnicodeStringLength]())
                )
            )
        )
        OR
        (
            @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys IS NOT NULL
            AND
            (
                @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueReferenceKey IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
                OR
                @functionValue IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'value');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @membershipConditionKeysDocument = 
            CAST(@dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys AS XML)

        IF @membershipConditionKeysDocument IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END

        IF @dereferencedValueAttribute IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT @dereferencedValueAttributeKey = [ai].[Key]
            FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            WHERE
                    [ai].[Name] = @dereferencedValueAttribute;
            
            IF @dereferencedValueAttributeKey IS NULL
            OR @missingValue = @trueFlag
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'dereferencedValueAttribute');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                RETURN;
            END
        END
        
        DECLARE @recursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        IF @recursivelyDereferencedAttribute IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'recursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END
    END

    IF @dereferencedValueAttributeKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *    D.    Processing specific to dereferencing statements.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        DECLARE @membershipConditionDereferencedValue   TABLE
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey]                    INT
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @membershipConditionDereferencedValue
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey]
        )
        SELECT [MembershipCondition].[key].value('.','INT')
        FROM @membershipConditionKeysDocument.nodes('/Statement/DereferencedMembershipConditions/Key') [MembershipCondition]([key]);
        
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM @membershipConditionDereferencedValue AS [mcdv]
        )
        OR 
        (
            SELECT COUNT([mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey])
            FROM @membershipConditionDereferencedValue AS [mcdv]
        ) > 1
        OR
        (
            SELECT COUNT([mcmcs].[StatementKey])
            FROM @membershipConditionDereferencedValue AS [mcdv]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
                ON [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey]
        ) > 2
        OR EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [mcs].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
                ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN @membershipConditionDereferencedValue AS [mcdv]
                ON [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey]
            WHERE
                    [mcs].[AttributeKey] NOT IN
                    (
                        @identifierAttributeKey,
                        @objectTypeAttributeKey
                    )
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidMembershipConditionStatementDereferencedValueException]();
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END
        
        SELECT @dereferencedValueObjectKey = [fim].[GetMembershipConditionObjectKey]([mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey])
        FROM @membershipConditionDereferencedValue AS [mcdv];

        IF @dereferencedValueObjectKey IS NULL
        OR @dereferencedValueObjectKey < 0
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidMembershipConditionStatementDereferencedValueException]();
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [dereferencedSet].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetFilter] AS [dereferencedSet]
            WHERE
                    [dereferencedSet].[SetKey] = @dereferencedValueObjectKey
                AND [dereferencedSet].[Temporal] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatDereferencedTemporalResourceException]();
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END
    END    
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *    E.    Record the statement.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @functionValue IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [mcfv].[Function]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [mcfv]
            WHERE
                    [mcfv].[Function] = @functionValue
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @functionOutput TABLE
            (
                [Value] DATETIME
            );
            
            DECLARE @functionStatement NVARCHAR(MAX);
            SET @functionStatement = N'SELECT ' + @functionValue;
            INSERT INTO @functionOutput
                EXECUTE(@functionStatement);

            -- if @functionValue length more than 448 ([fim].[MaximumIndexedUnicodeStringLength]) the error should be raised in vaidating stage above (C. Validate the statement) 
            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue]
            (
                [Function],
                [Seed],
                [Value]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                CAST(@functionValue AS NVARCHAR(448)),
                @currentDay,
                [fo].[Value]
            FROM @functionOutput AS [fo]
        END
        
        SELECT @functionValueKey = [mcfv].[FunctionValueKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [mcfv]
        WHERE
                [mcfv].[Function] = @functionValue;
    END
                             
    INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement]
    (
        [XPath],
        [ReferentKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [OperatorEqual],
        [OperatorGreater],
        [OperatorLike],
        [OperatorInversion],
        [LiteralValueBoolean],
        [LiteralValueDateTime],
        [LiteralValueInteger],
        [LiteralValueReference],
        [LiteralValueString],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [FunctionValueKey],
        [MissingValue],
        [DereferencedValueObjectKey],
        [DereferencedValueAttributeKey],
        [RecursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey],
        [RecursionTo],
        [RecursionFrom],
        [DataTypeKey]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @xpath,
        CASE 
            WHEN @referentKey = @targetReferentKey THEN NULL
            ELSE @referentKey
        END,
        @attributeKey,
        @operatorEqual,
        @operatorGreater,
        @operatorLike,
        @operatorInversion,
        @literalValueBoolean,
        @literalValueDateTime,
        @literalValueInteger,
        @literalValueReferenceKey,
        @literalValueString,
        @objectTypeKey,
        @functionValueKey,
        @missingValue,
        @dereferencedValueObjectKey,
        @dereferencedValueAttributeKey,
        @recursivelyDereferencedAttributeKey,
        @recursionTo,
        @recursionFrom,
        @dataTypeKey
    );
    
    SET @statementKey = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

    INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementAttribute]
    (
        [StatementKey],
        [AttributeKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @statementKey,
        [ai].[Key]
    FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
    INNER JOIN @attributeName AS [an] 
        ON [ai].[Name] = an.AttributeName;
    
    INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionDereferencedValue]
    (
        [StatementKey],
        [MembershipConditionKey],
        [DereferencedObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT 
        @statementKey,
        [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey],
        @dereferencedValueObjectKey
    FROM @membershipConditionDereferencedValue AS [mcdv]
    
    IF
    (
        @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL
        OR
        @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL
        OR
        @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL
        OR
        @literalValueReferenceKey IS NOT NULL
        OR
        @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
        OR
        @functionValueKey IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *    F.    Processing specific to literal statements.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF
        (
                @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
            AND    LEN(@literalValueString) <= 448
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @indexedString = LEFT(@literalValueString,448);
            
            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString]
            (
                [StatementKey],
                [LiteralValueString]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @statementKey,
                @indexedString
            );
        END        
                        
        IF @operatorInversion = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *    F.1    For a negative literal statement, find or create the positive 
 *        counterpart.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                    
            SELECT TOP 1 @positiveCounterpartStatementKey = [mcs].[StatementKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            WHERE
                    [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                AND [mcs].[OperatorEqual] = @operatorEqual
                AND [mcs].[OperatorGreater] = @operatorGreater
                AND [mcs].[OperatorLike] = @operatorLike
                AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
                AND    
                (            
                    (
                        
                        @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL
                        AND
                        [mcs].LiteralValueBoolean = @literalValueBoolean
                    )
                    OR
                    (
                        @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL
                        AND
                        [mcs].LiteralValueDateTime = @literalValueDateTime
                    )
                    OR
                    (
                        @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL
                        AND
                        [mcs].LiteralValueInteger = @literalValueInteger
                    )
                    OR
                    (
                        @literalValueReferenceKey IS NOT NULL
                        AND
                        [mcs].LiteralValueReference = @literalValueReferenceKey
                    )
                    OR
                    (
                        @literalValueString IS NOT NULL
                        AND
                        [mcs].LiteralValueString = @literalValueString
                    )
                    OR
                    (
                        @functionValue IS NOT NULL
                        AND
                        [mcs].FunctionValueKey = @functionValueKey
                    )
                );
            
        
            IF(@positiveCounterpartStatementKey IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                EXECUTE [fim].[CreateMembershipConditionStatement]
                    @xpath=@xpath,
                    @referentKey=@targetReferentKey,
                    @attribute=@attribute,
                    @operatorEqual=@operatorEqual,
                    @operatorGreater=@operatorGreater,
                    @operatorLike=@operatorLike,
                    @operatorInversion=@falseFlag,
                    @literalValueBoolean=@literalValueBoolean,
                    @literalValueDateTime=@literalValueDateTime,
                    @literalValueInteger=@literalValueInteger,
                    @literalValueReference=@literalValueReference,
                    @literalValueString=@literalValueString,
                    @functionValue=@functionValue,
                    @missingValue=@falseFlag,
                    @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKeys=NULL, 
                    @dereferencedValueAttribute=NULL, 
                    @recursivelyDereferencedAttribute=NULL, 
                    @recursionFrom=NULL,
                    @recursionTo=NULL,
                    @attributes=@attributes,
                    @statementKey = @positiveCounterpartStatementKey OUTPUT;
            END
            
            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement]
            (
                NegativeStatementKey,
                PositiveStatementKey
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @statementKey,
                @positiveCounterpartStatementKey
            )
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *    F.2    For a positive literal statement, record the resources for which it 
 *        is true.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
            IF @attributeKey NOT IN
            (
                @identifierAttributeKey,
                @objectTypeAttributeKey
            )                    
            BEGIN
                EXECUTE [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                    @statementKey,
                    @attributeKey,
                    @operatorEqual,
                    @operatorGreater,
                    @operatorLike,
                    @literalValueBoolean,
                    @literalValueDateTime,
