                    @literalValueInteger,
                    @literalValueReferenceKey,
                    @literalValueString,
                    @functionValueKey,
                    @trace;
            END
        END
        
    END
  
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = 0, 
            @stage      = N'CreateMembershipConditionStatement';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CreateMembershipConditionTabularFunctionStatement]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CreateMembershipConditionTabularFunctionStatement]
    @tabularFunctionKey INT,
    @statementKey       INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE
        @attributeKey   SMALLINT,
        @attributeName  NVARCHAR(448),
        @dataTypeKey    TINYINT,
        @messageText    NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @trueFlag       BIT,
        @falseFlag      BIT;
    
    SELECT
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [function].[AttributeKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunction] AS [function]
        WHERE        [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @attributeKey = [function].[AttributeKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunction] AS [function]
        WHERE        [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionKey;
    END
    
    IF @attributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'tabularFunctionKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    SELECT 
        @attributeName = [fim].[AttributeNameFromKey](@attributeKey),
        @dataTypeKey = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromAttributeKey](@attributeKey);    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT    [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        WHERE        [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = @tabularFunctionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT    @statementKey = [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        WHERE        [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] = @tabularFunctionKey;
        
        RETURN;
    END    
    
    INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement]
    (
        [XPath],
        [AttributeKey],
        [OperatorEqual],
        [OperatorGreater],
        [OperatorLike],
        [OperatorInversion],
        [MissingValue],
        [RecursionTo],
        [RecursionFrom],
        [TabularFunctionValueKey],
        [DataTypeKey]
    )
    SELECT 
        N'f' + CAST(@tabularFunctionKey AS NVARCHAR(64)) + N'(' + @attributeName + N') = ' + [function].[ValueSignature],
        [function].[AttributeKey],
        @trueFlag,
        @falseFlag,
        @falseFlag,
        @falseFlag,
        @falseFlag,
        @falseFlag,
        @falseFlag,
        @tabularFunctionKey,
        @dataTypeKey
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunction] AS [function]
    WHERE        [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionKey;
    
    SELECT @statementKey = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    
    INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementAttribute]
    (
        [StatementKey],
        [AttributeKey]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @statementKey,
        @attributeKey
    );
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTabularFunctionTruth] 
        @statementKey = @statementKey, 
        @tabularFunctionKey = @tabularFunctionKey, 
        @attributeKey = @attributeKey;
    
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CreateObjectIdentifiers]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CreateObjectIdentifiers]
    @parameters XML(CONTENT [fim].[CreateObjectKeysCollection])
AS
    -- schema of @parameters is
    -- <Object TypeKey="17" Identifier="D55AF95C-1C23-4F84-B31E-4A2AA823E5F3" />
    -- <Object TypeKey="25" Identifier="D11F109C-B63A-43C7-91F6-3B5681AB99BC" />
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        @max INT, 
        @i INT,
        @objectTypeKey SMALLINT, 
        @objectIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @objectKey BIGINT;

    SELECT 
        @max = @parameters.query
         (
            '<count>
                 { count(/Object) }
             </count>'
         ).value('count[1]','int');

    SELECT @i = 1;

    WHILE @i <= @max 
    BEGIN

        SELECT 
            @objectTypeKey = Node.value('@TypeKey', 'BIGINT'),
            @objectIdentifier = Node.value('@Identifier', 'UNIQUEIDENTIFIER')
        FROM @parameters.nodes('/Object[position()=sql:variable("@i")]') TempXML (Node);

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]  
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            WHERE [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] = @objectIdentifier 
        )
        BEGIN   
            EXECUTE [fim].[AddObject]
                @objectTypeKey = @objectTypeKey,
                @objectID = @objectIdentifier OUTPUT,
                @objectKey = @objectKey OUTPUT; 
        END
                
        SET @i = @i + 1;
    END
	
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CreateObjectIdentifiersFromRequestParameters]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CreateObjectIdentifiersFromRequestParameters]
    @requestParameters XML
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE @objectKeyCreationParameters XML;
    SELECT @objectKeyCreationParameters =
    (
        SELECT
            [oti].[Key] AS [TypeKey],
            Root.requestParameter.value('(Target/text())[1]', 'UNIQUEIDENTIFIER') AS [Identifier]
        FROM @requestParameters.nodes('/RequestParameters/RequestParameter') Root(requestParameter)
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
            ON Root.requestParameter.value('(Value/text())[1]','NVARCHAR(MAX)') = [oti].[Name] 
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON Root.requestParameter.value('(Target/text())[1]', 'UNIQUEIDENTIFIER') = [o].[ObjectID] 
        WHERE 
                Root.requestParameter.value('(Operation/text())[1]',    'NVARCHAR(448)') = N'Create'
            AND Root.requestParameter.value('(PropertyName/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(448)') = N'ObjectType'
            AND [o].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
        FOR XML RAW ('Object')
    );
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[CreateObjectIdentifiers] 
        @parameters = @objectKeyCreationParameters;

END
GO

            @requestIdentifier = NULL,      -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    BEGIN TRY

	        @displayName = @displayName OUTPUT,
	        @targetObjectTypeName = @targetObjectTypeName OUTPUT,
	        @time = @time OUTPUT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        RETURN;
    END CATCH  
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[CreateWorkflowInstance]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- Top level
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[CreateWorkflowInstance]
    @workflowDefinitionIdentifier       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey       INT,
    @requestIdentifier                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @principalIdentifier                UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @targetIdentifier                   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @workflowType                       TINYINT,
    @workflowInstanceIdentifier         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    OUTPUT,
    @workflowDefinitionVersionKeyOut    INT                 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    SELECT  @workflowDefinitionVersionKeyOut = NULL,    -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @workflowInstanceIdentifier = NULL;         -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    BEGIN TRY

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
        DECLARE @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');
        
        DECLARE @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
    
        DECLARE @workflowDefinitionKey BIGINT;
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @workflowDefinitionIdentifier,
            @objectTypeKey = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @workflowDefinitionKey OUTPUT;

        DECLARE @requestKey BIGINT;
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @requestIdentifier,
            @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @requestKey OUTPUT;
      
        DECLARE @principalKey BIGINT;
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @principalIdentifier,
            @objectKey = @principalKey OUTPUT;
  
        DECLARE @targetKey BIGINT;
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @targetIdentifier,
            @objectKey = @targetKey OUTPUT;

        DECLARE @processingTime DATETIME;
        SELECT @processingTime = GETUTCDATE();
        
        DECLARE @workflowInstanceKey BIGINT;
        
        IF(@workflowDefinitionVersionKey IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = [fim].[GetCurrentWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey](@workflowDefinitionKey);
        END
        
        SELECT @workflowDefinitionVersionKeyOut = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey;
        
        BEGIN TRANSACTION

        EXECUTE [fim].[DoCreateWorkflowInstance]
            @workflowDefinitionKey,
            @workflowDefinitionVersionKey,
            @requestKey,
            @principalKey,
            @targetKey,
            @workflowType,
            @processingTime,
            @workflowInstanceKey OUTPUT,
            @workflowInstanceIdentifier OUTPUT

        COMMIT TRANSACTION    
    
    
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH     
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DeleteCompletedWorkItems]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DeleteCompletedWorkItems]
    @instanceId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
    --Top level
BEGIN
    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    *   Completed Work Items are marked with LockOwner = NULL and LockExpiration = CONVERT(DATETIME,'9999')
    *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        DECLARE @workflowInstanceObjectKey BIGINT,
                @workItemId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @instanceId,
            @objectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey OUTPUT;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        DECLARE @workItems TABLE
        (
            [WorkItemId] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
        )
        
        INSERT INTO @workItems
        (
            [WorkItemId]
        )
        SELECT [wisq].[WorkItemId]
        FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [wisq]
        WHERE
                [wisq].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
            AND [wisq].[Completed] = 1;
        
        -- Since we do not have CASCADE DELETE between [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
        -- and [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueueProperties] we cannot use single DELETE statement
        -- thus calling [fim].[DoDeleteWorkItem] in a loop
        SELECT TOP (1) @workItemId = [WorkItemId]
        FROM @workItems;
        
        WHILE (@@ROWCOUNT > 0)
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [wisq].[WorkItemId]
                FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [wisq]
                WHERE [wisq].[WorkItemId] = @workItemId
            )
            BEGIN
                EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteWorkItem]
                    @workItemId = @workItemId,
                    @instanceId = @instanceId,
                    @lockTimeout = -1;
            END
                
            DELETE @workItems
            WHERE [WorkItemId] = @workItemId;
             
            SELECT TOP (1) @workItemId = [WorkItemId]
            FROM @workItems;
        END
            
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        RETURN;
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DeleteExpiredSystemObjects]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DeleteExpiredSystemObjects]
    @requestLimit INT=20000
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    BEGIN TRY
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        DECLARE             
            @requestObjectTypeKey       SMALLINT,
            @reportingJobObjectTypeKey  SMALLINT,
            @expirationTimeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @time                       DATETIME,
            @foundKeys                  INT;

        SELECT  
            @requestObjectTypeKey       = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),             
            @reportingJobObjectTypeKey  = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmReportingJob'),            
            @expirationTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExpirationTime'),
            @time = GETUTCDATE();
            

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
         *	A.	Only gather new Key Values if previous keys have been deleted.
         *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        IF NOT EXISTS 
        ( 
            SELECT TOP 1 [ObjectKey] 
            FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] 
        )
        BEGIN
    		
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
             * B.	First gather the list of Request whose expiration time is less than 
             *      current time (i.e. the top @requestLimit expired requests will be
             *      considered). We always want to keep duplicates out.
             *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            )
            SELECT TOP (@requestLimit) [o].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [date]
                ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [date].[ObjectKey] 
            WHERE 
                    [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey                
                AND [date].[AttributeKey] = @expirationTimeAttributeKey 
                AND [date].[ValueDateTime] < @time;
        END
        
        -- Create temp table of system object types to optimize later join. 
        SELECT [oti].[Key] 
        INTO #SystemObjectTypeKeys
        FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti] 
        WHERE [fim].[IsExpiringSystemTypeKey] ([oti].[Key]) = 1	            


	/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	 * C.	Gather all non-Request system objects that reference the set of 
	 *      expired requests.
	 *      i.e based on 8/6/2009 schema this query will collect WorkflowInstance 
	 *      and Approval Objects which both have Request as a Reference Attribute
	 *      value.
	 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [o].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
            ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] AS [xid] 
            ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [xid].[ObjectKey]  -- references expired request
        INNER JOIN #SystemObjectTypeKeys AS [s]
            ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [s].[Key]
        WHERE
                [o].[ObjectTypeKey] != @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [o].[ObjectKey] NOT IN (
                                           SELECT [eok].[ObjectKey] 
                                           FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] AS [eok]
                                       );

	/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	 * D.	Gather all non-Request system objects that are referenced by the set 
	 *      of expired System Objects.
	 *      i.e. based on 8/6/2009 schema this query will find ApprovalResponse object
	 *      which has Approval as a Reference attribute.  
	 *      NOTE:  some objects have a two way reference (parent points to child 
	 *      and child points to parent) so this query will return rows that were 
	 *      already found in part (b) which will be duplicates in this table.
	 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
        (
			    [ObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [o].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
            ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ValueReference]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] AS [xid] 
            ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [xid].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN #SystemObjectTypeKeys AS [s]
            ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [s].[Key]
        WHERE
                [o].[ObjectTypeKey] != @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [o].[ObjectKey] NOT IN (
			                   SELECT [eok].[ObjectKey] 
			                   FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] AS [eok]
			               );

         /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * E.	Gather the set of Reporting Job objects that have expired and add them
         *      to the expired objects table if their object keys are not already there.
         *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
         INSERT INTO [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
         (
            [ObjectKey]
         )
         SELECT [objects].[ObjectKey] 
         FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
         INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [date]
            ON [objects].[ObjectKey] = [date].[ObjectKey] 
         WHERE 
               [objects].[ObjectTypeKey] = @reportingJobObjectTypeKey
           AND [date].[AttributeKey] = @expirationTimeAttributeKey 
           AND [date].[ValueDateTime] < @time
           AND [objects].[ObjectKey] NOT IN (
			                        SELECT [eok].[ObjectKey] 
			                        FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] AS [eok]
			                        );        
				
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * F.	Delete all tuples belonging to the set of Requests and other expired 
         *      objects from Object Value and Object Tables.
         *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] 
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN (
                                 SELECT [ObjectKey] 
                                 FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                             );
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] 
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN (
                                 SELECT [ObjectKey] 
                                 FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                             );
        
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] 
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN (
                                 SELECT [ObjectKey] 
                                 FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                             );
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN (
                                 SELECT [ObjectKey] 
                                 FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                             );
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] 
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN (
                                 SELECT [ObjectKey] 
                                 FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                             );
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] 
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN (
                                 SELECT [ObjectKey] 
                                 FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                             );
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] 
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN (
                                 SELECT [ObjectKey] 
                                 FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                             );
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] 
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN (
                                 SELECT [ObjectKey] 
                                 FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                             );
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] 
        WHERE [ValueReference] IN (
                                      SELECT [ObjectKey] 
                                      FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                                  );



        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * G.	Delete from the ExpiredObjectTable ONLY if no rows remain in the 
         *      Objects/ObjectValue Tables.
         *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
         IF NOT EXISTS 
         (
             SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey] 
             FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] [o]
             INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] [e] 
                 ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [e].[ObjectKey]
         )
         BEGIN
             IF NOT EXISTS 
             (
                 SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey] 
                 FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] [o]
                 INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] [e]
                     ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [e].[ObjectKey]
             )
             BEGIN
                 IF NOT EXISTS 
                 (
                     SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey] 
                     FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] [o]
                     INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] [e] 
                     ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [e].[ObjectKey]
                 )
                 BEGIN
                     IF NOT EXISTS 
                     (
                         SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey] 
                         FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] [o]
                         INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] [e] 
                             ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [e].[ObjectKey]
                     )
                     BEGIN
                         IF NOT EXISTS 
                         (
                             SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey] 
                             FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] [o]
                             INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] [e] 
                                 ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [e].[ObjectKey]
                         )
                         BEGIN
                             IF NOT EXISTS
                             (
                                 SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey] 
                                 FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] [o]
                                 INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] [e] 
                                     ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [e].[ObjectKey]
                             )
                             BEGIN
                                 IF NOT EXISTS 
                                 (
                                     SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey] 
                                     FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] [o]
                                     INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] [e] 
                                         ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [e].[ObjectKey]
                                 )
                                 BEGIN
                                     IF NOT EXISTS
                                     (
                                         SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey] 
                                         FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] [o]
                                         INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] [e] 
                                            ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [e].[ObjectKey]
                                    )
                                    BEGIN
                                        IF NOT EXISTS 
                                        (
                                            SELECT TOP 1 [o].[ObjectKey] 
                                            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] [o]
                                            INNER JOIN [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys] [e] 
                                                ON [o].[ValueReference] = [e].[ObjectKey]
                                        )
                                        BEGIN
                                            --REMOVE ALL ROWS FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys]
                                            DELETE FROM [fim].[ExpiredObjectKeys];
                                        END
                                    END
                                END
                            END	
                        END
                    END
                END
            END
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DeleteObject]
    @objectKey BIGINT 
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @objectKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [reference].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [reference]
        WHERE   [ValueReference] = @objectKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
        WHERE   [ValueReference] = @objectKey;
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DeleteSetMembershipConditions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DeleteSetMembershipConditions]
    @setKey    BIGINT,
    @requestKey BIGINT = NULL
AS
--Called from other stored procedures

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Removes the membership conditions associated with a set.  
-- For internal use only.  
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [smc].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
        WHERE
                [smc].[SetKey] = @setKey
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    DECLARE 
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName  NVARCHAR(32),
        @membershipConditionKey                        INT,
        @statementKey                                INT;
    
    SELECT @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName = [fim].[GetMembershipConditionAncillaryParameterName]();
    
    DECLARE @membershipCondition    TABLE
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );
    
    DECLARE @partition                TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey]                INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );

    -- Store the current membership conditions for the Set
    INSERT INTO @membershipCondition
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT [smc].[MembershipConditionKey]
    FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
    WHERE [smc].[SetKey] = @setKey;


    DECLARE @requestMembershipCondition TABLE
    (
        [ParameterValue]              NVARCHAR(MAX),
        [MembershipConditionKey]      INT
    );

    -- Look for and store the membership conditions found in the current Request
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rap].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
        WHERE
                [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @requestMembershipCondition
        (
            [ParameterValue],
            [MembershipConditionKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [rap].[Value],
            NULL
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
        WHERE
                [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName;

        UPDATE @requestMembershipCondition
        SET [MembershipConditionKey] = CAST([ParameterValue] AS INT);

        -- remove from temp table any MembershipConditions in which they exist in the
        -- original set and in the Request
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM @membershipCondition AS [mc]
            INNER JOIN @requestMembershipCondition AS [rmc]
            ON [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM @membershipCondition
            FROM @membershipCondition AS [mc]
            INNER JOIN @requestMembershipCondition AS [rmc]
            ON [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [rmc].[MembershipConditionKey];
        END
    END

    -- If we have any membershipconditions that are no longer part of this set 
    -- delete them from this set.  Also call the procedure that will delete them
    -- from all related tables if they are no longer used by any other set.  
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @membershipCondition AS [mc]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition]
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
        INNER JOIN @membershipCondition AS [mc]
        ON [smc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE [smc].[SetKey] = @setKey;

        DECLARE membershipConditionCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @membershipCondition AS [mc];

        OPEN membershipConditionCursor;
        WHILE(1 = 1)
        BEGIN
            SET @membershipConditionKey = NULL;

            FETCH NEXT FROM membershipConditionCursor INTO 
            @membershipConditionKey

            IF @membershipConditionKey IS NULL
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteMembershipCondition] @membershipConditionKey = @membershipConditionKey;

        END;
        CLOSE MembershipConditionCursor;
        DEALLOCATE MembershipConditionCursor;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [partition].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[SetKey] = @setKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @partition
        (
            [StatementKey] 
        )
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[SetKey] = @setKey;
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[SetPartition]
        WHERE        [SetKey] = @setKey;

        DECLARE partitionCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM @partition AS [partition]

        OPEN partitionCursor;
        WHILE(1 = 1)
        BEGIN
            SET @statementKey = NULL;

            FETCH NEXT FROM partitionCursor INTO 
            @statementKey

            IF @statementKey IS NULL
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteMembershipConditionPartitioningStatement]
                    @statementKey = @statementKey;

        END;
        CLOSE partitionCursor;
        DEALLOCATE partitionCursor;
    END
    
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DequeuePolicyApplication]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DequeuePolicyApplication]
    @serviceId                                 SMALLINT,  -- value comes from [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
    @objectId		                        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT,
    @workflowId	                            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT,
    @requestId		                        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT,
    @cause			                        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT,
    @parentRequestServicePartitionId        SMALLINT         OUTPUT
AS
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT  @cause = NULL,                              -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @objectId = NULL,                           -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @parentRequestServicePartitionId = NULL,    -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @requestId = NULL,                          -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @workflowId = NULL;                         -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013


    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. If there is no work to do return
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [SequenceKey]
            FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication]
        )
        BEGIN
            RETURN;
        END
      
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. If you can't get a lock then fail.
        *    We Need a lock to support Multiple FIM Services trying to dispatch from this table, and to support
        *    the Request Cancel feature.
        *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
          
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
           
        DECLARE @acquiredLock SMALLINT,            
                @lockName NVARCHAR(32),
                @messageText NVARCHAR(2000);
 
        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @lockName = N'PolicyApplication';
        
        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock] @Resource = @lockName, @LockMode = N'Exclusive', @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END   
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Look up the ServicePartition this Service belongs to and determine if it
        *    also processes the SystemPartition.  If so, get its Id.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @processSystemPartition BIT,
                @servicePartitionId SMALLINT,
                @systemServicePartitionId SMALLINT; 

        SELECT 
            @processSystemPartition = [ProcessSystemPartition],
            @servicePartitionId = [ServicePartitionId],
            @systemServicePartitionId = 
            CASE
                WHEN [ProcessSystemPartition] = 1 THEN [fim].[GetSystemServicePartitionId]()
                ELSE NULL
            END
        FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
        WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;
           
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D. Look for Requests that match up with the ServicePartitions it can process
        *    The procedure will find the oldest record that has not been dispatched, 
        *    mark it with a timestamp, then return data from the marked record.        
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
           
        DECLARE @causeKey BIGINT,
                @requestKey BIGINT,
                @sequenceKey BIGINT,
                @targetKey BIGINT,
                @time DATETIME,
                @workflowDefinitionKey BIGINT;
               
        SELECT @time = GETUTCDATE();

        SELECT TOP (1)
            @sequenceKey = [pa].[SequenceKey],
            @causeKey = [pa].[Cause],
            @requestKey = [pa].[RequestKey],
            @targetKey = [pa].[TargetKey],
            @workflowDefinitionKey = [pa].[WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            @parentRequestServicePartitionId = [r].[ServicePartitionId]
        FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication] AS [pa]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        ON [pa].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
        WHERE 
                --if @systemServicePartitionId IS NULL then it won't be processed by this Service
                [r].[ServicePartitionId] IN (@servicePartitionId, @systemServicePartitionId)
            AND [pa].[ServiceId] IS NULL
         ORDER BY [SequenceKey] ASC;

        
        IF(@@ROWCOUNT = 1)
        BEGIN
            -- Mark this row to show it is being dispatched by this service.
            UPDATE [fim].[PolicyApplication]
            SET 
                [DispatchTime] = @time,
                [ServiceId] = @serviceId
            WHERE 
                    [SequenceKey] = @sequenceKey
                AND [DispatchTime] IS NULL;
                
            IF(@@ROWCOUNT != 1)
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Update PolicyApplication Failed.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END   
             
            SELECT 
                @objectId = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@targetKey), 
                @workflowId = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@workflowDefinitionKey),
                @requestId = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@requestKey),
                @cause = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@causeKey)
        END

        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        RETURN;
    END CATCH  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DequeueWorkItem]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DequeueWorkItem]
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @instanceId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @serviceHostName NVARCHAR(32),
    @lockTimeout INT,
    @result INT OUTPUT
AS
    --Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT  @result = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. If there is no work to do return
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [SequenceKey]
            FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @result = 1; -- Instance not found
            RETURN;
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Look up the ServicePartition this Service belongs to and determine if it
        *    also processes the SystemPartition.  If so, get its Id.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        DECLARE @lockExpiration DATETIME,
                @now DATETIME,
                @processSystemPartition BIT,
                @servicePartitionId SMALLINT,
                @systemServicePartitionId SMALLINT,
                @workItemID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;

        SELECT  @now = GETUTCDATE(),
                @result = 0;

        SELECT 
            @processSystemPartition = [ProcessSystemPartition],
            @servicePartitionId = [ServicePartitionId],
            @systemServicePartitionId = 
            CASE
                WHEN [ProcessSystemPartition] = 1 THEN [fim].[GetSystemServicePartitionId]()
                ELSE NULL
            END
        FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
        WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Look for WorkItems that match up with the following:
        *    ServicePartitions it can process
        *    ServiceHostName must match
        *    LockOwner must match unless NULL, or expired (supports retry scenario)
        *    READPAST Table hint is used because this is a Queue.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
 
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @workItemID = [wisq].[WorkItemId]
        FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [wisq] WITH (READPAST)
        INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
        ON 
            [wisq].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = [wi].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        ON 
            [wi].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
        WHERE
                --if @systemServicePartitionId IS NULL then it won't be processed by this Service
                [r].[ServicePartitionId] IN (@servicePartitionId, @systemServicePartitionId)
            AND
            (
                    [LockExpiration] IS NULL
                OR  [LockExpiration] < @now
            )
            AND
            (
                    [NextRetry] IS NULL
                OR  [NextRetry] < @now
            )
            AND [ServiceHostName] = @serviceHostName
            AND [Completed] = 0
            -- To eliminate race condition possibility with multiple workflow hosts compete for 
            -- processing of a just created workflow, add a restriction 'not to process a workflow
            -- if it was created less than second ago on another MIM Service instance'.
            AND 
            (
                    EXISTS (SELECT * FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [si] WHERE [si].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier])
                OR  [wi].[ServiceId] = @serviceId
                OR  [wisq].[ServiceHostName] <> N'DefaultRuntime'
                OR  [wisq].[Created] < DATEADD(s, -1, @now)
            )
        ORDER BY [SequenceKey];

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT @result = 1; -- Instance not found
        END

        IF
        (
                @result = 0
            AND @lockTimeout >= 0
        )
        BEGIN
            IF @lockTimeout = 0
            BEGIN
                SELECT @lockExpiration = CONVERT(DATETIME,'9999');
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT @lockExpiration = DATEADD(second, @lockTimeout, @now);
            END
            
            UPDATE [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
            SET
                [LockOwner] = @instanceId,
                [LockExpiration] = @lockExpiration
            WHERE 
                    [WorkItemId] = @workItemID
                AND
                (
                        [LockOwner] IS NULL
                   OR   [LockExpiration] < @now
                );

            IF(@@ROWCOUNT != 1)
            BEGIN 
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [WorkItemId]
                    FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
                    WHERE [WorkItemId] = @workItemID
                )
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @result = 2; -- Could not acquire lock
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @result = 1; -- Instance not found
                END
            END
        END

        IF(@result = 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT 
                [WorkItemId],
                [WorkItemData],
                [RetryCount]
            FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
            WHERE [WorkItemId] = @workItemID;
        END
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoActionOnMonitoredRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoActionOnMonitoredRequest]
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @requestCleanupMaxRequests INT,
    @requestRecoveryMaxRequests INT,
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 1  -- 0 none, 1 data only, 2 data + messages
AS
-- Called by other stored procedures 
BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY

        IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
        BEGIN
            SET NOCOUNT ON;
        END 
    
        --DESIGN POINT:  This procedure is called from within SQL but it iterates over a set of requests.
        --we want each individual request to be transactional but do not want to fail the batch if one request has issuess.
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        DECLARE @acquiredLockDoActionOnMonitoredRequest SMALLINT,
                @acquiredLockRequestKey INT,
                @causeKey BIGINT,
                @collateralRequestKey BIGINT,
                @commitTime DATETIME,
                @didExpireRequestStatus TINYINT,
                @didMarkForCancel BIT,                
                @lockNameDoActionOnMonitoredRequest NVARCHAR(64),
                @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),
                @parentRequestAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestCancelReasonMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),                
                @requestControlCancelActionWorkflowKey TINYINT,
                @requestControlCancelOperationKey TINYINT,
                @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestMonitorActionCancelCollateralRequestKey TINYINT,                
                @requestMonitorActionCancelRequestKey TINYINT,
                @requestMonitorActionCleanupRequestKey TINYINT,
                @requestMonitorActionExpireRequestKey TINYINT,                
                @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey TINYINT,
                @requestMonitorActionResumeRequestKey TINYINT,
                @requestMonitorActionResumeWorkflowKey TINYINT,
                @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning NVARCHAR(16),
                @requestStatusPostProcessing NVARCHAR(448),
                @serviceAccountKey BIGINT,
                @workflowControlMessageResumeKey TINYINT,
                @workflowTypeActionKey TINYINT;

 
        SELECT  @acquiredLockDoActionOnMonitoredRequest = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @acquiredLockRequestKey = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @commitTime = GETUTCDATE(),
                @lockNameDoActionOnMonitoredRequest = N'DoActionOnMonitoredRequest',
                @parentRequestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ParentRequest'),
                @requestControlCancelActionWorkflowKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlCancelActionWorkflow]()),
                @requestControlCancelOperationKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlCancelOperation]()),
                @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestMonitorActionCancelCollateralRequestKey = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionCancelCollateralRequest]()),
                @requestMonitorActionCancelRequestKey = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionCancelRequest]()),
                @requestMonitorActionCleanupRequestKey = [fim].GetRequestMonitorActionKey([fim].RequestMonitorActionCleanupRequest()),
                @requestMonitorActionExpireRequestKey = [fim].GetRequestMonitorActionKey([fim].RequestMonitorActionExpireRequest()),                
                @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey = [fim].GetRequestMonitorActionKey([fim].RequestMonitorActionFinalizeRequest()),                
                @requestMonitorActionResumeRequestKey = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeRequest]()),
                @requestMonitorActionResumeWorkflowKey = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeWorkflow]()),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning = [fim].[RequestStatusDetailLevelWarning](),
                @requestStatusPostProcessing = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessing](),
                @serviceAccountKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey](),
                @workflowControlMessageResumeKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowControlMessageKey]([fim].[WorkflowControlMessageResume]()),
                @workflowTypeActionKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey]([fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]());
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get a lock
        *    DESIGN POINT In a multi-service environment we only want 1 service at a time processing this table.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        EXECUTE @acquiredLockDoActionOnMonitoredRequest = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockNameDoActionOnMonitoredRequest,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session'
            
        IF(@acquiredLockDoActionOnMonitoredRequest < 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatNotAbleToObtainRequestSessionLock](@lockNameDoActionOnMonitoredRequest);
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        --Diagnostics
        DECLARE @statistics TABLE
        (
            [RequestKey] BIGINT,
            [RequestIdentifier] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            [Operation] NVARCHAR(MAX),
            [Failed] BIT
        )

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Look up the ServicePartition this Service belongs to and determine if it
        *    also processes the SystemPartition.  If so, get its Id.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @processSystemPartition BIT,
                @servicePartitionId SMALLINT,
                @systemServicePartitionId SMALLINT;

        SELECT 
            @processSystemPartition = [ProcessSystemPartition],
            @servicePartitionId = [ServicePartitionId],
            @systemServicePartitionId = 
            CASE
                WHEN [ProcessSystemPartition] = 1 THEN [fim].[GetSystemServicePartitionId]()
                ELSE NULL
            END
        FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
        WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Get a copy of the Requests that need to be processed
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @request TABLE
        (
            [RequestKey] BIGINT,
            [RequestStatusKey] SMALLINT,
            [ActionType] TINYINT,
            [ActionsAttempted] SMALLINT
        )

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D. Grab a copy of the rows to process that are eligible based on the NextActionDate < 
        * the current DateTime and that have not hit the MAX re-try attempts
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        INSERT @request
        SELECT TOP(@requestCleanupMaxRequests)
            [rm].[RequestKey],
            [rm].[RequestStatusKey],
            [rm].[ActionType],
            [rm].[ActionsAttempted]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMonitor] AS [rm]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        ON
            [rm].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
        WHERE
                --if @systemServicePartitionId IS NULL then it won't be processed by this Service
                [r].[ServicePartitionId] IN (@servicePartitionId, @systemServicePartitionId)
            AND [rm].[NextActionDate] < @commitTime
            AND [rm].[ActionsAttempted] < 32767   -- MAX SMALLINT
        ORDER BY [rm].[NextActionDate];

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * E. Process The main Request table by looking at each Request's status 
        * to determine next steps:  Status unchanged, first action?
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM @request
        )
        BEGIN

            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * E.1 Try to perform the expected Action on each Request.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            DECLARE @redispatchCount SMALLINT;
            SELECT @redispatchCount = 0;

            DECLARE @requestKey BIGINT;
            DECLARE @requestStatusKey SMALLINT; 
            DECLARE @actionType TINYINT;
            DECLARE @actionsAttempted SMALLINT;

            DECLARE RequestCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT 
                [RequestKey],
                [RequestStatusKey],
                [ActionType],
                [ActionsAttempted]
            FROM @request;

            OPEN RequestCursor;
            WHILE(1 = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @requestKey = NULL;
                SELECT @requestStatusKey = NULL;
                SELECT @actionType = NULL;
                SELECT @actionsAttempted = NULL;
                SELECT @causeKey = NULL;

                FETCH NEXT FROM RequestCursor INTO 
                    @requestKey,
                    @requestStatusKey,
                    @actionType,
                    @actionsAttempted

                IF(@requestKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                   -- No more records to process
                    BREAK;
                END

                BEGIN TRY
                
                    --Update this record so in case there is a time-out, it will move to the back
                    --of the Queue.
                    UPDATE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                    SET
                        [ActionsAttempted] = [ActionsAttempted] + 1,
                        [NextActionDate] = DATEADD(minute, 1, @commitTime)
                    WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION
                
                    -- Transactional Lock to make sure no other processing is happening on this request.
                    -- We try to get synchronized lock immediately and if another thread is processing this request we just skip past it.
                    EXECUTE @acquiredLockRequestKey = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @requestKey, @lockTimeout = 0;
                        
                    IF(@acquiredLockRequestKey != 0)
                    BEGIN
                        GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                    END
                
                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.1.1 If the Request status of the current object does not match the state when we
                    * added it to the table, then it is no longer stuck so remove it from tracking
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF NOT EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [ValueString]
                        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
                        WHERE 
                                [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus')
                            AND @requestStatusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([ValueString])
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

                        GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                    END

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.1.2 Process records marked CleanupRequest
                    * NOTE:  This ActionType only applies to Requests that have already reached a 
                    * Final state.  
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@actionType = @requestMonitorActionCleanupRequestKey)
                    BEGIN

                        DECLARE @wasDataChangedInt INT;
                        SELECT @wasDataChangedInt = 0;

                        EXECUTE @wasDataChangedInt = [fim].[DoDeleteOrCancelWorkflowInstances]
                            @requestKey = @requestKey,
                            @causeKey = @serviceAccountKey;

                        DECLARE @wasDataChanged BIT;
                        SELECT @wasDataChanged = CAST(@wasDataChangedInt AS BIT);
                            
                        DECLARE @minutes SMALLINT;
                        SELECT @minutes = 0;
                        
                        IF (@wasDataChanged = 1)
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT @minutes = 1;
                        END
                        
                        --queue up FinalizeRequest action on this request
                        UPDATE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                        SET
                            [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey,
                            [NextActionDate] = DATEADD(minute, @minutes, @commitTime)
                        WHERE   [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionCleanupRequestKey;
                            
                        GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                    END
                    
                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.1.3 Process records marked FinalizeRequest
                    * NOTE:  This code has five parts:
                    * Part 1)  Determine which FIM code owns Finalizing this Request.
                    * Part 2)  Determine if the Workflows associated with this Request are finished.
                    *            If not. skip this Request and re-run this code later.
                    * Part 3)  All Workflows completed, RequestStatus is Canceling,  update the
                    *           Request to its final state.
                    * Part 4)  All Workflows completed, remove this request from the Request cache tables
                    * Part 5)  Invalid RequestStatus to be finalized, remove from Monitor table.
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@actionType = @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey)
                    BEGIN  
                                              
                        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                        * Part 1 -- Determine FIM code ownership:
                        * UpdateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflows is responsible for transitioning
                        * "in process" requests into a final state, except the following special cases
                        * when this stored procedure takes over:
                        * 1. Request has no collateral requests AND
                        * 2. Request has 0 action workflows.
                        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                        IF 
                        (
                           (
                                EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT 1
                                    FROM [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking] AS [crt]
                                    WHERE [crt].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                )
                            OR  EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT 1
                                    FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] as [wi]
                                    WHERE 
                                            [wi].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                        AND [wi].[WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeActionKey
                                )
                            )
                            AND
                            [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeProcessing]([fim].[GetRequestStatusName](@requestStatusKey)) = 1
                        )
                        BEGIN                                
                            --Delete the row and allow UpdateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflows to transition
                            --this request into a final status when appropriate.
                            DELETE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                            WHERE   [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                AND [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey;
    
                            GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                        END                    

                       /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                        * Part 2 -- Determine If workflows are finished.  If not, re-try later.
                        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [RequestKey]
                            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                            WHERE
                                    [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                AND [Finished] = 0
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            --retry after a delay
                            EXECUTE [fim].[PostponeMonitorRequestAction]
                                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                                @commitTime = @commitTime;
                            
                            GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                        END
                    
                       /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                        * Part 3 -- Workflow Finished, If Canceling, Finalize the Request.
                        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                        IF
                        (
                            [fim].[GetRequestStatusName](@requestStatusKey) = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceling]() 
                        )
                        BEGIN                        
                            --everything final, just need to update the request to Canceled.
                            DECLARE @status NVARCHAR(32);
                            SELECT @status = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceled](); 
                            
                            DELETE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                            WHERE   [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                    AND [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey;
                           
                            EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
                                @requestKey =@requestKey,
                                @status = @status,
                                @causeKey = @serviceAccountKey;
                                
                            GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                        END
    
                       /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                        * Part 4 -- Workflow Finished, Remove Request from Cache tables and set Expiration.
                        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                       IF
                        (
                            [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFinal]([fim].[GetRequestStatusName](@requestStatusKey)) = 1
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            --Everything is final so we can close out this request
                             EXECUTE [fim].[DoExpireRequestObject]
                                @objectKey = @requestKey,
                                @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
                                @didExpireRequestStatus = @didExpireRequestStatus OUTPUT;
                          
                            --[DoExpireRequestObject] owns modification of
                            -- the entry in [RequestMonitor] for this @requestKey
                            
                            GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                        END
                        
                       /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                        * Part 5 -- Request is not in a proper state for Finalize operations. Delete it
                        *           from Monitoring.
                        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                        -- invalid status/action type -> clean up
                        DELETE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                        WHERE   [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey;
                            
                        GOTO EndofRequestCursor;                        
                    END                    

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.1.4 Process records marked CancelRequest
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@actionType = @requestMonitorActionCancelRequestKey)
                    BEGIN

                        -- If the Request has a Parent that is already canceling
                        -- then get the @causeKey from [RequestCancelTracking]
                        -- since the Cancel must cascade from the parent to all of
                        -- its children.  If not then use the ServiceAccountKey
                        
                        SELECT @causeKey = [CauseKey]
                        FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking] AS [rct]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] as [ovr]
                        ON [rct].[RequestKey] = [ovr].[ValueReference]
                        WHERE   
                                [ovr].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                            AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @parentRequestAttributeKey;

                        IF(@causeKey IS NULL)
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT @causeKey = @serviceAccountKey;
                        END
                        
                        SELECT @didMarkForCancel = 0;

                        SELECT @requestCancelReasonMessage = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonServiceRestart](@requestKey);                          
                        
                        --Commit the Cancel 
                        EXECUTE [fim].[DoCancelRequest]
                            @requestKey = @requestKey,
                            @requestControlKey = NULL, -- Cancel any non-final state.
                            @causeKey = @causeKey,
                            @reason = @requestCancelReasonMessage,
                            @reasonDetailLevel = @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning,
                            @recordRequestControl = 1,
                            @didMarkForCancel = @didMarkForCancel OUTPUT;

                        -- NOTE: the [DoCancelRequest] stored proc will remove the row from [RequestMonitor] if @didMarkForCancel = 1
                        -- and insert a check for finalize instead.

                        --If it did not mark for cancel then we want to change this status to Cleanup
                        IF(@didMarkForCancel = 0)
                        BEGIN
                            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                            SET [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionCleanupRequestKey,
                                [ActionsAttempted] = 0
                            WHERE   [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                AND [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionCancelRequestKey;
                        END

                        GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                    END

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    *E.1.5 Process records marked ResumeRequest
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@actionType = @requestMonitorActionResumeRequestKey)
                    BEGIN
                        --We do this in a batch at the end of this procedure
                        --Review Section F.
                        GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                    END

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.1.6 Process records marked ExpireRequest
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@actionType = @requestMonitorActionExpireRequestKey)
                    BEGIN
                        EXECUTE [fim].[DoExpireRequestObject]
                            @objectKey = @requestKey,
                            @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
                            @didExpireRequestStatus = @didExpireRequestStatus OUTPUT;

                            --[DoExpireRequestObject] owns modification of
                            -- the entry in [RequestMonitor] for this @requestKey
                            
                        GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                    END
                    
                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.1.7 Process records marked CancelCollateralRequest
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@actionType = @requestMonitorActionCancelCollateralRequestKey)
                    BEGIN
                        -- This code will find all the CollateralRequests that are not yet 
                        -- final.
                        
                        DECLARE @collateralRequestNotFinal TABLE
                        (
                            [RequestKey] BIGINT PRIMARY KEY
                        )
                        
                        -- Find all Requests that have a Status of PostProcessing
                        -- and cancel them.
                        INSERT @collateralRequestNotFinal
                        (
                            [RequestKey]
                        )
                        SELECT TOP(@requestCleanupMaxRequests)
                            [RequestKey]
                        FROM [fim].[Request]
                        WHERE
                                [Cause] = @requestKey
                            AND [Operation] = N'SystemEvent';

                        
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [RequestKey]
                            FROM @collateralRequestNotFinal
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            --Setup a cursor and cancel these Requests
                            
                            -- Get the cause from the Tracking Table                             
                            SELECT @causeKey = [CauseKey]
                            FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking]
                            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

                            DECLARE CancelCollateralRequestsCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
                            SELECT [RequestKey]
                            FROM @collateralRequestNotFinal
                            
                            OPEN CancelCollateralRequestsCursor;
                            WHILE(1 = 1)
                            BEGIN
                                SELECT @collateralRequestKey = NULL;

                                FETCH NEXT FROM CancelCollateralRequestsCursor INTO 
                                    @collateralRequestKey;

                                IF(@collateralRequestKey IS NULL)
                                BEGIN
                                    -- NO MORE RECORDS
                                    BREAK;
                                END
                                
                                SELECT @requestCancelReasonMessage = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonParentRequestWasCanceled](@requestKey);                          
                                
                                EXECUTE [fim].[DoCancelRequest]
