                                    @requestKey = @collateralRequestKey,
                                    @requestControlKey = NULL,  -- Cancel any Non-Final Request
                                    @causeKey = @causeKey,
                                    @reason = @requestCancelReasonMessage,
                                    @reasonDetailLevel = @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning,
                                    @recordRequestControl = 1,
                                    @didMarkForCancel = @didMarkForCancel OUTPUT;
                                                    
                            END
                            CLOSE CancelCollateralRequestsCursor;
                            DEALLOCATE CancelCollateralRequestsCursor; 
                            
                            -- Since there is a throttle on the number of Requests that we canceled
                            -- it is possible that we will need to run this repeatedly until there are no more
                            -- Requests picked up by the above query.  We don't want this design to count against
                            -- [ActionsAttempted] column which indicates namely how many times a specific work item
                            -- was atttempted (and failed).   This procedure has already updated the [ActionsAttempted] +1
                            -- and set the [NextActionDate] in case this item timed out during processing it would move to the back
                            -- of the cursor the next execution of this stored procedure.
                            -- Since we are here and have not timed out, we want to roll back the [ActionsAttempted] -1 and set the Date
                            -- to Now so this item can be fetched again into the cursor as soon as possible.
                            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                            SET 
                                [ActionsAttempted] = 
                                CASE WHEN [ActionsAttempted]-1 > 0 THEN [ActionsAttempted] -1
                                     ELSE  0
                                END,
                                [NextActionDate] = @commitTime
                            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                            
                        END
                        ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            -- All CollateralRequests are no longer processing so delete this 
                            -- row from RequestMonitor.  [fim].[UpdateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflows]
                            -- will finalize this CollateralRequest
                            DELETE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                            WHERE   [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                                AND [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionCancelCollateralRequestKey;
                                                     
                        END
                        
                        GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                    END
                                        
                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.1.8 Process records marked ResumeWorkflow
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@actionType = @requestMonitorActionResumeWorkflowKey)
                    BEGIN

                        --Send the workflow runtime a ping to test if the workflow is still running
                        UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                        SET [WorkflowControlMessage] = @workflowControlMessageResumeKey
                        WHERE 
                                [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [Finished] = 0
                            AND [WorkflowControlMessage] IS NULL  -- don't stomp on an existing message if one exists.
                            AND [ServiceId] = NULL;  -- do not mark workflows that have not yet started.  RedispatchRequest action is required for these

                        EXECUTE [fim].[PostponeMonitorRequestAction]
                            @requestKey = @requestKey,
                            @commitTime = @commitTime,
                            @minutes = 1440;

                        GOTO EndofRequestCursor;
                    END
                    
        EndOfRequestCursor: 
                COMMIT TRANSACTION
                             
                --Diagnostics    
                IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                BEGIN
                    INSERT @statistics
                    (
                        [RequestKey],
                        [RequestIdentifier],
                        [Operation],
                        [Failed]
                    )
                    SELECT
                        @requestKey,
                        [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@requestKey),
                        [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionName](@actionType),
                        0;
                END
                                    
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                
                    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.1.7  Update this record so that it moves to the back of the queue so we don't 
                    *        end up processing the same "bad" Requests before others.
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    EXECUTE [fim].[PostponeMonitorRequestAction]
                        @requestKey = @requestKey,
                        @commitTime = @commitTime;
                    
                    --Record failure
                    INSERT @statistics
                    (
                        [RequestKey],
                        [RequestIdentifier],                        
                        [Operation],
                        [Failed]
                    )
                    SELECT 
                        @requestKey,
                        [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@requestKey),                        
                        [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionName](@actionType) + ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                        1;
                     --NOTE:  we are not going to raise an error to allow the next Request to be processed in the cursor.
                END CATCH
            END
            CLOSE RequestCursor;
            DEALLOCATE RequestCursor; 

            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * F. Return a recordset of the Requests that require Re-Dispatch
            * up to the max allowed.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            DECLARE @requestRedispatch TABLE
            (
                [RequestKey] BIGINT
            )

            INSERT INTO @requestRedispatch
            SELECT TOP(@requestRecoveryMaxRequests) [RequestKey] FROM @request
            WHERE [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionResumeRequestKey;

            -- We need to keep the Resume record in this table for multi-service support so another Service instance does not try to redispatch this Request at the same time.
            -- When the middle tier receives this recordset, it will call [fim].[UpdateRequestOwner] stored procedure which will 
            -- remove this entry since the hand-off to the Service is completed and the Request will resume operations and provide its own
            -- [RequestStatus] updates as it moves through the pipeline.  The 5 minute re-try would allow another re-dispatch attempt if the first
            -- one fails for some reason.
            UPDATE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
            SET [NextActionDate] = DATEADD(minute, 5, @commitTime)
            WHERE [RequestKey] IN 
            (
                SELECT [RequestKey]
                FROM @requestRedispatch
            );

            --Diagnostics
            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
            BEGIN
                SELECT 
                    [RequestKey] AS [N'Requests Processed'],
                    [RequestIdentifier],
                    [Operation],
                    [Failed]
                FROM @statistics;
            END
           
            --Return results as a recordset
            SELECT [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([RequestKey]) AS [N'Requests To Redispatch'] FROM @requestRedispatch;
            
            -- If any failures were recorded, throw the failures back to the caller so they are aware that all requests were not 
            -- processed successfully.
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [RequestKey]
                FROM @statistics
                WHERE [Failed] = 1
            )
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @errorString NVARCHAR(MAX);
                SET @errorString =
                (
                     CAST((SELECT [RequestIdentifier], [Operation] FROM @statistics FOR XML AUTO) AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
                );
                
                RAISERROR(@errorString, 16, 1);
            END
             
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            *  DESIGN NOTE: IMT 26482 
            *  The as built design will continue to re-try the current operation until the max [ActionsAttempted] value is hit
            *  The fact that an operation is failing and is being re-tried multiple times is not surfaced to an Admin in the current design
            *  The only indication one would have that this is happening is to look at the [fim].[RequestMonitor] table for rows that have 
            *  [ActionsAttempted] with a high number.  Surfacing these problem Requests and providing a way to do a cleanup (manual or automated?) should
            *  be considered in order to keep the system clean.   Without this, one would see some very old Requests that are stuck in a state and would
            *  not understand why, and would have no way to "force" the Request to terminate.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        END  
        IF(@acquiredLockDoActionOnMonitoredRequest = 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameDoActionOnMonitoredRequest,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF(@acquiredLockDoActionOnMonitoredRequest = 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameDoActionOnMonitoredRequest,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoApplyPolicyRule]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoApplyPolicyRule]
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 0
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN 

    /* original check-in: Change 211787 by REDMOND\craigmcm@CSD1366274-miis on 2008/04/02 11:03:41

    DoApplyPolicyRule implements the specification,    http://sharepoint/sites/IdMT/Raven/Shared%20Documents/Feature%20Team%20
    Documents/Policy/ILM2.M4.RunMappings.Speclet.v2.docx 
  
    Terms:  
            Request - The datawrapper used to create and change objects. Proposed changes are cached in Request cache tables prior to committing the change.
            Target -  This is the primary object that is being created or modified as part of the Request.
            Multi-Target Requests;  {A limited use feature introduced to assist with removing custom action processors.}  
                This code examines only the Target to determine eligibility; however, once eligible all ComputedMembers added to the eligible 
                ResourceFinalSet will get the workflow (including those objects that transitioned due to the Multi-Target induced changes).
            WorkflowRetroActivePolicy (WRAP) --  An ActionWorkflow which has Attribute RunOnPolicyUpdate = true 
                and is referenced by an MPR that has Attribute Disabled = false && ManagementPolicyRuleType = SetTransition
                && ActionType = TransitionIn.
                ActionWorkflows that have RunOnPolicyUpdate = false OR are associated with only MPRs that do not meet
                the criteria above are not considered WRAP.
                The ActionType attribute on transitional MPRs can have one of the two mutually exclusively values, 
                and it can be derived from the target resource attribute:
					TransitionIn: ResourceFinalSet != null && ResourceCurrentSet == null
					TansitionOut: ResourceFinalSet == null && ResourceCurrentSet != null
                ManagementPolicyRuleType and ActionType (when defined on ManagementPolicyRuleType==SetTransition) are not 
                modifiable, which is guarded in the action processor.
            ManagementPolicyRule (MPR) - an object that is used to enforce policy on access and changes to other objects.  
            Set - a collection of objects
            ResourceFinalSet - When committing the Request, this is the Set referenced by an MPR for which WRAP will be enforced.
            ApplyWRAPToAllMembers -  For each member in ResourceFinalSet, run WRAP on each member.
            ApplyWRAPToNewMembers -  For each new member added to ResourceFinalSet due to the Request being commited, run WRAP on each new member
            ApplyNewWRAPToAllMembers - For all members of ResourceFinalSet, apply the new WRAP that was added as part of this Request to all members.
            ExplicitMember - Adding objects to a set explicitly (e.g.  add billg)
            SetFilter - Using Xpath expressions to dynamically select objects to add to a set (e.g.  /Person would include all objects of type Person)
            Create - The Request is creating a new object
            Put - The Request is modifying an existing object.
            
    The logic is different for Create and Put operations as follows:
         
    Create an MPR:
        *If the Target MPR does have Attribute Disabled = false do ApplyWRAPToAllMembers
    
    Update to an MPR:
        * If the Request changes the Target MPR Attribute Disabled from true to false, do ApplyWRAPToAllMembers
        * If the Request is to change the ResourceFinalSet to a different set, do ApplyWRAPToAllMembers
        * If the Request is to add a new WRAP then do ApplyNewWrapToAllMembers
        
        
    Update to a Set that is referenced by an MPR as its ResourceFinalSet:
        * do ApplyWRAPtoNewMembers
        
    
    Assumptions:
        
        * ActionWorkflows with RunOnPolicyUpdate Attribute = true can be found in WorkflowRetroactivePolicy cache table which is managed by code in PostProcessUpdate.
    
        * ManagementPolicyRule cache table [ManagementPolicyRule] contains only MPRs that are Enabled and has up to date references for [ResourceFinalSet], [ResourceCurrentSet]
            so can join against it as necessary.
        
        * This stored procedure is called post commit of the Request so all data changes are already in the ObjectValue* tables.
          Request, RequestParameter, and RequestOutput* cache tables are still available to query against to figure out what changed as a result of
          the Request being committed.
    */


    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

        --DESIGN POINT: This procedure runs post CRUD commit so changes to workflow definitions have already been cached and current attributes
        --can be read from the permanent tables to process this logic.

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. If there are no Action Workflows that have an attribute of
        *    N'RunOnPolicyUpdate' = true then no additional policy applies.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowRetroactivePolicy]
        )
        BEGIN
            IF(@extendedOutput = 2)
            BEGIN
                PRINT('No ActionWorkflowDefinitions exist with RunOnPolicyUpdate set to True. Policy is up to date.');
            END
            RETURN;
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Get the Target object from the Request and if it is not a Set or 
        *    ManagementPolicyRule change, then no additional policy applies.   
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @setObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @setObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Set');

        DECLARE @targetIsTypeSet BIT;
        SELECT @targetIsTypeSet = 0;

        DECLARE @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'ManagementPolicyRule');

        DECLARE @targetIsTypeManagementPolicyRule BIT;
        SELECT @targetIsTypeManagementPolicyRule = 0;
              

        DECLARE @targetKey BIGINT;
        DECLARE @targetObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
        DECLARE @operation NVARCHAR(448);
        DECLARE @principalObjectKey BIGINT;
        
        SELECT 
            @targetKey = [TargetKey],
            @targetObjectTypeKey = [TargetObjectTypeKey],
            @operation = [Operation],
            @principalObjectKey = [Creator],
            @targetIsTypeSet =
            CASE 
                WHEN [TargetObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey THEN 1
                ELSE @targetIsTypeSet
            END,
            @targetIsTypeManagementPolicyRule =
            CASE 
                WHEN [TargetObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey THEN 1
                ELSE @targetIsTypeManagementPolicyRule
            END
        FROM [fim].[Request]
        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
        IF NOT
        (
                @targetIsTypeSet = 1
            OR  @targetIsTypeManagementPolicyRule =1
        )
        BEGIN
            IF(@extendedOutput = 2)
            BEGIN
                PRINT('Target object is not a Set or ManagementPolicyRule. Policy is up to date.');
            END
            RETURN;
        END


        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Common vars and temp Tables to hold data for the next set of checks
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
              
        DECLARE @disabledAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @disabledAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Disabled');
        
        DECLARE @resourceFinalSetAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @resourceFinalSetAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ResourceFinalSet');
        
        DECLARE @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');

        DECLARE @explicitMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember');

        DECLARE @actionWorfklowDefinitionAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @actionWorfklowDefinitionAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ActionWorkflowDefinition');
    
        DECLARE @ApplyPolicyToAllMembersOfResourceFinalSet BIT;
        SELECT @ApplyPolicyToAllMembersOfResourceFinalSet = 0;
    
        DECLARE @doWorkflowRetroactivePolicy BIT;
        SELECT @doWorkflowRetroactivePolicy = 0;
        
        DECLARE @requestParameter TABLE
        ( 
            [Attribute] NVARCHAR (448),
            [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX)
        );

         DECLARE @managementPolicyRule TABLE
        (
            [ManagementPolicyRuleObjectKey] BIGINT,
            [AttributeKey] SMALLINT,
            [ValueReferenceKey]  BIGINT
        );
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D. If the target is a Set:
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF(@targetIsTypeSet = 1)
        BEGIN
        
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * D.1 If the change is not a Modify operation, then no policy workflows will apply
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            IF NOT( @operation = N'Put')
            BEGIN
                IF(@extendedOutput = 2)
                BEGIN
                    PRINT('Target is a Set, but the Operation is not a Put. Policy is up to date.');
                END

                RETURN;
            END               

            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * D.2 Get modified attributes and if not a Filter or ExplicitMember change,
            * then no policy workflows will apply
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            INSERT INTO @requestParameter
            (
                [Attribute],
                [Value]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [AttributeName],
                [AttributeValue]
                FROM [fim].[RequestParameter]
                WHERE 
                        [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND 
                    (
                            [AttributeName] = N'Filter'
                        OR  [AttributeName] = N'ExplicitMember'
                    );
 
            IF(@@ROWCOUNT = 0) 
            BEGIN
                IF(@extendedOutput = 2)
                BEGIN
                    PRINT('Target is a Set, but neither the Filter or ExplicitMember values have changed. Policy is up to date.');
                END

                RETURN;
            END
            
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * D.3 This set may be referenced within ManagementPolicyRules so find all the
            *     transitional ManagementPolicyRules (that are not disabled) that have this set as the 
            *     ResourceFinalSet and have WRAP. Add the MPR and key attributes to a temp table for further analysis.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            INSERT INTO @managementPolicyRule
            (
                [ManagementPolicyRuleObjectKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReferenceKey]
            )
            
            
            SELECT
                [mprCache].[ObjectKey],
                [ovrMprAttribs].[AttributeKey],
                [ovrMprAttribs].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [mprCache]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovrMprAttribs]
            ON
                [mprCache].[ObjectKey] = [ovrMprAttribs].[ObjectKey]
            -- LEFT JOIN because we include ResourceFinalSet Attributes which will be NULL on this Join condition.
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[WorkflowRetroactivePolicy] AS [wrap]
            ON  
                [ovrMprAttribs].[ValueReference] = [wrap].[WorkflowDefinitionKey]
            WHERE
            (
                    -- MPR has this set as its FinalSet
                    [mprCache].[ResourceFinalSet] = @targetKey
                    
                    -- MPR is transitional
                AND [mprCache].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = N'SetTransition'
                    
                    -- Fetch the ResourceFinalSet and actionWorkflowDefinitions assigned that are WRAP
                AND [ovrMprAttribs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
                AND 
                (       [ovrMprAttribs].[AttributeKey] = @resourceFinalSetAttributeKey
                    OR  
                    (    
                            [ovrMprAttribs].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorfklowDefinitionAttributeKey                    
                        AND [wrap].[WorkflowDefinitionKey] IS NOT NULL
                    )
                )
               
             )            
             
             IF(@@ROWCOUNT > 0)
             BEGIN
                SELECT @doWorkflowRetroactivePolicy = 1;
             END
             ELSE
             BEGIN
                IF(@extendedOutput = 2)
                BEGIN
                    PRINT('Target is a Set, but there are no enabled ManagementPolicyRules with this set as the ResourceFinalSet, with ActionWorflows set to RunOnPolicyUpdate. Policy is up to date.');
                END
                
                RETURN;
             END
             
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * D.4 Policy is applied only to the new members added to the ResourceFinalSet
            *     as a result of this Set update Request being committed.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            SELECT @ApplyPolicyToAllMembersOfResourceFinalSet = 0;
             
         END
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * E. If the target is a ManagementPolicyRule:
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF(@targetIsTypeManagementPolicyRule = 1)
        BEGIN
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * E.1 If the change is not a Create or Modify operation, then no policy workflows will apply
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            IF NOT
            (
                    @operation = N'Create'
                OR  @operation = N'Put'
            )
            BEGIN
                IF(@extendedOutput = 2)
                BEGIN
                    PRINT('Target is a ManagementPolicyRule, but the Operation is not a Create or Put. Policy is up to date.');
                END
            
                RETURN;
            END               
      
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * E.2 Get modified attributes and if not an ActionWorkflowDefinition or ResourceFinalSet
            * or Disabled change, then no policy workflows will apply
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

            INSERT INTO @requestParameter
            (
                [Attribute],
                [Value]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [AttributeName],
                [AttributeValue]
                FROM [fim].[RequestParameter]
                WHERE 
                        [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND 
                    (
                            [AttributeName] = N'ActionWorkflowDefinition'
                        OR  [AttributeName] = N'ResourceFinalSet'
                        OR  [AttributeName] = N'Disabled'
                    )

            IF(@@ROWCOUNT = 0)
            BEGIN
                IF(@extendedOutput = 2)
                BEGIN
                    PRINT('Target is a ManagementPolicyRule, but neither ActionWorkflowDefinition or ResourceFinalSet or Disabled attributes have changed. Policy is up to date.');
                END
             
                RETURN;
            END
            
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * E.3 This rule may apply so add it to temp table for further analysis.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            INSERT INTO @managementPolicyRule
            (
                [ManagementPolicyRuleObjectKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReferenceKey]
            )
            SELECT 
                [ovrAttribs].[ObjectKey],
                [ovrAttribs].[AttributeKey],
                [ovrAttribs].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [mprCache]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovrAttribs]
            ON
                [mprCache].[ObjectKey] = [ovrAttribs].[ObjectKey]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[WorkflowRetroactivePolicy] AS [wrap]
            ON  
                [ovrAttribs].[ValueReference] = [wrap].[WorkflowDefinitionKey]
            WHERE
                    [mprCache].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
                    
                    -- MPR is transitional and has ResourceFinalSet or ActionWorkflowDefinition defined and is of type WRAP
                AND [ovrAttribs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
                AND [mprCache].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = N'SetTransition'
                AND 
                (       [ovrAttribs].[AttributeKey] = @resourceFinalSetAttributeKey
                
                    OR  
                    (    
                            [ovrAttribs].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorfklowDefinitionAttributeKey                    
                        AND [wrap].[WorkflowDefinitionKey] IS NOT NULL
                    )
                );             
           
             IF(@@ROWCOUNT > 0)
             BEGIN
                SELECT @doWorkflowRetroactivePolicy = 1;
             END
             ELSE
             BEGIN
                IF(@extendedOutput = 2)
                BEGIN
                    PRINT('Target is an ManagementPolicyRule, but it is not enabled with ActionWorflows set to RunOnPolicyUpdate. Policy is up to date.');
                END
                
                RETURN;
             END          

             
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * E.4 If the only MPR change is to add a new WRAP then limit policy application
            * to just this new WRAP since previous workflows have already been applied.
            * Since ManagementPolicyRuleType and ActionType (TransitionIn|TransitionOut) attributes are 
            * not modifiable, therefore, if they are present in a request and define a WRAP, they will be 
            * accompanied with a ResourceFinalSet and we neeed not to detect their change separately.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            IF NOT EXISTS 
            (
                --If MPR is now enabled or we have a new set we apply all Workflows.
                SELECT [Attribute] 
                FROM @requestParameter 
                WHERE 
                        [Attribute] = N'ResourceFinalSet'
                    OR  [Attribute] = N'Disabled'
            )
            AND EXISTS
            (
                --If this is the only attribute change, then we want to only apply this workflow
                SELECT [Attribute]
                FROM @requestParameter
                WHERE
                    [Attribute] = N'ActionWorkflowDefinition'
            )
            BEGIN
                 --Since the target object is an MPR there is only 1 MPR in the @managementPolicyRule table.
                 --This deletes any action workflows from our temp table that previously existed and have already been applied to the members
                 --in ResourceFinalSet.
                 DELETE @managementPolicyRule
                 WHERE 
                        [AttributeKey] = @actionWorfklowDefinitionAttributeKey
                    AND [ValueReferenceKey] NOT IN
                        ( 
                            SELECT [ValueReference]
                            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
                            WHERE 
                                    [ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
                                AND [AttributeKey] = @actionWorfklowDefinitionAttributeKey
                                AND [Deleted] = 0
                        )
            END
            
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * E.5 MPR changes are applied to all members in the ResourceFinalSet
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
                SELECT @ApplyPolicyToAllMembersOfResourceFinalSet = 1;
         END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * F. Find the resources that are eligible for Workflow RetroActive Policy
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @resourceFinalSetMember TABLE
        (
			[SetKey] BIGINT,
            [MemberKey] BIGINT
        );

        IF(@ApplyPolicyToAllMembersOfResourceFinalSet = 1)
        BEGIN
            -- applies to all members of the set.
            INSERT INTO @resourceFinalSetMember
            (
				[SetKey],
                [MemberKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
				[ovr].[ObjectKey],
                [ovr].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
            INNER JOIN @managementPolicyRule AS [mpr]
            ON
                -- Join on the Set
                [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [mpr].[ValueReferenceKey]
            WHERE
                    --Where it is the FinalSet identified in the MPR
                    [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [mpr].[AttributeKey] = @resourceFinalSetAttributeKey
                    --Member of the set
                AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- applies to new members of the set so must join on 
            -- RequestOutput* table to get the new members who joined
            -- the set as a result of this request
            INSERT @resourceFinalSetMember
            (
				[SetKey],
                [MemberKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [newMembers].[ObjectKey],
                [newMembers].[ValueReference]
            FROM @managementPolicyRule AS [mpr]
            INNER JOIN [RequestOutputReference] AS [newMembers]
            ON
                [mpr].[ValueReferenceKey] = [newMembers].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [newMembers].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [newMembers].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey    
                AND [mpr].[AttributeKey] = @resourceFinalSetAttributeKey
                AND [newMembers].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [newMembers].[Deleted] = 0;
                
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * G. For each ActionWorkflowDefinition Attribute left in the @managementPolicyRule
        *    temp table, Apply the policy on the defined targets in @resourceFinalSetMember
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @collateralWorkflowCount INT;
        SELECT @collateralWorkflowCount = 0;
        
        DECLARE @commitTimeStamp DATETIME;
        SELECT @commitTimeStamp = GETUTCDATE();
        
        --DESIGN POINT:  A lock on this table [fim].[PolicyApplication] exists for dispatching and updates to existing rows
        --but we are adding new rows so do not need to use it.

        -- Insert workflows to be run on all the rows in @resourceFinalSetMember 
        -- where they are part of the final set, and have an actionWorklow applied
        -- and this workflow must not already be defined in RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition 
        -- for the target specified on this RequestKey        

        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT [RequestKey],
                [PolicyRuleKey],
                [ResourceKey],
                [SetKey],
                [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
                [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                [ActionWorkflowInstanceIdentifier]
            FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition]
        END


        INSERT INTO [fim].[PolicyApplication]
        (
            [TargetKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [RequestKey],
            [ManagementPolicyRuleKey],
            [Cause],
            [ServiceId],
            [DispatchTime],
            [IsCanceled]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rfsm].[MemberKey],
            [mprAwd].[ValueReferenceKey],
            [fim].[GetCurrentWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]([mprAwd].[ValueReferenceKey]),
            @requestKey,
            [mprFs].[ManagementPolicyRuleObjectKey],
            @principalObjectKey,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            0
        FROM @resourceFinalSetMember AS [rfsm]
        INNER JOIN @managementPolicyRule AS [mprFs]
        ON 
            [rfsm].[SetKey] = [mprFs].[ValueReferenceKey]
        INNER JOIN @managementPolicyRule AS [mprAwd] 
        ON 
            [mprFs].[ManagementPolicyRuleObjectKey] = [mprAwd].[ManagementPolicyRuleObjectKey]
        WHERE
        (
                --MPR must have a finalset and workflow attribute
                [mprFs].[AttributeKey] = @resourceFinalSetAttributeKey
            AND [mprAwd].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorfklowDefinitionAttributeKey

                --The workflow must not already have been added for the same target for the same request
                --during evaluateRequest processing.
            AND NOT EXISTS 
            (
                SELECT
                [rstawd].[ResourceKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [rstawd]
                WHERE
                (
                        [rstawd].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rstawd].[ResourceKey] = [rfsm].[MemberKey]
                    AND [rstawd].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey] = [mprAwd].[ValueReferenceKey]
                )
            )
        )

        --If we add rows to [fim].[PolicyApplication], mark this request as having a collateral request dependency.
        SELECT @collateralWorkflowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        IF (@collateralWorkflowCount > 0)
        BEGIN
            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
            BEGIN
                SELECT [SequenceKey],
                    [TargetKey],
                    [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
                    [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ManagementPolicyRuleKey],
                    [Cause],
                    [ServiceId],
                    [DispatchTime],
                    [IsCanceled]
                FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication]
                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END        
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoBindRequestWithCollateralRequestDependency] @requestKey = @requestKey, @collateralWorkflowCount = @collateralWorkflowCount, @commitTimeStamp = @commitTimeStamp;
        END
        
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoBindRequestWithCollateralRequestDependency]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoBindRequestWithCollateralRequestDependency]
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @collateralWorkflowCount INT,
    @commitTimeStamp DATETIME
AS
-- Only called from other stored procedures
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    BEGIN TRY 
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
        
        --DESIGN POINT:  Design this to be additive since there are currently two different places
        -- that can create Collateral Workflows.
        
        DECLARE @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
        
        DECLARE @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'HasCollateralRequest');       
        
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean]
            WHERE 
                    [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            -- First time Collateral Workflows have been identified for this Request
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean]
            (
                ObjectKey,
                ObjectTypeKey,
                AttributeKey,
                ValueBoolean
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey,
                1;   

            INSERT INTO [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [CollateralWorkflowCount],
                [AddTime],
                [TrackingStatus],
                [NextCheckTime]
            )
            SELECT 
                @requestKey,
                @collateralWorkflowCount,
                @commitTimeStamp,
                [fim].[CollateralRequestTrackingPending](),
                @commitTimeStamp;                     
        END      
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- This request already has CollateralWorkflows added to it so 
            -- just add the new ones to the total number and update the time stamps to current time.
            UPDATE [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking]
            SET 
                [CollateralWorkflowCount] = [CollateralWorkflowCount] + @collateralWorkflowCount,
                [AddTime] = @commitTimeStamp,
                [NextCheckTime] = @commitTimeStamp
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
        
        END        
            
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoBulkCancelRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoBulkCancelRequest]
    @trace              BIT             = 0,
    @extendedOutput     BIT             = 0
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN

    DECLARE @messageText    NVARCHAR(2000),
            @startTime      DATETIME,           
            @falseFlag      BIT;
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @falseFlag   = CONVERT(BIT,0);

    BEGIN TRY
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @falseFlag;

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * A. Initialize locals
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @acquiredLock                           INT,
                @acquiredLockRequestKey                 INT,                     
                @causeKey                               BIGINT,
                @didMarkForCancel                       BIT,
                @lockName                               NVARCHAR(64),               
                @reason                                 NVARCHAR(448),
                @reasonDetailLevel                      NVARCHAR(16), -- Error, Warning, Information
                @recordRequestControl                   BIT,
                @requestControlKey                      TINYINT,
                @requestKey                             BIGINT;

        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @acquiredLockRequestKey = -1, --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @lockName = N'BulkCancelRequest';
                
        -- We only want a single instance of this running at a time so get a Session lock.
        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockName,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session',
            @LockTimeout = 30000;   -- wait 30 seconds before giving up.

        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END        
        
       /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Cancel Identified Requests
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#bulkCancelRequest') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = N'Procedure requires tempdb..#bulkCancelRequest table as input.';
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #bulkCancelRequest
        )
        BEGIN

            DECLARE bulkCancelRequestCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT
                [RequestKey],
                [RequestControlKey],
                [CauseKey],
                [Reason],
                [ReasonDetailLevel],
                [RecordRequestControl]
            FROM #bulkCancelRequest

            OPEN bulkCancelRequestCursor;
            WHILE(1 = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT  @didMarkForCancel = NULL,
                        @causeKey = NULL,
                        @reason = NULL,
                        @reasonDetailLevel = NULL,
                        @recordRequestControl = NULL,
                        @requestControlKey = NULL,
                        @requestKey = NULL

                FETCH NEXT FROM bulkCancelRequestCursor INTO 
                    @requestKey,
                    @requestControlKey,
                    @causeKey,
                    @reason,
                    @reasonDetailLevel,
                    @recordRequestControl

                IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
                BEGIN
                    -- No More Records
                    BREAK;
                END
               
                BEGIN TRY
                
                    -- Diagnostics
                    IF(@extendedOutput = 2)
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT N'Processing RequestKey:' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(20));
                    END
                
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                    
                    -- Transactional Lock to make sure no other processing is happening on this request.
                    -- We try to get synchronized lock immediately and if another thread is processing this request we just skip past it.
                    EXECUTE @acquiredLockRequestKey = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @requestKey, @lockTimeout = 0;
                        
                    IF(@acquiredLockRequestKey != 0)
                    BEGIN
                        GOTO SkipCancel;
                    END
                                    
                        EXECUTE [fim].[DoCancelRequest]
                            @requestKey = @requestKey,
                            @requestControlKey = @requestControlKey,
                            @causeKey  = @causeKey,
                            @reason = @reason,
                            @reasonDetailLevel = @reasonDetailLevel,
                            @recordRequestControl = @recordRequestControl,
                            @didMarkForCancel = @didMarkForCancel OUTPUT;
                       
                        UPDATE #bulkCancelRequest
                        SET [DidMarkForCancel] = @didMarkForCancel
                        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                       
                SkipCancel: 
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                    IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
                    BEGIN
                        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                    END
                    
                    UPDATE #bulkCancelRequest
                    SET [Error] = ERROR_MESSAGE()
                    WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                  
                END CATCH
                
            END
            CLOSE bulkCancelRequestCursor;
            DEALLOCATE bulkCancelRequestCursor; 
        END        
   
    -- Release the Session lock.
    IF(@acquiredLock >= 0)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
            @Resource = @lockName,
            @LockOwner = N'Session';
    END        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        -- Release the Session lock.
        IF(@acquiredLock >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockName,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'DoBulkCancelRequest';
    END
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoCacheWorkflowDefinition]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoCacheWorkflowDefinition]
    @workflowDefinitionKey BIGINT,
    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT  @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    BEGIN TRY
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

        DECLARE @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');

        DECLARE @objectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');

        DECLARE @xomlAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @xomlAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'XOML');

        DECLARE @rulesAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @rulesAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Rules');

        DECLARE @requestPhaseAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @requestPhaseAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestPhase');
       
        DECLARE @didCache BIT;
        SELECT @didCache = 0;
        
        DECLARE @xoml NVARCHAR(MAX);
        DECLARE @rules NVARCHAR(MAX);
        DECLARE @workflowTypeName NVARCHAR(448);
        DECLARE @workflowType TINYINT;
        DECLARE @deleted BIT;

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Fetch current definition from ObjectValue*  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        
        --NOTE: Rules can be null so use LEFT JOIN for Rules Attribute
        SELECT 
            @xoml = [xovt].[ValueText],
            @rules = [rovt].[ValueText],
            @workflowTypeName = [wfovs].[ValueString]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [xovt]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [wfovs]
        ON
        (
                [xovt].[ObjectKey] = [wfovs].[ObjectKey]
            AND [wfovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
            AND [wfovs].[AttributeKey] = @requestPhaseAttributeKey
        )    
		LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [rovt]
        ON
        (
                [wfovs].[ObjectKey] = [rovt].[ObjectKey]
            AND [rovt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
            AND [rovt].[AttributeKey] = @rulesAttributeKey
        )

        WHERE
        (
                [xovt].[ObjectKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey
            AND [xovt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
            AND [xovt].[AttributeKey] = @xomlAttributeKey
        );
        
        IF(@@ROWCOUNT = 0)
        BEGIN
            -- This definition is no longer active so don't cache it
            RETURN;
        END
       
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Update the Workflow Definition version cache for any new version 
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        
        DECLARE @workflowTypeKey TINYINT;
        SELECT @workflowTypeKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey](@workflowTypeName);

        SELECT
            @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = [wd].[VersionKey],
            @deleted = [wd].[Deleted]
        FROM [fim].[WorkflowDefinition] AS [wd]
        WHERE
                [wd].[ObjectKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey
            AND [wd].[Xoml] = @xoml
            AND [wd].[WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeKey
            AND (
                        [wd].[Rules] = @rules
                    OR
                    (
                            @rules IS NULL 
                        AND [wd].[Rules] IS NULL
                    )
                )
            
        IF(@workflowDefinitionVersionKey IS NULL)
        BEGIN

            -- new definition.
            INSERT [fim].[WorkflowDefinition]
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [Xoml],
                [Rules],
                [WorkflowType],
                [Deleted]
            )
            SELECT
                @workflowDefinitionKey,
                @xoml,
                @rules,
                @workflowTypeKey,
                0
              
            SELECT @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
          
            -- Now that we have a new definition, mark all the older ones as deleted
            -- Any Workflow already committed in the system (current running or scheduled to be run) with an old key can still
            -- run the workflow or create an instance using the old definition.
            -- RequestEvaluation for new requests will only use the new version
            
            IF(@workflowDefinitionVersionKey IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @didCache = 1;
            END
        END
        ELSE IF(@deleted = 1)
        BEGIN
            -- This version of the workflow is now the active one so need to clear the flag.  
            -- This code is reached if a user creates a workflow version A, updates it to Version B, then later updates it to match A again.
            -- At this point Version A is now the active version.
            UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowDefinition]
            SET [Deleted] = 0
            WHERE [VersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey;
            
            IF(@@ROWCOUNT = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @didCache = 1;
            END
        END
        
        IF(@didCache = 1)
        BEGIN
                --Mark all other Versions as Deleted except the version that was just cached.
                UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowDefinition]
                SET [Deleted] = 1
                WHERE
                        [ObjectKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey
                    AND [VersionKey] != @workflowDefinitionVersionKey
                    AND [Deleted] = 0;        
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoCalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoCalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions]
    @setKey BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
/*
This sproc is needed to calculate the membershp changes that have to happen on any given group

Algorithm:
1) Take the sql query that is kept along with the group, modify it to select all the information necessary
2) Make outer join of the query above and the query that returns current members.
3) Where we get null on either side of the join we have an actionable item.
    a) If the null is on group query side we have to mark the member for removal
    b) If the null is on current membership query side we have to mark the member for adding
*/
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @sql    NVARCHAR(MAX);

    SELECT @sql = [sf].[Sql]
    FROM [fim].[SetFilter] AS [sf]
    WHERE [sf].[SetKey] = @setKey;
    
    IF @sql IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END

    SELECT @sql = REPLACE(@sql,
        N'SELECT DISTINCT [CandidateList].[ObjectKey]',
        N'SELECT DISTINCT ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @setKey)
            + N', [CandidateList].[ObjectKey],
                  [r].[ValueReference]');

    SELECT @sql =
    @sql +
    N'
    FULL OUTER JOIN
    (
        SELECT [r].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [r]
        WHERE [r].[ObjectKey] = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @setKey) + N'
            AND [r].[AttributeKey] = 40 -- ComputedMember, hardcoded for better performance of dynamic sql generation and readability
    ) AS [r]
    ON [CandidateList].[ObjectKey] = [r].[ValueReference]
    WHERE [CandidateList].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
        OR [r].[ValueReference] IS NULL'

        INSERT INTO #membershipModifications
        (
            [SetKey],
            [MemberToAdd],
            [MemberToRemove]
        )
        EXECUTE SP_EXECUTESQL @sql;
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoCancelRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
