CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoCancelRequest] 
    @requestKey                             BIGINT,
    @requestControlKey                      TINYINT,
    @causeKey                               BIGINT,
    @reason                                 NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @reasonDetailLevel                      NVARCHAR(16) = NULL, -- Error, Warning, Information
    @recordRequestControl                   BIT = 0,
    @didMarkForCancel                       BIT                 OUTPUT 
AS
-- Called by other stored procedures
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT  @didMarkForCancel = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    BEGIN TRY
    
        DECLARE @trueFlag BIT;
    
        SELECT @trueFlag   = CONVERT(BIT,1);

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;
    
        DECLARE @acquiredLock                                   INT,
                @allowCancelActionWorkflow                      BIT,
                @commitTime                                     DATETIME,
                @checkIfCanceledIsCompletedTime                 DATETIME,
                @falseFlag                                      BIT,
                @finalizeCauseWhenCancelCompleted               BIT,
                @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
                @messageText                                    NVARCHAR(2000),
                @parentRequestAttributeKey                      SMALLINT,
                @parentRequestKey                               BIGINT,
                @recordRequestControlKey                        TINYINT,                           
                @requestControlCancelOperationKey               TINYINT,            
                @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey         TINYINT,
                @requestIdentifier                              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,           
                @requestMonitorActionKey                        TINYINT,
                @requestMonitorActionCancelCollateralRequestKey TINYINT,
                @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey         TINYINT,
                @requestMonitorNextActionDate                   DATETIME,
                @requestFinalStatus                             NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatus                                  NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusCanceling                         NVARCHAR(448),
                @serviceAccountObjectKey                        BIGINT,
                @statusDetails                                  XML,
                @wasWorkflowCancelActionPerformed               BIT,
                @wasWorkflowCancelActionPerformedInt            INT,
                @cancelWorkflowLatencyInSeconds                 TINYINT;

        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @cancelWorkflowLatencyInSeconds = 15,
                    -- 15 seconds is chosen because the normal data exchange time between the FIMService and SQL for cancel workflow is ~ 7 seconds
                    -- (5 second polling timer + 2 seconds to re-hydrate the workflow, cancel it, and update the database to its final state.)
                    -- The extra 8 seconds is for buffer.  If it misses, it will try again after 1 minute.
                @commitTime = GETUTCDATE(),
                @didMarkForCancel = 0,
                @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
                @finalizeCauseWhenCancelCompleted = 1,
                @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'HasCollateralRequest'),
                @parentRequestAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'ParentRequest'),             
                @requestControlCancelOperationKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlCancelOperation]()),
                @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlSystemCancelOperation]()),
                @requestIdentifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@requestKey),
                @requestMonitorActionCancelCollateralRequestKey = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionCancelCollateralRequest]()),
                @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionFinalizeRequest]()),
                @requestStatusCanceling = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceling](),           
                @serviceAccountObjectKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey]();
                
        -- These depend on other variables in prior initialization.
        SELECT  @allowCancelActionWorkflow = @trueFlag,
                @requestMonitorNextActionDate = @commitTime;




        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @requestKey;
            
        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatNotAbleToObtainLockOnRequestKey](@requestKey);
            RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
        END
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get the Request status and determine if it is ok to perform the operation
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        SELECT @requestStatus = [ValueString]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
        WHERE
                [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ObjectTypeKey] = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request')
            AND [AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus');

        IF(@requestControlKey = @requestControlCancelOperationKey)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @allowCancelActionWorkflow = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF
        (
            [fim].[IsRequestStatusOkToCancelOperation](@requestStatus) = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @requestFinalStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceled]();
        END
        ELSE IF
        (
                @allowCancelActionWorkflow = @trueFlag
            AND [fim].[IsRequestStatusOkToCancelActionWorkflow](@requestStatus) = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @requestFinalStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing]();
        END
        
        -- Do not allow Request Cancel chaining:  Request 1;  Request 2 cancels Request 1;  Request 3 cancels Request 2 is NOT allowed.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking]
            WHERE [CauseKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidRequestOperationException](@requestIdentifier, N'Request Cancel chaining is not allowed.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
        END 
            
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. If status is not null then perform the operation
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF(@requestFinalStatus IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
           
            IF(@reason IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @statusDetails = [fim].[CreateRequestStatusDetail](@reason, @reasonDetailLevel);
            END
           
            IF(@recordRequestControl = @trueFlag)
            BEGIN
                -- Setting @requestControlKey to a non-NULL value will cause the [DoUpdateRequest]
                -- procedure to stamp it on the Request 
                SELECT @recordRequestControlKey = @requestControlKey;
            END
           
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @committedTime = @commitTime,
                @status = @requestStatusCanceling,
                @statusDetails = @statusDetails,
                @causeKey = @causeKey,
                @requestControlKey = @recordRequestControlKey;

            
            EXECUTE @wasWorkflowCancelActionPerformedInt = [fim].[DoDeleteOrCancelWorkflowInstances]
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @causeKey = @causeKey;

            SELECT @wasWorkflowCancelActionPerformed = CAST(@wasWorkflowCancelActionPerformedInt AS BIT)

            IF
            (       -- Cause is not a Request
                    @causeKey = @serviceAccountObjectKey
                OR  EXISTS
                (
                    -- Cause is already being monitored for Cancel
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking]
                    WHERE   [RequestKey] = @causeKey
                )
             )
             BEGIN
                -- Do not link finalization of the Cause to finalization of this Request
                SELECT @finalizeCauseWhenCancelCompleted = 0;
             END

            
            INSERT [fim].[RequestCancelTracking]
            (
                [RequestKey],          
                [CauseKey],               
                [RequestStatusCurrent],
                [RequestStatusFinal],  
                [AddTime],
                [FinalizeCancelRequest]             
            )    
            SELECT  @requestKey,
                    @causeKey,
                    @requestStatus,
                    @requestFinalStatus,
                    @commitTime,
                    @finalizeCauseWhenCancelCompleted;

            IF(@@ROWCOUNT != 1)
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Failed to add request [' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @requestKey) + N'] to RequestCancelTracking table.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
            END
            
            -- If this request has collateral requests then call DoCancelRequest on them recursively.
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb]
                WHERE 
                        [ovb].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [ovb].[AttributeKey] = @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                -- Setup async process to cancel all the CollateralRequests.
                SELECT  @requestMonitorActionKey = @requestMonitorActionCancelCollateralRequestKey;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- Setup async process to finalize this Request.
                IF(@wasWorkflowCancelActionPerformed = @trueFlag)
                BEGIN
                    -- delay the check to wait for workflows to cancel.
                    SELECT  @requestMonitorNextActionDate = DATEADD(second, @cancelWorkflowLatencyInSeconds, @commitTime);
                END
                
                SELECT @requestMonitorActionKey = @requestMonitorActionFinalizeRequestKey;
            END

            DELETE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

            INSERT [fim].[RequestMonitor]
            (
                [RequestKey],        
                [RequestStatusKey],  
                [ActionType],        
                [DateAdded],         
                [NextActionDate],    
                [ActionsAttempted]  
            )      
            SELECT 
                @requestKey, 
                [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@requestStatusCanceling), 
                @requestMonitorActionKey,
                @commitTime,
                @requestMonitorNextActionDate, 
                0;

            SELECT @didMarkForCancel = 1;
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoCompositeTypeCreation]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoCompositeTypeCreation]
    @compositeTypeIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @creator UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @values XML(CONTENT [fim].[ReferenceSchemaCollection])
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;    

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

    DECLARE 
        @attributeKeyCreatedTime    SMALLINT,
        @attributeKeyCreator        SMALLINT,
        @attributeKeyElement        SMALLINT,        
        @attributeKeyObjectID       SMALLINT,
        @attributeKeyObjectType     SMALLINT,
        @compositeTypeObjectKey     BIGINT,
        @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @creatorObjectKey           BIGINT,
        @defaultLocaleKey           SMALLINT,
        @time                       DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                   BIT,
        @falseFlag                  BIT;

    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier] 
        @objectID   = @creator,
        @objectKey  = @creatorObjectKey OUTPUT;
            
    SELECT
        @attributeKeyCreatedTime    = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'CreatedTime'),
        @attributeKeyCreator        = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'Creator'),
        @attributeKeyElement        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'msidmElement'),        
        @attributeKeyObjectID       = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'ObjectID'),
        @attributeKeyObjectType     = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'ObjectType'),
        @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'msidmCompositeType'),
        @defaultLocaleKey           = [fim].[GetDefaultLocaleKey](),
        @time                       = GETUTCDATE(),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);


    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier] 
        @objectID = @compositeTypeIdentifier,
        @objectTypeKey = @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey,
        @objectKey = @compositeTypeObjectKey OUTPUT;
      
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Build and populate a table of the compositeType's attributes.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
 
    DECLARE @attribute TABLE
    (
        [AttributeKey]     SMALLINT,
        [ValueDateTime]    DATETIME,
        [ValueReference]   BIGINT,
        [ValueString]      NVARCHAR(448)
    );

    INSERT INTO @attribute
    (
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueDateTime],
        [ValueReference],
        [ValueString]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @attributeKeyObjectID,
        NULL,
        @compositeTypeObjectKey,
        NULL;
            
    INSERT INTO @attribute
    (
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueDateTime],
        [ValueReference],
        [ValueString]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @attributeKeyObjectType,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        N'msidmCompositeType';
            
    INSERT INTO @attribute
    (
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueDateTime],
        [ValueReference],
        [ValueString]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @attributeKeyCreator,
        NULL,
        @creatorObjectKey,
        NULL;
            
    INSERT INTO @attribute
    (
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueDateTime],
        [ValueReference],
        [ValueString]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @attributeKeyCreatedTime,
        @time,
        NULL,
        NULL;

    INSERT INTO @attribute
    (
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueDateTime],
        [ValueReference],
        [ValueString]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @attributeKeyElement,
        NULL,
        [o].[ObjectKey],
        NULL
    FROM
    (
        SELECT [o].[value]('.[1]', 'uniqueidentifier') AS [item]
        FROM @values.nodes('/v') O(o)
    ) [Identifiers]
    JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
    ON [Identifiers].[item] = [o].[ObjectID];
                    
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Range-lock the non-reference attributes so that SequenceID is unique
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                    
    DECLARE @count INT;
    
    SELECT @count = COUNT([t].[ObjectKey])
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [t] WITH (XLOCK)
    WHERE       
            [t].[AttributeKey]  = @attributeKeyCreatedTime
        AND [t].[ObjectKey]     = @compositeTypeObjectKey
        AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey;

    SELECT @count = COUNT([t].[ObjectKey])
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [t] WITH (XLOCK)
    WHERE 
            [t].[AttributeKey]  = @attributeKeyObjectType
        AND [t].[ObjectKey]     = @compositeTypeObjectKey
        AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Store the composite type as a normal object  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                    
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] 
    (   
        [ObjectKey], 
        [ObjectTypeKey], 
        [AttributeKey],
        [SequenceID],
        [ValueDateTime],
        [Multivalued] 
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @compositeTypeObjectKey,
        @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey,
        [a].[AttributeKey],
        CAST((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [a].[AttributeKey] ORDER BY [a].[AttributeKey]) - 1) AS SMALLINT),
        [a].[ValueDateTime],
        [ai].[Multivalued]         
    FROM @attribute AS [a]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [a].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    WHERE   [a].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyCreatedTime;

    INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
    (   
        [ObjectKey], 
        [ObjectTypeKey], 
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference],
        [Multivalued] 
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @compositeTypeObjectKey,
        @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey,
        [a].[AttributeKey],
        [a].[ValueReference],
        [ai].[Multivalued] 
    FROM @attribute AS [a]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [a].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    WHERE
            (
                    [a].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyCreator
                OR  [a].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyElement
                OR  [a].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyObjectID
            );

    -- Design point: The multi-value sequence number will be set to zero
    -- since this is only expected to accomodate single-valued strings.
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
    (   
        [ObjectKey], 
        [ObjectTypeKey], 
        [AttributeKey],
        [SequenceID],
        [LocaleKey],
        [ValueString],
        [Multivalued]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @compositeTypeObjectKey,
        @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey,
        [a].[AttributeKey],
        0,
        @defaultLocaleKey,
        [a].[ValueString],
        @falseFlag
    FROM @attribute AS [a]
    WHERE   [a].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKeyObjectType;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.    Trigger any necessary set transitions for the compositeType resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    EXECUTE [fim].[DoSystemObjectSetTransitions] 
        @objectKey      = @compositeTypeObjectKey,
        @objectTypeKey  = @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey;

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoCreateEvaluateAndProcessSystemRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoCreateEvaluateAndProcessSystemRequest]
    @requestDisplayNameTemplate NVARCHAR(448) = NULL,
    @operation NVARCHAR(448),
    @parameters XML = NULL,
    @ancillaryParameters XML = NULL,
    @targetIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT, -- INPUT and OUTPUT
    @requestIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT,
    @requestStatusFinalKey SMALLINT OUTPUT,
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 0  -- 0 None, 1 Diagnostic Recordsets, 2 messages
AS
-- Called by other stored procedures
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
    END
    
    SELECT  @requestIdentifier = NULL,              -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @requestStatusFinalKey = NULL;          -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

   -- WARNING:  @targetIdentifier is an INPUT and OUTPUT param, must set its value for SR0013 to pass
    SELECT  @targetIdentifier = @targetIdentifier;  -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013



    BEGIN TRY

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        DECLARE @committedRequestStatusKey SMALLINT,
                @committedTime DATETIME,
                @displayName NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestDependencyKey TINYINT,
                @requestKey BIGINT,
                @requestMarker UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusFailedKey SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusKey SMALLINT,
                @resourceKey BIGINT,
                @serviceAccountIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @serviceAccountObjectKey BIGINT,
                @systemServicePartitionId SMALLINT,
                @systemServiceId SMALLINT,
                @targetObjectTypeName NVARCHAR(448),
                @time DATETIME;

        SELECT  @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestMarker = NEWID(),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                @requestStatusFailedKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusFailed]()),
                @requestStatusFinalKey = @requestStatusFailedKey, -- Default to Failed.                 
                @serviceAccountIdentifier = [fim].[GetServiceAccountIdentifier](),
                @serviceAccountObjectKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey](),
                @systemServiceId = [fim].[GetSystemServiceId](),
                @systemServicePartitionId = [fim].[GetSystemServicePartitionId]();                 

        -- Create the request                  
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoRequestCreation]
            @servicePartitionId = @systemServicePartitionId,
            @serviceId = @systemServiceId,
            @targetIdentifier =	@targetIdentifier OUTPUT,
            @creator = @serviceAccountIdentifier,
            @anonymous = 0, 
            @operation = @operation,
            @parameters = @parameters,
            @ancillaryParameters = @ancillaryParameters,
            @displayNameTemplate = @requestDisplayNameTemplate,
            @doSetTransitions = 1,
            @cause = @serviceAccountIdentifier,
            @requestMarker = @requestMarker,
            @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT,
            @displayName = @displayName OUTPUT,
            @targetObjectTypeName = @targetObjectTypeName OUTPUT,
            @time = @time OUTPUT;

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @requestIdentifier,
            @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @requestKey OUTPUT;

        -- Calculate Set Transitions and MPRs + Action Workflows
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoEvaluateRequest]
            @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier, 
            @doNotEnforceRights = 1, 
            @bypassAction = 0, 
            @bypassAuthentication = 1, 
            @bypassAuthorization = 1, 
            @trace = 0;
                
         -- Processing each Request must be transactional to keep the data change and request
        -- object in sync.  Each set is processed and Committed independent of the others.
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    
        -- Commit the changes to the Set and commit the Collateral Action Workflows (if specified)	
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoProcessRequest]
            @requestKey = @requestKey,
            @includeResourceInActionWorkflowCreation = 1,  --create ActionWorkflows for Target if policy dictates.
            @trace = 0,
            @resourceKey = @resourceKey OUTPUT,    
            @requestDependencyKey = @requestDependencyKey OUTPUT,
            @committedRequestStatusKey = @committedRequestStatusKey OUTPUT,
            @committedTime = @committedTime OUTPUT 

        --At this point the Request can have these states:
        --  1) ActionWorkflows were created against the Target of the Request
        --  2) CollateralAction Workflows were created against other Objects that Transitioned in/out of the Target Set
        --  3) Both 1) and 2)
        --  4) Neither 1) nor 2)
        
        DECLARE @workflowTypeActionKey TINYINT;
        SELECT @workflowTypeActionKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey]([fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]());
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            WHERE 
                    [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeActionKey
        )
        BEGIN
            -- State 1 or State 3 = true; we need to have the Service resume this request from its current state (Committed) and run the action workflows
            DECLARE @currentTime DATETIME;
            SELECT @currentTime = GETUTCDATE();
        
            INSERT [fim].[RequestMonitor]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [RequestStatusKey],
                [ActionType],
                [DateAdded],
                [NextActionDate],
                [ActionsAttempted]
            )
            SELECT 
                @requestKey,
                @committedRequestStatusKey,
                [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeRequest]()),
                @currentTime,
                @currentTime,  -- Resume as soon as possible
                0

            -- Return Final status
            SELECT @requestStatusFinalKey = @committedRequestStatusKey;
                
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF(@requestDependencyKey IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                -- State 4 = true; There were no Action Workflows created for this request of any type.
                -- no dependencies so complete the request now.
                SELECT @requestStatusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]());
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- State 2 = true; there were only collateral workflows created so we can't finalize the request just yet.
                -- rely on PostProcessManager to complete the request when all dependencies are completed.
                SELECT @requestStatusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessing]());
             END
            
            -- Only update the RequestStatus if we did not dispatch to the Service.
            EXECUTE [fim].DoUpdateRequest 
                @requestKey = @requestKey, 
                @statusKey = @requestStatusKey,
                @causeKey = @serviceAccountObjectKey,
                @trace = 0;
                
            -- Return Final status    
            SELECT @requestStatusFinalKey = @requestStatusKey;
        END
          
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        
        -- If we created a Request we need to mark it as Failed 
        IF(@requestKey IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                EXECUTE [fim].DoUpdateRequest 
                @requestKey = @requestKey, 
                @statusKey = @requestStatusFailedKey,
                @causeKey = @serviceAccountObjectKey,
                @failed = 1,
                @trace = 0;
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        END
	
    	EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
	END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoCreateWorkflowInstance]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *

--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoCreateWorkflowInstance]
    @workflowDefinitionKey          BIGINT          = NULL,
    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey   INT             = NULL,
    @requestKey                     BIGINT,
    @principalKey                   BIGINT,
    @targetKey                      BIGINT,
    @workflowType                   TINYINT,
    @processingTime                 DATETIME,
    @workflowInstanceKey            BIGINT                  OUTPUT,
    @workflowInstanceIdentifier     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER        OUTPUT
AS
-- Called by other stored procedures
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT  @workflowInstanceKey = NULL,        -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @workflowInstanceIdentifier = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    BEGIN TRY

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * A. Declare and initialize variables.  
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @creatorAttributeKey                SMALLINT,
                @createdTimeAttributeKey            SMALLINT,
                @defaultStatus                      NVARCHAR(448),
                @defaultWorkflowInstanceStatusKey   TINYINT,
                @deleteCause                        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @deleted                            BIT,
                @displayName                        NVARCHAR(448),
                @displayNameAttributeKey            SMALLINT,
                @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
                @objectIDAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
                @objectTypeAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
                @requestAttributeKey                SMALLINT,
                @requestorAttributeKey              SMALLINT,
                @requestTypeKey                     SMALLINT,
                @rules                              NVARCHAR(MAX),
                @serviceId                          SMALLINT,
                @targetAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
                @workflowDefinitionAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
                @workflowDefinitionIdentifier       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey    SMALLINT,
                @workflowInstanceTypeKey            SMALLINT,
                @workflowStatusAttributeKey         SMALLINT,
                @workflowTypeAttributeKey           SMALLINT,
                @workflowTypeName                   NVARCHAR(32),
                @xoml                               NVARCHAR(MAX);

        SELECT  @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
                @creatorAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Creator'),
                @defaultStatus = [fim].[WorkflowStatusPending](),
                @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
                @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
                @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
                @requestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestorAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Requestor'),
                @requestTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @targetAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Target'),
                @workflowDefinitionAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition'),
                @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition'),
                @workflowStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowStatus'),
                @workflowInstanceIdentifier = NEWID(),
                @workflowInstanceTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowInstance'),
                @workflowTypeName = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeName](@workflowType);

        -- Depends on values initialized above
        SELECT  @defaultWorkflowInstanceStatusKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey](@defaultStatus);


        IF(@workflowTypeName = NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'workflowType');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        SELECT  @workflowTypeAttributeKey = 
            CASE 
                WHEN(@workflowTypeName = [fim].[WorkflowTypeAuthentication]()) THEN [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthenticationWorkflowInstance')
                WHEN(@workflowTypeName = [fim].[WorkflowTypeAuthorization]()) THEN [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthorizationWorkflowInstance')
                WHEN(@workflowTypeName = [fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]()) THEN [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ActionWorkflowInstance')
                ELSE NULL
            END;

        IF(@workflowTypeAttributeKey = NULL)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequiredAttributeViolationException](N'@workflowTypeAttributeKey');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        IF(@workflowDefinitionVersionKey IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = [fim].[GetCurrentWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey](@workflowDefinitionKey);
        END

        IF(@workflowDefinitionKey IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            
            EXECUTE [fim].[RetrieveWorkflowDefinition]
                @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey,
                @workflowDefinitionIdentifier = @workflowDefinitionIdentifier OUTPUT, 
                @xoml = @xoml OUTPUT,
                @rules = @rules OUTPUT,
                @workflowType = @workflowType OUTPUT,
                @deleted = @deleted OUTPUT
                
            EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                @objectID = @workflowDefinitionIdentifier,
                @objectTypeKey = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey,
                @objectKey = @workflowDefinitionKey OUTPUT;
        END
        
        IF(@workflowDefinitionVersionKey IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Failed to find the version key for WorkflowDefinition ' + CAST(@workflowDefinitionIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(36)) + ' in [WorkflowDefinition] table.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
       
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @workflowInstanceIdentifier,
            @objectTypeKey = @workflowInstanceTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @workflowInstanceKey OUTPUT;

        SELECT @serviceId = [ServiceId]
        FROM [fim].[Request]
        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
     
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * B. Determine the display name.  
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/  
        SELECT @displayName = vs.[ValueString]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [vs]
        WHERE 
                [vs].[ObjectKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey
            AND [vs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey;

        IF(@displayName IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @displayName = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(448),@workflowDefinitionKey);
        END
        
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * C. Add the workflow instance to the primary object table.  
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/      
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueReference] 
            @ObjectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @AttributeKey   = @objectIDAttributeKey,
            @value          = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
            	
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueString] 
            @objectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @attributeKey   = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
            @value          = N'WorkflowInstance',
            @localeKey      = NULL,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
            	
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueReference] 
            @ObjectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @AttributeKey   = @creatorAttributeKey,
            @value          = @principalKey,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
            	
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueDateTime] 
            @ObjectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @AttributeKey   = @createdTimeAttributeKey,
            @value          = @processingTime,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
            	
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueReference] 
            @ObjectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @AttributeKey   = @requestAttributeKey,
            @value          = @requestKey,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
            	
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueReference] 
            @ObjectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @AttributeKey   = @requestorAttributeKey,
            @value          = @principalKey,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
            	
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueReference] 
            @ObjectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @AttributeKey   = @targetAttributeKey,
            @value          = @targetKey,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
            	
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueReference] 
            @ObjectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @AttributeKey   = @workflowDefinitionAttributeKey,
            @value          = @workflowDefinitionKey,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
            	
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueString] 
            @objectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @attributeKey   = @workflowStatusAttributeKey,
            @value          = @defaultStatus,
            @localeKey      = NULL,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;

        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueString] 
            @objectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @attributeKey   = @displayNameAttributeKey,
            @value          = @displayName,
            @localeKey      = NULL,
            @objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * D. Associate authorization and action workflow instances with a request.  
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
     
        DECLARE @attributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @attributeKey = @workflowTypeAttributeKey; 
  
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueReference] 
            @ObjectKey      = @requestKey,
            @AttributeKey   = @attributeKey,
            @value          = @workflowInstanceKey,
            @objectTypeKey  = @requestTypeKey;
     
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * E. Cache the workflow instance
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/  
        INSERT INTO [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [Identifier],                   
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [WorkflowType],                
            [RequestKey],                  
            [RequestorKey],                
            [TargetKey],                   
            [WorkflowStatus],              
            [Finished],                    
            [ServiceId],                      
            [WorkflowControlMessage],      
            [MessageReason],
            [RequestUpdateFailed]               
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @workflowInstanceKey,
            @workflowInstanceIdentifier,
            @workflowDefinitionKey,
            @workflowDefinitionVersionKey,
            @workflowType,
            @requestKey,
            @principalKey,
            @targetKey,
            @defaultWorkflowInstanceStatusKey,
            0,
            @serviceId,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            0
        );
       

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F. Perform system object set transitions.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/   
	EXECUTE [fim].[DoSystemObjectSetTransitions] 
		@objectKey      = @workflowInstanceKey,
		@objectTypeKey  = @workflowInstanceTypeKey;
            
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoDeleteCachedRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoDeleteCachedRequest]
        @requestKey BIGINT,
        @trace      BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @startTime DATETIME;

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    BEGIN TRY

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

        DELETE [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE 
                [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

        DELETE [fim].[PolicyApplication]
        WHERE
                [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

        DELETE [fim].[RequestCancelTracking] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE 
                [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

        EXECUTE [fim].[DeleteRequestOutput] 
            @requestKey = @requestKey;
        
        DELETE [fim].[RequestParameter] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
        DELETE [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE  [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
        DELETE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
        DELETE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
        DELETE [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
        DELETE [fim].[RequestPolicyRule] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

        DELETE [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

        DELETE [fim].[RequestStatusChange] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

        DELETE [fim].[RequestMonitor] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

        DELETE [fim].[WorkflowInstance] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                
        DELETE [fim].[Request] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE    [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH        

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'DoDeleteCachedRequest';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoDeleteMembershipCondition]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoDeleteMembershipCondition] 
    @membershipConditionKey INT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKey    INT,
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName  NVARCHAR(32),
        @membershipConditionKeyString               NVARCHAR(64);
        
    SELECT 
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName  =   [fim].[GetMembershipConditionAncillaryParameterName](),
        @membershipConditionKeyString               =   CAST(@membershipConditionKey AS NVARCHAR(64));
    
    DECLARE @statement  TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey]  INT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [StatementKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @negativeStatement      TABLE
    (
        [NegativeStatementKey]      INT,
        [PositiveStatementKey]      INT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [NegativeStatementKey],
            [PositiveStatementKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @nonObsoleteTabularFunction TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey]          INT NOT NULL,
        [TabularFunctionKey]    INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [TabularFunctionKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @tabularFunction TABLE
    (
        [TabularFunctionKey] INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );
        
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mc]
        WHERE       [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [smc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
        WHERE       [smc].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionDereferencedValue] AS [mcdv]
        WHERE
                [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [smc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mc]
            ON [smc].[MembershipConditionkey] = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [mc].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionDereferencedValue] AS [mcdv]
            ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcdv].[StatementKey]
            AND [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    OR EXISTS
    (
        --If any request in process is referencing this MembershipCondition then don't delete it.
        --Because we are tieing into data this is still in process, there is a chance that the requests
        --that reference these MembershipConditions fail due to rights checks or other issues which could 
        --lead to unused Membership Conditions in the database.  It is low probability and a suggestion would
        --be to provide some other "clean-up" procedure that would periodically scan all membership conditions
        --and do cleanup as needed.
        SELECT [rap].[Value]
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
        WHERE 
                [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
            AND [Value] = @membershipConditionKeyString
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    INSERT INTO @statement
    (
        [StatementKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT    [mc].[StatementKey] 
    FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mc]
    WHERE        [mc].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;           
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM @statement AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE        [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] != @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [candidate]
        FROM @statement AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE        [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] != @membershipConditionKey
    END

      
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM @statement AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negativeStatement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatement].[PositiveStatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @negativeStatement
        (
            [NegativeStatementKey],
            [PositiveStatementKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [negativeStatement].[NegativeStatementKey],
            [negativeStatement].[PositiveStatementKey]
        FROM @statement AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [negativeStatement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negativeStatement].[PositiveStatementKey];
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [negative].[NegativeStatementKey]
            FROM @negativeStatement AS [negative]
            INNER JOIN @statement AS [candidate]
                ON  [negative].[NegativeStatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [negative]
            FROM @negativeStatement AS [negative]
            INNER JOIN @statement AS [candidate]
                ON  [negative].[NegativeStatementKey] = [candidate].[StatementKey];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM @statement AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN @negativeStatement AS [negative]
                ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[PositiveStatementKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [candidate]
            FROM @statement AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN @negativeStatement AS [negative]
                ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [negative].[PositiveStatementKey]
        END
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT    [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionDereferencedValue] AS [mcdv]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [s]
            ON  [mcdv].[StatementKey]  = [s].[StatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE [membershipConditionCursor] CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT    [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionDereferencedValue] AS [mcdv]
            INNER JOIN @statement AS [s]
                ON  [mcdv].[StatementKey]  = [s].[StatementKey];
                    
        OPEN [membershipConditionCursor];
        WHILE(1 = 1)
        BEGIN
            SET @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKey = NULL;
          
            FETCH NEXT FROM [membershipConditionCursor] INTO 
                @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKey
            
            IF @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKey IS NULL
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteMembershipCondition] @membershipConditionKey = @dereferencedValueMembershipConditionKey;
        END;
        CLOSE [membershipConditionCursor];
        DEALLOCATE [membershipConditionCursor];

    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementAttribute] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementAttribute] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [candidate]
        WHERE        [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [candidate]
        WHERE        [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
    END
       
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [candidate]
        WHERE        [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN     
        DELETE [candidate] 
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject] AS [candidate] WITH (ROWLOCK)
        WHERE        [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
    END
          
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionDereferencedValue] AS [candidate]
        WHERE 
                [candidate].[StatementKey] IN
                (
                    SELECT [s].[StatementKey]
                    FROM @statement AS [s]
                )
    )
    BEGIN  
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionDereferencedValue] AS [candidate]
        WHERE 
                [candidate].[StatementKey] IN
                (
                    SELECT [s].[StatementKey]
                    FROM @statement AS [s]
                )
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[PositiveStatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[PositiveStatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]  
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE  [candidate]      
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[PositiveStatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey];
    END
         
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [candidate]
        WHERE   [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN   
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [candidate]
        WHERE   [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionAttributeSignature] AS [candidate]
        WHERE   [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionAttributeSignature] AS [candidate]
        WHERE   [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition]
        WHERE   [MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition]
        WHERE    [MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute]
        WHERE   [MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute]
        WHERE    [MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition]
        WHERE    [MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition]
        WHERE    [MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey;
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey];
    END
           
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN 
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey];
    END
            
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey]
        FROM @statement AS [obsolete]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [obsolete].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE        [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @tabularFunction
        (
            [TabularFunctionKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey]
        FROM @statement AS [obsolete]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [obsolete].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE        [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
        
        INSERT INTO @nonObsoleteTabularFunction
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [TabularFunctionKey]            
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [statement].[StatementKey],
            [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey]
        FROM @statement AS [obsolete]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [obsolete].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE        [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL;
        
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM @nonObsoleteTabularFunction AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [obsolete]
            ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [obsolete].[StatementKey];
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[TabularFunctionKey]
            FROM @tabularFunction AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN @nonObsoleteTabularFunction AS [function]
                ON    [candidate].[TabularFunctionKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM @tabularFunction AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN @nonObsoleteTabularFunction AS [function]
                ON    [candidate].[TabularFunctionKey] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey];
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN @tabularFunction AS [obsolete]
            ON    [value].[TabularFunctionKey] = [obsolete].[TabularFunctionKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [value]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN @tabularFunction AS [obsolete]
            ON    [value].[TabularFunctionKey] = [obsolete].[TabularFunctionKey];
    END
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN @tabularFunction AS [obsolete]
            ON    [value].[TabularFunctionKey] = [obsolete].[TabularFunctionKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [value]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN @tabularFunction AS [obsolete]
            ON    [value].[TabularFunctionKey] = [obsolete].[TabularFunctionKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [value].[TabularFunctionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN @tabularFunction AS [obsolete]
            ON    [value].[TabularFunctionKey] = [obsolete].[TabularFunctionKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [value]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN @tabularFunction AS [obsolete]
            ON    [value].[TabularFunctionKey] = [obsolete].[TabularFunctionKey];
    END 
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey];
    END   
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @statement AS [statement]
            ON  [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunction] AS [function]
        INNER JOIN @tabularFunction AS [obsolete]
            ON    [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = [obsolete].[TabularFunctionKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [function]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunction] AS [function]
        INNER JOIN @tabularFunction AS [obsolete]
            ON    [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = [obsolete].[TabularFunctionKey];
    END
    
    DECLARE @targetReferentKey INT
    SELECT @targetReferentKey = [fim].[GetMembershipConditionTargetReferentKey]();
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ReferentKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionReferent]
        WHERE 
                [ReferentKey] != @targetReferentKey
            AND [ReferentKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [mcs].[ReferentKey]
                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                WHERE 
                        [mcs].[StatementKey] IN
                        (
                            SELECT [s].[StatementKey]
                            FROM @statement AS [s]
                        )
                    AND [mcs].[ReferentKey] NOT IN
                        (
                            SELECT [mcsR].[ReferentKey]
                            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcsR]
                            WHERE 
                                    [mcsR].[StatementKey] NOT IN
                                    (
                                        SELECT [s].[StatementKey]
                                        FROM @statement AS [s]
                                    )
                        )
            )
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionReferent]
        WHERE 
                [ReferentKey] != @targetReferentKey
            AND [ReferentKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [mcs].[ReferentKey]
                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
                WHERE 
                        [mcs].[StatementKey] IN
                        (
                            SELECT [s].[StatementKey]
                            FROM @statement AS [s]
                        )
                    AND [mcs].[ReferentKey] NOT IN
                        (
                            SELECT [mcsR].[ReferentKey]
                            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcsR]
                            WHERE 
                                    [mcsR].[StatementKey] NOT IN
                                    (
                                        SELECT [s].[StatementKey]
                                        FROM @statement AS [s]
                                    )
                        )
            );
    END
    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoDeleteMembershipConditionPartitioningStatement]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoDeleteMembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] 
    @statementKey INT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [partition]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [partition]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
    END
END
