/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoDeleteOrCancelWorkflowInstances]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoDeleteOrCancelWorkflowInstances] 
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @causeKey  BIGINT
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    BEGIN TRY
     
        DECLARE @causeString NVARCHAR(64),
                @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning NVARCHAR(16);

        SELECT  @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning = [fim].[RequestStatusDetailLevelWarning]();

        SELECT @causeString = 
        CASE WHEN @causeKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey]() THEN N'Canceled by system.'
             ELSE N'Canceled by user or administrator.'
        END

        DECLARE @workflowsDeletedFromPolicyCount INT;
        SELECT @workflowsDeletedFromPolicyCount = 0;

        DECLARE @workflowsCanceledFromPolicyCount INT;
        SELECT @workflowsCanceledFromPolicyCount = 0;

        DECLARE @workflowsDeletedFromWorkflowInstance INT;
        SELECT @workflowsDeletedFromWorkflowInstance = 0;

        DECLARE @workflowsCanceledFromWorkflowInstance INT; 
        SELECT @workflowsCanceledFromWorkflowInstance = 0;

        DECLARE @wasDataChanged BIT;
        SELECT @wasDataChanged = 0;   -- return value to indicate whether this stored procedure did any work.

        DECLARE @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'HasCollateralRequest');

        DECLARE @lockNamePolicyApplication NVARCHAR(32);
        SELECT @lockNamePolicyApplication = N'PolicyApplication';

        DECLARE @acquiredLockPolicyApplication SMALLINT;
        SELECT @acquiredLockPolicyApplication = -1;  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API

        DECLARE @lockNameWorkflowInstance NVARCHAR(32);
        SELECT  @lockNameWorkflowInstance = N'WorkflowInstance';

        DECLARE @acquiredLockWorkflowInstance SMALLINT;
        SELECT  @acquiredLockWorkflowInstance = -1;  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API

        DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000);
        
        DECLARE @commitTime DATETIME;
        SELECT @commitTime = GETUTCDATE();

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Determine if we have Collateral Requests and include all of their workflows in this cancel operation:
        *    1) Remove Collateral Action Workflows from [fim].[PolicyApplication] not yet Dispatched for Creation
        *      2) Mark for Cancel Collateral Action Workflows already dispatched (but not yet created)
        *      3) Add to @request table so the workflows already created can be canceled/deleted 
        *    4) Add RequestStatusDetail to track results.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ovb].ObjectKey
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb]
            WHERE 
                    [ovb].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ovb].[AttributeKey] = @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            --DESIGN POINT:  Need lock to block FIM Service from trying to dispatch any more records
            --until we finish the cancel operation
            EXECUTE @acquiredLockPolicyApplication = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNamePolicyApplication,
                @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
                
            IF(@acquiredLockPolicyApplication < 0)
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockNamePolicyApplication + ' because it is locked by another process.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END

            --STOP creation of collateral requests that have not yet been dispatched
            DELETE [fim].[PolicyApplication]
            WHERE 
                    [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ServiceId] IS NULL;
                
            SELECT @workflowsDeletedFromPolicyCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

            -- Mark any dispatched records as Canceled to block [fim].DoRequestCreation from creating new workflows.
            UPDATE [fim].[PolicyApplication]
            SET [IsCanceled] = 1
            WHERE
                    [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ServiceId] IS NOT NULL
                AND [IsCanceled] = 0 --not already set to canceled
                
            SELECT @workflowsCanceledFromPolicyCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
             
            -- Since we are deleting workflows from the system we need to update the master tracking
            -- table with the number of workflows that will have auditable objects because this value is
            -- used to ensure all records are accounted for before the primary Request Status is updated to its final value.
            -- because the value has changed, set [NextActionDate] to now so the code that processes this table will check
            -- it immediately.
            UPDATE [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking]
            SET 
                [CollateralWorkflowCount] = [CollateralWorkflowCount] - @workflowsDeletedFromPolicyCount,
                [NextCheckTime] = @commitTime
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

        END

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Move Workflows not yet started to deleted status which prevents them from being started.
        *    Mark for Cancel workflows already started but have not yet reached a final state.
        *    Workflow host will attempt to cancel.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        --DESIGN POINT:  This stored proc is used to delete a workflow instance if it is not already created or set a message
        --to the host to cancel the workflow if it is still running.  The workflowInstance lock is needed to make sure we don't try to delete a 
        --workflow that is already running.
        EXECUTE @acquiredLockWorkflowInstance = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockNameWorkflowInstance,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
            
        IF(@acquiredLockWorkflowInstance < 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockNameWorkflowInstance + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        DECLARE @workflowStatusKeyDidNotExecute TINYINT;
        SELECT @workflowStatusKeyDidNotExecute = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusDidNotExecute]());
        
        DECLARE @workflowStatusKeyPending TINYINT;
        SELECT @workflowStatusKeyPending = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].WorkflowStatusPending());
      
        DECLARE @workflowControlMessageKeyCancel TINYINT;
        SELECT @workflowControlMessageKeyCancel = [fim].[GetWorkflowControlMessageKey]([fim].[WorkflowControlMessageCancel]());

        -- DESIGN POINT   order is important because we want to mark pending workflows first so they are not part of the 2nd update below.
 
        -- Part 1 - Pending Workflows

        -- We must use a cursor to finalize each WorkflowInstance because there is secondary logic that
        -- must be executed on each workflow when it completes.
        DECLARE @workflowInstanceObjectKey BIGINT,
                @workflowTypeName  NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestIdentifier  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @requestStatusMessage NVARCHAR(448),
                @deletedCount INTEGER;

        SELECT @deletedCount = 0;
        
        DECLARE CancelPendingWorkflowInstanceCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT
            [wi].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
        WHERE 
                [wi].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [wi].[WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusKeyPending;   -- Must not be created yet

        OPEN CancelPendingWorkflowInstanceCursor;
        WHILE(1 = 1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @workflowInstanceObjectKey = NULL;

            FETCH NEXT FROM CancelPendingWorkflowInstanceCursor INTO 
                @workflowInstanceObjectKey;

            IF(@workflowInstanceObjectKey IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                -- NO MORE RECORDS
                BREAK;
            END
            
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusFinal] 
                @workflowInstanceObjectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey, 
                @workflowStatusKey = @workflowStatusKeyDidNotExecute,
                @workflowStatusDetail = N'Prior state was Pending so this workflow did not execute.',
                @workflowTypeName = @workflowTypeName OUTPUT,
                @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT,
                @requestStatusMessage = @requestStatusMessage OUTPUT;
                
            SELECT @deletedCount = @deletedCount + 1;

        END
        CLOSE CancelPendingWorkflowInstanceCursor;
        DEALLOCATE CancelPendingWorkflowInstanceCursor; 

        SELECT @workflowsDeletedFromWorkflowInstance = @deletedCount;


        -- Part 2 - Workflows already Running

        UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
        SET 
            [WorkflowControlMessage] = @workflowControlMessageKeyCancel,
            [MessageReason] = @causeString
        WHERE 
                [RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [Finished] = 0
            AND
                (
                        [WorkflowControlMessage] IS NULL
                    OR  [WorkflowControlMessage] != @workflowControlMessageKeyCancel  -- don't overwrite an existing message
                )    

        SELECT @workflowsCanceledFromWorkflowInstance = @@ROWCOUNT;

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. If we deleted workflows from the system, we want to provide some details on the primary
        *    request for tracking purposes.  This will only happen if the primary request has collateral
        *    requests that were deleted or canceled from the PolicyApplication table.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        IF(@workflowsDeletedFromPolicyCount > 0)
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @message NVARCHAR(448);

            SELECT @message = CAST(@workflowsDeletedFromPolicyCount AS NVARCHAR) + N' Action Workflow(s) not created.';

            DECLARE @requestStatusDetail XML;

            SELECT @requestStatusDetail = [fim].[CreateRequestStatusDetail](@message, @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning);

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
                @requestKey =@requestKey,
                @statusDetails = @requestStatusDetail,
                @causeKey = @causeKey;

        END

        --Figure out if this stored procedure changed any data.
        IF
        (
                @workflowsDeletedFromWorkflowInstance > 0 
            OR  @workflowsCanceledFromWorkflowInstance > 0
            OR  @workflowsDeletedFromPolicyCount > 0
            OR  @workflowsCanceledFromPolicyCount > 0
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @wasDataChanged = 1;
        END

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D. Finished
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        RETURN @wasDataChanged;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoDeleteWorkItem]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoDeleteWorkItem]
    @workItemId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @instanceId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @lockTimeout INT,
    @workflowInstanceObjectKey BIGINT = NULL
AS
    -- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
 
        DECLARE @acquiredLock INT,
                @deleteWorkflowInstance BIT,
                @lockScope NVARCHAR(64),
                @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),
                @now DATETIME;
          
        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @deleteWorkflowInstance = 0,
                @lockScope = N'DoDeleteWorkItem-';
          
        IF(@workflowInstanceObjectKey IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
               SELECT @deleteWorkflowInstance = 1;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
              SELECT @workflowInstanceObjectKey = [WorkflowInstanceObjectKey]
              FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
              WHERE [WorkItemId] = @workItemId;
        END 
        
        IF(@workflowInstanceObjectKey IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            -- Obtain a lock and do the delete.
            
            EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey, @scope = @lockScope;
            
            IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + CAST(@workflowInstanceObjectKey AS NVARCHAR(19)) + ' because it is locked by another process.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END

            SELECT @now = GETUTCDATE();

            IF(@deleteWorkflowInstance = 1)
            BEGIN
                -- This is a hook added to ensure we can cleanup items in this table when a workflow
                -- terminates.

                -- Delete work item properties if they exist
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT *
                    FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [q]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueueProperties] AS [qp]
                        ON [q].[WorkItemId] = [qp].[WorkItemId]
                    WHERE [q].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueueProperties]
                    FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueueProperties] AS [qp]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [q]
                        ON [qp].[WorkItemId] = [q].[WorkItemId]
                    WHERE [q].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
                END;

                -- Delete work items
                DELETE FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
                WHERE [WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT *
                    FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
                    WHERE 
                        [WorkItemId] = @workItemId
                    AND
                    (
                            @lockTimeout < 0
                        OR
                        (
                                [LockOwner] = @instanceId
                            AND [LockExpiration] >= @now
                        )
                    )
                )
                BEGIN
                    DECLARE @workItems TABLE
                    (
                        [WorkItemId] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
                    )
                    
                    INSERT INTO @workItems
                    (
                        [WorkItemId]
                    )
                    SELECT [wisq].[WorkItemId]
                    FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [wisq]
                    WHERE
                            [wisq].[WorkItemId] = @workItemId
                        AND
                        (
                                @lockTimeout < 0
                            OR
                            (
                                    [wisq].[LockOwner] = @instanceId
                                AND [wisq].[LockExpiration] >= @now
                            )
                        );

                    -- Delete work item properties if they exist
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT *
                        FROM @workItems AS [wi]
                        INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueueProperties] AS [wisqp]
                            ON [wi].[WorkItemId] = [wisqp].[WorkItemId]
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        DELETE [wisqp]
                        FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueueProperties] AS [wisqp]
                        INNER JOIN @workItems AS [wi]
                            ON [wisqp].[WorkItemId] = [wi].[WorkItemId];
                    END

                    -- Delete work item
                    DELETE [wisq]
                    FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [wisq]
                    INNER JOIN @workItems AS [wi]
                        ON [wisq].[WorkItemId] = [wi].[WorkItemId];
                END
            END
        END
    END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH  
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoEvaluateRequest]
	@requestIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
	@doNotEnforceRights BIT=0, 
	@bypassAction BIT=0, 
	@bypassAuthentication BIT=0, 
	@bypassAuthorization BIT=0, 
	@trace BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
	DECLARE @startTime				    DATETIME;
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
	    SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

	DECLARE @processingTime		        DATETIME;
	DECLARE @operation			        NVARCHAR(448);
    DECLARE @principalKey               BIGINT;
    DECLARE @requestKey                 BIGINT; 
    DECLARE @targetKey                  BIGINT;
    DECLARE @targetObjectTypeKey        SMALLINT;
    
    DECLARE @mprObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT  @mprObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'ManagementPolicyRule');
	DECLARE @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT; 
	SELECT  @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
    DECLARE @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT  @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'WorkflowDefinition');
    DECLARE @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT  @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'WorkflowInstance');
    DECLARE @authnWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT  @authnWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthenticationWorkflowDefinition');
    DECLARE @authzWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT  @authzWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthorizationWorkflowDefinition');
    DECLARE @actionWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT  @actionWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ActionWorkflowDefinition');
    DECLARE @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT  @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');
    DECLARE @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT  @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'); 
    
	EXECUTE [fim].GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier
		@objectID = @requestIdentifier,
		@objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
		@objectKey = @requestKey OUTPUT;

    BEGIN TRANSACTION
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoEvaluateRequestInner]    
            @requestKey = @requestKey,
            @doNotEnforceRights = @doNotEnforceRights,
            @bypassAction = @bypassAction,
            @bypassAuthentication = @bypassAuthentication,
            @bypassAuthorization = @bypassAuthorization,
            @trace = @trace;

    COMMIT TRANSACTION


    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
	    EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'DoEvaluateRequest';
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoEvaluateRequestInner]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoEvaluateRequestInner]
    @requestKey             BIGINT, 
    @doNotEnforceRights     BIT=0, 
    @bypassAction           BIT=0, 
    @bypassAuthentication   BIT=0, 
    @bypassAuthorization    BIT=0, 
    @doNotEvaluateWorkflows BIT=0, 
    @reEvaluateRequest      BIT=0, 
    @trace                  BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @startTime                  DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                   BIT,
        @falseFlag                  BIT;

    SELECT
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    
    IF (@trace = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    DECLARE 
        @actionWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey           SMALLINT,
        @authnWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey            SMALLINT,
        @authzWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey            SMALLINT,
        @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey                     SMALLINT,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                     SMALLINT,
        @elementAttributeKey                            SMALLINT,
        @identifierAttributeKey                         SMALLINT,
        @managementPolicyRuleTypeRequestString          NVARCHAR(16),
        @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString    NVARCHAR(16),
        @mprAttributeKey                                SMALLINT,
        @mprObjectTypeKey                               SMALLINT,
        @operation                                      NVARCHAR(448),
        @processingTime                                 DATETIME,
        @principalKey                                   BIGINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey                           SMALLINT, 
        @setObjectTypeKey                               SMALLINT,
        @targetKey                                      BIGINT,
        @targetObjectTypeKey                            SMALLINT,
        @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey                SMALLINT,
        @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey                  SMALLINT;

    SELECT
        @actionWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey           = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ActionWorkflowDefinition'),
        @authnWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey            = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthenticationWorkflowDefinition'),
        @authzWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey            = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthorizationWorkflowDefinition'),
        @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey                     = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'msidmCompositeType'),
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @elementAttributeKey                            = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmElement'),
        @identifierAttributeKey                         = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @managementPolicyRuleTypeRequestString          = N'Request',
        @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString    = N'SetTransition',
        @mprAttributeKey                                = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ManagementPolicy'),
        @mprObjectTypeKey                               = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'ManagementPolicyRule'),
        @requestObjectTypeKey                           = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @setObjectTypeKey                               = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'Set'),
        @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey                = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'WorkflowDefinition'),
        @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey                  = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'WorkflowInstance');
    
    SELECT
        @processingTime      = GETUTCDATE(),
        @operation           = [r].[Operation],
        @principalKey        = [r].[Creator],
        @targetKey           = [r].[TargetKey],
        @targetObjectTypeKey = [r].[TargetObjectTypeKey]
    FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
    WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A. Calculate set transitions
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    EXECUTE [fim].[CalculateRequestSetTransitions]
        @requestKey = @requestKey,
        @trace = @trace;
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B. Cache the resource and principal sets 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE @principalSets TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @resourceSetsBefore TABLE
    (
        [SetKey]        BIGINT,
        [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [SetKey],
            [TargetKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @resourceSetsAfter TABLE
    (
        [SetKey]        BIGINT,
        [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [SetKey],
            [TargetKey]
        )        
    );

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [ovr].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
        WHERE 
                [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
            AND [ovr].[ValueReference] = @principalKey
            AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @principalSets
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT [ovr].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
        WHERE 
                [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
            AND [ovr].[ValueReference] = @principalKey
            AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40,@setObjectTypeKey = 29));
    END

    IF @targetObjectTypeKey != @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [ovr].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                ON [r].[TargetKey] = [ovr].[ValueReference] 
            WHERE
                    [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @resourceSetsBefore
            (
                [SetKey],
                [TargetKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ovr].[ObjectKey],
                [ovr].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                ON [r].[TargetKey] = [ovr].[ValueReference] 
            WHERE
                    [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40,@setObjectTypeKey = 29));
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT [composite].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [request]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [composite]
                ON [request].[TargetKey] = [composite].[ObjectKey] 
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [composite].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey
                AND [composite].[AttributeKey] = @elementAttributeKey   
                AND [composite].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @element TABLE
            (
                [ObjectKey] BIGINT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
            );
            
            INSERT INTO @element
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [composite].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [request]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [composite]
                ON [request].[TargetKey] = [composite].[ObjectKey] 
            WHERE
                    [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [composite].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey
                AND [composite].[AttributeKey] = @elementAttributeKey   
                AND [composite].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@elementAttributeKey = 252,@compositeTypeObjectTypeKey = 37));
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [set].[ObjectKey],
                    [set].[ValueReference]
                FROM @element AS [element]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
                    ON [element].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference] 
                WHERE
                        [set].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                    AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN       
                INSERT INTO @resourceSetsBefore
                (
                    [SetKey],
                    [TargetKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [set].[ObjectKey],
                    [set].[ValueReference]
                FROM @element AS [element]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [set]
                    ON [element].[ObjectKey] = [set].[ValueReference] 
                WHERE
                        [set].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                    AND [set].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40,@setObjectTypeKey = 29));
            END
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [before].[SetKey]
        FROM @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @resourceSetsAfter
        (
            [SetKey],
            [TargetKey]
        )
        SELECT
            [before].[SetKey],
            [before].[TargetKey]
        FROM @resourceSetsBefore AS [before];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [after].[SetKey]
        FROM @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
            ON  [after].[SetKey] = [transition].[ObjectKey]
            AND [after].[TargetKey] = [transition].[ValueReference]
        WHERE 
                [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [transition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
            AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [transition].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [after]
        FROM @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
            ON  [after].[SetKey] = [transition].[ObjectKey]
            AND [after].[TargetKey] = [transition].[ValueReference]
        WHERE 
                [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [transition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
            AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [transition].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40,@setObjectTypeKey = 29));
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [transition].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            ON  [transition].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
        WHERE 
                [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [transition].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @afterBuffer TABLE
        (
            [SetKey]        BIGINT,
            [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [SetKey],
                [TargetKey]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @afterBuffer
        (
            [SetKey],
            [TargetKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [transition].[ObjectKey],
            [transition].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            ON  [transition].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
        WHERE 
                [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            AND [transition].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [buffer].[SetKey]
            FROM @afterBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
                ON  [buffer].[SetKey] = [after].[SetKey]
                AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [after].[TargetKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [buffer]
            FROM @afterBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
                ON  [buffer].[SetKey] = [after].[SetKey]
                AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [after].[TargetKey]
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [buffer].[SetKey]
            FROM @afterBuffer AS [buffer]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @resourceSetsAfter
            (
                [SetKey],
                [TargetKey]
            )
            SELECT 
                [buffer].[SetKey],
                [buffer].[TargetKey]
            FROM @afterBuffer AS [buffer];
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C. Look up the applicable MPRs
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE @applicableRule TABLE
    (
        [RuleKey]       BIGINT,
        [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
        [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
        [GrantRight]    BIT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [RuleKey],
            [TargetKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @candidateRule TABLE
    (
        [RuleKey]       BIGINT,
        [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
        [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [RuleKey],
            [TargetKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF (@operation = N'Create')
    BEGIN
        -- Filter on request based MPRs for creation.
        -- ResourceCurrentSet is ignored for the creation. 
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation]AS [ruleOperation]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleOperation].[ObjectKey]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] AS [ruleAttribute]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleAttribute].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [requestParameter]
                ON
                (
                        [ruleAttribute].[ActionParameterKey] = [requestParameter].[AttributeKey]
                    OR  [rule].[ActionParameterAll] = @trueFlag
                )
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
                ON  [after].[SetKey] = [rule].[ResourceFinalSet]
                AND [after].[TargetKey] = [requestParameter].[ObjectKey] 
            WHERE 
                    [requestParameter].[RequestKey]  = @requestKey
                AND [ruleOperation].[ActionType] = N'Create'
                AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeRequestString
                AND [requestParameter].[SystemGenerated] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @candidateRule
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [requestParameter].[ObjectKey],
                [requestParameter].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation]AS [ruleOperation]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleOperation].[ObjectKey]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] AS [ruleAttribute]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleAttribute].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [requestParameter]
                ON
                (
                        [ruleAttribute].[ActionParameterKey] = [requestParameter].[AttributeKey]
                    OR  [rule].[ActionParameterAll] = @trueFlag
                )
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
                ON  [after].[SetKey] = [rule].[ResourceFinalSet]
                AND [after].[TargetKey] = [requestParameter].[ObjectKey] 
            WHERE 
                    [requestParameter].[RequestKey]  = @requestKey
                AND [ruleOperation].[ActionType] = N'Create'
                AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeRequestString
                AND [requestParameter].[SystemGenerated] = @falseFlag;
        END

        -- non-reflexive case 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[RuleKey]
            INNER JOIN @principalSets AS [principal]
                ON [rule].[PrincipalSet] = [principal].[ObjectKey]
        )           
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @applicableRule
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [GrantRight]
            )
            SELECT 
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[TargetKey],
                [candidate].[AttributeKey],
                [rule].[GrantRight]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[RuleKey]
            INNER JOIN @principalSets AS [principal]
                ON [rule].[PrincipalSet] = [principal].[ObjectKey];
        END

        -- Reflexive principal case.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[RuleKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [output]
                ON  [rule].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] = [output].[AttributeKey]
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [output].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE 
                    [output].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [output].[ValueReference] = @principalKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @reflexiveCreateRuleBuffer TABLE
            (
                [RuleKey]       BIGINT,
                [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
                [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
                [GrantRight]    BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [RuleKey],
                    [TargetKey],
                    [AttributeKey]
                )
            );
        
            INSERT INTO @reflexiveCreateRuleBuffer
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [GrantRight]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[TargetKey],
                [candidate].[AttributeKey],
                [rule].[GrantRight]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[RuleKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [output]
                ON  [rule].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] = [output].[AttributeKey]
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [output].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE 
                    [output].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [output].[ValueReference] = @principalKey;
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
                FROM @reflexiveCreateRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                    ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                    AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                    AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [buffer]
                FROM @reflexiveCreateRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                    ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                    AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                    AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
            END
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
                FROM @reflexiveCreateRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @applicableRule
                (
                    [RuleKey],
                    [TargetKey],
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [GrantRight]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [buffer].[RuleKey],
                    [buffer].[TargetKey],
                    [buffer].[AttributeKey],
                    [buffer].[GrantRight]
                FROM @reflexiveCreateRuleBuffer AS [buffer];
            END
        END
    END

    ELSE IF (@operation = N'Delete')
    BEGIN
        -- Delete is controlled by ObjectID attribute
        -- ResourceSetFinal is ignored           

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] AS [ruleOperation]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleOperation].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
                ON [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [before].[SetKey] 
            WHERE 
                    [ruleOperation].[ActionType] = N'Delete'    
                AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeRequestString
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @candidateRule 
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [before].[TargetKey],
                @identifierAttributeKey
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] AS [ruleOperation]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleOperation].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
                ON [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [before].[SetKey] 
            WHERE 
                    [ruleOperation].[ActionType] = N'Delete'    
                AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeRequestString
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));       
        END

        -- now filter target resource
  
        -- non-reflexive case

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] [rule]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[RuleKey]
            INNER JOIN @principalSets [principal]
                ON [principal].[ObjectKey] = [rule].[PrincipalSet]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @applicableRule
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [GrantRight]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[TargetKey],
                @identifierAttributeKey,
                [rule].[GrantRight]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] [rule]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [candidate].[RuleKey]
            INNER JOIN @principalSets [principal]
                ON [principal].[ObjectKey] = [rule].[PrincipalSet]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@identifierAttributeKey = 0));
        END
           
        -- Reflexive principal case.
        -- Note, ObjectKeys of reflexive principal MPRs and non-reflecxive MPRs do not overlap.
        -- Reflexive target is not handled: the feature may be removed, it does not make much sense for Delete anyway.  
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON [candidate].[RuleKey] = [rule].[ObjectKey] 
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
                ON  [candidate].[TargetKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [rule].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] = [value].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE       [value].[ValueReference] = @principalKey
        )
        BEGIN 
            DECLARE @reflexiveDeleteRuleBuffer TABLE
            (
                [RuleKey]       BIGINT,
                [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
                [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
                [GrantRight]    BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [RuleKey],
                    [TargetKey],
                    [AttributeKey]
                )
            );
         
            INSERT INTO @reflexiveDeleteRuleBuffer
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [GrantRight]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[TargetKey],
                [candidate].[AttributeKey],
                [rule].[GrantRight]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON [candidate].[RuleKey] = [rule].[ObjectKey] 
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
                ON  [candidate].[TargetKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [rule].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] = [value].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE       [value].[ValueReference] = @principalKey;
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
                FROM @reflexiveDeleteRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                    ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                    AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                    AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [buffer]
                FROM @reflexiveDeleteRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                    ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                    AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                    AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
            END
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
                FROM @reflexiveDeleteRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @applicableRule
                (
                    [RuleKey],
                    [TargetKey],
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [GrantRight]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [buffer].[RuleKey],
                    [buffer].[TargetKey],
                    [buffer].[AttributeKey],
                    [buffer].[GrantRight]
                FROM @reflexiveDeleteRuleBuffer AS [buffer];
            END
        END
            
    END
    ELSE IF (@operation = N'Put')
    BEGIN
    
        -- IMT 22850.  If rp.[Mode] is NULL (allowed in current schema)
        -- then the associated attributes will not be properly represented in 
        -- policy decisions.  
        
        -- Filter operation and target attributes first
        -- Returns request based MPRs and attributes to which they apply
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] [ruleOperation]
                ON  [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleOperation].[ObjectKey]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] [ruleAttribute]
                ON  [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleAttribute].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [parameter]
                ON  [rule].ManagementPolicyRuleType = @managementPolicyRuleTypeRequestString
                AND 
                (
                        [ruleAttribute].[ActionParameterKey] = [parameter].[AttributeKey]
                    OR  [rule].[ActionParameterAll] = @trueFlag
                )
                AND [ruleOperation].[ActionType] = [parameter].[Mode]
            WHERE       [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @candidateRule
            (
                [RuleKey], 
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [parameter].[ObjectKey],
                [parameter].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] [ruleOperation]
                ON  [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleOperation].[ObjectKey]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] [ruleAttribute]
                ON  [rule].[ObjectKey] = [ruleAttribute].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [parameter]
                ON  [rule].ManagementPolicyRuleType = @managementPolicyRuleTypeRequestString
                AND 
                (
                        [ruleAttribute].[ActionParameterKey] = [parameter].[AttributeKey]
                    OR  [rule].[ActionParameterAll] = @trueFlag
                )
                AND [ruleOperation].[ActionType] = [parameter].[Mode]
            WHERE       [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        END
                
                                   
        -- non-reflexive case       
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON  [candidate].[RuleKey] = [rule].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
                ON  [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [before].[SetKey] 
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [before].[TargetKey] 
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
                ON [rule].[ResourceFinalSet] = [after].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [after].[TargetKey]
            INNER JOIN @principalSets [principal]
                ON [rule].[PrincipalSet] = [principal].[ObjectKey]             
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @applicableRule
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [GrantRight]
            )
            SELECT 
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[TargetKey],
                [candidate].[AttributeKey],
                [rule].[GrantRight]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON  [candidate].[RuleKey] = [rule].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
                ON  [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [before].[SetKey] 
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [before].[TargetKey] 
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
                ON [rule].[ResourceFinalSet] = [after].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [after].[TargetKey]
            INNER JOIN @principalSets [principal]
                ON [rule].[PrincipalSet] = [principal].[ObjectKey];
        END
            
        -- Reflexive principal case.
        -- Reflexive target is not handled. If feature may be dropped, if so,
        -- consider join to ResourceCurrent/FinalSet in @candidateMPRs.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON  [candidate].[RuleKey] = [rule].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
                ON  [candidate].[TargetKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [rule].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] = [value].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
                ON  [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [before].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [before].[TargetKey]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
                ON  [rule].[ResourceFinalSet] = [after].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [after].[TargetKey]
            WHERE       [value].[ValueReference] = @principalKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @reflexivePutRuleBuffer TABLE
            (
                [RuleKey]       BIGINT,
                [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
                [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
                [GrantRight]    BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [RuleKey],
                    [TargetKey],
                    [AttributeKey]
                )
            );
         
            INSERT INTO @reflexivePutRuleBuffer
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [GrantRight]
            )
            SELECT 
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [candidate].[TargetKey],
                [candidate].[AttributeKey],
                [rule].[GrantRight]
             FROM @candidateRule AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON  [candidate].[RuleKey] = [rule].[ObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
                ON  [candidate].[TargetKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
                AND [rule].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] = [value].[AttributeKey]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
                ON  [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [before].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [before].[TargetKey]
            INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
                ON  [rule].[ResourceFinalSet] = [after].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[TargetKey] = [after].[TargetKey]
            WHERE       [value].[ValueReference] = @principalKey;
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
                FROM @reflexivePutRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                    ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                    AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                    AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [buffer]
                FROM @reflexivePutRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                    ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                    AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                    AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
            END
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
                FROM @reflexivePutRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @applicableRule
                (
                    [RuleKey],
                    [TargetKey],
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [GrantRight]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [buffer].[RuleKey],
                    [buffer].[TargetKey],
                    [buffer].[AttributeKey],
                    [buffer].[GrantRight]
                FROM @reflexivePutRuleBuffer AS [buffer];
            END    
        END
            
    END
        
    -- TransitionIn
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
        INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
            ON  [rule].[ResourceFinalSet] = [after].[SetKey] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [parameter]
            ON [after].[TargetKey] = [parameter].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
            ON  [after].[SetKey] = [before].[SetKey]
            AND [after].[TargetKey] = [before].[TargetKey]
        WHERE 
                [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [before].[SetKey] IS NULL
            AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @transitionInApplicableRuleBuffer TABLE
        (
            [RuleKey]       BIGINT,
            [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
            [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
            [GrantRight]    BIT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
        );
     
        INSERT INTO @transitionInApplicableRuleBuffer
        (
            [RuleKey],
            [TargetKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [GrantRight]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rule].[ObjectKey],
            [after].[TargetKey],
            [parameter].[AttributeKey],
            @falseFlag
        FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
        INNER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
            ON  [rule].[ResourceFinalSet] = [after].[SetKey] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [parameter]
            ON [after].[TargetKey] = [parameter].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
            ON  [after].[SetKey] = [before].[SetKey]
            AND [after].[TargetKey] = [before].[TargetKey]
        WHERE 
                [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [before].[SetKey] IS NULL
            AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString;
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
            FROM @transitionInApplicableRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [buffer]
            FROM @transitionInApplicableRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
        END
    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
            FROM @transitionInApplicableRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @applicableRule
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [GrantRight]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [buffer].[RuleKey],
                [buffer].[TargetKey],
                [buffer].[AttributeKey],
                [buffer].[GrantRight]
            FROM @transitionInApplicableRuleBuffer AS [buffer];
        END        
    END

    -- TransitionOut
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
        INNER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
            ON [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [before].[SetKey] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [parameter]
            ON [before].[TargetKey]  = [parameter].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
            ON  [before].[SetKey] = [after].[SetKey]
            AND [before].[TargetKey] = [after].[TargetKey]
        WHERE 
                [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [after].[SetKey] IS NULL
            AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @transitionOutApplicableRuleBuffer TABLE
        (
            [RuleKey]       BIGINT,
            [TargetKey]     BIGINT,
            [AttributeKey]  SMALLINT,
            [GrantRight]    BIT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
        );
     
        INSERT INTO @transitionOutApplicableRuleBuffer
        (
            [RuleKey],
            [TargetKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [GrantRight]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rule].[ObjectKey],
            [before].[TargetKey],
            [parameter].[AttributeKey],
            @falseFlag
        FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
        INNER JOIN @resourceSetsBefore AS [before]
            ON [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [before].[SetKey] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [parameter]
            ON [before].[TargetKey]  = [parameter].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN @resourceSetsAfter AS [after]
            ON  [before].[SetKey] = [after].[SetKey]
            AND [before].[TargetKey] = [after].[TargetKey]
        WHERE 
                [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [after].[SetKey] IS NULL
            AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString;
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
            FROM @transitionOutApplicableRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [buffer]
            FROM @transitionOutApplicableRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [applicable]
                ON  [buffer].[RuleKey] = [applicable].[RuleKey]
                AND [buffer].[TargetKey] = [applicable].[TargetKey]
                AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [applicable].[AttributeKey]
        END
    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[RuleKey]
            FROM @transitionOutApplicableRuleBuffer AS [buffer]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @applicableRule
            (
                [RuleKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [GrantRight]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [buffer].[RuleKey],
                [buffer].[TargetKey],
                [buffer].[AttributeKey],
                [buffer].[GrantRight]
            FROM @transitionOutApplicableRuleBuffer AS [buffer];
        END        
    END
        
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1 Record Applicable MPRs
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF
    (
            @doNotEnforceRights = @falseFlag
        OR  @doNotEvaluateWorkflows = @falseFlag
    )
    AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rule].[RuleKey]
        FROM @applicableRule AS [rule]
    )
    BEGIN
        -- Rights should be evaluated only once for each request, 
        -- duplicate or 2nd attempt insertion should fault.        
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [Multivalued]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @requestKey,
            @requestObjectTypeKey,
            @mprAttributeKey,
            [rule].[RuleKey],
            @trueFlag -- ManagementPolicy is Multivalued, no need for lookup
        FROM @applicableRule AS [rule]
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2 Enforce rights
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @doNotEnforceRights = @falseFlag
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @attemptedModification TABLE
        (
            [TargetKey]             BIGINT,
            [AttributeKey]          SMALLINT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
        );
        
        IF @operation = N'Delete'
            -- enumerate rules that match objectID 
        BEGIN
            IF @targetObjectTypeKey != @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @attemptedModification
                (
                    [TargetKey],
                    [AttributeKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                    [r].TargetKey,
                    @identifierAttributeKey
                FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
                WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @attemptedModification
                (
                    [TargetKey],
                    [AttributeKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                    [composite].[ValueReference],
                    @identifierAttributeKey
                FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [composite]
                    ON [r].[TargetKey] = [composite].[ObjectKey] 
                WHERE
                        [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [composite].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeTypeObjectTypeKey
                    AND [composite].[AttributeKey] = @elementAttributeKey;                     
            END
                               
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @attemptedModification
            (
                [TargetKey],
                [AttributeKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [parameter].[ObjectKey],
                [parameter].[AttributeKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [parameter]
            WHERE
                    [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [parameter].[SystemGenerated] = @falseFlag;
                
        END
        
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [attempted].[TargetKey]
            FROM @attemptedModification AS [attempted]
            INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [permitted]
                ON  [attempted].[TargetKey] = [permitted].[TargetKey]
                AND [attempted].[AttributeKey] = [permitted].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [permitted].[GrantRight] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [attempted]
            FROM @attemptedModification AS [attempted]
            INNER JOIN @applicableRule AS [permitted]
                ON  [attempted].[TargetKey] = [permitted].[TargetKey]
                AND [attempted].[AttributeKey] = [permitted].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [permitted].[GrantRight] = @trueFlag
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [attempted].[TargetKey]
            FROM @attemptedModification AS [attempted]
        )
        BEGIN

            -- An exception will be thrown that will be translated into a PermissionDeniedFault
            DECLARE 
                @failedAttributes XML,
                @messageText NVARCHAR(MAX);
            
            SELECT @failedAttributes = 
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT [ai].[Name] AS [Name]
                FROM [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
                LEFT JOIN
                (
                    SELECT [ar].[AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey]
                    FROM @applicableRule AS [ar]
                    WHERE [ar].[GrantRight] = 1
                    GROUP BY [ar].[AttributeKey], [ar].[GrantRight]
                ) AS [mpr]
                    ON [rp].[AttributeKey] = [mpr].[AttributeKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                    ON [rp].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
                WHERE [rp].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [rp].[SystemGenerated] = 0
                    AND [mpr].[AttributeKey] IS NULL
                FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS
            )
            
            --If there are no attributes in failed attributes table, then presumably it is a delete operation.  
            --In that case, the attribute for which permission is denied will be shown as being the ObjectID field.  
            IF (@failedAttributes IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @failedAttributes = 
                (
                    SELECT [ai].[Name] AS [Name]
                    FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                    WHERE [ai].[Key] = @identifierAttributeKey
                    FOR XML AUTO, ELEMENTS
                )
            END
            
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatPermissionDeniedException](@failedAttributes)

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;

            IF (@trace = 1)
            BEGIN
                EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
                    @startTime  = @startTime,
                    @requestKey = @requestKey, 
                    @stage      = N'DoEvaluateRequest';
            END

            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END
    END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E. Cache authorization and non-collateral action workflows
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 
    IF (@doNotEvaluateWorkflows = 0)
    BEGIN
        
        DECLARE @actionWorkflows TABLE
        (
            [PolicyKey]             BIGINT,
            [TargetKey]             BIGINT,
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey] BIGINT,
            [WorkflowInstanceKey]   BIGINT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [PolicyKey],             
                [TargetKey],
                [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
            )
        );
        
        DECLARE @authorizationWorkflows TABLE
        (
            [PolicyKey]             BIGINT,
            [TargetKey]             BIGINT,
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey] BIGINT,
            [WorkflowInstanceKey]   BIGINT
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [PolicyKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
            )
        );
        
        IF 
                @bypassAuthorization != @trueFlag
            AND EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[RuleKey]
                FROM @applicableRule AS [rule]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [authorization]
                    ON [rule].[RuleKey] = [authorization].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE 
                        [authorization].[ObjectTypeKey] = @mprObjectTypeKey
                    AND [authorization].[AttributeKey] = @authzWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey
            )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @authorizationWorkflows
            (
                [PolicyKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [WorkflowDefinitionKey] 
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rule].[RuleKey],
                [rule].[TargetKey],
                [authorization].[ValueReference]
            FROM @applicableRule AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [authorization]
                ON [rule].[RuleKey] = [authorization].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE 
                    [authorization].[ObjectTypeKey] = @mprObjectTypeKey
                AND [authorization].[AttributeKey] = @authzWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey;
        END
        
        IF 
                @bypassAction != @trueFlag
            AND EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[RuleKey]
                FROM @applicableRule AS [rule]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [action]
                    ON [rule].[RuleKey] = [action].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE 
                        [action].[ObjectTypeKey] = @mprObjectTypeKey
                    AND [action].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey
            )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @actionWorkflows
            (
                [PolicyKey],
                [TargetKey],
                [WorkflowDefinitionKey] 
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rule].[RuleKey],
                [rule].[TargetKey],
                [action].[ValueReference]
            FROM @applicableRule AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [action]
                ON [rule].[RuleKey] = [action].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE 
                    [action].[ObjectTypeKey] = @mprObjectTypeKey
                AND [action].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey
            
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F. Record non-collateral action workflows
 *    @actionWorkflows table was populated from matching up the Request to all MPRs that
 *    apply for the target. The SetKey recorded here will be stamped on the Request in the SetTransition
 *    Attribute along with the ActionWorkflowDefinition.  The design uses ResourceFinalSet
 *    as the preferred Set to stamp because it reflects the as committed state.  However
 *    for a Delete operation, the Target will no longer belong to any Sets so we
 *    must use ResourceCurrentSet instead.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [action].[PolicyKey]
            FROM @actionWorkflows AS [action]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON [action].[PolicyKey] = [rule].[ObjectKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] 
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [PolicyRuleKey],
                [ResourceKey],
                [SetKey],
                [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
                [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]  
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [action].[PolicyKey],
                [action].[TargetKey],
                CASE 
                    WHEN [rule].[ResourceFinalSet] IS NULL THEN [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet]
                    ELSE [rule].[ResourceFinalSet]
                END,
                [action].[WorkflowDefinitionKey],
                [fim].[GetCurrentWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]([action].[WorkflowDefinitionKey])
            FROM @actionWorkflows AS [action]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                ON [action].[PolicyKey] = [rule].[ObjectKey];
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G. Create authorization and non-collateral action workflow instances
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        DECLARE 
            @ruleKey BIGINT,
            @workflowTargetKey BIGINT,
            @workflowDefinitionKey BIGINT,
            @workflowInstanceKey BIGINT,
            @workflowInstanceIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            @workflowType TINYINT;

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [workflow].[PolicyKey]
            FROM @authorizationWorkflows AS [workflow]
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE authorizationWorkflowCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [workflow].[PolicyKey],
                [workflow].[TargetKey],
                [workflow].[WorkflowDefinitionKey]
            FROM @authorizationWorkflows AS [workflow];

            --Authorization Worfklow
            SELECT @workflowType = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey]([fim].[WorkflowTypeAuthorization]());

            OPEN authorizationWorkflowCursor;
            WHILE 1 = 1
            BEGIN
                SELECT
                    @ruleKey = NULL,
                    @workflowTargetKey = NULL,
                    @workflowDefinitionKey = NULL;

                FETCH NEXT FROM authorizationWorkflowCursor INTO 
                    @ruleKey,
                    @workflowTargetKey,
                    @workflowDefinitionKey;

                IF (@ruleKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END

                IF @workflowDefinitionKey IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    CONTINUE;
                END
        
                SELECT
                    @workflowInstanceKey = NULL,
                    @workflowInstanceIdentifier = NULL;
