                EXECUTE [fim].[DoCreateWorkflowInstance]
                     @workflowDefinitionKey = @workflowDefinitionKey,
                     @requestKey = @requestKey,
                     @principalKey = @principalKey,
                     @targetKey = @workflowTargetKey,
                     @processingTime = @processingTime,
                     @workflowType = @workflowType,
                     @workflowInstanceKey = @workflowInstanceKey OUTPUT,
                     @workflowInstanceIdentifier = @workflowInstanceIdentifier OUTPUT;
            
                IF(@ruleKey IS NOT NULL)
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE @authorizationWorkflows
                    SET [WorkflowInstanceKey] = @workflowInstanceKey
                    WHERE 
                            [PolicyKey] = @ruleKey
                        AND [TargetKey] = @workflowTargetKey
                        AND [WorkflowDefinitionKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey;
                END
            END
       
            CLOSE authorizationWorkflowCursor;
            DEALLOCATE authorizationWorkflowCursor;
        END  

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * H. Find collateral action workflows
 *    The definition of collateral is "other target" than the Target of the Request.
 *    The spec also requires the MPR to define both a ResourceCurrentSet and ResourceFinalSet
 *    and the "other target" must be a member of both sets for this MPR to apply its
 *    action workflow.  
 *    The following code is written to the above assumption and does not fully support 
 *    Multi-Target Requests;  {A limited use feature introduced to assist with removing custom
 *    action processors.}  Since this logic requires an object to be a member of
 *    the MPR ResourceCurrentSet and MPR ResourceFinalSet,  a Multi-Target Request that contains
 *    Create or Delete operations on "other targets" will never satisfy the conditions for these
 *    objects.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @setTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition TABLE
        (
            [PolicyKey]             BIGINT,
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey] BIGINT
            
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [PolicyKey],
                [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
            )
        );
        
        DECLARE @collateralActionWorkflows TABLE
        (
            [PolicyKey]             BIGINT,
            [ResourceKey]           BIGINT,
            [SetKey]                BIGINT,
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey] BIGINT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [PolicyKey],
                [ResourceKey],
                [SetKey],
                [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
            )
        );
        
        DECLARE @collateralSetTransitions TABLE
        (
            [ResourceKey] BIGINT,
            [SetKey]      BIGINT,
            [Join]        BIT,
            [Leave]       BIT,  
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [ResourceKey],
                [SetKey],
                [Join],
                [Leave]
            )
        );        
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE 
                    [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey
                AND [value].[ObjectTypekey] = @mprObjectTypeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @setTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition
            (
                [PolicyKey],
                [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rule].[ObjectKey],
                [value].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
                ON [rule].[ObjectKey] = [value].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE 
                    [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString
                AND [value].[AttributeKey] = @actionWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey
                AND [value].[ObjectTypekey] = @mprObjectTypeKey;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [transition].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [target]
                ON  [transition].[RequestKey] = [target].[RequestKey]
                AND [transition].[ValueReference] = [target].[TargetKey] 
            WHERE 
                    [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [transition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [target].[TargetKey] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @collateralSetTransitions
            (
                [ResourceKey],
                [SetKey],
                [Join],
                [Leave]        
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [transition].[ValueReference],
                [transition].[ObjectKey],
                CASE 
                    WHEN [transition].[Deleted] = @falseFlag THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END,
                CASE 
                    WHEN [transition].[Deleted] = @trueFlag THEN @trueFlag
                    ELSE @falseFlag
                END
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [transition]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [target]
                ON  [transition].[RequestKey] = [target].[RequestKey]
                AND [transition].[ValueReference] = [target].[TargetKey]
            WHERE 
                    [transition].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [transition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [transition].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [target].[TargetKey] IS NULL;
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                INNER JOIN @setTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition AS [workflow]
                    ON  [rule].[ObjectKey] = [workflow].[PolicyKey]
                INNER JOIN @collateralSetTransitions AS [collateral]
                    ON [rule].[ResourceFinalSet] = [collateral].[SetKey]
                WHERE       [collateral].[Join] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN            
                INSERT INTO @collateralActionWorkflows
                (
                    [PolicyKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [SetKey],
                    [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [rule].[ObjectKey],
                    [collateral].[ResourceKey],
                    [collateral].[SetKey],
                    [workflow].[WorkflowDefinitionKey]
                FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                INNER JOIN @setTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition AS [workflow]
                    ON  [rule].[ObjectKey] = [workflow].[PolicyKey]
                INNER JOIN @collateralSetTransitions AS [collateral]
                    ON [rule].[ResourceFinalSet] = [collateral].[SetKey]
                WHERE       [collateral].[Join] = @trueFlag;
                    
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [collateral].[PolicyKey]
                    FROM @collateralActionWorkflows AS [collateral]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [finalSet] 
                        ON  [collateral].[SetKey] = [finalSet].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [finalSet].[ValueReference] = [collateral].[ResourceKey]
                    WHERE
                            [finalSet].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                        AND [finalSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [collateral]
                    FROM @collateralActionWorkflows AS [collateral]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [finalSet]
                        ON  [collateral].[SetKey] = [finalSet].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [finalSet].[ValueReference] = [collateral].[ResourceKey]
                    WHERE
                            [finalSet].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                        AND [finalSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey;
                END
            END
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [rule].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                INNER JOIN @setTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition AS [definition]
                    ON  [rule].[ObjectKey] = [definition].[PolicyKey]
                INNER JOIN @collateralSetTransitions AS [collateral]
                    ON  [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [collateral].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [currentSet] 
                    ON  [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [currentSet].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [collateral].[ResourceKey] = [currentSet].[ValueReference]
                WHERE 
                        [collateral].[Leave] = @trueFlag
                    AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString
                    AND [currentSet].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                    AND [currentSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @collateralActionWorkflows
                (
                    [PolicyKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [SetKey],
                    [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [rule].[ObjectKey],
                    [collateral].[ResourceKey],
                    [collateral].[SetKey],
                    [definition].[WorkflowDefinitionKey]
                FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [rule]
                INNER JOIN @setTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition AS [definition]
                    ON  [rule].[ObjectKey] = [definition].[PolicyKey]
                INNER JOIN @collateralSetTransitions AS [collateral]
                    ON  [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [collateral].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [currentSet]
                    ON  [rule].[ResourceCurrentSet] = [currentSet].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [collateral].[ResourceKey] = [currentSet].[ValueReference]
                WHERE 
                        [collateral].[Leave] = @trueFlag
                    AND [rule].[ManagementPolicyRuleType] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeSetTransitionString
                    AND [currentSet].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                    AND [currentSet].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey;
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * I. Record collateral action workflows
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [collateral].[PolicyKey]
                FROM @collateralActionWorkflows AS [collateral]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [collateral].[PolicyKey] = [duplicate].[PolicyRuleKey]
                    AND [collateral].[ResourceKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                    AND [collateral].[WorkflowDefinitionKey] = [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]
                    AND [collateral].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
                WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [collateral]
                FROM @collateralActionWorkflows AS [collateral]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [collateral].[PolicyKey] = [duplicate].[PolicyRuleKey]
                    AND [collateral].[ResourceKey] = [duplicate].[ResourceKey]
                    AND [collateral].[WorkflowDefinitionKey] = [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]
                    AND [collateral].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
                WHERE       [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            END
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [collateral].[PolicyKey]
                FROM @collateralActionWorkflows AS [collateral]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] 
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [PolicyRuleKey],
                    [ResourceKey],
                    [SetKey],
                    [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
                    [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]  
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [collateral].[PolicyKey],
                    [collateral].[ResourceKey],
                    [collateral].[SetKey],
                    [collateral].[WorkflowDefinitionKey],
                    [fim].[GetCurrentWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]([collateral].[WorkflowDefinitionKey])
                FROM @collateralActionWorkflows AS [collateral];
            END
        END

    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * J. Return matching MPRs
 *    Read-only
 *    For authentication workflows definitions are returned
 *    For authorization workflow instances are returned
 *    Only non-collateral workflows are returned
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @reEvaluateRequest = 0
    BEGIN

        -- Design Point: Mid-tier can only process rows relating to the current target        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [ruleIdentifier].[ValueIdentifier] AS [PolicyKey],
            [authenticationWorkflowIdentifier].[ValueIdentifier] AS [Authentication Workflow Definition],
            [authorizationWorkflowIdentifier].[ValueIdentifier] AS [Authorization Workflow Instance]
        FROM @applicableRule AS [rule]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ruleIdentifier]
            ON [rule].[RuleKey] = [ruleIdentifier].[ObjectKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [authenticationPolicy]
            ON  [rule].[RuleKey] = [authenticationPolicy].[ObjectKey]
            AND [authenticationPolicy].[ObjectTypeKey] = @mprObjectTypeKey
            AND [authenticationPolicy].[AttributeKey] = @authnWorkflowDefinitionAttributeKey
            AND @bypassAuthentication != @trueFlag
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [authenticationWorkflowIdentifier]
            ON  [authenticationPolicy].[ValueReference] = [authenticationWorkflowIdentifier].[ObjectKey]
            AND [authenticationWorkflowIdentifier].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
        LEFT OUTER JOIN @authorizationWorkflows AS [authorization]
            ON  [rule].[RuleKey] = [authorization].[PolicyKey] 
            AND [rule].[TargetKey] = [authorization].[TargetKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [authorizationWorkflowIdentifier]
            ON  [authorization].[WorkflowInstanceKey] = [authorizationWorkflowIdentifier].[ObjectKey]
            AND [authorizationWorkflowIdentifier].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey;

    END

    IF @trace = 1
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'DoEvaluateRequestInner';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoExpireRequestObject]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoExpireRequestObject]
    @objectKey              BIGINT,
    @objectTypeKey          SMALLINT,
    @didExpireRequestStatus TINYINT = NULL   OUTPUT   -- 0 scheduled for later, 1 did setExpiration, 2 childRequest deferred till parent is stamped,  3 already has expiration, 
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT  @didExpireRequestStatus = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
        
    BEGIN TRY

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

        DECLARE 
            @commitTime DATETIME,
            @enableRequestCacheRetention BIT,
            @expirationTimeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @index INT,
            @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),
            @nextActionDate DATETIME,
            @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @parentRequestAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @requestMonitorActionExpireRequestKey TINYINT,            
            @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
            @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,            
            @systemObjectExpirationTime DATETIME;           

 
        SELECT
            @commitTime = GETUTCDATE(),
            @enableRequestCacheRetention = [fim].[ShouldRetainRequestCache](),
            @expirationTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExpirationTime'),
            @index = -1,
            @nextActionDate = DATEADD(day, 1, @commitTime), -- will retry 1 day later if all Requests in the tree are not done.
            @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
            @parentRequestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ParentRequest'),
            @requestMonitorActionExpireRequestKey  = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionExpireRequest]()),        
            @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
            @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
            @systemObjectExpirationTime = [fim].[GetSystemObjectExpirationTime]();
            
    
        -- Check that the input @objectTypeKey corresponds to Request.
        IF (@objectTypeKey != @requestObjectTypeKey)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'The object to expire [' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @objectKey) + N'] must be of type Request.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
        END


        IF EXISTS 
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [vdt].[ValueDateTime]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [vdt]
            WHERE 
                    [vdt].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
                AND [vdt].[AttributeKey] = @expirationTimeAttributeKey
                AND [vdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey
        )          
        BEGIN
        
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteCachedRequest] 
                @requestKey = @objectKey;                                                   
        
            SELECT @didExpireRequestStatus = 3;
            RETURN;
        END        
        
        -- if request caching is enabled update the request to expire one day from 
        -- commit time and return.    
        IF (@enableRequestCacheRetention = 1)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[ScheduleRequestExpiration] 
                @commitTime = @commitTime,
                @nextActionDate = @nextActionDate,
                @requestKey = @objectKey;
            RETURN;
            
            SELECT @didExpireRequestStatus = 0;
        END


        -- This auditing is based on Request objects. We follow the "system objects to delete" 
        -- trail starting at the expired Request object. Thus there is no reason to expire 
        -- anything other than the Request.
        --
        -- If the object is not a root request (no ParentRequest link), then we 
        -- do not want to mark ExpirationTime on the object.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [vr].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [vr]
            WHERE 
                    [vr].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
                AND [vr].[AttributeKey] = @parentRequestAttributeKey
                AND [vr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey
        )
        BEGIN            
            -- We no longer need any of the Request Cache data for this Request
            -- so delete it.
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteCachedRequest] 
                @requestKey = @objectKey;                                                   
                           
            SELECT @didExpireRequestStatus = 2;
                           
            RETURN;
        END
        
        
        DECLARE @requestSet  TABLE
        (
            [RequestKey]    BIGINT  PRIMARY KEY
        );
        
                
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet;
        END  
        
        CREATE TABLE #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet
        (
            [Order]        INT     IDENTITY(0,1)   PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
            [RequestKey]   BIGINT                  NOT NULL
        );
        
        CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_DoExpireRequestObject_DoExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet]
        ON #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet
        (
            [RequestKey]
        );

        
        -- At this point the request must be a top level request. It has no parent
        -- of its own.
        -- we always start with the root Request object.
        INSERT INTO #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet
        (
            [RequestKey]
        )
        SELECT @objectKey AS N'RequestKey';
        
        WHILE (1=1)
        BEGIN            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                -- If this does NOT return anything we know we've processed all
                -- applicable requests. @index is incremented to the last object
                -- after every iteration.
                SELECT TOP 1 [request].[RequestKey]
                FROM #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet AS [request]
                WHERE [request].[Order] >= @index
            )
            BEGIN
                -- insert all the requests that haven't been processed yet. We find this
                -- by finding the items added since the last index was stored.
                INSERT INTO @requestSet
                (
                    [RequestKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT [request].[RequestKey]
                FROM #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet AS [request]
                WHERE
                        [request].[Order] > @index;
                    
                -- We want to limit this to only Requests that have a ParentRequest reference to
                -- a request in our set.   
                -- If a Request references another Request as a Target or some other relationship
                -- we don't want to stamp it with ExpirationTime (ex. Cancel request case).
                INSERT INTO @requestSet
                (
                    [RequestKey]
                )
                SELECT [ovr].[ObjectKey] AS N'RequestKey'
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
                INNER JOIN @requestSet AS [rs]
                    ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [rs].[RequestKey]
                WHERE 
                        [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @parentRequestAttributeKey;
                    
                    
                -- Note that at this time, @requestSet may contain request keys that
                -- we've already processed. Use an inner join with the temp table
                -- to delete these references.
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [candidate].[RequestKey]
                    FROM @requestSet AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet AS [duplicate]
                        ON [candidate].[RequestKey] = [duplicate].[RequestKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE FROM @requestSet
                    FROM @requestSet AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet AS [duplicate]
                        ON [candidate].[RequestKey] = [duplicate].[RequestKey]
                END
                
                
                -- At this time the only things in @requestKey are request keys that
                -- are descendents of the top level request. Must be merged into 
                -- #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet. 
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [candidate].[RequestKey]
                    FROM @requestSet AS [candidate]
                )
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @index = MAX([set].[Order])
                    FROM #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet AS [set];
                
                    INSERT INTO #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet
                    (
                        [RequestKey]
                    )
                    SELECT 
                        [candidate].[RequestKey]
                    FROM @requestSet AS [candidate];
                    
                    -- clear the temporary cache since we already know that these
                    -- requests are a part of the chain.
                    DELETE FROM @requestSet;
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END
        END -- WHILE(1=1)
        

        -- If we find any Request in this chain that is not final, then we do not 
        -- mark any of these with ExpirationTime and queue up a re-try.
        -- When a child Request is final, it is deleted from the [fim].[Request] table
           
        IF EXISTS
        (    
            SELECT TOP 1 [deroars].[RequestKey]
            FROM #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet AS [deroars]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            ON [deroars].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
            WHERE [deroars].[RequestKey] != @objectKey
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[ScheduleRequestExpiration] 
                @commitTime = @commitTime,
                @nextActionDate = @nextActionDate,
                @requestKey = @objectKey;           

            SELECT @didExpireRequestStatus = 0;
                                   
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- At this point the entire request chain should be in #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet.
            -- And all have reached a final state.
            -- Expire all these requests.
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueDateTime],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT 
                [applicable].[RequestKey],
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                @expirationTimeAttributeKey,
                0,
                @systemObjectExpirationTime,
                0            
            FROM #doExpireRequestObjectsApplicableRequestSet AS [applicable];
                
            -- Setting an ExpirationTime attribute is the last item to do on a Request object
            -- so remove this Request from Cache.
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteCachedRequest] 
                @requestKey = @objectKey;
                
            SELECT @didExpireRequestStatus = 1;
                
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoMaintainSet]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoMaintainSet]
    @setKey                             BIGINT,
    @reportOnly                         BIT                 = 0,
    @setIdentifier                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL,
    @setTypeKey                         SMALLINT            = NULL,
    @setTypeName                        NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL,
    @falseFlag                          BIT                 = NULL,
    @trueFlag                           BIT                 = NULL,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey         SMALLINT            = NULL,
    @explicitMemberAttributeKey         SMALLINT            = NULL
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  This procedure compares the actual membership of a resource of which the 
 *  membership is defined by a filter--the de facto membership--to what the 
 *  membership ought to be, as specified by the filter--the de jure membership.  
 *  If there is any discrepancy between the de facto and de jure membership, 
 *  the discrepancy is corrected, and a notification of the correct is sent.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    DECLARE 
        @ancillaryParameters                    XML,
        @batchEnd                               BIGINT,
        @batchStart                             BIGINT,
        @correctionCount                        INTEGER,
        @hasConditions                          BIT,
        @maxNumberCorrections                   SMALLINT,
        @message                                NVARCHAR(2000),
        @memberIdentifier                       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @memberKey                              BIGINT,
        @notificationBatchSize                  BIGINT,
        @notificationDialogHandle               UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @notificationMessage                    XML,
        @rowIndex                               BIGINT,
        @rowLimit                               BIGINT,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeKey                          SMALLINT,
        @parametersAddMemberToSetTemplate       NVARCHAR(1024),
        @parametersRemoveMemberFromSetTemplate  NVARCHAR(1024),
        @parametersString                       NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @parameters                             XML,
        @requestDisplayNameTemplate             NVARCHAR(448),
        @requestIdentifier                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @requestStatusFailedKey                 SMALLINT,
        @requestStatusFinalKey                  SMALLINT,
        @sql                                    NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @falseFlag;
    
    IF @setIdentifier IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @setIdentifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectkey](@setKey);
    END
        
    IF @setTypeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @setTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey](@setKey);
    END
   
    IF @setTypeName IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @setTypeName = [fim].[ObjectTypeNameFromKey](@setTypeKey);
    END
          
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');
    END
    
    IF @explicitMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @explicitMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember');
    END
    
    SELECT  @ancillaryParameters = CAST(N'<AncillaryParameters><RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>true</Calculated><Target>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000</Target><PropertyName>SetCorrection</PropertyName><Value xsi:type=''xsd:string''>True</Value><Operation>Put</Operation></RequestParameter></AncillaryParameters>' AS XML),
            @correctionCount = 0,
            @maxNumberCorrections = 10000,
            @notificationBatchSize = 100,
            @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
            @parametersAddMemberToSetTemplate = REPLACE(N'<RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>false</Calculated><Target>{0}</Target><PropertyName>ComputedMember</PropertyName><Value xmlns:q1=''http://microsoft.com/wsdl/types/'' xsi:type=''q1:guid''>{1}</Value><Operation>Create</Operation><Mode>Add</Mode></RequestParameter>', N'{0}', @setIdentifier),
            @parametersRemoveMemberFromSetTemplate = REPLACE(N'<RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>false</Calculated><Target>{0}</Target><PropertyName>ComputedMember</PropertyName><Value xmlns:q1=''http://microsoft.com/wsdl/types/'' xsi:type=''q1:guid''>{1}</Value><Operation>Create</Operation><Mode>Remove</Mode></RequestParameter>', N'{0}', @setIdentifier),
            @parametersString = N'',
            @requestDisplayNameTemplate = N'Set Correction For {0} {1}',
            @requestStatusFailedKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusFailed]());
            
    
    SELECT @hasConditions = [set].[HasMembershipConditions]
    FROM [fim].[Set] AS [set]
    WHERE		[set].[SetKey] = @setKey;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* A.   Populate a temporary table with the explicit members of the set.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [explicit].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicit]
        WHERE
                [explicit].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [explicit].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [explicit].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetExplicitMember') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #maintainSetExplicitMember;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT [explicit].[ValueReference] AS [MemberKey]
        INTO #maintainSetExplicitMember
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [explicit]
        WHERE
                [explicit].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [explicit].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [explicit].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
        ORDER BY [explicit].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetExplicitMember]
        ON #maintainSetExplicitMember
        (
            [MemberKey]
        ); 
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.   Populate a temporary table with the de jure members of the set.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    SELECT @sql = [filter].[SQL]
    FROM [fim].[SetFilter] AS [filter]
    WHERE
            [filter].[SetKey] = @setKey;
            
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetDeJureMember') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #maintainSetDeJureMember;
    END            
            
    CREATE TABLE #maintainSetDeJureMember
    (
        [MemberKey] BIGINT
    );
    
    INSERT INTO #maintainSetDeJureMember
    (
        [MemberKey]
    )
    EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql;   
    
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeJureMember]
    ON #maintainSetDeJureMember
    (
        [MemberKey]
    ); 

    -- Add Explicit members
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetExplicitMember') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [explicit].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetExplicitMember AS [explicit]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                ON [explicit].[MemberKey] = [deJure].[MemberKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [explicit]
            FROM #maintainSetExplicitMember AS [explicit]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                ON [explicit].[MemberKey] = [deJure].[MemberKey]
        END  
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [explicit].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetExplicitMember AS [explicit]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #maintainSetDeJureMember
            (
                [MemberKey]
            )
            SELECT [explicit].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetExplicitMember AS [explicit]
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* C.   Populate a temporary table with the de facto members of the set.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetDeFactoMember') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #maintainSetDeFactoMember;
    END            
            
    CREATE TABLE #maintainSetDeFactoMember
    (
        [MemberKey] BIGINT
    );    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
        WHERE
                [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #maintainSetDeFactoMember
        (
            [MemberKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
        WHERE
                [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        ORDER BY [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeFactoMember]
        ON #maintainSetDeFactoMember
        (
            [MemberKey]
        ); 
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* D.   Identify any de facto members of the set that are not de jure
*      members (invalid members)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                ON [notDeJure].[MemberKey] = [deJure].[MemberKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                ON [notDeJure].[MemberKey] = [deJure].[MemberKey];
        END
    END
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* E.   Identify any de jure members that are not de facto members (missing members)
*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [deJure].[MemberKey]
        FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
            ON [deJure].[MemberKey] = [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember
        FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
            ON [deJure].[MemberKey] = [deFacto].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
            AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
            AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
    END

/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  F.  Exclude any corrections to set memberships managed by the 
 *      [fim].[DoSystemObjectSetTransition] procedure.  
 *--------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT [deJure].[MemberKey] AS [MemberKey]
        FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            ON  [deJure].[MemberKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [SystemSetTransitionObjectTypeKey]() AS [system]
            ON  [object].[ObjectTypeKey] = [system].[ObjectTypeKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [deJure].[MemberKey] AS [MemberKey],
            [object].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [ObjectTypeKey]
        INTO #maintainSetDeJureSystem
        FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            ON  [deJure].[MemberKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [SystemSetTransitionObjectTypeKey]() AS [system]
            ON  [object].[ObjectTypeKey] = [system].[ObjectTypeKey]
        ORDER BY
            [deJure].[MemberKey],
            [object].[ObjectTypeKey];
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeJureSystem]
        ON #maintainSetDeJureSystem
        (
            [MemberKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        ); 
        
        CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeJureSystem_ObjectType]
        ON #maintainSetDeJureSystem
        (
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        IF @hasConditions = @falseFlag
        BEGIN
            DELETE [deJure]
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureSystem AS [system]
                ON  [dejure].[MemberKey] = [system].[MemberKey];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [setCondition].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [typeCondition] 
                ON [typeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureSystem AS [system]
                ON [typeCondition].[ObjectTypeKey] = [typeCondition].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [conditionStatement]
                ON [typeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [conditionStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] [statement]
                ON [conditionStatement].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [setCondition].[SetKey] = @setKey
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @deJureConditionsBuffer TABLE
            (
                [ObjectTypeKey]             SMALLINT,
                [MembershipConditionKey]    INT,
                [StatementKey]              INT,     
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [ObjectTypeKey],
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [StatementKey]
                )
            );
            
            INSERT INTO @deJureConditionsBuffer
            (
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [StatementKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [system].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [statement].[StatementKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [typeCondition] 
                ON [typeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureSystem AS [system]
                ON [typeCondition].[ObjectTypeKey] = [typeCondition].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [conditionStatement]
                ON [typeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [conditionStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] [statement]
                ON [conditionStatement].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE		
                    [setCondition].[SetKey] = @setKey
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM @deJureConditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE       [buffer].[StatementKey] != [statement].[StatementKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [buffer]
                FROM @deJureConditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE       [buffer].[StatementKey] != [statement].[StatementKey];
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [deJure].[MemberKey]
                FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureSystem AS [system]
                    ON  [deJure].[MemberKey] = [system].[MemberKey] 
                INNER JOIN @deJureConditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
                    ON  [system].[ObjectTypeKey] = [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [deJure]
                FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeJureSystem AS [system]
                    ON  [deJure].[MemberKey] = [system].[MemberKey] 
                INNER JOIN @deJureConditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
                    ON  [system].[ObjectTypeKey] = [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey];
            END
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT [deFacto].[MemberKey] AS [MemberKey]
        FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [deFacto]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            ON  [deFacto].[MemberKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [SystemSetTransitionObjectTypeKey]() AS [system]
            ON  [object].[ObjectTypeKey] = [system].[ObjectTypeKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [deFacto].[MemberKey] AS [MemberKey],
            [object].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [ObjectTypeKey]
        INTO #maintainSetDeFactoSystem
        FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [deFacto]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            ON  [deFacto].[MemberKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [SystemSetTransitionObjectTypeKey]() AS [system]
            ON  [object].[ObjectTypeKey] = [system].[ObjectTypeKey]
        ORDER BY
            [deFacto].[MemberKey],
            [object].[ObjectTypeKey];
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeFactoSystem]
        ON #maintainSetDeFactoSystem
        (
            [MemberKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        ); 
        
        CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeFactoSystem_ObjectType]
        ON #maintainSetDeFactoSystem
        (
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        );
        
        IF @hasConditions = @falseFlag
        BEGIN
            DELETE [deFacto]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [deFacto]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeFactoSystem AS [system]
                ON      [deFacto].[MemberKey] = [system].[MemberKey];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [setCondition].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [typeCondition] 
                ON [typeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeFactoSystem AS [system]
                ON [typeCondition].[ObjectTypeKey] = [typeCondition].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [conditionStatement]
                ON [typeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [conditionStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] [statement]
                ON [conditionStatement].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [setCondition].[SetKey] = @setKey
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @deFactoConditionsBuffer TABLE
            (
                [ObjectTypeKey]             SMALLINT,
                [MembershipConditionKey]    INT,
                [StatementKey]              INT,     
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [ObjectTypeKey],
                    [MembershipConditionKey],
                    [StatementKey]
                )
            );
            
            INSERT INTO @deFactoConditionsBuffer
            (
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [StatementKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [system].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [statement].[StatementKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [setCondition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] AS [typeCondition] 
                ON [typeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [setCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeFactoSystem AS [system]
                ON [typeCondition].[ObjectTypeKey] = [typeCondition].[ObjectTypeKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [conditionStatement]
                ON [typeCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [conditionStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] [statement]
                ON [conditionStatement].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE   
                    [setCondition].[SetKey] = @setKey
                AND [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@objectTypeAttributeKey = 132));
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM @deFactoConditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE       [buffer].[StatementKey] != [statement].[StatementKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [buffer]
                FROM @deFactoConditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON  [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE       [buffer].[StatementKey] != [statement].[StatementKey];
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [deFacto].[MemberKey]
                FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [deFacto]
                INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeFactoSystem AS [system]
                    ON  [deFacto].[MemberKey] = [system].[MemberKey] 
                INNER JOIN @deFactoConditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
                    ON  [system].[ObjectTypeKey] = [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [deFacto]
                FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [deFacto]
                INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeFactoSystem AS [system]
                    ON  [deFacto].[MemberKey] = [system].[MemberKey] 
                INNER JOIN @deFactoConditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
                    ON  [system].[ObjectTypeKey] = [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey];
            END
        END
    END   
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* G.   Correction and Reporting 
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    IF(@reportOnly = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @setKey AS N'SetKey',
                [defacto].[ValueReference] AS N'Invalid Member'
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [deFacto]
            INNER JOIN #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
                ON [deFacto].[ValueReference] = [notDeJure].[MemberKey]
            WHERE
                    [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = @setKey
                AND [deFacto].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setTypeKey
                AND [deFacto].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [deJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @setKey AS N'SetKey',
                [deJure].[MemberKey] AS N'Missing Member'
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure];
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * G.1  Correction  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     

        -- Create a new table that records the members to be removed
        -- up to the throttle limit.  RowNumber is used for Notification batching
        CREATE TABLE #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection
        (
            [MemberIdentifier] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            [RowNumber] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1)
        );   
              
        -- Create a new table that records the members to be added
        -- up to the throttle limit.  RowNumber is used for Notification batching
        CREATE TABLE #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection
        (
            [MemberIdentifier] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            [RowNumber] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1)
        );        
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
        )
        BEGIN      
            INSERT #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection
            (
                [MemberIdentifier]
            )
            SELECT TOP(@maxNumberCorrections)
                [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [notDeJure].[MemberKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        
        
            CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection_RowNumber]
            ON #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection
            (
                [RowNumber],
                [MemberIdentifier]
            ); 
 
            DECLARE setCursorRemove CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
            SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberIdentifier]
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection AS [notDeJure]
           
            OPEN setCursorRemove;
            WHILE(1=1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT  @memberIdentifier = NULL;
                
                FETCH NEXT FROM setCursorRemove INTO
                    @memberIdentifier;
                    
                IF @memberIdentifier IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
                
                SELECT @parametersString = @parametersString + REPLACE(@parametersRemoveMemberFromSetTemplate, N'{1}', CAST(@memberIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(36)));

            END
            CLOSE setCursorRemove;
            DEALLOCATE setCursorRemove;
            
            -- Number of corrections made so far
            SELECT @correctionCount = COUNT([notDeJure].[MemberIdentifier])
            FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection AS [notDeJure];
            
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [deJure].[MemberKey]
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        )
        BEGIN      
            INSERT #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection
            (
                [MemberIdentifier]
            )
            SELECT TOP(@maxNumberCorrections - @correctionCount)
                [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMember AS [deJure]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [deJure].[MemberKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
       
            CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection_RowNumber]
            ON #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection
            (
                [RowNumber],
                [MemberIdentifier]
            ); 
        
            DECLARE setCursorAdd CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
            SELECT [deJure].[MemberIdentifier]
            FROM #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection AS [deJure]
            
            OPEN setCursorAdd;
            WHILE(1=1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @memberIdentifier = NULL;
                
                FETCH NEXT FROM setCursorAdd INTO 
                    @memberIdentifier;
                    
                IF @memberIdentifier IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
                
                SELECT @parametersString = @parametersString + REPLACE(@parametersAddMemberToSetTemplate, N'{1}', CAST(@memberIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(36)));

            END
            CLOSE setCursorAdd;
            DEALLOCATE setCursorAdd;            
        END
        
        IF(@parametersString != N'')
        BEGIN
            SELECT @parameters = CAST(N'<RequestParameters>' + @parametersString + N'</RequestParameters>' AS XML);

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoCreateEvaluateAndProcessSystemRequest]
                @requestDisplayNameTemplate = @requestDisplayNameTemplate,
                @operation = N'Put',
                @parameters = @parameters,
                @ancillaryParameters = @ancillaryParameters,
                @targetIdentifier = @setIdentifier OUTPUT,
                @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT,
                @requestStatusFinalKey = @requestStatusFinalKey OUTPUT,
                @extendedOutput = 0; 
        END
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * G.2  Notification 
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        IF(@requestStatusFinalKey != @requestStatusFailedKey)
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberIdentifier]
                FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection AS [notDeJure]
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT 
                    @batchStart = 0,
                    @batchEnd = @notificationBatchSize,
                    @rowLimit = MAX([notDeJure].[RowNumber])
                FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection AS [notDeJure]

                BEGIN DIALOG CONVERSATION @notificationDialogHandle
                FROM SERVICE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/NotificationInitiator]
                TO SERVICE '//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/NotificationReceiver'
                ON CONTRACT [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Contract/Notification]
                WITH ENCRYPTION=OFF;
                
                WHILE @batchStart <= @rowLimit
                BEGIN
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [notDeJure].[MemberIdentifier]
                        FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection AS [notDeJure]
                        WHERE
                                [notDeJure].[RowNumber] > @batchStart
                            AND [notDeJure].[RowNumber] <= @batchEnd
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        ;WITH XMLNAMESPACES
                        (
                            DEFAULT 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/2006/11/ResourceManagement'
                        )
                        SELECT @notificationMessage =
                        ( 
                            SELECT 
                            N'',                    
                            (
                                SELECT
                                    @setIdentifier AS N'SetID',
                                    @setTypeName AS N'SetObjectType',
                                    [notDeJure].[MemberIdentifier] AS N'MemberID',
                                    @falseFlag AS N'Added' 
                                FROM #maintainSetDeFactoMemberCorrection AS [notDeJure]
                                WHERE
                                        [notDeJure].[RowNumber] > @batchStart
                                    AND [notDeJure].[RowNumber] <= @batchEnd                                       
                                FOR XML PATH (N'FilteredMembershipCorrection'), TYPE
                            )
                            FOR XML PATH (N'FilteredMembershipCorrections')
                        );
                        
                        SEND ON CONVERSATION @notificationDialogHandle 
                        MESSAGE TYPE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Message/Notification](@notificationMessage);
                    END
                
                    SELECT 
                        @batchStart = @batchEnd,
                        @batchEnd = @batchEnd + @notificationBatchSize;
                END            
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [deJure].[MemberIdentifier]
                FROM #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection AS [deJure]
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT 
                @batchStart = 0,
                @batchEnd = @notificationBatchSize,
                @rowLimit = MAX([deJure].[RowNumber])
                FROM #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection AS [deJure]

                BEGIN DIALOG CONVERSATION @notificationDialogHandle
                FROM SERVICE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/NotificationInitiator]
                TO SERVICE '//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/NotificationReceiver'
                ON CONTRACT [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Contract/Notification]
                WITH ENCRYPTION=OFF;

                WHILE @batchStart <= @rowLimit
                BEGIN
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [deJure].[MemberIdentifier]
                        FROM #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection AS [deJure]
                        WHERE
                                [deJure].[RowNumber] > @batchStart
                            AND [deJure].[RowNumber] <= @batchEnd
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        ;WITH XMLNAMESPACES
                        (
                            DEFAULT 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/2006/11/ResourceManagement'
                        )
                        SELECT @notificationMessage =
                            ( 
                                SELECT 
                                N'',                    
                                (
                                    SELECT
                                        @setIdentifier AS N'SetID',
                                        @setTypeName AS N'SetObjectType',
                                        [deJure].[MemberIdentifier] AS N'MemberID',
                                        @trueFlag AS N'Added' 
                                    FROM #maintainSetDeJureMemberCorrection AS [deJure]
                                    WHERE
                                            [deJure].[RowNumber] > @batchStart
                                        AND [deJure].[RowNumber] <= @batchEnd                                       
                                    FOR XML PATH (N'FilteredMembershipCorrection'), TYPE
                                )
                                FOR XML PATH (N'FilteredMembershipCorrections')
                            );     

                        SEND ON CONVERSATION @notificationDialogHandle 
                        MESSAGE TYPE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Message/Notification](@notificationMessage);
                    END

                    SELECT 
                        @batchStart = @batchEnd,
                        @batchEnd = @batchEnd + @notificationBatchSize;
                END                
            END
        END  -- End Correction and Notification
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions] 
    @statementKey INT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @identifierAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        
    SELECT
        @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        WHERE
                [statement].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
            AND
                (
                        [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                    OR  [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                    OR  [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                    OR  [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
                )
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [set].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE        [condition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsConditions') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsConditions;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INTO #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsConditions
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
        WHERE       [condition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
        ORDER BY 
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_DoOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsConditions]
        ON #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsConditions
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey]
        );
        
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement]
        (
            [StatementKey]
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @statementKey
        );
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT  [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsConditions AS [condition]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition]
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [StatementKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                @statementKey
            FROM #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsConditions AS [condition];
            
            UPDATE [condition]
                SET [StatementCount] = [StatementCount] - 1
            FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            INNER JOIN #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsConditions AS [partition]
                ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [partition].[MembershipConditionKey];
    
            DELETE [condition]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            WHERE        [condition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
        
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [set].[SetKey] AS [SetKey],
                [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INTO #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            INNER JOIN #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsConditions AS [condition]
                ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            ORDER BY 
                    [set].[SetKey],
                    [set].[MembershipConditionKey];
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_DoOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets]
            ON #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets
            (
                [SetKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            );
            
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAll') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAll;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [set].[SetKey] AS [SetKey],
                [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INTO #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAll
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            INNER JOIN #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets AS [condition]
                ON    [set].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey]
            ORDER BY 
                    [set].[SetKey],
                    [set].[MembershipConditionKey];
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_DoOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAll]
            ON #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAll
            (
                [SetKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            );
            
            DELETE [all]
            FROM #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAll AS [all]
            INNER JOIN #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets AS [candidate]
                ON    [all].[SetKey] = [candidate].[SetKey]
                AND   [all].[MembershipConditionKey] = [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey];
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAll AS [all]
                    ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [all].[SetKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAll AS [all]
                    ON    [candidate].[SetKey] = [all].[SetKey];
            END        
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                FROM #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[SetPartition]
                (
                    [SetKey],
                    [StatementKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT    
                    [set].[SetKey],
                    @statementKey
                FROM #doOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsSets AS [set]
            END
        END
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoProcessRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
