-- Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoProcessRequest]
    @requestKey                                 BIGINT,
    @includeResourceInActionWorkflowCreation    BIT             = 0,
    @trace                                      BIT             = 0,
    @reevaluateRequest                          BIT             = 0,
    @instantiateWorkflowInstances               BIT             = 1,
    @trueFlag                                   BIT             = NULL,
    @falseFlag                                  BIT             = NULL,
    @resourceKey                                BIGINT                  OUTPUT,    
    @requestDependencyKey                       TINYINT                 OUTPUT,
    @committedRequestStatusKey                  SMALLINT                OUTPUT,
    @committedTime                              DATETIME                OUTPUT 
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT  @committedTime = NULL,              -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @committedRequestStatusKey = NULL,  -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @requestDependencyKey = NULL,       -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @resourceKey = NULL;                -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;

    DECLARE @startTime DATETIME;

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    BEGIN TRY

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Declare and initialize variables.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        SELECT @committedTime = GETUTCDATE();

        DECLARE 
            @acquiredLock                       INT,
            @collateralWorkflowCount            INT,
            @compositeObjectTypeKey             SMALLINT,
            @createdTimeAttributeKey            SMALLINT,
            @didMarkForCancel                   BIT,    --used only if this request is attempting to cancel another request.
            @filterAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
            @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey   SMALLINT,
            @invalidAttributeName               NVARCHAR(448),
            @localeKey                          SMALLINT,
            @messageText                        NVARCHAR(2000),
            @operation                          NVARCHAR(448),
            @requestCancelReasonMessage         NVARCHAR(MAX),                
            @requestControlAttributeKey         SMALLINT,            
            @requestControlKey                  TINYINT,
            @requestIdentifier                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            @requestObjectTypeKey               SMALLINT,
            @requestStatusCommittedString       NVARCHAR(32),
            @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning    NVARCHAR(16),
            @resourceTypeKey                    SMALLINT,
            @targetAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
            @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey      SMALLINT,
            @principalKey                       BIGINT;
           
        SELECT 
            @acquiredLock                       =   -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
            @compositeObjectTypeKey             =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmCompositeType'),
            @createdTimeAttributeKey            =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
            @didMarkForCancel                   =   @falseFlag,
            @filterAttributeKey                 =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Filter'),
            @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey   =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'HasCollateralRequest'),
            @requestControlAttributeKey         =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestControl'),                      
            @requestDependencyKey               =   NULL,
            @requestIdentifier                  =   [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@requestKey),
            @requestObjectTypeKey               =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
            @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey      =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'WorkflowInstance'),
            @requestStatusCommittedString       =   [fim].[RequestStatusCommitted](),
            @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning    =   [fim].[RequestStatusDetailLevelWarning](),
            @targetAttributeKey                 =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Target');
        

        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @requestKey;
            
        IF @acquiredLock < 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatNotAbleToObtainLockOnRequestKey](@requestKey);
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
        SELECT
            @localeKey = [LocaleKey],
            @operation = [Operation],
            @resourceKey = [TargetKey],
            @resourceTypeKey = [TargetObjectTypeKey],
            @principalKey = [Creator]
        FROM [fim].[Request]
        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
        IF @@ROWCOUNT != 1
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = N'Request ' + CAST(@requestIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(36)) + N' not found in Request table';
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B. Check if this is a Cancel Request and Process it.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @requestControlAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @requestControlKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([ro].[ValueString])
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @requestControlAttributeKey;
        END
            
        IF @requestControlKey IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
        
            SELECT @requestCancelReasonMessage = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonUserInitiated](@requestKey);             

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoCancelRequest]
                @requestKey = @resourceKey,
                @requestControlKey = @requestControlKey,
                @causeKey = @requestKey,
                @reason = @requestCancelReasonMessage,
                @reasonDetailLevel = @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning,
                @recordRequestControl = 0,  -- [fim].[UpdateResource] (called later in this stored procedure) will stamp RequestControl on this Request
                @didMarkForCancel = @didMarkForCancel OUTPUT;

            IF @didMarkForCancel = @falseFlag
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageText = N'Cancel Request is denied for Request ' + CAST(@requestIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(36));
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END
       END 

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Reevaluate the request if we found it to be coming out of pending
 *       AuthZ. @reevaluateRequest is passed in from the request dispatcher. 
 *       The goal is to get the current set transitions because the set 
 *       transitions evaluated for the request, perhaps a long time ago, may
 *       no longer be correct. Reevaluation of the request will be done to
 *       generate the new final set membership state for the target. 
 *       Do not execute if we're cancelling the request.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @evaluationChanged BIT;
        -- At this point we are not cancelling
        IF (@reevaluateRequest = 1)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequest]
                @originalRequestKey = @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
                @operation = @operation,
                @targetKey = @resourceKey,
                @trace = @trace;               
        END
			          

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.    Update the Target to set the Created Time if it is not being 
 *       deleted.  The goal is to have the CreatedTime for a Target = to the
 *       CommittedTime of the Request that created the Target for audit purposes.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        UPDATE [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime]
            SET 
                [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime].[ValueDateTime] = @committedTime
            WHERE 
                    [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
                        

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.    Re-add duplicate removals & additions to the Request Output tables
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputString]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [SequenceID],
            [LocaleKey],
            [ValueString],
            [Deleted]           
        )
        SELECT 
            [rod].[RequestKey],
            [rod].[ObjectKey],
            [rod].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [rod].[AttributeKey],
            [rod].[SequenceID],
            [rod].[LocaleKey],
            [rod].[ValueString],
            [rod].[Deleted]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDuplicateString] AS [rod]
        WHERE [rod].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
 

        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputText]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [SequenceID],
            [LocaleKey],
            [ValueText],
            [Deleted]           
        )
        SELECT 
            [rod].[RequestKey],
            [rod].[ObjectKey],
            [rod].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [rod].[AttributeKey],
            [rod].[SequenceID],
            [rod].[LocaleKey],
            [rod].[ValueText],
            [rod].[Deleted]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDuplicateText] AS [rod]
        WHERE [rod].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.    Replace the current representation of the target resource with the 
 *        updated representation.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        EXECUTE [fim].[UpdateResource] 
            @requestKey     = @requestKey, 
            @resourceKey	= @resourceKey, 
            @localeKey		= @localeKey, 
            @time			= @committedTime,
            @trace          = @trace;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G.    Process any ancillary parameters
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        -- Make sure composite request doesn't modify membership conditons.
        -- When composite type request functionality was implemented
        -- possibility to have multiple ancillary parameters related to different targets wasn't considered what
        -- resulted in a bug that there can be membership condition created to point to the composite object
        -- rather than to individual group/set. See bug IMT 31354 and 31692 for details.
        IF @resourceTypeKey = @compositeObjectTypeKey
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT *
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText]
                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = N'Composite requests are not allowed to modify Filter attribute.';
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END
        END
 
        EXECUTE [fim].[ProcessAncillaryRequestParameters]
            @requestKey = @requestKey,
            @resourceKey = @resourceKey,
            @processingTime = @committedTime,
            @trace          = @trace;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * H.     Instantiate the action workflows for this target and return the 
 *        record set of instance guids to the caller.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
        IF (@instantiateWorkflowInstances = 1)
        BEGIN
            DECLARE 
                @policyRuleKey BIGINT,
                @workflowDefinitionKey BIGINT,
                @workflowDefinitionVersionKey INT,
                @workflowInstanceKey BIGINT,
                @workflowInstanceIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @workflowType TINYINT;
    	   
            DECLARE actionWorkflowCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [rstw].[PolicyRuleKey],
                [rstw].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
                [rstw].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [rstw]
            WHERE 
                    [rstw].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rstw].[ResourceKey] = @resourceKey; 

            --Action Workflows only
            SET @workflowType = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey]([fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]());
            OPEN actionWorkflowCursor;
            WHILE (1 = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT 
                    @policyRuleKey = NULL,
                    @workflowDefinitionKey = NULL,
                    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = NULL;
                    
                FETCH NEXT FROM actionWorkflowCursor INTO 
                    @policyRuleKey,
                    @workflowDefinitionKey,
                    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey;

                -- Base case for cursor.
                IF (@policyRuleKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END

                IF (@workflowDefinitionKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    CONTINUE;
                END
    	           
                SET @workflowInstanceKey = NULL;
                SET @workflowInstanceIdentifier = NULL;
    	            
                EXECUTE [fim].[DoCreateWorkflowInstance]
                    @workflowDefinitionKey = @workflowDefinitionKey,
                    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey,
                    @requestKey = @requestKey,
                    @principalKey = @principalKey,
                    @targetKey = @resourceKey,
                    @processingTime = @committedTime,
                    @workflowType = @workflowType,
                    @workflowInstanceKey = @workflowInstanceKey OUTPUT,
                    @workflowInstanceIdentifier = @workflowInstanceIdentifier OUTPUT;

                UPDATE [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition]
                SET [ActionWorkflowInstanceIdentifier] = @workflowInstanceIdentifier
                WHERE 
                        [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [ResourceKey] = @resourceKey
                    AND [PolicyRuleKey] = @policyRuleKey
                    AND [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey
                    AND [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey;
            END
            CLOSE actionWorkflowCursor;
            DEALLOCATE actionWorkflowCursor;
    		           
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [policy].[ValueIdentifier] AS 'PolicyKey',
                [instance].[ActionWorkflowInstanceIdentifier] AS 'Action Workflow Instance'
            FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [instance]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [policy]
                ON [instance].[PolicyRuleKey] = [policy].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE 
                    [instance].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [instance].[ResourceKey] = @resourceKey;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * I.     Prepare For Dispatch of Collateral Workflows (If applicable)
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        INSERT [fim].[PolicyApplication]
        (
            [TargetKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [RequestKey],
            [ManagementPolicyRuleKey],
            [Cause],
            [ServiceId],                       
            [DispatchTime],                  
            [IsCanceled]                   
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rstawd].[ResourceKey],
            [rstawd].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [rstawd].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [rstawd].[RequestKey],
            [rstawd].[PolicyRuleKey],
            [rstawd].[RequestKey],
            NULL,
            NULL,
            0    
        FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [rstawd]
        WHERE
                [rstawd].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rstawd].[ResourceKey] != 
                CASE 
                    WHEN @includeResourceInActionWorkflowCreation = @falseFlag THEN @resourceKey  --Do not include the target resource
                    ELSE -1  -- ALL including target resource [Cant use NULL in this type of expression so am using an ObjectKey = -1 which is invalid to represent the same thing] 
                END;

        SELECT @collateralWorkflowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

        IF @collateralWorkflowCount > 0
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoBindRequestWithCollateralRequestDependency]
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @collateralWorkflowCount = @collateralWorkflowCount,
                @commitTimeStamp = @committedTime;
        END  
                     
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * J. Mark Request object as Committed. 
 *    This ensures the date-time stamp on the target matches the Request Committed
 *    date-time stamp for searches. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest] 
            @requestKey = @requestKey,
            @targetKey = @resourceKey,
            @committedTime = @committedTime,
            @status = @requestStatusCommittedString,
            @causeKey = @requestKey,
            @trace = @trace;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * K.    Perform system operations.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessUpdate] 
            @resourceKey = @resourceKey,
            @resourceTypeKey = @resourceTypeKey,
            @cause = @requestKey, 
            @time = @committedTime,
            @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
            @trace = @trace;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * L. Return results (primarily for middle tier service)
 *    RequestStatus and HasCollateralRequest attributes are used by the C# RequestDispatcher
 *    State Machine to control the next set of operations to be performed on 
 *    this request object.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        --Return the current value of the RequestStatus (should be committed if everything worked)        
        SELECT @committedRequestStatusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([ovs].[ValueString])
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        WHERE
                [ovs].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus');

        --Return a final value for @requestDependencyKey
        IF @didMarkForCancel = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            SELECT @requestDependencyKey = [fim].[GetRequestDependencyKey]([fim].[RequestDependencyCancelingRequest]());
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [ValueBoolean]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean]
                WHERE 
                        [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [AttributeKey] = @hasCollateralRequestAttributeKey
                    AND [ValueBoolean] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @requestDependencyKey = [fim].[GetRequestDependencyKey]([fim].[RequestDependencyCollateralRequest]());
            END
        END

        IF @trace = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
	        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
                @startTime  = @startTime,
                @requestKey = @requestKey, 
                @stage      = N'DoProcessRequest';
        END

    END TRY
    
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
       
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoRefreshWorkflowDefinitionCache]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoRefreshWorkflowDefinitionCache]
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 0
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY
    
        IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
        BEGIN
           SET NOCOUNT ON;
        END
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

        DECLARE @createdTimeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),      
                @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
                
        SELECT  @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
                @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition')
    
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get all definitions that are in use.  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

        DECLARE @WorkflowDefinitionId TABLE
        (
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey] BIGINT,
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] INT,
            [SourceTable] NVARCHAR(64)
        )

        --Active definitions 
        INSERT @WorkflowDefinitionId
        (
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [SourceTable]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [ObjectKey],
            NULL,
            N'ObjectValueDateTime'
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
        WHERE   [ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
            AND [AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;

        --RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition (may have old versions pending)
        INSERT @WorkflowDefinitionId
        (
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [SourceTable]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            N'RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition'
        FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] 
        WHERE [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] IS NOT NULL;

        --WorkflowInstance (may have old versions running or pending)
        INSERT @WorkflowDefinitionId
        (
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [SourceTable]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            N'WorkflowInstance'
        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
        WHERE [Finished] = 0;

        --PolicyApplication (may have old versions pending)
        INSERT @WorkflowDefinitionId
        (
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [SourceTable]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            N'PolicyApplication'
        FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication]

        --Debugging
        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
                [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                [SourceTable]
            FROM @WorkflowDefinitionId
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. For each in use definition, add it to cache and update local temp table
        * with its unique key. 
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

        DECLARE WorkflowDefinitionIdCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT DISTINCT [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
        FROM @WorkflowDefinitionId;

        DECLARE @workflowDefinitionKey BIGINT;
        DECLARE @workflowDefinitionVersionKey INT;

        OPEN WorkflowDefinitionIdCursor;
        WHILE(1 = 1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @workflowDefinitionKey = NULL;
            SELECT @workflowDefinitionVersionKey  = NULL;

            FETCH NEXT FROM WorkflowDefinitionIdCursor INTO @workflowDefinitionKey;

            IF(@workflowDefinitionKey IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                -- NO MORE RECORDS
                BREAK;
            END

            --NOTE this should be a no-op since the table should contain all the keys already
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoCacheWorkflowDefinition]
                @workflowDefinitionKey = @workflowDefinitionKey,
                @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey OUTPUT;

            IF(@workflowDefinitionVersionKey IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                -- Update any rows that do not have the version already
                UPDATE @WorkflowDefinitionId
                SET [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey
                WHERE
                        [WorkflowDefinitionKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey
                    AND [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] IS NULL;
            END


        END
        CLOSE WorkflowDefinitionIdCursor;
        DEALLOCATE WorkflowDefinitionIdCursor; 

        --Debugging
        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [WorkflowDefinitionKey],
                [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
            FROM @WorkflowDefinitionId;
        END
                
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Delete everything from WorkflowDefinition cache tables that are no longer needed.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        
        -- FK dependency on [WorkflowDefinition]
        DELETE [fim].[ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints]
        WHERE [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] NOT IN
        (
            SELECT [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] FROM @WorkflowDefinitionId
            WHERE [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] IS NOT NULL
        ) 
        
        DELETE [fim].[WorkflowDefinition]
        WHERE [VersionKey] NOT IN 
        (
            SELECT [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] FROM @WorkflowDefinitionId
            WHERE [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] IS NOT NULL
        )  
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D. Make sure to maintain referential integrity between the various workflow
        *    instance cache tables and the [WorkflowDefinition] table.  
        *    At the conclusion of this procedure, the version key in the workflow 
        *    cache tables must be found in the workflowDefinition table.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

        DECLARE @WorkflowDefinitionVersionKeyConflict TABLE
        (
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey]			BIGINT
        )
        
        INSERT INTO @WorkflowDefinitionVersionKeyConflict
        (
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [WorkflowDefinitionKey]
        FROM @WorkflowDefinitionId AS [wdi]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[WorkflowDefinition] AS [wd]
        ON
                [wdi].[WorkflowDefinitionKey] = [wd].[ObjectKey]
            AND [wdi].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = [wd].[VersionKey]
        WHERE
            [wd].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;
            
        
        IF(@@ROWCOUNT > 0)	
        BEGIN
            --Found mismatch versions which are not allowed
            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
            BEGIN
                SELECT 
                    [wdi].[WorkflowDefinitionKey],
                    [wdi].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                    [wdi].[SourceTable]
                FROM @WorkflowDefinitionId AS [wdi]
                INNER JOIN @WorkflowDefinitionVersionKeyConflict AS [wdvkc]
                ON
                    [wdi].[WorkflowDefinitionKey] = [wdvkc].[WorkflowDefinitionKey];
            END	

            SET @messageText = 
                [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'A WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey mismatch exists in one of the workflow instance cache tables. You must restore the specified version to [WorkflowDefinition] or remove the instance from the cache tables before executing this procedure.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
    END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException]
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoRefreshWorkflowRetroactivePolicyCache]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- Called by other stored procedures 
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoRefreshWorkflowRetroactivePolicyCache]
    @workflowDefinitionKey BIGINT = NULL,
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 0  -- 0 no output, 1 data only, 2 data + messages
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


	BEGIN TRY
	
        IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
        BEGIN
           SET NOCOUNT ON;
        END

        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
 
        DECLARE @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');
        
        DECLARE @runOnPolicyUpdateAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @runOnPolicyUpdateAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RunOnPolicyUpdate');

        IF(@workflowDefinitionKey IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            -- delete all
            DELETE FROM [fim].[WorkflowRetroactivePolicy];

            -- insert all active
            INSERT INTO [fim].[WorkflowRetroactivePolicy]
            (
                WorkflowDefinitionKey        
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean]
            WHERE 
                    [ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @runOnPolicyUpdateAttributeKey
                AND [ValueBoolean] = 1;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- delete specific id if it exits.
            DELETE FROM [fim].[WorkflowRetroactivePolicy]
            WHERE [WorkflowDefinitionKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey;

            -- insert specific id if it is still active. 
            INSERT INTO [fim].[WorkflowRetroactivePolicy]
            (
                WorkflowDefinitionKey      
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean]
            WHERE 
                    [ObjectKey] = @workflowDefinitionKey
                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @runOnPolicyUpdateAttributeKey
                AND [ValueBoolean] = 1;
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoRemoveReportingJob]
	@reportingJobObjectKey  BIGINT	
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************   
     EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
          
     DELETE
     FROM [fim].[ReportingJobs]
     WHERE [JobIdentifierKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey;	
         
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoRemoveSetMembershipConditionPartition]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoRemoveSetMembershipConditionPartition] 
    @statementKey INT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement]
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [StatementKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [condition].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
            ON    [partition].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
        
        UPDATE [condition]
            SET [StatementCount] = [StatementCount] + 1
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition] AS [condition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
        WHERE        [statement].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
            
        DELETE [partition]
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [partition]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [partition].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [partition]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement] AS [partition]
        WHERE        [partition].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
    END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoRequestCreation]
    @serviceId              SMALLINT,
    @servicePartitionId     SMALLINT,
    @targetIdentifier       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL OUTPUT, -- INPUT and OUTPUT
    @creator                UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @requestContext         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL,
    @anonymous              BIT,
    @operation              NVARCHAR(448),
    @parameters             XML                 = NULL,
    @ancillaryParameters    XML                 = NULL,
    @displayNameTemplate    NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL,
    @justification          NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL,
    @locale                 NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL,
    @doSetTransitions       BIT                 = 1,
    @cause                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @requestMarker          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @isChildRequest         BIT                 = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT                 = 0,
    @requestIdentifier      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER           OUTPUT,
    @displayName            NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL OUTPUT,
    @targetObjectTypeName   NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL OUTPUT,
    @time                   DATETIME            = NULL OUTPUT
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    -- WARNING:  @targetIdentifier is an INPUT and OUTPUT param, must set its value for SR0013 to pass
    SELECT  @targetIdentifier = @targetIdentifier;  -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

    DECLARE @startTime                    DATETIME;
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Declare and initialize variables.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    
    DECLARE 
        @creatorAttributeKey                                    SMALLINT,
        @creatorKey                                             BIGINT,
        @causeKey                                               BIGINT,  
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                             SMALLINT,
        @count                                                  INT,  
        @displayNameAttributeKey                                SMALLINT,
        @justificationAttributeKey                              SMALLINT,
        @reasonAttributeKey                                     SMALLINT,
        @reason                                                 NVARCHAR(448) = NULL,
        @falseFlag                                              BIT,
        @localeKey                                              SMALLINT,
        @mayRetry                                               BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                                            INT,
        @messageText                                            NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @objectIDAttributeKey                                   SMALLINT,
        @parentRequestAttributeKey                              SMALLINT,
        @requestContextKey                                      BIGINT,        
        @requestKey                                             BIGINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey                                   SMALLINT,
        @resourceKey                                            BIGINT,
        @retryCount                                             INT,
        @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey                       SMALLINT,   -- this was not part of RTM Request Object Schema; Will be added by "DatabaseUpgrade.exe".
        @setObjectTypeKey                                       SMALLINT,
        @synchronizationServiceUser                             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @targetAttributeKey                                     SMALLINT,
        @targetObjectTypeKey                                    SMALLINT,
        @targetObjectDisplayName                                NVARCHAR(448),
        @trueFlag                                               BIT,
        @SyncExportTimeOut                                      BIT = 0;

    SELECT 

        @mayRetry                                   = 0,
        @mayRetryInt                                = 0,
        @retryCount                                 = 3,
        @requestIdentifier                          = NEWID(),
        @displayName                                = N'', 
        @falseFlag                                  = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag                                   = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @requestObjectTypeKey                       = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @setObjectTypeKey                           = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Set'),
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                 = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @creatorAttributeKey                        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Creator'),
        @displayNameAttributeKey                    = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),        
        @justificationAttributeKey                  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Justification'),
        @reasonAttributeKey                         = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Reason'),
        @objectIDAttributeKey                       = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @parentRequestAttributeKey                  = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'ParentRequest'),
        @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'ServicePartitionName'), 
        @targetAttributeKey                         = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Target'),
        @synchronizationServiceUser                 = [fim].[GetSynchronizationAccountIdentifier](),
        @targetObjectTypeName                       = NULL,
        @time                                       = GETUTCDATE();
    
    SELECT @creatorKey = [o].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o] 
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectID] = @creator;
    
    SELECT @causeKey = [o].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o] 
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectID] = @cause;
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Create object keys for the creations
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        

            EXECUTE [fim].[CreateObjectIdentifiersFromRequestParameters] 
                @requestParameters = @parameters;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Identify the target.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 
            IF (@targetIdentifier IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                RAISERROR(N'Invalid target Identifier', 16, 1);
            END

            EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                @objectID = @targetIdentifier,
                @objectTypeKey = @targetObjectTypeKey,
                @objectKey = @resourceKey OUTPUT;
                
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Stop processing synchronization requests on objects for which 
 *      synchronization errors have been recorded.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
            
            IF
            (
                    @creator = @synchronizationServiceUser
                AND 
                (
                        @operation = N'Delete'
                    OR  @operation = N'Put'
                )
                AND EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [error].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM [sync].[ObjectSynchronizationError] AS [error]
                    WHERE
                            [error].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                )
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageText = [sync].[FormatSynchronizationException](@resourceKey);
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                RETURN; 
            END
                
            IF @creator = @synchronizationServiceUser
                SELECT @SyncExportTimeOut = 1 
                FROM [sync].[ExportTimeOutReached]
                WHERE ExportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();

            IF @SyncExportTimeOut = 1
                RAISERROR ('FIM MA Export Timeout is reached. Rollback transaction.', 16, 1);
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.    If the request was to retrieve data, then the work is complete.     
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            IF(@operation = N'Get')
            BEGIN
                IF(XACT_STATE() = 1)
                BEGIN
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
                END
                RETURN;
            END



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.1.    Create object keys for the request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
            EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                @objectID = @requestIdentifier,
                @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
                @objectKey = @requestKey OUTPUT;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.2.    Cache the request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        

                IF(@ancillaryParameters IS NOT NULL)
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter]
                    (
                        [RequestKey],
                        [Name],
                        Value
                    )
                    SELECT
                        @requestKey,
                        Root.ancillaryParameter.value('(PropertyName/text())[1]','NVARCHAR(448)'),
                        Root.ancillaryParameter.value('(Value/text())[1]','NVARCHAR(MAX)')
                    FROM @ancillaryParameters.nodes('/AncillaryParameters/RequestParameter') Root(ancillaryParameter);
                END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.3    Generate request parameters and request output.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoRequestParameterAndOutputGeneration]
                @serviceId = @serviceId,
                @servicePartitionId = @servicePartitionId,
                @targetKey = @resourceKey,
                @anonymous = @anonymous,
                @creatorKey = @creatorKey,
                @operation = @operation,
                @parameters = @parameters,
                @locale = @locale,
                @causeKey = @causeKey,
                @requestMarker = @requestMarker,
                @trace = @trace,
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @targetIdentifier = @targetIdentifier,
                @targetObjectDisplayName = @targetObjectDisplayName OUTPUT,
                @targetObjectTypeKey = @targetObjectTypeKey OUTPUT,
                @targetObjectTypeName = @targetObjectTypeName OUTPUT;
                

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.4    Determine the display name of the request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
             IF(@displayNameTemplate IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                SET @displayName = REPLACE(REPLACE(@displayNameTemplate, '{0}', ISNULL(@targetObjectTypeName,'')), '{1}', ISNULL(@targetObjectDisplayName,''));
            END
            

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G.    Build and populate a table of the request's attributes.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
 
            DECLARE @attribute TABLE
            (
                [AttributeKey]     SMALLINT,
                [ValueDateTime]    DATETIME,
                [ValueString]      NVARCHAR(448),
                [ValueText]        NVARCHAR(MAX)
            );
            
            DECLARE @referenceAttribute TABLE
            (
                [AttributeKey]     SMALLINT,
                [ValueReference]   BIGINT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [AttributeKey]
                )
            );

            INSERT INTO @referenceAttribute
            (
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                    @objectIDAttributeKey,
                    @requestKey
            );
                    
            INSERT INTO @attribute
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
                    NULL,
                    N'Request',
                    NULL;
                    
            INSERT INTO @referenceAttribute
            (
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                    @creatorAttributeKey,
                    @creatorKey
            );
                    
            INSERT INTO @attribute
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
                    @time,
                    NULL,
                    NULL;

            INSERT INTO @attribute
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Operation'),
                    NULL,
                    @operation,
                    NULL;
                    
            IF(@displayName IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @attribute
                    SELECT
                        @displayNameAttributeKey,
                        NULL,
                        @displayName,
                        NULL;
            END

            IF(@justification IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @attribute
                    SELECT
                        @justificationAttributeKey,
                        NULL,
                        @justification, 
                        NULL;
            END

            IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fim.RequestParameter WHERE RequestKey = @requestKey AND AttributeName = 'Reason') AND
               NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
                          WHERE ObjectKey = @causeKey AND ObjectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey AND AttributeKey = @reasonAttributeKey))
            BEGIN
                SELECT @reason = AttributeValue FROM fim.RequestParameter WHERE RequestKey = @requestKey AND AttributeName = 'Reason';

                INSERT INTO @attribute
                    SELECT
                        @reasonAttributeKey,
                        NULL,
                        @reason, 
                        NULL;

                IF (@causeKey IS NOT NULL AND @reasonAttributeKey IS NOT NULL AND @reason IS NOT NULL)
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
                    (
                    [ObjectKey], 
                    [ObjectTypeKey], 
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [SequenceID],
                    [ValueString],
                    [Multivalued]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @causeKey,
                        @requestObjectTypeKey,
                        @reasonAttributeKey,
                        CAST((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY @reasonAttributeKey ORDER BY @reasonAttributeKey) - 1) AS SMALLINT),
                        @reason,
                        0;
                END
            END ELSE IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fim.RequestParameter WHERE RequestKey = @requestKey AND AttributeName = 'Reason') AND
                        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
                               WHERE ObjectKey = @causeKey AND ObjectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey AND AttributeKey = @reasonAttributeKey))
            BEGIN
                SELECT @reason = AttributeValue FROM fim.RequestParameter WHERE RequestKey = @requestKey AND AttributeName = 'Reason';

                IF (@causeKey IS NOT NULL AND @reasonAttributeKey IS NOT NULL AND @reason IS NOT NULL)
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueString]
                    SET ValueString = CONCAT(ValueString, '; ', @reason)
                    WHERE [ObjectKey] = @causeKey
                      AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                      AND [AttributeKey] = @reasonAttributeKey;
                END
            END

            IF(@requestContext IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @requestContextKey = [o].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o] 
                WHERE 
                        [o].[ValueIdentifier] = @requestContext;


                INSERT INTO @referenceAttribute
                (
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference]
                )
                VALUES
                (
                        [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmRequestContext'),
                        @requestContextKey
                );

            END

            IF(@targetIdentifier IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @referenceAttribute
                (
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference]
                )
                VALUES
                (
                        @targetAttributeKey,
                        @resourceKey
                );
            END

            IF(@targetObjectTypeName IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @attribute
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'TargetObjectType'),
                        NULL,
                        @targetObjectTypeName,
                        NULL;
            END

            IF(@locale IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @attribute
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Locale'),
                        NULL,
                        @locale,
                        NULL;
            END

            INSERT INTO @attribute
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                    NULL,
                    [fim].[RequestStatusValidating](),
                    NULL;
                    
            IF([fim].[DoesBindingExist](@requestObjectTypeKey, @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey) = 1)
            BEGIN                                
                INSERT INTO @attribute
                    SELECT
                        @servicePartitionNameAttributeKey,
                        NULL,
                        [partition].[ServicePartitionName],
                        NULL
                FROM [fim].[ServicePartition] AS [partition]
                WHERE [partition].[ServicePartitionId] = @servicePartitionId        
            END

            IF(@parameters IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @requestParameterAttributeKey SMALLINT;
                SELECT @requestParameterAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestParameter');

                -- Forming and inserting XML in this way is a few orders of magnitude faster than ".query('.')", which involves heavy spooling.
                WITH XMLNAMESPACES 
                (
                    'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance' AS [xsi],
                    'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'          AS [xsd],
                    'http://microsoft.com/wsdl/types/'          AS [q1]
                )
                INSERT INTO @attribute
                SELECT 
                    @requestParameterAttributeKey,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    (
                        SELECT 
                            requestParameter.value('@xsi:type',                             'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS '@xsi:type',
                            requestParameter.value('(Target/text())[1]',                    'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Target',
                            requestParameter.value('(Calculated/text())[1]',                'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Calculated',
                            requestParameter.value('(PropertyName/text())[1]',              'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'PropertyName',
                            requestParameter.value('(Value/@xsi:type)[1]',                  'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Value/@xsi:type',
                            requestParameter.value('(Value/text())[1]',                     'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Value',
                            requestParameter.value('(Operation/text())[1]',                 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Operation',
                            requestParameter.value('(Mode/text())[1]',                      'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Mode',
                            requestParameter.value('(WorkflowDefinition/Value/@xsi:type)[1]','NVARCHAR(MAX)')   AS 'WorkflowDefinition/Value/@xsi:type',
                            requestParameter.value('(WorkflowDefinition/Value/text())[1]',  'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'WorkflowDefinition/Value'
                        FOR XML PATH('RequestParameter')
                    )
                FROM @parameters.nodes('/RequestParameters/RequestParameter') Root(requestParameter);
            END

            IF @isChildRequest = 1
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @referenceAttribute
                (
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference]
                )
                VALUES
                (
                        @parentRequestAttributeKey,
                        @causeKey
                );
            END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * H.    Range-lock the non-reference attributes so that SequenceID is unique
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                    

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [t].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [t]
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @count = COUNT([t].[ObjectKey])
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [t] WITH (XLOCK)
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [t].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [t]
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @count = COUNT([t].[ObjectKey])
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [t] WITH (XLOCK)
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [t].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [t]
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @count = COUNT([t].[ObjectKey])
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [t] WITH (XLOCK)
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [t].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [t]
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @count = COUNT([t].[ObjectKey])
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [t] WITH (XLOCK)
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [t].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [t]
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @count = COUNT([t].[ObjectKey])
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [t] WITH (XLOCK)
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [t].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] AS [t]
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @count = COUNT([t].[ObjectKey])
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] AS [t] WITH (XLOCK)
                INNER JOIN @attribute AS [a]
                    ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [a].[AttributeKey]
                WHERE 
                        [t].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [t].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * I.    Store the request as a normal object  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                    
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueDateTime],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                [a].[AttributeKey],
                CAST((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [a].[AttributeKey] ORDER BY [a].[AttributeKey]) - 1) AS SMALLINT),
                [a].[ValueDateTime],
                [ai].[Multivalued]
            FROM @attribute AS [a]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [a].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            WHERE [a].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL;

            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT
                @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                [a].[AttributeKey],
                [a].[ValueReference],
                @falseFlag
            FROM @referenceAttribute AS [a]
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@requestObjectTypeKey = 26));
            
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueString],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                [a].[AttributeKey],
                CAST((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [a].[AttributeKey] ORDER BY [a].[AttributeKey]) - 1) AS SMALLINT),
                [a].[ValueString],
                [ai].[Multivalued]
            FROM @attribute AS [a]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [a].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            WHERE [a].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL;

            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueText] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueText],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                [a].[AttributeKey],
                CAST((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [a].[AttributeKey] ORDER BY [a].[AttributeKey]) - 1) AS INT),
                [a].[ValueText],
                [ai].[Multivalued]
            FROM @attribute AS [a]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [a].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            WHERE [a].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * J.   If the request was initiated by the Synchronization Service, then 
 *      record that fact.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/              
            EXECUTE [fim].[AddExportRequest]
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @action = @operation,
                @creatorKey = @creatorKey;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * K.    Trigger any necessary set transitions for the request resource.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
             IF(@doSetTransitions = 1)
            BEGIN    
                EXECUTE [fim].[DoSystemObjectSetTransitions] 
                    @objectKey      = @requestKey,
                    @objectTypeKey  = @requestObjectTypeKey;
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * L.    Commit the transaction.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
 
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * M.    Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH


    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'DoRequestCreation';
    END

END

--********************************************************
