CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoRequestParameterAndOutputGeneration]
    @serviceId SMALLINT, 
    @servicePartitionId SMALLINT, 
    @targetKey BIGINT=NULL OUTPUT, -- INPUT and OUTPUT
    @anonymous BIT, 
    @creatorKey BIGINT, 
    @operation NVARCHAR (448), 
    @parameters XML=NULL,
    @locale NVARCHAR (448)=NULL, 
    @causeKey BIGINT, 
    @requestMarker UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
    @targetIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
    @trace BIT=0, 
    @requestKey BIGINT OUTPUT,  -- INPUT and OUTPUT
    @targetObjectDisplayName NVARCHAR (448)=NULL OUTPUT, 
    @targetObjectTypeKey SMALLINT=NULL OUTPUT, 
    @targetObjectTypeName NVARCHAR (448)=NULL OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    -- WARNING: @requestKey is an INPUT and OUTPUT param, must set its value for SR0013 to pass
    -- WARNING: @targetKey is an INPUT and OUTPUT param, must set its value for SR0013 to pass

    SELECT  @requestKey = @requestKey,       -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @targetKey = @targetKey,         -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @targetObjectDisplayName = NULL, -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @targetObjectTypeKey = NULL,     -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @targetObjectTypeName = NULL;    -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        @messageSizeLimit               SMALLINT;

    SELECT 
        @messageSizeLimit = 2048;

    DECLARE 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey                            SMALLINT,
        @defaultLocaleKey                                   SMALLINT,
        @displayNameAttributeKey                            SMALLINT,
        @index                                              BIGINT,
        @localeKey                                          SMALLINT,
        @messageTargets                                     NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @messageText                                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @targetObjectTypeDisplayNameAncillaryParameterName  NVARCHAR(32),
        @requestObjectTypeKey                               SMALLINT, 
        @serviceAccountObjectKey                            BIGINT,
        @startTime                                          DATETIME,
        @time                                               DATETIME,
        @locale16                                           NVARCHAR(16);
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Declare and initialize variables.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    
    SELECT
        @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'CreatedTime'),
        @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
        @serviceAccountObjectKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey](),
        @targetObjectTypeDisplayNameAncillaryParameterName = [fim].[GetTargetObjectTypeAncillaryParameterName](),
        @targetObjectTypeName = NULL;
        
    DECLARE @retryCount INT;
    SET @retryCount = 3;
    
    DECLARE @mayRetry    BIT,
            @mayRetryInt INT;
    SET @mayRetry = 0;
    SET @mayRetryInt = 0;
    
    SET @time = GETUTCDATE();
            
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 

        SET @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Parse and cache the update request parameters.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @requestParameter TABLE
        (
            [Index]                    INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
            [Mode]                     NVARCHAR(448),
            [ObjectIdentifier]         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            [ObjectKey]                BIGINT NULL,
            [AttributeName]            NVARCHAR(448),
            [AttributeValue]           NVARCHAR(MAX),
            [AttributeValueIdentifier] NVARCHAR(40),
            [SystemGenerated]          BIT
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [Index]
            )
        );
        
        DECLARE @exceptionObject TABLE
        (
            [Index]         BIGINT  IDENTITY(1,1)   NOT NULL,
            [ObjectKey]     BIGINT                  NOT NULL,
            [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT                NOT NULL,
            [AttributeName] NVARCHAR(448)           NOT NULL,
            [Identifier]    NVARCHAR(448)           NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [Index]
            )
        );
        
        IF 
        (
                @parameters IS NOT NULL
            AND @operation != N'Get'
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @requestParameter
            (
                [Mode],
                [ObjectIdentifier],
                [ObjectKey],
                [AttributeName],
                [AttributeValue],
                [SystemGenerated]                    
            )
            SELECT
                COALESCE
                (
                    Root.requestParameter.value('(Mode/text())[1]',      'NVARCHAR(448)'),    
                    Root.requestParameter.value('(Operation/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(448)')    
                ),
                Root.requestParameter.value('(Target/text())[1]',        'UNIQUEIDENTIFIER'), 
                NULL,
                Root.requestParameter.value('(PropertyName/text())[1]',  'NVARCHAR(448)'),    
                Root.requestParameter.value('(Value/text())[1]',         'NVARCHAR(MAX)'),    
                Root.requestParameter.value('(Calculated/text())[1]',    'BIT')              
            FROM @parameters.nodes('/RequestParameters/RequestParameter') Root(requestParameter);
        END

        IF EXISTS 
        (
            SELECT [rp].[AttributeName] 
            FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [rp].[AttributeName] = [ai].[Name]
            WHERE [ai].[Name] IS NULL 
                AND [rp].[AttributeName] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @attributeName NVARCHAR(448);
            DECLARE @errorText   NVARCHAR(MAX);
            
            SELECT TOP 1 @attributeName = [rp].[AttributeName] 
            FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [rp].[AttributeName] = [ai].[Name] 
            WHERE [ai].[Name] IS NULL 
                AND [rp].[AttributeName] IS NOT NULL
            
            SET @errorText = fim.FormatInvalidAttributeSpecifiedInRequest(@attributeName);
            RAISERROR(@errorText, 16, 1);
        END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Identify the target.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF(@operation = N'Create')
        BEGIN
            IF(@parameters IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
            
                IF (@targetKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN             

                    SELECT @targetObjectTypeName = LEFT([rp].[AttributeValue],448)
                    FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
                    WHERE 
                            [rp].AttributeName = N'ObjectType'
                        AND [rp].[ObjectIdentifier] = @targetIdentifier;
                    
                    IF(@targetObjectTypeName IS NOT NULL)
                    BEGIN
                        SET @targetObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](@targetObjectTypeName);
                    END
                
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SET @targetObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey] (@targetKey);
                    SET @targetObjectTypeName = [fim].[ObjectTypeNameFromKey] (@targetObjectTypeKey);
                END

                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [rap].[RequestKey]
                    FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
                    WHERE
                            [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [rap].[Name] = @targetObjectTypeDisplayNameAncillaryParameterName
                )
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @targetObjectDisplayName = LEFT([rap].[Value],448)
                     FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
                    WHERE
                            [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [rap].[Name] = @targetObjectTypeDisplayNameAncillaryParameterName;
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @targetObjectDisplayName = LEFT([rp].AttributeValue,448)
                    FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
                    WHERE [rp].AttributeName = N'DisplayName';
                END
                
                EXECUTE [fim].GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier
                @objectID = @targetIdentifier,
                @objectTypeKey = @targetObjectTypeKey,
                @objectKey = @targetKey OUTPUT;

            END
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF(@targetIdentifier IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN

                EXECUTE [fim].GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier
                @objectID = @targetIdentifier,
                @objectTypeKey = @targetObjectTypeKey OUTPUT,
                @objectKey = @targetKey OUTPUT;


                DECLARE @acquiredLock INT;
                SELECT @acquiredLock = -1;  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API

                EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @targetKey;
                    
                IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire exclusive lock on Target ' + CAST(@targetIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(36)));
                    RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                END

                IF(@targetObjectTypeKey IS NOT NULL)
                BEGIN
                    SET @targetObjectTypeName = [fim].[ObjectTypeNameFromKey](@targetObjectTypeKey);
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatPermissionDeniedException](NULL);
                    RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    RETURN;
                END

                SELECT @defaultLocaleKey = [fim].[GetDefaultLocaleKey]();

                SELECT @targetObjectDisplayName = [vs].[ValueString]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [vs]
                WHERE 
                        [vs].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
                    AND [vs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
                    AND [vs].[LocaleKey] = @defaultLocaleKey
                    AND [vs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
                OPTION (RECOMPILE);
            END
        END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.    If the request was to retrieve data, then the work is complete.     
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        IF(@operation = N'Get')
        BEGIN
            IF(XACT_STATE() = 1)
            BEGIN
                COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            END
            RETURN;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1.  Add CreatedTime to creates
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rp].[Mode] 
            FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
            WHERE [rp].[Mode] = N'Create'
        )
        BEGIN        
            INSERT INTO @requestParameter
            (
                [Mode],
                [ObjectIdentifier],
                [ObjectKey],
                [AttributeName],
                [AttributeValue],
                [SystemGenerated]                    
            )
            SELECT
                N'Create',
                [rp].[ObjectIdentifier],
                [rp].[ObjectKey],
                N'CreatedTime',
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), @time, 126), --ISO8601, yyyy-mm-dd Thh:mm:ss.mmm
                1
            FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
            WHERE [rp].[Mode] = N'Create'
            AND [rp].[AttributeName] = N'ObjectType'
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E1.   Set object keys
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rp].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
            WHERE [rp].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE @requestParameter
            SET [ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
                ON [rp].[ObjectIdentifier] = [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] 
            WHERE [rp].[ObjectKey] IS NULL; 
        END


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E2.  Identify any invalid reference values
 *      Convert reference request parameter values to objectKey
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        DECLARE @referenceRequestParameters TABLE
        (
            [Index]                     INT                                 NOT NULL,
            [ObjectIdentifier]          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER                    NOT NULL,
            [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT                              NOT NULL,
            [AttributeName]             NVARCHAR(448)                       NOT NULL,
            [AttributeValueString]      NVARCHAR(MAX)                       NOT NULL,
            [Mode]                      NVARCHAR(448)                       NOT NULL,
            [AttributeValueIdentifier]  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER                    NULL,
            [AttributeValueReference]   BIGINT                              NULL
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [Index]
            )
        );

        DECLARE @objectIdentifiers TABLE
        (
            [ObjectIdentifier]          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [ObjectIdentifier]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @referenceRequestParameters 
        (
            [Index],
            [ObjectIdentifier],
            [ObjectKey],
            [AttributeName],
            [AttributeValueString],
            [Mode]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [parameter].[Index],
            [parameter].[ObjectIdentifier],
            [parameter].[ObjectKey],
            [parameter].[AttributeName],
            [parameter].[AttributeValue],
            [parameter].[Mode]
        FROM @requestParameter AS [parameter]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
            ON [parameter].[AttributeName] = [attribute].[Name] 
        WHERE 
                [attribute].[DataType] = N'Reference'
            AND [parameter].[AttributeValue] IS NOT NULL;

        UPDATE @referenceRequestParameters 
        SET [AttributeValueIdentifier] = CAST ([AttributeValueString] AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);

        UPDATE @referenceRequestParameters 
        SET [AttributeValueReference] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @referenceRequestParameters AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON [rp].[AttributeValueIdentifier] = [o].[ObjectID] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            ON  [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;

        INSERT INTO @objectIdentifiers
        (
            [ObjectIdentifier],
            [ObjectKey] 
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            CAST([rp].[AttributeValue] AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER),
            [rp].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
        WHERE
            [rp].[AttributeName] = N'ObjectID';            

        UPDATE @referenceRequestParameters 
        SET [AttributeValueReference] = [oi].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @referenceRequestParameters AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN @objectIdentifiers AS [oi]
            ON [rp].[AttributeValueIdentifier] = [oi].[ObjectIdentifier]
        WHERE   
            [rp].[AttributeName] = N'ObjectID';
                
        UPDATE @referenceRequestParameters 
        SET [AttributeValueReference] = [oi].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @referenceRequestParameters AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN @objectIdentifiers AS [oi]
            ON [rp].[AttributeValueIdentifier] = [oi].[ObjectIdentifier];
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [reference].[AttributeValueReference] 
            FROM @referenceRequestParameters AS [reference]
            WHERE 
                    [reference].[AttributeValueReference] IS NULL
                AND [reference].[Mode] = N'Remove'
        )  
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [reference].[AttributeValueReference] 
                FROM @referenceRequestParameters AS [reference]
                INNER JOIN @requestParameter AS [parameter]
                    ON  [reference].[Index] = [parameter].[Index]
                    AND [reference].[AttributeName] = [parameter].[AttributeName]
                    AND [reference].[AttributeValueString] = [parameter].[AttributeValue]
                WHERE 
                        [reference].[AttributeValueReference] IS NULL
                    AND [reference].[Mode] = N'Remove'
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [parameter]
                FROM @referenceRequestParameters AS [reference]
                INNER JOIN @requestParameter AS [parameter]
                    ON  [reference].[Index] = [parameter].[Index]
                    AND [reference].[AttributeName] = [parameter].[AttributeName]
                    AND [reference].[AttributeValueString] = [parameter].[AttributeValue]
                WHERE 
                        [reference].[AttributeValueReference] IS NULL
                    AND [reference].[Mode] = N'Remove'
            END

            DELETE FROM @referenceRequestParameters
            WHERE 
                    [AttributeValueReference] IS NULL
                AND [Mode] = N'Remove'
        END
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [reference].[AttributeValueReference] 
            FROM @referenceRequestParameters AS [reference]
            WHERE [reference].[AttributeValueReference] IS NULL
        )        
        BEGIN
            IF @creatorKey = @serviceAccountObjectKey
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [parameter].[Index]
                    FROM @requestParameter AS [parameter]
                    INNER JOIN @referenceRequestParameters AS [referenceParameter]
                        ON 
                                [parameter].[Index] = [referenceParameter].[Index] 
                            AND [parameter].[AttributeName] = [referenceParameter].[AttributeName] 
                            AND [parameter].[AttributeValue] = [referenceParameter].[AttributeValueString]
                    WHERE       [referenceParameter].[AttributeValueReference] IS NULL
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [parameter]
                    FROM @requestParameter AS [parameter]
                    INNER JOIN @referenceRequestParameters AS [referenceParameter]
                        ON 
                                [parameter].[Index] = [referenceParameter].[Index] 
                            AND [parameter].[AttributeName] = [referenceParameter].[AttributeName] 
                            AND [parameter].[AttributeValue] = [referenceParameter].[AttributeValueString]
                    WHERE       [referenceParameter].[AttributeValueReference] IS NULL;
                END 
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @exceptionObject
                (
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [ObjectTypeKey],
                    [AttributeName]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [reference].[ObjectKey],                    
                    [object].[ObjectTypeKey],
                    [reference].[AttributeName]
                FROM @referenceRequestParameters AS [reference] 
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                    ON  [reference].[ObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE       [reference].[AttributeValueReference] IS NULL;
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [exception].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
                    INNER JOIN @requestParameter AS [name]
                        ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE   [name].[AttributeName] = N'DisplayName'
                )
                BEGIN            
                    UPDATE @exceptionObject
                    SET [Identifier] = CAST([name].[AttributeValue] AS NVARCHAR(448))
                    FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
                    INNER JOIN @requestParameter AS [name]
                        ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE   [name].[AttributeName] = N'DisplayName';
                END
                        
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [exception].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [name]
                        ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [name].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    WHERE       [name].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
                )
                BEGIN            
                    UPDATE @exceptionObject
                    SET [Identifier] = [name].[ValueString]
                    FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [name]
                        ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [name].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    WHERE       [name].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey;
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [exception].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
                        ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [objects].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [objects].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    WHERE       [exception].[Identifier] IS NULL
                )
                BEGIN            
                    UPDATE @exceptionObject
                    SET [Identifier] = CAST([objects].[ObjectID] AS NVARCHAR(448))
                    FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
                        ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [objects].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [objects].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    WHERE       [exception].[Identifier] IS NULL;
                END
                
                SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidReferenceIdentifierException]();
                
                SELECT @index = MAX([exception].[Index])
                FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception];
                
                WHILE 1=1
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @messageTargets =
                    ( 
                        SELECT 
                        N'',                    
                        (
                            SELECT 
                                [exception].[Identifier] AS [n],
                                [exception].[AttributeName] AS [a]
                            FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
                            WHERE       [exception].[Index] <= @index
                            FOR XML PATH (N'i'), TYPE
                        )
                        FOR XML PATH (N'targets')
                    );  
                    
                    IF @messageTargets IS NULL
                    BEGIN
                        BREAK;
                    END
                
                    IF (LEN(@messageText) + LEN(N' ') + LEN(@messageTargets)) <= @messageSizeLimit
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @messageText = @messageText + N' ' + @messageTargets;
                        BREAK;
                    END
                    ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @index = @index - 1;
                        IF @index <= 0
                        BEGIN
                            BREAK;
                        END
                    END
                    
                END
                
                RAISERROR (@messageText, 16, 1);
            END
        END

        UPDATE @requestParameter 
        SET 
            [AttributeValue] = CAST ([refp].[AttributeValueReference] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),
            [AttributeValueIdentifier] = CAST ([refp].[AttributeValueIdentifier] AS NVARCHAR(40))
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN @referenceRequestParameters AS [refp]
        ON 
                [rp].[Index] = [refp].[Index] 
            AND [rp].[AttributeName] = [refp].[AttributeName] 
            AND [rp].[AttributeValue] = [refp].[AttributeValueString];

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E3.   Normalize delete fragements
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rp].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
            WHERE [rp].[Mode] = N'Delete'
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE @requestParameter
            SET 
                [AttributeName] = N'ObjectID',
                [AttributeValue] = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),[rp].[ObjectIdentifier]) 
            FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
            WHERE [rp].[Mode] = N'Delete';
        END


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.    Cache the request.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        

        IF(@targetObjectTypeKey IS NOT NULL) --The target is valid.  
        BEGIN
            -- locale is stored in [fim].[LocaleInternal] as NVARCHAR(16), casting to it
            SELECT @locale16 = CAST(@locale AS NVARCHAR(16));
            EXECUTE [fim].[GetLocaleKey] @locale = @locale16, @localeKey = @localeKey OUTPUT;

            DECLARE @statusKey SMALLINT;
            SET @statusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusValidating]());
                    
            IF 
            (
                    @parameters IS NOT NULL
                AND EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [parameter].[AttributeName]
                    FROM @requestParameter AS [parameter]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                    ON [parameter].[AttributeName] = [attribute].[Name]
                )
            )
            BEGIN            
            
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestParameter] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ObjectKey],            
                    [RequestParameterIndex],
                    [Mode],            
                    [AttributeName],
                    [AttributeKey],        
                    [AttributeType],         
                    [AttributeValue],
                    [AttributeValueIdentifier],        
                    [SystemGenerated]       
                )  
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [parameter].[ObjectKey],
                    [parameter].[Index],
                    [parameter].[Mode],
                    [parameter].[AttributeName],
                    [attribute].[Key],
                    [attribute].[DataType],
                    [parameter].[AttributeValue],
                    [parameter].[AttributeValueIdentifier],
                    [parameter].[SystemGenerated]
                FROM @requestParameter AS [parameter]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                ON [parameter].[AttributeName] = [attribute].[Name];
            END            


            IF
            (
                @targetObjectTypeKey IS NOT NULL
                AND NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT TOP 1 [r].[RequestKey]
                    FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
                    WHERE [r].RequestKey = @requestKey
                )               
            ) 
            BEGIN
                SELECT @locale16 = CAST(@locale AS NVARCHAR(16));
                EXECUTE [fim].[GetLocaleKey] @locale = @locale16, @localeKey = @localeKey OUTPUT;

                SET @statusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusValidating]());
            
                INSERT INTO [fim].[Request] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK) 
                VALUES
                (
                    @requestKey,
                    @serviceId,
                    @servicePartitionId,
                    @targetKey,
                    @targetObjectTypeKey,
                    @targetObjectTypeName,
                    @creatorKey,
                    @anonymous,
                    @operation,
                    @statusKey,
                    @causeKey,
                    @requestMarker,
                    @time,
                    @locale,
                    @localeKey,
                    NULL,
                    NULL
                );
                
                EXECUTE [fim].[RecordRequestStatusChange] 
                    @requestKey=@requestKey, 
                    @statusKey=@statusKey,
                    @time=@time;                                
            END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G.    Generate request output.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
                                
            EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateRequestOutput] 
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @operation = @operation,
                @targetKey = @targetKey,
                @targetObjectTypeKey = @targetObjectTypeKey,
                @localeKey = @localeKey,
                @trace = @trace;
        END
 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * H.    Commit the transaction.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
 
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * I.    Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'DoRequestOutputGeneration';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoSendReportingJobSchedulerMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoSendReportingJobSchedulerMessage]
    @reportingJobType NVARCHAR(11) = N'Incremental'
AS
BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
        
        DECLARE
            @hasInitialSynchronizationCompleted BIT,           
            @notificationDialogHandle           UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            @notificationMessage                XML,
            @trueFlag                           BIT;
    
        SELECT 
            @hasInitialSynchronizationCompleted = [fim].[HasReportingInitialSynchronizationCompleted](),
            @notificationMessage                = [fim].[FormatReportingJobMessage](@reportingJobType),            
            @trueFlag                           = CONVERT(BIT, 1);
                                             
        -- Send a create message for incremental sync only if initial sync has completed.
        IF(@hasInitialSynchronizationCompleted = @trueFlag)
        BEGIN
            BEGIN DIALOG CONVERSATION @notificationDialogHandle
            FROM SERVICE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/ReportingJobScheduleInitiator]
            TO SERVICE '//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/ReportingJobScheduleReceiver'
            ON CONTRACT [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Contract/ReportingJobSchedule]
            WITH ENCRYPTION=OFF;                   
                  
            SEND ON CONVERSATION @notificationDialogHandle 
            MESSAGE TYPE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Message/ReportingJobSchedule](@notificationMessage);
        END
    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoSetReportingJobDateTimeAttribute]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoSetReportingJobDateTimeAttribute]
    @reportingJobObjectIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @attributeName NVARCHAR(448), 
    @value         DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE 
        @attributeKey SMALLINT,
        @reportingJobObjectKey BIGINT,
        @reportingJobObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    SELECT
        @attributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](@attributeName),        
        @reportingJobObjectKey = [fim].[ObjectKeyFromObjectIdentifier](@reportingJobObjectIdentifier),
        @reportingJobObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmReportingJob');    

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ovd].[ValueDateTime]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovd]        
        WHERE
                [ovd].[ObjectKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey
            AND [ovd].[ObjectTypeKey] = @reportingJobObjectTypeKey
            AND [ovd].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
        SET [ValueDateTime] = @value
        WHERE
                [ObjectKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey
            AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @reportingJobObjectTypeKey
            AND [AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
    END
    ELSE                
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [SequenceID],
            [ValueDateTime],
            [Multivalued]            
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @reportingJobObjectKey,
            @reportingJobObjectTypeKey,
            @attributeKey,
            0,
            @value,
            0
        );
    END
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoSetTransitions] 
    @resourceKey        BIGINT,
    @requestKey         BIGINT,
    @trace              BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        @falseFlag                  BIT,
        @startTime				    DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;
        
    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.	Validate the input.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE 
        @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeKeyOfRequests    SMALLINT,
        @targetObjectTypeKey        SMALLINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey       SMALLINT;

    SELECT
        @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
        @objectTypeKeyOfRequests = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @targetObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey](@resourceKey),
        @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey](@requestKey);
    
    IF @requestObjectTypeKey IS NULL 
    OR [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey](@requestKey) != @objectTypeKeyOfRequests
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @requestKey IS NULL 
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.	Cache the request data.  
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    
    DECLARE 
        @operation      NVARCHAR(448),
        @processingTime DATETIME;
    
    SELECT @operation = r.Operation
    FROM [fim].[Request] AS r
    WHERE r.[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    
    IF(@operation IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    SELECT @processingTime = MAX(rsc.[Time])
    FROM [fim].[RequestStatusChange] AS [rsc]
    WHERE [rsc].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;

    IF @processingTime IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @processingTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.	Update the truth of membership condition statements.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.1	Delete records indicating the truth of positive literal statements
 *      falsified by the current request.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcst].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
            ON [mcst].[StatementKey] = [rmcst].[StatementKey]
            AND [mcst].[ResourceKey] = [rmcst].[ResourceKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcst].[True] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
            
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
            ON [mcst].[StatementKey] = [rmcst].[StatementKey]
            AND [mcst].[ResourceKey] = [rmcst].[ResourceKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcst].[True] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.2	Delete records indicating the truth of positive literal statements
 *      that are no longer true, because the current request has made the
 *      negative equivalent of those statements true.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    DECLARE @trueNegativeStatementsPositiveCounterparts TABLE
    (
        [ResourceKey]           BIGINT,
        [PositiveStatementKey]  INT
    );

    INSERT INTO @trueNegativeStatementsPositiveCounterparts
    (
        [ResourceKey],
        [PositiveStatementKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [rmcst].[ResourceKey],
        [mcns].[PositiveStatementKey]
    FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
        ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
        ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
    WHERE
            [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [rmcst].[True] = @trueFlag
        AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
        AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [tns].[ResourceKey]
        FROM @trueNegativeStatementsPositiveCounterparts [tns]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
            ON [tns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
            AND [tns].[ResourceKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
        INNER JOIN @trueNegativeStatementsPositiveCounterparts [tns]
            ON [mcst].[StatementKey] = [tns].[PositiveStatementKey]
            AND [mcst].[ResourceKey] = [tns].[ResourceKey]
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.3	Remove statements about immutable attributes from further consideration.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/			
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcst].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcst].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
            AND 
            (
                    [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                OR  [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            )
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [rmcst] 
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcst].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
            AND 
            (
                    [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                OR  [mcs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            );
    END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.4	Ignore a positive statement if the change to the truth of that
 *      statement caused by the current request was already made.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/		
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcst].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
            AND [rmcst].[ResourceKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcst].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
            AND [rmcst].[ResourceKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcst].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.5	Record the truth of a positive literal statement made true by the 
 *      current request.   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/		
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rmcst].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcst].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ResourceKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [rmcst].[StatementKey],
            [rmcst].[ResourceKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcst].[True] = @trueFlag
            AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @falseFlag
            AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.6	Ignore a negative statement if the change to the truth of that
 *      statement caused by the current request was already made.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/				
    DECLARE @falseNegativeStatements TABLE
    (
        [ResourceKey]           BIGINT,
        [NegativeStatementKey]  INT,
        [PositiveStatementKey]  INT
    );

    INSERT INTO @falseNegativeStatements
    (
        [ResourceKey],
        [NegativeStatementKey],
        [PositiveStatementKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [rmcst].[ResourceKey],
        [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey],
        [mcns].[PositiveStatementKey]
    FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
        ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
        ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
    WHERE
            [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [rmcst].[True] = @falseFlag
        AND [mcs].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
        AND [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL;
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [fns].[ResourceKey]
        FROM @falseNegativeStatements [fns]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
            ON [fns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
            AND [fns].[ResourceKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [rmcst]
        INNER JOIN @falseNegativeStatements AS [fns]
            ON [rmcst].[StatementKey] = [fns].[NegativeStatementKey]
            AND [rmcst].[ResourceKey] = [fns].[ResourceKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
            ON [fns].[PositiveStatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
            AND [rmcst].[ResourceKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
        WHERE
                [rmcst].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rmcst].[True] = @falseFlag
    END

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'DoSetTransitions';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoSystemObjectSetTransitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--  Adds given object to all sets possessing 1 membership condition of one statement of a given type or no conditions at all.

--  This procedure should only be called for the types identified by the [fim].[SystemObjectSetTransitionObjectType]() function.
--  Calling it for any other type of object will yield an exception.  
--  If the procedure is to be applied to additional types of objects, then the [fim].[SystemObjectSetTransitionObjectType]() function
--  must be modified to identify that type.  One purpose of having the function constrain the permissable types is so that the 
--  set correction process can exclude those types from its purview.  

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoSystemObjectSetTransitions]
    @objectKey BIGINT, 
    @objectTypeKey SMALLINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE 
        @computedMemberAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @messageText                    NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey         SMALLINT,
        @setObjectTypeKey               SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                      BIT,
        @trueFlag                       BIT;

    SELECT 
        @computedMemberAttributeKey     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey         = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
        @setObjectTypeKey               = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'Set'),
        @falseFlag                      = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag                       = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [expectedType].[ObjectTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[SystemSetTransitionObjectTypeKey]() AS [expectedType]
        WHERE       [expectedType].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidObjectTypeOperationException](@objectTypeKey);
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [s].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[Set] AS [s]
        WHERE       [s].[HasMembershipConditions] = @falseFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @noConditionsBuffer TABLE
        (
            [ObjectKey]         BIGINT
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @noConditionsBuffer
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [s].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[Set] AS [s]
        WHERE       [s].[HasMembershipConditions] = @falseFlag;
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @noConditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                ON  [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
             WHERE
                    [existing].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [existing].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [existing].[ValueReference] = @objectKey
                AND [existing].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [buffer]
            FROM @noConditionsBuffer AS [buffer] 
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                ON  [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
             WHERE
                    [existing].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [existing].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [existing].[ValueReference] = @objectKey
                AND [existing].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag;
        END
        
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [Multivalued]
        )
        SELECT
            [buffer].[ObjectKey],
            @setObjectTypeKey,
            @computedMemberAttributeKey,
            @objectKey,
            @trueFlag -- ComputedMember is Multivalued, no need for look up
        FROM @noConditionsBuffer AS [buffer];
    END        
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [smc].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] [smc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] [mcot]
            ON [mcot].[MembershipConditionKey] = [smc].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND [mcot].ObjectTypeKey = @objectTypeKey
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] [cs]
            ON [cs].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mcot].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] [s]
            ON [cs].[StatementKey] = [s].[StatementKey]
        WHERE       [s].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @conditionsBuffer TABLE
        (
            [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT,
            [MembershipConditionKey]    INT,
            [StatementKey]              INT,     
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [StatementKey]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @conditionsBuffer
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [StatementKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [smc].[SetKey],
            [smc].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [cs].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] [smc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType] [mcot]
            ON [mcot].[MembershipConditionKey] = [smc].[MembershipConditionKey]
            AND [mcot].ObjectTypeKey = @objectTypeKey
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] [cs]
            ON [cs].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mcot].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] [s]
            ON [cs].[StatementKey] = [s].[StatementKey]
        WHERE       [s].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey;
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM @conditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
            WHERE       [buffer].[StatementKey] != [statement].[StatementKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [buffer]
            FROM @conditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
            WHERE       [buffer].[StatementKey] != [statement].[StatementKey];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [buffer].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @conditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                ON  [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
             WHERE
                    [existing].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [existing].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [existing].[ValueReference] = @objectKey
                AND [existing].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [buffer]
            FROM @conditionsBuffer AS [buffer]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                ON  [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
             WHERE
                    [existing].[ObjectTypeKey] = @setObjectTypeKey
                AND [existing].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [existing].[ValueReference] = @objectKey
                AND [existing].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag;
        END
        
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [Multivalued]
        )
        SELECT
            [buffer].[ObjectKey],
            @setObjectTypeKey,
            @computedMemberAttributeKey,
            @objectKey,
            @trueFlag -- ComputedMember is Multivalued, no need for look up
        FROM @conditionsBuffer AS [buffer];
    END

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoTerminateRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoTerminateRequest] 
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @reason                 NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @reasonDetailLevel      NVARCHAR(16),  -- Error, Warning, Information
    @didTerminateRequest    BIT             OUTPUT

AS
-- Called by other stored procedures
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT  @didTerminateRequest = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    BEGIN TRY
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A.    Declare and initialize variables.  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        DECLARE @acquiredLock                               INT,
                @failed                                     BIT,
                @causeKey                                   BIGINT,
                @messageText                                NVARCHAR(2000),
                @requestFinalStatus                         NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestControlSystemTerminateOperationKey  TINYINT,
                @requestCommittedTime                       DATETIME,
                @requestIdentifier                          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @requestObjectTypeKey                       SMALLINT,
                @requestStatus                              NVARCHAR(448),       
                @requestStatusAttributeKey                  SMALLINT, 
                @requestStatusMessage                       NVARCHAR(448),
                @statusDetailsXml                           XML,
                @workflowInstance                           UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateList      NVARCHAR(MAX),
                @workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateMessage   NVARCHAR(100),               
                @workflowInstanceTerminatedList             NVARCHAR(MAX),
                @workflowInstanceTerminatedMessage          NVARCHAR(100),               
                @workflowKey                                BIGINT,
                @workflowStatusKey                          TINYINT,
                @workflowTypeName                           NVARCHAR(448),
                @workflowTerminationAttempted               BIT;
        
        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,
                @causeKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey](),
                @didTerminateRequest = 0,
                @failed = 0,
                @requestControlSystemTerminateOperationKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlSystemTerminateOperation]()),
                @requestFinalStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusFailed](),
                @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                @workflowStatusKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusTerminated]()),
                @workflowInstanceTerminatedMessage = N'The system terminated the following WorkflowInstance(s): ',
                @workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateMessage = N'The system failed to terminate the following WorkflowInstance(s): ';
                
                    
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Get Lock, verify Request is in a state in which a Terminate operation is valid.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        
        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @requestKey;
        
        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire exclusive lock on RequestKey ' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(19)));
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        SELECT  @requestStatus = [fim].[GetRequestStatusName]([r].[Status]),
                @requestCommittedTime = [CommittedTime]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            
        IF
        ( 
                @requestStatus IS NULL
            OR [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFinal](@requestStatus) = 1
        )
        BEGIN
                -- Nothing left to do
                RETURN;
        END
        
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Terminate any remaining running workflows.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            WHERE   [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [Finished] = 0
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE workflowCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ObjectKey],
                [Identifier]
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            WHERE   
                    [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [Finished] = 0

            OPEN workflowCursor;
            WHILE(1 = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT  @requestIdentifier = NULL,
                        @requestStatusMessage = NULL,
                        @workflowInstance = NULL,
                        @workflowKey = NULL,
                        @workflowTypeName = NULL;

                FETCH NEXT FROM workflowCursor INTO 
                    @workflowKey,
                    @workflowInstance;

                IF(@workflowKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    -- NO MORE RECORDS
                    BREAK;
                END
                
                SELECT @workflowTerminationAttempted = 1;
                BEGIN TRY
                    EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusFinal]
                        @workflowInstanceObjectKey = @workflowKey,
                        @workflowStatusKey  = @workflowStatusKey,
                        @workflowStatusDetail = @reason,
                        @workflowTypeName = @workflowTypeName OUTPUT,
                        @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT,
                        @requestStatusMessage = @requestStatusMessage OUTPUT;    

                    SELECT @workflowInstanceTerminatedList = 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN @workflowInstanceTerminatedList IS NULL THEN @workflowInstanceTerminatedMessage + CAST(@workflowInstance AS NVARCHAR(36))
                        ELSE @workflowInstanceTerminatedList + ',' + CAST(@workflowInstance AS NVARCHAR(36))
                    END
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                    /***********************************************************************************************************************
                    *  DESIGN POINT:  we will still finalize the Request even though the workflow may still be running since this code could
                    *  not set its final status.  If the workflow is loaded in the FIMService and is running, it can finish its current work,
                    *  but will no longer be able to persist its state since the Request is finalized which removes the workflow from the 
                    *  persistence store and internal cache tables permanently.
                    ************************************************************************************************************************/
                    SELECT @workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateList = 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN @workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateList IS NULL THEN @workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateMessage + CAST(@workflowInstance AS NVARCHAR(36))
                        ELSE @workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateList + ',' + CAST(@workflowInstance AS NVARCHAR(36))
                    END
                END CATCH
            END
            
            CLOSE workflowCursor;
            DEALLOCATE workflowCursor;
        END
        
        IF(@workflowTerminationAttempted = 1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @failed = 1;
        END
        
        -- Stamp Details only if Required via input argument or Workflows were running and an attempt was made to terminate them.
        IF
        (
                @reason IS NOT NULL
            OR  @failed = 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT  @reason = ISNULL(@reason + N' ', N''),
                    @workflowInstanceTerminatedList = ISNULL(@workflowInstanceTerminatedList + N'. ', N''),
                    @workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateList = ISNULL(@workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateList + N'.', N'');
                    
            SELECT @statusDetailsXml = [fim].[CreateRequestStatusDetail](@reason + @workflowInstanceTerminatedList + @workflowInstanceFailedToTerminateList, @reasonDetailLevel); 
        END
                   
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
            @requestKey = @requestKey,
            @status = @requestFinalStatus,  -- Any final status will work. [DoUpdateRequest] will determine final value.
            @statusDetails = @statusDetailsXml,
            @causeKey = @causeKey,
            @requestControlKey = @requestControlSystemTerminateOperationKey,
            @failed = @failed;
        
        SELECT @didTerminateRequest = 1;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
