--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
    @requestKey         BIGINT, 
    @targetKey          BIGINT          = NULL, 
    @displayName        NVARCHAR (448)  = NULL, 
    @description        NVARCHAR (MAX)  = NULL, 
    @committedTime      DATETIME        = NULL, 
    @computedActors     XML             = NULL, 
    @managementPolicies XML             = NULL, 
    @status             NVARCHAR (448)  = NULL, 
    @requestParameters  XML             = NULL, 
    @statusKey          SMALLINT        = NULL, 
    @statusDetails      XML             = NULL, 
    @causeKey           BIGINT,
    @requestControlKey  TINYINT         = NULL,
    @failed             BIT             = 0,
    @trace              BIT             = 0
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN

    DECLARE @messageText    NVARCHAR(2000),
            @startTime      DATETIME,           
            @trueFlag       BIT;
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @trueFlag   = CONVERT(BIT,1);

    BEGIN TRY
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * A. Validate the request key.  
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[Request]
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'This Request ' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(19)) + N' has already completed processing.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * B. Initialize locals
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @acquiredLock                               INT,
                @cancelRequestKey                           BIGINT,
                @completedTimeAttributeKey                  SMALLINT,  -- this was not part of RTM Request Object Schema; Will be added by "DatabaseUpgrade.exe".
                @computedActorAttributeKey                  SMALLINT,
                @didExpireRequestStatus                     TINYINT,
                @falseFlag                                  BIT,
                @finalizeCancelRequest                      BIT,
                @isMarkedForCancel                          BIT,
                @objectIDAttributeKey                       SMALLINT,
                @operation                                  NVARCHAR(448),
                @principalKey                               BIGINT,
                @requestControlAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
                @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey     TINYINT,
                @requestControlSystemTerminateOperationKey  TINYINT,
                @requestObjectTypeKey                       SMALLINT,
                @requestParameterKey                        SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusAttributeKey                  SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusCanceled                      NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusCanceledPostProcessing        NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusCancelingKey                  SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusFailed                        NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusFinal                         NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusPostProcessingError           NVARCHAR(448),
                @targetObjectTypeKey                        SMALLINT,
                @time                                       DATETIME;

        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @computedActorAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedActor'),
                @completedTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmCompletedTime'),
                @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
                @isMarkedForCancel = 0,
                @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),                
                @requestControlAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestControl'),
                @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlSystemCancelOperation]()),
                @requestControlSystemTerminateOperationKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlSystemTerminateOperation]()),
                @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                @requestStatusCanceled = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceled](),
                @requestStatusCanceledPostProcessing = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing](),
                @requestStatusCancelingKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusCanceling]()),             
                @requestStatusFailed = [fim].[RequestStatusFailed](),
                @requestStatusPostProcessingError = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessingError]();
               
        SELECT  @time =
        CASE 
            WHEN @committedTime IS NULL THEN GETUTCDATE()
            ELSE @committedTime
        END;

        IF(@statusKey IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @status = [fim].[GetRequestStatusName](@statusKey);
            IF(@status IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Invalid @statusKey ' + CAST(@statusKey AS NVARCHAR(5)));
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END
        END

        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @requestKey;
        
        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire exclusive lock on RequestKey ' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(19)));
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        SELECT
            @operation                  = [r].[Operation],
            @principalKey               = [r].[Creator],
            @targetObjectTypeKey        = [r].[TargetObjectTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
        IF (@operation IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'requestKey');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * C.  Update the RequestControl attribute
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF(@requestControlKey IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequestControl]
            @requestKey         = @requestKey,        
            @causeKey           = @causeKey,
            @requestControlKey  = @requestControlKey;
        END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * D.  Need to check to see if this request is marked for cancel
    *     and if it is, then only allow this operation if it is to move this request to 
    *     a final state.
    *     If so, we can also move the request used to request the cancel to its final state
    *     and cleanup.
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking]
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )    
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @requestStatusFinal = [RequestStatusFinal],
                @cancelRequestKey = [CauseKey],
                @finalizeCancelRequest = [FinalizeCancelRequest]
            FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking]
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

            --This request is marked for cancel.
            SELECT @isMarkedForCancel = 1;
            
            --Finalize the cancel if the @status input value is of type final
            IF([fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFinal](@status) = 1)
            BEGIN
                -- Set the final status 
                SELECT @status =
                    CASE
                        WHEN @failed = 0 THEN @requestStatusFinal
                        WHEN @failed = 1 AND @requestStatusFinal = @requestStatusCanceled THEN @requestStatusFailed
                        WHEN @failed = 1 AND @requestStatusFinal = @requestStatusCanceledPostProcessing THEN @requestStatusPostProcessingError
                    END

                /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                *   DESIGN NOTE:
                *
                *   If the cause of the Cancel is our ServiceAccount then this was issued
                *   within SQL via [fim].[DoActionOnMonitoredRequest] so is not backed by an actual Request
                *   so do not call [fim].[UpdateRequest] since there isn't one.
                *
                *   Also, do not call [fim].[UpdateRequest] if @finalizeCancelRequest = 0 - this means
                *   that this request is a collateral request being canceled because its parent is being
                *   canceled.
                *
                *   Also do not call [fim].[UpdateRequest] if the Request is already final.
                *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                IF
                (
                        @finalizeCancelRequest = 1
                    AND @cancelRequestKey != [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey]()
                )
                BEGIN
                    DECLARE @constRequestStatusCompleted NVARCHAR(32),
                            @cancelCauseRequestStatus NVARCHAR(448);

                    SELECT  @constRequestStatusCompleted = [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]();

                    SELECT @cancelCauseRequestStatus = [ValueString] 
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
                    WHERE   [ObjectKey] = @cancelRequestKey
                        AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey;

                    -- update the RequestStatus to final state of the Cancelling Request if not already final.
                    IF([fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeProcessing](@cancelCauseRequestStatus) = 1)
                    BEGIN
                        EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
                            @requestKey = @cancelRequestKey,
                            @targetKey = @requestKey,
                            @status = @constRequestStatusCompleted,
                            @committedTime = @time,
                            @causeKey = @causeKey;
                    END
                END
            END
        END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * E.  Need to check to see if this request has already reached a final state or is marked for Cancel
    *      and if it has, then do not execute the operation unless the change is to add a
    *      RequestStatusDetail attribute which is OK.
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @currentRequestStatus NVARCHAR(448);
        SELECT @currentRequestStatus = [ValueString]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
        WHERE 
                ObjectKey = @requestKey
            AND ObjectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND AttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus');

        -- If the request is final, only allow a change to @statusDetails.
        IF
        (
                [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFinal](@currentRequestStatus) = 1
           AND 
           (
                @statusDetails IS NULL          -- Must have, this is what we allow to be added.
            OR  @computedActors IS NOT NULL     -- if trying to change the state, reject it since request is already final.
            OR  @managementPolicies IS NOT NULL -- reject it.
            OR  @status IS NOT NULL             -- reject it.
           )
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'This operation is not allowed on RequestKey ' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(19)) + N' because it is already in a final state.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
        -- If the request is marked for cancel only allow a change to @statusDetails or to update the request to a final cancel state.
        IF
        (
                @isMarkedForCancel = 1
           AND 
           (
                    @computedActors IS NOT NULL     -- if trying to change the state, reject it since request is already final.
                OR  @managementPolicies IS NOT NULL -- reject it.
                OR  
                (
                        -- reject it if not setting it to a final canceled state.            
                        [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeCanceled](@status) = 0 
                    AND [fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFailed](@status) = 0
                )
            )
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'This operation is not allowed on RequestKey ' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(19)) + N' because it is in a canceling state.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * F. We have the final status now so get the key. 
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF(@status IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @statusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@status);
        END
        
        
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * G. Augment the ComputedActors on the Request in main table
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
       IF (@computedActors IS NOT NULL)
       BEGIN
            DECLARE @computedActorBuffer TABLE
            (
                [ObjectKey]         BIGINT,
                [ObjectTypeKey]     SMALLINT,
                [AttributeKey]      SMALLINT,
                [ValueReference]    BIGINT,
                [Multivalued]       BIT,
                PRIMARY KEY
                (
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [ObjectTypeKey],
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference]
                )
            )
            
            INSERT INTO @computedActorBuffer
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                @computedActorAttributeKey,
                [vi].[ObjectKey],
                @trueFlag -- ComputedActor is Multivalued, no need for lookup
            FROM @computedActors.nodes('/ComputedActors/Identifier') Root(computedActor)
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] [vi]
                ON  [vi].[ValueIdentifier] = Root.computedActor.value('.','UNIQUEIDENTIFIER')
                AND [vi].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey;
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [buffer].[ObjectKey]
                FROM @computedActorBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                    ON  [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [buffer].[ValueReference] = [existing].[ValueReference]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [buffer]
                FROM @computedActorBuffer AS [buffer]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                    ON  [buffer].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [buffer].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [buffer].[ValueReference] = [existing].[ValueReference];
            END
            
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT 
                [buffer].[ObjectKey],
                [buffer].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [buffer].[AttributeKey],
                [buffer].[ValueReference],
                [buffer].[Multivalued]
            FROM @computedActorBuffer AS [buffer];            
       END

       IF (@requestParameters IS NOT NULL)
       BEGIN
       
            SET @requestParameterKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestParameter');
            
            DELETE FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText]
            WHERE 
                    [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                AND [AttributeKey] = @requestParameterKey;
                
                
            -- Forming and inserting XML in this way is a few orders of magnitude faster than ".query('.')", which involves heavy spooling.
            WITH XMLNAMESPACES 
            (
                'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance' AS [xsi],
                'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'          AS [xsd],
                'http://microsoft.com/wsdl/types/'          AS [q1]
            )
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueText]
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueText],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT
                @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                @requestParameterKey,
                CAST((ROW_NUMBER()OVER (ORDER BY Root.requestParameter) + -1) AS INT),
                (
                    SELECT 
                        requestParameter.value('@xsi:type',                             'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS '@xsi:type',
                        requestParameter.value('(Target/text())[1]',                    'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Target',
                        requestParameter.value('(Calculated/text())[1]',                'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Calculated',
                        requestParameter.value('(PropertyName/text())[1]',              'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'PropertyName',
                        requestParameter.value('(Value/@xsi:type)[1]',                  'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Value/@xsi:type',
                        requestParameter.value('(Value/text())[1]',                     'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Value',
                        requestParameter.value('(Operation/text())[1]',                 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Operation',
                        requestParameter.value('(Mode/text())[1]',                      'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'Mode',
                        requestParameter.value('(WorkflowDefinition/Value/@xsi:type)[1]','NVARCHAR(MAX)')   AS 'WorkflowDefinition/Value/@xsi:type',
                        requestParameter.value('(WorkflowDefinition/Value/text())[1]',  'NVARCHAR(MAX)')    AS 'WorkflowDefinition/Value'
                    FOR XML PATH('RequestParameter')
                ),
                @trueFlag -- RequestParameter is Multivalued, no need for lookup
            FROM @requestParameters.nodes('/RequestParameters/RequestParameter') Root(requestParameter);
            
            DELETE 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] 
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

            DELETE 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] 
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            DELETE 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputIdentifier]  
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            DELETE 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputInteger]  
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            DELETE 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference]  
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            DELETE 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString]  
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            DELETE 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText]  
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            DELETE 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputXml]  
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            DELETE 
            FROM [fim].[RequestParameter]  
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            DECLARE @parameters XML;
            SELECT
                @parameters = Root.requestParameter.query('.')
            FROM @requestParameters.nodes('/RequestParameters') Root(requestParameter);
            
            DECLARE @targetIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
            SELECT @targetIdentifier = [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] 
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
            ON [r].[TargetKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            DECLARE @requestMarker UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
            SELECT @requestMarker = [r].[RequestMarker]
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                        
            EXECUTE [fim].[CreateObjectIdentifiersFromRequestParameters] 
                @requestParameters = @parameters;

            DECLARE @serviceId SMALLINT,
                    @servicePartitionId SMALLINT;
                    
            SELECT 
                @serviceId = [ServiceId],
                @servicePartitionId = [ServicePartitionId]
            FROM [fim].[Request]
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoRequestParameterAndOutputGeneration] 
                @serviceId = @serviceId,
                @servicePartitionId = @servicePartitionId,
                @targetKey = @targetKey,
                @anonymous = 0,
                @creatorKey = @principalKey,
                @operation = @operation,
                @parameters = @parameters,
                @causeKey = @causeKey,
                @requestMarker = @requestMarker,
                @targetIdentifier = @targetIdentifier,
                @trace  = @trace,
                @requestKey = @requestKey OUTPUT;
                
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoEvaluateRequestInner]
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @doNotEnforceRights = 1, 
                @doNotEvaluateWorkflows = 1,
                @bypassAction = 1, 
                @bypassAuthentication =1, 
                @bypassAuthorization =1,
                @trace = @trace;
                
       END


    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * H. Augment the RequestStatusDetail on the Request in main table
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
       IF (@statusDetails IS NOT NULL)
       BEGIN
            DECLARE @requestDetailAttributeKey SMALLINT;
            SELECT @requestDetailAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatusDetail');
            
            DECLARE @sequenceID INT;

            SELECT @sequenceID = MAX ([vt].[SequenceID])
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] [vt]
            WHERE 
                    [vt].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                AND [vt].[AttributeKey] = @requestDetailAttributeKey;

            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueText]
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueText],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT
                @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                @requestDetailAttributeKey,
                ROW_NUMBER()OVER (ORDER BY Root.requestStatusDetail) + COALESCE(@sequenceID, -1),
                CAST(Root.requestStatusDetail.query('.') AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),
                @trueFlag -- RequestDetail is Multivalued, no need for lookup
            FROM @statusDetails.nodes('/RequestStatusDetails/RequestStatusDetail') Root(requestStatusDetail)
       END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * I. Update the committed time in Request cache table
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF(@status = [fim].[RequestStatusCommitted]())
        BEGIN
            -- When request is being committed, the caller, presumably, DoProcessRequest, must provide the CommittedTime
            IF (@committedTime IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'committedTime');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END
            
            UPDATE [fim].[Request]
            SET [CommittedTime] = @committedTime
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueDateTime],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                @requestObjectTypeKey,
                [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CommittedTime'),
                0,
                @committedTime,
                @falseFlag; -- CommittedTime is not Multivalued, no need to look up
                
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReleaseRequestWorkItems] @requestKey = @requestKey;
        END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * J. Record the most recent status change.  
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/      
        IF (@status IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[UpdateRequestStatus]
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @status = @status,
                @time = @time;
        END


    /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * K. Clear the request cache tables if the request is completed.  
    *    Before finalizing the Request, we need to make sure there are no more workflows.
    *    If we do find workflows, schedule them for cleanup before allowing this Request
    *    to clean-up.
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF([fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFinal](@status) = 1)
        BEGIN
        
            -- Add CompletedTime attribute if it does not already have one.
            -- NOTE:  This Attribute was added to the Request schema
            -- after RTM and will not be present until after the schema is applied
            -- to the database.  The out of box upgrade tool creates Requests to apply this
            -- schema so we must check to see if it exists before trying to apply it on these
            -- Requests.
            IF([fim].[DoesBindingExist](@requestObjectTypeKey, @completedTimeAttributeKey) = 1)
            BEGIN
                IF NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime]
                    WHERE   [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [AttributeKey] = @completedTimeAttributeKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueDateTime] 
                        @objectKey      = @requestKey,
                        @attributeKey   = @completedTimeAttributeKey, 
                        @value          = @time,
                        @objectTypeKey  = @requestObjectTypeKey;
                END
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [Finished] = 0
            )
            BEGIN
                --By adding an entry to the [fim].[RequestMonitor] it provides an 
                --asynchronous way to allow for this cleanup step to happen.

                --If this request is already in the table delete it first so we insert the appropriate action to perform based on the
                --latest status.
                DELETE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

                INSERT [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [RequestStatusKey],
                    [ActionType],
                    [DateAdded],
                    [NextActionDate],
                    [ActionsAttempted]
                )
                SELECT 
                    [RequestKey] = @requestKey,
                    [RequestStatusKey] = @statusKey,
                    [ActionType] = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionCleanupRequest]()),
                    [AddTime] = @time,
                    [NextActionTime] = @time,  --schedule immediate followup
                    0;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                --We reached a final state in a predictable manner so all things are in order and we can 
                --stamp the ExpirationTime attribute and clean out the Request Cache tables.

                EXECUTE [fim].[DoExpireRequestObject] 
                    @objectKey = @requestKey, 
                    @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
                    @didExpireRequestStatus = @didExpireRequestStatus OUTPUT;
            END

            EXEC [fim].[ReleaseRequestWorkItems] @requestKey = @requestKey;
        END

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'DoUpdateRequest';
    END
END
GO

--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoUpdateRequestControl]
    @requestKey                 BIGINT,         -- This is the Request that you are Canceling.
    @causeKey                   BIGINT,         -- This represents the Cause of the Cancel.
    @requestControlKey          TINYINT
    
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * A.    Declare and initialize variables.  
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    BEGIN TRY
        
        DECLARE @requestControlAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestControlName         NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestObjectTypeKey       SMALLINT,
                @trueFlag                   BIT;
        
        SELECT  @requestControlAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestControl'),
                @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;

        SELECT @requestControlName = [fim].[GetRequestControlName](@requestControlKey);
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
            WHERE 
                    [ovs].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @requestControlAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [ovs]
            SET [ValueString] = @requestControlName
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
            WHERE 
                    [ovs].[ObjectKey] =  @requestKey
                AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @requestControlAttributeKey
                AND [ValueString] != @requestControlName
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueString] 
                @objectKey      = @requestKey,
                @attributeKey   = @requestControlAttributeKey, 
                @value          = @requestControlName,
                @objectTypeKey  = @requestObjectTypeKey;
        END

    END TRY
    
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
       
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DoUpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusFinal]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DoUpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusFinal] 
    @workflowInstanceObjectKey BIGINT,
    @workflowStatusKey  TINYINT,
    @workflowStatusDetail NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @workflowTypeName NVARCHAR(448) OUTPUT,
    @requestIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT,
    @requestStatusMessage NVARCHAR(448) OUTPUT
AS
-- Called by other stored procedures
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT  @requestIdentifier = NULL,    -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @requestStatusMessage = NULL, -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @workflowTypeName = NULL;     -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    

        DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),
                @requestKey BIGINT,
                @workflowIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @workflowTypeKey TINYINT;
        
        SELECT
            @workflowIdentifier = [Identifier],
            @requestKey = [RequestKey],
            @workflowTypeKey = [WorkflowType]
        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
        WHERE 
            [ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey;

        SELECT @requestIdentifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@requestKey);

        SELECT @workflowTypeName = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeName](@workflowTypeKey);

        DECLARE @finished BIT;
        SELECT @finished = 1; 

        DECLARE @didUpdate    BIT,
                @didUpdateInt INT;
        SELECT @didUpdate = 0,
               @didUpdateInt = 0;

    SECTIONA:
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Update the workflow to a final state in the table that the workflow host communicates with 
        *    Make sure the workflow is removed from the WF persistence store so it is not able
        *    to re-hydrate since we are marking it as final. 
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        
        --Remove from WF persistence store
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT
                [uidInstanceID] 
            FROM [dbo].[InstanceState]
            WHERE [uidInstanceID] = @workflowIdentifier 
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [dbo].[InstanceState]
            WHERE [uidInstanceID] = @workflowIdentifier 
        END
      
            
        -- update cache table to set this workflow instance to finished.
        UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
        SET 
            [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusKey,
            [Finished] =1
        WHERE 
                [ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
            AND [WorkflowStatus] != @workflowStatusKey  -- Must be a new status
            AND Finished = 0; -- Must not already be finished

        IF( @@ROWCOUNT = 1)
        BEGIN
            --Only update if the status changed.
            EXECUTE @didUpdateInt = [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceObject]
                @workflowInstanceObjectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey, @workflowStatusKey = @workflowStatusKey, @workflowStatusDetail = @workflowStatusDetail;

            SELECT @didUpdate = CAST(@didUpdateInt AS BIT);
        END

        --check to see if there are any pending workItems and delete them.
        
        IF EXISTS 
        (
            SELECT [WorkflowInstanceObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
            WHERE [WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteWorkItem]
                @workItemId = NULL,
                @instanceId = NULL,
                @lockTimeout = NULL,
                @workflowInstanceObjectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
        END

        IF(@didUpdate = 0)
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @isFinished BIT;
            SELECT @isFinished = 0;

            SELECT
                @finished = [wi].Finished
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            WHERE
                [wi].[ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey;
                
            IF(@finished = 1)
            BEGIN
                -- If it is already finished then ignore this update.
                GOTO SECTIONC
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Failed to update workflow instance ' + CAST(@workflowIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(36)) + ' to a final state.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END  
        END


    SECTIONB:
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Apply Business Logic
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

        IF(@workflowTypeName = [fim].[WorkflowTypeAuthentication]())
        BEGIN
            -- Nothing more to do, these workflows are run synchronously in the middle tier so when they finish
            -- the request dispatch continues.
            GOTO SECTIONC;
        END

        -- if AuthZ and the result is fail then return message 'Fail'
        -- to the application or if all are completed then return 'Completed'
        IF(@workflowTypeName = [fim].[WorkflowTypeAuthorization]())
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @workflowResultsStatus NVARCHAR(448);

            EXECUTE [fim].[AreWorkflowInstancesFinished]
                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                @workflowTypeKey = @workflowTypeKey,
                @workflowResultsStatus = @workflowResultsStatus OUTPUT

            IF(@workflowResultsStatus IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @requestStatusMessage = @workflowResultsStatus;
            END

            GOTO SECTIONC;
        END


        IF(@workflowTypeName = [fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]())
        BEGIN
            -- [fim].[UpdateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflows] handles moving the request along in the dispatch pipeline
            -- based on processing results of action workflows.
            GOTO SECTIONC;
        END

    SECTIONC:
        --DONE  

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[DumpWorkflowInstanceState]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[DumpWorkflowInstanceState]
    @workflowIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

    DECLARE @DataDumpByTable AS TABLE
    (
        [Name] NVARCHAR(30),
        [Data] XML
    );

    DECLARE @objectIDAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
            @displayNameAttributeKey            SMALLINT,
            @requestKey                         BIGINT,
            @workflowDefinitionObjectKey        BIGINT,
            @workflowDefinitionVersionKey       INTEGER,
            @workflowInstanceObjectKey          BIGINT,
            @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey      SMALLINT,
            @workflowInstanceServiceId          SMALLINT,
            @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey   SMALLINT;

    SELECT  @objectIDAttributeKey               = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
            @displayNameAttributeKey            = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
            @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey      = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowInstance'),
            @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey   = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowStatusDetail');

    SELECT  @workflowInstanceObjectKey      = [wi].[ObjectKey],
            @workflowDefinitionObjectKey    = [wi].[WorkflowDefinitionKey],
            @workflowDefinitionVersionKey   = [wi].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            @requestKey                     = [wi].[RequestKey],
            @workflowInstanceServiceId      = [wi].[ServiceId]
    FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
    WHERE [wi].[Identifier] = @workflowIdentifier;
    

    -- WorkflowInstance Cache Table
    INSERT INTO @DataDumpByTable
    (
        [Name],
        [Data]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        N'WorkflowInstance',
        (
            SELECT
                [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeName]([wi].[WorkflowType]) AS [WorkflowType],
                [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusName]([wi].[WorkflowStatus]) AS [WorkflowStatus],
                [wi].[Finished],
                [wi].[WorkflowControlMessage],
                [wi].[MessageReason],
                [wi].[RequestUpdateFailed],
                [requestor].[ValueIdentifier] AS [RequestorId],
                [target].[ValueIdentifier]    AS [TargetId],
                CASE WHEN [shb].[ServiceName] IS NOT NULL THEN [shb].[ServiceName]
                     ELSE N'WARNING: WorkflowInstance ServiceId ' + CAST([wi].[ServiceId] AS NVARCHAR(5)) + N' is invalid (not listed in ServiceHeartbeat table)'
                END AS [ServiceName],
                CASE WHEN [r].[RequestKey] IS NOT NULL THEN N'GOOD: WorkflowInstance ServiceId matches Request ServiceId'
                     ELSE N'WARNING: WorkflowInstance ServiceId '  + CAST([wi].[ServiceId] AS NVARCHAR(5)) + N' does not match Request ServiceId'
                END AS [ValidateWorkflowAlignment]
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [shb]
                ON [wi].[ServiceId] = [shb].[ServiceId]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
                ON      [wi].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
                    AND [r].[ServiceId] = [shb].[ServiceId]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [requestor]
                ON 
                        [wi].[RequestorKey] = [requestor].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [requestor].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [target]
                ON 
                        [wi].[TargetKey] = [target].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [target].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
            WHERE [wi].[ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
            FOR XML RAW (N'WorkflowInstance')
        )
    );
    
     -- WorkflowInstance Object
    INSERT INTO @DataDumpByTable
    (
        [Name],
        [Data]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        N'ObjectField',
        (
            SELECT
                [ai].[Name],
                [statusDetail].[ValueText] AS [Value],
                [statusDetail].[SequenceID]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [statusDetail]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [statusDetail].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            WHERE   [statusDetail].[ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
                AND [statusDetail].[ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey
                AND [statusDetail].[AttributeKey] = @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey
            ORDER BY [statusDetail].[SequenceID]
            FOR XML RAW (N'ObjectField')
        )
    )

    -- InstanceState
    INSERT INTO @DataDumpByTable
    (
        [Name],
        [Data]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        N'InstanceState',
        (
            SELECT
                [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusName](CONVERT(tinyint, [is].[status])) AS [Status],
                [is].[unlocked] AS [Unlocked],
                [is].[blocked] AS [Blocked],
                [is].[info] AS [Info],
                [is].[modified] AS [Modified],
                [is].[ownerID] AS [OwnerId],
                [is].[ownedUntil] AS [OwnedUntil],
                [is].[nextTimer] AS [NextTimer]
            FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]
            WHERE [is].[uidInstanceID] = @workflowIdentifier
            FOR XML RAW (N'InstanceState')
        )
    );
    
    -- WorkItemSchedulerQueue
    INSERT INTO @DataDumpByTable
    (
        [Name],
        [Data]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        N'WorkItemSchedulerQueue',
        (
            SELECT
                [wis].[WorkItemId],
                [wis].[Created],
                [wis].[LockExpiration],
                [wis].[LockOwner],
                [wis].[NextRetry],
                [wis].[RetryCount],
                [wis].[SequenceKey],
                [wis].[ServiceHostName]
            FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [wis]
            WHERE [wis].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
            FOR XML RAW (N'WorkItem')
        )
    );
    
    -- WorkflowDefinition
    INSERT INTO @DataDumpByTable
    (
        [Name],
        [Data]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        N'WorkflowDefinition',
        (
            SELECT
                [wd].[Xoml],
                [wd].[Rules],
                [wd].[Deleted]
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowDefinition] AS [wd]
            WHERE [wd].[ObjectKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey
            AND [wd].[VersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey
            FOR XML RAW (N'WorkflowDefinition')
        )
    );
    
    -- Request
    INSERT INTO @DataDumpByTable
    (
        [Name],
        [Data]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        N'Request',
        (
            SELECT
                [request].[ValueIdentifier] AS [RequestId],
                [requestdn].[ValueString] AS [RequestDisplayName],
                [shb].[ServiceId],
                [shb].[ServiceName],
                CASE 
                    WHEN [shb].[LastPingTime] >= DATEADD(second, -60, GETUTCDATE()) THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(second, [shb].[LastPingTime], GETUTCDATE()) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + N' seconds'
                    ELSE N'WARNING: It has been ' + CAST(DATEDIFF(minute, [shb].[LastPingTime], GETUTCDATE()) AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N' minute(s) since the ServiceId tied to this Request has reported status.'
                END AS [TimeSinceServiceLastPinged],
                [sp].[ServicePartitionId],
                [sp].[ServicePartitionName],
                CASE WHEN [shb2].[ServiceId] IS NOT NULL THEN N'GOOD: The Request is tied to a valid Service/ServicePartition'
                    ELSE N'WARNING: The Request is tied to an inactive Service/ServicePartition'
                END AS [ValidateServicePartitionAlignment],
                [target].[ValueIdentifier] AS [TargetId],
                [r].[TargetObjectTypeName],
                [creator].[ValueIdentifier] AS [CreatorId],
                [creatordn].[ValueString] AS [CreatorDisplayName],
                [r].[Anonymous],
                [r].[Operation],
                [fim].[GetRequestStatusName]([r].[Status]) AS [Status],
                [cause].[ValueIdentifier] AS [CauseId],
                [r].[RequestMarker],
                [r].[Time],
                [r].[Locale],
                [r].[LocaleKey],
                [r].[CommittedTime],
                [r].[ReEvaluated]
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [shb]
                ON      [r].[ServiceId] = [shb].[ServiceId]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ServicePartition] AS [sp]
                ON      [r].[ServicePartitionId] = [sp].[ServicePartitionId]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [shb2]
                ON      [r].[ServiceId] = [shb2].[ServiceId]
                    AND [r].[ServicePartitionId] = [shb2].[ServicePartitionId]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [request]
                ON 
                        [r].[RequestKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [requestdn]
                ON 
                        [r].[RequestKey] = [requestdn].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [requestdn].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [creator]
                ON 
                        [r].[Creator] = [creator].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [creator].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [cause]
                ON 
                        [r].[Cause] = [cause].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [cause].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [creatordn]
                ON 
                        [r].[Creator] = [creatordn].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [creatordn].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [target]
                ON 
                        [r].[TargetKey] = [target].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [target].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
            WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            FOR XML RAW (N'Request')
        )
    );
    
    SELECT
        [Name],
        [Data]
    FROM @DataDumpByTable
    ORDER BY [Name];
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[EnqueueWorkItem]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[EnqueueWorkItem]
    @workItemId         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @workItemData       VARBINARY(max),
    @lockInstance       BIT,
    @instanceId         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @lockTimeout        INT,
    @workflowIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @serviceHostName    NVARCHAR(32),
    @nextRetry          DATETIME,
    @propertiesAsXml    XML = NULL,
    @result             INT OUTPUT
AS
    --Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT  @result = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        DECLARE @now DATETIME,
                @lockExpiration DATETIME,
                @newOwner UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @workflowInstanceObjectKey BIGINT,
                @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;

        SELECT  @now = GETUTCDATE(),
                @result = 0,
                @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowInstance');

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier] 
            @objectID = @workflowIdentifier, 
            @objectTypeKey = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey OUTPUT;

        IF
        (
                @lockTimeout < 0
            OR  @lockInstance = 0
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT  @lockExpiration = NULL,
                    @newOwner = NULL;
        END
        ELSE 
        BEGIN
            SELECT @newOwner = @instanceId;

            IF(@lockTimeout = 0)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @lockExpiration = CONVERT(DATETIME,N'9999');
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT @lockExpiration = DATEADD(second, @lockTimeout, @now);
            END
        END
        
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

            INSERT INTO [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
            (
                [WorkItemId],
                [WorkItemData], 
                [Created], 
                [LockOwner], 
                [LockExpiration], 
                [WorkflowInstanceObjectKey], 
                [ServiceHostName],
                [NextRetry]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @workItemId,
                @workItemData,
                @now,
                @newOwner,
                @lockExpiration,
                @workflowInstanceObjectKey,
                @serviceHostName,
                @nextRetry
            );

            IF(@@ROWCOUNT = 0)
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [WorkItemId]
                    FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
                    WHERE [WorkItemId] = @workItemId
                )
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @result = 1; -- The instance already existed.
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @result = 2; -- Some other non-fatal error caused us not to insert
                END
            END;

            IF @propertiesAsXml IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueueProperties]
                (
                    [WorkItemId],
                    [Name],
                    [Value]
                )
                SELECT
                    @workItemId,
                    property.value('(@Name)[1]', 'VARCHAR(64)')    AS 'Name',
                    property.value('(@Value)[1]', 'NVARCHAR(448)')    AS 'Value'
                FROM @propertiesAsXml.nodes('/Properties/Row') ROOT(property)
            END;
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
          ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END;
        
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH         
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[EvaluateNewRequest]         
    @ancillaryParameters    XML                                                 = NULL, 
    @anonymous              BIT, 
    @bypassAuthentication   BIT                                                 = 0, 
    @bypassAuthorization    BIT                                                 = 0, 
    @cause                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
    @creator                UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,                
    @displayName            NVARCHAR (448) OUTPUT, 
    @displayNameTemplate    NVARCHAR (448),
	@justification          NVARCHAR (448)                                      = NULL,
    @doNotEnforceRights     BIT                                                 = 0,
    @isChildRequest         BIT                                                 = NULL,                
    @locale                 NVARCHAR (448)                                      = NULL,     
    @operation              NVARCHAR (448), 
    @parameters             XML(CONTENT [fim].[RequestParametersCollection])    = NULL, 
    @requestContext         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER                                    = NULL,
    @requestIdentifier      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT, 
    @requestMarker          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,     
    @serviceId              SMALLINT, 
    @servicePartitionId     SMALLINT,  
    @targetIdentifier       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER                                    = NULL, 
    @targetObjectTypeName   NVARCHAR (448) OUTPUT, 
    @time                   DATETIME OUTPUT,
    @trace                  BIT                                                 =0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT  @displayName = NULL,            -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @requestIdentifier = NULL,      -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @targetObjectTypeName = NULL,   -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @time = NULL;                   -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    DECLARE @mayRetry    BIT,
            @mayRetryInt INT;
    SET @mayRetry = 0;
    SET @mayRetryInt = 0;
    DECLARE @retryCount INT;
    SET @retryCount = 3;

RetryCreateRequest:
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoRequestCreation]
            @serviceId = @serviceId,
            @servicePartitionId = @servicePartitionId,
            @targetIdentifier = @targetIdentifier OUTPUT,
            @creator = @creator,
            @requestContext = @requestContext,
            @anonymous = @anonymous,
            @operation = @operation,
            @parameters = @parameters,
            @ancillaryParameters = @ancillaryParameters,
            @displayNameTemplate = @displayNameTemplate, 
            @locale = @locale,
			@justification = @justification,
            @cause = @cause,
            @requestMarker = @requestMarker,
            @isChildRequest = @isChildRequest,
            @doSetTransitions = 1,
            @trace = @trace,
            @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT,
            @displayName = @displayName OUTPUT,
            @targetObjectTypeName = @targetObjectTypeName OUTPUT,
            @time = @time OUTPUT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryCreateRequest;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
            RETURN;
        END   
    END CATCH  
  
    SET @mayRetry = 0;
    SET @mayRetryInt = 0;
    SET @retryCount = 3;

RetryEvaluateRequest:

    BEGIN TRY
        IF((@targetIdentifier IS NULL)OR(@targetObjectTypeName IS NULL))
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000)
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidRequestTargetException](@requestIdentifier, @targetIdentifier);
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoEvaluateRequest]
                @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier,
                @doNotEnforceRights = @doNotEnforceRights,
                @trace = @trace,
                @bypassAuthentication = @bypassAuthentication,
                @bypassAuthorization = @bypassAuthorization;
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryEvaluateRequest;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
            RETURN;
        END   
    END CATCH  
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[EvaluateNewRequestRetryEvaluation]
    @bypassAuthentication   BIT                                                 = 0,

    @doNotEnforceRights     BIT                                                 = 0,
    @requestIdentifier      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,

    @time                   DATETIME OUTPUT,

AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT  @displayName = NULL,            -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

            @time = NULL,
            @targetIdentifier = NULL;       -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    DECLARE @mayRetry    BIT,
            @mayRetryInt INT;
    SET @mayRetry = 0;
    SET @mayRetryInt = 0;
    DECLARE @retryCount INT;

    BEGIN TRY

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetRequestCreationOutputParameters]
           @targetIdentifier = @targetIdentifier OUTPUT,
           @trace = @trace,
           @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier,
           @displayName = @displayName OUTPUT,
           @targetObjectTypeName = @targetObjectTypeName OUTPUT,

                    @trace = @trace,

                    @bypassAuthorization = @bypassAuthorization;

        END

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryEvaluateRequest;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
            RETURN;
        END   
    END CATCH  
END
