SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ExecuteQuery]
    @sql                NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @xpath              NVARCHAR(MAX)       = NULL,
    @serviceId          SMALLINT            = 0,  -- Default to FIM SYSTEM if not provided; [ServiceId] = 0 in [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
    @userIdentifier     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL
AS
EXECUTE AS USER='FIMServiceReadUser'
BEGIN
    DECLARE @recordQuery                            NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @systemPropertyRecordQuery              NVARCHAR(64);

    SELECT  @systemPropertyRecordQuery = [fim].[SystemPropertyRecordQuery]();
    
    SELECT  @recordQuery = [fim].[GetSystemProperty](@systemPropertyRecordQuery);
	
    --to fix too many negative conditions exception we add hint 'OPTION (FORCE ORDER)' 
    --if 'NOT IN' conditions are more than 7 and if we have system property 'AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7' equals 'True'    
    DECLARE @systemPropertyAddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 NVARCHAR(64),
            @AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @lenNOTIN SMALLINT,
            @countNegativeConditions SMALLINT,
            @sqlWithoutNOTIN NVARCHAR(MAX);
             
    SELECT @systemPropertyAddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 = N'AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7';
    
    SELECT  @AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 = [fim].[GetSystemProperty](@systemPropertyAddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7);
    
    IF 
    (
			@AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 IS NOT NULL
		AND @AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 = N'True'
	)
	BEGIN	    
	    SELECT @lenNOTIN = 6; --LEN('NOT IN') 
	    SELECT @countNegativeConditions = 7;
	    SELECT @sqlWithoutNOTIN = REPLACE(@sql, N'NOT IN', N'');
	    
	    --negative condition transforms into 'NOT IN' in the SQL statement
		--we find the difference between SQL statement and SQL statement without 'NOT IN', divide it by the length 'NOT IN', to count number of negative conditions
		--if the number is greater than 7 we add hint
		IF 
		(			
			(LEN(@sql)-LEN(@sqlWithoutNOTIN))/@lenNOTIN > @countNegativeConditions
		)
		BEGIN
			IF 
			(
				RIGHT(@sql, 1 )= N';' 
			)	
			BEGIN
				SELECT @sql = LEFT(@sql, LEN(@sql) - 1) + N' OPTION (FORCE ORDER);';
			END   
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				SELECT @sql = @sql + N' OPTION (FORCE ORDER);';  
			END  
		END 
    END
    --end fix 
	
    
    IF
    (       @recordQuery IS NOT NULL 
        AND @recordQuery = N'True'
    )
    BEGIN
    
        DECLARE @now DATETIME,
                @logKey BIGINT,
                @recordQueryGeneratedSql                NVARCHAR(MAX),
                @systemPropertyRecordQueryGeneratedSql  NVARCHAR(64);

        SELECT @now = GETUTCDATE(),
               @systemPropertyRecordQueryGeneratedSql  = [fim].[SystemPropertyRecordQueryGeneratedSql]();
                
        SELECT @recordQueryGeneratedSql = [fim].[GetSystemProperty](@systemPropertyRecordQueryGeneratedSql);
                
        INSERT [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
        (
            [XPathFilter], -- NOT NULL
            [GeneratedSql],
            [ServiceId],
            [User],
            [StartTime],
            [DurationMilliseconds]
        )
        SELECT  ISNULL(@xpath, N'NULL'), 
                CASE
                    WHEN @recordQueryGeneratedSql = N'True' THEN @sql
                    ELSE NULL
                END,
                @serviceId,
                @userIdentifier,
                @now,
                NULL;
        SELECT @logKey = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
                    
        EXEC (@sql);
        
        UPDATE [fim].[RecordQueryOperation]
        SET [DurationMilliseconds] = DATEDIFF(millisecond, @now, GETUTCDATE())
        WHERE [LogKey] = @logKey;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        EXEC (@sql);
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[ExpireStuckRequests]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ExpireStuckRequests]
    @batchSize  INT = 10000,
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 0  -- 0 none, 1 data only, 2 data + messages
AS
-- Top Level
BEGIN

    IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON
    END
         
    BEGIN TRY
    
        --DESIGN POINT:  This stored procedure handles its own transaction requirements
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        *  BACKGROUND: This stored procedure will look for Requests that are final, but have not yet ran the code
        *              that stamps their ExpirationTime
        *              Requests must wait for all their descendants to finalize before we do the stamp.
        *              [RequestMonitor] normally holds the action to do this work, but it will only happen if a service
        *              is running for the ServerPartition the Request is associated with.
        *              If the server is not running, this procedure will do the work instead.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         

        DECLARE @acquiredLockBulkExpireRequest                  SMALLINT,
                @commitTime                                     DATETIME,
                @lockNameBulkExpireRequest                      NVARCHAR(40),
                @messageText                                    NVARCHAR(2000),
                @trueFlag                                       BIT;               

        SELECT  @acquiredLockBulkExpireRequest = -1,
                @commitTime = GETUTCDATE(),
                @lockNameBulkExpireRequest = N'bulkExpireRequest',
                @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get Exclusive lock
        *   DESIGN POINT We want to ensure only one instance of this procedure can run at a time
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        EXECUTE @acquiredLockBulkExpireRequest = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockNameBulkExpireRequest,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session',
            @LockTimeout = 10000;  -- wait for up to 10 seconds to get the lock

        IF(@acquiredLockBulkExpireRequest < 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockNameBulkExpireRequest + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

       /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B.1 Setup Table that holds the Stuck Requests to be Expired
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        
        -- NOTE:  This temporary table is shared between two stored procedures
        --        The reason for this is to separate the Detection from the Expire operation
        --        so that other stored procedures could be written in the future
        --        to provide different detection logic, and then share the bulk Expire operation.
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#bulkExpireRequest') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #bulkExpireRequest;
        END

        -- Find Finalized Requests that do not have Expiration Time
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [r].[RequestKey]	
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[GetRequestStatusKeysOfTypeFinal]() AS [grsk]
            ON [r].[Status] = [grsk].[RequestStatusKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP(@batchSize)
                [r].[RequestKey],
                NULL AS [DidExpireRequest],
                CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(2000)) AS [Error]
            INTO #bulkExpireRequest
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[GetRequestStatusKeysOfTypeFinal]() AS [grsk]
            ON [r].[Status] = [grsk].[RequestStatusKey];
                
            -- Do the Expiration check
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoBulkExpireRequest];
            
            IF(@extendedOutput >= 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT
                    [RequestKey],                           
                    [DidExpireRequest],
                    [Error]
                FROM #bulkExpireRequest
            END
        END
        
        IF(@acquiredLockBulkExpireRequest >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameBulkExpireRequest,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF(@acquiredLockBulkExpireRequest >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameBulkExpireRequest,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GenerateCompositeRequestMemberOutput]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateCompositeRequestMemberOutput]
    @requestKey	            BIGINT,
    @operation              NVARCHAR(448),
    @targetKey              BIGINT,
    @targetObjectTypeKey    SMALLINT,
    @trace                  BIT = 0
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
   
    DECLARE 
        @compositeObjectTypeKey                     SMALLINT,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @elementAttributeKey                        SMALLINT,
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @filterAttributeKey                         SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                                  BIT,
        @startTime                                  DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                                   BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @falseFlag  =   CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag   =   CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END
        
    SELECT 
        @compositeObjectTypeKey                     =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmCompositeType'),
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                 =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @elementAttributeKey                        =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmElement'),
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey                 =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember');
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.	Identify the targets.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [r].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [r]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON  [r].[ValueReference] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [r].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
            AND [r].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeObjectTypeKey
            AND [r].[AttributeKey] = @elementAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
   		
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Element') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Element;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [o].[ObjectKey] AS [TargetKey],
            [o].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [TargetTypeKey]
        INTO #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Element
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [r]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON  [r].[ValueReference] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [r].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
            AND [r].[ObjectTypeKey] = @compositeObjectTypeKey
            AND [r].[AttributeKey] = @elementAttributeKey
        ORDER BY
                [o].[ObjectKey] ASC,
                [o].[ObjectTypeKey] ASC
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@elementAttributeKey = 252, @compositeObjectTypeKey = 37));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GenerateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Element]
        ON #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Element
        (
            [TargetKey],
            [TargetTypeKey]
        ); 

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.	Identify any new explicit members.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Element AS [target]
                ON  [ro].[ObjectKey] = [target].[TargetKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [target].[TargetTypeKey]
            WHERE   
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey] AS [TargetKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [TargetTypeKey],
                [ro].[ValueReference] AS [MemberKey]
            INTO #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Element AS [target]
                ON  [ro].[ObjectKey] = [target].[TargetKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [target].[TargetTypeKey]
            WHERE   
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            ORDER BY 
                [ro].[ObjectKey] ASC,
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] ASC,
                [ro].[ValueReference] ASC
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GenerateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New]
            ON #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New
            (
                [TargetKey],
                [TargetTypeKey],
                [MemberKey]
            ); 
        
            IF @operation = N'Put'
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [new].[TargetKey]
                    FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New AS [new]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                        ON  [new].[TargetKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [new].[TargetTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                        AND [new].[MemberKey] = [existing].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE   [existing].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [new]
                    FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New AS [new]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                        ON  [new].[TargetKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [new].[TargetTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                        AND [new].[MemberKey] = [existing].[ValueReference]
                    WHERE   [existing].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
                END
            END
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [new].[TargetKey]
                FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New AS [new]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [new].[TargetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [new].[TargetTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [new].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
                WHERE   
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [duplicate].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [new]
                FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New AS [new]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [new].[TargetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [new].[TargetTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [new].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
                WHERE   
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [duplicate].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
            END
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [new].[TargetKey]
                FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New AS [new]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference] WITH (ROWLOCK, XLOCK)
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [ObjectTypeKey],
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference],
                    [Deleted]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [new].[TargetKey],
                    [new].[TargetTypeKey],
                    @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                    [new].[MemberKey],
                    @falseFlag
                FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_New AS [new]
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
            END
        END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.	Identify any removed explicit members.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	        
        IF @operation = N'Put'
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Element AS [target]
                ON  [ro].[ObjectKey] = [target].[TargetKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [target].[TargetTypeKey]
            WHERE   
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Old') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Old;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey] AS [TargetKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [TargetTypeKey],
                [ro].[ValueReference] AS [MemberKey]
            INTO #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Old
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Element AS [target]
                ON  [ro].[ObjectKey] = [target].[TargetKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [target].[TargetTypeKey]
            WHERE   
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            ORDER BY 
                [ro].[ObjectKey] ASC,
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] ASC,
                [ro].[ValueReference] ASC
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
            
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GenerateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Old]
            ON #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Old
            (
                [TargetKey],
                [TargetTypeKey],
                [MemberKey]
            ); 
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [old].[TargetKey]
                FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Old AS [old]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [old].[TargetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [old].[TargetTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [old].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
                WHERE   
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [duplicate].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [old]
                FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Old AS [old]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
                    ON  [old].[TargetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [old].[TargetTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [old].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
                WHERE   
                        [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [duplicate].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [old].[TargetKey]
                FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Old AS [old]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference] WITH (ROWLOCK, XLOCK)
                (
                    [RequestKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [ObjectTypeKey],
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference],
                    [Deleted]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @requestKey,
                    [old].[TargetKey],
                    [old].[TargetTypeKey],
                    @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                    [old].[MemberKey],
                    @trueFlag
                FROM #generateCompositeRequestMemberOutput_Old AS [old]
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
            END
        END
    END    
 
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GenerateCompositeRequestMemberOutput';
    END
END
GO

--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionSQL] 
    @membershipConditionKey                 INT,
    @immutableAttributeSelectionString      NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey                 SMALLINT        = NULL,
    @createdTimeAttributeKeyString          NVARCHAR(16)    = NULL,
    @sql                                    NVARCHAR(MAX)           OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey        SMALLINT,
        @index                          INT,
        @limit                          INT,
        @membershipConditionKeyString   NVARCHAR(32),
        @notObjectKey                   BIT,
        @objectKey                      BIGINT,
        @objectKeyString                NVARCHAR(64),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey         SMALLINT,
        @statementKey                   INT,
        @statementSQL                   NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @topStatement                   BIT,
        @trueFlag                       BIT,
        @falseFlag                      BIT;
        
    SELECT
        @trueFlag                       =   CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @falseFlag                      =   CONVERT(BIT,0);
        
    DECLARE @statement  TABLE
    (
        [Index]         INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(0,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        [StatementKey]  INT
    );
    
    SELECT
        @membershipConditionKeyString   =   CAST(@membershipConditionKey AS NVARCHAR(32)),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey         =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
        @objectKey                      =   [fim].[GetMembershipConditionObjectKey](@membershipConditionKey),
        @notObjectKey                   =   @falseFlag;
        
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END
        
    IF @createdTimeAttributeKeyString IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime');
        SELECT @createdTimeAttributeKeyString = CAST(@createdTimeAttributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16));
    END

    IF @objectKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF @objectKey < 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT 
                @notObjectKey           =   @trueFlag,
                @objectKey              =   @objectKey * -1;
        END
        
        SELECT @objectKeyString         = 
            CASE
                WHEN @notObjectKey = @trueFlag THEN N' != '
                ELSE N' = '
            END + 
            CAST(@objectKey AS NVARCHAR(64));
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        WHERE        [statement].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @statement
        (
            [StatementKey]
        )
        SELECT [mcs].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
            ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            ON [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        WHERE
                [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
            AND (
                        [mcs].[AttributeKey] NOT IN
                        (
                            @identifierAttributeKey,
                            @objectTypeAttributeKey
                        )
                    OR  [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
                )
        ORDER BY [ai].[Selectivity] DESC;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [statement]
        WHERE        [statement].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @statement
        (
            [StatementKey]
        )
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [statement]
        WHERE        [statement].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
    END
    
/*
    At creation time, 
    all resources for which specified statements are true.  
    
    Sample output: 

SELECT DISTINCT [60955].[ObjectKey]
FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [60955]
WHERE
        [60955].[AttributeKey] = 53
    AND
        [60955].[ObjectTypeKey] = 19
    AND [60955].[ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [69614].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [69614]
            WHERE
                    [69614].[ObjectKey] = 209848
                AND [69614].[ObjectTypeKey] = 29
                AND [69614].[AttributeKey] = 24
        )
*/ 
    SELECT
        @index = 0,
        @limit = NULL,
        @topStatement = 0;
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[Index]
        FROM @statement AS [statement]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @limit = MAX([statement].[Index])
        FROM @statement AS [statement];
    END
    
    SELECT @sql =                                                                               N'
SELECT [*].[ObjectKey]'                                                                         + N'
FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [*]'                                                        + N'
WHERE [*].[AttributeKey] = ' + @createdTimeAttributeKeyString                                   + 
        CASE
            WHEN
                (
                        @objectKeyString IS NOT NULL
                    OR  @immutableAttributeSelectionString IS NOT NULL
                    OR  @limit IS NOT NULL                       
                )THEN                                                                           N'
    AND '
            ELSE                                                                                N''
        END                                                                                     +
        CASE
            WHEN(@objectKeyString IS NOT NULL)THEN                                              N'
        [*].[ObjectKey]' + @objectKeyString                                                     + 
                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                            @immutableAttributeSelectionString IS NOT NULL
                        OR  @limit IS NOT NULL
                    )THEN                                                                       N'
    AND '
                    ELSE                                                                        N''
                END
            ELSE                                                                                N''
        END                                                                                     +
        CASE 
            WHEN @immutableAttributeSelectionString IS NOT NULL THEN                            N'
        ' + @immutableAttributeSelectionString                                                  +
                CASE
                    WHEN @limit IS NOT NULL THEN                                                N'
    AND '
                    ELSE                                                                        N''
                END
            ELSE                                                                                N''
        END;
        
    IF @limit IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        WHILE(@index <= @limit)
        BEGIN
            
            SELECT @statementKey = [statement].[StatementKey]
            FROM @statement AS [statement]
            WHERE   [statement].[Index] = @index;
                    
            IF @index = @limit
            BEGIN
                SELECT @topStatement = 1
            END
            
            EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementSQL] 
                @statementKey                       = @statementKey,
                @topStatement                       = @topStatement,
                @otherStatementsSQL                 = @statementSQL,
                @identifierAttributeKey             = @identifierAttributeKey,
                @objectTypeAttributeKey             = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
                @createdTimeAttributeKeyString      = @createdTimeAttributeKeyString,
                @immutableAttributeSelectionString  = @immutableAttributeSelectionString,
                @sql                                = @statementSQL OUTPUT;
                
            SELECT @index = @index + 1;
        END
        
        SELECT @sql = @sql                                                                  + N'/*<BR>*/
        [*].[ObjectKey] IN'                                                                 + N'/*<BR>*/
        ('                                                                                  + N'/*<BR>*/
            ' + @statementSQL                                                               + N'/*<BR>*/
        )';
   END 
    
    SELECT @sql = 
        REPLACE(@sql,'[*]',N'[' + @membershipConditionKeyString + N']');        
END
GO

--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementDereferencedMembershipConditionSQL]
    @dereferencingStatementKeyString            NVARCHAR(32),
    @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey         INT,
    @dereferencedAttributeKey                   SMALLINT,
    @sql							            NVARCHAR(MAX)	        OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @count                                                  INT,
        @dereferencedAttributeKeyString                         NVARCHAR(16),
        @dereferencedMembershipConditionKeyString               NVARCHAR(32),
        @dereferencedResourceIdentifier                         BIGINT,
        @dereferencedResourceIdentifierString                   NVARCHAR(64),
        @dereferencedResourceTypeString                         NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @messageText                                            NVARCHAR(MAX);
	
	IF @dereferencingStatementKeyString IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'dereferencingStatementKeyString');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	IF @dereferencedAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'dereferencedAttributeKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	IF @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'dereferencedMembershipConditionKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	SELECT @dereferencedResourceIdentifier = 
	    [fim].[GetMembershipConditionObjectKey](@dereferencedMembershipConditionKey);
	    
	IF @dereferencedResourceIdentifier IS NULL
	OR @dereferencedResourceIdentifier < 0
	BEGIN
	    SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidMembershipConditionStatementDereferencedValueException]();
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;   
	END
	
	SELECT 
	    @dereferencedAttributeKeyString = CAST(@dereferencedAttributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16)),
	    @dereferencedMembershipConditionKeyString = CAST(@dereferencedMembershipConditionKey AS NVARCHAR(32)),
	    @dereferencedResourceIdentifierString = CAST(@dereferencedResourceIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(64)),
	    @dereferencedResourceTypeString = [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionImmutableAttributeSQL](@dereferencedMembershipConditionKey);
	    
	IF @dereferencedResourceTypeString IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
	    SELECT @dereferencedResourceTypeString = 
	        REPLACE(@dereferencedResourceTypeString,'[*]',N'[' + @dereferencedMembershipConditionKeyString + N']');
	END
	
/*
    At creation time, 
    the value of a given attribute of a resource.  
    
    Sample output: 

SELECT [69614].[ValueReference]
FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [69614]
WHERE
        [69614].[ObjectKey] = 209848
    AND [69614].[ObjectTypeKey] = 29
    AND [69614].[AttributeKey] = 24
    
*/ 
		
		
	SELECT @sql =                                                                             N'
SELECT [*].[ValueReference]'                                                                + N'/*<BR>*/
FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [*]'                                                   + N'/*<BR>*/
WHERE'                                                                                      + N'/*<BR>*/
        [*].[ObjectKey] = ' + @dereferencedResourceIdentifierString                         + 
        CASE
            WHEN @dereferencedResourceTypeString IS NOT NULL THEN                             N'/*<BR>*/
    AND ' + @dereferencedResourceTypeString                                             
            ELSE                                                                              N''
        END                                                                                 + N'/*<BR>*/
    AND [*].[AttributeKey] = ' + @dereferencedAttributeKeyString;                                                         
		
	SELECT @sql = REPLACE(@sql,'[*]',N'[' + @dereferencedMembershipConditionKeyString + N']');
		
END
GO

--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementDereferencedValueSQL]
    @statementKeyString						    NVARCHAR(32),
    @attributeKey                               SMALLINT,
    @negativeStatement                          BIT,
    @dereferencedAttributeKey                   SMALLINT,
	@dereferencedMembershipConditionKey         INT,
	@distinctString                             NVARCHAR(16)    = N'',
	@otherStatementsSQL                         NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
	@immutableAttributeSelectionString          NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
	@attributeKeyString                         NVARCHAR(16)    = NULL,
	@identifierAttributeKey                     SMALLINT        = NULL,
	@objectTypeAttributeKey                     SMALLINT        = NULL,
	@sql							            NVARCHAR(MAX)	        OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @dereferencedValueSQL               NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    IF @statementKeyString IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'statementKeyString');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	IF @negativeStatement IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'negativeStatement');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	IF @attributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'attributeKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	IF @dereferencedAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'dereferencedAttributeKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	IF @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'dereferencedMembershipConditionKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	IF @attributeKeyString IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @attributeKeyString = CAST(@attributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16));
	END
	
	IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
	END
	
	IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
	END
	
	IF
    (
        SELECT COUNT([mcmcs].[StatementKey])
        FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
        WHERE
                [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey
    ) > 2
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [mcs].[AttributeKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcmcs]
            ON [mcs].[StatementKey] = [mcmcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [mcmcs].[MembershipConditionKey] = @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey
            AND [mcs].[AttributeKey] NOT IN
            (
                @identifierAttributeKey,
                @objectTypeAttributeKey
            )
    )
	BEGIN
	    SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidMembershipConditionStatementDereferencedValueException]();
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementDereferencedMembershipConditionSQL]
        @dereferencingStatementKeyString            = @statementKeyString,
        @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey         = @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey,
        @dereferencedAttributeKey                   = @dereferencedAttributeKey,
	    @sql                                        = @dereferencedValueSQL OUTPUT;
	    
	EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementDereferencingStatementSQL]
        @statementKeyString	                        = @statementKeyString,
	    @attributeKey                               = @attributeKey,
	    @negativeStatement                          = @negativeStatement,
	    @dereferencedValueSQL                       = @dereferencedValueSQL,
	    @distinctString                             = @distinctString,
	    @attributeKeyString                         = @attributeKeyString,
	    @identifierAttributeKey                     = @identifierAttributeKey,
	    @immutableAttributeSelectionString          = @immutableAttributeSelectionString,
	    @otherStatementsSQL                         = @otherStatementsSQL,
	    @sql                                        = @sql OUTPUT;

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementDereferencingStatementSQL]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementDereferencingStatementSQL]
    @statementKeyString                            NVARCHAR(36),
    @attributeKey                               SMALLINT,
    @negativeStatement                          BIT,
    @dereferencedValueSQL                       NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @distinctString                             NVARCHAR(16)    = N'',
    @attributeKeyString                         NVARCHAR(16)    = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey                     SMALLINT        = NULL,
    @immutableAttributeSelectionString                  NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
    @otherStatementsSQL                         NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
    @sql                                        NVARCHAR(MAX)            OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @bodySQL                            NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @frameworkSQL                       NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @notSQL                             NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @inString                           NVARCHAR(8),
        @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    IF @statementKeyString IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'statementKeyString');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @negativeStatement IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'negativeStatement');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @attributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'attributeKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @dereferencedValueSQL IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'dereferencedValueSQL');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END
    
    IF @attributeKeyString IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @attributeKeyString = CAST(@attributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16));
    END
    
    SELECT @inString = 
        CASE
            WHEN(@negativeStatement = 1)THEN N'NOT '
            ELSE N''
        END + 
        N'IN';

    
/*
    At creation time, 
    all resources of which the value of a given attribute matches the values of other selected resources.  
    
    Sample output: 

SELECT [60955].[ObjectKey]
FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [60955]
WHERE
        [60955].[ObjectTypeKey] = 19
    AND [60955].[AttributeKey] = 140
    AND [60955].[ValueReference] IN
        (
            SELECT [69614].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [69614]
            WHERE
                    [69614].[ObjectKey] = 209848
                AND [69614].[ObjectTypeKey] = 29
                AND [69614].[AttributeKey] = 24
        )
        
    If @attributeKey = @identifierAttributeKey then, the output will rather be like this: 
  
SELECT [60955].[ObjectKey]
FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [60955]
WHERE
        [60955].[ObjectTypeKey] = 19
    AND [60955].[AttributeKey] = 53 --CreatedTime attribute key
    AND [60955].[ValueReference] = [60955].[ObjectKey]
    AND [60955].[ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [69614].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [69614]
            WHERE
                    [69614].[ObjectKey] = 209848
                AND [69614].[ObjectTypeKey] = 29
                AND [69614].[AttributeKey] = 24
        )  
        
*/ 
    SELECT @frameworkSQL =                                                                                  N'
SELECT ' + @distinctString + ' [*].[ObjectKey]'                                                             + N'/*<BR>*/
FROM '                                                                                                      + 
    CASE
        WHEN @attributeKey = @identifierAttributeKey THEN                                                   N'
            [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] '
        ELSE                                                                                                N'
            [fim].[ObjectValueReference] '
    END                                                                                                     + N'
    AS [*] '                                                                                                + N'/*<BR>*/
WHERE'                                                                                                      +
        CASE
            WHEN @immutableAttributeSelectionString IS NOT NULL THEN                                        N'/*<BR>*/
            ' + @immutableAttributeSelectionString                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/
        AND '
            ELSE                                                                                            N''
        END                                                                                                 + N'/*<BR>*/
            ('                                                                                              + N'/*<BR>*/
                --BODY-- '                                                                                  + N'/*<BR>*/
            )'                                                                                              + 
        CASE
            WHEN @otherStatementsSQL IS NOT NULL THEN                                                       N'/*<BR>*/
        AND [*].[ObjectKey] IN'                                                                             + N'/*<BR>*/
            ('                                                                                              + N'/*<BR>*/
                ' + @otherStatementsSQL                                                                     + N'/*<BR>*/
            )'
            ELSE                                                                                            N''
        END;                                                                                                 
        
        
    SELECT @bodySQL =                                                                                       
        CASE
            WHEN @negativeStatement = 1 AND @attributeKey != @identifierAttributeKey THEN                   N'/*<BR>*/
                    [*].[AttributeKey] = ' + @attributeKeyString                                            + N'/*<BR>*/
                AND [*].[ObjectKey] ' + @inString                                                           + N'/*<BR>*/
                    ('                                                                                      + N'/*<BR>*/
                        SELECT [*match].[ObjectKey]'                                                        + N'/*<BR>*/
                        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [*match]'                                      + N'/*<BR>*/
                        WHERE'                                                                              + N'/*<BR>*/
                                [*match].[ObjectTypeKey] = [*].[ObjectTypeKey]'                             + N'/*<BR>*/
                            AND [*match].[AttributeKey] = ' + @attributeKeyString                           + N'/*<BR>*/
                            AND [*match].[ValueReference] IN'                                               + N'/*<BR>*/
                                ('                                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/ 
                                    ' + @dereferencedValueSQL                                               + N'/*<BR>*/ 
                                )'                                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/ 
                    )'                                                                                          
            ELSE                                                                                            N'/*<BR>*/
                ('                                                                                          + 
                CASE
                    WHEN @attributeKey != @identifierAttributeKey THEN                                      N'/*<BR>*/
                        [*].[AttributeKey] = ' + @attributeKeyString                                        + N'/*<BR>*/
                    AND [*].[ValueReference] '
                    ELSE                                                                                    N'
                        [*].[ObjectKey] = [*].[ObjectKey]'                                                 + N'/*<BR>*/
                    AND [*].[ObjectKey] '
                END 
                    + @inString                                                                             + N'/*<BR>*/
                    ('                                                                                      + N'
                        ' + @dereferencedValueSQL                                                           + N'/*<BR>*/
                    )'                                                                                      + N'/*<BR>*/
                )'                                                                                          
        END;                                                                                                 
        
    SELECT @sql = REPLACE(@frameworkSQL,'--BODY--',@bodySQL);
    
    IF @negativeStatement = 1 AND @attributeKey != @identifierAttributeKey 
    BEGIN
        SELECT @notSQL =                                                                                    N'/*<BR>*/
                ('                                                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/
                    [*].[ObjectKey] NOT IN '                                                                + N'/*<BR>*/
                    ('                                                                                      + N'/*<BR>*/
                        SELECT [*missing].[ObjectKey]'                                                      + N'/*<BR>*/
                        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [*missing]'                                    + N'/*<BR>*/
                        WHERE'                                                                              + 
                CASE
                    WHEN @immutableAttributeSelectionString IS NOT NULL THEN                                N'/*<BR>*/                                        
                                ' + REPLACE(@immutableAttributeSelectionString,N'[*]',N'[*missing]')        + N'/*<BR>*/
                            AND '
                    ELSE                                                                                    N''
                    END                                                                                     + N'/*<BR>*/    
                                [*missing].[AttributeKey] = ' + @attributeKeyString                         + N'/*<BR>*/
                    )'                                                                                      + N'/*<BR>*/
                )';  
        
        SELECT @sql = @sql                                                                                  + N'/*<BR>*/
UNION ALL'                                                                                                  + N'/*<BR>*/' +
            REPLACE(@frameworkSQL,'--BODY--',@notSQL);

    END                                                                                        
        
    SELECT @sql = REPLACE(@sql,'[*',N'[' + @statementKeyString);
    
    SELECT @sql =                                                                                           N'
('                                                                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/' +
    @sql                                                                                                    + N'
)'
  

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementNegativeLiteralValueSQL]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementNegativeLiteralValueSQL] 
    @statementKey                               INT,
    @attributeKeyString                         NVARCHAR(16),
    @valueTableName                             NVARCHAR(128),
    @missingValue                               BIT             = 0,
    @distinctString                             NVARCHAR(16)    = N'',
    @statementKeyString                         NVARCHAR(36)    = NULL,
    @otherStatementsSQL                         NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
    @createdTimeAttributeKeyString              NVARCHAR(16)    = NULL,
    @immutableAttributeSelectionString                  NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
    @sql                                        NVARCHAR(MAX)	        OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey                SMALLINT,
        @messageText                            NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @positiveCounterpartStatementKeyString  NVARCHAR(32);
    
    IF @statementKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'statementKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @attributeKeyString IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'attributeKeyString');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @valueTableName IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'valueTableName');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @createdTimeAttributeKeyString IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime');
        SELECT @createdTimeAttributeKeyString = CAST(@createdTimeAttributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16));
    END
    
    IF @statementKeyString IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @statementKeyString = CAST(@statementKey AS NVARCHAR(32));
    END
    
    SELECT @positiveCounterpartStatementKeyString = CAST([mcns].[PositiveStatementKey] AS NVARCHAR(32))
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement] AS [mcns]
    WHERE
            [mcns].[NegativeStatementKey] = @statementKey;
    
    IF @positiveCounterpartStatementKeyString IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'statementKey');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
/*
    At creation time, 
    all resources for which the positive counterpart of a negative statement is not
    true.  
    
    Sample output: 

SELECT DISTINCT [60955n].[ObjectKey]
FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [60955n]
WHERE
        [60955n].[ObjectTypeKey] = 19
    AND [60955n].[AttributeKey] = 140
    AND [60955n].[ObjectKey] NOT IN
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT [60954].[ResourceKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [60954]
            WHERE
                    [60954].[StatementKey] = 60954
        )
    
*/    
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementPositiveLiteralValueSQL] 
        @statementKeyString                     = @positiveCounterpartStatementKeyString,
        @distinctString                         = N'',
        @otherStatementsSQL                     = NULL,
        @sql                                    = @sql OUTPUT;	
        
    SELECT @sql =                                                                           N'/*<BR>*/
SELECT ' + @distinctString + ' [*n].[ObjectKey]'                                            + N'/*<BR>*/
FROM [fim].' + 
        CASE
            WHEN @missingValue = 0 THEN @valueTableName
            ELSE N'[ObjectValueDateTime]'
        END + 
        N' AS [*n]'                                                                         + N'/*<BR>*/
WHERE'                                                                                      + 
        CASE
            WHEN @immutableAttributeSelectionString IS NOT NULL THEN                        N'/*<BR>*/
            ' + REPLACE(@immutableAttributeSelectionString,N'[*]',N'[*n]')                  + N'/*<BR>*/
    AND '
        ELSE                                                                                N''
        END                                                                                 +
        CASE
            WHEN @missingValue = 0 THEN                                                     N'/*<BR>*/
        [*n].[AttributeKey] = ' + @attributeKeyString                                       
            ELSE                                                                            N'/*<BR>*/
        [*n].[AttributeKey] = ' + @createdTimeAttributeKeyString                            
        END                                                                                 + N'/*<BR>*/
    AND [*n].[ObjectKey] NOT IN'                                                            + N'/*<BR>*/
        ('                                                                                  + N'/*<BR>*/
            ' + @sql                                                                        + N'/*<BR>*/
        )'                                                                                  +
        CASE
            WHEN(@otherStatementsSQL IS NOT NULL)THEN                                       N'/*<BR>*/
    AND [*n].[ObjectKey] IN'                                                                + N'/*<BR>*/
        ('                                                                                  + N'/*<BR>*/
            ' + @otherStatementsSQL                                                         + N'/*<BR>*/
        )'
        ELSE                                                                                N''
        END;
    
        SELECT @sql = REPLACE(@sql, N'[*' ,N'[' + @statementKeyString);
     
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementPositiveLiteralValueSQL]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
