--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementPositiveLiteralValueSQL] 
	@statementKeyString						    NVARCHAR(36),
	@distinctString                             NVARCHAR(16)    = N'',
	@otherStatementsSQL                         NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
	@sql							            NVARCHAR(MAX)	        OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	DECLARE @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX);
	
	IF @statementKeyString IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'statementKeyString');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
/*
    At creation time, 
    all resources for which a positive statement is true.  
    
    Sample output: 

SELECT DISTINCT [60955].[ResourceKey]
FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [60955]
WHERE
        [60955].[StatementKey] = 60955
    
*/    
        
           
    SELECT @sql =                    												        N'/*<BR>*/
SELECT ' + @distinctString + ' [*].[ResourceKey]'                                           + N'/*<BR>*/
FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [*]'                                     + N'/*<BR>*/
WHERE'                                                                                      + N'/*<BR>*/
        [*].[StatementKey] = ' + @statementKeyString                                        +
        CASE 
            WHEN @otherStatementsSQL IS NOT NULL THEN                                       N'/*<BR>*/
    AND [*].[ResourceKey] IN'                                                               + N'/*<BR>*/
        ('                                                                                  + N'/*<BR>*/
            ' + @otherStatementsSQL                                                         + N'/*<BR>*/
        )'
            ELSE                                                                            N''
        END;                                      

    SELECT @sql = REPLACE(@sql,'[*]',N'[' + @statementKeyString + N']');

  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementSQL]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementSQL] 
	@statementKey							            INT,
	@topStatement                                       BIT             = 0,
	@otherStatementsSQL                                 NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL, 
	@identifierAttributeKey                             SMALLINT        = NULL,
	@objectTypeAttributeKey                             SMALLINT        = NULL,
	@createdTimeAttributeKeyString                      NVARCHAR(16)    = NULL,
	@immutableAttributeSelectionString                  NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
	@sql           							            NVARCHAR(MAX)	        OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE 
	    @attributeDataTypeName              NVARCHAR(64),
	    @attributeKey                       SMALLINT,
	    @attributeKeyString                 NVARCHAR(16),
	    @dereferencedAttributeKey           SMALLINT,
	    @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey INT,
	    @distinctString                     NVARCHAR(16),
	    @identifierAttributeKeyString       NVARCHAR(16),
	    @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
	    @missingValue                       BIT,
	    @missingValueSQL                    NVARCHAR(MAX),
	    @negativeStatement                  BIT,
	    @statementKeyString                 NVARCHAR(32),
	    @valueTableName                     NVARCHAR(128);
	    
	IF @statementKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'statementKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END
	
	IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
	END
	
	IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
	END
	
	SELECT
	    @attributeKey                   = [mcs].[AttributeKey],
	    @missingValue                   = [mcs].[MissingValue],
	    @negativeStatement              = [mcs].[OperatorInversion],
	    @dereferencedAttributeKey       = [mcs].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey],
	    @attributeDataTypeName          = [ai].[DataType]
	FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
	INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
	    ON [mcs].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
	WHERE
	        [mcs].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
	        
	IF @attributeKey IS NULL
	OR @negativeStatement IS NULL
	OR @attributeDataTypeName IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'statementKey');
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
	END    
	
	SELECT 
	    @attributeKeyString = CAST(@attributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16)),
	    @distinctString =   CASE
	                            WHEN @topStatement = 1 THEN N'DISTINCT'
	                            ELSE N''
	                        END,
	    @identifierAttributeKeyString = CAST(@identifierAttributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16)),
	    @statementKeyString = CAST(@statementKey AS NVARCHAR(32)),
	    @valueTableName = N'[ObjectValue' + @attributeDataTypeName + N']';

	
	IF @dereferencedAttributeKey IS NULL
	BEGIN
	    IF @negativeStatement = 1
	    BEGIN
	        EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementNegativeLiteralValueSQL] 
	            @statementKey                       = @statementKey,
                @attributeKeyString                 = @attributeKeyString,
                @valueTableName                     = @valueTableName,
	            @missingValue                       = @missingValue,
	            @distinctString                     = @distinctString,
	            @statementKeyString	                = @statementKeyString,
	            @otherStatementsSQL                 = @otherStatementsSQL,
	            @createdTimeAttributeKeyString      = @createdTimeAttributeKeyString,
	            @immutableAttributeSelectionString  = @immutableAttributeSelectionString,
	            @sql							    = @sql OUTPUT;
	    END
	    ELSE
	    BEGIN
	        EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementPositiveLiteralValueSQL] 
	            @statementKeyString                     = @statementKeyString,
	            @distinctString                         = @distinctString,
	            @otherStatementsSQL                     = @otherStatementsSQL,
	            @sql                                    = @sql OUTPUT;	    
	    END
	END 
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	    SELECT @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey = [mcdv].[MembershipConditionKey]
	    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionDereferencedValue] AS [mcdv]
	    WHERE
	            [mcdv].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
	            
	    IF @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey IS NULL
	    BEGIN
		    SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'statementKey');
		    RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		    RETURN;
	    END 
	    
	    EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionStatementDereferencedValueSQL]
            @statementKeyString                 = @statementKeyString,
            @attributeKey                       = @attributeKey,
            @negativeStatement                  = @negativeStatement,
            @dereferencedAttributeKey           = @dereferencedAttributeKey,
	        @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey = @dereferencedMembershipConditionKey,
	        @distinctString                     = @distinctString,
	        @otherStatementsSQL                 = @otherStatementsSQL,
	        @immutableAttributeSelectionString  = @immutableAttributeSelectionString,
	        @attributeKeyString                 = @attributeKeyString,
	        @identifierAttributeKey             = @identifierAttributeKey,
	        @objectTypeAttributeKey             = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
	        @sql	                            = @sql OUTPUT;
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GenerateRequestComputedMemberOutput]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateRequestComputedMemberOutput]
    @requestKey                        BIGINT,
    @operation                      NVARCHAR(448),
    @targetKey                      BIGINT,
    @targetTypeKey                  SMALLINT,
    @trueFlag                       BIT             = NULL,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey     SMALLINT        = NULL,
    @identifierAttributeKey         SMALLINT        = NULL,
    @trace                          BIT             = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @computedMemberAttributeKeyString               NVARCHAR(16),
        @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName                NVARCHAR(16),
        @index                                          INT,
        @limit                                          INT,
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName      NVARCHAR(32),
        @membershipConditionKey                         INT,
        @membershipConditionSQL                         NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @immutableAttributeSelectionString                      NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @requestKeyString                               NVARCHAR(64),
        @requestSetFilterSQL                            NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @targetKeyString                                NVARCHAR(64),
        @targetTypeKeyString                            NVARCHAR(16),
        @setFilterSQL                                   NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @startTime                                      DATETIME;        
        
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT 
        @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName            =   [fim].[GetFilterSQLAncillaryParameterName](),
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName  =   [fim].[GetMembershipConditionAncillaryParameterName]();
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR
    (
        @operation != N'Create'
        AND @operation != N'Put'
    )
    OR @targetKey IS NULL
    OR @targetTypeKey IS NULL
    OR 
    (
        NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rap].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
            WHERE
                    [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [smc].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] aS [smc]
            WHERE        [smc].[SetKey] = @targetKey
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectKey');
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Determine the computed members.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    EXECUTE [fim].[OptimizeSetMembershipConditions]
        @requestKey    = @requestKey,
        @setKey = @targetKey,
        @trace = @trace;
     
    EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateSetFilterSQL]
        @setKey                         = @targetKey,
        @setTypeKey                     = @targetTypeKey,
        @requestKey                     = @requestKey,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey     = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
        @identifierAttributeKey         = @identifierAttributeKey,
        @requestSetFilterSQL            = @requestSetFilterSQL OUTPUT,
        @setFilterSQL                   = @setFilterSQL OUTPUT;
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ancillaryParameter].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [ancillaryParameter]
        WHERE
                [ancillaryParameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ancillaryParameter].[Name] = @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName
    )
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter]
        SET [Value] = @setFilterSQL
        WHERE
                [RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [Name] = @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [Name],
            [Value]
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @requestKey,
            @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName,
            @setFilterSQL
        );
    END
    
    --to fix too many negative conditions exception we add hint 'OPTION (FORCE ORDER)' 
    --if 'NOT IN' conditions are more than 7 and if we have system property 'AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7' equals 'True'    
    DECLARE @systemPropertyAddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 NVARCHAR(64),
            @AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @lenNOTIN SMALLINT,
            @countNegativeConditions SMALLINT,
            @sqlWithoutNOTIN NVARCHAR(MAX);
             
    SELECT @systemPropertyAddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 = N'AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7';
    
    SELECT  @AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 = [fim].[GetSystemProperty](@systemPropertyAddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7);
    
    IF 
    (
			@AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 IS NOT NULL
		AND @AddHintWhenNegativeConditionsMoreThan7 = N'True'
	)
	BEGIN	    
	    SELECT @lenNOTIN = 6; --LEN('NOT IN') 
	    SELECT @countNegativeConditions = 7;
	    SELECT @sqlWithoutNOTIN = REPLACE(@requestSetFilterSQL, N'NOT IN', N'');
	    
	    --negative condition transforms into 'NOT IN' in the SQL statement
		--we find the difference between SQL statement and SQL statement without 'NOT IN', divide it by the length 'NOT IN', to count number of negative conditions
		--if the number is greater than 7 we add hint
		IF 
		(			
			(LEN(@requestSetFilterSQL)-LEN(@sqlWithoutNOTIN))/@lenNOTIN > @countNegativeConditions
		)
		BEGIN
			IF 
			(
				RIGHT(@requestSetFilterSQL, 1 )= N';' 
			)	
			BEGIN
				SELECT @requestSetFilterSQL = LEFT(@requestSetFilterSQL, LEN(@requestSetFilterSQL) - 1) + N' OPTION (FORCE ORDER);';
			END   
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				SELECT @requestSetFilterSQL = @requestSetFilterSQL + N' OPTION (FORCE ORDER);';  
			END  
		END 
    END
    --end fix

    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
    (
        [RequestKey],
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference],
        [Deleted]
    )
    EXECUTE sp_executesql @requestSetFilterSQL;      
             
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GenerateRequestComputedMemberOutput';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GenerateRequestFilterOutput]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateRequestFilterOutput]
    @requestKey	            BIGINT,
    @operation              NVARCHAR(448),
    @targetKey              BIGINT,
    @targetObjectTypeKey    SMALLINT,
    @trace                  BIT = 0
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @compositeObjectTypeKey                     SMALLINT,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @filterAttributeKey                         SMALLINT,
        @identifierAttributeKey                     SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                                  BIT,
        @index                                      INT,
        @limit                                      INT,
        @messageText                                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName  NVARCHAR(32),
        @membershipConditionKey                     INT,
        @startTime                                  DATETIME,
        @subSectionStartTime                        DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                                   BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @falseFlag  =   CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag   =   CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
        SELECT @subSectionStartTime = @startTime;
    END
        
    SELECT 
        @compositeObjectTypeKey                     =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmCompositeType'),
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                 =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @explicitMemberAttributeKey                 =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember'),
        @filterAttributeKey                         =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Filter'),
        @identifierAttributeKey                     =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName  =   [fim].[GetMembershipConditionAncillaryParameterName]();
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.	Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    IF @requestKey IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            
    )
    OR @operation IS NULL
    OR
    (
        @operation != N'Create'
        AND @operation != N'Put'
    )
    OR @targetKey IS NULL
    OR @targetObjectTypeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @targetObjectTypeKey = @compositeObjectTypeKey
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateCompositeRequestMemberOutput]
            @requestKey	            = @requestKey,
            @operation              = @operation,
            @targetKey              = @targetKey,
            @targetObjectTypeKey    = @targetObjectTypeKey,
            @trace                  = @trace;
            
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rap].[Name]
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] as [rap]
        WHERE 
                [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rap].[Name] = N'SetCorrection'
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidDataException](N'RequestOutputReference');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @subSectionStartTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GenerateRequestFilterOutput-A';
            
        SELECT @subSectionStartTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.	Cache any new explicit members.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
    )
    BEGIN		
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @targetKey  AS N'SetKey',
            @targetObjectTypeKey AS N'SetTypeKey',
            [ro].[ValueReference] AS N'MemberKey'
        INTO #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        ORDER BY [ro].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GenerateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember]
        ON #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember
        (
            [SetKey],
            [SetTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        ); 
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @subSectionStartTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GenerateRequestFilterOutput-B';
            
        SELECT @subSectionStartTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.	Determine the computed members.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/		
    IF
    (
        @operation = N'Create'
        OR @operation = N'Put'
    )
    AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rap].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
        WHERE
                [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateRequestComputedMemberOutput]
            @requestKey                     = @requestKey,
            @operation                      = @operation,
            @targetKey                      = @targetKey,
            @targetTypeKey                  = @targetObjectTypeKey,
            @trueFlag                       = @trueFlag,
            @computedMemberAttributeKey     = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
            @identifierAttributeKey         = @identifierAttributeKey,
            @trace                          = @trace;
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @subSectionStartTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GenerateRequestFilterOutput-C';
            
        SELECT @subSectionStartTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.	Handle the Explicit Members.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1	Any new explicit member is also a computed member.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1.a    If any of the new explicit members have already been added as 
 *          computed members as part of the current request, then ignore 
 *          them.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/						
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [computedMember]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [computedMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [computedMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [computedMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [computedMember].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember
            FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [computedMember]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [computedMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [computedMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [computedMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [computedMember].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1.b If any of the new explicit members are already computed members
 *       then ignore them.      
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/								
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [computedMember]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [computedMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [computedMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember 
            FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [computedMember]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [computedMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [computedMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [computedMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.1.c  Add any remaining explicit members as computed members.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/		
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[SetKey],
                [candidate].[SetTypeKey],
                @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                [candidate].[MemberKey],
                @falseFlag
            FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMember AS [candidate] 
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @subSectionStartTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GenerateRequestComputedMemberOutput-D1';
            
        SELECT @subSectionStartTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.2	Any removed explicit member of a set with no membership conditions
 *      is also removed as a computed member.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @operation = N'Put'
    AND NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rap].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
        WHERE
                [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
    )
    BEGIN
    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ValueReference]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [smc].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
            WHERE
                    [smc].[SetKey] = @targetKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                @targetKey,
                @targetObjectTypeKey,
                @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                [ro].[ValueReference],
                1
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1;
                    
        END
        
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @subSectionStartTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GenerateRequestComputedMemberOutput-D2';
            
        SELECT @subSectionStartTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END	
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.3	That any removed explicit member of a set that does not match any of 
 *      the sets membership conditions, must also be removed, is accomplished
 *      by CalculateRequestSetTransitions, via its sub-procedure, 
 *      CalculateRequestRemovedExplicitMemberSetTransitions.  However, if the 
 *      filter of the set is being modified, then any removed explicit member
 *      that has not been identified as matching the revised filter, must be
 *      removed as a computed member.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @operation = N'Put'
    AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [parameter].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [parameter]
        WHERE
                [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [parameter].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
    )
    AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN		
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateRequestFilterOutputRemovedExplicitMember') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #generateRequestFilterOutputRemovedExplicitMember;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @targetKey  AS N'SetKey',
            @targetObjectTypeKey AS N'SetTypeKey',
            [ro].[ValueReference] AS N'MemberKey'
        INTO #generateRequestFilterOutputRemovedExplicitMember
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        ORDER BY [ro].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GenerateRequestFilterOutputRemovedExplicitMember]
        ON #generateRequestFilterOutputRemovedExplicitMember
        (
            [SetKey],
            [SetTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        ); 
        
        DELETE FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputRemovedExplicitMember
        FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputRemovedExplicitMember AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
            ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            AND [candidate].[SetTypeKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [candidate].[MemberKey] = [duplicate].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
                [duplicate].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey;
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputRemovedExplicitMember AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [candidate].[SetKey],
                [candidate].[SetTypeKey],
                @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                [candidate].[MemberKey],
                @trueFlag
            FROM #generateRequestFilterOutputRemovedExplicitMember AS [candidate]
        END
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.   Update the computed member attribute values for a set of which the 
 *      filter is being altered OR MembershipConditions are changing. (Temporal
 *      events code uses MembershipConditions)
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @operation = N'Put'
    AND
    (
        EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [parameter].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [parameter]
            WHERE
                    [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [parameter].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
  
        )
        OR
        EXISTS 
        (
            -- TemporalEvents Request sets this which indicates we want to do a "diff"
            -- of existing set members vs. the result of executing the current filter 
            SELECT [rap].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
            WHERE
                    [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
        )
    )
    BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.1	Remove existing members that do not match the new filter, and which 
 *      were not explicit members.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
 
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateRequestFilterOutputOriginalExplicitMember') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #generateRequestFilterOutputOriginalExplicitMember;
        END
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @targetKey  AS N'SetKey',
            @targetObjectTypeKey AS N'SetTypeKey',
            [ov].[ValueReference] AS N'MemberKey'
        INTO #generateRequestFilterOutputOriginalExplicitMember
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ov]
        WHERE
                [ov].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
            AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
            AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
        ORDER BY [ov].[ValueReference]
        OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GenerateRequestFilterOutputOriginalExplicitMember]
        ON #generateRequestFilterOutputOriginalExplicitMember
        (
            [SetKey],
            [SetTypeKey],
            [MemberKey]
        ); 
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [existingMember].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existingMember]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [newMember]
                ON [newMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [existingMember].[ObjectKey] = [newMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [newMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = [newMember].[AttributeKey]
                AND [existingMember].[ValueReference] = [newMember].[ValueReference]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN #generateRequestFilterOutputOriginalExplicitMember AS [existingExplicitMember]
                ON [existingMember].[ObjectKey] = [existingExplicitMember].[SetKey]
                AND [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existingExplicitMember].[SetTypeKey]
                AND [existingMember].[ValueReference] = [existingExplicitMember].[MemberKey]
            WHERE
                    [existingMember].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
                AND [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
                AND [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [newMember].[RequestKey] IS NULL
                AND [existingExplicitMember].[SetKey] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
                [Deleted]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                [existingMember].[ObjectKey],
                [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey],
                @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                [existingMember].[ValueReference],
                @trueFlag
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existingMember]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [newMember]
                ON [newMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [existingMember].[ObjectKey] = [newMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [newMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = [newMember].[AttributeKey]
                AND [existingMember].[ValueReference] = [newMember].[ValueReference]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN #generateRequestFilterOutputOriginalExplicitMember AS [existingExplicitMember]
                ON [existingMember].[ObjectKey] = [existingExplicitMember].[SetKey]
                AND [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existingExplicitMember].[SetTypeKey]
                AND [existingMember].[ValueReference] = [existingExplicitMember].[MemberKey]
            WHERE
                    [existingMember].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
                AND [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
                AND [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [newMember].[RequestKey] IS NULL
                AND [existingExplicitMember].[SetKey] IS NULL
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.2	Do not remove existing members that do not match the new filter, 
 *      but which are being added as explicit members.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [ro].[ValueReference]
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                WHERE
                        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
                    AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            )
            BEGIN		
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMemberFilterChanged') IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    DROP TABLE #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMemberFilterChanged;
                END
                
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    @targetKey  AS N'SetKey',
                    @targetObjectTypeKey AS N'SetTypeKey',
                    [ro].[ValueReference] AS N'MemberKey'
                INTO #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMemberFilterChanged
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                WHERE
                        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
                    AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @targetObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @explicitMemberAttributeKey
                    AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                ORDER BY [ro].[ValueReference]
                OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@explicitMemberAttributeKey = 83));
                
                CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GenerateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMemberFilterChanged]
                ON #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMemberFilterChanged
                (
                    [SetKey],
                    [SetTypeKey],
                    [MemberKey]
                ); 	        
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [removedMember].[RequestKey] 
                    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [removedMember]
                    INNER JOIN #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMemberFilterChanged AS [newExplicitMember]
                        ON  [removedMember].[ObjectKey] = [newExplicitMember].[SetKey]
                        AND [removedMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [newExplicitMember].[SetTypeKey]
                        AND [removedMember].[ValueReference] = [newExplicitMember].[MemberKey]
                    WHERE
                            [removedMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [removedMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                        AND [removedMember].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE FROM [removedMember]
                    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [removedMember]
                    INNER JOIN #generateRequestFilterOutputNewExplicitMemberFilterChanged AS [newExplicitMember]
                        ON  [removedMember].[ObjectKey] = [newExplicitMember].[SetKey]
                        AND [removedMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [newExplicitMember].[SetTypeKey]
                        AND [removedMember].[ValueReference] = [newExplicitMember].[MemberKey]
                    WHERE
                            [removedMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [removedMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                        AND [removedMember].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                END
            END
        END
        
        IF @trace = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
                @startTime  = @subSectionStartTime,
                @requestKey = @requestKey, 
                @stage      = N'GenerateRequestComputedMemberOutput-E1';
                
            SELECT @subSectionStartTime  = GETUTCDATE();
        END	
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.3	Remove any new members that were existing members.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/	 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [newMember].[RequestKey] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [newMember]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existingMember]
                ON [newMember].[ObjectKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [newMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [newMember].[AttributeKey] = [existingMember].[AttributeKey]
                AND [newMember].[ValueReference] = [existingMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [newMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [newMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [newMember].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [newMember]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existingMember]
                ON [newMember].[ObjectKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectKey]
                AND [newMember].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existingMember].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [newMember].[AttributeKey] = [existingMember].[AttributeKey]
                AND [newMember].[ValueReference] = [existingMember].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [newMember].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [newMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                AND [newMember].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [existingMember].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@computedMemberAttributeKey = 40));
        END
        
        IF @trace = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
                @startTime  = @subSectionStartTime,
                @requestKey = @requestKey, 
                @stage      = N'GenerateRequestComputedMemberOutput-E2';
                
            SELECT @subSectionStartTime  = GETUTCDATE();
        END		        
        
    END		    
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GenerateRequestFilterOutput';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GenerateRequestOutput]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateRequestOutput]
    @requestKey             BIGINT,
    @operation              NVARCHAR(448)   = NULL,
    @targetKey              BIGINT          = NULL,
    @targetObjectTypeKey    SMALLINT        = NULL,
    @localeKey              SMALLINT        = NULL,
    @trace                  BIT             = 0,
    @boolDefaultValue       BIT             = 0

AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE @startTime DATETIME;

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    DECLARE @count INT;
    
    DECLARE
        @compositeObjectTypeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @creatorAttributeKey                    SMALLINT,
        @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey         SMALLINT,
        @elementAttributeKey                    SMALLINT,
        @groupCalculationAncillaryParameterName NVARCHAR(32),
        @parentRequestAttributeKey              SMALLINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey                   SMALLINT,
        @targetAttributeKey                     SMALLINT,
        @trueFlag                               BIT,
        @messageText                            NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @falseFlag                              BIT;
    
    SELECT 
        @compositeObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmCompositeType'),
        @creatorAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Creator'),
        @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmDeferredEvaluation'),
        @elementAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmElement'),
        @groupCalculationAncillaryParameterName = [fim].[GetGroupCalculationAncillaryParameterName](),
        @parentRequestAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ParentRequest'),
        @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @targetAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Target'),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Validate input parameter values.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    IF
    (
        @requestKey IS NULL
        OR NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [r].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR ('Invalid Request', 16, 1);
    END
    
    IF @operation IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @operation = [r].[Operation]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE
                [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
    
    IF @targetKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @targetKey = [r].[TargetKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE
                [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
    
    IF @targetObjectTypeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @targetObjectTypeKey = [r].[TargetObjectTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE
                [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
    
    IF @localeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @localeKey = [r].[LocaleKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE
                [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Assemble the request parameters.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE @requestParameter TABLE
    (
        TargetKey           BIGINT,
        TargetObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
        Mode                NVARCHAR(448),
        AttributeName       NVARCHAR(448),
        AttributeKey        SMALLINT,
        AttributeType       NVARCHAR(64),
        AttributeValue      NVARCHAR(MAX)
    );
    
    INSERT INTO @requestParameter
    (
        [TargetKey],
        [TargetObjectTypeKey],
        [Mode],
        [AttributeName],
        [AttributeKey],
        [AttributeType],
        [AttributeValue]      
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [rp].[ObjectKey],
        [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey]([rp].[ObjectKey]),
        [rp].Mode,
        [rp].AttributeName,
        [rp].AttributeKey,
        [rp].AttributeType,
        [rp].AttributeValue
    FROM [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
    WHERE [rp].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
            
    DECLARE @operationDataType  TABLE
    (
        [Mode]                  NVARCHAR(448),
        [DataType]              NVARCHAR(64)
    );    

    INSERT INTO @operationDataType
    (
        [Mode],
        [DataType]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [rp].[Mode],
        [rp].[AttributeType]
    FROM @requestParameter AS [rp];

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Calculate the results
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[DeleteRequestOutput]
        @requestKey = @requestKey;
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.1    Produce the results of request parameters which add new rows   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [odt].[Mode]
        FROM @operationDataType AS [odt]
        WHERE
            (
                    [odt].[Mode] = N'Add'
                OR  [odt].[Mode] = N'Create'
                OR  [odt].[Mode] = N'Modify'
            )
            AND [odt].[DataType] = N'Binary'
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputBinary]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [SequenceID],
            [ValueBinary],
            [Deleted]
        )
        SELECT
            @requestKey,
            [rp].[TargetKey],
            [rp].[TargetObjectTypeKey],
            [rp].[AttributeKey],
            CAST((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [rp].[TargetKey])) AS SMALLINT),
            [fim].ParseXmlBinary([rp].[AttributeValue]),
            0
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp] 
        WHERE 
            (
                    [rp].[Mode] = N'Add'
                OR  [rp].[Mode] = N'Create'
                OR  [rp].[Mode] = N'Modify'
            )
            AND [rp].[AttributeType] = N'Binary'
            AND [rp].[AttributeValue] IS NOT NULL;
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [odt].[Mode]
        FROM @operationDataType AS [odt]
        WHERE
            (
                    [odt].[Mode] = N'Add'
                OR  [odt].[Mode] = N'Create'
                OR  [odt].[Mode] = N'Modify'
            )
            AND [odt].[DataType] = N'Boolean'
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueBoolean],
            [Deleted]
        )
        SELECT
            @requestKey,
            [rp].[TargetKey],
            [rp].[TargetObjectTypeKey],
            [rp].[AttributeKey],
            CAST([rp].[AttributeValue] AS BIT),
            0
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp] 
        WHERE   
            (
                    [rp].[Mode] = N'Add'

            @groupObjectTypeKey                         =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Group'),
            @lastIdAncillaryParameterName               =   [fim].[GetLastIdAncillaryParameterName]();

        SELECT @batchSize = CAST([rap].[Value] AS INT)
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
        WHERE
                [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rap].[Name] = @batchSizeAncillaryParameterName;

        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
        WHERE

            @requestKey,
            [SetKey],

            @computedMemberAttributeKey,

        FROM #membershipModificationsIds
        WHERE [Id] > @lastId

        IF EXISTS

                AND [bool].[AttributeKey] = @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey

            [v].[ValueXml],
            1,
            [v].[LocaleKey]
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueXml] AS [v]

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [v].[ValueReference]
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [v]
            ON [rp].[TargetKey] = [v].[ValueReference] 
            AND [v].[ObjectKey] != [rp].[TargetKey] 
            AND [rp].[Mode] = 'Delete'
    )
    BEGIN
        -- Design Point: This code removes references to objects that are
        -- being deleted by the current request. A few special attributes
        -- are exempted from this. This list of attributes is hard-coded here.
        --
        -- [fim].[RemoveReferencesToDeletedObjects] also has very similar
        -- logic, and duplicates this hard-coded list. The two pieces of code
        -- must be kept in sync. 
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference] 
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [Deleted]
        )
        SELECT
            @requestKey,
            [v].[ObjectKey],
            [v].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [v].[AttributeKey],
            [rp].[TargetKey],
            1
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [v]
            ON [rp].[TargetKey] = [v].[ValueReference] 
            AND [v].[ObjectKey] != [rp].[TargetKey] 
            AND [rp].[Mode] = 'Delete' -- The attributes of the object itself have already been added
            AND
            ( -- Request Objects need to maintain their references even after those objects have been deleted
                    [v].[ObjectTypeKey] != @requestObjectTypeKey                    
                AND
                (
                        [v].[AttributeKey] != @creatorAttributeKey
                    OR  [v].[AttributeKey] != @targetAttributeKey
                    OR  [v].[AttributeKey] != @parentRequestAttributeKey
                )
            )
            AND
            (
                    [v].[ObjectTypeKey] != @compositeObjectTypeKey
                AND [v].[AttributeKey] != @elementAttributeKey
            )
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ror] -- Join on existing attributes in request output table
            ON [ror].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [v].[ObjectKey] = [ror].[ObjectKey]
            AND [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ror].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [v].[AttributeKey] = [ror].[AttributeKey]
            AND [v].[ValueReference] = [ror].[ValueReference]
        WHERE
            [ror].[AttributeKey] IS NULL
        OPTION (LOOP JOIN);                 -- When deleting multiple objects, those objects may contain references to
                                            -- each other.  This clause prevents adding duplicate rows to the table in such cases
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.3    Produce the results of request parameters 
 *        (other than deletion) which remove rows   
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [odt].[Mode]
        FROM @operationDataType AS [odt]
        WHERE
                [odt].[DataType] = N'Binary'
            AND 
            (   
                    [odt].[Mode] = N'Modify'
                OR  [odt].[Mode] = N'Remove'
            )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @count = COUNT([ro].[RequestKey])
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] [ro]
        WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputBinary]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [SequenceID],
            [ValueBinary],
            [Deleted]
        )
        SELECT
            @requestKey,
            [rp].[TargetKey],
            [rp].[TargetObjectTypeKey],
            [v].[AttributeKey],
            CAST((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [v].[ObjectKey]) + @count) AS SMALLINT),
            [v].[ValueBinary],
            1
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [v]
            ON  [rp].[TargetKey] = [v].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [rp].[AttributeKey] = [v].[AttributeKey] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            ON [rp].AttributeKey = [ai].[Key]
        WHERE 
        (
            [rp].[AttributeType] = N'Binary' 
            AND 
            (   
                [rp].[Mode] = N'Modify'
                OR
                (
                        [rp].[Mode] = N'Remove'
                    AND [v].[ValueBinary] = [fim].ParseXmlBinary([rp].[AttributeValue])
                )
            )
        )
        OPTION (LOOP JOIN)
    END
        
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [odt].[Mode]
        FROM @operationDataType AS [odt]
        WHERE
                [odt].[DataType] = N'Boolean'
            AND 
            (   
                    [odt].[Mode] = N'Modify'
                OR  [odt].[Mode] = N'Remove'
            )
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueBoolean],
            [Deleted]
        )
        SELECT
            @requestKey,
            [rp].[TargetKey],
            [rp].[TargetObjectTypeKey],
            [v].[AttributeKey],
            [v].[ValueBoolean],
            1
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [v]
            ON  [rp].[TargetKey] = [v].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [rp].[AttributeKey] = [v].[AttributeKey] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            ON [rp].AttributeKey = [ai].[Key]
        WHERE 
        (
            [rp].[AttributeType] = N'Boolean' 
            AND 
            (   
                [rp].[Mode] = N'Modify'
                OR
                (
                        [rp].[Mode] = N'Remove'
                    AND [v].[ValueBoolean] = CONVERT(BIT,[rp].[AttributeValue])
                )
            )
        )
        OPTION (LOOP JOIN)
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [odt].[Mode]
        FROM @operationDataType AS [odt]
        WHERE
                [odt].[DataType] = N'DateTime'
            AND 
            (   
                    [odt].[Mode] = N'Modify'
                OR  [odt].[Mode] = N'Remove'
            )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @count = COUNT([ro].[RequestKey])
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] [ro]
        WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [SequenceID],
            [ValueDateTime],
            [Deleted]
        )
        SELECT
            @requestKey,
            [rp].[TargetKey],
            [rp].[TargetObjectTypeKey],
            [v].[AttributeKey],
            CAST((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [v].[ObjectKey]) + @count) AS SMALLINT),
            [v].[ValueDateTime],
            1
        FROM @requestParameter AS [rp]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [v]
            ON  [rp].[TargetKey] = [v].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [rp].[AttributeKey] = [v].[AttributeKey] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            ON [rp].AttributeKey = [ai].[Key]
        WHERE 
        (
            [rp].[AttributeType] = N'DateTime' 
            AND 
            (   
                [rp].[Mode] = N'Modify'
                OR
                (
                        [rp].[Mode] = N'Remove'
                    AND [v].[ValueDateTime] = [fim].ParseXmlDate([rp].[AttributeValue])
                )
            )
        )
        OPTION (LOOP JOIN)
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D     Remove the results of request parameters (adds and deletes)
 *        that are duplicates of existing values
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 
    -- Binary
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] as [ro]
        WHERE 
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateRequestOutputDuplicateBinary') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #generateRequestOutputDuplicateBinary;
        END
    
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[ValueBinary],
            [ro].[Deleted]
        INTO #generateRequestOutputDuplicateBinary
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] as [ro]
        WHERE 
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueBinary],
            [Deleted];
            
        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GenerateRequestOutputDuplicateBinary_ObjectKey_ObjectTypeKey_AttributeKey_Deleted]
        ON #generateRequestOutputDuplicateBinary
        ( 
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [Deleted]
        );
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro1].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] as [ro1]
            INNER JOIN #generateRequestOutputDuplicateBinary AS [ro2]
                ON  [ro1].[ObjectKey] = [ro2].[ObjectKey] 
                AND [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro2].[ObjectTypeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[AttributeKey] = [ro2].[AttributeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[ValueBinary] = [ro2].[ValueBinary]
            WHERE 
                    [ro1].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro1].[Deleted] != [ro2].[Deleted]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [ro1]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] as [ro1]
            INNER JOIN #generateRequestOutputDuplicateBinary AS [ro2]
                ON  [ro1].[ObjectKey] = [ro2].[ObjectKey] 
                AND [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro2].[ObjectTypeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[AttributeKey] = [ro2].[AttributeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[ValueBinary] = [ro2].[ValueBinary]
            WHERE 
                    [ro1].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro1].[Deleted] != [ro2].[Deleted];
        END
    END
