                AND [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro2].[ObjectTypeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[AttributeKey] = [ro2].[AttributeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[LocaleKey] = [ro2].[LocaleKey]
                AND [ro1].[ValueString] = [ro2].[ValueString]
            WHERE 
                    [ro1].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro1].[Deleted] != [ro2].[Deleted]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputDuplicateString]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [LocaleKey],
                [ValueString],
                [Deleted]           
            )
            SELECT
                [ro1].[RequestKey],
                [ro1].[ObjectKey],
                [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro1].[AttributeKey],
                [ro1].[SequenceID],
                [ro1].[LocaleKey],
                [ro1].[ValueString],
                [ro1].[Deleted]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] as [ro1]
            INNER JOIN #generateRequestOutputDuplicateString AS [ro2]
                ON  [ro1].[ObjectKey] = [ro2].[ObjectKey] 
                AND [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro2].[ObjectTypeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[AttributeKey] = [ro2].[AttributeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[LocaleKey] = [ro2].[LocaleKey]
                AND [ro1].[ValueString] = [ro2].[ValueString]
            WHERE 
                    [ro1].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro1].[Deleted] != [ro2].[Deleted];


            DELETE FROM [ro1]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] as [ro1]
            INNER JOIN #generateRequestOutputDuplicateString AS [ro2]
                ON  [ro1].[ObjectKey] = [ro2].[ObjectKey] 
                AND [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro2].[ObjectTypeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[AttributeKey] = [ro2].[AttributeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[LocaleKey] = [ro2].[LocaleKey]
                AND [ro1].[ValueString] = [ro2].[ValueString]
            WHERE 
                    [ro1].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro1].[Deleted] != [ro2].[Deleted];
        END
    END
    
    -- Text
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] as [ro]
        WHERE 
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateRequestOutputDuplicateText') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #generateRequestOutputDuplicateText;
        END
    
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ro].[AttributeKey],
            [ro].[LocaleKey],
            [ro].[ValueText],
            [ro].[Deleted]
        INTO #generateRequestOutputDuplicateText
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] as [ro]
        WHERE 
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        ORDER BY
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [LocaleKey],
            [ValueText],
            [Deleted]
            
        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GenerateRequestOutputDuplicateText_ObjectKey_ObjectTypeKey_AttributeKey_LocaleKey_Deleted]
        ON #generateRequestOutputDuplicateText
        ( 
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [LocaleKey],
            [Deleted]
        );
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro1].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] as [ro1]
            INNER JOIN #generateRequestOutputDuplicateText AS [ro2]
                ON  [ro1].[ObjectKey] = [ro2].[ObjectKey] 
                AND [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro2].[ObjectTypeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[AttributeKey] = [ro2].[AttributeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[LocaleKey] = [ro2].[LocaleKey]
                AND [ro1].[ValueText] = [ro2].[ValueText]
            WHERE 
                    [ro1].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro1].[Deleted] != [ro2].[Deleted]
        )
        BEGIN

            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputDuplicateText]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [LocaleKey],
                [ValueText],
                [Deleted]           
            )
            SELECT 
                [ro1].[RequestKey],
                [ro1].[ObjectKey],
                [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro1].[AttributeKey],
                [ro1].[SequenceID],
                [ro1].[LocaleKey],
                [ro1].[ValueText],
                [ro1].[Deleted]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] as [ro1]
            INNER JOIN #generateRequestOutputDuplicateText AS [ro2]
                ON  [ro1].[ObjectKey] = [ro2].[ObjectKey] 
                AND [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro2].[ObjectTypeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[AttributeKey] = [ro2].[AttributeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[LocaleKey] = [ro2].[LocaleKey]
                AND [ro1].[ValueText] = [ro2].[ValueText]
            WHERE 
                    [ro1].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro1].[Deleted] != [ro2].[Deleted];


            DELETE FROM [ro1]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] as [ro1]
            INNER JOIN #generateRequestOutputDuplicateText AS [ro2]
                ON  [ro1].[ObjectKey] = [ro2].[ObjectKey] 
                AND [ro1].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro2].[ObjectTypeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[AttributeKey] = [ro2].[AttributeKey] 
                AND [ro1].[LocaleKey] = [ro2].[LocaleKey]
                AND [ro1].[ValueText] = [ro2].[ValueText]
            WHERE 
                    [ro1].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro1].[Deleted] != [ro2].[Deleted];
        END
    END
    
    -- No entry for XML because XML cannot be compared.  However,
    -- it cannot be used in set filter either so there is no harm
    -- in leaving the delete-add in RequestOutputXml

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.    Initialize boolean attribute that is not specified in the request.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF (@operation = N'Create')
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @boolAttributeDataTypeKey TINYINT = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'Boolean');

        DECLARE @targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection]);
        EXEC [fim].[GetTargetObjectsForRequest] @requestKey = @requestKey, @targetObjects = @targetsXml OUTPUT;   

        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#generateObjectKey') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #generateObjectKey;
        END    
        
        SELECT 
            Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT') AS [ObjectKey],
            Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectTypeKey', 'SMALLINT') AS [ObjectTypeKey]            
        INTO #generateObjectKey
        FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject)
        WHERE Root.targetObject.value('@Deleted', 'SMALLINT') = @falseFlag;		

        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean]
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueBoolean],
            [Deleted]
        )
        SELECT 
            DISTINCT
            @requestKey,
            [t1].[ObjectKey], 
            [t1].[ObjectTypeKey], 
            [ai].[Key] AS [AttributeKey],
            @boolDefaultValue as [ValueBoolean],
            @falseFlag    
        FROM #generateObjectKey [t1]
        INNER JOIN @requestParameter [rp]
            ON [t1].[ObjectKey] = [rp].[TargetKey]
            AND [rp].[Mode] = N'Create'
        INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] [bi]
            ON [bi].[ObjectTypeKey] = [t1].[ObjectTypeKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] [ai]
            ON [ai].[Key] = [bi].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ai].[DataTypeKey] = @boolAttributeDataTypeKey
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ov]
            WHERE [ov].[ObjectKey] = [t1].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [t1].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        )
        OPTION (LOOP JOIN);
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.    Determine the computed members.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateRequestFilterOutput]
        @requestKey = @requestKey,
        @operation = @operation,
        @targetKey = @targetKey,
        @targetObjectTypeKey = @targetObjectTypeKey,
        @trace = @trace;
    
   
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GenerateRequestOutput';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GenerateSetFilterSQL]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures.  
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GenerateSetFilterSQL]
	@setKey                         BIGINT,
	@setTypeKey                     SMALLINT,
	@requestKey                     BIGINT          =   NULL,
	@computedMemberAttributeKey     SMALLINT        =   NULL,
	@identifierAttributeKey         SMALLINT        =   NULL,
	@requestSetFilterSQL            NVARCHAR(MAX)               OUTPUT,
	@setFilterSQL                   NVARCHAR(MAX)               OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT  @requestSetFilterSQL = NULL;  -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    DECLARE 
        @computedMemberAttributeKeyString           NVARCHAR(16),
        @identifierAttributeKeyString               NVARCHAR(16),
        @filterSQL                                  NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @index                                      INT,
        @limit                                      INT,
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName  NVARCHAR(32),
        @membershipConditionKey                     INT,
        @createdTimeAttributeKey                    SMALLINT,
        @createdTimeAttributeKeyString              NVARCHAR(16),
        @membershipConditionSQL                     NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @messageText                                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @immutableAttributeSelectionString          NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @requestKeyString                           NVARCHAR(64),
        @setObjectTypeKey                           SMALLINT,
        @setKeyString                               NVARCHAR(64),
        @setTypeKeyString                           NVARCHAR(16);
        
    IF @computedMemberAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember');
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END
        
    SELECT 
        @computedMemberAttributeKeyString = CAST(@computedMemberAttributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16)),
        @identifierAttributeKeyString = CAST(@identifierAttributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16)),
        @createdTimeAttributeKey  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @createdTimeAttributeKeyString = CAST(@createdTimeAttributeKey AS NVARCHAR(16)),
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName = [fim].[GetMembershipConditionAncillaryParameterName](),
        @setObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Set'),
        @setKeyString = CAST(@setKey AS NVARCHAR(64)),
        @setTypeKeyString = CAST(@setTypeKey AS NVARCHAR(16));
        
    IF @requestKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @requestKeyString = CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(64));
    END
    
    DECLARE @membershipCondition    TABLE
    (
        [Index]                     INT IDENTITY(0,1),
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT
    );

    IF @requestKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rap].[RequestKey]
	        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
            WHERE
                    [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @membershipCondition
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            )
            SELECT CAST([rap].[Value] AS INT)
            FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
            WHERE
                    [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName;
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [smc].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
            WHERE
                    [smc].[SetKey] = @setKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @membershipCondition
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            )
            SELECT [smc].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
            WHERE
                    [smc].[SetKey] = @setKey;
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @membershipCondition AS [membershipCondition]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatement]
            ON [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [membershipConditionStatement].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON [membershipConditionStatement].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = @setKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatCircularFilterDependencyException]();
		RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
		RETURN;
    END
    
    IF @setTypeKey = @setObjectTypeKey
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM @membershipCondition AS [membershipCondition]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [membershipConditionStatements]
                ON  [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [membershipConditionStatements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON  [membershipConditionStatements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [dereferencedObject]
                ON  [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = [dereferencedObject].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [dereferencedObject].[ObjectTypeKey] != @setObjectTypeKey
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidMembershipConditionStatementDereferencedValueException]();
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            RETURN;
        END
    END
    
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @membershipCondition AS [mc]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @filterSQL =                                                 N'
[o].[ObjectKey] IN
('                                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/
    SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]'                                                + N'/*<BR>*/
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ov]'                              + N'/*<BR>*/
    WHERE'                                                                  + N'/*<BR>*/
            [ov].[AttributeKey] = ' + @identifierAttributeKeyString         + N'/*<BR>*/
)';    
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
    
        SELECT
            @filterSQL  =   N'',
            @index      =   0,
            @limit      =   MAX([mc].[Index])
        FROM @membershipCondition AS [mc];
        
        WHILE(@index <= @limit)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @membershipConditionKey = [mc].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM @membershipCondition AS [mc]
            WHERE
                    [mc].[Index] = @index;
                    
            SELECT @immutableAttributeSelectionString = 
                [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionImmutableAttributeSQL](@membershipConditionKey);
            
            EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateMembershipConditionSQL] 
                @membershipConditionKey = @membershipConditionKey,
                @immutableAttributeSelectionString = @immutableAttributeSelectionString,
                @identifierAttributeKey = @identifierAttributeKey,
                @createdTimeAttributeKeyString = @createdTimeAttributeKeyString,
                @sql = @membershipConditionSQL OUTPUT;
                
            SELECT @filterSQL = @filterSQL +                                        N'
    ('                                                                              + N'/*<BR>*/' 
                + 





                CASE
                    WHEN @immutableAttributeSelectionString IS NOT NULL THEN        N'/*<BR>*/
            ' + @immutableAttributeSelectionString                                  + N'/*<BR>*/
        AND '
                    ELSE                                                            N''
                END                                                                 + N'/*<BR>*/
            [o].[ObjectKey] IN'                                                     + N'/*<BR>*/
        ('                                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/
            ' + @membershipConditionSQL                                             + N'/*<BR>*/
        )'                                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/
    )'                                                                              + 
                CASE
                    WHEN @index < @limit THEN                                       + N'/*<BR>*/
    OR'                                                                             + N'/*<BR>*/'
                    ELSE                                                            N''
                END;    

            
            SELECT @index = @index + 1;
            
        END
        
    END
    
    SELECT @filterSQL = REPLACE(@filterSQL,N'[*]',N'[o]');

    SELECT @setFilterSQL =                                                          N'
SELECT '                                                                            + N'/*<BR>*/
    [o].[ObjectKey]'                                                                + N'/*<BR>*/
FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [o]'                                            + N'/*<BR>*/
WHERE [o].[AttributeKey] = ' + @createdTimeAttributeKeyString                       + N'/*<BR>*/
    AND 
    ('                                                                              + N'/*<BR>*/
        ' + @filterSQL                                                              + N'/*<BR>*/
    ) ORDER BY [o].[ObjectKey];'                                                                             

    IF @requestKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN

        SELECT @requestSetFilterSQL =                                               N'
    SELECT '                                                                        + N'/*<BR>*/
        ' + @requestKeyString + ','                                                 + N'/*<BR>*/
        ' + @setKeyString + ','                                                     + N'/*<BR>*/
        ' + @setTypeKeyString + ','                                                 + N'/*<BR>*/
        ' + @computedMemberAttributeKeyString + ','                                 + N'/*<BR>*/
        [o].[ObjectKey],'                                                           + N'/*<BR>*/
        0'                                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [o]'                                        + N'/*<BR>*/
    WHERE [o].[AttributeKey] = ' + @createdTimeAttributeKeyString                   + N'/*<BR>*/
        AND 
        ('                                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/
            ' + @filterSQL                                                          + N'/*<BR>*/
        )  ORDER BY [o].[ObjectKey];'                                                      
    END

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetAttributeBindingIdentifiers]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetAttributeBindingIdentifiers]
    @objectTypeDescriptionIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    -- Convert the identifier to a key
    DECLARE @objectTypeDescriptionObjectKey BIGINT;
    DECLARE @bindingDescriptionObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @objectIdentifierAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier
        @objectID = @objectTypeDescriptionIdentifier,
        @objectKey = @objectTypeDescriptionObjectKey OUTPUT;
        
    SELECT 
        @bindingDescriptionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'BindingDescription'),
        @objectIdentifierAttributeKey    = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName]  (N'ObjectID');
        
    -- Only time this is used is to get the objectIdentifier. Can expand later if neccessary.
    SELECT DISTINCT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
        ON [oti].[Key] = [bi].[ObjectTypeKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON 
                [bi].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ovi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionObjectTypeKey
            AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierAttributeKey
    WHERE 
        [oti].[ObjectKey] = @objectTypeDescriptionObjectKey;

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetAttributes]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetAttributes]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey    SMALLINT,
        @defaultLocaleKey                   SMALLINT,
        @descriptionKey                     SMALLINT,
        @displayNameKey                     SMALLINT;
        
    SELECT
        @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'AttributeTypeDescription'),
        @defaultLocaleKey = [fim].[GetDefaultLocaleKey](),
        @descriptionKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Description'),
        @displayNameKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName');

    DECLARE @attributes TABLE
    (
        [Key]           SMALLINT,
        [ObjectID]      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        [Name]          NVARCHAR(448),
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT,
        [DataType]      NVARCHAR(64),
        [Multivalued]   BIT,
        [Selectivity]   TINYINT,
        [DisplayName]   NVARCHAR(448),
        [Description]   NVARCHAR(448)
    );
    

    INSERT INTO @attributes
    (
        [Key],
        [Name],
        [ObjectKey],
        [DataType],
        [Multivalued],
        [Selectivity]
    )    
    SELECT
        [ai].[Key],
        [ai].[Name],
        [ai].[ObjectKey],
        [ai].[DataType],
        [ai].[Multivalued],
        [ai].[Selectivity]
    FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai];
    
    UPDATE @attributes
    SET [ObjectID] = [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] 
    FROM @attributes AS [a]
    JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON  [a].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
    
    UPDATE @attributes
    SET [DisplayName] = [ovs].[ValueString] 
    FROM @attributes AS [a]
    JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [a].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameKey
        AND [ovs].[LocaleKey] = @defaultLocaleKey;

    UPDATE @attributes
    SET [Description] = [ovs].[ValueString] 
    FROM @attributes AS [a]
    JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [a].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @descriptionKey
        AND [ovs].[LocaleKey] = @defaultLocaleKey;

    SELECT 
        [a].[Key],
        [a].[ObjectID],
        [a].[Name],
        [a].[DataType],
        [a].[Multivalued],
        [a].[Selectivity],
        [a].[DisplayName],
        [a].[Description]
    FROM @attributes AS [a]
    WHERE [a].[ObjectID] IS NOT NULL;
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetAttributeValues]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetAttributeValues]
	@objectIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
	@attributeName NVARCHAR (448)	
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @objectKey BIGINT;
    DECLARE @attributeKey SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @attributeTypeName NVARCHAR (448);    
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
        @objectID = @objectIdentifier,
        @objectTypeKey = NULL,
        @objectKey = @objectKey OUTPUT
    SELECT @attributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (@attributeName);
    SELECT @attributeTypeName = [fim].[AttributeTypeFromKey] (@attributeKey);
    
    IF (@attributeTypeName = N'Reference')
    BEGIN
        SELECT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS [ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
        JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE 
                [ovr].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey 
            AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
    END
    ELSE IF (@attributeTypeName = N'Text')
    BEGIN
        SELECT [ovt].[ValueText]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
        WHERE 
                [ovt].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey 
            AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
    END
    ELSE IF (@attributeTypeName = N'String')
    BEGIN
        SELECT [ovs].[ValueString]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        WHERE 
                [ovs].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey 
            AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
    END
    ELSE IF (@attributeTypeName = N'Binary')
    BEGIN
        SELECT [ovb].[ValueBinary]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ovb]
        WHERE 
                [ovb].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey 
            AND [ovb].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
    END
    ELSE IF (@attributeTypeName = N'Boolean')
    BEGIN
        SELECT [ovb].[ValueBoolean]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb]
        WHERE 
                [ovb].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey 
            AND [ovb].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
    END
    ELSE IF (@attributeTypeName = N'DateTime')
    BEGIN
        SELECT [ovdt].[ValueDateTime]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
        WHERE 
                [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey 
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
    END
    ELSE IF (@attributeTypeName = N'Integer')
    BEGIN
        SELECT [ovi].[ValueInteger]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ovi]
        WHERE 
                [ovi].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey 
            AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
    END
    -- There should never be an unknown data type.
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetDatabaseVersion]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetDatabaseVersion]
    @Version        INT OUTPUT,
    @BinaryVersion  NVARCHAR(19) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SELECT TOP 1
         @Version       = [Version], 
         @BinaryVersion = [BinaryVersion]
    FROM [fim].[Version] 
    ORDER BY [Version] DESC
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetDomainConfigurationIdentifiersFromDomain]
    @domainName NVARCHAR(448)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    DECLARE @domainAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
            @domainConfigurationObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
            @objectIDAttributeKey             SMALLINT;

    SELECT @domainAttributeKey               = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Domain'),
           @domainConfigurationObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'DomainConfiguration'),
           @objectIDAttributeKey             = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectID');

    SELECT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON [ovi].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE 
            [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @domainAttributeKey
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey]= @domainConfigurationObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[ValueString]  = @domainName
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetDomainFromDomainConfigurationIdentifier]
    @domainConfigurationObjectId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @domainName NVARCHAR(448) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    DECLARE @domainAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
            @domainConfigurationObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
            @objectIDAttributeKey             SMALLINT;

    SELECT @domainAttributeKey               = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Domain'),
           @domainConfigurationObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'DomainConfiguration'),
           @objectIDAttributeKey             = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectID');

    SELECT @domainName = [ovs].[ValueString]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE 
            [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] = @domainConfigurationObjectId
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey]   = @domainConfigurationObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey]    = @domainAttributeKey
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey]    = @objectIDAttributeKey;

END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetFilterScopeAttributeNames]
    @filterScopeIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @filterScopeKey BIGINT;
    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
        @objectID         = @filterScopeIdentifier,
        @objectKey        = @filterScopeKey OUTPUT;

    DECLARE @allowedAttributesKey SMALLINT;
    SET @allowedAttributesKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'AllowedAttributes');

    SELECT [ai].[Name] FROM
    (
        SELECT  [ovr].[ValueReference] AS ObjectKey
        FROM    [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS ovr
        WHERE   [ovr].[ObjectKey] = @filterScopeKey
            AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @allowedAttributesKey
    ) AS allowedAttributes
    JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS ai
    ON [allowedAttributes].[ObjectKey] = [ai].[ObjectKey] 
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetGateObjectsTiedToUsers]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetGateObjectsTiedToUsers]
    @userGuids XML(CONTENT [fim].[ReferenceSchemaCollection])
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @gateRegistrationTypeKey    SMALLINT,
        @userIDKey                  SMALLINT;
        
    SELECT
        @gateRegistrationTypeKey    = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'GateRegistration'),
        @userIDKey                  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'UserID');

    DECLARE @userObjects TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]                  BIGINT        
        PRIMARY KEY 
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
    );

    INSERT INTO @userObjects
    (
        [ObjectKey] 
    )    
    SELECT DISTINCT [o].[ObjectKey]    
    FROM
    (
        SELECT o.value('.[1]', 'uniqueidentifier') AS [item]
        FROM @userGuids.nodes('/v') O(o)
    ) [Identifiers]
    JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        ON [Identifiers].[item] = [o].[ObjectID];

    -- PK_ObjectValueReference: AttributeKey, ObjectTypeKey, ValueReference, ObjectKey
    SELECT 
        [o].[ObjectID] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey] 
    INNER JOIN @userObjects AS [uo]
        ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [uo].[ObjectKey] 
    WHERE 
            [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @userIDKey
        AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @gateRegistrationTypeKey;
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetGateObjectsTiedToUserSpecificWorkflow]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetGateObjectsTiedToUserSpecificWorkflow]
    @UserID                 UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @WorkflowDefinitionID   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @gateRegistrationTypeKey            SMALLINT,
        @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @objectIdAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
        @userIdAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @userObjectKey                      BIGINT,
        @workflowDefinitionIdAttributeKey   SMALLINT,
        @workflowDefinitionObjectKey        BIGINT;

    SELECT 
        @gateRegistrationTypeKey            = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'GateRegistration'),
        @objectIdAttributeKey               = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @userIdAttributeKey                 = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'UserID'),
        @workflowDefinitionIdAttributeKey   = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');
    
    IF @UserID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'UserID');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN; 
    END

    IF @WorkflowDefinitionID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'WorkflowDefinitionID');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN; 
    END

    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier] 
        @objectID = @UserID,
        @objectTypeKey = NULL,
        @objectKey = @userObjectKey OUTPUT;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
        @objectID = @WorkflowDefinitionID,
        @objectTypeKey = NULL,
        @objectKey = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey OUTPUT;    
    
    SELECT [o].[ObjectID] AS [ObjectID]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [gate]
        ON 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = [gate].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [gate].[ObjectTypeKey] = @gateRegistrationTypeKey
        AND [gate].[AttributeKey] = @userIdAttributeKey
        AND [gate].[ValueReference] = @userObjectKey
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [workflow]
        ON
            [gate].[ObjectKey] = [workflow].[ObjectKey]
        AND [workflow].[ObjectTypeKey] = @gateRegistrationTypeKey
        AND [workflow].[AttributeKey] = @workflowDefinitionIdAttributeKey
        AND [workflow].[ValueReference] = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey;

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetGateObjectsTiedToWorkflow]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetGateObjectsTiedToWorkflow]
    @WorkflowDefinitionID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @gateRegistrationTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @gateRegistrationTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'GateRegistration');
    
    DECLARE @objectIdAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @objectIdAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    
    DECLARE @userObjectKey BIGINT;
    
    DECLARE @workflowDefinitionIdAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @workflowDefinitionIdAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');
    
    DECLARE @workflowDefinitionObjectKey BIGINT;
    
    IF (@WorkflowDefinitionID IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @workflowDefinitionObjectKey = NULL;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @WorkflowDefinitionID,
            @objectTypeKey = NULL,
            @objectKey = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey OUTPUT;
    END
    
    DECLARE @gateIdAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @gateIdAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'GateID');
    
    DECLARE @gateDataAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @gateDataAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'GateData');
        
    SELECT 
        ovs.ValueString as [GateID],
        ovb.ValueBinary as [GateData],
        ovi.ValueIdentifier as [ObjectID]
    FROM
        [fim].[ObjectValueReference] ovr
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] ovb
        ON
        (
            ovr.ObjectKey = ovb.ObjectKey
        AND ovb.AttributeKey = @gateDataAttributeKey
        )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] ovi
        ON
        (
            ovr.ObjectKey = ovi.ObjectKey
        AND ovi.AttributeKey = @objectIdAttributeKey
        )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] ovs
        ON
        (
            ovr.ObjectKey = ovs.ObjectKey
        AND ovs.AttributeKey = @gateIdAttributeKey
        )
    WHERE
            ovr.ObjectTypeKey = @gateRegistrationTypeKey
        AND ovr.AttributeKey = @workflowDefinitionIdAttributeKey
        AND ovr.ValueReference = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey
        
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetGateRegistrationObject]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetGateRegistrationObject]
    @UserID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @WorkflowDefinitionID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @QualifiedName NVARCHAR (128)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey            SMALLINT,
        @gateDataAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
        @gateIdAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @gateRegistrationTypeKey            SMALLINT,
        @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @objectIdAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
        @userIdAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @userObjectKey                      BIGINT,
        @workflowDefinitionIdAttributeKey   SMALLINT,
        @workflowDefinitionObjectKey        BIGINT;

    IF @UserID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'UserID');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN; 
    END

    IF @WorkflowDefinitionID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'WorkflowDefinitionID');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN; 
    END

    SELECT 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey            = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @gateDataAttributeKey               = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'GateData'),
        @gateIdAttributeKey                 = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'GateID'),
        @gateRegistrationTypeKey            = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'GateRegistration'),
        @objectIdAttributeKey               = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @userIdAttributeKey                 = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'UserID'),
        @workflowDefinitionIdAttributeKey   = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier] 
        @objectID = @UserID,
        @objectTypeKey = NULL,
        @objectKey = @userObjectKey OUTPUT;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
        @objectID = @WorkflowDefinitionID,
        @objectTypeKey = NULL,
        @objectKey = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey OUTPUT;

    DECLARE @userGates TABLE
    (
        [GateID]        NVARCHAR(448),
        [GateData]        VARBINARY(MAX),
        [ObjectKey]        BIGINT,
        [ObjectID]        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        [CreatedTime]    DateTime
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
    );

    -- Future considerations:
    -- The joins on ObjectValueReference omit the AttributeKey clause 
    -- because of the way our indexes are built. 
    -- In the future, after our indexes are rationalized, 
    -- we should add the clause back.
    --
    -- The clause ([gateData].[ValueBinary] IS NOT NULL)
    -- should have no impact because the column is defined NOT NULL
    -- After confirming that there is indeed no performance impact,
    -- this clause should be removed.
    INSERT INTO @userGates
    (
        [GateID],
        [GateData],
        [ObjectKey],        
        [ObjectID]        
    )        
    SELECT 
        [gateId].[ValueString] AS [GateID],
        [gateData].[ValueBinary] AS [GateData],
        [o].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
        [o].[ObjectID] AS [ObjectID]    
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [gate]
        ON
            [o].[ObjectKey] = [gate].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [gate].[ObjectTypeKey] = @gateRegistrationTypeKey
        --AND [gate].[AttributeKey] = @userIdAttributeKey
        AND [gate].[ValueReference] = @userObjectKey
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [gateData]
        ON
            [gate].[ObjectKey] = [gateData].[ObjectKey]
        AND [gateData].[AttributeKey] = @gateDataAttributeKey
        AND [gateData].[ObjectTypeKey] = @gateRegistrationTypeKey            
        AND [gateData].[ValueBinary] IS NOT NULL
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [gateId]
        ON
            [gate].[ObjectKey] = [gateId].[ObjectKey]
        AND [gateId].[ObjectTypeKey] = @gateRegistrationTypeKey            
        AND [gateId].[AttributeKey] = @gateIdAttributeKey
        AND [gateId].[ValueString] = @QualifiedName
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [workflowDefinition]
        ON
            [gate].[ObjectKey] = [workflowDefinition].[ObjectKey]
        --AND [workflowDefinition].[ObjectTypeKey] = @gateRegistrationTypeKey            
        AND [workflowDefinition].[AttributeKey] = @workflowDefinitionIdAttributeKey
        AND [workflowDefinition].[ValueReference] = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey
    WHERE [gate].[ObjectTypeKey] = @gateRegistrationTypeKey;


    -- Design Point:
    -- Rather than adding an 'INNER JOIN' clause to the previous statement,
    -- this 'UPDATE' is done as a separate statement for performance reasons.
    -- @userGates usually contains 0 or 1 rows.
    UPDATE @userGates
    SET [CreatedTime] = [CreatedTime].[ValueDateTime]
    FROM @userGates AS [gate]    
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [createdTime]
        ON
            [gate].[ObjectKey] = [createdTime].[ObjectKey]
        AND [createdTime].[ObjectTypeKey] = @gateRegistrationTypeKey            
        AND [createdTime].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;

    -- Design Point:
    -- The 'ORDER BY' is performed here in a separate statement to ensure that
    -- intermediate results are not sorted.
    -- Otherwise, the query plan effectively sorts a large portion of ObjectValueDateTime.
    SELECT
        [gate].[GateID],
        [gate].[GateData],
        [gate].[ObjectID]
    FROM @userGates AS [gate]
    ORDER BY [gate].[CreatedTime] DESC;
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetInitialDataBatch]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetInitialDataBatch]
    @subscriberIdentifier SMALLINT,
    @batchSize INT,
    @initialObjectKey BIGINT,
    @lastInitializedTime DATETIME = NULL,
    @nextObjectKey BIGINT OUTPUT,
    @nextObjectIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE
        @added TINYINT,
        @requestIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        
    SELECT  @added = 1,
            @requestIdentifier = CAST(N'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);

    IF  OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpObjectKeyBatch') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE [#tmpObjectKeyBatch];

    SELECT DISTINCT TOP (@batchSize)
        [objects].[ObjectKey],
        [objects].[ObjectID],
        [objects].[ObjectTypeKey]
    INTO [#tmpObjectKeyBatch]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [d]
        ON [objects].[ObjectKey] = [d].[ObjectKey] 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [el]
        ON [d].[ObjectTypeKey] = [el].[ObjectTypeKey] 
    WHERE [d].[AttributeKey] = 53                   --CreatedTime
        AND [objects].[ObjectKey] >= @initialObjectKey
        AND [el].[SubscriptionKey] = 1              --FIMReportingSubscription
    ORDER BY [objects].[ObjectKey] ASC;

    SELECT @nextObjectKey = MAX([ObjectKey]) + 1
    FROM [#tmpObjectKeyBatch]; 

    IF @lastInitializedTime IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @lastInitializedTime = CAST(N'1/1/2000' AS DATETIME); -- Initialize to a time in the past
    END
    
    SELECT @nextObjectIdentifier = [objects].[ObjectID]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
    WHERE [objects].[ObjectKey] = @nextObjectKey;

    WITH [StringBatch] (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [LocaleKey],
        [ValueString] ) AS
	(
        SELECT 
            [ovString].[ObjectKey],
            [ovString].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ovString].[AttributeKey],
            [ovString].[LocaleKey],
            [ovString].[ValueString]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovString]
        INNER JOIN [#tmpObjectKeyBatch] AS [objectKeyBatch] 
            ON [ovString].[ObjectKey] = [objectKeyBatch].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ovString].[ObjectTypeKey] = [objectKeyBatch].[ObjectTypeKey]
    )    
    SELECT
        @requestIdentifier                        AS [RequestIdentifier],
        [v].[ObjectKey]                           AS [ObjectKey],
        [v].[ObjectID]                            AS [ObjectID],
        [ai].[DataType]                           AS [DataType],
        [ai].[Name]                               AS [AttributeName],
        [oi].[Name]                               AS [ObjectTypeName],
        [ai].[Multivalued]                        AS [Multivalued],
        [ovBinary].[ValueBinary]                  AS [ValueBinary],
        [ovBoolean].[ValueBoolean]                AS [ValueBoolean],
        [ovDateTime].[ValueDateTime]              AS [ValueDatetime],
        [ovInteger].[ValueInteger]                AS [ValueInteger],    
        [ovReference].[ValueReference]            AS [ValueReferenceKey],
        [ovReferenceIdentifier].[ValueIdentifier] AS [ValueReference],
        [ovString].[ValueString]                  AS [ValueString],
        [ovText].[ValueText]                      AS [ValueText],
        [elsb].[SubscriptionBindingDetails]       AS [SubscriptionBindingDetails],
        @added                                    AS [Added],
        GETUTCDATE()                              AS [EventTime]
    FROM [#tmpObjectKeyBatch] AS [v]    
    CROSS JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ovBinary]
    ON
            [v].[ObjectKey] = [ovBinary].[ObjectKey]
        AND [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovBinary].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ai].[Key] = [ovBinary].[AttributeKey]                
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovBoolean]
    ON
            [v].[ObjectKey] = [ovBoolean].[ObjectKey]
        AND [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovBoolean].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ai].[Key] = [ovBoolean].[AttributeKey]        
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovDateTime]
    ON
            [v].[ObjectKey] = [ovDateTime].[ObjectKey]
        AND [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovDateTime].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ai].[Key] = [ovDateTime].[AttributeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ovInteger]
    ON
            [v].[ObjectKey] = [ovInteger].[ObjectKey]
        AND [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovInteger].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ai].[Key] = [ovInteger].[AttributeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovReference]
    ON
            [v].[ObjectKey] = [ovReference].[ObjectKey]
        AND [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovReference].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ai].[Key] = [ovReference].[AttributeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovReferenceIdentifier]
        ON [ovReference].[ValueReference] = [ovReferenceIdentifier].[ObjectKey]  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [StringBatch] AS [ovString]
    ON
            [v].[ObjectKey] = [ovString].[ObjectKey]
        AND [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovString].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ai].[Key] = [ovString].[AttributeKey]
        AND [ovString].[LocaleKey] = 127
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovText]
    ON
            [v].[ObjectKey] = [ovText].[ObjectKey]
        AND [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovText].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ai].[Key] = [ovText].[AttributeKey]
        AND [ovText].[LocaleKey] = 127
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [elb]
    ON 
            [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [elb].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ai].[Key] = [elb].[AttributeKey]    
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding] AS [elsb]
        ON [elb].[ExportBindingKey] = [elsb].[ExportBindingKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oi]
        ON [v].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oi].[Key]
    WHERE
        (
               [ovBinary].[ValueBinary] IS NOT NULL
            OR [ovBoolean].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
            OR [ovDateTime].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
            OR [ovInteger].[ValueInteger] IS NOT NULL
            OR [ovReference].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
            OR [ovString].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
            OR [ovText].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
        )
    AND [elb].[SubscriptionKey] = @subscriberIdentifier
    AND [elsb].[SubscriptionBindingOption] = 1 --capturing rows that will be flow as part of initial
    AND [elsb].[DefinitionDate] > @lastInitializedTime
    ORDER BY [v].[ObjectKey];
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetInitialDataWarehouseBindings]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetInitialDataWarehouseBindings]
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [bi].[AttributeName] AS [AttributeName],
        [bi].[ObjectType] AS [ObjectType],
        [elsb].[SubscriptionBindingDetails] AS [SubscriptionBindingDetails]
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [elb]
        ON 
        (
                [bi].[AttributeKey] = [elb].[AttributeKey]
            AND [bi].[ObjectTypeKey] = [elb].[ObjectTypeKey]
        )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding] AS [elsb]
        ON [elb].[ExportBindingKey] = [elsb].[ExportBindingKey]
    WHERE [elsb].[SubscriptionBindingOption] = 1;
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetInitialPartialDataBatch]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetInitialPartialDataBatch]
    @subscriberIdentifier SMALLINT,
    @batchSize INT,
    @initialObjectKey BIGINT,
    @nextObjectKey BIGINT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN    
    DECLARE @lastInitializedTime DATETIME,
            @nextObjectIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
    
    SELECT @lastInitializedTime = [es].[LastInitialized]
    FROM [fim].[ExportSubscription] AS [es]
    WHERE [es].[SubscriptionKey] = @subscriberIdentifier;
    
    EXEC [fim].[GetInitialDataBatch]
        @subscriberIdentifier = @subscriberIdentifier,
        @batchSize = @batchSize,
        @initialObjectKey = @initialObjectKey,
        @lastInitializedTime = @lastInitializedTime,
        @nextObjectKey = @nextObjectKey OUTPUT,
        @nextObjectIdentifier = @nextObjectIdentifier OUTPUT;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetInlineRights]
	@relativeViewPointGuid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@targetGuid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY

	    DECLARE @relativeViewpointKey BIGINT;
	    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
	        @objectID		= @relativeViewPointGuid,
	        @objectKey		= @relativeViewpointKey OUTPUT;

	    DECLARE @targetKey BIGINT;
	    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
	        @objectID		= @targetGuid,
	        @objectKey		= @targetKey OUTPUT;

	    DECLARE @objectTypeKey BIGINT;
	    SET @objectTypeKey = [fim].ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey(@targetKey);

	    DECLARE @SetObjectTypeKey BIGINT;
	    SET @SetObjectTypeKey = [fim].ObjectTypeKeyFromName(N'Set');
    	
	    DECLARE @ComputedMemberAttributeKey BIGINT;
	    SET @ComputedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'ComputedMember');

	    SELECT DISTINCT
		    COALESCE([bi].[AttributeKey], [ActionParameterAllRights].[ActionParameterKey]) AS AttributeKey,
		    [ActionParameterAllRights].[ActionType]
	    FROM
	    (
		    SELECT DISTINCT [r].[ActionParameterAll], [ra].[ActionParameterKey], [ro].[ActionType] 
		    FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS r 
		    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] AS ra
		    ON [r].[ObjectKey] = [ra].[ObjectKey] AND [r].[ActionParameterAll] = 0
		    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] AS ro
		    ON [r].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey] 
		    WHERE 
		    (
			    [r].[GrantRight] = 1
			    AND
			    [r].[PrincipalSet] IN
			    (
				    SELECT [ovr].[ObjectKey]
				    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS ovr
				    WHERE 
				    (
					    [ovr].ObjectTypeKey = @SetObjectTypeKey
					    AND
					    [ovr].AttributeKey = @ComputedMemberAttributeKey
					    AND
					    [ovr].ValueReference = @relativeViewpointKey
				    )
			    ) -- end [r].PrincipalSet IN
			    AND
			    [r].[ResourceCurrentSet] IN
			    (
				    SELECT [ovr].[ObjectKey]
				    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS ovr
				    WHERE 
				    (
					    [ovr].ObjectTypeKey = @SetObjectTypeKey
					    AND
					    [ovr].AttributeKey = @ComputedMemberAttributeKey
					    AND
					    [ovr].ValueReference = @targetKey
				    )
			    ) -- end [r].ResourceCurrentSet IN
		    ) -- end regular MPR check

		    UNION

		    SELECT DISTINCT [r].[ActionParameterAll], [ra].[ActionParameterKey], [ro].[ActionType] 
		    FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS r 
		    JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS ovr
		    ON
		    (
			    [ovr].ObjectKey = @targetKey
			    AND
			    [ovr].[AttributeKey] = [r].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] 
			    AND
			    [ovr].[ValueReference] = @relativeViewpointKey
		    )
		    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] AS ra
		    ON [r].[ObjectKey] = [ra].[ObjectKey] AND [r].[ActionParameterAll] = 0
		    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] AS ro
		    ON [r].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey] 
		    WHERE 
		    (
			    [r].[GrantRight] = 1
			    AND
			    [r].[ResourceCurrentSet] IN
			    (
					SELECT [ovr].[ObjectKey]
				    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS ovr
				    WHERE 
				    (
					    [ovr].ObjectTypeKey = @SetObjectTypeKey
					    AND
					    [ovr].AttributeKey = @ComputedMemberAttributeKey
					    AND
					    [ovr].ValueReference = @targetKey
				    )
			    ) -- end [r].[ResourceCurrentSet]IN
		    ) -- end relativeToResourceCurrent
	    ) AS ActionParameterAllRights
            JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS bi
	    ON 
	    (
		    (
		        ([ActionParameterAllRights].[ActionParameterAll] = 1)
		        OR
		        ([ActionParameterAllRights].ActionParameterKey = [bi].AttributeKey)
		    )
		    AND
		    [bi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey 
	    )
	    ORDER BY AttributeKey;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        RETURN;
    END CATCH  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetLocaleKey]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetLocaleKey] 
    @locale		NVARCHAR(16),
    @localeKey  SMALLINT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	IF(@locale IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			@localeKey =	127;
		RETURN;
	END
	
	SELECT
		@localeKey = [li].[Key]
	FROM [fim].[LocaleInternal] AS [li]
	WHERE
	(
		([li].[Name] = @locale)
	);

	IF(@localeKey IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		RETURN;
	END

-- Not affect Chinese languages or special cases because they were handled in the previous SELECT
	SELECT
		@localeKey = [li].[Key]
	FROM [fim].[LocaleInternal] AS [li]
	WHERE
	(
		([li].[Name] = LEFT (@locale, 2))
	);
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetMaDataObjectIdentifier]
    @maDataGuid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @objectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @objectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'ma-data');

    DECLARE @syncConfigIdAttributeKey SMALLINT
    SELECT @syncConfigIdAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'SyncConfig-id');
    
    DECLARE @maDataGuidString NVARCHAR(38);
    SELECT @maDataGuidString = '{' + CAST(@maDataGuid AS NVARCHAR(36)) + '}';
    

    SELECT [ObjectIdentifiers].[ValueIdentifier]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ObjectIdentifiers]
        ON [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [ObjectIdentifiers].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE 
            [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey 
	    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @syncConfigIdAttributeKey 
	    AND ValueString = @maDataGuidString;
            
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetMembersNotInSets]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetMembersNotInSets]
	@SetIdentifiers XML(CONTENT [fim].[ReferenceSchemaCollection]), 
	@Values XML(CONTENT [fim].[ReferenceSchemaCollection])
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


   SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @computedMemberAttributeKey SMALLINT;    
    DECLARE @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    
    SELECT
        @computedMemberAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');

    SELECT o.value('.[1]', 'uniqueidentifier') AS NonReferencedMembers
    FROM @Values.nodes('/v') O(o)
    EXCEPT
    (
        SELECT 
            [refID].[ValueIdentifier]
        FROM 
        (
            SELECT o.value('.[1]', 'uniqueidentifier') AS [setIdentifier]
            FROM @SetIdentifiers.nodes('/v') O(o)
        ) AS setID
        JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [setKey]
            ON [setKey].[ValueIdentifier] = [setID].[setIdentifier]
            AND [setKey].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
        JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ref]
            ON [ref].[ObjectKey] = [setKey].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ref].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
        JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [refID]
            ON [refID].[ObjectKey] = [ref].[ValueReference]
            AND [refID].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
    )    
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetMultipleResourceProperties]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetMultipleResourceProperties]
    @identifierList fim.IdentifierListInternal READONLY
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @Cursor CURSOR;
	DECLARE @id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
    
	SET @Cursor = CURSOR FOR
    SELECT Identifier from @identifierList

    OPEN @Cursor 
    FETCH NEXT FROM @Cursor 
    INTO @id

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
		EXECUTE [fim].[GetResourceProperties]
				@identifier = @id;
					
      FETCH NEXT FROM @Cursor 
      INTO @id 
    END; 

    CLOSE @Cursor ;
    DEALLOCATE @Cursor;

END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetObjectFromEmail]
    @email NVARCHAR (MAX), 
    @objectType NVARCHAR (448), 
    @userID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @emailAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @objectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    
    SELECT @userID = [fim].[GetEmptyGuid]();
    
    SELECT 
        @emailAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Email'),
        @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](@objectType);

    SELECT @userID = [oi].[ValueIdentifier]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ov]
    JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [oi]
        ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [oi].[ObjectKey]
        AND [oi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey
        AND [oi].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
    WHERE 
            [ov].[ValueString] = @email 
        AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = @emailAttributeKey;

END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetObjectIdentifiersByType]
    @objectType NVARCHAR (448)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @objectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @objectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (@objectType);  
    
    DECLARE @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectID');
    
    -- Deleted objects may still have an ObjectID value but they won't have ObjectType.
    DECLARE @objectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectType');

    SELECT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS [ObjectID]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
    JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON [ovi].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE 
            [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey    -- should only exist one ObjectType row per object.
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey;
            
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
    @objectID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
    @objectTypeKey SMALLINT = NULL OUTPUT, 
    @objectKey BIGINT = NULL OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	DECLARE @identifierAttributeKey SMALLINT;
	
	SELECT
	    @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
	    @objectKey = NULL;
	
	SELECT	
		@objectKey = [identifier].[ObjectKey],
		@objectTypeKey = [identifier].[ObjectTypeKey] 
	FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [identifier]
	WHERE	
	(
		([identifier].[ValueIdentifier] = @objectID)
		AND
		([identifier].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey)
	);	
	
	IF(@objectKey IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @effectiveTypeKey SMALLINT;
		SET @effectiveTypeKey = @objectTypeKey;
		IF(@effectiveTypeKey IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @effectiveTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Resource');
		END
		
		BEGIN TRANSACTION
	
		INSERT INTO [fim].[Objects]
		(
			ObjectTypeKey,
			ObjectID
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@effectiveTypeKey,
			@objectID
		);
		
		SET @objectKey = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
		
		INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier]
		(
			ObjectKey,
			ObjectTypeKey,
			AttributeKey,
			ValueIdentifier
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@objectKey,
			@effectiveTypeKey,
			@identifierAttributeKey,
			@objectID
		);
		
		COMMIT TRANSACTION
	END
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetObjectTypesFromIdentifiers]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetObjectTypesFromIdentifiers]
    @values XML(CONTENT [fim].[ReferenceSchemaCollection])
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT DISTINCT [oti].[Name] 
    FROM
    (
        SELECT o.value('.[1]', 'uniqueidentifier') AS [item]
        FROM @values.nodes('/v') O(o)
    ) [Identifiers]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        ON [Identifiers].[item] = [o].[ObjectID] 
    LEFT JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
        ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key];     
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetReferencingSyncRules]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetReferencingSyncRules]
    @maDataGuid NVARCHAR(38)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @synchronizationRuleObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @connectedSystemAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @managementAgentIDAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        
    SELECT 
        @synchronizationRuleObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'SynchronizationRule'),
        @connectedSystemAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ConnectedSystem'),
        @managementAgentIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ManagementAgentID');
    
    SELECT [o].[ObjectID], [maids].[ObjectID] AS N'ManagementAgentID'
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @managementAgentIDAttributeKey
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [maids]
        ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [maids].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @synchronizationRuleObjectTypeKey 
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @connectedSystemAttributeKey
        AND [ovs].[ValueString] = @maDataGuid
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetReportingJobHoldingService]
    @reportingJobIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER   
AS
BEGIN	
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************    
    DECLARE @reportingJobObjectKey BIGINT;
    
    BEGIN TRY
        -- verify the jobIdentifier parameter
          EXECUTE [fim].[ValidateReportingJobIdentifier]
                @reportingJobIdentifier = @reportingJobIdentifier,
                @reportingJobObjectKey = @reportingJobObjectKey OUTPUT;                
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH            
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];                  
    END CATCH

    SELECT [rpj].[ServiceIdentifier]
    FROM [fim].[ReportingJobs] AS [rpj]
    WHERE [rpj].[JobIdentifierKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey;
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetRequestCreationOutputParameters]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetRequestCreationOutputParameters]
    @targetIdentifier       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL OUTPUT, 
    @trace                  BIT                 = 0,
    @requestIdentifier      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @displayName            NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL OUTPUT,
    @targetObjectTypeName   NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL OUTPUT,
    @time                   DATETIME            = NULL OUTPUT
AS
-- Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

    DECLARE @startTime                    DATETIME;
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Declare and initialize variables.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    
    DECLARE        
        @requestKey                                             BIGINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey                                   SMALLINT,
        @resourceKey                                            BIGINT;

    SELECT 
        @requestKey = [fim].[ObjectKeyFromObjectIdentifier](@requestIdentifier),
        @requestObjectTypeKey                       = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @displayName                                = N'',                
        @targetObjectTypeName                       = NULL,
        @time                                       = NULL,
        @targetIdentifier                           = NULL,
        @resourceKey                                = NULL; 

        SELECT @resourceKey = [r].[ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] [r]
        WHERE [r].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [r].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [r].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Target');

        SELECT @displayName = [s].[ValueString]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] [s]
        WHERE [s].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [s].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [s].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName');

        SELECT @time = [d].[ValueDateTime]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] [d]
        WHERE [d].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [d].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [d].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime');

        SELECT @targetObjectTypeName = [s].[ValueString]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] [s]
        WHERE [s].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [s].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [s].[AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'TargetObjectType');

     SELECT 
         @targetIdentifier = [fim].[ObjectIDFromObjectKey](@resourceKey);

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'GetRequestCreationOutputParameters';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetResourceAttributes]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetResourceAttributes]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey    SMALLINT,
        @objectIdentifierKey                SMALLINT,
        @resourceObjectKey                  BIGINT;

    SELECT
        @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey    = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'AttributeTypeDescription'), 
        @objectIdentifierKey                = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectID');

    SELECT @resourceObjectKey = [oti].[ObjectKey] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
    WHERE [oti].[Name] = N'Resource';
    
    SELECT
        [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS [AttributeTypeIdentifier],
        [ai].[Name] AS [AttributeTypeName]
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [bi].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON  [ai].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [ovi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey
    WHERE [bi].[ObjectType] = N'Resource';

END
