/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetResourceProperties]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetResourceProperties]
    @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @typeKey  AS SMALLINT
	DECLARE @objectKey BIGINT

    SELECT 
        @typeKey = [t].[Key],
        @objectKey = [o].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [t]
        ON [t].[Key] = [o].[ObjectTypeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectID] = @identifier

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueBoolean] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'boolean' AS 'type'
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        convert(nvarchar(MAX),[o].[ValueDateTime], 25),
        'datetime' AS 'type'
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueInteger] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'integer' AS 'type'
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueReference] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'reference' AS 'type'
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueString] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'string' AS 'type'
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueText] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'text' AS 'type'
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey


    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        [o].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        CAST ([o].[ValueXml] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),   
        'xml' AS 'type'
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Key] = [o].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE 
            [o].[ObjectKey] = @objectKey
        AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = @typeKey;
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetSyncRuleByConnectedSystemAndPrecedence]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetSyncRuleByConnectedSystemAndPrecedence]
@ReturnAttributes XML, 
@ConnectedSystem NVARCHAR (448), 
@Precedence SMALLINT=NULL, 
@GreaterThan BIT=1
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
    DECLARE @synchronizationRuleObjectTypeKey SMALLINT; 
    SET @synchronizationRuleObjectTypeKey = [fim].ObjectTypeKeyFromName(N'SynchronizationRule');

    DECLARE @connectedSystemAttributeKey SMALLINT; 
    SET @connectedSystemAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'ConnectedSystem');

    DECLARE @precedenceAttributekey SMALLINT; 
    SET @precedenceAttributekey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'Precedence');

    WITH rules(ObjectKey)
	AS
	(
        SELECT DISTINCT	
            [cs].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [cs]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [os]
            ON [os].[ObjectKey] = [cs].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [oi]
            ON [oi].[ObjectKey] = [cs].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE  
            [cs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @synchronizationRuleObjectTypeKey
        AND [os].[AttributeKey] = @connectedSystemAttributeKey 
        AND [os].[ValueString] = @ConnectedSystem
        AND [oi].[AttributeKey] = @precedenceAttributekey
        AND  
        (	
                @Precedence IS NULL
            OR
            (
                @Precedence IS NOT NULL
                AND
                (
                        (
                                @GreaterThan = 1
                            AND [oi].[ValueInteger] > @Precedence
                        )
                    OR  (
                                 @GreaterThan = 0
                            AND [oi].[ValueInteger] < @Precedence
                        )
                )
            )
        )
    ) 
    ,
    ObjectOrdering(ObjectKey, Ordering, ReverseOrdering)
    AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [r].[ObjectKey],
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY [r].[ObjectKey] ASC) AS [Index],
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY [r].[ObjectKey] DESC) AS [ReverseIndex]
        FROM rules  AS [r]		
    )

    SELECT  
        [oi].[ObjectKey],
        [oi].[ObjectID] AS [ObjectIdentifier],
        [oi].[ObjectTypeKey], 
        [ai].[Key] AS [AttributeKey],
        [valueBinary].[ValueBinary],
        [valueBoolean].[ValueBoolean],  
        [valueDateTime].[ValueDateTime],
        [valueInteger].[ValueInteger],
        [valueReference].[ValueReference],
        [valueIdentifier].[ValueIdentifier] AS [ValueReferenceIdentifier],
        127 AS [LocaleKey],
        [valueString].[ValueString],
        [valueText].[ValueText],
        [o].[Ordering] as [Ordering],
        [o].[ReverseOrdering] as [ReverseOrdering]            
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [oi]     
    INNER JOIN ObjectOrdering AS [o]
        ON [oi].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]	
    CROSS JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] as [valueBinary]
        ON [valueBinary].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]	
        AND [valueBinary].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        AND [valueBinary].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oi].[ObjectTypeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] as [valueBoolean]
        ON [valueBoolean].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        AND [valueBoolean].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        AND [valueBoolean].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oi].[ObjectTypeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] as [valueDateTime]
        ON [valueDateTime].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        AND [valueDateTime].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        AND [valueDateTime].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oi].[ObjectTypeKey]     		
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] as [valueInteger]
        ON [valueInteger].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        AND [valueInteger].[AttributeKey] = ai.[Key]
        AND [valueInteger].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oi].[ObjectTypeKey] 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] as [valueReference]
        ON [valueReference].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        AND [valueReference].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        AND [valueReference].[ObjectTypeKey]= [oi].[ObjectTypeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] as [valueIdentifier]
        ON [valueIdentifier].[ObjectKey]  =[valueReference].[ValueReference]
        AND[valueIdentifier].[AttributeKey] = 0
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] as [valueString] 	  
        ON [valueString].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        AND [valueString].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        AND [valueString].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oi].[ObjectTypeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] as [valueText]     
        ON [valueText].[ObjectKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        AND [valueText].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
        AND [valueText].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oi].[ObjectTypeKey]
    WHERE 
    (
        [ai].[Name]   
        IN
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                Root.attributeNames.value('.','NVARCHAR(448)')
            FROM @ReturnAttributes.nodes('/Attributes/AttributeName') Root(attributeNames)
        )	   
    );

 END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetSystemWorkloadData]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetSystemWorkloadData]
    @returnPerformanceCounterData   BIT,
    @systemThrottleLevel            INT OUTPUT,
    @systemWorkloadInPercent        SMALLINT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
    
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * A. Getting the statistics on the execution of the sprocs
    *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF @returnPerformanceCounterData = 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT [p].[name],
            [eps].[execution_count],
            [eps].[total_logical_reads],
            [eps].[total_logical_writes],
            [eps].[total_elapsed_time]
        FROM [sys].[dm_exec_procedure_stats] AS [eps]
        INNER JOIN [sys].[procedures] AS [p]
            ON [eps].[object_id] = [p].[object_id]
        WHERE [p].[name] IN (
                                N'DoEvaluateRequestInner',
                                N'ExecuteQuery',
                                N'DoRequestCreation',
                                N'DoProcessRequest' 
                            )
    END;
    
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * B. Getting the value of the SQL Workload: CPU usage% counter
    *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    -- Only Enterprise Editions have Resource Governor feature
    IF SERVERPROPERTY('EngineEdition') = 3
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @cpuCount           SMALLINT,
                    @cpuUsageObjectName NVARCHAR(448);
                    
            SELECT @cpuCount = [cpu_count]
            FROM [sys].[dm_os_sys_info];

            -- Named instances of SQL Server have names of the objects in [sys].[dm_os_performance_counters] reflect the instance name
            SELECT @cpuUsageObjectName =
                CASE
                    WHEN SERVERPROPERTY(N'InstanceName') IS NULL
                        THEN N'SQLServer:Workload Group Stats'
                    ELSE N'MSSQL$' + CAST(SERVERPROPERTY(N'InstanceName') AS NVARCHAR(448)) + N':Workload Group Stats'
                END;

            SELECT @systemWorkloadInPercent = CAST([cntr_value] / 10 / @cpuCount AS SMALLINT)
            FROM [sys].[dm_os_performance_counters]
            WHERE   [counter_name] = N'CPU usage %'
                AND [instance_name] = N'default'
                AND [object_name] = @cpuUsageObjectName;
            
            IF @systemWorkloadInPercent IS NULL
            BEGIN
                RAISERROR(N'Workload Group Stats: CPU usage data not found.', 16, 1)
            END
        END
    ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- Data about the load is not present due to SQL Server edition limitation
            -- Letting Throttling to make decisions based on Service machine CPU load
            SELECT @systemWorkloadInPercent = 0;
        END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * C. Get the SystemThrottleLevel
    *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    DECLARE @systemThrottleLevelAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @systemThrottleLevelAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmSystemThrottleLevel');
    SELECT @systemThrottleLevel = CAST([fim].[GetIntegerSystemConfigurationSetting](@systemThrottleLevelAttributeKey) AS INT);
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetTargetObjectsForRequest]
    @requestKey         BIGINT,
    @targetObjects      XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection]) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @targetObjects  =
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [allObjectTypeKeys].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
            [oti].[Name] AS [ObjectType],
            [allObjectTypeKeys].[ObjectTypeKey] AS [ObjectTypeKey],
            [allObjectTypeKeys].[Deleted] AS [Deleted]
        FROM
        (
            SELECT 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[Deleted] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
            WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 

            UNION

            SELECT 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[Deleted] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
            WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 

            UNION

            SELECT 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[Deleted] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
            WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 

            UNION

            SELECT 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[Deleted] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputIdentifier] AS [ro]
            WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 

            UNION

            SELECT 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[Deleted] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
            WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 

            UNION

            SELECT 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[Deleted] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 

            UNION

            SELECT 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[Deleted] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
            WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 

            UNION

            SELECT 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[Deleted] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
            WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
            
            UNION

            SELECT 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[Deleted] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputXml] AS [ro]
            WHERE [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 

        ) AS [allObjectTypeKeys]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
            ON [allObjectTypeKeys].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key]
        FOR XML RAW ('TargetObject')
    );
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[GetUserFromName]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Read Only
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[GetUserFromName]
    @Name NVARCHAR (MAX),
    @DomainName NVARCHAR (MAX),
    @UserID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT @UserID = [fim].[GetEmptyGuid]()

    DECLARE @accountNameAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @accountNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AccountName');

    DECLARE @domainAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @domainAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Domain');

    DECLARE @userObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @userObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Person');

    SELECT @UserID = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](ovsA.[ObjectKey])
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] as [ovsA]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] as [ovsD]
    ON
        [ovsA].[ObjectKey] = [ovsD].[ObjectKey]    
    WHERE 
            @Name = [ovsA].[ValueString]
        AND [ovsA].[ObjectTypeKey] = @userObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovsA].[AttributeKey] = @accountNameAttributeKey
        
        AND @DomainName = [ovsD].[ValueString]
        AND [ovsD].[ObjectTypeKey] = @userObjectTypeKey
        AND [ovsD].[AttributeKey] = @domainAttributeKey;
      
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[IdentifyInvalidReferences]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[IdentifyInvalidReferences]
	@candidates XML(CONTENT [fim].[ReferenceSchemaCollection])
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @createdTimeAttributeKey SMALLINT; 
    
    SELECT @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime');

    DECLARE @candidate TABLE
    (
        [Identifier]    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [Identifier]
        )
    )
    
    INSERT INTO @candidate
    (
        [Identifier]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT node.value('.[1]', 'uniqueidentifier') AS [Value]
    FROM @candidates.nodes('/v') Root(node);
    
    DELETE [candidate]
    FROM @candidate AS [candidate]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
        ON  [candidate].[Identifier] = [object].[ObjectID]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [current]
        ON  [object].[ObjectKey] = [current].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE       [current].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;   
    
    SELECT [candidate].[Identifier]
    FROM @candidate AS [candidate];    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[IfRequestHaveNotLoggedYet]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[IfRequestHaveNotLoggedYet] 
    @objectID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @requestKey BIGINT;
    DECLARE @res BIT = 1;
    
    SELECT @requestKey = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
    WHERE [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] = @objectID
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = 0;           -- The ObjectID attribute is always 0

    SELECT @res = 0 FROM [fim].[HybridReportingRequestsLogged]
    WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

    IF (@res = 1)
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[HybridReportingRequestsLogged]([RequestKey])
        VALUES(@requestKey);
    END
        
    SELECT @res; 

END
GO

--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[InitializeSubscriberWatermark]
    @subscriptionKey SMALLINT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @exportLogKey BIGINT;
    
    SELECT @exportLogKey = MIN([el].[ExportLogKey])
    FROM [fim].[ExportLog] AS [el];

    UPDATE [fim].[ExportSubscription]
    SET [Watermark] = @exportLogKey
    WHERE [SubscriptionKey] = @subscriptionKey;
    
    EXEC [fim].[InitializeSubscriberTime] @subscriptionKey = @subscriptionKey;

GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[InsertLocaleInternal]
    @name    NVARCHAR (16), 
    @key    SMALLINT OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON;
BEGIN

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [li].[Key]
        FROM [fim].[LocaleInternal] AS [li]
        WHERE [li].[Name] = @name
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            @key = [li].[Key]
        FROM [fim].[LocaleInternal] AS [li]
        WHERE [li].[Name] = @name
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[LocaleInternal]
        (
            [Name]
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @name
        );
        
        SELECT @key = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[LockResource]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[LockResource]
	@objectKey BIGINT,
	@scope     NVARCHAR(64) = N'',
	@lockOwner NVARCHAR(16) = N'Transaction',
    @lockTimeout INT = @@LOCK_TIMEOUT

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @acquiredLock SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @resourceName NVARCHAR(255);
    SELECT @resourceName = N'FimResource-' + @scope + CAST(@objectKey AS NVARCHAR(19));

    EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
        @Resource = @resourceName,
        @LockMode = 'Exclusive',
        @LockOwner = @lockOwner,
        @LockTimeout = @lockTimeout;
        
    -- refer to the sp_getapplock API to understand the return values
    RETURN @acquiredLock;
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[MaintainSet]
    @setKey                             BIGINT,
    @reportOnly                         BIT                 = 0,
    @setIdentifier                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    = NULL,
    @setTypeKey                         SMALLINT            = NULL,
    @setTypeName                        NVARCHAR(448)       = NULL,
    @falseFlag                          BIT                 = NULL,
    @trueFlag                           BIT                 = NULL,
    @computedMemberAttributeKey         SMALLINT            = NULL,
    @explicitMemberAttributeKey         SMALLINT            = NULL
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @falseFlag;

    
    BEGIN TRY
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoMaintainSet]
                @setKey                         = @setKey,
                @reportOnly                     = @reportOnly,
                @setIdentifier                  = @setIdentifier,
                @setTypeKey                     = @setTypeKey,
                @setTypeName                    = @setTypeName,
                @falseFlag                      = @falseFlag,
                @trueFlag                       = @trueFlag,
                @computedMemberAttributeKey     = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                @explicitMemberAttributeKey     = @explicitMemberAttributeKey;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[MaintainSets]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[MaintainSets]
    @objectTypeKey  SMALLINT    = NULL,
    @reportOnly     BIT         = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  This procedure is for correcting the membership of resources with members
 *  that are identified by an XPath filter expression.  Such resources are 
 *  referred to by the generic term, "set."  
 *
 *  By default, resources of which the the ObjectType is "Set" or "Group" may 
 *  have members identified by an XPath filter expression.  
 *
 *  The procedure identifies all of the resource of a given ObjectType, and then
 *  iterates through those resources.  For each resource, the MaintainSet 
 *  procedure is invoked to identify and correct any errors in the membership of
 *  that resource.  
 *
 *  The order in which the procedure iterates through the resource relies
 *  on the concept of set nesting.  
 *
 *  If the membership of one set depends on the membership of another set, then
 *  the first set is said to nest the second set, and the second set is said to
 *  be nested by the first set.  For example, if Set X consists of all full-time
 *  employees, and Set Y consists of everyone whose manager is in Set X, then 
 *  Set Y nests Set X, and Set X is nested by Set Y.  
 *
 *  If there is an error in the membership of Set X that needs to be corrected, 
 *  then that will quite possibly entail that there is an error in the 
 *  membership of Set Y that must be corrected as well.  Therefore, the procedure 
 *  iterates through the resources starting with the nested sets and then proceeding 
 *  to the nesting ones.  
 *
 *  Determining the right order is complicated by the fact that one nesting set 
 *  might in turn be nested by another nesting set.  
 *
 *  For the purpose of explaining the process of identifying the order, assume
 *  that there are five sets nested in the following way: 
 *
 *  Set                     Nests
 *  1                       5
 *  2                       -
 *  3                       1
 *  4                       5
 *  5                       -
 *
 *  That is, Sets 1 and 4 nest set 5, and Set 3 nests Set 1, so the order in 
 *  which the membership of the sets is corrected must have Set 5 preceeding 
 *  Sets 1 and 4, and the correction of Sets 1 must precede the correction
 *  of Set 3.  
 *
 *  Because it is possible that there is a circular chain of nesting among
 *  the sets, the iteration must be sure to terminate.  The membership of sets
 *  in a circular chain of nesting is specified as being indeterminate.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    BEGIN TRY
        
        
        DECLARE 
            @currentTime                    DATETIME,
            @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey SMALLINT,
            @index                          INT,
            @trueFlag                       BIT,
            @falseFlag                      BIT,
            @createdTimeAttributeKey        SMALLINT,
            @computedMemberAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
            @explicitMemberAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
            @identifierAttributeKey         SMALLINT,
            @objectTypeName                 NVARCHAR(448),
            @setIdentifier                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            @setKey                         BIGINT;
            
        SELECT
            @currentTime                =   GETUTCDATE(),
            @falseFlag                  =   CONVERT(BIT,0),
            @trueFlag                   =   CONVERT(BIT,1);        
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @falseFlag;
        
        IF @objectTypeKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT @objectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Set');
        END
        
        SELECT
            @computedMemberAttributeKey         =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
            @createdTimeAttributeKey            =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
            @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey     =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmDeferredEvaluation'),
            @explicitMemberAttributeKey         =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ExplicitMember'),
            @identifierAttributeKey             =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
            @objectTypeName                     =   [fim].[ObjectTypeNameFromKey](@objectTypeKey);
            
        EXECUTE [fim].[MaintainStatements]
            @reportOnly = @reportOnly,
            @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag = @falseFlag;      
            
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * A.   Identify all of the sets of the specified type, and copy those into 
     *      #maintainSetsAll. Do not include the groups marked for deferred evaluation
     *
     *      Order   SetKey  DependentSetKey
     *      1       1       1
     *      2       2       2
     *      3       3       3
     *      4       4       4
     *      5       5       5
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetsAll') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #maintainSetsAll;
        END  
        
        CREATE TABLE #maintainSetsAll
        (
            [Order]             INT     IDENTITY(0,1)   NOT NULL,
            [SetKey]            BIGINT                  NOT NULL,
            [DependentSetKey]   BIGINT                  NOT NULL
        );
        
        INSERT INTO #maintainSetsAll
        (
            [SetKey],
            [DependentSetKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [existingSet].[ObjectKey],
            [existingSet].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [existingSet]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [deferred]
            ON      [existingSet].[ObjectKey] = [deferred].[ObjectKey]
                AND [deferred].[AttributeKey] = @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey
        WHERE
                [existingSet].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey
            AND [existingSet].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
            AND ISNULL([deferred].[ValueBoolean], @falseFlag) = @falseFlag -- Include only groups that are not marked for Deferred Evaluation
        ORDER BY
                [existingSet].[ObjectKey];
                
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetsAll]
        ON #maintainSetsAll
        (
            [Order],
            [SetKey],
            [DependentSetKey]
        );  
        
        CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetsAll_Order_DependentSetKey_SetKey]
        ON #maintainSetsAll
        (
            [Order],
            [DependentSetKey],
            [SetKey]
        );  
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetsAll_SetKey]
        ON #maintainSetsAll
        (
            [SetKey]
        );  
        
        CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetsAll_SetKey_DependentSetKey]
        ON #maintainSetsAll
        (
            [SetKey],
            [DependentSetKey]
        );  

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * B.   Add the direct nesting relationships to #maintainSetsAll.  
     *
     *      Order   SetKey  DependentSetKey
     *      1       1       1
     *      2       2       2
     *      3       3       3
     *      4       4       4
     *      5       5       5
     *      ------------------------------
     *      6       1       5
     *      7       3       1
     *      8       4       5
     *
     *      Note that any nesting of a set by itself is excluded.  
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [set].[SetKey]
            FROM #maintainSetsAll AS [set]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [membershipCondition]
                ON [set].[SetKey] = [membershipCondition].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                AND [set].[SetKey] != [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
                    
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #maintainSetsAll
            (
                [SetKey],
                [DependentSetKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [set].[SetKey],
                [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
            FROM #maintainSetsAll AS [set]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [membershipCondition]
                ON [set].[SetKey] = [membershipCondition].[SetKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statements]
                ON [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [statements].[MembershipConditionKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                ON [statements].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            WHERE
                    [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                AND [set].[SetKey] != [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
            ORDER BY [set].[SetKey]
        END

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * C.   Iterate to identify the indirect nesting relationships.  In the case
     *      of the example, Set 3 directly nests Set 1, but because Set 1 nests
     *      Set 5, Set 3 indirectly nests Set 1.  
     *
     *      Order   SetKey  DependentSetKey
     *      1       1       1
     *      2       2       2
     *      3       3       3
     *      4       4       4
     *      5       5       5
     *      ------------------------------
     *      6       1       5
     *      7       3       1
     *      8       4       5
     *      ------------------------------
     *      9       3       5
     *
     *      Note that duplicate SetKey and DependentSetKey entries, and inverse 
     *      SetKey and DependentSetKey entries are excluded to omit circular 
     *      nesting relationships.  
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        
        DECLARE @setDependency  TABLE
        (
            [SetKey]            BIGINT,
            [DependentSetKey]   BIGINT,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [SetKey],
                [DependentSetKey]
            )
        );
        
        SELECT @index = -1;

        WHILE(1=1)
        BEGIN
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [nested].[SetKey]
                FROM #maintainSetsAll AS [nested]
                INNER JOIN #maintainSetsAll AS [nesting]
                    ON [nested].[SetKey] = [nesting].[DependentSetKey]
                    AND [nested].[SetKey] != [nesting].[DependentSetKey]
                WHERE
                        [nested].[Order] >= @index
                    AND [nesting].[Order] >= @index
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @setDependency
                (
                    [SetKey],
                    [DependentSetKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [nesting].[SetKey],
                    [nested].[DependentSetKey]
                FROM #maintainSetsAll AS [nested]
                INNER JOIN #maintainSetsAll AS [nesting]
                    ON [nested].[SetKey] = [nesting].[DependentKey]
                    AND [nested].[SetKey] != [nesting].[DependentKey]
                WHERE
                        [nested].[Order] > @index
                    AND [nesting].[Order] > @index;
                    
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                    FROM @setDependency AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #maintainSetsAll AS [duplicate]
                        ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
                        AND [candidate].[DependentSetKey] = [duplicate].[DependentSetKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE FROM @setDependency
                    FROM @setDependency AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #maintainSetsAll AS [duplicate]
                        ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
                        AND [candidate].[DependentSetKey] = [duplicate].[DependentSetKey];
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                    FROM @setDependency AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #maintainSetsAll AS [inverse]
                        ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [inverse].[DependentSetKey]
                        AND [candidate].[DependentSetKey] = [inverse].[SetKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE FROM @setDependency
                    FROM @setDependency AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN #maintainSetsAll AS [inverse]
                        ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [inverse].[DependentSetKey]
                        AND [candidate].[DependentSetKey] = [inverse].[SetKey];
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                    FROM @setDependency AS [candidate]
                )
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @index = MAX([set].[Order])
                    FROM #maintainSetsAll AS [set];
                
                    INSERT INTO #maintainSetsAll
                    (
                        [SetKey],
                        [DependentSetKey]
                    )
                    SELECT 
                        [candidate].[SetKey],
                        [candidate].[DependentSetKey]
                    FROM @setDependency AS [candidate];
                    
                    DELETE FROM @setDependency;
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END
        END
        
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * D.   Now the records in #maintainSetsAll are grouped by SetKey, and the 
     *      highest value of Order, for each SetKey is copied into 
     *      #maintainSetsOrder.  
     *
     *      #maintainSetsAll: 
     *
     *      Order   SetKey  DependentSetKey
     *      1       1       1
     *      2       2       2
     *      3       3       3
     *      4       4       4
     *      5       5       5
     *      ------------------------------
     *      6       1       5
     *      7       3       1
     *      8       4       5
     *      ------------------------------
     *      9       3       5
     *
     *      Values of Order grouped by SetKey:
     *
     *      SetKey  Order Values
     *      1       1, 6
     *      2       2
     *      3       3, 7, 9
     *      4       4, 8
     *      5       5
     *
     *      So, highest value of Order by SetKey: 
     *      
     *      SetKey  Order
     *      1       6
     *      2       2
     *      3       9
     *      4       8
     *      5       5
     *
     *      Thus, #maintainSetsOrder: 
     *      
     *      SetKey  Order
     *      1       6
     *      2       2
     *      3       9
     *      4       8
     *      5       5
     *
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/       
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSetsOrder') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #maintainSetsOrder;
        END    
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [all].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
            MAX([all].[Order]) AS N'Order'
        INTO #maintainSetsOrder
        FROM #maintainSetsAll AS [all]
        GROUP BY [all].[SetKey]
        ORDER BY [all].[SetKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetsOrder]
        ON #maintainSetsOrder
        (
            [SetKey],
            [Order]
        ); 

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * E.   Copy the values in #maintainSetsOrder into #maintainSets, 
     *      ordering them by the value of the Order column in #maintainSetsOrder, 
     *      and adding the unique identifiers for each set: 
     *
     *      #maintainSetsOrder: 
     *      
     *      SetKey  Order
     *      1       6
     *      2       2
     *      3       9
     *      4       8
     *      5       5
     *
     *
     *      #maintainSets:
     *
     *      Order   SetKey  Identifier
     *      2       2       222222222222-2222-2222-2222-22222222
     *      5       5       555555555555-5555-5555-5555-55555555
     *      6       1       111111111111-1111-1111-1111-11111111
     *      8       4       444444444444-4444-4444-4444-44444444
     *      9       3       333333333333-3333-3333-3333-33333333
     *
     *      Note that the sequence of SetKey by Order value is now correct, with 
     *      the nested sets coming before the nesting sets.  
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/       
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainSets') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #maintainSets;
        END    
        
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [order].[Order] AS N'Order',
            [order].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
            [identifier].[ValueIdentifier] AS N'Identifier'
        INTO #maintainSets
        FROM #maintainSetsOrder AS [order]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [identifier]
            ON [order].[SetKey] = [identifier].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [identifier].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey
            AND [identifier].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
        ORDER BY [order].[Order];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSets]
        ON #maintainSets
        (
            [Order],
            [SetKey],
            [Identifier]
        );  

    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * F.   Iterate through the set in #maintainSets by the value of the Order
     *      column, invoking the MaintainSet procedure for each one.  
     *      Each attempted set correction is wrapped in a TRY CATCH block and if an
     *      Error is thrown, it will be recorded, but processing will continue
     *      with the next set.  Errors will be re-thrown at the end as a single rolled
     *      up XML string.
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/       
        
        DECLARE @failedSetCorrections TABLE
        (
            [SetKey] BIGINT,
            [ErrorMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX)
        )
        
        DECLARE setCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
        SELECT 
            [set].[SetKey],
            [set].[Identifier]
        FROM #maintainSets AS [set]
        ORDER BY [set].[Order];
        
        OPEN setCursor;
        WHILE(1=1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @setKey = NULL;
            
            FETCH NEXT FROM setCursor INTO 
                @setKey,
                @setIdentifier;
                
            IF @setKey IS NULL
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END
            
            BEGIN TRY
                EXECUTE [fim].[MaintainSet]
                    @setKey                         = @setKey,
                    @reportOnly                     = @reportOnly,
                    @setIdentifier                  = @setIdentifier,
                    @setTypeKey                     = @objectTypeKey,                        
                    @setTypeName                    = @objectTypeName,
                    @falseFlag                      = @falseFlag,                    
                    @trueFlag                       = @trueFlag,                    
                    @computedMemberAttributeKey     = @computedMemberAttributeKey,   
                    @explicitMemberAttributeKey     = @explicitMemberAttributeKey;
            END TRY
            BEGIN CATCH
                -- Record the error and continue.
                INSERT @failedSetCorrections
                (
                    [SetKey],
                    [ErrorMessage]
                )
                SELECT @setKey, ERROR_MESSAGE()
                
            END CATCH
        END
        CLOSE setCursor;
        DEALLOCATE setCursor;
        
        -- If any errors occurred during Set correction RAISE them as a single error message.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [SetKey]
            FROM @failedSetCorrections
        )
        BEGIN    
            DECLARE @errorString NVARCHAR(MAX);
            SET @errorString =
            (
                CAST(N'<Failures>' + (SELECT [SetKey], [ErrorMessage] FROM @failedSetCorrections FOR XML AUTO) + N'</Failures>' AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            );
            
            RAISERROR(@errorString, 16, 1);
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        	EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[MaintainStatement]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[MaintainStatement]
    @statementKey                       INT,
    @reportOnly                         BIT                 = 0,
    @identifierAttributeKey             SMALLINT            = NULL,
    @objectTypeAttributeKey             SMALLINT            = NULL,
    @trueFlag                           BIT                 = NULL,
    @falseFlag                          BIT                 = NULL
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  This procedure compares the actual records in the 
 *  MembershipConditionStatementTruth table--the de facto content--to the records 
 *  that should be in the table--the de jure content--for a given statement.  
 *  If there is any discrepancy between the de facto and de jure content, 
 *  the discrepancy is corrected.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
    DECLARE 
        @attributeKey               SMALLINT,
        @dataTypeKey                TINYINT,
        @dataTypeKeyInteger            TINYINT,
        @dataTypeKeyReference        TINYINT,
        @dataTypeKeyString            TINYINT,
        @functionValue              DATETIME,
        @functionValueKey           INT,
        @isText                     BIT,
        @operatorEqual              BIT,
        @operatorGreater            BIT,
        @operatorLike               BIT,
        @operatorInversion          BIT,
        @literalValueBoolean        BIT,
        @literalValueDateTime       DATETIME,
        @literalValueInteger        BIGINT,
        @literalValueReference      BIGINT,
        @literalValueString         NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @tabularFunctionValueKey    INT;
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @identifierAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @identifierAttributeKey     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    END
       
    IF @objectTypeAttributeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN 
        SELECT @objectTypeAttributeKey     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
    END
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @falseFlag;
    
    SELECT TOP 1
        @isText = 0,
        @attributeKey = [statement].[AttributeKey],
        @operatorEqual = [statement].[OperatorEqual],
        @operatorGreater = [statement].[OperatorGreater],
        @operatorLike = [statement].[OperatorLike],
        @operatorInversion = [statement].[OperatorInversion],
        @functionValueKey = [statement].[FunctionValueKey],
        @literalValueBoolean = [statement].[LiteralValueBoolean],
        @literalValueDateTime = [statement].[LiteralValueDateTime],
        @literalValueInteger = [statement].[LiteralValueInteger],
        @literalValueReference = [statement].[LiteralValueReference],
        @literalValueString = [statement].[LiteralValueString],
        @tabularFunctionValueKey = [statement].[TabularFunctionValueKey]
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
    WHERE        [statement].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
    
    SELECT
        @dataTypeKey = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromAttributeKey](@attributeKey),
        @dataTypeKeyInteger = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'Integer'),
        @dataTypeKeyReference = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'Reference'),
        @dataTypeKeyString = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'String');
    
    IF @operatorInversion = @trueFlag
    OR
    (
        @literalValueBoolean IS NULL
        AND
        @literalValueDateTime IS NULL
        AND
        @functionValueKey IS NULL
        AND
        @literalValueInteger IS NULL
        AND
        @literalValueReference IS NULL
        AND
        @literalValueString IS NULL
        AND
        @tabularFunctionValueKey IS NULL
    )
    OR @attributeKey = @identifierAttributeKey
    OR @attributeKey = @objectTypeAttributeKey
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    
        IF @functionValueKey IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT @functionValue = [mcfv].[Value]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [mcfv]
            WHERE
                    [mcfv].[FunctionValueKey] = @functionValueKey;

            IF @functionValue IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                SET @literalValueDateTime = @functionValue
            END
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.   Populate a temporary table with the resources for which the statement
 *      is true de jure.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainStatementDeJureMember') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #maintainStatementDeJureMember;
        END            
                
        CREATE TABLE #maintainStatementDeJureMember
        (
            [ObjectKey] BIGINT
        );
        
        IF @literalValueReference IS NOT NULL                           -- if #1
        BEGIN
            IF @operatorEqual != 1
            BEGIN
                    SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorEqual');
                    RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    RETURN;
            END

            INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [v]
            WHERE
                    [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                AND [v].[ValueReference] = @literalValueReference;
        END                                                             -- if #1
        ELSE IF @literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL                        -- if #2
        BEGIN
            IF @operatorEqual != 1
            BEGIN
                    SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorEqual');
                    RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    RETURN;
            END

            INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [v]
            WHERE
                    [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                AND [v].[ValueBoolean] = @literalValueBoolean;
        END                                                             -- if #2
        ELSE IF @literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL                       -- if #3
        BEGIN
            IF @operatorLike = 1                         
            BEGIN
                    SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorLike');
                    RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    RETURN;
            END

            IF @operatorEqual = 1                                       -- if #4
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [v]
                WHERE
                        [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                    AND [v].[ValueDateTime] = @literalValueDateTime;
            END                                                         -- if #4
            ELSE IF @operatorGreater = 1                                -- if #5
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [v]
                WHERE
                        [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                    AND [v].[ValueDateTime] > @literalValueDateTime;
            END                                                         -- if #5
        END                                                             -- if #3
        ELSE IF @literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL                        -- if #6
        BEGIN
            IF @operatorLike = 1
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorLike');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                RETURN;
            END

            IF @operatorEqual = 1                                       -- if #7
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [v]
                WHERE
                        [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                    AND [v].[ValueInteger] = @literalValueInteger;
            END                                                         -- if #7
            ELSE IF @operatorGreater = 1                                -- if #8
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [v]
                WHERE
                        [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                    AND v.[ValueInteger] > @literalValueInteger;
            END                                                         -- if #8
        END                                                             -- if #6
        ELSE IF @literalValueString IS NOT NULL                         -- if #9
        BEGIN
            IF @operatorGreater = 1                                     
            BEGIN
                    SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorGreater');
                    RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    RETURN;
            END

            IF [fim].[AttributeTypeFromKey](@attributeKey) = N'Text'
            BEGIN
                SELECT @isText = 1;
            END

            IF @operatorEqual = 1                                       -- if #10
            BEGIN
                IF @isText = 0                                          -- if #11
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                    (
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [v]
                    WHERE
                            [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                        AND [v].[ValueString] = @literalValueString
                END                                         
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                    (
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [v]
                    WHERE
                            [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                        AND [v].[ValueText] = @literalValueString
                END                                                     -- if #11
            END                                                         -- if #10
            ELSE IF @operatorLike = 1                                   -- if #12
            BEGIN
                IF @isText = 0                                          -- if #13
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                    (
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [v]
                    WHERE
                            [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                        AND [v].[ValueString] LIKE @literalValueString
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                    (
                        [ObjectKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT [v].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [v]
                    WHERE
                            [v].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
                        AND [v].[ValueText] LIKE @literalValueString
                END                                                     -- if #13
            END                                                         -- if #12
        END                                                             -- if #9
        ELSE IF @tabularFunctionValueKey IS NOT NULL                    -- if #14
        BEGIN
            IF @dataTypeKey = @dataTypeKeyInteger                        -- if #15
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT [value].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [value]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
                    ON    [value].[ValueInteger] = [function].[Value]
                WHERE    
                        [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionValueKey
                    AND    [value].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
            END                                                            -- if #15
            ELSE IF @dataTypeKey = @dataTypeKeyReference                -- if #16
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT [value].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [function]
                    ON    [value].[ValueReference] = [function].[Value]
                WHERE    
                        [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionValueKey
                    AND    [value].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
            END                                                            -- if #16
            ELSE IF @dataTypeKey = @dataTypeKeyString                    -- if #17
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #maintainStatementDeJureMember
                (
                    [ObjectKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT [value].[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [value]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue] AS [function]
                    ON    [value].[ValueString] = [function].[Value]
                WHERE    
                        [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionValueKey
                    AND    [value].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
            END                                                            -- if #17
        END                                                                -- if #14
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeJureMember]
        ON #maintainStatementDeJureMember
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        ); 
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.   Populate a temporary table with the resources for which the statement
 *      is true de facto.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [deFacto].[ResourceKey]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [deFacto]
            WHERE
                    [deFacto].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#maintainStatementDeFactoMember') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #maintainStatementDeFactoMember;
            END
        
            SELECT DISTINCT [deFacto].[ResourceKey] AS N'ObjectKey'
            INTO #maintainStatementDeFactoMember
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [deFacto]
            WHERE
                    [deFacto].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MaintainSetDeFactoMember]
            ON #maintainStatementDeFactoMember
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            ); 
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.   Identify any resources for which the statement is true de facto 
 *      for which it is also true de jure.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [deFacto].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #maintainStatementDeFactoMember AS [deFacto]
                INNER JOIN #maintainStatementDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                    ON [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = [deJure].[ObjectKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM #maintainStatementDeFactoMember
                FROM #maintainStatementDeFactoMember AS [deFacto]
                INNER JOIN #maintainStatementDeJureMember AS [deJure]
                    ON [deFacto].[ObjectKey] = [deJure].[ObjectKey];
            END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.   Falsify the statement for any resources for which it is true de facto
 *      but not de jure.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [notDeJure].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #maintainStatementDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
            )
            BEGIN
                IF @reportOnly = @trueFlag
                BEGIN
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @statementKey AS N'StatementKey',
                        [defacto].[ObjectKey] AS N'FalsePositive'
                    FROM #maintainStatementDeFactoMember AS [defacto];
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    DELETE FROM [deFacto]
                    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [deFacto]
                    INNER JOIN #maintainStatementDeFactoMember AS [notDeJure]
                        ON  [deFacto].[ResourceKey] = [notDeJure].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE
                            [deFacto].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
                        
                END
            END
        END 
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.   Identify any resources for which the statement is true de jure, but 
 *      not de facto.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [deJure].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #maintainStatementDeJureMember AS [deJure]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [deFacto]
                ON [deJure].[ObjectKey] = [deFacto].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [deFacto].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [deJure]
            FROM #maintainStatementDeJureMember AS [deJure]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [deFacto]
                ON [deJure].[ObjectKey] = [deFacto].[ResourceKey]
            WHERE
                    [deFacto].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
        END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.   Record the truth of the statement for resources for which the statement
 *      is true de jure, but not de facto.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [deJure].[ObjectKey]
            FROM #maintainStatementDeJureMember AS [deJure]
        )
        BEGIN
            IF @reportOnly = @trueFlag
            BEGIN
                SELECT
                    @statementKey AS N'StatementKey',
                    [deJure].[ObjectKey] AS N'FalseNegative'
                FROM #maintainStatementDeJureMember AS [deJure];
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ResourceKey]
                )
                SELECT
                    @statementKey,
                    [deJure].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #maintainStatementDeJureMember AS [deJure];
                
            END
            
        END    

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[MaintainStatements]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[MaintainStatements]
    @reportOnly                         BIT                 = 0,
    @trueFlag                           BIT                 = NULL,
    @falseFlag                          BIT                 = NULL
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @falseFlag;
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  This procedure calls the MaintainStatement procedure for each set filtering
 *  statement.  Refer to the MaintainStatement procedure for an explanation of 
 *  that procedure's purpose.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
     
    DECLARE 
        @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @statementKey               INT;
        
    SELECT
        @identifierAttributeKey     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement]   AS  [statement]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal]       AS  [type]
            ON     [statement].[LiteralValueString] = [type].[Name]
        WHERE
                    [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            AND     [statement].[ObjectTypeKey] != [type].[Key]
    )
    BEGIN
        IF @reportOnly = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [statement].[StatementKey]  AS  [StatementKey],
                [statement].[ObjectTypeKey] AS  [Incorrect Object Type Key],
                [type].[Key]                AS  [Correct Object Type Key]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [type]
                ON     [statement].[LiteralValueString] = [type].[Name]
            WHERE
                        [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                AND     [statement].[ObjectTypeKey] != [type].[Key];
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement]
            SET [ObjectTypeKey] = [type].[Key]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement]   AS  [statement]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal]       AS  [type]
                ON     [statement].[LiteralValueString] = [type].[Name]
            WHERE
                        [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
                AND     [statement].[ObjectTypeKey] != [type].[Key];
            
        END
    END
        
    IF @reportOnly != @trueFlag
    AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [truth].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]  AS  [truth]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
            OR  [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            OR  [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
            OR  [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [truth]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON [truth].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                [statement].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
            OR  [statement].[AttributeKey] = @objectTypeAttributeKey
            OR  [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
            OR  [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag;
    END

    DECLARE statementCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR 
    SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement];
    
    OPEN statementCursor;
    WHILE 1=1
    BEGIN
        SELECT @statementKey = NULL;
        
        FETCH NEXT FROM statementCursor INTO 
            @statementKey;
            
        IF @statementKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[MaintainStatement]
            @statementKey                   = @statementKey,
            @reportOnly                     = @reportOnly,
            @identifierAttributeKey         = @identifierAttributeKey,
            @objectTypeAttributeKey         = @objectTypeAttributeKey,
            @trueFlag                       = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag                      = @falseFlag;
    END
    CLOSE statementCursor;
    DEALLOCATE statementCursor;
END
GO

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[MarkWorkItemAsCompleted]
    @workItemId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
    --Top level
BEGIN
    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    *   Completed Work Items are marked with LockOwner = NULL and LockExpiration = CONVERT(DATETIME,'9999')
    *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        UPDATE [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
        SET [LockOwner] = NULL,
            [Completed] = 1
        WHERE [WorkItemId] = @workItemId;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[MayRetryTransaction]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[MayRetryTransaction]
 @retryCount INT OUTPUT
AS
IF ((ERROR_NUMBER() in (1205)) AND (XACT_STATE() != -1)) --1205 signifies a deadlock.  Refer to http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/aa337376.aspx 
BEGIN
 IF (@retryCount IS NULL)
 BEGIN
  SET @retryCount = 3;
 END
 
 IF (@retryCount > 0)
 BEGIN
  SET @retryCount = @retryCount - 1
  RETURN 1;
 END
  
END
SET @retryCount = 0;
RETURN 0;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[OptimizeSetMembershipConditions]
    @requestKey    BIGINT    = NULL, 
    @setKey        BIGINT    = NULL,
    @trace        BIT        = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE
        @startTime    DATETIME,
        @trueFlag    BIT;
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingTabularFunctions]
        @requestKey = @requestKey,
        @setKey = @setKey,
        @trace = @trace; 
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'OptimizeSetMembershipConditions';
    END  
END
