/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions] 
    @reportOnly BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *        If a membership condition statement is associated with more than a 
 *        threshold number of sets, then it is not joined to those sets using
 *        the MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement table, but rather
 *        joined directly using the SetPartition table.  That can serve to reduce
 *        the number of sets for which an object is considered for membership in 
 *        the CalculateRequestSetTransitionsMembershipConditionEvaluation 
 *        procedure.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @activationThreshold INT,
        @falseFlag BIT,
        @identifierAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @setCount BIGINT,
        @statementKey INT,
        @threshold    TINYINT,
        @thresholdCount BIGINT,
        @tolerance TINYINT,
        @trueFlag BIT;
        
    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    SELECT
        @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
        @activationThreshold = [fim].[GetSetPartitionActivationThreshold](),
        @threshold = [fim].[GetSetPartitionThreshold](),
        @tolerance = [fim].[GetSetPartitionTolerance](),
        @setCount = 0;
        
    DECLARE @partition TABLE
    (
        [StatementKey]                INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [s].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[Set] AS [s]
        WHERE        [s].[HasMembershipConditions] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @setCount = COUNT_BIG([s].[SetKey])
        FROM [fim].[Set] AS [s]
        WHERE        [s].[HasMembershipConditions] = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    IF    @activationThreshold <= 0
    OR    @setCount < @activationThreshold
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [set].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @thresholdCount = (@threshold*@setCount)/100;
        
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAdd') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAdd;
        END
        
        SELECT
            [condition].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
            COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT [set].[SetKey]) AS [SetCount]
        INTO #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAdd
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                    [statement].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey
                AND    [statement].[AttributeKey] != @objectTypeAttributeKey
        GROUP BY
                [condition].[StatementKey]
        ORDER BY
                [condition].[StatementKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions]
        ON #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAdd
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [SetCount]
        );
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAdd AS [candidate]
            WHERE        [candidate].[SetCount] < @thresholdCount
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAdd AS [candidate]
            WHERE        [candidate].[SetCount] < @thresholdCount;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAdd AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            IF @reportOnly = @trueFlag
            BEGIN
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                    [candidate].[StatementKey] AS [Membership Partitioning Candidate Key],
                    [statement].[XPath] AS [Membership Partitioning Candidate Expression],
                    [candidate].[SetCount] AS [Number of Filters],
                    CASE 
                        WHEN 
                                (
                                        [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NULL
                                    AND    [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL
                                ) THEN @trueFlag
                        ELSE @falseFlag
                    END    AS [Partitioning Supported]
                FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAdd AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                DECLARE [addPartitionCursor] CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
                    SELECT DISTINCT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsAdd AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    WHERE
                            [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NULL
                        AND    [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NULL;
                        
                OPEN [addPartitionCursor];
                WHILE(1 = 1)
                BEGIN
                    SET @statementKey = NULL;
                  
                    FETCH NEXT FROM [addPartitionCursor] INTO 
                        @statementKey
                    
                    IF @statementKey IS NULL
                    BEGIN
                        BREAK;
                    END

                    BEGIN TRANSACTION
                        EXECUTE [fim].[DoOptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions] 
                            @statementKey = @statementKey;
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION
                END;
                CLOSE [addPartitionCursor];
                DEALLOCATE [addPartitionCursor];
            END
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [set].[SetKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [set]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @thresholdCount = ((@threshold - @tolerance)*@setCount)/100;
    
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove;
        END
        
        SELECT
            [partition].[StatementKey] AS [StatementKey],
            COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT [partition].[SetKey]) AS [SetCount]
        INTO #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove
        FROM [fim].[SetPartition] AS [partition]
        GROUP BY
                [partition].[StatementKey]
        ORDER BY
                [partition].[StatementKey];
        
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove]
        ON #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [SetCount]
        );
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove AS [candidate]
            WHERE        [candidate].[SetCount] >= @thresholdCount
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove AS [candidate]
            WHERE        [candidate].[SetCount] >= @thresholdCount;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[StatementKey]
            FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove AS [candidate]
        )
        BEGIN
            IF @reportOnly = @trueFlag
            BEGIN
                SELECT DISTINCT 
                    [candidate].[StatementKey] AS [Obsolete Membership Partition Key],
                    [statement].[XPath] AS [Membership Partitioning Candidate Expression],
                    [candidate].[SetCount] AS [Number of Filters]
                FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                    ON    [candidate].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                DECLARE [removePartitionCursor] CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
                    SELECT DISTINCT [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    FROM #optimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitionsRemove AS [candidate];
                        
                OPEN [removePartitionCursor];
                WHILE(1 = 1)
                BEGIN
                    SET @statementKey = NULL;
                  
                    FETCH NEXT FROM [removePartitionCursor] INTO 
                        @statementKey
                    
                    IF @statementKey IS NULL
                    BEGIN
                        BREAK;
                    END

                    BEGIN TRANSACTION
                        EXECUTE [fim].[DoRemoveSetMembershipConditionPartition] 
                            @statementKey = @statementKey;
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION
                END;
                CLOSE [removePartitionCursor];
                DEALLOCATE [removePartitionCursor];
            END
        END
    END    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingTabularFunctions]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingTabularFunctions] 
    @requestKey BIGINT = NULL,
    @setKey BIGINT = NULL,
    @trace BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *        Given the filter, /Person[Building=E or Building=D],
 *        two membership conditions will be produced:
 *
 *        1.    ObjectType=Person && Building=E
 *        2.    ObjectType=Person && Building=D
 *
 *        The purpose of this procedure is to optimize the representation of such
 *        filters by instead representing them with a single membership condition:
 *        1.    ObjectType=Person && Building={D || E}
 *
 *        The expression, "Building={D || E}" will be referred to as a tabular
 *        function.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @currentAttributeSignature NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @dataTypeKeyInteger TINYINT,
        @dataTypeKeyReference TINYINT,
        @dataTypeKeyString TINYINT,
        @falseFlag    BIT,
        @trueFlag    BIT,
        @attributeSignatureKey INT,
        @attributeSignatureLimit INT,
        @functionSignatureKey INT,
        @functionSignatureLimit INT,
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName NVARCHAR(32),
        @membershipConditionDocument NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @membershipConditionKey INT,
        @obsoleteConditionIndex INT,
        @obsoleteConditionKey INT,
        @obsoleteConditionLimit INT,
        @statementKey INT,
        @startTime DATETIME,
        @tabularFunctionKey INT,
        @messageText NVARCHAR(MAX);
        
    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END
        
    SELECT
        @dataTypeKeyInteger = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'Integer'),
        @dataTypeKeyReference = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'Reference'),
        @dataTypeKeyString = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'String'),
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName = [fim].[GetMembershipConditionAncillaryParameterName]();        
        
    DECLARE @attributeSignatureBuffer TABLE
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL,
        [AttributeSignature]        NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL
    )
    
    DECLARE @attributeSignature TABLE
    (
        [AttributeSignatureKey]     INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        [AttributeSignature]        NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL
    )
        
    DECLARE @attributeSignatureCondition TABLE
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL,
        [AttributeSignatureKey]     INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [AttributeSignatureKey]
        )
    );

    DECLARE @attributeSignatureConditionCount TABLE
    (
        [Key]                       INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        [AttributeSignatureKey]     INT NOT NULL,
        [MembershipConditionCount]  INT NOT NULL
    );

    DECLARE @conditionMembershipAndPartition TABLE
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL,
        [StatementKey]              INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [StatementKey]
        )
    );

    DECLARE @commonStatement TABLE
    (
        [AttributeSignatureKey]       INT NOT NULL, 
        [StatementKey]                INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [AttributeSignatureKey],
            [StatementKey]
        )
    );

    DECLARE @conditionStatementCount TABLE
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL,
        [AttributeKey]              SMALLINT NOT NULL,
        [StatementCount]            INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [AttributeKey]
        )        
    );
    
    DECLARE @functionSignature TABLE
    (
        [FunctionSignatureKey]      INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        [AttributeSignatureKey]     INT NOT NULL,
        [AttributeKey]              SMALLINT NOT NULL,
        [DataTypeKey]               TINYINT,
        [ValueSignature]            NVARCHAR(MAX)
    );
    
    DECLARE @function TABLE
    (
        [AttributeSignatureKey]       INT NOT NULL,
        [FunctionSignatureKey]        INT NOT NULL,
        [StatementKey]                INT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [AttributeSignatureKey],
            [FunctionSignatureKey],
            [StatementKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @membershipCondition TABLE
    (
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );
    
    DECLARE @newCondition TABLE
    (
        [AttributeSignatureKey]     INT    NOT NULL,
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [AttributeSignatureKey],
            [MembershipConditionKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @obsoleteCondition TABLE
    (
        [Key]                       INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT NOT NULL
    );
    
    DECLARE @valueCount TABLE
    (
        [AttributeSignatureKey]     INT NOT NULL,
        [AttributeKey]              SMALLINT NOT NULL,
        [DataTypeKey]               TINYINT,
        [ValueCount]                INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [AttributeSignatureKey] ASC,
            [AttributeKey] ASC
        )
    );
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 0.    Identify the membership conditions to be optimized for an existing
 *        set or a set that is about to be created or updated.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF @requestKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [parameter].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [parameter]
            WHERE
                    [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [parameter].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @membershipCondition
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT CAST([parameter].[Value] AS INT)
            FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [parameter]
            WHERE
                    [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [parameter].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName;
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [set].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            WHERE        [set].[SetKey] = @setKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @membershipCondition
            (
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
            WHERE        [set].[SetKey] = @setKey;
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    Retrieve the attribute signature of each of the set's membership conditions.  
 *
 *        The attribute signature of a membership condition is a string of XML
 *        identifying the keys of all of the attributes to which the statements
 *        of the condition refer.  
 *
 *        While XML is generally not ordered, in this case, provided the XML is
 *        treated as a string, rather than parsed as XML, the order of the 
 *        attribute keys is ascending.  
 *
 *        If two membership condition's attribute signatures are matching strings
 *        then the conditions refer to the same attributes, and neither condition
 *        refers to additional attributes to which the other conditions does not
 *        refer.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [set].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @membershipCondition AS [set]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionAttributeSignature] AS [signature]
            ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [signature].[MembershipConditionKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @attributeSignatureBuffer
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [AttributeSignature]            
        )
        SELECT
            [signature].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [signature].[AttributeSignature]
        FROM @membershipCondition AS [set]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionAttributeSignature] AS [signature]
            ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [signature].[MembershipConditionKey];
        
        INSERT INTO @attributeSignature
        (
            [AttributeSignature]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [buffer].[AttributeSignature]
        FROM @attributeSignatureBuffer AS [buffer];
        
        INSERT INTO @attributeSignatureCondition
        (
            [AttributeSignatureKey],
            [MembershipConditionKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT    
            [signature].[AttributeSignatureKey],
            [buffer].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @attributeSignatureBuffer AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN @attributeSignature AS [signature]
            ON    [buffer].[AttributeSignature] = [signature].[AttributeSignature];
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *     To fix SE Issue 240239:Set Partitioning not working if set criteria contains a sub-condition
 *     we use @conditionMembershipAndPartition table that contains all MembershipConditionKey 
 *     and StatementKey pairs realated to @attributeSignatureCondition
 *     These pairs could be either in MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement or 
 *     in MembershipConditionPartition table. MembershipConditionPartition table is used 
 *     for partitioning statements
 *     So we combine these tables into @conditionMembershipAndPartition instead of using
 *     MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement only
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @conditionMembershipAndPartition
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [StatementKey]
        )
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
               [condition].[StatementKey]
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [condition]
            ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey];
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
            ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        LEFT JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition [dublicate] 
            ON    [dublicate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] AND
                  [dublicate].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE [dublicate].[MembershipConditionKey] IS NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @conditionMembershipAndPartition
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [StatementKey]
        )
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
               [condition].[StatementKey]
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [condition]
            ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        LEFT JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition [dublicate] 
            ON    [dublicate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] AND
                  [dublicate].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
        WHERE [dublicate].[MembershipConditionKey] IS NULL;
    END    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Eliminate any conditions that have statements that are not simple
 *        assertions that the value of an attribute is equal to a given literal.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
            ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                    [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                OR    [statement].[OperatorEqual] = @falseFlag
                OR    [statement].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag
                OR    [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                OR    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                OR    [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
                OR    [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                OR
                    (
                            [statement].[LiteralValueInteger] IS NULL
                        AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NULL
                        AND [statement].[LiteralValueString] IS NULL
                    )
                OR    [statement].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [candidate]
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
            ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        WHERE
                    [statement].[MissingValue] = @trueFlag
                OR    [statement].[OperatorEqual] = @falseFlag
                OR    [statement].[OperatorGreater] = @trueFlag
                OR    [statement].[OperatorLike] = @trueFlag
                OR    [statement].[OperatorInversion] = @trueFlag
                OR    [statement].[DereferencedValueAttributeKey] IS NOT NULL
                OR    [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] IS NOT NULL
                OR
                    (
                            [statement].[LiteralValueInteger] IS NULL
                        AND [statement].[LiteralValueReference] IS NULL
                        AND [statement].[LiteralValueString] IS NULL
                    )
                OR    [statement].[FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL    
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *        Also eliminate any conditions that have more than one statement referring
 *        to the same object, such as /Person[AttributeX=D and AttributeX=E]
 *        ... which would be valid for a multi-valued attribute.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
            ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @conditionStatementCount
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [StatementCount]
        )
        SELECT 
            [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [statement].[AttributeKey],
            COUNT([statement].[StatementKey])
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
            ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
            ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
        GROUP BY 
            [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey],
            [statement].[AttributeKey];
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN @conditionStatementCount AS [count]
                ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
            WHERE        [count].[StatementCount] > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN @conditionStatementCount AS [count]
                ON    [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [count].[MembershipConditionKey]
            WHERE        [count].[StatementCount] > 1
        END
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Identify which membership conditions have the same attribute signature.  
 *
 *        Accomplish that by counting the number of membership conditions that
 *        have a given signature, and eliminating any signatures that are unique
 *        to a membership condition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [source].[AttributeSignatureKey]
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [source]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @attributeSignatureConditionCount
        (
            [AttributeSignatureKey],
            [MembershipConditionCount]
        )
        SELECT 
            [source].[AttributeSignatureKey],
            COUNT([source].[MembershipConditionKey])
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [source]
        GROUP BY
                [source].[AttributeSignatureKey];
    END

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [count].[MembershipConditionCount]
        FROM @attributeSignatureConditionCount AS [count]
        WHERE        [count].[MembershipConditionCount] <= 1
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [count]
        FROM @attributeSignatureConditionCount AS [count]
        WHERE        [count].[MembershipConditionCount] <= 1;
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.    Iterate over the attribute signatures.  
 *
 *        Each of these remaining signatures is shared by more than one 
 *        membership condition.  Those several membership conditions will 
 *        be replaced by one condition incorporating one or more tabular functions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [count].[Key]
        FROM @attributeSignatureConditionCount AS [count]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @attributeSignatureLimit = MAX([count].[AttributeSignatureKey])
        FROM @attributeSignatureConditionCount AS [count];
        
        SELECT @attributeSignatureKey = MIN([count].[AttributeSignatureKey])
        FROM @attributeSignatureConditionCount AS [count];
        
        WHILE(@attributeSignatureKey <= @attributeSignatureLimit)
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [count].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                FROM @attributeSignatureConditionCount AS [count]
                WHERE        [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
            )
            BEGIN
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.    Get the current attribute signature.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
                SELECT @currentAttributeSignature = [count].[AttributeSignature]
                FROM @attributeSignature AS [count]
                WHERE        [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey;
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F.    For each of the attributes to which the condition refers, get the 
 *        count of the number of values asserted for that attribute by all of
 *        the membership conditions.  
 *
 *        In this example, 
 *        1.    ObjectType=Person && Building=E
 *        2.    ObjectType=Person && Building=D
 *
 *        ... ObjectType has a count of 1, whereas Building has a count of 2.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                        
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                    FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                        ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [attribute].[Key]
                    WHERE        
                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                        AND    [attribute].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyInteger
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @valueCount
                    (
                        [AttributeSignatureKey],
                        [AttributeKey],
                        [DataTypeKey],
                        [ValueCount]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @attributeSignatureKey,
                        [statement].[AttributeKey],
                        @dataTypeKeyInteger,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT [statement].[LiteralValueInteger])
                    FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                        ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [attribute].[Key]
                    WHERE        
                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                        AND    [attribute].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyInteger
                    GROUP BY
                            [statement].[AttributeKey];
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                    FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                        ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [attribute].[Key]
                    WHERE        
                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                        AND    [attribute].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyReference
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @valueCount
                    (
                        [AttributeSignatureKey],
                        [AttributeKey],
                        [DataTypeKey],
                        [ValueCount]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @attributeSignatureKey,
                        [statement].[AttributeKey],
                        @dataTypeKeyReference,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT [statement].[LiteralValueReference])
                    FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                        ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [attribute].[Key]
                    WHERE        
                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                        AND    [attribute].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyReference
                    GROUP BY
                            [statement].[AttributeKey];
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                    FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                        ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [attribute].[Key]
                    WHERE        
                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                        AND    [attribute].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyString
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @valueCount
                    (
                        [AttributeSignatureKey],
                        [AttributeKey],
                        [DataTypeKey],
                        [ValueCount]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @attributeSignatureKey,
                        [statement].[AttributeKey],
                        @dataTypeKeyString,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT [statement].[LiteralValueString])
                    FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [condition].[StatementKey] = [statement].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
                        ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [attribute].[Key]
                    WHERE        
                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                        AND    [attribute].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyString
                    GROUP BY
                            [statement].[AttributeKey];
                END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G.    Remember the statements that reference attributes with only a single
 *       value.  Those are statements that the membership conditions must 
 *       all share.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                                        
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [count].[ValueCount]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [signature]
                        ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [signature].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE
                            [count].[ValueCount] = 1
                        AND    [signature].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @commonStatement
                    (
                        [AttributeSignatureKey],
                        [StatementKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT 
                        @attributeSignatureKey,
                        [statement].[StatementKey]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [signature]
                        ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [signature].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE
                            [count].[ValueCount] = 1
                        AND    [signature].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * H.    For the attributes of which the count of the number of values is 
 *       greater than one, compose a tabular function for that attribute ... 
 *       or identify an existing one.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
                 IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [count].[ValueCount]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    WHERE    [count].[ValueCount] <= 1
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [count]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    WHERE    [count].[ValueCount] <= 1;
                END
                
                -- There can be a case when in the same attribute signature there are two or more attributes with different values.
                -- E.g.     (ObjectType=Person and Dept=1010 and AccountName=John)
                --       or (ObjectType=Person and Dept=2020 and AccountName=Chris)
                -- In this case we don't want both of Dept and AccountName to end up in Tabular functions since it will produce wrong memberships
                -- like some John from Dept 2020.
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [count].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    GROUP BY
                        [count].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                    HAVING
                        COUNT([count].[AttributeSignatureKey]) > 1
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [count]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    WHERE   [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] IN
                    (
                        SELECT [count].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                        FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                        GROUP BY
                            [count].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                        HAVING
                            COUNT([count].[AttributeSignatureKey]) > 1
                    )
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [count].[DataTypeKey]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    WHERE        
                            [count].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyInteger
                        AND    [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                )
                AND EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                        AND    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE        
                            [count].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyInteger
                        AND    [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @functionSignature
                    (
                        [AttributeSignatureKey],
                        [AttributeKey],
                        [DataTypeKey],
                        [ValueSignature]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @attributeSignatureKey,
                        [count].[AttributeKey],
                        @dataTypeKeyInteger,
                        CAST
                        (
                            ( 
                                SELECT
                                N'',                    
                                (
                                    SELECT DISTINCT    [documentStatement].[LiteralValueInteger] AS [Value]
                                    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [documentStatement]
                                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [documentCondition]
                                        ON    [documentStatement].[StatementKey] = [documentCondition].[StatementKey]
                                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [documentAttributes]
                                        ON    [documentCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [documentAttributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                    WHERE        [documentAttributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                            AND    [documentStatement].[AttributeKey] = [count].[AttributeKey]
                                    ORDER BY
                                            [documentStatement].[LiteralValueInteger]
                                    FOR XML PATH (N'AttributeValue'), TYPE
                                )
                                FOR XML PATH (N'ValueSignature')
                            )
                            AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                        ) AS [ValueSignature]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                        ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE        
                                [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                            AND    [count].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyInteger;
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [count].[DataTypeKey]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    WHERE        
                            [count].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyReference
                        AND    [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                )
                AND EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                        AND    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE        
                            [count].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyReference
                        AND    [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @functionSignature
                    (
                        [AttributeSignatureKey],
                        [AttributeKey],
                        [DataTypeKey],
                        [ValueSignature]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @attributeSignatureKey,
                        [count].[AttributeKey],
                        @dataTypeKeyReference,
                        CAST
                        (
                            ( 
                                SELECT
                                N'',                    
                                (
                                    SELECT DISTINCT    [documentStatement].[LiteralValueReference] AS [Value]
                                    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [documentStatement]
                                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [documentCondition]
                                        ON    [documentStatement].[StatementKey] = [documentCondition].[StatementKey]
                                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [documentAttributes]
                                        ON    [documentCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [documentAttributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                    WHERE        [documentAttributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                            AND    [documentStatement].[AttributeKey] = [count].[AttributeKey]
                                    ORDER BY
                                            [documentStatement].[LiteralValueReference]
                                    FOR XML PATH (N'AttributeValue'), TYPE
                                )
                                FOR XML PATH (N'ValueSignature')
                            )
                            AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                        ) AS [ValueSignature]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                        ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE        
                                [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                            AND    [count].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyReference;
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [count].[DataTypeKey]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    WHERE        
                            [count].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyString
                        AND    [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                )
                AND EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                        AND    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE        
                            [count].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyString
                        AND    [count].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @functionSignature
                    (
                        [AttributeSignatureKey],
                        [AttributeKey],
                        [DataTypeKey],
                        [ValueSignature]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        @attributeSignatureKey,
                        [count].[AttributeKey],
                        @dataTypeKeyString,
                        CAST
                        (
                            ( 
                                SELECT
                                N'',                    
                                (
                                    SELECT DISTINCT    [documentStatement].[LiteralValueString] AS [Value]
                                    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [documentStatement]
                                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [documentCondition]
                                        ON    [documentStatement].[StatementKey] = [documentCondition].[StatementKey]
                                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [documentAttributes]
                                        ON    [documentCondition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [documentAttributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                    WHERE        [documentAttributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                            AND    [documentStatement].[AttributeKey] = [count].[AttributeKey]
                                    ORDER BY
                                            [documentStatement].[LiteralValueString]
                                    FOR XML PATH (N'AttributeValue'), TYPE
                                )
                                FOR XML PATH (N'ValueSignature')
                            )
                            AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                        ) AS [ValueSignature]
                    FROM @valueCount AS [count]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                        ON    [count].[AttributeKey] = [statement].[AttributeKey]
                    INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                        ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                    INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                        ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    WHERE        
                                [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                            AND    [count].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyString;
                END
                
                SELECT @functionSignatureLimit = MAX([function].[FunctionSignatureKey])
                FROM @functionSignature AS [function]
                WHERE        [function].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey;
                
                SELECT @functionSignatureKey = MIN([function].[FunctionSignatureKey])
                FROM @functionSignature AS [function]
                WHERE        [function].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey;
                
                WHILE(@functionSignatureKey <= @functionSignatureLimit)
                BEGIN
                    SELECT 
                        @statementKey = NULL,
                        @tabularFunctionKey = NULL;
                                            
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [function].[FunctionSignatureKey]
                        FROM @functionSignature AS [function]
                        WHERE
                                [function].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                            AND    [function].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [tabularFunction].[TabularFunctionKey]
                            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunction] AS [tabularFunction]
                            INNER JOIN @functionSignature AS [signature]
                                ON    [tabularFunction].[AttributeKey] = [signature].[AttributeKey]
                                AND    [tabularFunction].[ValueSignature] = [signature].[ValueSignature]
                            WHERE        [signature].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT @tabularFunctionKey = [tabularFunction].[TabularFunctionKey]
                            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunction] AS [tabularFunction]
                            INNER JOIN @functionSignature AS [signature]
                                ON    [tabularFunction].[AttributeKey] = [signature].[AttributeKey]
                                AND    [tabularFunction].[ValueSignature] = [signature].[ValueSignature]
                            WHERE        [signature].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey;
                        END
                        ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunction]
                            (
                                [AttributeKey],
                                [ValueSignature]
                            )
                            SELECT    
                                [signature].[AttributeKey],
                                [signature].[ValueSignature]
                            FROM @functionSignature AS [signature]
                            WHERE        [signature].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey;
                            
                            SET @tabularFunctionKey = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
                        
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
                                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                                    ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN @functionSignature AS [function]
                                    ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [function].[AttributeKey]
                                WHERE        
                                        [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                    AND    [function].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey
                                    AND    [function].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyInteger
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue]
                                (
                                    [TabularFunctionKey],
                                    [Value]
                                )
                                SELECT DISTINCT
                                    @tabularFunctionKey,
                                    [statement].[LiteralValueInteger]
                                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                                    ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN @functionSignature AS [function]
                                    ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [function].[AttributeKey]
                                WHERE        
                                        [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                    AND    [function].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey
                                    AND    [function].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyInteger
                                ORDER BY
                                        [statement].[LiteralValueInteger];                        
                            END
                            
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT DISTINCT [statement].[StatementKey]
                                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                                    ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN @functionSignature AS [function]
                                    ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [function].[AttributeKey]
                                WHERE        
                                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyReference
                            )
                            BEGIN
                                INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue]
                                (
                                    [TabularFunctionKey],
                                    [Value]
                                )
                                SELECT DISTINCT
                                    @tabularFunctionKey,
                                    [statement].[LiteralValueReference]
                                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                                    ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN @functionSignature AS [function]
                                    ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [function].[AttributeKey]
                                WHERE        
                                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyReference
                                ORDER BY
                                        [statement].[LiteralValueReference];                        
                            END
                            
                            IF EXISTS
                            (
                                SELECT [statement].[StatementKey]
                                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                                    ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN @functionSignature AS [function]
                                    ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [function].[AttributeKey]
                                WHERE        
                                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyString
                            )
                            BEGIN

                                -- clecking length of MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue
                                IF EXISTS
                                (
                                    SELECT DISTINCT [statement].[LiteralValueString]
                                    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                        INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                                             ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                                        INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                                             ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                        INNER JOIN @functionSignature AS [function]
                                            ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [function].[AttributeKey]
                                    WHERE        
                                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyString
                                        AND    LEN([statement].[LiteralValueString]) > 448
                                )
                                BEGIN
                                    SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatStringOrBinaryTruncationException]( N'MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue', N'Value');
                                    RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                                END

                                INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue]
                                (
                                    [TabularFunctionKey],
                                    [Value]
                                )
                                SELECT DISTINCT
                                    @tabularFunctionKey,
                                    CAST([statement].[LiteralValueString] AS NVARCHAR(448))
                                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                                INNER JOIN @conditionMembershipAndPartition AS [condition]
                                    ON    [statement].[StatementKey] = [condition].[StatementKey]
                                INNER JOIN @attributeSignatureCondition AS [attributes]
                                    ON    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [attributes].[MembershipConditionKey]
                                INNER JOIN @functionSignature AS [function]
                                    ON    [statement].[AttributeKey] = [function].[AttributeKey]
                                WHERE        
                                            [attributes].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[FunctionSignatureKey] = @functionSignatureKey
                                        AND    [function].[DataTypeKey] = @dataTypeKeyString
                                ORDER BY
                                        CAST([statement].[LiteralValueString] AS NVARCHAR(448));
                            END
                        END
                        
                        IF @tabularFunctionKey IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            EXECUTE [fim].[CreateMembershipConditionTabularFunctionStatement]
                                @tabularFunctionKey = @tabularFunctionKey,
                                @statementKey = @statementKey OUTPUT;
                                
                            INSERT INTO @function
                            (
                                [AttributeSignatureKey],
                                [FunctionSignatureKey],
                                [StatementKey]
                            )
                            VALUES
                            (
                                @attributeSignatureKey,
                                @functionSignatureKey,
                                @statementKey
                            );
                        END
                    END
                    
                    SELECT @functionSignatureKey = @functionSignatureKey + 1;
                END
            END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * H.    Compose a new membership condition to replace the original ones, using
 *        the tabular functions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT [function].[AttributeSignatureKey]
                FROM @function AS [function]
                WHERE        [function].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
            )
            BEGIN            
                SELECT @membershipConditionDocument = 
                    CAST
                    (
                        (
                            SELECT
                            N'',                    
                            (
                                SELECT [combined].[Key] AS [Key]
                                FROM
                                (
                                    SELECT DISTINCT [function].[StatementKey] AS [Key]
                                    FROM @function AS [function]
                                    WHERE        [function].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                    UNION
                                    SELECT DISTINCT [common].[StatementKey] AS [Key]
                                    FROM @commonStatement AS [common]
                                    WHERE        [common].[AttributeSignatureKey] = @attributeSignatureKey
                                ) AS [combined]
                                FOR XML PATH (N'Statements'), TYPE
                            )
                            FOR XML PATH (N'MembershipCondition')
                        )
                        AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                    );
                
                EXECUTE [fim].[CreateMembershipCondition] 
                    @membershipCondition = @membershipConditionDocument,
                    @membershipConditionKey = @membershipConditionKey OUTPUT;
                    
                IF NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                    FROM @newCondition AS [condition]
                    WHERE    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey] = @membershipConditionKey
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @newCondition
                    (
                        [AttributeSignatureKey],
                        [MembershipConditionKey]
                    )
                    VALUES
                    (
                        @attributeSignatureKey,
                        @membershipConditionKey
                    );
                END            
            END
            
            SELECT @attributeSignatureKey = @attributeSignatureKey + 1;
        END
        
    END    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [condition].[AttributeSignatureKey]
        FROM @newCondition AS [condition]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @obsoleteCondition
        (
            [MembershipConditionKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [source].[MembershipConditionKey]
        FROM @attributeSignatureCondition AS [source]
        INNER JOIN @newCondition AS [new]
            ON    [source].[AttributeSignatureKey] = [new].[AttributeSignatureKey];
            
        IF @requestKey IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN    
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [parameter].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [parameter]
                INNER JOIN @obsoleteCondition AS [condition]
                    ON    CAST([parameter].[Value] AS INT) = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE       [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [parameter].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [parameter]
                FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [parameter]
                INNER JOIN @obsoleteCondition AS [condition]
                    ON    CAST([parameter].[Value] AS INT) = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE       [parameter].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [parameter].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName;
            END
            
            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter]
            (
                [RequestKey],
                [Name],
                [Value]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @requestKey,
                @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName,
                CAST([condition].[MembershipConditionKey] AS NVARCHAR(128))
            FROM @newCondition AS [condition]
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [set].[SetKey]
                FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                INNER JOIN @obsoleteCondition AS [condition]
                    ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE        [set].[SetKey] = @setKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [set]
                FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [set]
                INNER JOIN @obsoleteCondition AS [condition]
                    ON    [set].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE        [set].[SetKey] = @setKey;
            END
            
            INSERT INTO [fim].[SetMembershipCondition]
            (
                [SetKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @setKey,
                [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM @newCondition AS [condition]
        END
        
        SELECT @obsoleteConditionLimit = MAX([condition].[Key])
        FROM @obsoleteCondition AS [condition];
        
        SELECT @obsoleteConditionIndex = 1;
        WHILE(@obsoleteConditionIndex <= @obsoleteConditionLimit)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @obsoleteConditionKey = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
            FROM @obsoleteCondition AS [condition]
            WHERE        [condition].[Key] = @obsoleteConditionIndex;
            
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteMembershipCondition] @membershipConditionKey = @obsoleteConditionKey;
            
            SELECT @obsoleteConditionIndex = @obsoleteConditionIndex + 1;
        END
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingTabularFunctions';
    END  
END
GO

--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostponeMonitorRequestAction]
	@requestKey BIGINT,
	@commitTime DATETIME = NULL,
	@minutes    SMALLINT = NULL
AS
    IF(@commitTime IS NULL)
    BEGIN
	    SELECT  @commitTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    --If desired delay is not specified we use simple logic to come up with a reasonable delay
    IF(@minutes IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @actionsAttempted SMALLINT;
        SELECT @actionsAttempted = [ActionsAttempted]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMonitor]
        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
        
        SELECT @minutes =
        CASE
            WHEN @actionsAttempted <= 2     THEN 1
            WHEN @actionsAttempted < 10     THEN 5
            WHEN @actionsAttempted < 100    THEN 60
            WHEN @actionsAttempted < 1000   THEN 600
            ELSE                                 1440
        END;        
    END
   
    UPDATE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
    SET [NextActionDate] = DATEADD(minute, @minutes, @commitTime)
    WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    
RETURN @@ROWCOUNT
GO
