--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessAttributeTypeDescriptionUpdate]
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection])
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey    SMALLINT,
        @attributeTypeDescriptionName       NVARCHAR(448),
        @dataTypeKey                        SMALLINT,
        @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey      SMALLINT,
        @integerMinimuKey                   SMALLINT,
        @integerMaximumKey                  SMALLINT,
        @nameKey                            SMALLINT,
        @objectIdentifierKey                SMALLINT,
        @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @multivaluedKey                     SMALLINT,
        @Selectivity                        SMALLINT,
        @skipUsageKeywordCheckPropertyName  NVARCHAR(448),
        @skipUsageKeywordCheckValue         NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @stringRegexKey                     SMALLINT,        
        @usageKeywordKey                    SMALLINT;

    SELECT
        @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey    = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'AttributeTypeDescription'),
        @dataTypeKey                        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'DataType'),
        @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey      = NULL,
        @integerMinimuKey                   = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'IntegerMinimum'),
        @integerMaximumKey                  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'IntegerMaximum'),
        @multivaluedKey                     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Multivalued'),
        @nameKey                            = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Name'),
        @objectIdentifierKey                = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectID'),
        @Selectivity                        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Selectivity'),
        @skipUsageKeywordCheckPropertyName  = N'SkipBindingUsageKeywordCheck',
        @skipUsageKeywordCheckValue         = NULL,
        @stringRegexKey                     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'StringRegex'),
        @usageKeywordKey                    = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'UsageKeyword');

    DECLARE @targets TABLE
    (
        [Name]                  NVARCHAR(448),
        [ObjectKey]             BIGINT,
        [DataType]              NVARCHAR(64),
        [Multivalued]           BIT,
        [Selectivity]           TINYINT,
        [WebServiceUsageKeyword]BIT,
        [DataTypeKey]           TINYINT
    );

    INSERT INTO @targets
    (
        [Name],
        [ObjectKey],
        [DataType],
        [Multivalued],
        [Selectivity],
        [WebServiceUsageKeyword]
    )
    SELECT 
        N'',
        Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT'),
        N'',
        0,
        0,
        0
    FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject)
    WHERE 
            Root.targetObject.value('@Deleted', 'SMALLINT') = 0
        AND Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectTypeKey', 'SMALLINT') = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey;
   
    UPDATE @targets
    SET [Name] = [ovs].[ValueString] 
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @nameKey;
               
    UPDATE @targets
    SET [WebServiceUsageKeyword] = 1      
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @usageKeywordKey
        AND [ovs].[ValueString] =  N'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices';       

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	A. Take care of deletions
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    -- cannot delete attributeTypeDescription with 'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices" keyword
    SELECT TOP 1 
        @attributeTypeDescriptionName =  [t].[Name]
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [rof]
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [rof].[ObjectKey]
        AND [rof].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey      
    WHERE
            [rof].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
        AND [rof].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey    
        AND [rof].[Deleted] = 1
        AND [t].[WebServiceUsageKeyword] = 1; 
    
    IF @attributeTypeDescriptionName IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatAttributeTypeCannotBeDeletedException]
            (            
                @attributeTypeDescriptionName
            );
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END    

    DELETE [fim].[AttributeInternal]  
    FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [rof]
        ON  [ai].[ObjectKey] = [rof].[ObjectKey]
        AND [rof].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey
    WHERE
            [rof].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
        AND [rof].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [rof].[Deleted] = 1;  

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	B. Take care of creates / updates
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE @targets
    SET [DataType] = LEFT([ovs].[ValueString],64)
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @dataTypeKey;

    UPDATE @targets
    SET [Multivalued] = [ovb].[ValueBoolean]  
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb] 
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovb].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovb].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovb].[AttributeKey] = @multivaluedKey;
    
    -- get the current value of the system setting.
    SELECT @skipUsageKeywordCheckValue = [fim].[GetSystemProperty](@skipUsageKeywordCheckPropertyName);
                   
    IF(@skipUsageKeywordCheckValue IS NULL)
    BEGIN                     
        -- Prevent addition or removal of UsageKeyword value 'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices'.    
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  = [ros].[AttributeKey] ,
            @attributeTypeDescriptionName = [t].[Name]
        FROM    @targets AS [t]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ros]
            ON [t].[ObjectKey] = [ros].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ros].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey
            AND [ros].[AttributeKey] = @usageKeywordKey
            AND [ros].[ValueString] =  N'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices' 
        WHERE 
            [ros].[RequestKey] = @requestKey; 
    
        IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN          
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatAttributeTypeUsageKeywordCannotBeModifiedException]
                (
                    N'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices',
                    @attributeTypeDescriptionName
                );
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END   
    
        IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NULL    
        BEGIN    
            SELECT TOP 1 
                @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  = [roi].[AttributeKey], 
                @attributeTypeDescriptionName = [t].[Name]            
            FROM    @targets AS [t]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [roi]
                ON [t].[ObjectKey] = [roi].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE   
                    [roi].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                AND [t].[WebServiceUsageKeyword] = 1
                AND	
                (	
                        [roi].[AttributeKey] = @integerMinimuKey
                    OR  [roi].[AttributeKey] = @integerMaximumKey                
                );
        END
  
        IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 
                @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  = [rot].[AttributeKey],
                @attributeTypeDescriptionName = [t].[Name]
            FROM	@targets AS [t]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [rot]
                ON [t].[ObjectKey] = [rot].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE	
                    [rot].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                AND [t].[WebServiceUsageKeyword] = 1
                AND	[rot].[AttributeKey] = @stringRegexKey;			
        END 

        IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN         
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatAttributeCannotBeModifiedException]
                (
                    [fim].[AttributeNameFromKey](@illegallyModifiedAttributeKey),
                    @attributeTypeDescriptionName
                );
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END   
   END      


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	C. Update cache tables
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    UPDATE [target]
    SET
        [DataTypeKey] = [type].[DataTypeKey]
    FROM @targets AS [target]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[DataTypeInternal] AS [type]
        ON  [target].[DataType] = [type].[DataType];

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute] 
        INNER JOIN @targets AS [target]
            ON [attribute].[ObjectKey] = [target].[ObjectKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [fim].[AttributeInternal]  
        SET 
            [Name] = [target].[Name],
            [DataType] = [target].[DataType],
            [Multivalued] = [target].[Multivalued],
            [Selectivity] = [target].[Selectivity],
            [DataTypeKey] = [target].[DataTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute] 
        INNER JOIN @targets AS [target]
            ON [attribute].[ObjectKey] = [target].[ObjectKey];
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[AttributeInternal] 
        (
            [Name],
            [ObjectKey],
            [DataType],
            [Multivalued],
            [Selectivity],
            [DataTypeKey]
        )
        SELECT
            [target].[Name],
            [target].[ObjectKey],
            [target].[DataType],
            [target].[Multivalued],
            [target].[Selectivity],
            [target].[DataTypeKey] 
        FROM @targets AS [target]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attribute]
            ON [target].[ObjectKey] = [attribute].[ObjectKey] 
        WHERE   [attribute].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;
    END

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	D. Take care of inherited attributes
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    DECLARE @bindingsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[BindingDescriptionSchemaCollection]);

    SET @bindingsXml =
    ( 
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [bi].[ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey]
        FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject)
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            ON Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT') = [ai].[ObjectKey] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
            ON [ai].[Key] = [bi].[AttributeKey] 
        FOR XML RAW ('BindingDescription')
    );

    EXECUTE [fim].[UpdateBindingDescriptionsInherited]
        @bindingsXml = @bindingsXml;

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[PostProcessBindingDescriptionUpdate]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessBindingDescriptionUpdate]
	@requestKey BIGINT, 
	@targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection]),
	@boolDefaultValue	BIT = 0
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        @attributeName                      NVARCHAR(448),
        @attributeDescriptionTypeKey        SMALLINT,  
        @attributeDisplayNameTypeKey        SMALLINT,
        @attributeTypeDescriptionObjectKey  SMALLINT,
        @bindingDescriptionTypeKey          SMALLINT,
        @bindingInUseByObjectKey            BIGINT,
        @bindingObjectTypeKey               SMALLINT,
        @bindingAttributeKey                SMALLINT,
        @boundAttributeTypeKey              SMALLINT,
        @boundObjectTypeKey                 SMALLINT,            
        @createdTimeAttributeKey            SMALLINT,  
        @defaultLocaleKey                   SMALLINT, 
        @falseFlag                          BIT,
        @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey      SMALLINT,
        @integerMinimuKey                   SMALLINT,
        @integerMaximumKey                  SMALLINT,      
        @messageText	                    NVARCHAR(MAX),  
        @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey    BIGINT,   
        @objectIdentifierKey                SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey       SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeName                     NVARCHAR(448),
        @operation                          NVARCHAR(448),
        @requiredKey                        SMALLINT,
        @skipUsageKeywordCheckPropertyName  NVARCHAR(448),
        @skipUsageKeywordCheckValue         NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @stringRegexKey                     SMALLINT,
        @usageKeywordKey                    SMALLINT,
        @creatorObjectTypeKey               SMALLINT;
              
    SELECT
        @attributeDescriptionTypeKey        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Description'),
        @attributeDisplayNameTypeKey        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'DisplayName'),
        @attributeTypeDescriptionObjectKey  = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'AttributeTypeDescription'),
        @bindingDescriptionTypeKey          = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'BindingDescription'),
        @bindingInUseByObjectKey            = NULL,
        @boundAttributeTypeKey              = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'BoundAttributeType'),
        @boundObjectTypeKey                 = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'BoundObjectType'),
        @createdTimeAttributeKey            = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @defaultLocaleKey                   = [fim].[GetDefaultLocaleKey](),
        @falseFlag                          = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey      = NULL,
        @integerMinimuKey                   = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'IntegerMinimum'),
        @integerMaximumKey                  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'IntegerMaximum'),
        @objectIdentifierKey                = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey       = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectTypeDescription'),
        @requiredKey                        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Required'),
        @stringRegexKey                     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'StringRegex'),
        @skipUsageKeywordCheckPropertyName  = N'SkipBindingUsageKeywordCheck',
        @skipUsageKeywordCheckValue         = NULL,
        @usageKeywordKey                    = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'UsageKeyword'),
        @creatorObjectTypeKey               = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'Creator');

    DECLARE @targets TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]         BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey]     SMALLINT,
        [ObjectTypeValueReference] BIGINT,
        [AttributeKey]      SMALLINT,
        [Required]          BIT,
        [ObjectType]        NVARCHAR(448),
        [AttributeName]     NVARCHAR(448),
        [StringRegex]       NVARCHAR(MAX),
        [IntegerMinimum]    BIGINT,
        [IntegerMaximum]    BIGINT,
        [WebServiceUsageKeyword]BIT,
        [Create]            BIT,
        [WebServiceUsageKeywordOnObjectTypeDescription] BIT
    );
    
    DECLARE @bindingDescriptions TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]                  BIGINT,        
        [BoundAttributeType]         BIGINT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [BoundAttributeType]
        )
    );

    INSERT INTO @targets
    (
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT 
        Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT')
    FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject)
    WHERE 
            Root.targetObject.value('@Deleted', 'SMALLINT') = 0
        AND Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectTypeKey', 'SMALLINT') = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey;
        
   SELECT @operation = [r].[Operation]
   FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
   WHERE [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	A. Take care of deletions
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    DECLARE @deletedBindings TABLE
    (
        ObjectKey           BIGINT,
        ObjectTypeKey       SMALLINT,
        AttributeTypeKey    SMALLINT,
        DataType            NVARCHAR(68)
    );

    INSERT INTO @deletedBindings 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeTypeKey],
        [DataType]
    )
    SELECT
        [rof].[ObjectKey],
        [bi].[ObjectTypeKey],
        [bi].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[DataType]
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [rof]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
        ON  [rof].[ObjectKey] = [bi].[ObjectKey]
        AND [rof].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [bi].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    WHERE
            [rof].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
        AND [rof].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey 
        AND [rof].[Deleted] = 1;
        
    --cannot delete binding with "'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices" keyword
    SELECT TOP 1 
        @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  = [ros].[AttributeKey],
        @bindingObjectTypeKey = [db].[ObjectTypeKey],
        @bindingAttributeKey = [db].[AttributeTypeKey] 
    FROM    @deletedBindings AS [db]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ros]
        ON  [db].[ObjectKey] = [ros].[ObjectKey]     
        AND [ros].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ros].[AttributeKey] = @usageKeywordKey
        AND [ros].[ValueString] =  N'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices';

    IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN          
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatBindingCannotBeDeletedException]
            (            
                [fim].[AttributeNameFromKey] (@bindingAttributeKey),
                [fim].[ObjectTypeNameFromKey] (@bindingObjectTypeKey)
            );
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END  

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [db].[DataType]  
        FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
        WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Binary'
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @bindingInUseByObjectKey = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ov]
            ON  [db].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [db].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey] 
        WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Binary'
    END
  
    IF
    (
        @bindingInUseByObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [db].[DataType]  
            FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
            WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Boolean'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @bindingInUseByObjectKey = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ov]
            ON  [db].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [db].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Boolean'
    END


    IF
    (
        @bindingInUseByObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [db].[DataType]  
            FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
            WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'DateTime'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @bindingInUseByObjectKey = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ov]
            ON  [db].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [db].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'DateTime'
    END
    
    IF
    (
        @bindingInUseByObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [db].[DataType]  
            FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
            WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Integer'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @bindingInUseByObjectKey = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ov]
            ON  [db].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [db].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Integer'
    END
    
    IF
    (
        @bindingInUseByObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [db].[DataType]  
            FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
            WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Reference'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @bindingInUseByObjectKey = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ov]
            ON  [db].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [db].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Reference'
    END
    
    IF
    (
        @bindingInUseByObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [db].[DataType]  
            FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
            WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'String'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @bindingInUseByObjectKey = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ov]
            ON  [db].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [db].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'String'
    END
        
    IF
    (
        @bindingInUseByObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [db].[DataType]  
            FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
            WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Text'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @bindingInUseByObjectKey = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM @deletedBindings AS [db]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ov]
            ON  [db].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [db].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
        WHERE [db].[DataType] = N'Text'
    END
    
    IF (@bindingInUseByObjectKey IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN      
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatBindingInUseException](@bindingInUseByObjectKey);
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END

    -- cannot delete binding of attributeTypeDescription if it's used in filters of Sets
    DECLARE @delAttributeName  NVARCHAR(448);
    DECLARE @delObjectType     NVARCHAR(448);
    DECLARE @delAttributeKey   SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @delObjectTypeKey  SMALLINT;

    SELECT TOP 1
        @delAttributeName = [ai].[Name],
        @delObjectType = [bi].[ObjectType],
        @delAttributeKey = [d].[AttributeTypeKey],
        @delObjectTypeKey = [d].[ObjectTypeKey]
    FROM @deletedBindings AS [d]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
        ON [d].[AttributeTypeKey] = [bi].[AttributeKey]
        AND [d].[ObjectTypeKey] = [bi].[ObjectTypeKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [d].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ai].[Key]

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] [mcs1]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] [mxm1]
            ON [mcs1].[StatementKey] = [mxm1].[StatementKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] [mxm2]
            ON [mxm1].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mxm2].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] [mcs2]
            ON [mxm2].[StatementKey] = [mcs2].[StatementKey]
        WHERE [mcs1].[AttributeKey] = @delAttributeKey
          AND [mcs2].[ObjectTypeKey] = @delObjectTypeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatBindingCannotBeDeletedUsedInSetsException]
            (
                @delAttributeName,
                @delObjectType
            );
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END


    DELETE [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [rof]
        ON  [bi].[ObjectKey] = [rof].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [rof].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey
    WHERE
            [rof].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
        AND [rof].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [rof].[Deleted] = 1;

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	B. Take care of creates / updates
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   UPDATE @targets
    SET 
        [ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key],
        [ObjectType] = [oti].[Name],
        [ObjectTypeValueReference] = [oti].[ObjectKey]
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @boundObjectTypeKey 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
        ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [oti].[ObjectKey];

    UPDATE @targets
    SET 
        [AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key],
        [AttributeName] = [ai].[Name] 
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovr].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @boundAttributeTypeKey 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovr].[ValueReference] = [ai].[ObjectKey];

    UPDATE @targets
    SET [Required] = [ovb].[ValueBoolean] 
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb] 
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovb].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovb].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovb].[AttributeKey] = @requiredKey;
        
    UPDATE @targets
    SET [Create] = 1      
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ror] 
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ror].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ror].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ror].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey
    WHERE
        [ror].[RequestKey] = @requestKey; 
        
    UPDATE @targets
    SET [WebServiceUsageKeyword] = 1           
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @usageKeywordKey
        AND [ovs].[ValueString] =  N'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices';
        
    UPDATE @targets
    SET [WebServiceUsageKeywordOnObjectTypeDescription] = 1      
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [t].[ObjectTypeValueReference] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @usageKeywordKey
        AND [ovs].[ValueString] =  N'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices';
    
    -- get the current value of the system setting
    SELECT @skipUsageKeywordCheckValue = [fim].[GetSystemProperty](@skipUsageKeywordCheckPropertyName);
    
    IF(@skipUsageKeywordCheckValue IS NULL)
    BEGIN            
        -- Prevent addition of UsageKeyword value 'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices' to existing binding.    
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  = [ros].[AttributeKey],
            @attributeName = [t].[AttributeName],
            @objectTypeName = [t].[ObjectType] 
        FROM    @targets AS [t]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ros]
            ON [t].[ObjectKey] = [ros].[ObjectKey]
            AND [ros].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
            AND [ros].[AttributeKey] = @usageKeywordKey
            AND [ros].[ValueString] =  N'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices'
        WHERE
            [ros].[RequestKey] = @requestKey; 
            
        IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN          
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatBindingUsageKeywordCannotBeModifiedException]
                (
                    N'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices',
                    @attributeName,
                    @objectTypeName
                );
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END       
    
    
        IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  = [roi].[AttributeKey] 
            FROM    @targets AS [t]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [roi]
                ON [t].[ObjectKey] = [roi].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE 
                    [roi].[RequestKey] = @requestKey   
                AND [t].[WebServiceUsageKeyword] = 1
                AND	
                    (	
                        [roi].[AttributeKey] = @integerMinimuKey
                    OR  [roi].[AttributeKey] = @integerMaximumKey
                );
        END
  
        IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  = [rot].[AttributeKey] 
            FROM	@targets AS [t]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [rot]
                ON [t].[ObjectKey] = [rot].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [rot].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 	
                AND [t].[WebServiceUsageKeyword] = 1
                AND	[rot].[AttributeKey] = @stringRegexKey;			
        END
    
        IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  = [rob].[AttributeKey] 
            FROM	@targets AS [t]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [rob]
                ON [t].[ObjectKey] = [rob].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [rob].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 	
                AND [t].[WebServiceUsageKeyword] = 1            
                AND	[rob].[AttributeKey] = @requiredKey;			
        END

        IF @illegallyModifiedAttributeKey  IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN         
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatAttributeCannotBeModifiedException]
                (
                    [fim].[AttributeNameFromKey](@illegallyModifiedAttributeKey),
                    [fim].[AttributeNameFromKey](@illegallyModifiedAttributeKey)
                );
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
    END
    
    -- cannot create a required binding for an object type with "'Microsoft.ResourceManagement.WebServices" keyword
    SELECT @bindingObjectTypeKey = NULL;
    
    SELECT TOP 1 
       @bindingObjectTypeKey = [t].[ObjectTypeKey],
       @bindingAttributeKey = [t].[AttributeKey]	
    FROM    @targets AS [t]  
    WHERE   
            [t].[Create] = 1
        AND [t].[Required] = 1
        AND [t].[WebServiceUsageKeywordOnObjectTypeDescription] = 1;
        
    IF @bindingObjectTypeKey IS NOT NULL    
    BEGIN 
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatBindingCannotBeCreatedException]
            (
                [fim].[AttributeNameFromKey] (@bindingAttributeKey),
                [fim].[ObjectTypeNameFromKey] (@bindingObjectTypeKey)
            );
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END  
    
    -- Prevent creation of a required attribute binding if there is already instance of 
    -- this object type.
    DECLARE @requiredBindings TABLE
    (
        ObjectTypeKey       SMALLINT,
        AttributeTypeKey    SMALLINT,
        DataType            NVARCHAR(68)
    );
     
    INSERT INTO @requiredBindings 
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeTypeKey],
        [DataType]
    )
    SELECT
        [t].[ObjectTypeKey],
        [t].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[DataType]
    FROM  @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [rob] 
        ON  [rob].[ObjectKey] = [t].[ObjectKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    WHERE
            [rob].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [rob].[AttributeKey] = @requiredKey      
        AND [rob].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey        
        AND [rob].[ValueBoolean] = 1;  

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [rb].[DataType]  
        FROM @requiredBindings AS [rb]
        WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Binary'		
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey = [ovdt].[ObjectKey],
            @bindingObjectTypeKey = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey],
            @bindingAttributeKey = [rb].[AttributeTypeKey]		     
        FROM @requiredBindings AS [rb]	
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]	
            ON [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ovb]
            ON [rb].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ovb].[AttributeKey]            
            AND [rb].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovb].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ovb].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Binary'
            AND [ovb].[ValueBinary] IS NULL	
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey            
    END        
	
    IF 
    (
        @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rb].[DataType]  
            FROM @requiredBindings AS [rb]
            WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Boolean'		
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey = [ovdt].[ObjectKey],
            @bindingObjectTypeKey = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey],
            @bindingAttributeKey = [rb].[AttributeTypeKey]	
        FROM @requiredBindings AS [rb]	
        INNER JOIN  [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]	
            ON [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb]
            ON [rb].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ovb].[AttributeKey]            
            AND [rb].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovb].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ovb].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Boolean'
            AND [ovb].[ValueBoolean] IS NULL	
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey   
    END        

    IF 
    (
        @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rb].[DataType]  
            FROM @requiredBindings AS [rb]
            WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'DateTime'		
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey = [ovdt].[ObjectKey],
            @bindingObjectTypeKey = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey],
            @bindingAttributeKey = [rb].[AttributeTypeKey]
        FROM  @requiredBindings AS [rb]		
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            ON [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovd]
            ON [rb].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ovd].[AttributeKey] 
            AND [ovd].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
            AND [rb].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovd].[ObjectTypeKey] 
        WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'DateTime'
            AND [ovd].[ValueDateTime] IS NULL
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey   	
    END
	
    IF 
    (
        @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rb].[DataType]  
            FROM @requiredBindings AS [rb]
            WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Integer'		
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey = [ovdt].[ObjectKey],
            @bindingObjectTypeKey = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey],
            @bindingAttributeKey = [rb].[AttributeTypeKey]
        FROM  @requiredBindings AS [rb]		
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            ON [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ovi]
            ON [rb].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ovi].[AttributeKey]            
            AND [rb].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovi].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ovi].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Integer'
            AND [ovi].[ValueInteger] IS NULL
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey   		
    END
	
    IF 
    (
        @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rb].[DataType]  
            FROM @requiredBindings AS [rb]
            WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Reference'		
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey = [ovdt].[ObjectKey],
            @bindingObjectTypeKey = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey],
            @bindingAttributeKey = [rb].[AttributeTypeKey]
        FROM  @requiredBindings AS [rb]		
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            ON [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
            ON [rb].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ovr].[AttributeKey]         
            AND [rb].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Reference'
            AND [ovr].[ValueReference] IS NULL
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey   		
    END

    IF 
    (
        @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rb].[DataType]  
            FROM @requiredBindings AS [rb]
            WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'String'		
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey = [ovdt].[ObjectKey],
            @bindingObjectTypeKey = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey],
            @bindingAttributeKey = [rb].[AttributeTypeKey]	
        FROM  @requiredBindings AS [rb]		
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            ON [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
            ON [rb].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ovs].[AttributeKey]         
            AND [rb].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'String'
            AND [ovs].[ValueString] IS NULL
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey   		
    END

    IF 
    (
        @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [rb].[DataType]  
            FROM @requiredBindings AS [rb]
            WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Text'		
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @missingRequiredBindingObjectKey = [ovdt].[ObjectKey],
            @bindingObjectTypeKey = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey],
            @bindingAttributeKey = [rb].[AttributeTypeKey]		
        FROM  @requiredBindings AS [rb]		
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
            ON [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = [rb].[ObjectTypeKey]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
            ON [rb].[AttributeTypeKey] = [ovt].[AttributeKey]
            AND [rb].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovt].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ovt].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE [rb].[DataType] = N'Text'
            AND [ovt].[ValueText] IS NULL	
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey   	
    END
	
    IF (@missingRequiredBindingObjectKey IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN 
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatBindingCannotBeRequiredException](
            [fim].[AttributeNameFromKey] (@bindingAttributeKey),
            [fim].[ObjectTypeNameFromKey] (@bindingObjectTypeKey));
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END 
 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	C. Reference attributes cannot be required
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT TOP 1
        @attributeName = [t].[AttributeName],
        @objectTypeName = [t].[ObjectType] 
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [t].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    WHERE 
            [t].[Required] = 1
        AND [ai].[DataType] = N'Reference';

    IF (@attributeName IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatReferenceBindingCannotBeRequiredException](@attributeName, @objectTypeName);
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	D. Update cache tables
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    UPDATE [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    SET 
        [ObjectTypeKey] = [t].[ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey] = [t].[AttributeKey],
        [Required] = [t].[Required],
        [ObjectKey] = [t].[ObjectKey],
        [ObjectType] = [t].[ObjectType],
        [AttributeName] = [t].[AttributeName]
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN @targets AS [t]
        ON [bi].[ObjectKey] = [t].[ObjectKey];

	IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#bindingInternalToInsert') IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
	    DROP TABLE #bindingInternalToInsert;
	END

	SELECT
        [t].[ObjectTypeKey],
        [t].[AttributeKey],
        [t].[Required],
        [t].[ObjectKey],
        [t].[ObjectType],
        [t].[AttributeName] 
	INTO #bindingInternalToInsert
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
		ON [t].[ObjectKey] = [bi].[ObjectKey] 
    WHERE [bi].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;


    INSERT INTO [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [Required],
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectType],
        [AttributeName]
    )
    SELECT
        [t].[ObjectTypeKey],
        [t].[AttributeKey],
        [t].[Required],
        [t].[ObjectKey],
        [t].[ObjectType],
        [t].[AttributeName] 
	FROM #bindingInternalToInsert AS [t];

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	D.1. Initialize boolean attributes for existing objects
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	DECLARE @boolAttributeDataTypeKey TINYINT = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'Boolean');

    INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] 
    (   
        [ObjectKey], 
        [ObjectTypeKey], 
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueBoolean]
    )
    SELECT 
        [obj].[ObjectKey],
        [obj].[ObjectTypeKey],
        [ai].[Key],
		@boolDefaultValue
	FROM #bindingInternalToInsert AS [t]
	INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] [ai]
		ON [ai].[Key] = [t].[AttributeKey]
			AND [ai].[DataTypeKey] = @boolAttributeDataTypeKey
	INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [obj]
		ON [obj].[ObjectTypeKey] = [t].[ObjectTypeKey]
		WHERE [obj].[ObjectTypeKey] != @creatorObjectTypeKey;


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	E. Add locale specific binding descriptions 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @operation = N'Create'
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @bindingDescriptions
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [BoundAttributeType]
        )    
        SELECT
            [ObjectKey],
            [ValueReference]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ror]
        WHERE 
                [ror].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
            AND [ror].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
            AND [ror].[AttributeKey] = @boundAttributeTypeKey
            AND [ror].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
    
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueString]	
        (   
            [ObjectKey], 
            [ObjectTypeKey], 
            [AttributeKey],
            [SequenceID],
            [ValueString],
            [LocaleKey],
            [Multivalued]
        )
        SELECT 
            [bd].[ObjectKey], 
            @bindingDescriptionTypeKey, 
            [ovs].[AttributeKey],
            CAST((ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ovs].[ObjectKey], [ovs].[AttributeKey] ORDER BY [ovs].[AttributeKey])) AS SMALLINT),
            [ovs].[ValueString],
            [ovs].[LocaleKey],
            [ovs].[Multivalued]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]  
        INNER JOIN @bindingDescriptions AS [bd]
        ON [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [bd].[BoundAttributeType]        
        AND
        (
               [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @attributeDescriptionTypeKey 
            OR [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @attributeDisplayNameTypeKey
        )
        AND [ovs].[LocaleKey] != @defaultLocaleKey
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionObjectKey;
     END
    
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	F. Take care of inherited attributes
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    DECLARE @bindingsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[BindingDescriptionSchemaCollection]);

    SET @bindingsXml =
    ( 
        SELECT Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT') AS [ObjectKey]
        FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject)
        FOR XML RAW ('BindingDescription')
    );

    EXECUTE [fim].[UpdateBindingDescriptionsInherited]
        @bindingsXml = @bindingsXml;

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[PostProcessDataWarehouseBindingUpdate]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessDataWarehouseBindingUpdate]
    @requestKey BIGINT, 
    @targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection])
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @classSubscriptionFlag                      TINYINT,
        @dataWarehouseBindingObjectTypeKey          SMALLINT, 
        @dataWarehouseBindingAttributeKey           SMALLINT,
        @initialLoadOptionFlag                      TINYINT,
        @noOptionFlag                               TINYINT,
        @relationshipSubscriptionFlag               TINYINT,
        @systemDataWarehouseBindingObjectKey        BIGINT,
        @systemRelationshipOption                   TINYINT,
        @UpdateTime                                 DATETIME,
        @messageText                                NVARCHAR(MAX);
        
    DECLARE @targets TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]         BIGINT,
        [MappingXml]        XML(CONTENT [fim].[DataWarehouseBindingSchemaCollection])
    );
        
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    SET @UpdateTime = GETUTCDATE();

    SELECT
        @dataWarehouseBindingAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmDataWarehouseMapping'),    
        @dataWarehouseBindingObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmDataWarehouseBinding'),
        @systemDataWarehouseBindingObjectKey = [fim].[ObjectKeyFromObjectIdentifier]([fim].[GetProtectedDataWarehouseBindingIdentifier]()),
        @classSubscriptionFlag = 1,
        @relationshipSubscriptionFlag = 2,
        @initialLoadOptionFlag = 1,
        @noOptionFlag = 0;

    INSERT INTO @targets
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [MappingXml]
    )
    SELECT 
        Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT'),
        NULL
    FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject)
    WHERE 
            Root.targetObject.value('@Deleted', 'SMALLINT') = 0
        AND Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectTypeKey', 'SMALLINT') = @dataWarehouseBindingObjectTypeKey;

    -- This clause is for when the Object binding is deleted
    -- delete bindings from ExportLogSubscriptionBinding table
    DELETE FROM [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding]
    FROM [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding] AS [elsb]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
        ON [elsb].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey] 
    WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @dataWarehouseBindingAttributeKey
        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @dataWarehouseBindingObjectTypeKey
        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1;
   
   -- This clause cleans up any ExportLogBindings that are not associated with ExportLogSubscriptionBindings
    DELETE FROM [fim].[ExportLogBinding]
    FROM [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [elb]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding] AS [elsb]
	    ON [elb].[ExportBindingKey] = [elsb].[ExportBindingKey]
	WHERE [elsb].[ExportBindingKey] IS NULL;
    ------------------------- Get updated/inserted objects ------------------------------------------------

    -- Clause for when Object is inserted/modified             
    -- Get all inserted/updated MappingXml
    UPDATE @targets
    SET [MappingXml] = CAST([ovt].[ValueText] AS XML)
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovt].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @dataWarehouseBindingObjectTypeKey 
        AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @dataWarehouseBindingAttributeKey;
    
    -- insert/update data warehouse bindings

    DECLARE @dataWarehouseBindings  TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey] BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeName] NVARCHAR(448), 
        [AttributeName] NVARCHAR(448), 
        [SubscriptionType] TINYINT,
        [SubscriptionBindingDetails] NVARCHAR(MAX),
        [SubscriptionBindingOption] TINYINT
    );

    DECLARE cursor_targets CURSOR
        FOR SELECT [ObjectKey], [MappingXml]
            FROM @targets;

    DECLARE 
        @objectKey BIGINT,
        @mappingXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[DataWarehouseBindingSchemaCollection]);        

    OPEN cursor_targets;
    
    FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_targets INTO @objectKey, @mappingXml
    
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @dataWarehouseBindings
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeName], 
            [AttributeName], 
            [SubscriptionType],
            [SubscriptionBindingDetails],
            [SubscriptionBindingOption]
        )
        SELECT 
            @objectKey,
            [ClassBinding].value('./SystemObjectAttribute[1]/@ObjectTypeName', 'VARCHAR(448)'),
            [ClassBinding].value('./SystemObjectAttribute[1]/@AttributeName', 'VARCHAR(448)'),
            @classSubscriptionFlag,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),[ClassBinding].query('./DataWarehouseClassProperty[1]')),
            @initialLoadOptionFlag
        FROM 
            @mappingXml.nodes('Mapping/ClassBindings/ClassBinding') ClassBindings([ClassBinding])
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            @objectKey,
            [RelationshipBinding].value('./SystemObjectAttribute[1]/@ObjectTypeName', 'VARCHAR(448)'),
            [RelationshipBinding].value('./SystemObjectAttribute[1]/@AttributeName', 'VARCHAR(448)'),
            @relationshipSubscriptionFlag,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),[RelationshipBinding].query('./DataWarehouseRelationshipProperty[1]')),
            CASE
                WHEN [RelationshipBinding].value('./@InitialLoad', 'NVARCHAR(448)') = 'true' THEN @initialLoadOptionFlag
                ELSE @noOptionFlag
            END
        FROM 
            @mappingXml.nodes('Mapping/RelationshipBindings/RelationshipBinding') RelationshipBindings([RelationshipBinding]); 
            
        FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_targets INTO @objectKey, @mappingXml;
    END

    CLOSE cursor_targets;
    
    -- Check to make sure ALL Object.Attributes exist
    IF EXISTS 
    (
        SELECT TOP 1
            [dwb].[ObjectTypeName], 
            [dwb].[AttributeName],
            [bi].[ObjectType]
        FROM
            @dataWarehouseBindings AS [dwb]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
            ON [dwb].[ObjectTypeName] = [bi].[ObjectType]
            AND [dwb].[AttributeName] = [bi].[AttributeName]
        WHERE [bi].[ObjectType] IS NULL
    )        
    BEGIN            
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatDataWarehouseBindingException](N'Cannot create binding for non existing Object Attribute definition.');
        RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
        RETURN;   
    END

    -- insert object attribute binding pair into the ExportLogBinding table
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLogBinding] 
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey], 
        [AttributeKey], 
        [SubscriptionKey]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ResolvedBindingKeys].[ObjectTypeKey], 
        [ResolvedBindingKeys].[AttributeKey], 
        1
    FROM 
    (
        -- resolve keys for Object and Attribute pairs that are in @dataWarehouseBindings
        SELECT 
            [oti].[Key] AS [ObjectTypeKey], 
            [ai].[Key] AS [AttributeKey]
        FROM @dataWarehouseBindings AS [dwbs]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
            ON [oti].[Name] = [dwbs].[ObjectTypeName]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            ON [ai].[Name] = [dwbs].[AttributeName] 
    ) AS [ResolvedBindingKeys]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [elb] --left join with exportLogBinding, if bindingKey not in Export_log_binding, insert it
        ON [ResolvedBindingKeys].[ObjectTypeKey] = [elb].[ObjectTypeKey] 
        AND [ResolvedBindingKeys].[AttributeKey] = [elb].[AttributeKey]
    WHERE [elb].[ExportBindingKey] IS NULL;

    DECLARE @dataWarehouseBindingsResolved TABLE
    (
        [ExportBindingKey]                INT, 
        [SubscriptionBindingObjectKey]  BIGINT, 
        [SubscriptionBindingDetails]    NVARCHAR(MAX),
        [SubscriptionBindingOption]     TINYINT,
        [SubscriptionType]              TINYINT
    );

    INSERT INTO @dataWarehouseBindingsResolved
    (
        [ExportBindingKey], 
        [SubscriptionBindingObjectKey], 
        [SubscriptionBindingDetails],
        [SubscriptionBindingOption],
        [SubscriptionType]
    )
    SELECT 
        [elb].[ExportBindingKey], 
        [dwb].[ObjectKey], 
        [dwb].[SubscriptionBindingDetails],
        [dwb].[SubscriptionBindingOption],
        [dwb].[SubscriptionType]
    FROM @dataWarehouseBindings AS [dwb]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti] 
        ON [dwb].[ObjectTypeName] = [oti].[name]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ai].[Name] = [dwb].[AttributeName]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [elb]
        ON [elb].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oti].[Key] AND [elb].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key];

    --check to see if the user has attempted to set the SystemRelationshipProperty on a non-default data warehouse binding object
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [dwbr].[ExportBindingKey]
        FROM @dataWarehouseBindingsResolved AS [dwbr]
        WHERE 
                [dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey] <> @systemDataWarehouseBindingObjectKey
            AND [dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingOption] = @systemRelationshipOption
            AND [dwbr].[SubscriptionType] = @relationshipSubscriptionFlag
    )
    BEGIN            
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatDataWarehouseBindingException](N'Cannot create a data warehouse binding with the SystemRelationship attribute defined.');
        RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
        RETURN;   
    END
    

    -- add rows to ExportLogSubscriptionBinding table for new bindings
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding] 
    (
        [ExportBindingKey], 
        [SubscriptionBindingObjectKey], 
        [DefinitionDate], 
        [SubscriptionBindingDetails],
        [SubscriptionBindingOption]
    )
    SELECT 
        [dwbr].[ExportBindingKey], 
        [dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey], 
        @UpdateTime, 
        [dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingDetails],
        [dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingOption]
    FROM @dataWarehouseBindingsResolved AS [dwbr]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding] AS [xlsb]
        ON [dwbr].[ExportBindingKey] = [xlsb].[ExportBindingKey] 
        AND [dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey] = [xlsb].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey] 
        AND [fim].[CompareBindingTarget](CONVERT(XML,[dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingDetails]), CONVERT(XML,[xlsb].[SubscriptionBindingDetails])) = 0   
    WHERE [xlsb].[ExportBindingKey] IS NULL;


    DELETE FROM [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding]
    WHERE [ExportLogSubscriptionBindingKey] in
    (
        SELECT [ExportLogSubscriptionBindingKey]
        FROM 
        (
            SELECT 
                [xlsb].[ExportLogSubscriptionBindingKey],
                [xlsb].[ExportBindingKey],
                [xlsb].[SubscriptionBindingDetails],
                [xlsb].[DefinitionDate],
                [xlsb].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding] AS [xlsb]
            INNER JOIN @dataWarehouseBindingsResolved AS [dwbr]
            ON [xlsb].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey] = [dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey]            
        ) AS [exportLogSubscriptionBindingTrimed]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN @dataWarehouseBindingsResolved AS [dwbr]
            ON [dwbr].[ExportBindingKey] = [exportLogSubscriptionBindingTrimed].[ExportBindingKey] 
            AND [dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey] = [exportLogSubscriptionBindingTrimed].[SubscriptionBindingObjectKey] 
            AND [fim].[CompareBindingTarget](CONVERT(XML,[dwbr].[SubscriptionBindingDetails]), CONVERT(XML,[exportLogSubscriptionBindingTrimed].[SubscriptionBindingDetails])) = 0
        WHERE [dwbr].[ExportBindingKey] IS NULL
    );

    -- delete non-referenced binding key in ExportLogBinding table
    DELETE [fim].[ExportLogBinding]
    FROM [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [xlb]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding] AS [xlsb]
        ON [xlb].[ExportBindingKey] = [xlsb].[ExportBindingKey]
    WHERE
        [xlsb].[ExportLogSubscriptionBindingKey] IS NULL
        AND [xlb].[SubscriptionKey] = 1;
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[PostProcessDomainAndAccountNameUpdate]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessDomainAndAccountNameUpdate]
    @requestKey BIGINT
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @messageSizeLimit               SMALLINT;

    DECLARE 
        @accountNameAttributeKey        SMALLINT,
        @displayNameAttributeKey        SMALLINT,
        @domainAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
        @index                          BIGINT,
        @objectIdentifierAttributeKey   SMALLINT,
        @messageTargets                 NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @messageText                    NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    SELECT 
        @messageSizeLimit = 2048;
        
    SELECT
        @accountNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'AccountName'),
        @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
        @domainAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Domain'),
        @objectIdentifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectId');

    -- Note: Although ObjectValueString accomodates a larger string, 
    -- limits are placed on the Domainn and AccountName columns, corresponding
    -- to Active Directory limits. DomainAndAccountName is inserted into a single
    -- indexed column, and the combined key size must be <= 500.
    DECLARE @modifiedObjects TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]             BIGINT          NOT NULL,
        [ObjectTypeKey]         SMALLINT        NOT NULL,
        [Domain]                NVARCHAR(448)   NULL,
        [AccountName]           NVARCHAR(448)   NULL,
        [DomainAndAccountName]  NVARCHAR(321)   NULL,
        [Deleted]               BIT             NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
    );

    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* A.    Find all objects whose domain / accountName attributes have changed
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    
    INSERT INTO @modifiedObjects 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [Deleted] 
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [request].[ObjectKey],
        [request].[ObjectTypeKey],
        0
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [request]
    WHERE 
            [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
        AND
        (
                [request].[AttributeKey] = @domainAttributeKey 
            OR  [request].[AttributeKey] = @accountNameAttributeKey 
        );

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.    If the object is being deleted, remove the appropriate rows
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    UPDATE @modifiedObjects
    SET [Deleted] = 1
    FROM @modifiedObjects AS [mo]
    INNER JOIN [RequestOutputReference] AS [ror]
        ON [mo].[ObjectKey] = [ror].[ObjectKey] 
    WHERE 
            [ror].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ror].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierAttributeKey
        AND [ror].[Deleted] = 1;

    DELETE [fim].[DomainAndAccountName]
    FROM [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] AS [da]
    INNER JOIN @modifiedObjects AS [mo]
        ON [da].[ObjectKey] = [mo].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [mo].[Deleted] = 1;

    DELETE FROM @modifiedObjects
    WHERE [Deleted] = 1;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* C.    Find the object's userAccount. If it doesn't exist, remove it
*       from the cache.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    UPDATE @modifiedObjects
    SET [AccountName] = [ovs].[ValueString] 
    FROM @modifiedObjects AS [mo]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [mo].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @accountNameAttributeKey;

    DELETE [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] 
    FROM [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] AS [da]
    INNER JOIN @modifiedObjects AS [mo]
        ON [da].[ObjectKey] = [mo].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [mo].[AccountName] IS NULL;
        
    DELETE FROM @modifiedObjects 
    WHERE [AccountName] IS NULL;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* D.    Find the object's domain. If it doesn't exist, it is the empty string
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    UPDATE @modifiedObjects
    SET [Domain] = [ovs].[ValueString] 
    FROM @modifiedObjects AS [mo]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [mo].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @domainAttributeKey 

    UPDATE @modifiedObjects 
    SET [Domain] = N''
    WHERE [Domain] IS NULL;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* E.    Update the DomainAndAccountName column if it already exists.
*       Create it if necessary
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    UPDATE @modifiedObjects 
    SET [DomainAndAccountName] = LEFT([Domain] + N'\' + [AccountName],321);    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 
            [da].[ObjectKey],
            [da].[DomainAndAccountName]
        FROM [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] as [da]
        INNER JOIN @modifiedObjects AS [mo]
            ON [da].[DomainAndAccountName] = [mo].[DomainAndAccountName]
        WHERE [da].[ObjectKey] != [mo].[ObjectKey] 
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @exceptionObject TABLE
        (
            [Index]                 BIGINT  IDENTITY(1,1)   NOT NULL,
            [ObjectKey]             BIGINT                  NOT NULL,
            [ObjectTypeKey]         SMALLINT                NOT NULL,
            [DomainAndAccountName]  NVARCHAR(321)           NOT NULL,
            [DisplayName]           NVARCHAR(448)           NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY
            (
                [Index]
            )
        );
        
        INSERT INTO @exceptionObject
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [DomainAndAccountName]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [duplicate].[ObjectKey],
            [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [duplicate].[DomainAndAccountName]
        FROM [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] as [existing]
        INNER JOIN @modifiedObjects AS [duplicate]
            ON  [existing].[DomainAndAccountName] = [duplicate].[DomainAndAccountName];        
           
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [exception].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [name]
                ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [name].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [name].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [name].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN            
            UPDATE @exceptionObject
            SET [DisplayName] = [name].[ValueString]
            FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [name]
                ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [name].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [name].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [name].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [exception].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [name]
                ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [name].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [exception].[DisplayName] IS NULL
                AND [name].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN            
            UPDATE @exceptionObject
            SET [DisplayName] = [name].[ValueString]
            FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [name]
                ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [name].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE
                    [exception].[DisplayName] IS NULL
                AND [name].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey;
        END
        
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatUniqueDomainAccountNameException]();
        
        SELECT @index = MAX([exception].[Index])
        FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception];
        
        WHILE 1=1
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageTargets =
            ( 
                SELECT 
                N'',                    
                (
                    SELECT COALESCE ([exception].[DisplayName],[exception].[DomainAndAccountName]) AS [n]
                    FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
                    WHERE       [exception].[Index] <= @index
                    FOR XML PATH (N'i'), TYPE
                )
                FOR XML PATH (N'targets')
            );  
            
            IF @messageTargets IS NULL
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END
        
            IF (LEN(@messageText) + LEN(N' ') + LEN(@messageTargets)) <= @messageSizeLimit
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageText = @messageText + N' ' + @messageTargets;
                BREAK;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT @index = @index - 1;
                IF @index <= 0
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
            END
            
        END
        
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);       
    END


    UPDATE [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] 
    SET [DomainAndAccountName] = [mo].[DomainAndAccountName] 
    FROM [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] AS [da]
    INNER JOIN @modifiedObjects AS [mo]
        ON [da].[ObjectKey] = [mo].[ObjectKey];

    INSERT INTO [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [DomainAndAccountName] 
    )
    SELECT
        [mo].[ObjectKey],
        [mo].[DomainAndAccountName] 
    FROM @modifiedObjects AS [mo]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] AS [da]
        ON [mo].[ObjectKey] = [da].[ObjectKey] 
    WHERE [da].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;
 
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[PostProcessFilterUpdate]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessFilterUpdate] 
    @resourceKey                BIGINT,
    @filterAdded                BIT,
    @filterDeleted              BIT,
    @resourceTypeKey            SMALLINT    =   NULL,
    @cause                      BIGINT      =   NULL,
    @trueFlag                   BIT         =   NULL,
    @falseFlag                  BIT         =   NULL,
    @trace                      BIT         =   0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;

    DECLARE @startTime          DATETIME;
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    DECLARE 
        @computedMemberAttributeKey         SMALLINT,
        @computedMemberNestingLevel         INT,
        @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey     SMALLINT,
        @deferredEvaluationChanged          BIT,
        @filterAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName    NVARCHAR(16),
        @groupObjectTypeKey                 SMALLINT,
        @hasMembershipConditions            BIT,
        @identifierAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
        @levelChanged                       BIT,
        @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @nestingLevel                       INT,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
        @temporal                           BIT,
        @temporalAttributeKey               SMALLINT,
        @requestSQL                         NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @sql                                NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    SELECT 
        @computedMemberAttributeKey         =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey     =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmDeferredEvaluation'),
        @filterAttributeKey                 =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Filter'),
        @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName    =   [fim].[GetFilterSQLAncillaryParameterName](),
        @groupObjectTypeKey                 =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Group'),
        @identifierAttributeKey             =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey             =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType'),
        @temporalAttributeKey               =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Temporal');
        
        
    IF @resourceTypeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @resourceTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey](@resourceKey);
    END

    -- Check whether request changed the value of "DeferredEvaluation" attribute.
    -- If it did and there is a filter on the group (which means the group is dynamic), filter recalculation will be required.
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @cause
            AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @groupObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey
    )
    AND EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ovt].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
        WHERE [ovt].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
            AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @deferredEvaluationChanged = @trueFlag;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT @deferredEvaluationChanged = @falseFlag;
    END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    If a filter is being removed from a resource, remove the resource from
 *        the Set table and the SetDependency table.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @filterDeleted = @trueFlag
    AND @filterAdded = @falseFlag
    BEGIN
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [nesting].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetFilter] AS [nesting]
            WHERE        [nesting].[SetKey] = @resourceKey
        )            
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [fim].[SetFilter]
            WHERE        [SetKey] = @resourceKey;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [set].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[Set] AS [set]
            WHERE        [set].[SetKey] = @resourceKey
        )            
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [fim].[Set]
            WHERE        [SetKey] = @resourceKey;
        END
        
        -- Cancel the recalculation since the filter is deleted
        SELECT @deferredEvaluationChanged = @falseFlag;
    END    
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    If a filter is being assigned to a resource, ensure that the resource
 *        is recorded in the Set table.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/        
    IF @filterAdded = @trueFlag
        OR
       @deferredEvaluationChanged = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [smc].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
            WHERE        [smc].[SetKey] = @resourceKey
        )
        OR
        (
            [fim].[IsGroupOfTypeDeferred](@resourceKey) = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @hasMembershipConditions = @trueFlag;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @hasMembershipConditions = @falseFlag;
        END
        
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [s].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[Set] AS [s]
            WHERE        [s].[SetKey] = @resourceKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[Set]    
            (
                [SetKey],
                [HasMembershipConditions]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @resourceKey,
                @hasMembershipConditions
            );
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [set].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[Set] AS [set]
            WHERE
                    [set].[SetKey] = @resourceKey
                AND [set].[HasMembershipConditions] != @hasMembershipConditions
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [fim].[Set]
            SET    [fim].[Set].[HasMembershipConditions] = @hasMembershipConditions
            WHERE        [fim].[Set].[SetKey] = @resourceKey;
        END
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    If a filter is being assigned to a resource, ensure that the resource
 *        is recorded in the SetFilter table.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ancillaryParameter].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [ancillaryParameter]
            WHERE
                    [ancillaryParameter].[RequestKey] = @cause
                AND [ancillaryParameter].[Name] = @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @sql = [ancillaryParameter].[Value]
            FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [ancillaryParameter]
            WHERE
                    [ancillaryParameter].[RequestKey] = @cause
                AND [ancillaryParameter].[Name] = @filterSQLAncillaryParameterName
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateSetFilterSQL]
                @setKey                         = @resourceKey,
                @setTypeKey                     = @resourceTypeKey,
                @requestKey                     = NULL,
                @computedMemberAttributeKey     = @computedMemberAttributeKey,
                @identifierAttributeKey         = @identifierAttributeKey,
                @requestSetFilterSQL            = @requestSQL OUTPUT,
                @setFilterSQL                   = @sql OUTPUT;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ov]
            WHERE
                    [ov].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = @resourceTypeKey
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = @temporalAttributeKey
                AND [ov].[ValueBoolean] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
                WHERE   [statement].[DereferencedValueObjectKey] = @resourceKey
            )
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatDereferencedTemporalResourceException]();
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                RETURN;
            END
        
            SELECT @temporal = @trueFlag;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @temporal = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [filter].[SetKey]
            FROM [fim].[SetFilter] AS [filter]
            WHERE
                    [filter].[SetKey] = @resourceKey
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [fim].[SetFilter]
            SET
                [Temporal] = @temporal,
                [SQL] = @sql
            WHERE
                    [SetKey] = @resourceKey;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[SetFilter]
            (
                [SetKey],
