                [SetTypeKey],
                [Temporal],
                [SQL]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @resourceKey,
                @resourceTypeKey,
                @temporal,
                @sql
            );
        END
    END
    
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @cause, 
            @stage      = N'PostProcessFilterUpdate';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[PostProcessManagementPolicyRuleUpdate]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessManagementPolicyRuleUpdate]
@requestKey BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;


    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @actionParameterKey                     SMALLINT,
        @actionTypeKey                          SMALLINT,
        @disabledKey                            SMALLINT,
        @grantRightKey                          SMALLINT,
        @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey      SMALLINT,
        @managementPolicyRuleTypeKey            SMALLINT,
        @objectIdentifierKey                    SMALLINT,
        @principalSetKey                        SMALLINT,
        @principalRelativeToResourceKey         SMALLINT,
        @resourceCurrentSetKey                  SMALLINT,
        @resourceFinalSetKey                    SMALLINT,
        @messageText                            NVARCHAR(MAX);
            
    SELECT
        @actionParameterKey                 = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ActionParameter'),
        @actionTypeKey                      = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ActionType'),
        @disabledKey                        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Disabled'),
        @grantRightKey                      = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'GrantRight'),
        @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey  = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'ManagementPolicyRule'), 
        @managementPolicyRuleTypeKey        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ManagementPolicyRuleType'),
        @objectIdentifierKey                = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectID'),
        @principalSetKey                    = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'PrincipalSet'),
        @principalRelativeToResourceKey     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'PrincipalRelativeToResource'),
        @resourceCurrentSetKey              = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ResourceCurrentSet'),
        @resourceFinalSetKey                = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ResourceFinalSet');

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	Check to see if we really have anything to do
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    IF NOT EXISTS 
    (
        SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        WHERE 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
        WHERE 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
        WHERE 
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
        AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END


    
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	A. Enable disabled rules prior to modification
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    DECLARE @enabledRules TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT
    );

    INSERT INTO @enabledRules
    (
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
    WHERE   
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @disabledKey 
        AND [ro].[ValueBoolean] = 1
        AND [ro].Deleted = 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [ObjectKey]
        FROM @enabledRules 
    )
    BEGIN

        INSERT INTO [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ActionParameterAll],
            [GrantRight]
        )
        SELECT 
            [ObjectKey],
            0,
            0
        FROM @enabledRules;

        
        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [ActionParameterAll] = 1
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        WHERE   
                [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
            AND [ovs].AttributeKey = @actionParameterKey
            AND [ovs].[ValueString] = N'*' 
            AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            );

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [PrincipalSet] = [ovr].[ValueReference] 
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr] 
        WHERE   
                [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
            AND [ovr].AttributeKey = @principalSetKey 
            AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            );

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] = [ai].[Key]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
            ON [ovs].[ValueString] = [ai].[Name] 
        WHERE   
                [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
            AND [ovs].AttributeKey = @principalRelativeToResourceKey  
            AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            );

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [ResourceCurrentSet] = [ovr].[ValueReference] 
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr] 
        WHERE   
                [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
            AND [ovr].AttributeKey = @resourceCurrentSetKey 
            AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            );

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [ResourceFinalSet] = [ovr].[ValueReference] 
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr] 
        WHERE   
                [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
            AND [ovr].AttributeKey = @resourceFinalSetKey 
            AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ovr].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            );

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [GrantRight] = [ovb].[ValueBoolean]  
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb] 
        WHERE   
                [ovb].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
            AND [ovb].AttributeKey = @grantRightKey
            AND [ovb].[ObjectKey] = [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ovb].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            );

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [ManagementPolicyRuleType] = [ovs].[ValueString]  
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs] 
        WHERE   
                [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
            AND [ovs].AttributeKey = @managementPolicyRuleTypeKey
            AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            );


        -- multivalued MPR tables
        
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] 
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ActionParameterKey]
        )
        SELECT 
            [ovs].[ObjectKey], 
            [ai].[Key]   
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ovs].[ValueString] = [ai].[Name] 
        WHERE   
                [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
            AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @actionParameterKey  
            AND [ovs].ValueString != N'*'
            AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            );

        -- clecking length of ActionType
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ovs].[ValueString]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
            WHERE
                    [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
                AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @actionTypeKey 
                AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] IN
                (
                    SELECT [ObjectKey]
                    FROM @enabledRules
                )
                AND LEN([ovs].[ValueString]) > 20
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatStringOrBinaryTruncationException]( N'ManagementPolicyRuleOperation', N'ActionType');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        INSERT INTO [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] 
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ActionType]
        )
        SELECT [ovs].[ObjectKey], CAST([ovs].[ValueString] AS NVARCHAR(20))
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        WHERE   
                [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
            AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @actionTypeKey 
            AND [ovs].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            );

    END        


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	B. Populate read cache with enabled / grant right modifications with
--     existing values prior to other modifications
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal] 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [PrincipalSet],
        [PrincipalRelativeToResource],
        [ResourceCurrentSet],
        [ActionParameterAll]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [mpr].[ObjectKey],
        [mpr].[PrincipalSet],
        [mpr].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent],
        [mpr].[ResourceCurrentSet],
        [mpr].[ActionParameterAll] 
    FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [mpr]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro] 
        ON [mpr].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
        AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] AS [mpro]
        ON  [mpr].[ObjectKey] = [mpro].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [mpro].[ActionType] = N'Read'
    WHERE   
        (
            [mpr].[GrantRight] = 1
            AND [mpr].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ObjectKey]
                FROM @enabledRules
            )
        )
        OR
        (
                [ro].[AttributeKey] = @grantRightKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0
            AND [ro].[ValueBoolean] = 1
        );

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	C. Find all rules that are disabled, and delete them from the cache tables
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    DECLARE @disabledOrDeletedRules TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT
    );

    INSERT INTO @disabledOrDeletedRules 
    (
        [ObjectKey] 
    )
    SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
    WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @disabledKey
        AND [ro].[ValueBoolean]  = 1
        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0;
        
        
    INSERT INTO @disabledOrDeletedRules 
    (
        [ObjectKey] 
    )
    SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
    WHERE
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey 
        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1;
    
    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] 
    WHERE [ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [ObjectKey] FROM @disabledOrDeletedRules
        );

    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation]  
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [ObjectKey] FROM @disabledOrDeletedRules
        );

    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
    WHERE [ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [ObjectKey] FROM @disabledOrDeletedRules
        );

    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute]   
    WHERE [ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [ObjectKey] FROM @disabledOrDeletedRules
        );

    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal]  
        WHERE [ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [ObjectKey] FROM @disabledOrDeletedRules
        );
	
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	D. Find all rules that no longer have grant right, and remove them from
--     the read cache tables
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute] 
    WHERE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute].[ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
            WHERE   
                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @grantRightKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBoolean] = 1
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1
        );

    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal] 
    WHERE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal].[ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
            WHERE   
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @grantRightKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBoolean] = 1
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1
        );

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	D.1. Done if the MPR disabled
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   
    -- IMT 22863  FIM is designed for 1 Target per Request (Target is a single valued Attribute), however the
    -- RequestParameters object also has a Target property.  Our business logic contained in the C# ActionProcessors may add
    -- additional RequestParameters to a Request and the Target may also be different than the Request.Target  When this occurs
    -- The Request is now "multi-targeted".  "Multi-Targeted" Requests were added late in the development cycle 
    -- so a majority of the SQL code is unaware of this "inner" Target and therefore is not written to include that Target in the business logic.
    -- Development of a function/stored procedure that could be called to return "All Targets" of a Request should be considered to replace
    -- Queries that just assume a single Target such as  AND [r].[TargetKey] = [o].[ObjectKey].   Something like
    -- [fim].[GetAllTargets](@requestKey)  that returns a TABLE should be used in a JOIN operation instead.
    -- If a particular feature doesn't support Multi-Targeted Requests then it should write a detection statement and
    -- call RAISERROR to prevent the Request from completing.
    
    IF EXISTS 
    (
        -- disabled MPR
        SELECT [o].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [o]
        ON  [r].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [r].[TargetKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        AND [o].AttributeKey = @disabledKey
        AND [o].ValueBoolean = 1
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	E. Update New MPR Cache rows for single valued attributes
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [ObjectKey]
        FROM @enabledRules 
    )
    BEGIN
    
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule]
        (
	        [ObjectKey],
	        [GrantRight],
	        [ActionParameterAll]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
		        [ro].[ObjectKey],
		        0,
		        0
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
        WHERE
		        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
	        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
	        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey
	        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0;

        -- The following reference on ORDER BY does not affect the accuracy of subqueries below becuase 
        -- we always select TOP(1).
        -- http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ms188385.aspx: "When ORDER BY is used in the definition of a view, 
        -- inline function, derived table, or subquery, the clause is used only to determine the rows returned 
        -- by the TOP clause. The ORDER BY clause does not guarantee ordered results when these constructs are queried, 
        -- unless ORDER BY is also specified in the query itself."

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [ActionParameterAll] = CASE WHEN [change].[Deleted] = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        FROM 
        (
	        SELECT TOP(1) [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[Deleted]
	        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
	        WHERE   
			        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
		        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
		        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @actionParameterKey  
		        AND [ro].[ValueString] = N'*'
		        ORDER BY [ro].[Deleted] ASC
        ) as [change]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] m
        ON [m].[ObjectKey] = [change].[ObjectKey]
            
        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [GrantRight] = CASE WHEN [change].[Deleted] = 0 THEN ISNULL( [change].[ValueBoolean], 0 ) ELSE 0 END 
        FROM
        (
	        SELECT TOP(1) [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[Deleted], [ro].[ValueBoolean]
	        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
	        WHERE   
			        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
		        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
		        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @grantRightKey 
		        ORDER BY [ro].[Deleted] ASC
        ) as [change]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] m
        ON [m].[ObjectKey] = [change].[ObjectKey]

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [ManagementPolicyRuleType] = CASE WHEN [change].[Deleted] = 0 THEN ISNULL( [change].[ValueString], N'' ) ELSE N'' END 
        FROM
        (
	        SELECT TOP(1) [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[Deleted], [ro].[ValueString]
	        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
	        WHERE   
			        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
		        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
		        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleTypeKey
		        ORDER BY [ro].[Deleted] ASC
        ) as [change]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] m
        ON [m].[ObjectKey] = [change].[ObjectKey]


        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [PrincipalSet] = CASE WHEN [change].[Deleted] = 0 THEN [change].[ValueReference] ELSE NULL END  
        FROM
        (
	        SELECT TOP(1) [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[Deleted], [ro].[ValueReference]
	        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
	        WHERE   
			        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
		        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
		        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @principalSetKey 
		        ORDER BY [ro].[Deleted] ASC
        ) as [change]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] m
        ON [m].[ObjectKey] = [change].[ObjectKey]
           
        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent] = CASE WHEN [change].[Deleted] = 0 THEN [ai].[Key] ELSE NULL END    
        FROM
        (
	        SELECT TOP(1) [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[Deleted], [ro].[ValueString]
	        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
	        WHERE   
			        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
		        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
		        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @principalRelativeToResourceKey 
		        ORDER BY [ro].[Deleted] ASC
        ) as [change]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] m
        ON [m].[ObjectKey] = [change].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [change].[ValueString] = [ai].[Name] 

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule]       
        SET [ResourceCurrentSet] = CASE WHEN [change].[Deleted] = 0 THEN [change].[ValueReference] ELSE NULL END  
        FROM
        (
	        SELECT TOP(1) [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[Deleted], [ro].[ValueReference]
	        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
	        WHERE   
			        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
		        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
		        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @resourceCurrentSetKey 
		        ORDER BY [ro].[Deleted] ASC
        ) as [change]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] m
        ON [m].[ObjectKey] = [change].[ObjectKey]
           
        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule]       
        SET [ResourceFinalSet] = CASE WHEN [change].[Deleted] = 0 THEN [change].[ValueReference] ELSE NULL END  
        FROM
        (
	        SELECT TOP(1) [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[Deleted], [ro].[ValueReference]
	        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
	        WHERE   
			        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
		        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
		        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @resourceFinalSetKey
		        ORDER BY [ro].[Deleted] ASC
        ) as [change]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] m
        ON [m].[ObjectKey] = [change].[ObjectKey]

           
        -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        --	F. Update New MPR Cache rows for multi-valued attributes
        -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] 
        SET [ActionParameterAll] = 0
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
        WHERE   
		        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
	        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
	        AND [ManagementPolicyRule].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey] 
	        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @actionParameterKey  
	        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1
	        AND [ro].[ValueString] = N'*';


        INSERT INTO [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] 
        (
	        [ObjectKey],
	        [ActionParameterKey] 
        )
        SELECT 
	        [ro].[ObjectKey],
	        [ai].[Key] 
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [ro].[ValueString] = [ai].[Name] 
        WHERE   
		        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
	        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
	        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @actionParameterKey 
	        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0
	        AND [ro].[ValueString] != N'*';

        DELETE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute]
        FROM [fim].ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute AS [mpra]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
	        ON [mpra].[ActionParameterKey] = [ai].[Key] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
	        ON  [mpra].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey] 
	        AND [ai].[Name] = [ro].[ValueString]
	        AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
	        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @actionParameterKey
	        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1;
            
        -- clecking length of ActionType
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ValueString]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @actionTypeKey 
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0
                AND LEN([ro].[ValueString]) > 20
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatStringOrBinaryTruncationException]( N'ManagementPolicyRuleOperation', N'ActionType');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        INSERT INTO [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] 
        (
	        [ObjectKey],
	        [ActionType] 
        )
        SELECT 
	        [ro].[ObjectKey],
	        CAST([ro].[ValueString] AS NVARCHAR(20)) 
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
        WHERE   
		        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
	        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
	        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @actionTypeKey 
	        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0;

        DELETE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] 
        FROM [fim].ManagementPolicyRuleOperation AS [mpro]
        JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
	        ON  [mpro].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey] 
	        AND [mpro].[ActionType] = [ro].[ValueString]
	        AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
	        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @actionTypeKey 
	        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1;
    
    END

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	G. Update MPR Read caches
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal] 
    (
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT [mpr].[ObjectKey]  
    FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [mpr]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] AS [mpro]
        ON [mpr].[ObjectKey] = [mpro].ObjectKey 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal] AS [mprri]
        ON [mpr].[ObjectKey] = [mprri].[ObjectKey] 
    WHERE   
        [mpr].[GrantRight] = 1
        AND [mpro].[ActionType] = N'Read'
        AND [mprri].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;
                

    DECLARE @nonReadRules TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT
    );

    INSERT INTO @nonReadRules
    (
        [ObjectKey] 
    )
    SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
    WHERE   
            [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
        AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey 
        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @actionTypeKey 
        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1
        AND [ro].[ValueString] = N'Read';

    DELETE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute]
    FROM [fim].ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute AS [mpra]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [mpra].[ActionParameterKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
        ON  [mpra].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [ai].[Name] = [ro].[ValueString]
        AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @actionParameterKey
        AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1;


    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute]
    WHERE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute].[ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [ObjectKey] 
            FROM @nonReadRules
        );    
    
    DELETE FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal]
    WHERE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal].[ObjectKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [ObjectKey] 
            FROM @nonReadRules
        );    

    UPDATE [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal] 
    SET 
        [PrincipalSet] = [mpr].[PrincipalSet],
        [PrincipalRelativeToResource] = [mpr].[PrincipalRelativeToResourceCurrent],
        [ResourceCurrentSet] = [mpr].[ResourceCurrentSet],
        [ActionParameterAll] = [mpr].[ActionParameterAll]
    FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [mpr]
    WHERE   
            [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal].[ObjectKey] = [mpr].[ObjectKey]
        AND [mpr].[GrantRight] = 1
        AND
        (
            [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                WHERE   
                        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                    AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
            )
            OR
            [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternal].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
                WHERE   
                        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                    AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
            )
        );

        
    INSERT INTO [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute] 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ActionParameterKey] 
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [mpra].[ObjectKey], 
        [mpra].[ActionParameterKey] 
    FROM [fim].[ManagementPolicyRule] AS [mpr]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleOperation] AS [mpro]
        ON [mpr].[ObjectKey] = [mpro].[ObjectKey] 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleAttribute] AS [mpra]
        ON [mpr].[ObjectKey] = [mpra].[ObjectKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ManagementPolicyRuleReadInternalAttribute] AS [mprria]
        ON  [mpra].[ObjectKey] = [mprria].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [mpra].[ActionParameterKey] = [mprria].[ActionParameterKey] 
    WHERE   
            [mpr].[GrantRight] = 1
        AND [mpro].[ActionType] = N'Read'
        AND [mprria].[ObjectKey] IS NULL 
        AND [mprria].[ActionParameterKey] IS NULL
        AND
        (
            [mpr].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                WHERE   
                        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                    AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
            )
            OR
            [mpr].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
                WHERE   
                        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                    AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
            )
            OR
            [mpr].[ObjectKey] IN
            (
                SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey] 
                FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
                WHERE   
                        [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
                    AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @managementPolicyRuleObjectTypeKey
            )
        );
        
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[PostProcessObjectTypeDescriptionUpdate]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessObjectTypeDescriptionUpdate]
    @requestKey BIGINT, 
    @targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection])
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey       SMALLINT,
        @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @nameKey                            SMALLINT,
        @objectIdentifierKey                SMALLINT,
        @objectKey                          BIGINT,
        @trueFlag                           BIT;
    
    SELECT
        @objectKey                      = NULL,   
        @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey   = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectTypeDescription'),
        @nameKey                        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'Name'),
        @objectIdentifierKey            = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectID'),
        @trueFlag                       = CONVERT(BIT,1);

    DECLARE @targets TABLE
    (
        [Name]              NVARCHAR(448),
        [ObjectKey]         BIGINT
    );

    INSERT INTO @targets
    (
        [Name],
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT 
        N'',
        Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT')
    FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject)
    WHERE 
            Root.targetObject.value('@Deleted', 'SMALLINT') = 0
        AND Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectTypeKey', 'SMALLINT') = @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey;
        

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--     A. Take care of deletions
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT @objectKey = [request].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [type]
        ON     [request].[ObjectKey] = [type].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
        ON     [type].[Key] = [object].[ObjectTypeKey]
    WHERE
                [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
            AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey
            AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
            
    IF @objectKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatObjectTypeInUseException](@objectKey);
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
    
    SELECT @objectKey = [request].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [request]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [type]
        ON  [request].[ObjectKey] = [type].[ObjectKey] 
        AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [statement]
        ON     [type].[Key] = [statement].[ObjectTypeKey]
    WHERE
                [request].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
            AND [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey
            AND [request].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
    
    IF @objectKey IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatObjectTypeInUseException](@objectKey);
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
        
    DELETE [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [rof]
        ON  [oti].[ObjectKey] = [rof].[ObjectKey]
        AND [rof].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdentifierKey
    WHERE
            [rof].[RequestKey] = @requestKey 
        AND [rof].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [rof].[Deleted] = 1;

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--     B. Take care of creates / updates
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    UPDATE @targets
    SET [Name] = [ovs].[ValueString] 
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
        ON  [t].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey 
        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @nameKey;


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--     C. Update cache tables
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    UPDATE [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] 
    SET 
        [Name] = [t].[Name]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti] 
    INNER JOIN @targets AS [t]
        ON [oti].[ObjectKey] = [t].[ObjectKey];

    INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] 
    (
        [Name],
        [ObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT
        [t].[Name],
        [t].[ObjectKey]
    FROM @targets AS [t]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
        ON [t].[ObjectKey] = [oti].[ObjectKey] 
        WHERE [oti].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[PostProcessPersonUpdate]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessPersonUpdate]
    @requestKey BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE @personObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @objectSIDAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(MAX);
    
    SET @objectSIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectSID');
    SET @personObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Person');    

    -- If the objectSID attribute is modified on a person object, we need to update the UserSidTable
    
    -- This clause is for when the ObjectSID attribute is deleted
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[AttributeKey] = @objectSIDAttributeKey
            AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @personObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[UserSecurityIdentifiers] WITH(ROWLOCK)
        FROM [fim].[UserSecurityIdentifiers] AS [usi]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
            ON [usi].[UserObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @personObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @objectSIDAttributeKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = 1
            AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey;
    END
    
    -- Clause for when ObjectSID is inserted/modified             
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @personObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @objectSIDAttributeKey
            AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT [ro].[ValueBinary]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[UserSecurityIdentifiers] AS [usi]
                ON [ro].[ValueBinary] = [usi].[SecurityIdentifier]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @personObjectTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @objectSIDAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatUniqueUserSecurityIdentifierException]();
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);       
        END

        -- clecking length of ObjectSID
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT [ro].[ValueBinary]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @personObjectTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @objectSIDAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0
                AND LEN([ro].[ValueBinary]) > 85
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatStringOrBinaryTruncationException]( N'UserSecurityIdentifiers', N'SecurityIdentifier');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        INSERT INTO [fim].[UserSecurityIdentifiers] WITH(ROWLOCK)
        (
            [UserObjectKey],
            [SecurityIdentifier]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [ro].[ObjectKey],
            CAST([ro].[ValueBinary] AS VARBINARY(85))
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
        WHERE
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @personObjectTypeKey
            AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @objectSIDAttributeKey
            AND [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ro].[Deleted] = 0            
    END
    
END
GO

--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessSupportedLocaleConfigurationUpdate]
    @requestKey BIGINT,
    @targetKey BIGINT
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        @supportedLocaleConfigurationTypeKey  SMALLINT,
        @supportedLanguageCodeAttributeKey    SMALLINT,
        @messageText                          NVARCHAR(MAX);

    SELECT
        @supportedLocaleConfigurationTypeKey  = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'SupportedLocaleConfiguration'),
        @supportedLanguageCodeAttributeKey    = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'SupportedLanguageCode');
        
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	Update LocaleInernal Cache table
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    -- checking length of locale
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT [ros].[ValueString]
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ros] 
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap] 
            ON  [ros].[RequestKey] = [rap].[RequestKey]
            AND [ros].[ValueString] = [rap].[Name]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[LocaleInternal] AS [li] 
            ON  [rap].[Name] = [li].[Name] 
        WHERE 
                [ros].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ros].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
            AND [ros].[ObjectTypeKey] = @supportedLocaleConfigurationTypeKey
            AND [ros].[AttributeKey] = @supportedLanguageCodeAttributeKey
            AND [ros].[Deleted] = 0 
            AND [li].[Key] IS NULL
            AND LEN([ros].[ValueString]) > 16
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatStringOrBinaryTruncationException]( N'LocaleInternal', N'Name');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END


    DECLARE @newlocale TABLE 
    (
        [Key] SMALLINT, 
        [Name] NVARCHAR(16)
    )

    INSERT INTO @newlocale 
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        CAST([rap].[Value] AS SMALLINT),
        CAST([ros].[ValueString] AS NVARCHAR(16))
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ros] 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap] 
        ON  [ros].[RequestKey] = [rap].[RequestKey]
        AND [ros].[ValueString] = [rap].[Name]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[LocaleInternal] AS [li] 
        ON  [rap].[Name] = [li].[Name] 
    WHERE 
            [ros].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
        AND [ros].[ObjectKey] = @targetKey
        AND [ros].[ObjectTypeKey] = @supportedLocaleConfigurationTypeKey
        AND [ros].[AttributeKey] = @supportedLanguageCodeAttributeKey
        AND [ros].[Deleted] = 0 
        AND [li].[Key] IS NULL;

    INSERT INTO [fim].[LocaleInternal] 
    (
        [Key],
        [Name]
    )
    SELECT [NewLocale].[Key], [NewLocale].[Name] 
    FROM @newlocale	AS [NewLocale]

    --This part migrate from old locales to news like from 'ru-ru' to 'ru' 
    --For saving custom added locale string 
    DECLARE @oldLocaleMapping TABLE 
    (
        [NewKey] SMALLINT, 
        [OldKey] SMALLINT
    )

    INSERT INTO @oldLocaleMapping VALUES
    (5, 1029), (6, 1030), (7, 1031), (10, 3082), 
    (11, 1035), (12, 1036), (16, 1040), (17, 1041), 
    (18, 1042), (19, 1043), (21, 1045), (22, 2070), 
    (25, 1049), (29, 1053), (31, 1055), (4, 2052), 
    (31748, 1028)

    DECLARE @mappedLocale TABLE 
    (
        [NewKey] SMALLINT, 
        [OldKey] SMALLINT
    )

    INSERT INTO @mappedLocale
    SELECT [mapping].[NewKey], [mapping].[OldKey] 
    FROM @oldLocaleMapping AS [mapping]
    INNER JOIN @newlocale 
        ON [@newlocale].[Key] = [mapping].[NewKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[LocaleInternal] 
        ON [fim].[LocaleInternal].[Key] = [mapping].[OldKey] 	

    UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueString]
    SET [LocaleKey] = [ml].[NewKey] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs] 
    INNER JOIN @mappedLocale AS [ml]
        ON [ovs].[LocaleKey] = [ml].[OldKey]
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[PostProcessUpdate]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessUpdate]
    @resourceKey                            BIGINT,
    @resourceTypeKey                        SMALLINT,    
    @cause                                  BIGINT,
    @time                                   DATETIME,
    @trueFlag                               BIT         = NULL,
    @falseFlag                              BIT         = NULL,
    @trace                                  BIT         = 0
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    IF @trueFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF @falseFlag IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    END
    
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;

        DECLARE @startTime  DATETIME;

        IF @trace = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
        END

        DECLARE 
            @accountNameAttributeKey                SMALLINT,
            @attributeKey                           SMALLINT,
            @computedMemberAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
            @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey         SMALLINT,
            @displayNameAttributeKey                SMALLINT,
            @domainAttributeKey                     SMALLINT,
            @explicitMemberAttributeKey             SMALLINT,
            @filterAttributeKey                     SMALLINT,
            @endpointAddressAttributeKey            SMALLINT,
            @identifierAttributeKey                 SMALLINT,
            @isReportingLoggingSettingChanging      BIT,
            @count                                  BIGINT,
            @operation                              NVARCHAR(448),
            @policyRuleObjectTypeKey                SMALLINT,
            @reportingLoggingEnabledAttributeKey    SMALLINT,           
            @isReportingLoggingEnabledCurrentValue  BIT,
            @rulesAttributeKey                      SMALLINT,
            @systemConfigurationObjectTypeKey       SMALLINT,
            @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey        SMALLINT,
            @workflowDefinitionVersionKey           INT,
            @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey          SMALLINT,
            @xomlAttributeKey                       SMALLINT;

        SELECT 
            @accountNameAttributeKey                =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AccountName'),
            @computedMemberAttributeKey             =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
            @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey         =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmDeferredEvaluation'),
            @domainAttributeKey                     =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Domain'),
            @identifierAttributeKey                 =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
            @isReportingLoggingSettingChanging      =   @falseFlag,
            @filterAttributeKey                     =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Filter'),
            @reportingLoggingEnabledAttributeKey    =   [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmReportingLoggingEnabled'),
            @systemConfigurationObjectTypeKey       =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmSystemConfiguration'),
            @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey        =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');
            
        SELECT @operation = [r].[Operation]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE
                [r].[RequestKey] = @cause;

        DECLARE @targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection]);
        EXEC [fim].[GetTargetObjectsForRequest] 
            @requestKey = @cause, 
            @targetObjects = @targetsXml OUTPUT;

        DECLARE @affectedObjectTypes TABLE
        (
            [ObjectTypeName]     NVARCHAR(448)
        );

        INSERT INTO @affectedObjectTypes
        (
            [ObjectTypeName] 
        )
        SELECT Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectType', 'NVARCHAR(448)') AS [name]
        FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject);


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* A.    Validate schema meta-constraints
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        EXEC [fim].[PostProcessValidateSchemaConstraints] 
            @targetsXml = @targetsXml;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* B.    Update various cache tables
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ao].[ObjectTypeName] FROM @affectedObjectTypes AS [ao] 
            WHERE [ao].[ObjectTypeName] = N'AttributeTypeDescription'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessAttributeTypeDescriptionUpdate]
                @requestKey = @cause,
                @targetsXml = @targetsXml;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ao].[ObjectTypeName] FROM @affectedObjectTypes AS [ao] 
            WHERE [ao].[ObjectTypeName] = N'ObjectTypeDescription'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessObjectTypeDescriptionUpdate]
                @requestKey = @cause,
                @targetsXml = @targetsXml;
        END
        

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ao].[ObjectTypeName] FROM @affectedObjectTypes AS [ao] 
            WHERE [ao].[ObjectTypeName] = N'BindingDescription'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessBindingDescriptionUpdate]
                @requestKey = @cause,
                @targetsXml = @targetsXml;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ao].[ObjectTypeName] FROM @affectedObjectTypes AS [ao] 
            WHERE [ao].[ObjectTypeName] = N'msidmDataWarehouseBinding'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessDataWarehouseBindingUpdate]
                @requestKey = @cause,
                @targetsXml = @targetsXml;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ao].[ObjectTypeName] FROM @affectedObjectTypes AS [ao] 
            WHERE [ao].[ObjectTypeName] = N'SupportedLocaleConfiguration'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessSupportedLocaleConfigurationUpdate]
                @requestKey = @cause,
                @targetKey = @resourceKey;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ao].[ObjectTypeName] FROM @affectedObjectTypes AS [ao] 
            WHERE [ao].[ObjectTypeName] = N'ManagementPolicyRule'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessManagementPolicyRuleUpdate]
                @requestKey = @cause;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ao].[ObjectTypeName] FROM @affectedObjectTypes AS [ao] 
            WHERE [ao].[ObjectTypeName] = N'Person'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessPersonUpdate] 
                @requestKey = @cause;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ros].[AttributeKey] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ros]
            WHERE 
                [ros].[RequestKey] = @cause
                AND
                (
                        [ros].[AttributeKey] = @accountNameAttributeKey
                    OR  [ros].[AttributeKey] = @domainAttributeKey 
                )
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessDomainAndAccountNameUpdate]
                @requestKey = @cause;
        END


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Remove references to deleted resource and resource values
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @deleted                        TABLE
        (
            [ObjectKey]                         BIGINT
        );

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @cause
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @deleted
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [ro].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @cause
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;        
           
            DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
            WHERE
                    [mcst].[ResourceKey] IN
                    (
                        SELECT [d].[ObjectKey]
                        FROM @deleted AS [d]
                    );
            
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D.	Update the set cache.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @filterAdded                BIT,
                @filterDeleted              BIT,
                @deferredEvaluationChanged  BIT,
                @deferredEvaluationSet      BIT;

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @cause
                AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @resourceTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @filterAdded = @trueFlag;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @filterAdded = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @cause
                AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @resourceTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @filterAttributeKey

                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @filterDeleted = @trueFlag;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @filterDeleted = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @cause
                AND [ro].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = @resourceTypeKey
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = @deferredEvaluationAttributeKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND [ro].[ValueBoolean] = @trueFlag -- Explicitly specifying true
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT @deferredEvaluationSet = @trueFlag;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @deferredEvaluationSet = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF
        (
               @filterAdded = @trueFlag
            OR @filterDeleted = @trueFlag
            OR EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [bi].[ObjectTypeKey]
                FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
                WHERE
                (
                        [bi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @resourceTypeKey
                    AND [bi].[AttributeKey] = @computedMemberAttributeKey
                )
            )
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[PostProcessFilterUpdate] 
                @resourceKey = @resourceKey,
                @filterAdded = @filterAdded, 
                @filterDeleted = @filterDeleted,
                @resourceTypeKey = @resourceTypeKey,
                @cause = @cause,
                @trueFlag = @trueFlag,
                @falseFlag = @falseFlag,
                @trace = @trace;
        
            IF @operation = N'Delete'
            OR
            (
                    @operation = N'Put'
                AND @filterDeleted = @trueFlag
                AND @filterAdded = @falseFlag
            )
            OR
            (
                    @operation = N'Put'
                AND @deferredEvaluationSet = @trueFlag
            )
            BEGIN
                EXECUTE [fim].[DeleteSetMembershipConditions] @resourceKey;
            END
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E.    Update Workflow Cache Tables  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        -- If the target object is a Workflow definition ...
        IF @resourceTypeKey = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
        BEGIN

            IF @operation = N'Delete'
            BEGIN

                -- ... expire it in the Workflow Definition cache table
                UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowDefinition]
                SET [Deleted] = @trueFlag
                WHERE 
                        [ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                    AND [Deleted] = @falseFlag;
                
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                --For all other change types refresh the workflow cache to pickup any changes to the workflow definition.
                EXECUTE [fim].[DoCacheWorkflowDefinition]
                    @workflowDefinitionKey = @resourceKey,
                    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey OUTPUT;
            END

            -- Update the "Run Mapping" table.  The DoRefreshWorkflowRetroactivePolicyCache procedure will insert or remove rows from the "Run Mapping" table as appropriate.  
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoRefreshWorkflowRetroactivePolicyCache]
                @workflowDefinitionKey = @resourceKey,
                @extendedOutput = 0;

        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F. When a request has been committed any management policy rules that 
 *    apply to the change that it entailed, must be applied.    
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoApplyPolicyRule] @requestKey = @cause;
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G.    Do set transitions.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoSetTransitions] 
            @resourceKey        = @resourceKey, 
            @requestKey         = @cause,
            @trace              = @trace;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * H.    Write request values to log.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddRequestLog]
            @requestKey         = @cause,
            @targetsXml         = @targetsXml,
            @trace              = @trace;

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * I.    Write request values to export (reporting) log based on reportingLoggingEnabled value 
         or if this value is changing.
         system configuration setting is set to true
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/       
        SELECT 
            @isReportingLoggingEnabledCurrentValue = [fim].[GetBooleanSystemConfigurationSetting](@reportingLoggingEnabledAttributeKey);   
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] as [rob]
            WHERE
                    [rob].[RequestKey] = @cause
                AND [rob].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                AND [rob].[AttributeKey] = @reportingLoggingEnabledAttributeKey            
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @isReportingLoggingSettingChanging = @trueFlag;
        END
         
        
        IF (    (@isReportingLoggingEnabledCurrentValue = @trueFlag) 
             OR (@isReportingLoggingSettingChanging = @trueFlag) 
           )
        BEGIN                    
            EXECUTE [fim].[AddExportLog]
                @requestKey         = @cause,
                @targetsXml         = @targetsXml,
                @trace              = @trace;
        END
        
        IF @trace = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
                @startTime  = @startTime,
                @requestKey = @cause, 
                @stage      = N'PostProcessUpdate';
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[PostProcessValidateSchemaConstraints]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[PostProcessValidateSchemaConstraints]
    @targetsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[TargetObjectSchemaCollection])
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @messageSizeLimit               SMALLINT;

    SELECT 
        @messageSizeLimit = 2048;

    DECLARE 
        @displayNameAttributeKey    SMALLINT,
        @index                      BIGINT,        
        @messageTargets             NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),        
        @missingAttribute           NVARCHAR(448);
        
    SELECT 
        @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName'),
        @missingAttribute = NULL;
    
    DECLARE @exceptionObject TABLE
    (
        [Index]         BIGINT  IDENTITY(1,1)   NOT NULL,
        [ObjectKey]     BIGINT                  NOT NULL,
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT                NOT NULL,
        [Identifier]    NVARCHAR(448)           NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [Index]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @requiredAttributes TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]             BIGINT,
        [ObjectTypeKey]         SMALLINT,
        [AttributeName]         NVARCHAR(448),
        [AttributeKey]          SMALLINT,
        [DataType]              NVARCHAR(64)
    );

    INSERT INTO @requiredAttributes
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeName],
        [AttributeKey],
        [DataType]
    )
    SELECT 
        Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT'),
        [bi].[ObjectTypeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        [bi].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[DataType] 
    FROM @targetsXml.nodes('/TargetObject') AS Root(targetObject)
    INNER JOIN [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
        ON  Root.targetObject.value('@ObjectTypeKey', 'SMALLINT') = [bi].[ObjectTypeKey]
        AND [bi].[Required] = 1
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [bi].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    WHERE Root.targetObject.value('@Deleted', 'SMALLINT') = 0;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [ra].[ObjectKey] 
        FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
        WHERE [ra].[DataType] = N'Binary'
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @missingAttribute = [ra].[AttributeName] 
        FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ov]
            ON  [ra].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ra].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ra].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey] 
        WHERE 
                [ra].[DataType] = N'Binary'
            AND [ov].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;
    END
    
    IF 
    (
        @missingAttribute IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [ra].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
            WHERE [ra].[DataType] = N'Boolean'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @missingAttribute = [ra].[AttributeName] 
        FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ov]
            ON  [ra].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ra].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ra].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey] 
        WHERE 
                [ra].[DataType] = N'Boolean'
            AND [ov].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
    END

    IF 
    (
        @missingAttribute IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [ra].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
            WHERE [ra].[DataType] = N'DateTime'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @missingAttribute = [ra].[AttributeName] 
        FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ov]
            ON  [ra].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ra].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ra].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey] 
        WHERE 
                [ra].[DataType] = N'DateTime'
            AND [ov].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
    END
    
    IF 
    (
        @missingAttribute IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [ra].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
            WHERE [ra].[DataType] = N'Integer'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @missingAttribute = [ra].[AttributeName] 
        FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ov]
            ON  [ra].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ra].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ra].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey] 
        WHERE 
                [ra].[DataType] = N'Integer'
            AND [ov].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
    END

    -- Reference types cannot be marked as required
    -- so there is no need to check ObjectValueReference
    
    IF 
    (
        @missingAttribute IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [ra].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
            WHERE [ra].[DataType] = N'String'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @missingAttribute = [ra].[AttributeName] 
        FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ov]
            ON  [ra].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ra].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ra].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey] 
        WHERE 
                [ra].[DataType] = N'String'
            AND [ov].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
    END
    
    IF 
    (
        @missingAttribute IS NULL
        AND EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [ra].[ObjectKey] 
            FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
            WHERE [ra].[DataType] = N'Text'
        )
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @missingAttribute = [ra].[AttributeName] 
        FROM @requiredAttributes AS [ra]
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ov]
            ON  [ra].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey] 
            AND [ra].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] 
            AND [ra].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey] 
        WHERE 
                [ra].[DataType] = N'Text'
            AND [ov].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
    END


    IF @missingAttribute IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @exceptionObject
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [required].[ObjectKey],
            [required].[ObjectTypeKey]
        FROM @requiredAttributes AS [required]
        WHERE       [required].[AttributeName] = @missingAttribute;
                
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [exception].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [name]
                ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [name].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE       [name].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
        )
        BEGIN            
            UPDATE @exceptionObject
            SET [Identifier] = [name].[ValueString]
            FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [name]
                ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [name].[ObjectKey]
                AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [name].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE       [name].[AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [exception].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
                ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [objects].[ObjectKey]
                AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [objects].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE       [exception].[Identifier] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN            
            UPDATE @exceptionObject
            SET [Identifier] = CAST([objects].[ObjectID] AS NVARCHAR(448))
            FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [objects]
                ON  [exception].[ObjectKey] = [objects].[ObjectKey]
                AND [exception].[ObjectTypeKey] = [objects].[ObjectTypeKey]
            WHERE       [exception].[Identifier] IS NULL;
        END
        
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequiredAttributeViolationException](@missingAttribute);
        
        SELECT @index = MAX([exception].[Index])
        FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception];
        
        WHILE 1=1
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageTargets =
            ( 
                SELECT 
                N'',                    
                (
                    SELECT [exception].[Identifier] AS [n]
                    FROM @exceptionObject AS [exception]
                    WHERE       [exception].[Index] <= @index
                    FOR XML PATH (N'i'), TYPE
                )
                FOR XML PATH (N'targets')
            );  
            
            IF @messageTargets IS NULL
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END
        
            IF (LEN(@messageText) + LEN(N' ') + LEN(@messageTargets)) <= @messageSizeLimit
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageText = @messageText + N' ' + @messageTargets;
                BREAK;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT @index = @index - 1;
                IF @index <= 0
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
            END
            
        END
        
        RAISERROR (@messageText, 16, 1);
    END
END
GO
