CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ProcessAncillaryRequestParameters]
    @requestKey            BIGINT,
    @resourceKey        BIGINT,
    @processingTime        DATETIME,
    @trace              BIT = 0
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName  NVARCHAR(32),
        @requestObjectTypeKey                       SMALLINT,
        @startTime                                  DATETIME;

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    DECLARE @membershipCondition TABLE
    (
        [SetKey]                    BIGINT,
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT,
        [Time]                      DATETIME,
        PRIMARY KEY 
        (
            [SetKey], 
            [MembershipConditionKey]
        ) 
    );
    
    DECLARE @partition TABLE
    (
        [SetKey]        BIGINT,
        [StatementKey]  INT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [SetKey],
            [StatementKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @partitionCondition TABLE
    (
        [SetKey]                    BIGINT,
        [MembershipConditionKey]    INT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [SetKey],
            [MembershipConditionKey]
        )
    );
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A.    MembershipCondition.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
    SELECT 
        @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName  =   [fim].[GetMembershipConditionAncillaryParameterName](),
        @requestObjectTypeKey                       =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rap].[Value]
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
        WHERE
                [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
    )
    BEGIN
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[DeleteSetMembershipConditions] @resourceKey, @requestKey;
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rap].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
            WHERE
                    [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName
        )
        BEGIN   
            INSERT INTO @membershipCondition
            (
                [SetKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [Time]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                @resourceKey,
                CAST([rap].[Value] AS INT),
                @processingTime
            FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
            WHERE
                    [rap].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [rap].[Name] = @membershipConditionAncillaryParameterName;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
            FROM @membershipCondition AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [duplicate].[MembershipConditionKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM @membershipCondition AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [duplicate]
                ON [candidate].[SetKey] = [duplicate].[SetKey]
                AND [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [duplicate].[MembershipConditionKey];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [membershipCondition].[SetKey]
            FROM @membershipCondition AS [membershipCondition]
        )
        BEGIN 
            INSERT INTO [fim].[SetMembershipCondition]
            (
                [SetKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [Time]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [membershipCondition].[SetKey],
                [membershipCondition].[MembershipConditionKey],
                [membershipCondition].[Time]
            FROM @membershipCondition AS [membershipCondition];
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [condition].[SetKey]
                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                    ON    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE       [condition].[SetKey] = @resourceKey
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @partition
                (
                    [SetKey],
                    [StatementKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [condition].[SetKey],
                    [partition].[StatementKey]
                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                    ON    [partition].[MembershipConditionKey] = [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                WHERE        [condition].[SetKey] = @resourceKey;
                
                INSERT INTO @partitionCondition
                (
                    [SetKey],
                    [MembershipConditionKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [candidate].[SetKey],
                    [condition].[MembershipConditionKey]
                FROM @partition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [condition]
                    ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey];
                    
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM @partitionCondition AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN @partition AS [set]
                    ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [set].[SetKey]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition] AS [partition]
                    ON  [set].[StatementKey] = [partition].[StatementKey]
                    AND [candidate].[MembershipConditionKey] = [partition].[MembershipConditionKey];
                    
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                    FROM @partition AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN @partitionCondition AS [condition]
                        ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey]
                )
                BEGIN
                    DELETE [candidate]
                    FROM @partition AS [candidate]
                    INNER JOIN @partitionCondition AS [condition]
                        ON  [candidate].[SetKey] = [condition].[SetKey]
                END
                
                IF EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT [candidate].[SetKey]
                    FROM @partition AS [candidate]
                )
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO [fim].[SetPartition]
                    (
                        [SetKey],
                        [StatementKey]
                    )
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        [candidate].[SetKey],
                        [candidate].[StatementKey]
                    FROM @partition AS [candidate]
                END
            END
        END
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoSystemObjectSetTransitions] 
            @objectKey      = @requestKey,
            @objectTypeKey  = @requestObjectTypeKey;
    END

   
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'ProcessAncillaryRequestParameters';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[ProcessDeferredGroupMembershipChanges]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ProcessDeferredGroupMembershipChanges]
AS
BEGIN
/*
This sproc takes #MembershipModificationsIds table as input and generates requests to process membership changes.
Processing is done in batches (for performance reasons). Default batch size is 5000 records. It can be changed with
SystemProperty "DeferredEvaluationGroupBatchSize". In the same batch there can be members from different groups,
in the same batch there can be memberships to create and to delete. There is no guarantee that all the membership
changes for a given group will be processed in the same batch. The membership changes are not sent as request parameters,
instead only the batch size and the id in #MembershipModificationsIds table starting from which the batch should be taken
are sent with the request (as ancillary parameters). [fim].[GenerateRequestOutput] knows how to deal with this kind of
requests: it takes the data directly from #MembershipModificationsIds and puts it in [fim].[RequestOutputReference]

Algorithm:
1) Select batch of records to process from #MembershipModificationsIds
2) Identify the list of targets that will be affected by the request that is about to be created
3) Create composite type object with the list of targets that were identified for the batch
4) Create and execute request with the ancillary parameters (batch size and last id) and composite type object as request target.
5) Repeat from step 1) untill there are no unprocessed records in #MembershipModificationsIds
*/

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @ancillaryParametersTemplate                    NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ancillaryParameters                            XML,
        @batchSize                                      INT,
        @compositeTypeIdentifier                        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                     SMALLINT,
        @deferredEvaluationGroupBatchSizeSystemProperty NVARCHAR(448),
        @errorMessage                                   NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @falseFlag                                      BIT,
        @lastId                                         INT,
        @parameters                                     XML,
        @parametersAddMemberToSetTemplate               NVARCHAR(1024),
        @parametersRemoveMemberFromSetTemplate          NVARCHAR(1024),
        @parametersString                               NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @requestDisplayNameTemplate                     NVARCHAR(448),
        @requestIdentifier                              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @requestStatusFinalKey                          SMALLINT,
        @serviceAccountIdentifier                       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @targetIdsString                                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @targetIdsXML                                   XML,
        @trueFlag                                       BIT;

    SELECT
        @computedMemberAttributeKey                     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ComputedMember'),
        @deferredEvaluationGroupBatchSizeSystemProperty = N'DeferredEvaluationGroupBatchSize',
        @falseFlag                                      = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @lastId                                         = 0,
        @parametersAddMemberToSetTemplate               = N'<RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>false</Calculated><Target>{0}</Target><PropertyName>ComputedMember</PropertyName><Value xmlns:q1=''http://microsoft.com/wsdl/types/'' xsi:type=''q1:guid''>{1}</Value><Operation>Create</Operation><Mode>Add</Mode></RequestParameter>',
        @parametersRemoveMemberFromSetTemplate          = N'<RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>false</Calculated><Target>{0}</Target><PropertyName>ComputedMember</PropertyName><Value xmlns:q1=''http://microsoft.com/wsdl/types/'' xsi:type=''q1:guid''>{1}</Value><Operation>Create</Operation><Mode>Remove</Mode></RequestParameter>',
        @requestDisplayNameTemplate                     = N'Deferred Group Membership Calculation',
        @serviceAccountIdentifier                       = [fim].[GetServiceAccountIdentifier](),
        @trueFlag                                       = CONVERT(BIT,1);

    SELECT
        @batchSize                                      = ISNULL(CAST([fim].[GetSystemProperty](@deferredEvaluationGroupBatchSizeSystemProperty) AS INT), -1);
    
    IF @batchSize < 1
    BEGIN
        SELECT @batchSize = 5000;
    END

    SELECT
        @ancillaryParametersTemplate                    = N'<AncillaryParameters><RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>true</Calculated><Target>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000</Target><PropertyName>GroupCalculation</PropertyName><Value xsi:type=''xsd:string''>True</Value><Operation>Put</Operation></RequestParameter><RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>true</Calculated><Target>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000</Target><PropertyName>BatchSize</PropertyName><Value xsi:type=''xsd:string''>' + CAST(@batchSize AS NVARCHAR(20)) + '</Value><Operation>Put</Operation></RequestParameter><RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>true</Calculated><Target>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000</Target><PropertyName>LastId</PropertyName><Value xsi:type=''xsd:string''>{0}</Value><Operation>Put</Operation></RequestParameter></AncillaryParameters>';

    DECLARE @errors TABLE
    (
        [TargetIdentifier] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        [ErrorMessage] NVARCHAR(MAX)
    );

    WHILE (1 = 1)
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #MembershipModificationsIds
            WHERE [Id] > @lastId
        )
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END

        SELECT @targetIdsString = N'',
            @compositeTypeIdentifier = NEWID(),
            @ancillaryParameters = CAST(REPLACE(@ancillaryParametersTemplate, '{0}', CAST(@lastId AS NVARCHAR(20))) AS XML);
        
        SELECT @targetIdsString = @targetIdsString + N'<v>' + CAST([o].[ObjectID] AS NVARCHAR(36)) + N'</v>'
        FROM
        (
            SELECT TOP (@batchSize) [mm].[SetKey]
            FROM #MembershipModificationsIds AS [mm]
            WHERE [mm].[Id] > @lastId
            ORDER BY [mm].[Id]
        ) AS [mm]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
            ON [mm].[SetKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]
        GROUP BY [o].[ObjectID];
        
        SELECT @targetIdsXML = CAST(@targetIdsString AS XML);
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoCompositeTypeCreation]
            @compositeTypeIdentifier = @compositeTypeIdentifier,
            @creator = @serviceAccountIdentifier,
            @values = @targetIdsXML;

        SELECT @parameters = CAST(N'<RequestParameters/>' AS XML);

        BEGIN TRY
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoCreateEvaluateAndProcessSystemRequest]
                @requestDisplayNameTemplate = @requestDisplayNameTemplate,
                @operation = N'Put',
                @parameters = @parameters,
                @ancillaryParameters = @ancillaryParameters,
                @targetIdentifier = @compositeTypeIdentifier OUTPUT,
                @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT,
                @requestStatusFinalKey = @requestStatusFinalKey OUTPUT,
                @extendedOutput = 0; 
        
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            SET @errorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();
            
            INSERT INTO @errors
            (
                [TargetIdentifier],
                [ErrorMessage]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @compositeTypeIdentifier,
                @errorMessage
            );
        END CATCH
        
        SELECT TOP (@batchSize) @lastId = [Id]
        FROM #MembershipModificationsIds
        WHERE [Id] > @lastId
        ORDER BY [Id];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM @errors
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @errorString NVARCHAR(MAX);
        SELECT @errorString = N'';
        
        SELECT @errorString = @errorString + N'<Error compositeTypeObjectId="' + ISNULL(CAST([TargetIdentifier] AS NVARCHAR(36)), N'') + '">' + [ErrorMessage] + N'</Error>'
        FROM @errors;
        
        RAISERROR(@errorString, 16, 1);
    END
END
GO

-- Top level
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ProcessRequest]
    @requestIdentifier          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @trace                      BIT                 = 0,
    @reevaluationRequired       BIT                 = 0,
    @resourceIdentifier	        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER            OUTPUT,
    @requestDependencyKey       TINYINT                     OUTPUT,
    @committedRequestStatusKey  SMALLINT                    OUTPUT,
    @committedTime              DATETIME                    OUTPUT   
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    SELECT  @committedRequestStatusKey = NULL, -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @committedTime = NULL,             -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @resourceIdentifier = NULL,        -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @requestDependencyKey = NULL;      -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    DECLARE
        @falseFlag              BIT,
        @trueFlag               BIT,
        @requestKey             BIGINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey   SMALLINT;
        
    SELECT
        @falseFlag              = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag               = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    BEGIN TRY
        --DESIGN POINT:  The service calls this from within a transcation.
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;

        SELECT @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
                        
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID                                   = @requestIdentifier,
            @objectTypeKey                              = @requestObjectTypeKey,
            @objectKey                                  = @requestKey               OUTPUT;

        DECLARE @resourceKey BIGINT;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoProcessRequest]
            @requestKey                                 = @requestKey,
            @includeResourceInActionWorkflowCreation    = @falseFlag,
            @trace                                      = @trace,
            @trueFlag                                   = @trueFlag,
            @falseFlag                                  = @falseFlag,
            @reevaluateRequest                          = @reevaluationRequired,
	        @resourceKey                                = @resourceKey               OUTPUT,
	        @requestDependencyKey                       = @requestDependencyKey      OUTPUT,
	        @committedRequestStatusKey                  = @committedRequestStatusKey OUTPUT,
	        @committedTime                              = @committedTime             OUTPUT
	        
        SELECT @resourceIdentifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@resourceKey);

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTabularFunctionTruth]
    @statementKey        INT,
    @tabularFunctionKey INT,
    @attributeKey        SMALLINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE
        @dataTypeKey        TINYINT,
        @dataTypeKeyInteger TINYINT,
        @dataTypeKeyReference TINYINT,
        @dataTypeKeyString TINYINT,
        @identifierAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        
    SELECT 
        @dataTypeKey = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromAttributeKey](@attributeKey),
        @dataTypeKeyInteger = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'Integer'),
        @dataTypeKeyReference = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'Reference'),
        @dataTypeKeyString = [fim].[DataTypeKeyFromName](N'String'),
        @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @objectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectType');
        
    IF
    (
            @attributeKey = @identifierAttributeKey
        OR    @attributeKey = @objectTypeAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [truth].[StatementKey]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
        WHERE        [truth].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [truth]
        FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [truth]
        WHERE        [truth].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
    END
    
    
    IF    
    (
            @dataTypeKey = @dataTypeKeyInteger
        AND EXISTS
            (
                    SELECT    [value].[ObjectKey]
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [value]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
                        ON    [value].[ValueInteger] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
                    WHERE    
                            [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionKey
                        AND    [value].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
            )
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ResourceKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @statementKey,
            [value].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
            ON    [value].[ValueInteger] = [function].[TabularFunctionKey]
        WHERE    
                [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionKey
            AND    [value].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
        
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF    @dataTypeKey = @dataTypeKeyInteger
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTabularIntegerFunctionTruth]
            @statementKey = @statementKey, 
            @tabularFunctionKey = @tabularFunctionKey, 
            @attributeKey = @attributeKey;
    END
    
    IF    @dataTypeKey = @dataTypeKeyReference
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTabularReferenceFunctionTruth]
            @statementKey = @statementKey, 
            @tabularFunctionKey = @tabularFunctionKey, 
            @attributeKey = @attributeKey;
    END
    
    IF    @dataTypeKey = @dataTypeKeyString
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTabularStringFunctionTruth]
            @statementKey = @statementKey, 
            @tabularFunctionKey = @tabularFunctionKey, 
            @attributeKey = @attributeKey;
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTabularIntegerFunctionTruth]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTabularIntegerFunctionTruth]
    @statementKey        INT,
    @tabularFunctionKey INT,
    @attributeKey        SMALLINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
            SELECT    [value].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [value]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
                ON    [value].[ValueInteger] = [function].[Value]
            WHERE    
                    [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionKey
                AND    [value].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ResourceKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @statementKey,
            [value].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue] AS [function]
            ON    [value].[ValueInteger] = [function].[Value]
        WHERE    
                [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionKey
            AND    [value].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
        
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTabularReferenceFunctionTruth]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTabularReferenceFunctionTruth]
    @statementKey        INT,
    @tabularFunctionKey INT,
    @attributeKey        SMALLINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
            SELECT    [value].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [function]
                ON    [value].[ValueReference] = [function].[Value]
            WHERE    
                    [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionKey
                AND    [value].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
        (
            [StatementKey],
            [ResourceKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @statementKey,
            [value].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [value]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue] AS [function]
            ON    [value].[ValueReference] = [function].[Value]
        WHERE    
                [function].[TabularFunctionKey] = @tabularFunctionKey
            AND    [value].[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey;
        
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTruth]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RecordMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	@statementKey INT,
	@attributeKey SMALLINT,
	@operatorEqual BIT,
	@operatorGreater BIT,
	@operatorLike BIT,
	@literalValueBoolean BIT = NULL,
	@literalValueDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
	@literalValueInteger BIGINT = NULL,
	@literalValueReference BIGINT = NULL,
	@literalValueString NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
	@functionValueKey INT = NULL,
    @trace BIT = 0 
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;	

	DECLARE 
	    @functionValue	    DATETIME,
	    @messageText        NVARCHAR(MAX),
	    @startTime          DATETIME;
	
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

	IF EXISTS
	(
	    SELECT [ai].[Key]
	    FROM [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
	    WHERE
	            [ai].[Key] = @attributeKey
	        AND [ai].[Name] IN
	            (
	                N'ObjectID',
	                N'ObjectType'
	            )
	)
	BEGIN
	    RETURN;
	END
	
	IF @functionValueKey IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
	
	    SELECT @functionValue = [mcfv].[Value]
	    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [mcfv]
	    WHERE
	            [mcfv].[FunctionValueKey] = @functionValueKey;
    	
	    IF (@functionValue IS NOT NULL)
	    BEGIN
	        SET @literalValueDateTime = @functionValue
	    END
	END
	
	DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	WHERE
	        [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth].[StatementKey] = @statementKey;
	
    IF (@literalValueReference IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN
        IF (@operatorEqual != 1)
        BEGIN
				SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorEqual');
				RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
				RETURN;
        END

	    INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	    (
		    [StatementKey],
		    [ResourceKey]
	    )
		    SELECT DISTINCT
			    @statementKey,
			    v.[ObjectKey]
		    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS v
		    WHERE
		    (
			    (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
			    AND
			    (@literalValueReference = v.[ValueReference])
		    );
    END
    ELSE IF (@literalValueBoolean IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN
        IF (@operatorEqual != 1)
        BEGIN
				SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorEqual');
				RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
				RETURN;
        END

	    INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	    (
		    [StatementKey],
		    [ResourceKey]
	    )
		    SELECT DISTINCT
			    @statementKey,
			    v.[ObjectKey]
		    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS v
		    WHERE
		    (
			    (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
			    AND
			    (@literalValueBoolean = v.[ValueBoolean])
		    );
    END
    ELSE IF (@literalValueDateTime IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN
        IF (@operatorLike = 1)
        BEGIN
				SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorLike');
				RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
				RETURN;
        END

        IF (@operatorEqual = 1)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
            (
		        [StatementKey],
		        [ResourceKey]
            )
	            SELECT DISTINCT
		            @statementKey,
		            v.[ObjectKey]
	            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS v
	            WHERE
	            (
		            (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
		            AND
		            (@literalValueDateTime = v.[ValueDateTime])
	            );
        END
        ELSE IF (@operatorGreater = 1)
        BEGIN
	        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	        (
		        [StatementKey],
		        [ResourceKey]
	        )
		        SELECT DISTINCT
			        @statementKey,
			        v.[ObjectKey]
		        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS v
		        WHERE
		        (
			        (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
			        AND
			        (@literalValueDateTime < v.[ValueDateTime])
		        );
        END
    END
    ELSE IF (@literalValueInteger IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN
        IF (@operatorLike = 1)
        BEGIN
				SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorLike');
				RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
				RETURN;
        END

        IF (@operatorEqual = 1)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
            (
		        [StatementKey],
		        [ResourceKey]
            )
	            SELECT DISTINCT
		            @statementKey,
		            v.[ObjectKey]
	            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS v
	            WHERE
	            (
		            (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
		            AND
		            (@literalValueInteger = v.[ValueInteger])
	            );
        END
        ELSE IF (@operatorGreater = 1)
        BEGIN
	        INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	        (
		        [StatementKey],
		        [ResourceKey]
	        )
		        SELECT DISTINCT
			        @statementKey,
			        v.[ObjectKey]
		        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS v
		        WHERE
		        (
			        (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
			        AND
			        (@literalValueInteger < v.[ValueInteger])
		        );
        END
    END
    ELSE IF (@literalValueString IS NOT NULL)
    BEGIN
        IF (@operatorGreater = 1)
        BEGIN
				SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'@operatorGreater');
				RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
				RETURN;
        END

        DECLARE @isText BIT;
        SET @isText = 0;
        
        IF ([fim].[AttributeTypeFromKey](@attributeKey) = N'Text')
        BEGIN
            SET @isText = 1;
        END

        IF (@operatorEqual = 1)
        BEGIN
            IF (@isText = 0)
            BEGIN
	            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	            (
		            [StatementKey],
		            [ResourceKey]
	            )
	            SELECT DISTINCT
		            @statementKey,
		            v.[ObjectKey]
	            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS v
                WHERE
                (
	                (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
	                AND
			        (v.[ValueString] = @literalValueString)
                )
		    END
		    ELSE
		    BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
	                [StatementKey],
	                [ResourceKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
	                @statementKey,
	                v.[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS v
                WHERE
                (
	                (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
	                AND
			        (v.[ValueText] = @literalValueString)
                )
            END
        END
        ELSE IF(@operatorLike = 1)
        BEGIN
            IF (@isText = 0)
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                (
	                [StatementKey],
	                [ResourceKey]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
	                @statementKey,
	                v.[ObjectKey]
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS v
                WHERE
                (
	                (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
	                AND
			        (v.[ValueString] LIKE @literalValueString)
                )
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
	            INSERT INTO [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
	            (
		            [StatementKey],
		            [ResourceKey]
	            )
	            SELECT DISTINCT
		            @statementKey,
		            v.[ObjectKey]
	            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS v
	            WHERE
	            (
		            (v.[AttributeKey] = @attributeKey)
		            AND
				    (v.[ValueText] LIKE @literalValueString)
	            )
            END
        END
    END
  
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = 0, 
            @stage      = N'DoEvaluateRequest';
    END
END
GO

-- Only called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RecordRequestStatusChange]
    @requestKey    BIGINT,
    @statusKey     SMALLINT,
    @time          DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT  [rsc].[RequestKey]
        FROM    [fim].[RequestStatusChange] AS [rsc]
        WHERE
                [rsc].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
            AND [rsc].[Status] = @statusKey
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestStatusChange] WITH (ROWLOCK, XLOCK)
    VALUES
    (
        @requestKey, 
        @statusKey, 
        @time
    );
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RecoverStuckRequests]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RecoverStuckRequests]
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @batchSize SMALLINT = 200,
    @requestKeyStart BIGINT = 0,  -- Min Request Key to start looking for Stuck Requests.
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 0,  -- 0 none, 1 data only, 2 data + messages
    @numberOfRequestsNotFinal INT OUTPUT,
    @numberOfNonRecoverableRequests INT OUTPUT,
    @requestKeyEnd  BIGINT OUTPUT,
    @completed BIT OUTPUT
AS
-- Top Level
BEGIN

    IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON
    END

    SELECT  @completed = NULL,                      -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @numberOfNonRecoverableRequests = NULL, -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @numberOfRequestsNotFinal = NULL,       -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @requestKeyEnd = NULL;                  -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
         
    BEGIN TRY
    
        --DESIGN POINT:  This stored procedure handles its own transaction requirements
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        *  BACKGROUND: When a Service interruption occurs, Requests that were in process may be left in a non-final state.
        *    This procedure will find these Requests and put them in a SQL queue table to be processed by another thread which
        *    will either Cancel or Resume them depending on their current RequestStatus.
        *    The design of this Recovery feature is as follows:  
        *    Requests are marked with the last Service to operate on them to assist with this detection.          
        *    When a Service starts, it does a check on all existing Requests in the system to see if it was the last Service to operate on 
        *    it.  If it was, the Request may be stuck and is then flagged for follup operations to determine how to move it forward toward
        *    a final state.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         

        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        *  ORGANIZATION: This procedure has two parts.  INITIALIZATION code that runs once per Recovery Session, and BATCH code that is 
        *    meant to be called repeatedly with a size limitation to allow smaller sets of work to iterate over a large dataset.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         
         
        DECLARE @acquiredLock SMALLINT,
                @acquiredLockRequestKey INT,
                @action TINYINT,
                @defaultStatus NVARCHAR(448),
                @didMarkForCancel BIT,
                @createdBeforeTime DATETIME,
                @commitTime DATETIME,                
                @lockName NVARCHAR(40),
                @maxObjectKeyAtRestart BIGINT,
                @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),
                @nextRetryTime DATETIME,
                @numberOfStuckCollateralRequestsResetToAllowRetry INT,
                @numberOfStuckRequestsResetToAllowRequestCompleteRetry INT,
                @processSystemPartition BIT,
                @requestCancelReasonMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),                
                @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey  TINYINT,
                @requestKey BIGINT,
                @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,                
                @requestStatus NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning NVARCHAR(16),
                @serviceAccountObjectKey BIGINT,
                @systemServiceId SMALLINT,
                @tempTableForStuckRequests NVARCHAR(128),
                @workflowStatusKey TINYINT,
                @workflowStatusPendingKey TINYINT,
                @workflowTypeActionKey TINYINT,
                @workflowTypeAuthorizationKey TINYINT;
     
        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @acquiredLockRequestKey = -1,
                @completed = 0,
                @defaultStatus = N'Not Yet Processed',
                @commitTime = GETUTCDATE(),        
                @lockName = N'RecoverStuckRequestsForServiceId-' + CAST(@serviceId AS NVARCHAR(5)),
                @nextRetryTime = DATEADD(s, 30, @commitTime),
                @numberOfNonRecoverableRequests = 0,
                @numberOfRequestsNotFinal = 0,
                @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey = [fim].[GetRequestControlKey]([fim].[RequestControlSystemCancelOperation]()),
                @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning = [fim].[RequestStatusDetailLevelWarning](),
                @serviceAccountObjectKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey](),
                @tempTableForStuckRequests = N'RecoverStuckRequestsForServiceId-' + CAST(@serviceId AS NVARCHAR(5)),
                @workflowStatusPendingKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusPending]()),
                @workflowStatusPendingKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusPending]()),
                @workflowTypeActionKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey]([fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]()),
                @workflowTypeAuthorizationKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey]([fim].[WorkflowTypeAuthorization]());
          
        SELECT 
            @processSystemPartition = [ProcessSystemPartition],
            @maxObjectKeyAtRestart = [MaxObjectKeyAtRestart],
            @createdBeforeTime = [LastRestartTime]
        FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
        WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;

        -- If this Service can process the SystemPartition, set the @systemServiceId to its proper value (else it is NULL)
        IF(@processSystemPartition = 1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @systemServiceId = [fim].[GetSystemServiceId]();
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get Exclusive lock
        *   DESIGN POINT For each host, we want to ensure only one instance of this procedure can run at a time
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        --(set @LockTimeout = 0 means do not wait)
        --NOTE:  when @LockTimeout = 0, sp_getapplock returns a value of 1
        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockName,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session',
            @LockTimeout = 0;
            
        IF(@acquiredLock != 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
        DECLARE @failed TABLE
        (
            [RequestKey] BIGINT
        )
        
       /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        *  INITIALIZATION -- -1 indicates the Service is calling this for the first time this session.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         
        IF(@requestKeyStart = -1)
        BEGIN
    
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * B. Find all Requests that might be stuck due to an unexpected service interruption
            *    event. Stuck means they were last owned by this ServiceId prior to the Service starting
            *    and have a RequestStatus that is not in a final state and would not resume Request 
            *    processing operations automatically based on its current state.
            *    This section of code is designed to be run once per RequestRecovery Session 
            *    (which runs once per Service Start).  The caller will control this flag and set
            *    it to false on the first call, then true on any subsequent calls.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

            -- Diagnostics
            -- If this ServiceId can't process the SystemPartition then @systemServiceId will be NULL
	        SELECT 
	            @numberOfRequestsNotFinal = COUNT([r].[RequestKey])
            FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r] WITH (NOLOCK)  -- requests in the middle of a transaction lock rows in this table.  Dirty read is ok we don't change any data in this stored procedure.
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestMonitor] AS [rm]
                ON [rm].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
            WHERE
                    [r].[ServiceId] IN (@serviceId, @systemServiceId) --we only want to examine requests that this service is allowed to process.
                AND [r].[RequestKey] <=  @maxObjectKeyAtRestart  -- AND were created before this Service re-started
                AND [rm].[RequestKey] IS NULL  -- -- AND not already being monitored.
            
           
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * C. Check if any records exist in [fim].[PolicyApplication] that were dispatched by this host prior to the most recent 
            *    startup time.  If records are found, this means the service was shutdown before the dispatch operation completed so 
            *    we need to setup a re-try.
            *--------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
           
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [ServiceId]
                FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication]
                WHERE 
                        [DispatchTime] < @createdBeforeTime
                    AND [ServiceId] = @serviceId
            )
            BEGIN
                UPDATE [fim].[PolicyApplication]
                SET 
                    [ServiceId] = NULL,
                    [DispatchTime] = NULL
                WHERE 
                        [ServiceId] = @serviceId
                    AND [DispatchTime] < @createdBeforeTime;
                
                --Diagnostics
                SELECT @numberOfStuckCollateralRequestsResetToAllowRetry = @@ROWCOUNT;
                
            END
            
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * D. Check if any records exist in [fim].[WorkflowInstance] where [RequestUpdateFailed] = 1
            *    Clear this flag so that the system can do a re-try to finalize the associated
            *    Request in [UpdateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflows]
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [RequestUpdateFailed]
                FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                WHERE 
                        [RequestUpdateFailed] = 1
                    AND [ServiceId] = @serviceId
            )
            BEGIN
                UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance] WITH (TABLOCK,XLOCK)
                SET [RequestUpdateFailed] = 0
                WHERE 
                        [RequestUpdateFailed] = 1
                    AND [ServiceId] = @serviceId;
                
                --Diagnostics
                SELECT @numberOfStuckRequestsResetToAllowRequestCompleteRetry = @@ROWCOUNT;
            END
        END
        
       
        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        *  BATCH -- Designed to run multiple times
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * E.1 Find the potential Stuck Requests not already being monitored.
        *     If this ServiceId can't process the SystemPartition then @systemServiceId will be NULL
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        SELECT TOP(@batchSize)
             [r].[RequestKey],
             @defaultStatus AS [Status]
        INTO #RequestRecovery
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r] WITH (NOLOCK)  -- requests in the middle of a transaction lock rows in this table.  Dirty read is ok we don't change any data in this stored procedure.
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[RequestMonitor] AS [rm]
            ON [rm].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
        WHERE
                [r].[ServiceId] IN(@serviceId, @systemServiceId)      --we only want to examine requests that this service is allowed to process.
            AND [r].[RequestKey] >= @requestKeyStart  -- index on where to start from.
            AND [r].[RequestKey] <=  @maxObjectKeyAtRestart  -- AND were created before this Service re-started
            AND [rm].[RequestKey] IS NULL  -- -- AND not already being monitored.
	    ORDER BY 
	        [r].[RequestKey];  -- Want FIFO processing.
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * E.2 Process The main Request table by looking at each Request's status 
        *     to determine next steps.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM #RequestRecovery
        )
        BEGIN

            DECLARE RequestCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT
                [RequestKey]
            FROM #RequestRecovery
            ORDER BY [RequestKey]

            OPEN RequestCursor;
            WHILE(1 = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @requestKey = NULL;

                FETCH NEXT FROM RequestCursor INTO 
                    @requestKey

                IF(@requestKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    -- No More Records
                    BREAK;
                END
                
                BEGIN TRY

                    SELECT @requestStatus = NULL;
                    SELECT @action = NULL;
                    SELECT @workflowStatusKey = NULL;

                    -- get latest status
                    --NOTE:  NOLOCK is used because requests in process hold a lock on ObjectsInternal.
                    --At this point we just want to grab the request current status so we can put it in the RequestMonitor
                    --table.  We don't want this stored proc to get bogged down waiting for locks so NOLOCK is used.
                    SELECT @requestStatus = [ovs].[ValueString]
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs] WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE 
                            [ovs].[ObjectKey] = @requestKey
                        AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                        AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey;

                    --Can't process a request with a NULL status. This indicates that the Request Cache table entries do not match up to Request objects
                    --committed to ILM.  
                    IF(@requestStatus IS NULL)
                    BEGIN
                        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'RequestStatus does not exist for for Request ' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(19)) + ' even though it has a record in the [Request] table.');
                        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    END

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.2.1 Check if Request has reached a final state.
                    *       if already final then the request finished during the processing of this procedure
                    *       OR there is an issue with our cache tables not matching the actual object state.
                    *       In either case we will mark this row to be checked out
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF([fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeFinal](@requestStatus) = 1)
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                        (
                            [RequestKey],        
                            [RequestStatusKey],  
                            [ActionType],        
                            [DateAdded],         
                            [NextActionDate],    
                            [ActionsAttempted]  
                        )
                        SELECT 
                            @requestKey, 
                            [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@requestStatus),
                            [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionCleanupRequest]()),
                            @commitTime,
                            @commitTime,  -- this record will be processed right away.
                            0; 

                        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                        BEGIN
                            UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                            SET [Status] = N'Added to RequestMonitor for Cleanup.'
                            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                        END
                        
                        CONTINUE;  -- go to next Request
                    END

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.2.2 If Validating or Validated or Authenticating; a request is not yet authenticated there is no way to 
                    *       get credentials from the user so we issue a cancel.  It would be possible to allow pre-authenticated
                    *       requests to continue (such as Requests generated by FIMService or SyncService) since they currently bypass
                    *       AuthN and AuthZ workflows, but they get no special recovery treatment at this point.
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF
                    (
                            @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusValidating]()
                        OR  @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusValidated]()
                        OR  @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusAuthenticating]()
                    )
                    BEGIN
                            
                        BEGIN TRY
                            SELECT @didMarkForCancel = NULL;
                        
                            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                    
                            -- Transactional Lock to make sure no other processing is happening on this request.
                            -- We try to get synchronized lock immediately and if another thread is processing this request we just skip past it.
                            EXECUTE @acquiredLockRequestKey = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @requestKey, @lockTimeout = 0;
                                
                            IF(@acquiredLockRequestKey != 0)
                            BEGIN
                                INSERT @failed
                                SELECT @requestKey;
                                
                                IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                                BEGIN
                                    UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                                    SET [Status] =  'Did not obtain a lock on RequestKey ' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(19)) + ' unable to call [fim].[DoCancelRequest]'
                                    WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                                END         
                                
                                GOTO SkipCancel;
                            END
                               
                            SELECT @requestCancelReasonMessage = [fim].[FormatCancelRequestReasonServiceRestart](@requestKey);                          
                            
                            EXECUTE [fim].[DoCancelRequest]
                                @requestKey = @requestKey,
                                @requestControlKey = @requestControlSystemCancelOperationKey,
                                @causeKey = @serviceAccountObjectKey,
                                @reason = @requestCancelReasonMessage,
                                @reasonDetailLevel = @requestStatusDetailLevelWarning,
                                @recordRequestControl = 1, 
                                @didMarkForCancel = @didMarkForCancel OUTPUT;
                           
                            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                            BEGIN
                                UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                                SET [Status] =  N'[fim].[DoCancelRequest] called. @didMarkForCancel=' + CAST(@didMarkForCancel AS NVARCHAR(1))
                                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                            END                           
                    SkipCancel: 
                        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
                                                
                        END TRY
                        BEGIN CATCH
                            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
                            BEGIN
                                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                            END

                            INSERT @failed
                            SELECT @requestKey;
                            
                            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                            BEGIN
                                UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                                SET [Status] =  N'[fim].[DoCancelRequest] called. Error=' + ERROR_MESSAGE()
                                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                            END 
                        END CATCH
                             
                        SELECT @numberOfNonRecoverableRequests = @numberOfNonRecoverableRequests + 1;
                        
                        CONTINUE;  -- go to next Request
                    END

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.2.3 If Authenticated or Authorized or Committed, we have enough information to continue with the request
                    *       and need to re-dispatch it
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF
                    (
                            @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusAuthenticated]()
                        OR  @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusAuthorized]()
                        OR  @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusCommitted]()
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                        (
                            [RequestKey],        
                            [RequestStatusKey],  
                            [ActionType],        
                            [DateAdded],         
                            [NextActionDate],    
                            [ActionsAttempted]  
                        )                    
                        SELECT
                            @requestKey, 
                            [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@requestStatus),
                            [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeRequest]()), 
                            @commitTime,
                            @commitTime, -- this record will be processed right away.
                            0;

                        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                        BEGIN
                            UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                            SET [Status] = N'Added to RequestMonitor for Resume.'
                            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                        END
                        
                        CONTINUE;  -- go to next Request
                    END

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.2.4 If Authorizing we need to check on authZ workflows to determine what to do
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusAuthorizing]())
                    BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [WorkflowStatus]
                            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                            WHERE 
                                [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeAuthorizationKey
                            AND [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusPendingKey
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            --there are AuthZ workflows left to start so re-dispatch to move it through the pipe
                            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                            (
                                [RequestKey],        
                                [RequestStatusKey],  
                                [ActionType],        
                                [DateAdded],         
                                [NextActionDate],    
                                [ActionsAttempted]  
                            )
                            SELECT 
                                @requestKey, 
                                [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@requestStatus),
                                [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeRequest]()), 
                                @commitTime,
                                @commitTime,  
                                0; 
                                
                            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                            BEGIN
                                UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                                SET [Status] = N'Added to RequestMonitor for Resume from Authorizing to start additional authZ workflows.'
                                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                            END
                        END
                        ELSE IF NOT EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [WorkflowStatus]
                            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                            WHERE 
                                [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeAuthorizationKey
                            AND [Finished] = 0
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            --there are no Running AuthZ workflows so re-dispatch to move it through the pipe
                            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                            (
                                [RequestKey],        
                                [RequestStatusKey],  
                                [ActionType],        
                                [DateAdded],         
                                [NextActionDate],    
                                [ActionsAttempted]  
                            )
                            SELECT 
                                @requestKey, 
                                [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@requestStatus),
                                [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeRequest]()), 
                                @commitTime,
                                @commitTime,  
                                0; 
                                
                            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                            BEGIN
                                UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                                SET [Status] = N'Added to RequestMonitor for Resume from Authorizing.'
                                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                            END
                        END
                        ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            -- at least one AuthZ workflow is running (most likely a long running workflow is holding up this request)
                            -- which is a normal condition so we just leave this request alone.
                            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                            BEGIN
                                UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                                SET [Status] = N'Request is waiting for AuthZ worflows to complete. No action taken.'
                                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                            END
                        END

                        CONTINUE;  -- go to next Request
                    END

                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.2.5 If PostProcessing we need to check on action workflows and if this request
                    *       has other request dependencies to determine what to do
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessing]())
                    BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [WorkflowStatus]
                            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                            WHERE 
                                [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeActionKey
                            AND [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusPendingKey
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            --there are workflows left to start so re-dispatch to move it through the pipe
                            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                            (
                                [RequestKey],        
                                [RequestStatusKey],  
                                [ActionType],        
                                [DateAdded],         
                                [NextActionDate],    
                                [ActionsAttempted]  
                            )                        
                            SELECT 
                                @requestKey, 
                                [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@requestStatus),
                                [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeRequest]()), 
                                @commitTime,
                                @commitTime,  
                                0;    
                                
                            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                            BEGIN
                                UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                                SET [Status] = N'Added to RequestMonitor for Resume from PostProcessing to start additional action workflows.'
                                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                            END                            
                        END
                        --If running workflows then leave alone.
                        --If completed workflows, leave alone and allow PostProcessingManager to finalize this request
                        ELSE IF NOT EXISTS
                        (
                            SELECT [WorkflowStatus]
                            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                            WHERE 
                                [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeActionKey
                        )
                        AND NOT EXISTS  -- does not have collateralRequest dependencies   
                        (
                            SELECT [RequestKey]
                            FROM [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking]
                            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                        )
                        AND NOT EXISTS  -- is not a cancel request
                        (
                            SELECT [CauseKey]
                            FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking]
                            WHERE [CauseKey] = @requestKey
                        )
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                            (
                                [RequestKey],        
                                [RequestStatusKey],  
                                [ActionType],        
                                [DateAdded],         
                                [NextActionDate],    
                                [ActionsAttempted]  
                            )                        
                            SELECT 
                                @requestKey, 
                                [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@requestStatus),
                                [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeRequest]()), 
                                @commitTime,
                                @commitTime,  
                                0;  
                                  
                            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                            BEGIN
                                UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                                SET [Status] = N'Added to RequestMonitor for Resume from PostProcessing.'
                                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                            END                                
                        END
                        ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            -- all Action workflows are running (most likely a long running workflow is holding up this request)
                            -- or it has request dependencies which is a normal condition so we just leave this request alone.
                            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                            BEGIN
                                UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                                SET [Status] = N'Request is waiting for action workflows or dependent requests to complete. No action taken.'
                                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                            END                        
                        END
                        CONTINUE;
                    END 
                    
                    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    * E.2.6 If Canceling we mark for Finalize which means to wait for action workflows
                    *       to finish and then finalize the request.
                    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
                    IF(@requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceling]())
                    BEGIN
                       INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                       (
                            [RequestKey],        
                            [RequestStatusKey],  
                            [ActionType],        
                            [DateAdded],         
                            [NextActionDate],    
                            [ActionsAttempted]  
                        ) 
                        SELECT 
                            @requestKey, 
                            [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@requestStatus),
                            [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionCleanupRequest]()), 
                            @commitTime,
                            @commitTime,  
                            0;
                        
                        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                        BEGIN
                            UPDATE #RequestRecovery
                            SET [Status] = N'Added to RequestMonitor for Cleanup.'
                            WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;
                        END                        
                        
                        CONTINUE;
                    END
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                  -- Record the Failed RequestKey so we can send back to caller for error handling.
                  INSERT @failed
                  (
                    [RequestKey]
                  )
                  SELECT @requestKey;
                END CATCH
            END
            CLOSE RequestCursor;
            DEALLOCATE RequestCursor; 
            
            -- Return the largest Key found so caller can send this back in 
            -- as the next starting point.
            SELECT @requestKeyEnd = MAX([RequestKey])
            FROM #RequestRecovery;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- No more records found so we are done with the scan.
            SELECT @completed = 1;
            
            -- At this point we want to re-set the Request queue tables so all the older entries
            -- get a re-try right after the new entries are processed.  Hopefully the new entries
            -- will push Requests along in their processing so that the older entries can finish if they
            -- had dependencies on these newer entries.
            
            UPDATE [rm]
            SET [rm].[NextActionDate] = @nextRetryTime
            FROM [fim].[RequestMonitor] AS [rm]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            ON [rm].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
            WHERE
                    [r].[ServiceId] IN(@serviceId, @systemServiceId) --we only want to update requests that this service is allowed to process.
                AND [r].[RequestKey] <=  @maxObjectKeyAtRestart  -- AND were created before this Service re-started
                AND [NextActionDate] >= @commitTime

            UPDATE [crt]
            SET [crt].[NextCheckTime] = @nextRetryTime
            FROM [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking] AS [crt]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            ON [crt].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
            WHERE
                    [r].[ServiceId] IN(@serviceId, @systemServiceId) --we only want to update requests that this service is allowed to process.
                AND [r].[RequestKey] <=  @maxObjectKeyAtRestart  -- AND were created before this Service re-started
                AND [NextCheckTime] >= @commitTime
                
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * F. Finished
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT 
                [RequestKey],
                [Status]
            FROM #RequestRecovery;
            
            SELECT  @numberOfStuckCollateralRequestsResetToAllowRetry AS [N'Number of Create CollateralRequests reset to allow a retry'],
                    @numberOfStuckRequestsResetToAllowRequestCompleteRetry AS [N'Number of Requests reset to allow move to final result retry'];
        END
        
        IF(@acquiredLock = 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockName,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        
        -- If there were fails, send them back to the caller.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM @failed
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS [RequestIdentifier]
            FROM @failed as [f]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] as [ovi]
            ON [f].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey];
        END
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF(@acquiredLock = 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockName,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END

        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH 
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RecoverStuckWorkflows]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RecoverStuckWorkflows]
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @auditMessageRestartFromBeginning NVARCHAR(448),
    @auditMessageRestartFromLastPersistedState NVARCHAR(448),
    @workflowKeyStart BIGINT,
    @batchSize SMALLINT = 200,
    @determineNumberOfStuckWorkflows BIT = 0,
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 0,  -- 0 none, 1 data only, 2 data + messages
    @numberOfStuckWorkflows INT OUTPUT,
    @workflowKeyEnd  BIGINT OUTPUT,
    @completed BIT OUTPUT
AS
-- Top Level
BEGIN

    IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON
    END

    SELECT  @completed = NULL,              -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @numberOfStuckWorkflows = NULL, -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @workflowKeyEnd = NULL;         -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
         
    BEGIN TRY
    
        --DESIGN POINT:  This stored procedure handles its own transaction requirements
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
