        *  BACKGROUND:  the Workflow Runtime host maintains a persistence store in [dbo].[InstanceState] for each workflow instance.
        *  A workflow instance is added once it is created by the host and removed once it reaches a final state 
        *  (WorkflowStatus.Completed or WorkflowStatus.Terminated).  The relationship between the persistence store and our schema 
        *  is this:
        *  [dbo].[InstanceState].[uidInstanceID] = [fim].[WorkflowInstance].[Identifier]
        *  When the Service is stopped, it calls serviceHost.WorkflowRuntime.StopRuntime() on each host which will unload all of its
        *  in-memory workflows to [InstanceState].  If completed successfully, the rows in [InstanceState] would match with the 
        *  rows in [WorkflowInstance].  However, there are several conditions that are likely to happen (e.g. power-failure, 
        *  service crash due to a bug, forcing the service process to stop {kill process command}, etc.) in which the workflows would 
        *  not be left in a state that will automatically resume.  This procedure will look for these and "fix" them so they can
        *  be resumed.  There are 3 different cases to look for and fix.
        *
        *  Task 1) Workflow Instance is marked as Running in [WorkflowInstance] but does not have an entry in [InstanceState].  For these
        *     we will "rollback" their status to "Pending", and re-run them.
              Exclusion from this rule: There can be items which don't have an entry in [InstanceState], they are waiting for some child 
                requests to complete or for some work to be done. Such like instances have correspondent records in [WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
                table and will not be re-run.
        *  Task 2) Workflow Instance is marked as Running in [WorkflowInstance] and has a row in [InstanceState] with an [ownerId] column
        *     NOT NULL
        *  Task 3) Workflow Instance is marked as Created in [WorkflowInstance] and has a row in [InstanceState] with an [status] column
        *     = 4 (created).  The WorkflowHost will not automatically resume this workflow so we need to Start it.
        *
        *     This procedure will only operate on workflows that were last "owned" by the value in @serviceId because other servers in
        *     the system could be running concurrently and operating on workflows while this procedure is running.  We also only look
        *     at workflow objects that were created prior to this serviceID re-start because this @serviceId could be running new
        *     workflows while this procedure is running so must not interfere with them.
        *
        *     Finally,  for any workflow identified in 1) or 2) above, we will add a [WorkflowStatusDetail] attribute with an audit
        *     message that will indicate that it was re-run from the beginning (1), or from its last known persistence point (2).
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        DECLARE @acquiredLock SMALLINT,
                @maxObjectKeyAtRestart BIGINT,        
                @lockName NVARCHAR(40),        
                @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),
                @numberOfMissingWorkflows INT,
                @numberOfOwnerIdWorkflows INT,
                @numberOfCreatedWorkflows INT,
                @reasonMarkerNoPersistedState NVARCHAR(32),
                @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState NVARCHAR(32),
                @reasonMarkerCreatedPersistedState NVARCHAR(32),
                @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusCanceling NVARCHAR(448),
                @workflowControlMessageResume TINYINT,
                @workflowInstanceIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
                @workflowStatusCreatedKey TINYINT,                
                @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey  SMALLINT,
                @workflowStatusPendingKey TINYINT;

       
        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @auditMessageRestartFromBeginning = REPLACE(@auditMessageRestartFromBeginning, '{0}', GETUTCDATE()),
                @auditMessageRestartFromLastPersistedState = REPLACE(@auditMessageRestartFromLastPersistedState, '{0}', GETUTCDATE()),
                @completed = 0,
                @lockName = N'RecoverStuckWorkflowsForServiceId-' + CAST(@serviceId AS NVARCHAR(5)),
                @numberOfMissingWorkflows = 0,
                @numberOfOwnerIdWorkflows = 0,
                @numberOfCreatedWorkflows = 0,
                @reasonMarkerNoPersistedState = N'NoPersistedState',
                @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState = N'LockedPersistedState',
                @reasonMarkerCreatedPersistedState = N'CreatedPersistedState',
                @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                @requestStatusCanceling = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceling](),               
                @workflowControlMessageResume = [fim].[GetWorkflowControlMessageKey]([fim].[WorkflowControlMessageResume]()),
                @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowInstance'),
                @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowStatusDetail'),
                @workflowStatusCreatedKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusCreated]()),                
                @workflowStatusPendingKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusPending]());
              
        SELECT @maxObjectKeyAtRestart = [MaxObjectKeyAtRestart]
        FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
        WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get Exclusive lock
        *   DESIGN POINT For each host, we want to ensure only one instance of this procedure can run at a time
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        --(set @LockTimeout = 0 means do not wait)
        --NOTE:  when @LockTimeout = 0, sp_getapplock returns a value of 1
        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockName,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session',
            @LockTimeout = 0;
            
        IF(@acquiredLock != 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
        DECLARE @statistics TABLE
        (
            [WorkflowIdentifier] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            [WorkflowObjectKey] BIGINT,
            [Operation] NVARCHAR(MAX),
            [Failed] BIT
        )

       /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        *  INITIALIZATION -- -1 indicates the Service is calling this for the first time this session.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         
        --Statistics
        IF(@workflowKeyStart = -1)
        BEGIN
        
            -- No Persisted State and Request is not being canceled and not waiting for child request (or other work) to complete.
            SELECT @numberOfMissingWorkflows = COUNT([wi].[ObjectKey])
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            LEFT JOIN [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]
                ON [wi].[Identifier] = [is].[uidInstanceID]
            LEFT JOIN [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [q]
                ON [wi].[ObjectKey] = [q].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
                ON      [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [wi].[RequestKey]
                    AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                    AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey
            WHERE
                    [wi].[Finished] = 0
                AND NOT [wi].[WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusPendingKey
                AND [wi].[ServiceId] = @serviceId
                AND [wi].[ObjectKey] <= @maxObjectKeyAtRestart
                AND [is].[uidInstanceID] IS NULL
                AND [q].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] IS NULL
                AND NOT [ovs].[ValueString] = @requestStatusCanceling;
                
            -- Persisted with OwnerId NOT NULL
            SELECT @numberOfOwnerIdWorkflows = COUNT([wi].[ObjectKey])
            FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            ON
                [is].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier]
            WHERE
                    [is].[ownerID] IS NOT NULL
                AND [wi].[ServiceId] = @serviceId
                AND [wi].[ObjectKey] <= @maxObjectKeyAtRestart 
                
            -- Persisted in Created state
            SELECT @numberOfCreatedWorkflows = COUNT([uidInstanceID])
            FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] as [is]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            ON
                [is].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier]
            WHERE 
                    [is].[status] = @workflowStatusCreatedKey
                AND [wi].[ServiceId] = @serviceId
                AND [wi].[ObjectKey] <= @maxObjectKeyAtRestart
                AND [wi].[WorkflowControlMessage] IS NULL  -- not already flagged to be started, canceled etc.
                
            SELECT @numberOfStuckWorkflows = @numberOfMissingWorkflows + @numberOfOwnerIdWorkflows + @numberOfCreatedWorkflows;                
        END
       
        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        *  BATCH -- Designed to run multiple times
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         
        
        DECLARE @stuckWorkflowInstance TABLE
        (
            [WorkflowObjectKey] BIGINT,
            [WorkflowIdentifier] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
            [StuckReason] NVARCHAR(32)
        )
        
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B.1 Find all rows in [WorkflowInstance] that do NOT EXIST in [InstanceState] 
        *    and do not exist in [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
        *    that are older than @createdBeforeObjectKey which is the Max ojectkey created 
        *    in the system that is identified for this host when the Service is started.
        *    The workflows must not be in a Pending state and their Request must not
        *    be in a Canceling state and workflow should not be waiting for child request
        *    (or other work) to complete.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        INSERT @stuckWorkflowInstance
        (
            [WorkflowObjectKey],
            [WorkflowIdentifier],
            [StuckReason]
        )
        SELECT TOP(@batchSize)
            [wi].[ObjectKey],
            [wi].[Identifier],
            @reasonMarkerNoPersistedState            
        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi] WITH (NOLOCK)
        LEFT JOIN [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is] WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON [wi].[Identifier] = [is].[uidInstanceID]
        LEFT JOIN [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [q]
            ON [wi].[ObjectKey] = [q].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
            ON      [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [wi].[RequestKey]
                AND [ovs].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey
        WHERE
                [wi].[Finished] = 0
            AND NOT [wi].[WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusPendingKey
            AND [wi].[ServiceId] = @serviceId  -- last owned by this Service
            AND [wi].[ObjectKey] >= @workflowKeyStart  -- index on where to start from.
            AND [wi].[ObjectKey] <= @maxObjectKeyAtRestart
            AND [is].[uidInstanceID] IS NULL  -- NoPersistedState
            AND [q].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] IS NULL -- No workitems
            AND NOT [ovs].[ValueString] = @requestStatusCanceling  -- Request must not be in a canceling state.           
	    ORDER BY 
	        [wi].[ObjectKey] ASC;  -- Want FIFO processing.

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B.2 Find all rows in [InstanceState] that have an ownerId that is NOT NULL
        *    that were last owned by this serviceId and were created before or during the
        *    last time the service ran.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

        INSERT @stuckWorkflowInstance
        (
            [WorkflowObjectKey],
            [WorkflowIdentifier],
            [StuckReason]
        )
        SELECT TOP(@batchSize)
            [wi].[ObjectKey],
            [wi].[Identifier],
            @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState
        FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
        ON
            [is].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier]
        WHERE
                [is].[ownerID] IS NOT NULL
            AND [wi].[ServiceId] = @serviceId
            AND [wi].[ObjectKey] >= @workflowKeyStart
            AND [wi].[ObjectKey] <= @maxObjectKeyAtRestart 
	    ORDER BY 
	        [wi].[ObjectKey] ASC;  -- Want FIFO processing.

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B.3  Find all rows in [InstanceState] that have a [status] = 4  (Created).
        *    and mark [WorkflowInstance] to Resume the workflow.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
      
        INSERT @stuckWorkflowInstance
        (
            [WorkflowObjectKey],
            [WorkflowIdentifier],
            [StuckReason]
        )
        SELECT TOP(@batchSize)      
            [wi].[ObjectKey],
            [wi].[Identifier],
            @reasonMarkerCreatedPersistedState            
        FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] as [is]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
        ON
            [is].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier]
        WHERE 
                [is].[status] = @workflowStatusCreatedKey
            AND [wi].[ServiceId] = @serviceId
            AND [wi].[ObjectKey] >= @workflowKeyStart
            AND [wi].[ObjectKey] <= @maxObjectKeyAtRestart
            AND [wi].[WorkflowControlMessage] IS NULL  -- not already flagged to be started, canceled etc.
	    ORDER BY 
	        [wi].[ObjectKey] ASC;  -- Want FIFO processing.

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C.1 Process Workflows with @reasonMarkerNoPersistedState
        *    roll it back to Pending Status.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [WorkflowIdentifier]
            FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance
            WHERE [StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerNoPersistedState
        )
        BEGIN
            
            DECLARE @workflowInstanceKey BIGINT;
            
            DECLARE missingWorkflowInstanceCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT
                [WorkflowIdentifier],
                [WorkflowObjectKey]
            FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance
            WHERE [StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerNoPersistedState
            ORDER BY [WorkflowObjectKey] ASC;  -- Want FIFO processing.


            OPEN missingWorkflowInstanceCursor;
            WHILE(1 = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT  @workflowInstanceIdentifier = NULL,
                        @workflowInstanceKey = NULL;
                        
                FETCH NEXT FROM missingWorkflowInstanceCursor INTO 
                    @workflowInstanceIdentifier,
                    @workflowInstanceKey

                IF(@workflowInstanceIdentifier IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    -- No More Records
                    BREAK;
                END

                BEGIN TRY
                        EXECUTE [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatus] 
                            @identifier = @workflowInstanceIdentifier,
                            @workflowStatusKey = @workflowStatusPendingKey,
                            @workflowStatusDetail = @auditMessageRestartFromBeginning
                            
                        -- Retrying completed work items that were not erased from DB
                        UPDATE [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
                        SET [RetryCount] =
                                CASE
                                    WHEN ISNULL([RetryCount], 0) = 0 THEN 0
                                    ELSE [RetryCount] - 1
                                END,
                            [NextRetry] = NULL,
                            [Completed] = 0
                        WHERE   [WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceKey
                            AND [Completed] = 1;
                            
                        --Diagnostics
                        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                        BEGIN
                            INSERT @statistics
                            (
                                [WorkflowIdentifier],
                                [WorkflowObjectKey],
                                [Operation],
                                [Failed]
                            )
                            SELECT @workflowInstanceIdentifier, @workflowInstanceKey, N'The workflow was rolled back to Pending.', 0
                        END
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                    INSERT @statistics
                    (
                        [WorkflowIdentifier],
                        [WorkflowObjectKey],
                        [Operation],
                        [Failed]
                    )
                    SELECT @workflowInstanceIdentifier, @workflowInstanceKey, N'Failed to roll back the workflow to Pending.' + ERROR_MESSAGE(), 1
                END CATCH
            END
            CLOSE missingWorkflowInstanceCursor;
            DEALLOCATE missingWorkflowInstanceCursor; 
        END
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C.2 Process Workflows with @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState
        *    clear the locks so any WF host can resume the workflow from its last
        *    persisted state.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [WorkflowIdentifier]
            FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance
            WHERE [StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState
        )
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRY
                ;WITH [NextSequenceIDs] ([ObjectKey], [AttributeKey], [MaxSequenceId]) AS
                (
                    SELECT
                        [ovt].[ObjectKey], 
                        [ovt].[AttributeKey], 
                        MAX([ovt].[SequenceID]) 
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
                    INNER JOIN @stuckWorkflowInstance as [swi]
                        ON      [ovt].[ObjectKey] = [swi].[WorkflowObjectKey]
                            AND [swi].[StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState
                    WHERE [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey
                    GROUP BY [ovt].[ObjectKey], [ovt].[AttributeKey]
                )
                INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueText] 
                (   
                    [ObjectKey], 
                    [ObjectTypeKey], 
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [SequenceID],
                    [Multivalued],
                    [ValueText]
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [swi].[WorkflowObjectKey],
                    @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey,
                    @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [swi].[WorkflowObjectKey] 
                                       ORDER BY [swi].[WorkflowObjectKey]) 
                       + COALESCE([nsi].[MaxSequenceId], -1),
                    1,
                    @auditMessageRestartFromLastPersistedState
                FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance AS [swi]
                LEFT JOIN NextSequenceIDs as [nsi]
                    ON [swi].[WorkflowObjectKey] = [nsi].[ObjectKey]
                WHERE [swi].[StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState;
                    

                -- clear the ownerId column so any eligible host can resume it.
                UPDATE [dbo].[InstanceState]
                SET [ownerID] = NULL,
                    [ownedUntil] = NULL
                FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]
                INNER JOIN @stuckWorkflowInstance AS [swi]
                ON
                        [is].[uidInstanceID] = [swi].[WorkflowIdentifier]
                    AND [StuckReason] =  @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState;

                -- Retrying completed work items that were not erased from DB
                UPDATE [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
                SET [RetryCount] =
                        CASE
                            WHEN ISNULL([wisq].[RetryCount], 0) = 0 THEN 0
                            ELSE [wisq].[RetryCount] - 1
                        END,
                    [NextRetry] = NULL,
                    [Completed] = 0
                FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [wisq]
                INNER JOIN @stuckWorkflowInstance AS [swi]
                ON 
                        [wisq].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = [swi].[WorkflowObjectKey]
                    AND [StuckReason] =  @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState
                WHERE   [wisq].[Completed] = 1;

                IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                BEGIN
                   INSERT @statistics
                    (
                        [WorkflowIdentifier],
                        [WorkflowObjectKey],
                        [Operation],
                        [Failed]
                    )
                    SELECT 
                        [WorkflowIdentifier],
                        [WorkflowObjectKey],
                        N'Workflow ownerId set to NULL to allow resume from last persisted state.',
                        0
                FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance
                WHERE [StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState

                END
            END TRY
            BEGIN CATCH
               INSERT @statistics
                (
                    [WorkflowIdentifier],
                    [WorkflowObjectKey],
                    [Operation],
                    [Failed]
                )
                SELECT
                    [WorkflowIdentifier],
                    [WorkflowObjectKey],
                    N'Failed to clear locks. ' + ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                    1
                FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance
                WHERE [StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerLockedPersistedState
            END CATCH
         END
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C.3 Process Workflows with @reasonMarkerCreatedPersistedState
        *    Mark [WorkflowInstance] to Resume the workflow.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [WorkflowIdentifier]
            FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance
            WHERE [StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerCreatedPersistedState
        )
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRY
            
                --We have to send a message to notify them to start.
                UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                SET 
                    [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusCreatedKey,
                    [WorkflowControlMessage] = @workflowControlMessageResume
                FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] as [wi]
                INNER JOIN @stuckWorkflowInstance AS [cwi]
                ON
                        [wi].[ObjectKey] = [cwi].[WorkflowObjectKey]
                    AND [StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerCreatedPersistedState

                -- Retrying completed work items that were not erased from DB
                UPDATE [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
                SET [RetryCount] =
                        CASE
                            WHEN ISNULL([wisq].[RetryCount], 0) = 0 THEN 0
                            ELSE [wisq].[RetryCount] - 1
                        END,
                    [NextRetry] = NULL,
                    [Completed] = 0
                FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [wisq]
                INNER JOIN @stuckWorkflowInstance AS [swi]
                ON 
                        [wisq].[WorkflowInstanceObjectKey] = [swi].[WorkflowObjectKey]
                    AND [StuckReason] =  @reasonMarkerCreatedPersistedState
                WHERE   [wisq].[Completed] = 1;

                IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                BEGIN
                   INSERT @statistics
                    (
                        [WorkflowIdentifier],
                        [WorkflowObjectKey],
                        [Operation],
                        [Failed]
                    )
                    SELECT 
                        [WorkflowIdentifier],
                        [WorkflowObjectKey],
                        N'WorkflowControlMessage set to Resume so it can be started.',
                        0
                    FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance
                    WHERE [StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerCreatedPersistedState

                END
            END TRY
            BEGIN CATCH
                   INSERT @statistics
                    (
                        [WorkflowIdentifier],
                        [WorkflowObjectKey],
                        [Operation],
                        [Failed]
                    )
                    SELECT 
                        [WorkflowIdentifier],
                        [WorkflowObjectKey],
                        N'WorkflowControlMessage Failed set to Resume so it can be started.',
                        1
                    FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance
                    WHERE [StuckReason] = @reasonMarkerCreatedPersistedState
            END CATCH
        END
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * E. Finished
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

        ;WITH [WorkflowKeyEnd] ([WorkflowObjectKey], [StuckReason]) AS
        (
            SELECT 
                MIN([WorkflowObjectKey]), [StuckReason]
            FROM @stuckWorkflowInstance
            GROUP BY [StuckReason]
        )
        SELECT @workflowKeyEnd = MIN([wke].[WorkflowObjectKey])
        FROM [WorkflowKeyEnd] AS [wke];

        -- if there were no records in any of the tables then we are done.
        IF(@workflowKeyEnd IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @completed = 1;
        END
        
        --Diagnostics
        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT 
                [WorkflowIdentifier],
                [WorkflowObjectKey],
                [Operation],
                [Failed]
            FROM @statistics;
        END
        
        -- Send back individual Workflows that failed.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [Failed] 
            FROM @statistics
            WHERE [Failed] = 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT [WorkflowIdentifier]
            FROM @statistics
            WHERE [Failed] = 1;
        END
        
        IF(@acquiredLock = 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockName,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF(@acquiredLock = 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockName,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH 
 END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[ReEvaluateRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequest]
    @originalRequestKey   BIGINT, 
    @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT, 
    @operation            NVARCHAR (448), 
    @targetKey            BIGINT, 
    @trace                BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        -- request attributes
        @processingTime DATETIME,

        -- key/identifier for duplicate request
        @duplicateRequestIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @duplicateRequestKey BIGINT,

        -- target object keys
        @targetObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,

        -- constant status keys
        @statusKeyValidating SMALLINT,

        -- constant object type keys
        @setObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @groupObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,

        -- constant attribute keys
        @attributeKeyComputedMember SMALLINT, 
        
        -- locale
        @localeKey SMALLINT,

        -- tracing
        @startTime DATETIME,
        
        -- did we change the original request
        @evaluationChanged BIT,

        -- did we change the original request output
        @evaluationChangedRequestOutput BIT,

        -- did we change the original request set statements
        @evaluationChangedSetStatement BIT,

        -- did we change the workflows on the original request
        @evaluationChangedActionWorkflow BIT,

        -- true
        @trueFlag BIT,

        -- false
        @falseFlag BIT;

    SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,0), 
           @evaluationChangedRequestOutput  = CONVERT(BIT,0), 
           @evaluationChangedSetStatement  = CONVERT(BIT,0), 
           @evaluationChangedActionWorkflow  = CONVERT(BIT,0),
           @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
           @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END
   
    BEGIN TRY BEGIN

        IF
        (
            @originalRequestKey IS NULL
            OR
            NOT EXISTS               
            (
                SELECT [request].[RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].Request AS [request]
                WHERE 
                        [request].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey
                    AND [request].[ReEvaluated] IS NULL
            )
        )
        BEGIN
            RETURN;
        END

        SELECT @setObjectTypeKey = [fim].ObjectTypeKeyFromName(N'Set'),
               @groupObjectTypeKey = [fim].ObjectTypeKeyFromName(N'Group'),
               @attributeKeyComputedMember = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'ComputedMember');
      
        -- Get the attributes of the original request object. This value is used for GenerateRequestFilterOutput call.
        SELECT @targetObjectTypeKey = [request].[TargetObjectTypeKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [request]
        WHERE 
            [request].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey;
        
        -- Get localeKey from original request
        SELECT @localeKey=[r].[LocaleKey]
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE 
            [r].[RequestKey] = @duplicateRequestKey;
  
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A. Clone the original request. We will then evaluate this request which 
 *    will consider the current state of the system. The result of the 
 *    evaluation will represent the final state of the object. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 
        SELECT @duplicateRequestIdentifier = NEWID(),
               @processingTime = GETUTCDATE(),
               @statusKeyValidating = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusValidating]());
        
        -- Most request tables use the key instead of the guid to dispense a key.
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @duplicateRequestIdentifier,
            @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @duplicateRequestKey OUTPUT;
      
        -- Clone the original cached request object.
        INSERT INTO [fim].[Request] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ServiceId],
            [ServicePartitionId],
            [TargetKey],
            [TargetObjectTypeKey],
            [TargetObjectTypeName],
            [Creator],
            [Anonymous],
            [Operation],
            [Status],
            [Cause],
            [RequestMarker],
            [Time],
            [Locale],
            [LocaleKey],
            [CommittedTime],
            [ReEvaluated]
        )
        SELECT @duplicateRequestKey,
               [r].[ServiceId],
               [r].[ServicePartitionId],
               [r].[TargetKey],
               [r].[TargetObjectTypeKey],
               [r].[TargetObjectTypeName],
               [r].[Creator],
               [r].[Anonymous],
               [r].[Operation],
               @statusKeyValidating,
               [r].[Cause],
               [r].[RequestMarker],
               @processingTime,
               [r].[Locale],
               [r].[LocaleKey],
               NULL,
               NULL
        FROM [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        WHERE 
            [r].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey;
       
        INSERT INTO [fim].RequestParameter WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [RequestParameterIndex],
            [Mode],
            [AttributeName],
            [AttributeKey],
            [AttributeType],
            [AttributeValue],
            [SystemGenerated]
        )
        SELECT @duplicateRequestKey,
               [rp].[ObjectKey],
               [rp].[RequestParameterIndex],
               [rp].[Mode],
               [rp].[AttributeName],
               [rp].[AttributeKey],
               [rp].[AttributeType],
               [rp].[AttributeValue],
               [rp].[SystemGenerated]
        FROM [fim].[RequestParameter] AS [rp]
        WHERE 
            [rp].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey;
       
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B.    Clone request ancillary parameters.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
               
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [Name],
            [Value]
        )
        SELECT @duplicateRequestKey,
               [rap].[Name],
               [rap].[Value]
        FROM [fim].[RequestAncillaryParameter] AS [rap]
        WHERE 
            [rap].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C.    Re-generate request output.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
         
        EXECUTE [fim].[GenerateRequestOutput] 
            @requestKey = @duplicateRequestKey,
            @operation = @operation,
            @targetKey = @targetKey,
            @targetObjectTypeKey = @targetObjectTypeKey,
            @localeKey = @localeKey,
            @trace = @trace;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D. Evaluate the duplicate of the original request. AuthN and AuthZ are skipped.
 *    since this is the action phase right now and those items have already been
 *    addressed. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoEvaluateRequestInner]
            @requestKey = @duplicateRequestKey,
            @doNotEnforceRights = @trueFlag,
            @bypassAction = @falseFlag,
            @bypassAuthentication = @trueFlag,
            @bypassAuthorization = @trueFlag,
            @doNotEvaluateWorkflows = @falseFlag,
            @reEvaluateRequest = @trueFlag,
            @trace = @trace;

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E. Merge the RequestOutput tables.  
 *
 *    Delete any rows for the original request that do not appear in the duplicate request
 *
 *    Delete any rows for the original request that conflict with the duplicate request
 *
 *    Add any rows to the original request that appear in the duplicate request but
 *    do not appear in the original request
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputBinary]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedRequestOutput OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedRequestOutput;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputBoolean]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedRequestOutput OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedRequestOutput;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputDateTime]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedRequestOutput OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedRequestOutput;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputIdentifier]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedRequestOutput OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedRequestOutput;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputInteger]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedRequestOutput OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedRequestOutput;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputReference]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedRequestOutput OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedRequestOutput;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputString]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedRequestOutput OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedRequestOutput;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputText]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedRequestOutput OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedRequestOutput;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputXml]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedRequestOutput OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedRequestOutput;
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E1. Merge the RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject and
                 RequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth tables.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedSetStatement OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedSetStatement;
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementTruth]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedSetStatement OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedSetStatement;
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * E2. Merge the RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition table.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition]
            @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
            @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChangedActionWorkflow OUTPUT,
            @trace = @trace;
            
        SELECT @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged | @evaluationChangedActionWorkflow;
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F. Update the original request MPRs and re-evalution time
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF 
        (
                @evaluationChanged = 1
        )
        BEGIN
        
            UPDATE [fim].[Request]
            SET [ReEvaluated] = @processingTime
            WHERE [RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey;
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * F1. Update the applied policies of the original request if we detect that
 *     additional action workflows will be run
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
            IF @evaluationChangedActionWorkflow = 1
            BEGIN
                EXECUTE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestObjectValueReference]
                    @originalRequestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
                    @duplicateRequestKey = @duplicateRequestKey, 
                    @evaluationChanged = @evaluationChanged OUTPUT,
                    @trace = @trace;
            END       
        END
    END END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH 
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END 
    END CATCH

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * G. Delete the duplicate cached request. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    BEGIN TRY 
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoDeleteCachedRequest] 
                @requestKey = @duplicateRequestKey;
                
            -- At this point, because of calling DoEvaluateRequestInner, we now
            -- have some data in the ObjectValue tables for the duplicate requuest,
            -- such as the applicable MPRs.  We need to clean this up as well.
            EXECUTE [fim].[DeleteObject] @duplicateRequestKey;
        END    
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH 
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END 
    END CATCH
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @stage      = N'ReEvaluateRequest';
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObject]
    @originalRequestKey   BIGINT, 
    @duplicateRequestKey  BIGINT, 
    @evaluationChanged    BIT OUTPUT,
    @trace                BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE
    
       -- tracing
        @startTime DATETIME;

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A. Find the rows for the original request in RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject
 *    which need to be removed from the original request.
 *
 *    Note: We don't consider Iteration to be a fator in finding rows to remove.
 *          The level of set nesting does not affect our decision in whether the
 *          row should be removed.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectRemovalCandidate') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectRemovalCandidate;
    END
    
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [requestOriginal].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
        [requestOriginal].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
        [requestOriginal].[True] AS N'True',
        [requestOriginal].[Iteration] AS N'Iteration'
    INTO #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectRemovalCandidate
    FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [requestOriginal]
    WHERE 
        [requestOriginal].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey
    ORDER BY
        [ObjectKey],
        [StatementKey],
        [True];
        
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReEvaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectRemovalCandidate_ObjectKey_StatementKey_True]
    ON #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectRemovalCandidate
    ( 
        [ObjectKey],
        [StatementKey],
        [True]
    );  
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 
            [duplicate].[RequestKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]    = @duplicateRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = [rc].[ObjectKey]
            AND [duplicate].[StatementKey]  = [rc].[StatementKey]
            AND [duplicate].[True]          = [rc].[True]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [rc]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]    = @duplicateRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = [rc].[ObjectKey]
            AND [duplicate].[StatementKey]  = [rc].[StatementKey]
            AND [duplicate].[True]          = [rc].[True];
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B. Find the rows for the duplicated request in RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject
 *    which need to be added to the original request.
 *
 *    Note: We don't consider Iteration to be a fator in finding rows to add
 *          The level of set nesting does not affect our decision in whether the
 *          row should be added.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectAdditionCandidate') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectAdditionCandidate;
    END
    
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [requestDuplicate].[StatementKey] AS N'StatementKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[True] AS N'True',
        [requestDuplicate].[Iteration] AS N'Iteration'
    INTO #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectAdditionCandidate
    FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [requestDuplicate]
    WHERE 
        [requestDuplicate].[RequestKey] = @duplicateRequestKey
    ORDER BY
        [ObjectKey],
        [StatementKey],
        [True];    
        
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReEvaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectAdditionCandidate_ObjectKey_StatementKey_True]
    ON #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectAdditionCandidate
    ( 
        [ObjectKey],
        [StatementKey],
        [True]
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 
            [duplicate].[RequestKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]    = @originalRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = [ac].[ObjectKey]
            AND [duplicate].[StatementKey]  = [ac].[StatementKey]
            AND [duplicate].[True]          = [ac].[True]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [ac]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]    = @originalRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = [ac].[ObjectKey]
            AND [duplicate].[StatementKey]  = [ac].[StatementKey]
            AND [duplicate].[True]          = [ac].[True];
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C. Remove rows from the original request
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rc].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] WITH(ROWLOCK)
        FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] AS [requestOriginal]
        INNER JOIN #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
            ON  [requestOriginal].[StatementKey]    = [rc].[StatementKey]
            AND [requestOriginal].[ObjectKey]       = [rc].[ObjectKey]
            AND [requestOriginal].[True]            = [rc].[True]
        WHERE 
            [requestOriginal].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey;

        SET @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END        
              
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D. Add rows to the original request
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ac].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [StatementKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [True],
            [Iteration]
        )
        SELECT 
            @originalRequestKey,
            [ac].[StatementKey],
            [ac].[ObjectKey],
            [ac].[True],
            [ac].[Iteration]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObjectAdditionCandidate AS [ac]

        SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @stage      = N'ReEvaluateRequestMembershipConditionStatementObject';
    END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestObjectValueReference]
    @originalRequestKey   BIGINT, 
    @duplicateRequestKey  BIGINT, 
    @evaluationChanged    BIT OUTPUT,
    @trace                BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE
    
       -- tracing
        @startTime DATETIME;

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END       
    
    
    SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    
    DECLARE @managementPolicyAttributeKey BIGINT;
    SELECT @managementPolicyAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ManagementPolicy');
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A. Find the rows for the duplicated request in ObjectValueReference which need
 *    to be added to the original request, i.e. Action Owrkflow Policies
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#reevaluateRequestObjectValueReferenceAdditionCandidate') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #reevaluateRequestObjectValueReferenceAdditionCandidate;
    END
    
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [requestDuplicate].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[ValueReference] AS N'ValueReference',
        [requestDuplicate].[Multivalued] AS N'Multivalued'
    INTO #reevaluateRequestObjectValueReferenceAdditionCandidate
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [requestDuplicate]
    WHERE 
            [requestDuplicate].[ObjectKey]   = @duplicateRequestKey
        AND [requestDuplicate].[AttributeKey] = @managementPolicyAttributeKey
    ORDER BY 
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference];
        
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReEvaluateRequestRequestObjectValueReferenceAdditionCandidate_ObjectKey_ObjectTypeKey_AttributeKey_ValueReference]
    ON #reevaluateRequestObjectValueReferenceAdditionCandidate
    ( 
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference]
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 
            [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestObjectValueReferenceAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = @originalRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ac].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey]  = [ac].[AttributeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ValueReference]= [ac].[ValueReference]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [ac]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestObjectValueReferenceAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = @originalRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ac].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey]  = [ac].[AttributeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ValueReference]= [ac].[ValueReference];
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B. Add rows to the original request
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ac].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestObjectValueReferenceAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueReference] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [Multivalued]
        )
        SELECT 
            @originalRequestKey,
            [ac].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ac].[AttributeKey],
            [ac].[ValueReference],
            [ac].[Multivalued]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestObjectValueReferenceAdditionCandidate AS [ac]

        SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END

    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @stage      = N'ReEvaluateRequestObjectValueReference';
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestOutputReference]
    @originalRequestKey   BIGINT, 
    @duplicateRequestKey  BIGINT, 
    @evaluationChanged    BIT OUTPUT,
    @trace                BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE
    
       -- tracing
        @startTime DATETIME;

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A. Find the rows for the original request in RequestOutputReference which need
 *    to be removed from the original request.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceRemovalCandidate') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceRemovalCandidate;
    END
    
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [requestOriginal].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
        [requestOriginal].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
        [requestOriginal].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',
        [requestOriginal].[ValueReference] AS N'ValueReference',
        [requestOriginal].[Deleted] AS N'Deleted'
    INTO #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceRemovalCandidate
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [requestOriginal]
    WHERE 
        [requestOriginal].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey
    ORDER BY 
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference];
        
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReEvaluateRequestRequestOutputReferenceRemovalCandidate_ObjectKey_ObjectTypeKey_AttributeKey_ValueReference]
    ON #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceRemovalCandidate
    ( 
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference],
        [Deleted]
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT
            [duplicate].[RequestKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
            ON [duplicate].[RequestKey]     = @duplicateRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = [rc].[ObjectKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [rc].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey]  = [rc].[AttributeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ValueReference]= [rc].[ValueReference]
            AND [duplicate].[Deleted]       = [rc].[Deleted]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [rc]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
            ON [duplicate].[RequestKey]     = @duplicateRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = [rc].[ObjectKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [rc].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey]  = [rc].[AttributeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ValueReference]= [rc].[ValueReference]
            AND [duplicate].[Deleted]       = [rc].[Deleted];
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B. Find the rows for the duplicated request in RequestOutputReference which need
 *    to be added to the original request.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceAdditionCandidate') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceAdditionCandidate;
    END
    
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [requestDuplicate].[ObjectKey] AS N'ObjectKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[ObjectTypeKey] AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[AttributeKey] AS N'AttributeKey',

        [requestDuplicate].[Deleted] AS N'Deleted'
    INTO #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceAdditionCandidate
    FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [requestDuplicate]
    WHERE 
        [requestDuplicate].[RequestKey] = @duplicateRequestKey
    ORDER BY 
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference];
        
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReEvaluateRequestRequestOutputReferenceAdditionCandidate_ObjectKey_ObjectTypeKey_AttributeKey_ValueReference]
    ON #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceAdditionCandidate
    ( 
        [ObjectKey],
        [ObjectTypeKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference],
        [Deleted]
    );

    (
        SELECT
            [duplicate].[RequestKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]    = @originalRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = [ac].[ObjectKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ac].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey]  = [ac].[AttributeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ValueReference]= [ac].[ValueReference]
            AND [duplicate].[Deleted]       = [ac].[Deleted]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [ac]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]    = @originalRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectKey]     = [ac].[ObjectKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ac].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[AttributeKey]  = [ac].[AttributeKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ValueReference]= [ac].[ValueReference]
            AND [duplicate].[Deleted]       = [ac].[Deleted];
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C. Remove rows from the original request
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rc].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] WITH(ROWLOCK)
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [requestOriginal]
        INNER JOIN #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceRemovalCandidate AS [rc]

    END

    IF EXISTS

        SELECT [ac].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestOutputReferenceAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputReference] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueReference],
            [Deleted]
        )
        SELECT 
            @originalRequestKey,
            [ac].[ObjectKey],
            [ac].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ac].[AttributeKey],
            [ac].[ValueReference],
            [ac].[Deleted]

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,

            @stage      = N'ReEvaluateRequestOutputReference';

    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestOutputXml] WITH(ROWLOCK)
        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputXml] AS [requestOriginal]
        INNER JOIN #reevaluateRequestOutputXmlRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
            ON  [requestOriginal].[ObjectKey]       = [rc].[ObjectKey]
            AND [requestOriginal].[ObjectTypeKey]   = [rc].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [requestOriginal].[AttributeKey]    = [rc].[AttributeKey]
            AND [requestOriginal].[ValueXml]        = [rc].[ValueXml]
        WHERE 
            [requestOriginal].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey;

        SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END        
              
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D. Add rows to the original request
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ac].[ObjectKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestOutputXmlAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestOutputXml] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ObjectTypeKey],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ValueXml],
            [Deleted]
        )
        SELECT 
            @originalRequestKey,
            [ac].[ObjectKey],
            [ac].[ObjectTypeKey],
            [ac].[AttributeKey],
            [ac].[ValueXml],
            [ac].[Deleted]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestOutputXmlAdditionCandidate AS [ac]

        SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END

    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @stage      = N'ReEvaluateRequestOutputXml';
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ReEvaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition]
    @originalRequestKey   BIGINT, 
    @duplicateRequestKey  BIGINT, 
    @evaluationChanged    BIT OUTPUT,
    @trace                BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE
    
       -- tracing
        @startTime DATETIME;

    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END
    
    SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * A. Find the rows for the original request in RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition
 *    which need to be removed from the original request.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionRemovalCandidate') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionRemovalCandidate;
    END
    
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [requestOriginal].[PolicyRuleKey] AS N'PolicyRuleKey',
        [requestOriginal].[ResourceKey] AS N'ResourceKey',
        [requestOriginal].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
        [requestOriginal].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey] AS N'ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey',
        [requestOriginal].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] AS N'ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey'
    INTO #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionRemovalCandidate
    FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [requestOriginal]
    WHERE 
        [requestOriginal].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey
    ORDER BY
        [PolicyRuleKey],
        [ResourceKey],
        [SetKey],
        [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
        [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey];
    
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReEvaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionRemovalCandidate_PolicyKey_ResourceKey_SetKey]
    ON #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionRemovalCandidate
    ( 
        [PolicyRuleKey],
    [ResourceKey],
        [SetKey],
        [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
        [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT
            [duplicate].[RequestKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]                            = @duplicateRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[PolicyRuleKey]                         = [rc].[PolicyRuleKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ResourceKey]                           = [rc].[ResourceKey]
            AND [duplicate].[SetKey]                                = [rc].[SetKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]           = [rc].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]    = [rc].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [rc]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]                            = @duplicateRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[PolicyRuleKey]                         = [rc].[PolicyRuleKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ResourceKey]                           = [rc].[ResourceKey]
            AND [duplicate].[SetKey]                                = [rc].[SetKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]           = [rc].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]    = [rc].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey];
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * B. Find the rows for the duplicated request in RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition
 *    which need to be added to the original request.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionAdditionCandidate') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DROP TABLE #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionAdditionCandidate;
    END
    
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [requestDuplicate].[PolicyRuleKey] AS N'PolicyRuleKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[ResourceKey] AS N'ResourceKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[SetKey] AS N'SetKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey] AS N'ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey',
        [requestDuplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] AS N'ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey'
    INTO #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionAdditionCandidate
    FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [requestDuplicate]
    WHERE 
        [requestDuplicate].[RequestKey] = @duplicateRequestKey
    ORDER BY
        [PolicyRuleKey],
        [ResourceKey],
        [SetKey],
        [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
        [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey];
    
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReEvaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionAdditionCandidate_PolicyKey_ResourceKey_SetKey]
    ON #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionAdditionCandidate
    ( 
        [PolicyRuleKey],
        [ResourceKey],
        [SetKey],
        [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
        [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
    );  
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT
            [duplicate].[RequestKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]                            = @originalRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[PolicyRuleKey]                         = [ac].[PolicyRuleKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ResourceKey]                           = [ac].[ResourceKey]
            AND [duplicate].[SetKey]                                = [ac].[SetKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]           = [ac].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]    = [ac].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [ac]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [duplicate].[RequestKey]                            = @originalRequestKey
            AND [duplicate].[PolicyRuleKey]                         = [ac].[PolicyRuleKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ResourceKey]                           = [ac].[ResourceKey]
            AND [duplicate].[SetKey]                                = [ac].[SetKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]           = [ac].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]
            AND [duplicate].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]    = [ac].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey];
    END
    
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * C. Remove rows from the original request
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [rc].[ResourceKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] WITH(ROWLOCK)
        FROM [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] AS [requestOriginal]
        INNER JOIN #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionRemovalCandidate AS [rc]
            ON  [requestOriginal].[PolicyRuleKey]                       = [rc].[PolicyRuleKey]
            AND [requestOriginal].[ResourceKey]                         = [rc].[ResourceKey]
            AND [requestOriginal].[SetKey]                              = [rc].[SetKey]
            AND [requestOriginal].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]         = [rc].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey]
            AND [requestOriginal].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]  = [rc].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
        WHERE [requestOriginal].[RequestKey] = @originalRequestKey;

        SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END        
              
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * D. Add rows to the original request
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [ac].[ResourceKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionAdditionCandidate AS [ac]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition] WITH(ROWLOCK,XLOCK)
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [PolicyRuleKey],
            [ResourceKey],
            [SetKey],
            [ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
        )
        SELECT 
            @originalRequestKey,
            [ac].[PolicyRuleKey],
            [ac].[ResourceKey],
            [ac].[SetKey],
            [ac].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionKey],
            [ac].[ActionWorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
        FROM #reevaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinitionAdditionCandidate AS [ac]

        SELECT @evaluationChanged = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    END
    
    IF (@trace = 1)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @originalRequestKey, 
            @stage      = N'ReEvaluateRequestSetTransitionActionWorkflowDefinition';
    END

END

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RefreshMembershipConditionFunctionValues]
    @currentDateTime DATETIME,
    @setTimePartToCurrentTime BIT = 0
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- SQL2005 does not support DATE so use DATETIME and convert the existing DATETIME
    -- first to a FLOAT, remove the fraction then back to a DATETIME, effectively dropping the time
    -- which defaults to midnight
    DECLARE @currentDay DATETIME;
    SELECT @currentDay = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@currentDateTime AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME);
    
	-- Set the Time part to the current Time
	IF(@setTimePartToCurrentTime = 1)
	BEGIN
	    UPDATE [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] 
	    SET [Value] = [fim].[DateTimeReplaceTime]([Value], @currentDateTime);
	END

    -- Set the Date part if the [Seed] is not Today's date [keep the time part as is]
    IF EXISTS
	(
		SELECT [mcfv].[Seed]
		FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [mcfv]
		WHERE
		        [mcfv].[Seed] < @currentDay
	)
	BEGIN	
		UPDATE [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue]
		SET
			[Seed] = @currentDay,
			[Value] = DATEADD(DD,DATEDIFF(DD,[Seed],@currentDay),[Value])
		WHERE
		        [Seed] < @currentDay;
	END
END
