/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RegisterService]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RegisterService]
    @serviceName NVARCHAR(128),
    @servicePartitionName NVARCHAR(128),    
    @processSystemPartition BIT,
    @serviceId SMALLINT OUTPUT,
    @servicePartitionId SMALLINT OUTPUT
AS
    --Top level
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    SELECT  @serviceId = NULL,          -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
            @servicePartitionId = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A.   Define variables
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 
        DECLARE @commitTimeStamp DATETIME,
                @messageText NVARCHAR(2000);
                
        SELECT  @commitTimeStamp = GETUTCDATE();
       
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B.   If a new servicePartitionName, register it
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        
        SELECT @servicePartitionId =[sp].[ServicePartitionId]
        FROM [fim].[ServicePartition] AS [sp]
        WHERE [sp].[ServicePartitionName] = @servicePartitionName;

        IF(@servicePartitionId IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            --New ServicePartition registration
            INSERT [fim].[ServicePartition]
            (
                [ServicePartitionName]
            )
            SELECT 
                @servicePartitionName
 
            SELECT @servicePartitionId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

            IF(@servicePartitionId IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Failed to register servicePartitionName in [ServicePartition] table.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END
        END

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C.   If a new serviceName register it, else update the tracking table with the
        *      current time as the last restart time.  Return a unique key
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        
        --Get the newest objectKey created to use as a re-start benchmark.
        DECLARE @maxObjectKey BIGINT;
        SELECT @maxObjectKey = MAX([ObjectKey])
        FROM [fim].[Objects];
        
        SELECT @serviceId =[sh].[ServiceId]
        FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat] AS [sh]
        WHERE [sh].[ServiceName] = @serviceName;

        IF(@serviceId IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            --New registration for this Service
            INSERT [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
            (
                [ServiceName],
                [ServicePartitionId],
                [ProcessSystemPartition],
                [LastRestartTime],
                [MaxObjectKeyAtRestart],
                [LastPingTime],
                [PingIntervalSecs]
            )
            SELECT 
                @serviceName,
                @servicePartitionId,
                @processSystemPartition,
                @commitTimeStamp,
                @maxObjectKey,
                @commitTimeStamp,
                0

            SELECT @serviceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

            IF(@serviceId IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Failed to register hostName in [ServiceHeartbeat] table.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
             UPDATE [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
             SET 
                [ServicePartitionId] = @servicePartitionId,
                [ProcessSystemPartition] = @processSystemPartition,
                [LastRestartTime] = @commitTimeStamp,
                [MaxObjectKeyAtRestart] = @maxObjectKey
             WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;
        END
        
        
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D.   Cache all workflow definitions and clean up unused definitions as part of
        *      the service start-up process.  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        
        --This will remove all definitions from cache that are no longer in use which is required periodically to keep the system
       -- from generating WorkflowHosts in the Service that will never be used.
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoRefreshWorkflowDefinitionCache]
       
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH  
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ReleaseRequestWorkItems]
    @requestKey BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    --********************************************************
    --*                                                      *
    --*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
    --*                                                      *
    --********************************************************
    DECLARE 
        @requestKeyString NVARCHAR(50),
        @requestKeyPropertyName VARCHAR(64);

    SELECT
        @requestKeyString = CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(50)),
        @requestKeyPropertyName = 'RequestKey';
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT *
        FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueueProperties] AS [qp]
        WHERE   [qp].[Name] = @requestKeyPropertyName
            AND [qp].[Value] = @requestKeyString
    )
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
        SET [NextRetry] = NULL
        FROM [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue] AS [q]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueueProperties] AS [qp]
            ON [q].[WorkItemId] = [qp].[WorkItemId]
        WHERE   [qp].[Name] = @requestKeyPropertyName
            AND [qp].[Value] = @requestKeyString;
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RemoveReferencesToDeletedObjects]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RemoveReferencesToDeletedObjects]
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @compositeObjectTypeKey     SMALLINT,
        @creatorAttributeKey        SMALLINT,
        @elementAttributeKey        SMALLINT,
        @parentRequestAttributeKey  SMALLINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey       SMALLINT,
        @targetAttributeKey         SMALLINT;
        
    SELECT 
        @compositeObjectTypeKey     = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmCompositeType'),
        @requestObjectTypeKey       = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @creatorAttributeKey        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Creator'),
        @elementAttributeKey        = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmElement'),
        @targetAttributeKey         = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Target'),
        @parentRequestAttributeKey  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ParentRequest');

    -- Design Point: A few attributes are expected to maintain references
    -- to deleted objects. This hard-coded list of attributes is mastered
    -- in [fim].[GenerateRequestOutput].
    -- The two pieces of code must be kept in sync. 

    DELETE 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [v]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt] 
    ON [v].[ValueReference] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey] 
    WHERE 
        [ovdt].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
        AND 
        ( -- Request Objects need to maintain their references even after those objects have been deleted
                [v].[ObjectTypeKey] != @requestObjectTypeKey                    
            AND
            (
                    [v].[AttributeKey] != @creatorAttributeKey
                OR  [v].[AttributeKey] != @targetAttributeKey
                OR  [v].[AttributeKey] != @parentRequestAttributeKey
            )
        )
        AND
        (
                [v].[ObjectTypeKey] != @compositeObjectTypeKey
            AND [v].[AttributeKey] != @elementAttributeKey
        );
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RemoveReportingJob]
    @reportingJobIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER 	
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

    DECLARE @reportingJobObjectKey BIGINT;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        
            EXECUTE [fim].[ValidateReportingJobIdentifier]
                @reportingJobIdentifier = @reportingJobIdentifier,
                @reportingJobObjectKey = @reportingJobObjectKey OUTPUT;

           IF EXISTS
           (

               FROM [fim].[ReportingJobs] WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)
               WHERE [JobIdentifierKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey
           )           
           BEGIN
               EXECUTE [fim].[DoRemoveReportingJob] 
                   @reportingJobObjectKey = @reportingJobObjectKey;           
           END
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH       
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END 
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];                  
    END CATCH  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RenewReportingJobLock]
	@reportingJobIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER	
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

    DECLARE @currentTimeStamp           DATETIME,
            @reportingJobObjectKey      BIGINT;
        
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION

            EXECUTE [fim].[ValidateReportingJobIdentifier]
                @reportingJobIdentifier = @reportingJobIdentifier,
                @reportingJobObjectKey = @reportingJobObjectKey OUTPUT;

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM [fim].[ReportingJobs] WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE [JobIdentifierKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey
            )
            BEGIN
                UPDATE [fim].[ReportingJobs]
                SET	[LastHeartBeat] = GETUTCDATE()
                WHERE [JobIdentifierKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(448);                
                SET @messageText = N'Lock renewal failed because the reporting job has already been terminated';
                RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
            END            
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH       
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END 
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];                  
    END CATCH    
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[ReRaiseException]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ReRaiseException]

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

 DECLARE @errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX);
 SET @errorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();
 
 DECLARE @errorNumber INT;
 SET @errorNumber = ERROR_NUMBER() ;
 
 DECLARE @errorSeverity INT;
 SET @errorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY();
 
 DECLARE @errorState INT;
 SET @errorState = ERROR_STATE();
 IF (@errorState < 1)
 BEGIN
    SET @errorState = 1;
 END
 
 DECLARE @errorProcedure NVARCHAR(200);
 SET @errorProcedure = ISNULL(ERROR_PROCEDURE(), '?');
 
 DECLARE @errorLine INT;
 SET @errorLine = ERROR_LINE();
 
 Declare @language nvarchar(max);
 Set @language = @@LANGUAGE;

 SET LANGUAGE N'us_english';
 RAISERROR
 (
    N'Reraised Error %d, Level %d, State %d, Procedure %s, Line %d, Message: %s',
    @errorSeverity,
    1,
    @errorNumber,
    @errorSeverity,
    @errorState,
    @errorProcedure,
    @errorLine,
    @errorMessage
 )
 
 SET LANGUAGE @language;

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RetrieveANonblockingInstanceStateIdForServiceHost]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RetrieveANonblockingInstanceStateIdForServiceHost]
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey INT,
    @isHosted BIT,
    @workflowTypes NVARCHAR(128) = NULL,
    @ownerID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ownedUntil DATETIME,
    @workflowIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL OUTPUT
    
AS
    --Top Level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT  @workflowIdentifier = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    BEGIN TRY    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;        
        /************************************************************************************
        / DESIGN NOTE:   This procedure was hi-jacked from the Windows Workflow Foundation schema
        / and is normally found at[dbo].[RetrieveANonblockingInstanceStateId]
        / it is re-written to work with our workflow extensions to support multi-host 
        / environments and optimized from the original version.
        /
        /   It is by design that we are fetching records from the [dbo]. schema
        /   since this table is part of the Windows Workflow Foundation schema and their .NET
        /   libraries that connect to SQL require the [dbo] schema qualifier.
        ************************************************************************************/
        
        DECLARE @now DATETIME,
                @trueFlag BIT;
                
        SELECT  @now = GETUTCDATE(),
                @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Quick check to see if there are any rows that are not blocked
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [blocked]
            FROM [dbo].[InstanceState]
            WHERE [blocked] = 0
        )
        BEGIN
 
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * B. Look up the ServicePartition this Service belongs to and determine if it
            *    also processes the SystemPartition.  If so, get its Id.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            DECLARE @processSystemPartition BIT,
                    @servicePartitionId SMALLINT,
                    @systemServicePartitionId SMALLINT;

            SELECT 
                @processSystemPartition = [ProcessSystemPartition],
                @servicePartitionId = [ServicePartitionId],
                @systemServicePartitionId = 
                CASE
                    WHEN [ProcessSystemPartition] = 1 THEN [fim].[GetSystemServicePartitionId]()
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
            WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;

            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * C. Look for Workflows to process and return a RecordSet if found
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

            IF(@isHosted = @trueFlag)
            BEGIN

                --NOTE: it is by design that we are fetching records from the [dbo] schema
                --since this table is part of the Windows Workflow Foundation schema and C# libraries
                --that connect to SQL hard-code the dbo schema qualifier.
                --We want to process these as FIFO so order by [ObjectKey]  (Smallest = Oldest).
                SELECT TOP(1)
                    @workflowIdentifier = [is].[uidInstanceID]
                FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]  WITH (READPAST)   -- [dbo]. is by design (see DESIGN NOTE), (READPAST) since we want to fetch "any free record"
                INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
                    ON [is].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] as [r]
                    ON [wi].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]            
                WHERE 
                        [is].[blocked] = 0                          -- not blocked
                        --if @systemServicePartitionId IS NULL then it won't be processed by this Service
                    AND [r].[ServicePartitionId] IN (@servicePartitionId, @systemServicePartitionId)                         
                    AND [wi].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey  -- match on workflowVersion
                    AND [is].[status] = 0                           -- must be a running workflow
                    AND
                    (    
                            [is].[ownerID] IS NULL    -- not owned by anyone
                        OR  [is].[ownedUntil] < @now  -- or ownership lock has expired
                    )
                ORDER BY [wi].[ObjectKey] ASC;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
            
                -- WorkflowTypes can contain 1 or more values.
                -- We want to split them and add to a table so we can join it with the main query below

                ;WITH [WorkflowType] ([WorkflowTypeKey]) AS
                (
                    SELECT
                    [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey](CAST([ss].[String] AS NVARCHAR(448)))
                    FROM [fim].[SplitString](@workflowTypes, ',') as [ss]
                )
                SELECT TOP(1)
                    @workflowIdentifier = [is].[uidInstanceID]
                FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]      -- [dbo].  is by design (see DESIGN NOTE)
                INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
                    ON [is].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] as [r]
                    ON [wi].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
                INNER JOIN [WorkflowType] as [wt]
                    ON [wi].[WorkflowType] = [wt].[WorkflowTypeKey]       
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints] AS [ahwdwe]
                    ON [wi].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = [ahwdwe].WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey
                WHERE 
                        [is].[blocked] = 0                              -- not blocked
                        --if @systemServicePartitionId IS NULL then it won't be processed by this Service
                    AND [r].[ServicePartitionId] IN (@servicePartitionId, @systemServicePartitionId)                         
                    AND [ahwdwe].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] IS NULL -- exclude Hosted workflows
                    AND [is].[status] = 0                               -- must be a running workflow
                    AND
                    (    
                            [is].[ownerID] IS NULL    -- not owned by anyone
                        OR  [is].[ownedUntil] < @now  -- or ownership lock has expired
                    )
               ORDER BY [wi].[ObjectKey] ASC;
            END
            
            IF(@workflowIdentifier IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                UPDATE [dbo].[InstanceState]  
                SET [ownerID] = @ownerID,
                    [ownedUntil] = @ownedUntil
                WHERE [uidInstanceID] = @workflowIdentifier
            END
        END
            
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
		IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		END
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
        
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RetrieveExpiredTimerIdsForServiceHost]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RetrieveExpiredTimerIdsForServiceHost]
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey INT,
    @isHosted BIT,
    @workflowTypes NVARCHAR(128) = NULL,
    @maxWorkflowsToLoadOnTimerExpiration INT = 100   -- Enough work until the next polling interval.
AS
    --Top Level, Read Only
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    BEGIN TRY    

        /************************************************************************************
        / DESIGN NOTE:   This procedure was hi-jacked from Windows Workflow Foundation schema
        / and can be found at [dbo].[RetrieveExpiredTimerIds]
        / it is re-written to work with our workflow extensions to support multi-host 
        / environments and optimized from the original version.
        /
        /   It is by design that we are fetching records from the [dbo]. schema
        /   since this table is part of the Windows Workflow Foundation schema and their .NET
        /   libraries that connect to SQL require the [dbo] schema qualifier.
        ************************************************************************************/
        
        DECLARE @now DATETIME,
                @trueFlag BIT;
                
        SELECT  @now = GETUTCDATE(),
                @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Quick check to see if there are any rows with an Expired Timer
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            --NOTE: AuthN workflows are generally short-lived events so having 'persistence' across multiple 
			--services is generally not needed. The 'Service Partition and multiple service workflow support'
			--was really built for AuthZ workflows (which may live along time needing an Admin to approve the 
			--request – aka days of time) and recovery for Action Workflows.
            SELECT [nextTimer]
            FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
                ON [is].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier]
            WHERE [nextTimer] < @now
			  AND ([wi].WorkflowType <> [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey](N'Authentication')
				   OR [wi].[ServiceId] = @serviceId)        
        )
        BEGIN
        
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * B. Look up the ServicePartition this Service belongs to and determine if it
            *    also processes the SystemPartition.  If so, get its Id.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
            DECLARE @processSystemPartition BIT,
                    @servicePartitionId SMALLINT,
                    @systemServicePartitionId SMALLINT;

            SELECT 
                @processSystemPartition = [ProcessSystemPartition],
                @servicePartitionId = [ServicePartitionId],
                @systemServicePartitionId = 
                CASE
                    WHEN [ProcessSystemPartition] = 1 THEN [fim].[GetSystemServicePartitionId]()
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
            WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;
            
            /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
            * C. Look for Workflows to process and return a RecordSet if found
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

            IF(@isHosted = @trueFlag)
            BEGIN

                --NOTE: it is by design that we are fetching records from the [dbo] schema
                --since this table is part of the Windows Workflow Foundation schema and C# libraries
                --that connect to SQL hard-code the dbo schema qualifier.
                SELECT TOP (@maxWorkflowsToLoadOnTimerExpiration)
                    [is].[uidInstanceID]
                FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]  -- [dbo].  is by design (see DESIGN NOTE)
                INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
                    ON [is].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
                    ON [wi].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
                WHERE 
                        [is].[nextTimer] < @now                          -- expired timer
                        --if @systemServicePartitionId IS NULL then it won't be processed by this Service
                    AND [r].[ServicePartitionId] IN (@servicePartitionId, @systemServicePartitionId)   
                    AND [wi].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey  -- match on workflowVersion
                    AND [is].[status] = 0                                -- must be a running workflow
                    AND
                    (   -- not locked or owned by anyone 
                        (
                                [is].[unlocked]=1
                            AND [is].[ownerID] IS NULL
                        )
                        OR [is].[ownedUntil] < @now  -- or ownership lock has expired
                    )
                ORDER BY [is].[nextTimer]  ASC;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- WorkflowTypes can contain 1 or more values.
                -- We want to split them and add to a table so we can join it with the main query below
            
                ;WITH [WorkflowType] ([WorkflowTypeKey]) AS
                (
                    SELECT
                    [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey](CAST([ss].[String] AS NVARCHAR(448)))
                    FROM [fim].[SplitString](@workflowTypes, ',') as [ss]
                )
                SELECT TOP (@maxWorkflowsToLoadOnTimerExpiration)
                    [is].[uidInstanceID]
                FROM [dbo].[InstanceState] AS [is]      -- [dbo].  is by design (see DESIGN NOTE)
                INNER JOIN [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
                    ON [is].[uidInstanceID] = [wi].[Identifier]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
                    ON [wi].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
                INNER JOIN [WorkflowType] as [wt]
                    ON [wi].[WorkflowType] = [wt].[WorkflowTypeKey]       
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints] AS [ahwdwe]
                    ON [wi].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = [ahwdwe].WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey
                WHERE 
                        [is].[nextTimer] < @now                         -- expired timer
                        --if @systemServicePartitionId IS NULL then it won't be processed by this Service
                    AND [r].[ServicePartitionId] IN (@servicePartitionId, @systemServicePartitionId)   
                    AND [ahwdwe].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] IS NULL -- exclude Hosted workflows
                    AND [is].[status] = 0                               -- must be a running workflow
                    AND
                    (   -- not locked or owned by anyone 
                        (
                                [is].[unlocked]=1
                            AND [is].[ownerID] IS NULL
                        )
                        OR [is].[ownedUntil] < @now     -- or ownership lock has expired
                    )
                ORDER BY [is].[nextTimer]  ASC;
            
            END
        END

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
        
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RetrieveRegisteredAndLockedOutUsers]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RetrieveRegisteredAndLockedOutUsers]
	@workflowDefinitionId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @personTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @personTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Person');
    
    DECLARE @authnWfRegisteredAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @authnWfRegisteredAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthNWFRegistered');
    
    DECLARE @authnWfLockedOutAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @authnWfLockedOutAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'AuthNWFLockedOut');
    
    DECLARE @objectIdAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @objectIdAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
    
    DECLARE @workflowDefinitionObjectKey BIGINT;
    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
        @objectID = @workflowDefinitionId,
        @objectTypeKey = NULL,
        @objectKey = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey OUTPUT;
    
    SELECT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS [RegisteredUsers] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
    ON 
            [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE
            [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @personTypeKey
        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @authnWfRegisteredAttributeKey
        AND [ovr].[ValueReference] = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdAttributeKey
        
    SELECT [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] AS [LockedOutUsers] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ovr]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
    ON 
            [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE
            [ovr].[ObjectTypeKey] = @personTypeKey
        AND [ovr].[AttributeKey] = @authnWfLockedOutAttributeKey
        AND [ovr].[ValueReference] = @workflowDefinitionObjectKey
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @objectIdAttributeKey
        
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RetrieveWorkflowDataForHostActivator]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RetrieveWorkflowDataForHostActivator]
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @pingIntervalSecs SMALLINT = 5,        -- (Keep default aligned to this ServiceConfig value HostActivationDefaultIntervalInMilliseconds) time delay between calls to this procedure from the service 
    @activeHostedWorkflowDefinitionSequenceNumber INT,   -- service has cached workflowDefinitions up to this sequence number
    @workflowControlMessagesMaxPerMinute SMALLINT = 60,  -- max Workflow Control Messages to return to the service host to execute.
    @RequestRecoveryMaxPerMinute SMALLINT = 30,          -- max Requests to return to the service host to re-dispatch as part of request recovery post service startup.
    @RequestCleanupMaxPerMinute SMALLINT = 120,          -- max Requests to process that are in [fim].RequestMonitor waiting for an action to be taken.
    @doPolicyApplicationDispatch BIT OUTPUT
AS
-- Top level
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT  @doPolicyApplicationDispatch = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    BEGIN TRY    
        --DESIGN POINT:  This is a "utility" stored procedure which does a few different tasks.
        --The tasks are independent of the others and we want to accomplish as much work as possible
        --so Transactions happen within each task as required, so if one task fails, the others are not affected.

        DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000);

        DECLARE @failedTasks TABLE
        (
            [Task] NVARCHAR(256),
            [FailureInfo] NVARCHAR(MAX)
        )
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Update ServiceHeartbeat to show this service is alive and still pinging  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
         BEGIN TRY

            --we only need to check this once so do it inside the first task.
            EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

            DECLARE @commitTimeStamp DATETIME;
            SELECT @commitTimeStamp = GETUTCDATE();

            SELECT @doPolicyApplicationDispatch = 0;

            --Update ServiceHeartbeat to confirm the host is registered and
            --to show that the Service is still alive and record current pingInterval
            UPDATE [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
            SET 
                [LastPingTime] = @commitTimeStamp,
                [PingIntervalSecs] = @pingIntervalSecs
            WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;
            
            IF(@@ROWCOUNT != 1)
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'HostId was not found in [ServiceHeartbeat] table.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
            RETURN; -- This module must complete in order to move to the next task.
        END CATCH
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Return a recordset of all ActiveWorkflowDefinitions if the SequenceNumber
        * provided as input is less then the current sequence number of the table.
        * return all rows so that the service can add the new endpoints and also take
        * inventory of what it has opened and remove the ones that are no longer active. 
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        BEGIN TRY
        
            DECLARE @latestSequenceNumber INT;
            
            SELECT @latestSequenceNumber = ISNULL(MAX([SequenceNumber]), 0)
            FROM [fim].[ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints];

            IF(@latestSequenceNumber > ISNULL(@activeHostedWorkflowDefinitionSequenceNumber, 0))
            BEGIN
                SELECT
                    [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([wd].ObjectKey),
                    [wd].[VersionKey],
                    [wd].[Xoml],
                    [wd].[Rules],
                    [wd].[WorkflowType],
                    [wd].[Deleted],
                    ISNULL([ahwd].[SequenceNumber], 0) -- non-hosted workflows have a NULL sequence number.  Set to 0 which will be ignored by middle tier.
                FROM [fim].[WorkflowDefinition] AS [wd]
                LEFT JOIN [fim].[ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints] AS [ahwd]
                    ON [wd].[VersionKey] = [ahwd].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey]
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                --Send back a single NULL record so C# can skip parsing this recordset since nothing new to send.
                SELECT [VersionKey] 
                FROM [fim].[WorkflowDefinition]
                WHERE [VersionKey] = -1; --invalid since Identity column starts at 1
            END
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            INSERT @failedTasks
            (
                [Task],
                [FailureInfo]
            )
            SELECT 
                N'Return the latest Active Workflow Definitions failed.',
                ERROR_MESSAGE();
        END CATCH
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. For this host, Send back any workflow control messages in which the workflow is not yet finished
        *    that belong to this host.
        *    Limit the returned results per config settings to throttle the load in the middle tier.
        *    It will round down to whole number 
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        BEGIN TRY
        
            DECLARE @maxWorkflowMessagesToReturn INT;
            SELECT @maxWorkflowMessagesToReturn = (@workflowControlMessagesMaxPerMinute * @pingIntervalSecs)/60;

            SELECT TOP(@maxWorkflowMessagesToReturn) 
                [Identifier],
                [WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
                [WorkflowStatus],
                [WorkflowControlMessage]
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            WHERE
                    [ServiceId] = @serviceId
                AND [WorkflowControlMessage] IS NOT NULL
                AND [Finished] = 0;

        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            INSERT @failedTasks
            (
                [Task],
                [FailureInfo]
            )
            SELECT 
                N'Return new WorkflowControlMessages failed.',
                ERROR_MESSAGE();
         END CATCH
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * D. Send back flag to state whether or not there are pending CollateralRequests to process
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        BEGIN TRY

            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [TargetKey]
                FROM [fim].[PolicyApplication]
                WHERE [ServiceId] IS NULL
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @doPolicyApplicationDispatch = 1;
            END
          
        END TRY    
        BEGIN CATCH
        
            INSERT @failedTasks
            (
                [Task],
                [FailureInfo]
            )
            SELECT 
                N'The check for pending Collateral Workflows failed.',
                ERROR_MESSAGE();
         END CATCH
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * E. Process Monitored Requests
        *    For the Requests in [fim].[RequestMonitor] that have a NextActionTime in the past, do the action.
        *    Honor the limit to be "Cleaned" and "Re-Dispatched" per the following config settings.
        *    it will round down to whole number.
        *    The goal is to have a throttle in place so we don't slam the middle tier with large sets of data to process
        *    and so we can fan out the workload over time as needed.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        BEGIN TRY

            DECLARE @requestCleanupMaxRequests  INT;
            SELECT  @requestCleanupMaxRequests = (@RequestCleanupMaxPerMinute * CAST(@pingIntervalSecs AS INT))/60;

            DECLARE @requestRecoveryMaxRequests  INT;
            SELECT  @requestRecoveryMaxRequests = (@RequestRecoveryMaxPerMinute * CAST(@pingIntervalSecs AS INT))/60;

            EXECUTE [fim].[DoActionOnMonitoredRequest]
                @serviceId = @serviceId,
                @requestCleanupMaxRequests = @requestCleanupMaxRequests,
                @requestRecoveryMaxRequests = @requestRecoveryMaxRequests,
                @extendedOutput = 0;
        END TRY    
        BEGIN CATCH
            INSERT @failedTasks
            (
                [Task],
                [FailureInfo]
            )
            SELECT 
                N'A failure occurred while taking action on the Requests contained in the RequestMonitor table.',
                ERROR_MESSAGE();
        END CATCH
        
        -- If any tasks failed we want to throw the failures back to the caller so they are aware that all tasks
        -- did not complete successfully.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [Task]
            FROM @failedTasks
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @errorString NVARCHAR(MAX);
            SET @errorString =
            (
                 CAST((SELECT [Task], [FailureInfo] FROM @failedTasks FOR XML AUTO) AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            );
            
            RAISERROR(@errorString, 16, 1);
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH    
END
GO

--Read Only
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RetrieveWorkflowDefinition]
    @workflowDefinitionVersionKey INT,
    @workflowDefinitionIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT, 
    @xoml NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT,
    @rules NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT,
    @workflowType TINYINT OUTPUT,
    @deleted BIT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @workflowDefinitionTypeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @workflowDefinitionTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition');

    DECLARE @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT;
    SELECT @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');

    SELECT
        @workflowDefinitionIdentifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([wd].[ObjectKey]),
        @xoml = [wd].[Xoml],
        @rules = [wd].[Rules],
        @workflowType = [wd].[WorkflowType],
        @deleted = [wd].[Deleted]
    FROM [fim].[WorkflowDefinition] AS [wd]
    WHERE       [wd].[VersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKey;

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RetrieveWorkflowInstance]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RetrieveWorkflowInstance]
    @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
--Read only
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    BEGIN TRY

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Initialize variables
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

        DECLARE @objectIDAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @workflowInstanceObjectKey BIGINT;
        
        SELECT @objectIDAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID');
       
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
	        @objectID		= @identifier,
	        @objectKey		= @workflowInstanceObjectKey OUTPUT;
       
        SELECT
            @identifier                             AS [Identifier],
            [definition].[ValueIdentifier]          AS [WorkflowDefinition],
            [wi].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey],
            [wi].[WorkflowType],
            [request].[ValueIdentifier]             AS [RequestIdentifier],
            [requestor].[ValueIdentifier]           AS [RequestorIdentifier],
            [target].[ValueIdentifier]              AS [TargetIdentifier],
            [wi].[WorkflowStatus]
        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [definition]
            ON 
                    [wi].[WorkflowDefinitionKey] = [definition].[ObjectKey]
                AND [definition].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [request]
            ON 
                    [wi].[RequestKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
                AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [requestor]
            ON 
                    [wi].[RequestorKey] = [requestor].[ObjectKey]
                AND [requestor].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [target]
            ON 
                    [wi].[TargetKey] = [target].[ObjectKey]
                AND [target].[AttributeKey] = @objectIDAttributeKey
          
        WHERE [wi].[ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[RetryWorkItem]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[RetryWorkItem]
    @workItemId         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @retryCount         SMALLINT
AS
    --Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        DECLARE @nextRetry DATETIME;

        SELECT @nextRetry = [fim].[NextRetryDateForWorkItem](@retryCount);
        
        UPDATE [fim].[WorkItemSchedulerQueue]
        SET [RetryCount] = @retryCount,
            [NextRetry] = @nextRetry,
            [LockOwner] = NULL,
            [LockExpiration] = NULL
        WHERE [WorkItemId] = @workItemId
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[ScheduleRequestExpiration]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ScheduleRequestExpiration]
     @commitTime                           DATETIME,
     @nextActionDate                       DATETIME,
     @requestKey                           BIGINT          
AS	
BEGIN			
    DECLARE
        @requestStatusKey SMALLINT,
        @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @requestMonitorActionExpireRequestKey TINYINT,
        @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT;

    SELECT
        @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @requestMonitorActionExpireRequestKey  = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionExpireRequest]()),
        @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus');

    IF EXISTS
    (				
        SELECT [RequestKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestMonitor]
        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
    )
    BEGIN
        -- if an entry for this request already exists in the RequestMonitor
        -- update the next action date.
        UPDATE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
        SET 
            [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionExpireRequestKey,
            [NextActionDate] = @nextActionDate
        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
    END
    ELSE	
    BEGIN
        -- create a new entry in the requestMonitor table
        -- and set the nextActionDate.
        SELECT @requestStatusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([ValueString])
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
        WHERE 
                [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
            AND [AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey
            
        INSERT [fim].[RequestMonitor]
        (
            [RequestKey],        
            [RequestStatusKey],  
            [ActionType],        
            [DateAdded],         
            [NextActionDate],    
            [ActionsAttempted]  
        )      
        SELECT 
            @requestKey, 
            @requestStatusKey, 
            @requestMonitorActionExpireRequestKey,
            @commitTime,
            @nextActionDate,
            0;
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[SetRequestStatusDenied]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[SetRequestStatusDenied]
    @requestMarker UniqueIdentifier
AS
-- Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    * This procedure is designed to handle SQL timeouts in which the Service does not 
    * get a Request Identifier back from SQL so needs an alternate means to find and 
    * Deny the Request so its status is properly reflected in the system.  This procedure 
    * looks to see if a Request was created based on the marker and if so sets it to Denied.
    * If a Request with this marker does not exist, this is not an error.  It means that 
    * the SQL Timeout happened prior to the creation of the Request so there is no work to do. 
    *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    BEGIN TRY 
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
    
            DECLARE 
                @requestKey         BIGINT,
                @requestStatus      NVARCHAR(32),
                @serviceAccountKey  BIGINT;
            
            SELECT 
                @serviceAccountKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey](),               
                @requestStatus = [fim].[RequestStatusDenied]();
                    
            SELECT @requestKey = [r].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[Request] as [r]
            WHERE 
                [r].[RequestMarker] = @requestMarker              
                
            IF @requestKey IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
                    @requestKey =@requestKey,   
                    @status = @requestStatus,
                    @causeKey = @serviceAccountKey;
            END 
            
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
	
    END TRY		
    /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
     * 	Handle any errors that might have occured.  
     *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/				
    BEGIN CATCH   		
    		
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    		
    END CATCH
    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[SetSystemProperty]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[SetSystemProperty]
    @propertyName   NVARCHAR(448),
    @propertyValue  NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
-- Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [property].[SystemPropertyKey]
        FROM [fim].[SystemProperty] AS [property]
        WHERE   [property].[PropertyName] = @propertyName
    )
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [fim].[SystemProperty]
        SET
            [PropertyValue] = @propertyValue,
            [PropertyTime] = GETUTCDATE()
        WHERE [PropertyName] = @propertyName;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[SystemProperty]
        (
            [PropertyName],
            [PropertyValue],
            [PropertyTime]
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @propertyName,
            @propertyValue,
            GETUTCDATE()
        );
    END     
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[TerminateStuckRequests]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[TerminateStuckRequests]
    @requestMaximumCancelingDurationOverrideInSeconds   INT = NULL,
    @batchSize                                          INT = 10000,
    @extendedOutput                                     TINYINT = 0  -- 0 none, 1 data only, 2 data + messages
AS
-- Top Level
BEGIN

    IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON
    END
         
    BEGIN TRY
    
        --DESIGN POINT:  This stored procedure handles its own transaction requirements
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        *  BACKGROUND: This stored procedure will look for Requests that have a RequestStatus = Canceling
        *              for the time defined by the SystemConfiguration object RequestMaximumCancelingDuration
        *              and Terminate them.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/         

        DECLARE @acquiredLockBulkTerminateRequest               SMALLINT,
                @commitTime                                     DATETIME,
                @lockNameBulkTerminateRequest                   NVARCHAR(40),
                @messageText                                    NVARCHAR(2000),
                @requestMaximumCancelingDuration                BIGINT,
                @requestMaximumCancelingDurationAttributeKey    SMALLINT,
                @requestMaximumCancelingDurationDate            DATETIME,
                @requestMaximumCancelingDurationMessage         NVARCHAR(32),
                @requestStatusCancelingKey                      SMALLINT,                
                @requestStatusDetailLevelError                  NVARCHAR(16), 
                @trueFlag                                       BIT;               

        SELECT  @acquiredLockBulkTerminateRequest = -1,
                @commitTime = GETUTCDATE(),
                @lockNameBulkTerminateRequest = N'BulkTerminateRequest',
                @requestMaximumCancelingDurationAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmRequestMaximumCancelingDuration'),
                @requestStatusCancelingKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusCanceling]()),                
                @requestStatusDetailLevelError = [fim].[RequestStatusDetailLevelError](),
                @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get the value for how much time must pass before a Canceling Request can
        *    be terminated.  The primary location for this value is in a schema object
        *    SystemConfiguration.
        *
        *    For testing purposes, you can pass in an override as a parameter to this
        *    stored procedure.
        * 
        *    If the SystemConfiguration object does not exist and there is no
        *    override, a hard-coded value is used.  
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF(@requestMaximumCancelingDurationOverrideInSeconds IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT  @requestMaximumCancelingDurationDate = DATEADD(s, -1 * @requestMaximumCancelingDurationOverrideInSeconds,  @commitTime),   
                    @requestMaximumCancelingDurationMessage = CAST(@requestMaximumCancelingDurationOverrideInSeconds AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N' seconds';
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT  @requestMaximumCancelingDuration = [fim].[GetIntegerSystemConfigurationSetting](@requestMaximumCancelingDurationAttributeKey);
        
            SELECT  @requestMaximumCancelingDurationDate = DATEADD(d, -1 * @requestMaximumCancelingDuration,  @commitTime),
                    @requestMaximumCancelingDurationMessage = CAST(@requestMaximumCancelingDuration AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N' days';
        END
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Get Exclusive lock
        *   DESIGN POINT We want to ensure only one instance of this procedure can run at a time
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        EXECUTE @acquiredLockBulkTerminateRequest = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockNameBulkTerminateRequest,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session',
            @LockTimeout = 10000;  -- wait for up to 10 seconds to get the lock

        IF(@acquiredLockBulkTerminateRequest < 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockNameBulkTerminateRequest + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

       /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Setup Table that holds the Stuck Requests to be Terminated
        *    NOTE:  This temporary table is shared between two stored procedures
        *        The reason for this is to separate the Detection from the Terminate
        *        so that other stored procedures could be written in the future
        *        to provide different detection logic, and then share the bulk Terminate code.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#bulkTerminateRequest') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #bulkTerminateRequest;
        END

        -- Find Canceling Requests
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [rct].[RequestKey]			
            FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking] AS [rct]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            ON [rct].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
            WHERE   [rct].[AddTime] <= @requestMaximumCancelingDurationDate
                AND [r].[Status] = @requestStatusCancelingKey
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP(@batchSize)
                [rct].[RequestKey],			
                [Reason] = [fim].[FormatTerminateRequestReason](@requestMaximumCancelingDurationMessage, [r].[RequestKey]),
                @requestStatusDetailLevelError AS [ReasonDetailLevel],		
                NULL AS [DidTerminateRequest],
                CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(2000)) AS [Error]
            INTO #bulkTerminateRequest
            FROM [fim].[RequestCancelTracking] AS [rct]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
            ON [rct].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
            WHERE   [rct].[AddTime] <= @requestMaximumCancelingDurationDate
                AND [r].[Status] = @requestStatusCancelingKey;
                
            -- Do the Termination
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoBulkTerminateRequest];
            
            IF(@extendedOutput >= 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT
                    [RequestKey],                           
                    [Reason],
                    [DidTerminateRequest],
                    [Error]
                FROM #bulkTerminateRequest
            END
        END
        
        IF(@acquiredLockBulkTerminateRequest >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameBulkTerminateRequest,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF(@acquiredLockBulkTerminateRequest >= 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockNameBulkTerminateRequest,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
