CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[TraceDuration]
(
    @startTime  DATETIME,
    @requestKey BIGINT, 
    @stage      NVARCHAR(100)
)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

        DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000);
        SELECT @messageText = '<duration requestKey=' 
                            + CAST (@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(448))
                            + ' stage=' 
                            + @stage 
                            + ' milliseconds='
                            + CAST (DATEDIFF(ms, @startTime, GETUTCDATE()) AS NVARCHAR(448))
                            + '/>';
        
        RAISERROR(@messageText,1,1);
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[TriggerTemporalEvents]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[TriggerTemporalEvents]
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 0,  -- 0 None, 1 Diagnostic Recordsets, 2 messages
    @trace BIT = 0 
AS
-- Top Level
BEGIN
    IF(@extendedOutput < 2)
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
    END
    
    BEGIN TRY
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * Feature Overview:  This is called by SQL Agent once per day and is the mechanism
        * by which Sets based on time criteria get re-evaluated based on the current time.
        * The Temporal Attrbute is stamped on all Sets that have a time element so this is
        * how we figure out which sets to re-evaluate.
        * We need to do this in a way which also includes evaluation of any applicable
        * Management Policy Rule in the system so that action workflows fire as defined 
        * on objects that exist in the FinalResourceSet of the MPR and meet all other
        * required conditions of the MPR (Principal, Action, Attributes, ResourceCurrentSet)
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
        * A. Local variables to support diagnostics.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @timeBasedFunctionValue TABLE
        (
            [Function] NVARCHAR(448),
            [BeforeExecution] DATETIME,
            [AfterExecution] DATETIME
        );

        DECLARE @truthStatementTransition TABLE
        (
            [StatementKey] INT,
            [ObjectKey] BIGINT,
            [Join]  BIT,
            [Leave] BIT
        );
        
        
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
        * B. Get all sets that have a Temporal Attribute.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @temporalAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @temporalAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'Temporal');

        DECLARE @didFailureOccur BIT;
        SELECT @didFailureOccur = 0;
        
        DECLARE @temporalSets TABLE
        (
            [SetKey] BIGINT,                                -- Temporal Set key
            [MembershipConditionKey] INT,                   -- ALL MembershipCondition(s) for the Set (include time based and not time based)
            [SetMembershipConditionRowIdentifier] TINYINT,  -- supports while loop operations on a per SetKey/MembershipConditionKey basis for the portion of this procedure dealing with SetEvaluation/MPR
            [StatementKey] INT,                             -- Key to the Truth Statements
            [XPath] NVARCHAR(MAX),                          -- Required to handle the NOT part of Time based truths and how we store references in the Truth tables
            [OperatorInversion] BIT,                        -- Defines POSTIVE vs. NEGATIVE truth statement.
            [FunctionValueKey] INT                          -- used to denote time based truth statements so we only process rows where this is NOT NULL for Truth table updates
        );

        --Set definitions are broken into individual Truth Statements that contain
        --references to all objects in the system that match the statement.  As Requests 
        --are processed to change objects, the object references attached to each Truth Statement are updated.
        --With regard to time based truth statements (e.g. Object Attribute X > "Todays date") this procedure
        --is the one that is responsible to ensure that all of these Truth Statements contain references to the 
        --correct objects based on the current time.  Once the time based Truth Statements have references to the correct objects
        --evaluation of sets that use these objects can be computed.
        --The following query is gathering all MembershipConditions, and their Statements for Temporal sets.
        INSERT INTO @temporalSets
        (
            [SetKey],
            [MembershipConditionKey],
            [SetMembershipConditionRowIdentifier],
            [StatementKey],
            [XPath],
            [OperatorInversion],
            [FunctionValueKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
         [smc].[SetKey],
         [smc].[MembershipConditionKey],
         CAST((DENSE_RANK( ) OVER (PARTITION BY [smc].[SetKey] ORDER BY [smc].[MembershipConditionKey])) AS TINYINT),  -- Need an iterator later on to uniquely identify membershipConditions per set.
         [mcs].[StatementKey],
         [mcs].[XPath],
         [mcs].[OperatorInversion],
         [mcs].[FunctionValueKey]
        FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition] AS [smc]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ovb]
        ON
                [smc].[SetKey] = [ovb].[ObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcxmcs]
        ON		[smc].[MembershipConditionKey] = [mcxmcs].[MembershipConditionKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement] AS [mcs]
        ON      [mcxmcs].[StatementKey] = [mcs].[StatementKey]
        WHERE 
             
                --Set has Temporal Attribute
                [ovb].AttributeKey = @temporalAttributeKey
            AND [ovb].ValueBoolean = 1

        --Diagnostics
        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [SetKey] AS [Temporal SetKey],
                [MembershipConditionKey],
                [SetMembershipConditionRowIdentifier],
                [StatementKey],
                [XPath],
                [OperatorInversion],
                [FunctionValueKey]
            FROM @temporalSets
            ORDER BY [SetKey], [MembershipConditionKey], [SetMembershipConditionRowIdentifier];
        END
   
        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
        * C. Update the clock
        *    Each entry in the [FunctionValueKey] table maps to a value in the 
        *    [MembershipConditionFunctionValue] table.  Each function uses the current time
        *    to evaluate itself and the result is stored (cached) so it can be used when
        *    evaluating the truth statement.  The values are only updated once per day
        *    no matter how many times you run this procedure.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        
        --Diagnostics
        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            INSERT @timeBasedFunctionValue
            (
                [Function],
                [BeforeExecution],
                [AfterExecution]
            )
            SELECT 
                [Function],
                [Value],
                NULL
            FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue];
        END
        
        DECLARE @currentDateTime DATETIME;
        SELECT @currentDateTime = GETUTCDATE();
        
        --Update the function values table.  Force the cache to use the currentTime when generating the new values.
        EXECUTE [fim].[RefreshMembershipConditionFunctionValues] @currentDateTime = @currentDateTime, @setTimePartToCurrentTime = 1;

        --Diagnostics
        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE @timeBasedFunctionValue
            SET 
                [tbfv].[AfterExecution] = [mcfv].[Value]
            FROM @timeBasedFunctionValue AS [tbfv]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue] AS [mcfv]
            ON
                [tbfv].[Function] = [mcfv].[Function];
                
            SELECT 
                [Function],
                [BeforeExecution],
                [AfterExecution]
            FROM @timeBasedFunctionValue;
        END
 

        /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
        * D. For each XPath, re-calculate the truth table which takes into account the
        *    current date.  e.g.  Truth statment:  ExpirationTime > fn:current-dateTime()
        *    Let's say todays date is July 1, 2009 and there is an object with an ExpirationTime
        *    attribute set to July 1, 2009  6:00 PM.
        *    When we evaluate this truth statement, the object meets the criteria so it is
        *    then bound to it.  When we run this tomorrow, the Date will be July 2, 2009 and this object
        *    will no longer belong to this truth statement so will get removed as a reference.  
        *    It should be noted that moving objects in the Truth Table does not equal 
        *    objects transitioning into sets.  This requires the Set MemberShip to be 
        *    re-evaluated (which relies on the Truth tables as part of its logic)
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [XPath] 
            FROM @temporalSets
        )
        BEGIN
        
            DECLARE @xPath NVARCHAR(MAX);
            DECLARE @statementKey INT;
            DECLARE @attributeKey SMALLINT;
            DECLARE @operatorEqual BIT;
            DECLARE @operatorGreater BIT;
            DECLARE @operatorLike BIT;
            DECLARE @literalValueBoolean BIT;
            DECLARE @literalValueDateTime DATETIME;
            DECLARE @literalValueInteger BIGINT;
            DECLARE @literalValueReference BIGINT;
            DECLARE @literalValueString NVARCHAR(MAX);
            DECLARE @functionValueKey INT;
            
            -- if the [FunctionValueKey] is null, then this Statement is not time based so do not process it.
            DECLARE temporalSetsXpathCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT
            [XPath]
            FROM @temporalSets
            WHERE [FunctionValueKey] IS NOT NULL;

            OPEN temporalSetsXpathCursor;
            WHILE(1=1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @xPath = NULL;

                FETCH NEXT FROM temporalSetsXpathCursor INTO 
                @xPath

                IF(@xPath IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
               
                --DESIGN NOTE:  Truth tables have = and > statements which are Postive truths and have objects referenced that evaluate to true.  
                --Some statements have != and < and by design do not have objects referenced.  To get these objects the code 
                --does a NOT of the Postive truths.  Therefore we make sure we only update the 
                --Positive statements by selecting the Top (1) and order by [OperatorInversion] which gives us the Postive truth.
               
                SELECT TOP (1)
                    @statementKey = [StatementKey],
                    @attributeKey = [AttributeKey],
                    @operatorEqual = [OperatorEqual],
                    @operatorGreater = [OperatorGreater],
                    @operatorLike= [OperatorLike],
                    @literalValueBoolean = [LiteralValueBoolean],
                    @literalValueDateTime = [LiteralValueDateTime],
                    @literalValueInteger = [LiteralValueInteger] ,
                    @literalValueReference = [LiteralValueReference],
                    @literalValueString = [LiteralValueString],
                    @functionValueKey = [FunctionValueKey]
                FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement]
                    WHERE [XPath] = @xPath
                    ORDER BY [OperatorInversion]   

                --Diagnostics
                IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                BEGIN
                    INSERT @truthStatementTransition
                    (
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [Join],
                        [Leave]
                    )
                    SELECT
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ResourceKey],
                        0,
                        1 -- by default mark existing objects as if they left the truth table
                    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth]
                    WHERE [StatementKey] = @statementKey;
                END

                -- This is what re-calculates the TruthTable by 
                -- Add/Remove of objects that meet the statment XPath based on the clock change.
                EXECUTE [fim].[MaintainStatement]
                    @statementKey = @statementKey;

                --Diagnostics
                IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                BEGIN
                
                    -- add rows of members who were added
                    INSERT @truthStatementTransition
                    (
                        [StatementKey],
                        [ObjectKey],
                        [Join],
                        [Leave]
                    )
                    SELECT
                        [mcst].[StatementKey],
                        [mcst].[ResourceKey],
                        1,
                        0
                    FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] AS [mcst]
                    LEFT JOIN @truthStatementTransition AS [tst]
                    ON
                            [mcst].[StatementKey] = [tst].[StatementKey]
                        AND [mcst].[ResourceKey] = [tst].[ObjectKey]
                    WHERE
                            [mcst].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
                        AND [tst].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;

                    -- remove rows of members who did not change.
                    DELETE @truthStatementTransition
                    FROM @truthStatementTransition AS [tst]
                    INNER JOIN [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth] as [mcst]
                    ON
                            [tst].[StatementKey] = [mcst].[StatementKey]
                        AND [tst].[ObjectKey] = [mcst].[ResourceKey]
                    WHERE 
                            [mcst].[StatementKey] = @statementKey
                        AND [tst].[Leave] =1;
                END
                
            END
            CLOSE temporalSetsXpathCursor;
            DEALLOCATE temporalSetsXpathCursor;

            --Diagnostics
            IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
            BEGIN
                SELECT 
                    [StatementKey],
                    [ObjectKey],
                    [Join],
                    [Leave]
                FROM @truthStatementTransition;
            END

            /*----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
            * E. Now that we have all the Time Based Truth statements up to date,  we now
            *    want to re-calculate the Set Memberships for all Temporal Sets and to fire
            *    all Temporal MPRs that apply.
            *    A Temporal MPR meets the following criteria:
            *       It has Action = Modify
            *       It has ResourceTime as an Attribute
            *       It has a TemporalSet for its ResourceFinalSet 
            *    
            *    We will create a Request to modify the ResourceTime attribute which is the
            *    type of request required to fire Temporal MPRs.
            *    To get the Sets to "re-calculate" their membership, we can use an 
            *    AncillaryParameter called MembershipCondtion that will contain ALL MembershipConditions 
            *    for the Set (must include time based and non-time based)
            *    
            *    Rights and Workflows:
            *    We want to bypass all rights checks and authN/AuthZ workflows but do want
            *    to apply Action workflows.   It is expected that this request will force 
            *    Set Transitions and if MPRs fire will require Action Workflows on the
            *    transitioning objects.  If the Action Workflow is to be run on the Target Set, this
            *    will be created and stamped on the request.  We then must Dispatch this request
            *    to the Service to execute the workflow.   If the Action Workflows are to be run
            *    on other objects that were not the original target of the request, they will be
            *    executed via the Collateral Workflow process that is carried out by PostProcessManager
            *    in the Service.
            *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

            DECLARE @setKey BIGINT;
            DECLARE @membershipConditionKey INT;
            
            DECLARE @targetIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
            
            DECLARE @creator UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
            SELECT @creator = [fim].[GetServiceAccountIdentifier]();
            
            DECLARE @anonymous BIT;
            SELECT @anonymous = 0;
            
            DECLARE @operation NVARCHAR(448);
            SELECT @operation = N'Put';
       
            -- @dateString is used in @parameters
            -- the char 'Z' is not included by SQL so add it.
            DECLARE @dateString NVARCHAR(448);
            SELECT @dateString = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETUTCDATE(), 127) + N'Z';

            -- This gives us the proper Temporal MPR Signature.
            DECLARE @parametersTemplate              NVARCHAR(448);
	        SELECT @parametersTemplate = REPLACE(N'<RequestParameters><RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>true</Calculated><Target>{1}</Target><PropertyName>ResourceTime</PropertyName><Value xsi:type=''xsd:string''>{0}</Value><Mode>Modify</Mode></RequestParameter></RequestParameters>', N'{0}', @dateString);

            DECLARE @parameters              XML;

            -- This forces the evaluation code to re-calculate Set Membership
            DECLARE @ancillaryParametersTemplate	NVARCHAR(448);
            SELECT @ancillaryParametersTemplate = N'<RequestParameter xmlns:xsi=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'' xmlns:xsd=''http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'' xsi:type=''UpdateRequestParameter''><Calculated>true</Calculated><Target>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000</Target><PropertyName>MembershipCondition</PropertyName><Value xsi:type=''xsd:string''>{0}</Value><Operation>Put</Operation></RequestParameter>'
            
            DECLARE @ancillaryParametersBuilder NVARCHAR(MAX);
            
            DECLARE @ancillaryParameters XML;
            
            -- Since this request is not created by a user, we want the title to 
            -- be useful for understanding why this request exists
            DECLARE @displayNameTemplate NVARCHAR(448);
            SELECT @displayNameTemplate = N'Membership Update For Temporal {0} {1}'
            
            DECLARE @doSetTransitions BIT;
            SELECT @doSetTransitions = 1;
            
            DECLARE @cause UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
            SELECT @cause = [fim].[GetServiceAccountIdentifier]();
            
            DECLARE @causeKey BIGINT;
            SELECT @causeKey = [fim].[GetServiceAccountObjectKey]();
            
            DECLARE @requestMarker UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
            SELECT @requestMarker = NEWID();
            
            DECLARE @requestIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
            DECLARE @displayName NVARCHAR(448);
            DECLARE @targetObjectTypeName NVARCHAR(448);
            DECLARE @time DATETIME;

            DECLARE @requestKey             BIGINT;
            DECLARE @requestObjectTypeKey   SMALLINT;
            SELECT @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
            

            DECLARE @resourceKey BIGINT;
            DECLARE @requestDependencyKey TINYINT;
            DECLARE @committedRequestStatusKey SMALLINT;
            DECLARE @committedTime DATETIME;
            
            DECLARE @requestStatusKey SMALLINT;
            
            DECLARE @systemServiceId SMALLINT,
                    @systemServicePartitionId SMALLINT;
                    
            SELECT  @systemServiceId = [fim].[GetSystemServiceId](),
                    @systemServicePartitionId = [fim].[GetSystemServicePartitionId]();                   
            
            DECLARE @maxSetMembershipConditionRowIdentifier TINYINT;
            DECLARE @i TINYINT;
            
            -- Diagnostics
            DECLARE @failedTable TABLE
            (
                [SetKey] BIGINT,
                [ErrorMsg] NVARCHAR(2000)
            )

            -- DESIGN POINT:  The product rejects SetFilters that try to nest Temporal Sets because this implementation
            -- evaluates 1 Temporal Set at a time via a cursor and does not reason over the order of which Temporal Set should
            -- be evaluated first if there are multiple.  IMT21181 implements the SetFilter restriction.  The design and implementation
            -- of the [fim].[MaintainSets] feature does have set "ordering" logic and therefore could be used to enable nesting if this feature
            -- was re-designed to use its infrastructure as a way of executing the Temporal Set updates.
            
            DECLARE temporalSetsCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT
            [SetKey]
            FROM @temporalSets;

            OPEN temporalSetsCursor;
            WHILE(1=1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @setKey = NULL;

                FETCH NEXT FROM temporalSetsCursor INTO 
                @setKey

                IF(@setKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    BREAK;
                END
                
                --Diagnostics
                IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
                BEGIN
                    SELECT
                        @setKey AS [TemporalSet],
                        [ValueString] as [Display Name]
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
                    WHERE 
                            [ObjectKey] = @setKey
                        AND [AttributeKey] = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'DisplayName');
                
                END
                
                BEGIN TRY
                
                    --Replace with current Target
                    SELECT @targetIdentifier = [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey](@setKey);                                
                    SELECT @parameters = CAST(REPLACE(@parametersTemplate, N'{1}', CAST(@targetIdentifier AS NVARCHAR(36))) AS XML);

                    -- NOTE there could be multiple Membership Conditions and we must include
                    -- all of them as Ancillary Parameters so must do a loop to include all of them.
                    -- @temporalSets was populated so that each unique MembershipConditionKey in a Set has an incrementing
                    -- index starting from 1.  This is how we do incremental row fetching in a while loop to create the AncillaryParameters
                    
                    --Determine the Max index for the current Set.
                    SELECT @maxSetMembershipConditionRowIdentifier = MAX([SetMembershipConditionRowIdentifier])
                    FROM @temporalSets
                    WHERE [SetKey] = @setKey;
                    
                    -- the index starts at 1
                    SELECT @i = 1;
                    
                    -- add opening XML
                    SELECT @ancillaryParametersBuilder = N'<AncillaryParameters>';
                    
                    -- add Ancillary RequestParameters (1 per unique MembershipConditionKey)
                    WHILE @i <= @maxSetMembershipConditionRowIdentifier 
                    BEGIN
                        -- Each [MembershipConditionKey] can have multiple [Statements] which will produces multiple rows with the same identifier
                        -- so use TOP 1 (The [MembershipConditionKey] will be the same in any of the rows)
                        SELECT TOP (1) @membershipConditionKey = [MembershipConditionKey]
                        FROM @temporalSets
                        WHERE [SetKey] = @setKey
                        AND [SetMembershipConditionRowIdentifier] = @i;
                        
                        --Replace with the current MembershipConditionKey
                        SELECT @ancillaryParametersBuilder = @ancillaryParametersBuilder + REPLACE(@ancillaryParametersTemplate, N'{0}', @membershipConditionKey);
                        
                        SELECT @i = @i +1;
                    END               
                    
                    -- add closing XML;
                    SELECT @ancillaryParametersBuilder = @ancillaryParametersBuilder + N'</AncillaryParameters>';
                     
                    -- must be of type XML for stored procedure input param.                
                    SELECT @ancillaryParameters = CAST(@ancillaryParametersBuilder AS XML);
                    
                    -- Create the request                  
                    EXECUTE [fim].[DoRequestCreation]
                        @servicePartitionId = @systemServicePartitionId,
                        @serviceId = @systemServiceId,
                        @targetIdentifier =	@targetIdentifier OUTPUT,
                        @creator = @creator,
                        @anonymous = @anonymous,
                        @operation = @operation,
                        @parameters = @parameters,
                        @ancillaryParameters = @ancillaryParameters,
                        @displayNameTemplate = @displayNameTemplate,
                        @doSetTransitions = @doSetTransitions,
                        @cause = @cause,
                        @requestMarker = @requestMarker,
                        @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier OUTPUT,
                        @displayName = @displayName OUTPUT,
                        @targetObjectTypeName = @targetObjectTypeName OUTPUT,
                        @time = @time OUTPUT;

                    -- Calculate Set Transitions and MPRs + Action Workflows
                    EXECUTE [fim].[DoEvaluateRequest]
                        @requestIdentifier = @requestIdentifier, 
                        @doNotEnforceRights = 1, 
                        @bypassAction = 0, 
                        @bypassAuthentication = 1, 
                        @bypassAuthorization = 1, 
                        @trace = @trace;
                        
                    EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                        @objectID = @requestIdentifier,
                        @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey,
                        @objectKey = @requestKey OUTPUT;
                    
                    -- Processing each Request must be transactional to keep the data change and request
                    -- object in sync.  Each set is processed and Committed independent of the others.
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                
                    -- Commit the changes to the Set and commit the Collateral Action Workflows (if specified)	
                    EXECUTE [fim].[DoProcessRequest]
                        @requestKey = @requestKey,
                        @includeResourceInActionWorkflowCreation = 0,  --Do not create ActionWorkflows for Target [They are already created]
                        @trace = @trace,                
                        @resourceKey = @resourceKey OUTPUT,    
                        @requestDependencyKey = @requestDependencyKey OUTPUT,
                        @committedRequestStatusKey = @committedRequestStatusKey OUTPUT,
                        @committedTime = @committedTime OUTPUT 

                    
                    --At this point the Request can have these states:
                    --  1) ActionWorkflows were created against the Target of the Request
                    --  2) CollateralAction Workflows were created against other Objects that Transitioned in/out of the Target Set
                    --  3) Both 1) and 2)
                    --  4) Neither 1) nor 2)
                    
                    DECLARE @workflowTypeActionKey TINYINT;
                    SELECT @workflowTypeActionKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey]([fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]());
                    
                    IF EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT [ObjectKey]
                        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                        WHERE 
                                [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeActionKey
                    )
                    BEGIN
                        -- State 1 or State 3 = true; we need to have the Service resume this request from its current state (Committed) and run the action workflows
                        DECLARE @currentTime DATETIME;
                        SELECT @currentTime = GETUTCDATE();
                    
                        INSERT [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                        (
                            [RequestKey],
                            [RequestStatusKey],
                            [ActionType],
                            [DateAdded],
                            [NextActionDate],
                            [ActionsAttempted]
                        )
                        SELECT 
                            @requestKey,
                            @committedRequestStatusKey,
                            [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeRequest]()),
                            @currentTime,
                            @currentTime,  -- Resume as soon as possible
                            0
                    END
                    ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        IF(@requestDependencyKey IS NULL)
                        BEGIN
                            -- State 4 = true; There were no Action Workflows created for this request of any type.
                            -- no dependencies so complete the request now.
                            SELECT @requestStatusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]());
                        END
                        ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            -- State 2 = true; there were only collateral workflows created so we can't finalize the request just yet.
                            -- rely on PostProcessManager to complete the request when all dependencies are completed.
                            SELECT @requestStatusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey]([fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessing]());
                         END
                        
                        -- Only update the RequestStatus if we did not dispatch to the Service.
                        EXECUTE [fim].DoUpdateRequest 
                            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
                            @statusKey = @requestStatusKey,
                            @causeKey = @causeKey,
                            @trace = @trace;
                    END
                       
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                
                    --If a failure occurs for one set, record the failure information but allow the next set to be
                    --processed.
                    SELECT @didFailureOccur = 1;
                    INSERT @failedTable
                    (
                        [SetKey],
                        [ErrorMsg]
                    )
                    SELECT @setKey, ERROR_MESSAGE()
                    
                    IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
                    BEGIN
                        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                    END
                END CATCH
                    
            END
            CLOSE temporalSetsCursor;
            DEALLOCATE temporalSetsCursor;
        END
            
        --If we had any failures that we skipped over, print them out and throw an error
        IF(@didFailureOccur = 1)
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [SetKey],
                [ErrorMsg]
            FROM @failedTable;
            
            DECLARE @errorString NVARCHAR(MAX);
            SET @errorString =
            (
                CAST((SELECT [SetKey], [ErrorMsg] FROM @failedTable FOR XML AUTO) AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
            );
            
            RAISERROR(@errorString, 16, 1);
        END
    END TRY
        
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[TruncateAndReadAt]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[TruncateAndReadAt]
    @subscriberIdentifier SMALLINT,
    @batchSize INT,
    @rowLimit INT,
    @expectedWatermark BIGINT,
    @expectedWatermarkIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @nextWatermark BIGINT OUTPUT,
    @nextWatermarkIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE
        @watermark   BIGINT,
        @messageText NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @actualBatchSize INT,        
        @batchRequestCount BIGINT,
        @batchRowCount BIGINT,
        @cumulativeRequestRowCount BIGINT,
        @currentBatchRequestIdentifier INT;
    
    SELECT
        @cumulativeRequestRowCount = 0,
        @currentBatchRequestIdentifier = 0;

    DECLARE @requestBatch TABLE
    (
        [BatchRequestID] INT IDENTITY(0,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        [RequestKey] BIGINT,
        [ExportLogKey] BIGINT,
        [RowCount] BIGINT
    );
    
    DECLARE @nonSystemObjectTypes TABLE
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT
    );
    
    DECLARE @systemObjectTypes TABLE
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey] SMALLINT
    );
    
    INSERT INTO @systemObjectTypes
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey]
    )
    SELECT [oti].[Key]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
    WHERE [fim].[IsReportingSystemTypeKey]([oti].[Key]) = 1;
    
    INSERT INTO @nonSystemObjectTypes
    (
        [ObjectTypeKey]
    )
    SELECT [oti].[Key]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oti]
    WHERE [fim].[IsReportingSystemTypeKey]([oti].[Key]) <> 1;
    

    SELECT @watermark = [el].[ExportLogKey]
    FROM [fim].[ExportLog] AS [el]
    WHERE
            [el].[ExportLogKey] = @expectedWatermark
        AND [el].[ExportLogIdentifier] = @expectedWatermarkIdentifier;    
        
    IF @watermark IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[InvalidWatermarkIdentifierPairException]();
        RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [es].[Watermark]
        FROM [fim].[ExportSubscription] AS [es]
        WHERE 
                [es].[SubscriptionKey] = @subscriberIdentifier
            AND [es].[Watermark] > @watermark
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatWatermarkEarlierThanSubscriberWatermarkException]();
        RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [es].[Watermark]
        FROM [fim].[ExportSubscription] AS [es]
        WHERE 
                [es].[SubscriptionKey] = @subscriberIdentifier
            AND [es].[Watermark] < @watermark
    )
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [fim].[ExportSubscription]
        SET [Watermark] = @watermark
        WHERE [SubscriptionKey] = @subscriberIdentifier;
    END      

    INSERT INTO @requestBatch
    (
        [RequestKey],
        [ExportLogKey],
        [RowCount]
    )
    SELECT TOP (@batchSize)
        [el].[RequestKey],
        MAX([el].[ExportLogKey]),
        COUNT([el].[ExportLogKey])
    FROM [fim].[ExportLog] AS [el]
    WHERE [el].[ExportLogKey] > @watermark
    GROUP BY [el].[RequestKey]
    ORDER BY MAX([ExportLogKey]) ASC;

    SELECT @actualBatchSize = COUNT([rb].[BatchRequestID])
    FROM @requestBatch AS [rb];

    WHILE (1=1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @cumulativeRequestRowCount = @cumulativeRequestRowCount + [rb].[RowCount]
        FROM @requestBatch AS [rb]
        WHERE [rb].[BatchRequestID] = @currentBatchRequestIdentifier;
        
        IF (@cumulativeRequestRowCount > @rowLimit)
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS  
        (
            SELECT [rb].[BatchRequestID]
            FROM @requestBatch AS [rb]
            WHERE [rb].[BatchRequestID] = (@currentBatchRequestIdentifier + 1)
        )          
        BEGIN 
            SELECT @currentBatchRequestIdentifier = (@currentBatchRequestIdentifier + 1);
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            BREAK;
        END        
    END
    
    DELETE FROM @requestBatch WHERE [BatchRequestID] > @currentBatchRequestIdentifier;
    
    SELECT @nextWatermark = [rb].[ExportLogKey]
    FROM @requestBatch AS [rb]
    WHERE [rb].[BatchRequestID] = @currentBatchRequestIdentifier;
    
    SELECT @nextWatermarkIdentifier = [el].[ExportLogIdentifier] 
    FROM [fim].[ExportLog] AS [el]
    WHERE [el].[ExportLogKey] = @nextWatermark;
    
    SELECT
        [ovi].[ValueIdentifier]             AS [RequestIdentifier],
        [el].[ObjectKey]                    AS [ObjectKey],
        [el].[ObjectID]                     AS [ObjectID],
        [ai].[DataType]                     AS [DataType],
        [ai].[Name]                         AS [AttributeName],
        [oi].[Name]                         AS [ObjectTypeName],
        [ai].[Multivalued]                  AS [Multivalued],
        [el].[ValueBinary]                  AS [ValueBinary],
        [el].[ValueBoolean]                 AS [ValueBoolean],
        [el].[ValueDateTime]                AS [ValueDateTime],
        [el].[ValueInteger]                 AS [ValueInteger],
        [el].[ValueReference]               AS [ValueReference],
        [el].[ValueReferenceKey]            AS [ValueReferenceKey],
        [el].[ValueString]                  AS [ValueString],
        [el].[ValueText]                    AS [ValueText],
        [elsb].[SubscriptionBindingDetails] AS [SubscriptionBindingDetails],
        [el].[Added]                        AS [Added],
        [el].[EventTime]                    AS [EventTime]
    FROM @requestBatch AS [rb]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLog] AS [el]
        ON [rb].[RequestKey] = [el].[RequestKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [el].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [oi]
        ON [el].[ObjectTypeKey] = [oi].[Key]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
        ON [el].[RequestKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN @systemObjectTypes AS [s]
        ON [el].[ObjectTypeKey] = [s].[ObjectTypeKey]
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [o]
        ON [el].[ValueReferenceKey] = [o].[ObjectKey]    
    LEFT OUTER JOIN @nonSystemObjectTypes AS [ns]
        ON [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ns].[ObjectTypeKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogBinding] AS [elb]
        ON 
        (
                [el].[ObjectTypeKey] = [elb].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [el].[AttributeKey] = [elb].[AttributeKey]
        )
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLogSubscriptionBinding] AS [elsb]
        ON [elb].[ExportBindingKey] = [elsb].[ExportBindingKey]    
    WHERE 
            [elb].[SubscriptionKey] = @subscriberIdentifier            
        AND 
        (
               [el].[ValueReferenceKey] IS NULL --capture non-references
            OR [s].[ObjectTypeKey] IS NOT NULL  --include references from system objects to all objects
            OR [ns].[ObjectTypeKey] IS NOT NULL --include references from all objects to non-system objects
        )
    ORDER BY [el].[EventTime], [el].[ExportLogKey] ASC;      
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[TruncateExportLog]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[TruncateExportLog]
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE 
        @actualDaysElapsed                   INT,
        @completedTimeAttributeKey           SMALLINT,
        @lastCompletedTime                   DATETIME,
        @notificationDialogHandle            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @notificationMessage                 XML,
        @reportingLoggingEnabledAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @reportingJobObjectKey               SMALLINT,
        @reportingJobStatusAttributeKey      SMALLINT,
        @smallestWatermark                   BIGINT,
        @smallestExportLogKey                BIGINT,
        @trueFlag                            BIT,
        @warningThresholdInDays              INT;
    
    SELECT
        @completedTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmCompletedTime'),
        @reportingLoggingEnabledAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmReportingLoggingEnabled'),
        @reportingJobObjectKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmReportingJob'),        
        @reportingJobStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'msidmReportingJobStatus'),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT, 1),
        @warningThresholdInDays = 7;
        
    IF ([fim].[GetBooleanSystemConfigurationSetting](@reportingLoggingEnabledAttributeKey) = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @lastCompletedTime = [ovdt].[ValueDateTime]
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ovdt]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ovs]
            ON [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = [ovs].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE
                [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @completedTimeAttributeKey
            AND [ovs].[AttributeKey] = @reportingJobStatusAttributeKey
            AND [ovs].[ValueString] = N'Completed'
        ORDER BY [ovdt].[ValueDateTime] DESC;
        
        IF @lastCompletedTime IS NULL --reporting is enabled but ETL has not run ever
        BEGIN
            SELECT @actualDaysElapsed = 0;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @actualDaysElapsed = DATEDIFF(day, @lastCompletedTime, GETUTCDATE());
        END
        
        IF (@actualDaysElapsed >= @warningThresholdInDays)
        BEGIN
            BEGIN DIALOG CONVERSATION @notificationDialogHandle
            FROM SERVICE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/NotificationInitiator]
            TO SERVICE '//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/NotificationReceiver'
            ON CONTRACT [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Contract/Notification]
            WITH ENCRYPTION=OFF;
            
            ;WITH XMLNAMESPACES
            (
                DEFAULT 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/2006/11/ResourceManagement'
            )
            SELECT @notificationMessage =
            ( 
                SELECT 
                N''
                FOR XML PATH (N'StaleReportingState')
            );
            
            SEND ON CONVERSATION @notificationDialogHandle 
            MESSAGE TYPE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Message/Notification](@notificationMessage);
        END
        
        SELECT @smallestWatermark = MIN([es].[Watermark])
        FROM [fim].[ExportSubscription] AS [es];
        
        --there can be a request that straddles the watermark. For example:
        --    Export Log Key    Request Key
        --    ==============    ===========
        --    0                 0
        --    1                 2
        --    2                 1
        --WM=>3                 2
        --    4                 1
        --    5                 1
        --Since Request 1 is straddling the watermark, only the entry with Request Key 0 can be truncated.
        SELECT TOP 1 @smallestExportLogKey = [beforeWatermark].[ExportLogKey]
        FROM [fim].[ExportLog] AS [afterWatermark]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ExportLog] AS [beforeWatermark]
            ON [afterWatermark].[RequestKey] = [beforeWatermark].[RequestKey]
        WHERE
                [afterWatermark].[ExportLogKey] > @smallestWatermark
            AND [beforeWatermark].[ExportLogKey] <= @smallestWatermark
        ORDER BY [beforeWatermark].[ExportLogKey] ASC;

        --if there is no straddling request, then just take the watermark and truncate everything above it.
        IF @smallestExportLogKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT @smallestExportLogKey = @smallestWatermark;
        END
        
        DELETE FROM [fim].[ExportLog]
        WHERE [ExportLogKey] < @smallestExportLogKey;
    END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[TryAddReportingJob]
    @reportingJobIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,	     
    @wasJobSuccessfullyAdded BIT OUTPUT	
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

    -- initialize local and output variables
    DECLARE @falseFlag                  BIT,
            @reportingJobObjectKey      BIGINT,			            
            @trueFlag                   BIT;

    SELECT 
        @falseFlag                  = CONVERT(BIT,0),		
        @trueFlag                   = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @wasJobSuccessfullyAdded    = @falseFlag;
    
 
    -- try to check if there is a row in the table
    -- if not atomically insert one.
    BEGIN TRY		
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ValidateReportingJobIdentifier]
            @reportingJobIdentifier = @reportingJobIdentifier,
            @reportingJobObjectKey = @reportingJobObjectKey OUTPUT;
                    
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM [fim].[ReportingJobs] WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ReportingJobs]
            (
                [JobIdentifierKey],
                [ServiceIdentifier]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @reportingJobObjectKey, 
                NULL
            );
            
            SET @wasJobSuccessfullyAdded = @trueFlag;
        END
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    END TRY
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH       
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END 
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];                  
    END CATCH    		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[TryLockReportingJob]
    @reportingJobIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,	 
    @serviceIdentifier SMALLINT = NULL,
    @wasJobSuccessfullyLocked BIT OUTPUT	
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

    -- initialize local and output variables
    DECLARE @reportingJobObjectKey	BIGINT,
            @falseFlag		        BIT,
            @trueFlag		        BIT;

    SELECT 
        @falseFlag                  = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag                   = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @wasJobSuccessfullyLocked   = @falseFlag;
               
    -- try to check if there is a row in the table
    -- if not atomically insert one.
    BEGIN TRY		        
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
                
        EXECUTE [fim].[ValidateReportingJobIdentifier]
            @reportingJobIdentifier = @reportingJobIdentifier,
            @reportingJobObjectKey = @reportingJobObjectKey OUTPUT;

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM [fim].[ReportingJobs] WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE 
                  [JobIdentifierKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey
              AND [ServiceIdentifier] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [fim].[ReportingJobs]
            SET	[ServiceIdentifier] = @serviceIdentifier
            WHERE [JobIdentifierKey] = @reportingJobObjectKey;
                        
            SET @wasJobSuccessfullyLocked = @trueFlag;
        END       
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    END TRY
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH       
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END 
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];                  
    END CATCH    		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UnLockResource]
	@objectKey BIGINT

AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    --NOTE:  Do not call this for @LockOwner = N'Transaction' or it will fail.
    --Locks acquired within a Transaction are released when the Transaction commits.
    EXECUTE [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
        @Resource = @objectKey,
        @LockOwner = N'Session';
END

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateBindingDescriptionsInherited]
    @bindingsXml XML(CONTENT [fim].[BindingDescriptionSchemaCollection])
AS
--Called from other stored procedures
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE 
        @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey    SMALLINT,
        @bindingDescriptionTypeKey          SMALLINT,
        @stringRegexKey                     SMALLINT,
        @integerMinimumKey                  SMALLINT,
        @integerMaximumKey                  SMALLINT;

    SELECT
        @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey    = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'AttributeTypeDescription'), 
        @bindingDescriptionTypeKey          = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'BindingDescription'),
        @stringRegexKey                     = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'StringRegex'),
        @integerMinimumKey                  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'IntegerMinimum'),
        @integerMaximumKey                  = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'IntegerMaximum');

        DECLARE @bindings TABLE
        (
            [ObjectKey]         BIGINT
        );

        INSERT INTO @bindings
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT 
            Root.bindingDescription.value('@ObjectKey', 'BIGINT')
        FROM @bindingsXml.nodes('/BindingDescription') AS Root(bindingDescription);

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	A. Nullify values
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    UPDATE [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    SET
        [StringRegex] = NULL,
        [IntegerMinimum] = NULL,
        [IntegerMaximum] = NULL        
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN @bindings AS [b]
        ON [bi].[ObjectKey] = [b].[ObjectKey];

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	B. Stamp values from Attribute Type Description, if they exist
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    UPDATE [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    SET [StringRegex] = [ovt].[ValueText] 
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN @bindings AS [b]
        ON [bi].[ObjectKey] = [b].[ObjectKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [bi].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
        ON  [ai].[ObjectKey] = [ovt].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey 
        AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @stringRegexKey;

    UPDATE [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    SET [IntegerMinimum] = [ovi].[ValueInteger] 
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN @bindings AS [b]
        ON [bi].[ObjectKey] = [b].[ObjectKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [bi].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ovi] 
        ON  [ai].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey 
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @integerMinimumKey;

    UPDATE [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    SET [IntegerMaximum] = [ovi].[ValueInteger] 
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN @bindings AS [b]
        ON [bi].[ObjectKey] = [b].[ObjectKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [bi].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ovi] 
        ON  [ai].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @attributeTypeDescriptionTypeKey 
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @integerMaximumKey;

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	C. Stamp values from Binding Description, if they exist
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    UPDATE [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    SET [StringRegex] = [ovt].[ValueText] 
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN @bindings AS [b]
        ON [bi].[ObjectKey] = [b].[ObjectKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ovt]
        ON  [bi].[ObjectKey] = [ovt].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovt].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [ovt].[AttributeKey] = @stringRegexKey;

    UPDATE [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    SET [IntegerMinimum] = [ovi].[ValueInteger] 
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN @bindings AS [b]
        ON [bi].[ObjectKey] = [b].[ObjectKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ovi] 
        ON  [bi].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey 
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @integerMinimumKey;

    UPDATE [fim].[BindingInternal] 
    SET [IntegerMaximum] = [ovi].[ValueInteger] 
    FROM [fim].[BindingInternal] AS [bi]
    INNER JOIN @bindings AS [b]
        ON [bi].[ObjectKey] = [b].[ObjectKey]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ovi] 
        ON  [bi].[ObjectKey] = [ovi].[ObjectKey]
        AND [ovi].[ObjectTypeKey] = @bindingDescriptionTypeKey 
        AND [ovi].[AttributeKey] = @integerMaximumKey;    

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[UpdateRequest]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- Top level
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateRequest]
    @requestIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
    @targetIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER=NULL, 
    @displayName NVARCHAR (448)=NULL, 
    @description NVARCHAR (MAX)=NULL, 
    @computedActors XML=NULL, 
    @managementPolicies XML=NULL, 
    @requestParameters XML=NULL, 
    @status NVARCHAR (448)=NULL, 
    @statusDetails XML=NULL, 
    @cause                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @trace                  BIT                 = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

        DECLARE @requestKey                 BIGINT; 
        DECLARE @targetKey                  BIGINT;
        DECLARE @causeKey                   BIGINT;

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @requestIdentifier,
            @objectKey = @requestKey OUTPUT;

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @targetIdentifier,
            @objectKey = @targetKey OUTPUT;

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
            @objectID = @cause,
            @objectKey = @causeKey OUTPUT;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        
            EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
                @requestKey          = @requestKey,
                @targetKey           = @targetKey,
                @displayName         = @displayName,
                @description         = @description,
                @computedActors      = @computedActors,
                @managementPolicies  = @managementPolicies,
                @requestParameters   = @requestParameters,
                @status              = @status,
                @statusDetails       = @statusDetails,
                @causeKey            = @causeKey,
                @trace               = @trace;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        RETURN;
    END CATCH  
END
