/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[UpdateRequestOwner]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateRequestOwner]
    @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @serviceId SMALLINT
AS
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
       
            DECLARE @acquiredLock INT,
                    @messageText NVARCHAR(MAX),
                    @requestKey BIGINT,
                    @requestMonitorActionResumeRequestKey TINYINT,                    
                    @requestObjectTypeKey SMALLINT;
                    
            SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                    @requestMonitorActionResumeRequestKey = [fim].[GetRequestMonitorActionKey]([fim].[RequestMonitorActionResumeRequest]()),
                    @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request');
                    
            EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier]
                @objectID = @identifier, 
                @objectTypeKey = @requestObjectTypeKey, 
                @objectKey = @requestKey OUTPUT
          
            EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @requestKey;

            IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + CAST(@requestKey AS NVARCHAR(19)) + ' because it is locked by another process.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END
          
           --Update our record if a different FIM Service is now dispatching this Request.
            IF NOT EXISTS 
            (
                SELECT [ServiceId]
                FROM [fim].[Request]
                WHERE 
                        [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [ServiceId] = @serviceId
            )
            BEGIN
                UPDATE [fim].[Request]
                SET [ServiceId] = @serviceId
                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;            
            END
            
            -- The Service is re-dispatching this request so no longer need to monitor it.
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [RequestKey]
                FROM [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                WHERE   
                        [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                    AND [ActionType] = @requestMonitorActionResumeRequestKey
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [fim].[RequestMonitor]
                WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey
            END
            
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
		IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		END
		EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[UpdateRequestStatus]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- Only called from other stored procedures
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateRequestStatus]
    @requestKey    BIGINT,
    @status        NVARCHAR(448),
    @time          DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

    DECLARE @statusKey SMALLINT;
    SET @statusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@status);

    IF (@status = [fim].[RequestStatusValidating]()) -- original creation case is not supported
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(2000);
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'status');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        RETURN;
    END

    IF (@status IS NOT NULL) 
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [fim].[Request]
        SET [Status] = @statusKey
        WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

        EXECUTE [fim].[RecordRequestStatusChange]
            @requestKey = @requestKey,
            @statusKey  = @statusKey,
            @time       = @time;

        DECLARE @objectTypeKey SMALLINT;
        DECLARE @requestStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT;

        SET @objectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'); 
        SET @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus');

        UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueString]
        SET [ValueString] = @status
        WHERE [ObjectKey] = @requestKey
            AND [AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey
            AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeKey;
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[UpdateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflows]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflows]
    @serviceId SMALLINT,
    @maxRequestsToProcess SMALLINT = 500,
    @startCheckFromRequestKey BIGINT = 0,
    @extendedOutput TINYINT = 1,  -- 0 none, 1 data only, 2 data + messages
    @lastRequestKeyProcessed BIGINT OUTPUT
AS
-- Top level
BEGIN

    IF @extendedOutput < 2
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
    END 

    SELECT  @lastRequestKeyProcessed = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    BEGIN TRY

        
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        DECLARE @acquiredLock                           SMALLINT,
                @failed                                 BIT,
                @lockName                               NVARCHAR(64),
                @messageText                            NVARCHAR(2000),
                @numberOfFinishedRequestsFound          INT,
                @processSystemPartition                 BIT,
                @requestKey                             BIGINT,
                @requestObjectTypeKey                   SMALLINT,
                @requestStatus                          NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey              SMALLINT,
                @requestStatusCanceledPostProcessing    NVARCHAR(448),             
                @requestStatusCompleted                 NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusPostProcessingError       NVARCHAR(448),
                @requestStatusPostProcessingErrorKey    SMALLINT,
                @servicePartitionId                     SMALLINT,
                @systemServicePartitionId               SMALLINT,                
                @time                                   DATETIME,
                @workflowStatusCanceledKey              TINYINT,
                @workflowStatusDidNotExecuteKey         TINYINT,
                @workflowStatusKey                      TINYINT,                
                @workflowStatusTerminatedKey            TINYINT,
                @workflowTypeActionKey                  TINYINT;

        SELECT  @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                @lockName = N'UpdateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflows',
                @requestObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
                @requestStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'RequestStatus'),
                @requestStatusCanceledPostProcessing = [fim].[RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing](),             
                @requestStatusCompleted = [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted](),
                @requestStatusPostProcessingError = [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessingError](),
                @requestStatusPostProcessingErrorKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@requestStatusPostProcessingError),
                @time = GETUTCDATE(),
                @workflowStatusCanceledKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusCanceled]()),
                @workflowStatusDidNotExecuteKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusDidNotExecute]()),
                @workflowStatusTerminatedKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusTerminated]()),
                @workflowTypeActionKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowTypeKey]([fim].[WorkflowTypeAction]());

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * A. Get a lock
        *    DESIGN POINT In a multi-service environment we only want 1 service at a time processing this table.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
            @Resource = @lockName,
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Session'
            
        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatNotAbleToObtainRequestSessionLock](@lockName);
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
               
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * B. Get a snapshot copy of a batch of action workflows in the system and determine 
        * if the parent Request can be completed.
        *
        * DESIGN POINT:  The [WorkflowInstance] table is a "working" table so rows are added, updated and deleted.
        * We don't have control over the size of this table and need to design this procedure to assume it is a large table >500K rows
        * so this procedure will only process a limited batch at a time to avoid timeout issues based on the @maxRequestsToProcess parameter.  
        * In order to scan and process requests when the table is large, this procedure will require several executions and must keep track of 
        * where it starts and ends each scan.  The design takes advantage of the fact that this table has a CLUSTERED INDEX on the RequestKey and is ASCENDING.
        * Each execution starts at the provided starting [RequestKey] and works towards 0 in batches [1 batch per execution of this procedure].
        * This procedure and the caller will keep track of where to start the next scan by passing the [RequestKey] back and forth.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
      
        --Validate the start position
        
        DECLARE @minRequestKey BIGINT;
        SELECT @minRequestKey = MIN([RequestKey])
        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance];
        
        IF
        (       
                @startCheckFromRequestKey <= 0
            OR  @minRequestKey > @startCheckFromRequestKey
        )
        BEGIN
            --if the initial exeuction of this procedure or if the start position is less than any [RequestKey] 
            --remaining in the table, set it to MAX to start over.
            SELECT @startCheckFromRequestKey = ISNULL(MAX([RequestKey]),0)
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance];
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * C. Look up the ServicePartition this Service belongs to and determine if it
        *    also processes the SystemPartition.  If so, get its Id.
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        SELECT 
            @processSystemPartition = [ProcessSystemPartition],
            @servicePartitionId = [ServicePartitionId],
            @systemServicePartitionId = 
            CASE
                WHEN [ProcessSystemPartition] = 1 THEN [fim].[GetSystemServicePartitionId]()
                ELSE NULL
            END
        FROM [fim].[ServiceHeartbeat]
        WHERE [ServiceId] = @serviceId;

        --With this query, we will find a batch of action workflows that are finished.  We exclude any records that had previously been processed
        --by this procedure and resulted in a RequestUpdateFailed = 1.         
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstanceRequest') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstanceRequest;
        END

        SELECT DISTINCT TOP(@maxRequestsToProcess)
            [wi].[RequestKey]
        INTO #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstanceRequest            
        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Request] AS [r]
        ON
            [wi].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
        WHERE
                --if @systemServicePartitionId IS NULL then it won't be processed by this Service
                [r].[ServicePartitionId] IN (@servicePartitionId, @systemServicePartitionId)        
            AND [wi].[RequestKey] <= @startCheckFromRequestKey
            AND [wi].[WorkflowType] = @workflowTypeActionKey
            AND [wi].[Finished] = 1
            AND [wi].[RequestUpdateFailed] = 0
        ORDER BY [wi].[RequestKey] DESC;
        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstanceRequest_RequestKey 
        ON #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstanceRequest 
        (
            [RequestKey]
        );        

        -- Count the number of Requests found to process
        SELECT @numberOfFinishedRequestsFound = COUNT([RequestKey])
        FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstanceRequest;

        -- Determine the position of where the next scan will start.
        IF(@numberOfFinishedRequestsFound < @maxRequestsToProcess)
        BEGIN
            --Less than the maximum records were found during this scan so we have reached the beginning of the database.
            SELECT @lastRequestKeyProcessed = 0;   -- This will force the search to start from the end of the table next time.
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
             -- Set the last row processed marker to the MIN value found in the table.
             -- This is where this procedure will start the scan next time it is run.
            SELECT @lastRequestKeyProcessed = ISNULL(MIN([RequestKey]),0)
            FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstanceRequest;
        END        
            
        --Diagnostics
        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT 
                @startCheckFromRequestKey AS [RequestKeyStartScan],
                @lastRequestKeyProcessed AS [RequestKeyEndScan]
        END    
        
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance;
        END
        
        --Based on the Requests defined above, find all other Action Workflow Rows with the same [RequestKey] and copy locally.
        SELECT 
            [wi].[RequestKey],
            [wi].[WorkflowStatus],
            [wi].[Finished]
        INTO #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance            
        FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
        INNER JOIN #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstanceRequest AS [wir]
        ON 
                [wi].[RequestKey] = [wir].[RequestKey]
            AND [wi].WorkflowType = @workflowTypeActionKey
        ORDER BY [wi].[RequestKey];      
        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance_RequestKey 
        ON #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance 
        (
            [RequestKey]
        );
        
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance_Finished 
        ON #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance 
        (
            [Finished]
        );
      
        --Delete any [RequestKey] that has a workflow that is not finished
        DELETE #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance
        FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance AS [uwi]
        WHERE
            [uwi].[RequestKey] IN
                (
                    SELECT DISTINCT [RequestKey]
                    FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance
                    WHERE [Finished] = 0
                );
                
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance_WorkflowStatus 
        ON #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance 
        (
            [WorkflowStatus]
        );
                        
         /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
         * D. A request may contain multiple workflows. We want to end up with a single
         *    row per RequestKey with a single "collective" workflow result so do some prep
         *    work to merge workflow results for the same request to the same result state.
         *    This is the map:
         *  
         *    WorkflowStatus    RequestStatus
         *      Terminated,       PostProcessingError,
         *      DidNotExecute,    CanceledPostProcessing,
         *      Canceled,         CanceledPostProcessing,
         *      Completed         Completed.
         *    
         *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
         
        -- If any Workflow on a Request has a Status of Terminated, delete the other rows for that Request
        -- since Any Terminated workflow merges to PostProcessingError.       
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance
            WHERE [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusTerminatedKey
        )    
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#requestsWithTerminatedWorkflows') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #requestsWithTerminatedWorkflows;
            END

            SELECT DISTINCT
                [RequestKey]
            INTO #requestsWithTerminatedWorkflows         
            FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance
            WHERE [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusTerminatedKey;

            CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_requestsWithTerminatedWorkflows_RequestKey 
            ON #requestsWithTerminatedWorkflows
            (
                [RequestKey]
            );
            
            DELETE [urs]
            FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance AS [urs]
            INNER JOIN #requestsWithTerminatedWorkflows AS [rwtw]
            ON [urs].[RequestKey] = [rwtw].[RequestKey]
            WHERE [urs].[WorkflowStatus] != @workflowStatusTerminatedKey;
            
         END
         
        -- If any Workflow on a Request has a Status of DidNotExecute or Canceled, update the other rows for that Request to Canceled
        -- since both DidNotExecute and Canceled merge to CanceledPostProcessing.       
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance
            WHERE   [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusCanceledKey
                OR  [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusDidNotExecuteKey
        )    
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#requestsWithCanceledWorkflows') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #requestsWithCanceledWorkflows;
            END

            SELECT DISTINCT
                [RequestKey]
            INTO #requestsWithCanceledWorkflows         
            FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance
            WHERE [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusCanceledKey
                OR  [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusDidNotExecuteKey;

            CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_requestsWithCanceledWorkflows_RequestKey 
            ON #requestsWithCanceledWorkflows
            (
                [RequestKey]
            );
            
            -- UPDATE is used to merge these two into [WorkflowStatus] = Canceled rather than
            -- DELETE because we must have a single [WorkflowStatus] per [RequestKey]
            UPDATE [urs]
            SET [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusCanceledKey
            FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance AS [urs]
            INNER JOIN #requestsWithCanceledWorkflows AS [rwcw]
            ON [urs].[RequestKey] = [rwcw].[RequestKey]
            WHERE [urs].[WorkflowStatus] != @workflowStatusCanceledKey;
            
         END
         
         -- At this point all other Requests would have a WorkflowStatus of Completed.

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * E. If a Request has Collateral Request dependencies, it needs separate processing 
        * so pull these into a separate table and remove from the main table. 
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        DECLARE @collateralRequestTracking TABLE
        (
            [RequestKey] BIGINT,
            [CollateralWorkflowCount] INT,
            [AddTime] DATETIME,
            [TrackingStatus] NVARCHAR(448),
            [NextCheckTime] DATETIME,
            [RecordResultsForLocalLogging] NVARCHAR(448)
        );

        INSERT @collateralRequestTracking
        (
            [RequestKey],
            [CollateralWorkflowCount],
            [AddTime],
            [TrackingStatus],
            [NextCheckTime],
            [RecordResultsForLocalLogging]
        )
        SELECT
            [RequestKey],
            [CollateralWorkflowCount],
            [AddTime],
            [TrackingStatus],
            [NextCheckTime],
            N'Not Recorded'
        FROM [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking];

        DELETE #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance
        WHERE [RequestKey] IN
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM @collateralRequestTracking
        );

        -- Remove records that were just checked recently and flagged to be processed in the future
        DELETE @collateralRequestTracking
        WHERE [NextCheckTime] > @time; 


        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * F. Ready to process so setup some constants and tracking related schema so we can log results
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 

        --Diagnostics
        DECLARE @requestUpdateFailed TABLE
        (
            [RequestKey] BIGINT
        );

        -- used for all processing
        DECLARE @recordsProcessed SMALLINT;
        SELECT @recordsProcessed = 0;

        DECLARE @wasFailure BIT;
        SELECT @wasFailure = 0;

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * G. Process The main Request table
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance
        )
        BEGIN

            DECLARE requestCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [RequestKey],
                [WorkflowStatus]
            FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance;

            OPEN requestCursor;
            WHILE(1 = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT  @failed = 0,
                        @requestKey = NULL,
                        @requestStatus  = NULL,                       
                        @workflowStatusKey = NULL;
                        

                FETCH NEXT FROM requestCursor INTO 
                    @requestKey,
                    @workflowStatusKey;

                IF(@requestKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    -- NO MORE RECORDS
                    BREAK;
                END

                SELECT @requestStatus =
                CASE
                    WHEN [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusKeyOfTypeCompleted](@workflowStatusKey) = 1 THEN @requestStatusCompleted
                    WHEN [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusKeyOfTypeFailed](@workflowStatusKey) = 1 THEN  @requestStatusPostProcessingError
                    WHEN [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusKeyOfTypeCanceled](@workflowStatusKey) = 1 THEN  @requestStatusCanceledPostProcessing
                    ELSE NULL -- this should throw an exception as being invalid.
                END;

                -- Each request is processed as its own transaction so that if one fails the others are not affected.
                BEGIN TRY
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                    
                    IF(@requestStatus = @requestStatusPostProcessingError)
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @failed = 1;
                    END
                    
                    EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
                        @requestKey = @requestKey,
                        @status = @requestStatus,
                        @causeKey = @requestKey,
                        @failed = @failed;
                        
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                    IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
                    BEGIN
                        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                    END                
                    
                    SELECT @wasFailure = 1;
                    
                    --Diagnostics
                    INSERT @requestUpdateFailed
                    (
                        [RequestKey]
                    )
                    SELECT @requestKey;
                    
                    -- Mark all Workflows tied to this Request with a flag so they are not processed during the next run of this procedure.
                    UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
                    SET [RequestUpdateFailed] = 1
                    WHERE [RequestKey] = @requestKey;

                END CATCH

                SELECT @recordsProcessed = @recordsProcessed +1;
            END
            CLOSE requestCursor;
            DEALLOCATE requestCursor; 
        END

        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * H. Process Requests that have Collateral Request dependencies
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [RequestKey]
            FROM @collateralRequestTracking
            WHERE [TrackingStatus] != [fim].[CollateralRequestTrackingRequestCompleted]()
        )
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @acquiredCollateralRequestLock INT;
            DECLARE @parentRequestKey BIGINT;
            DECLARE @collateralWorkflowCount INT;

            DECLARE @recordResultsForLocalLogging NVARCHAR(448);

            DECLARE @collateralRequestProcessingStatus NVARCHAR(448);
            DECLARE @collateralRequestStatusFinalResult NVARCHAR(448);
            DECLARE @requestStatusDetail XML;

            DECLARE @reachedFinalResult BIT;

            DECLARE @workflowResultsStatus NVARCHAR(448);

            DECLARE @mergedStatus NVARCHAR(448);
            DECLARE @mergedStatusKey SMALLINT;
            
            DECLARE @addTime DATETIME;

            DECLARE CollateralRequestTrackingCursor CURSOR LOCAL READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT TOP(@maxRequestsToProcess)
                [RequestKey],
                [AddTime]
            FROM @collateralRequestTracking
            WHERE      
                    [NextCheckTime] <= @time
                AND [TrackingStatus] != [fim].[CollateralRequestTrackingRequestCompleted]()
            ORDER BY [NextCheckTime] ASC  -- FIFO

            OPEN CollateralRequestTrackingCursor;
            WHILE(1 = 1)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @parentRequestKey = NULL;

                FETCH NEXT FROM CollateralRequestTrackingCursor INTO 
                    @parentRequestKey,
                    @addTime;

                IF(@parentRequestKey IS NULL)
                BEGIN
                    -- NO MORE RECORDS
                    BREAK;
                END
                
                SELECT  @acquiredCollateralRequestLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
                        @collateralRequestProcessingStatus = NULL,
                        @collateralRequestStatusFinalResult = NULL,
                        @failed = 0,
                        @reachedFinalResult = 0,
                        @requestStatusDetail = NULL;

                BEGIN TRY
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

                    EXECUTE @acquiredCollateralRequestLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @parentRequestKey;
                    
                    IF(@acquiredCollateralRequestLock < 0)
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatNotAbleToObtainLockOnRequestKey](@parentRequestKey);
                        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    END
                    
                    -- This procedure treats [CollateralRequestTracking] as a queue ordered by [NextCheckTime].
                    -- Since we are processing this item now, update the [NextCheckTime] to NOW + 5 minutes.
                    -- This is done in a separate SQL Transaction from the code that processes the RequestKey
                    -- so that if the processing code fails, this item will not be re-tried before five minutes 
                    -- which will allow others in the Queue to be processed first.  This prevents a "stuck" queue.
                    UPDATE [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking]
                    SET [NextCheckTime] = DATEADD(s, 300, @time)
                    WHERE [RequestKey] = @parentRequestKey;
                    
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION            
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                    IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
                    BEGIN
                        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                    END
               
                    SELECT @wasFailure = 1;
                    
                    --Diagnostics
                    INSERT @requestUpdateFailed
                    (
                        [RequestKey]
                    )
                    SELECT @parentRequestKey;
                    
                END CATCH

                BEGIN TRY
                    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

                    EXECUTE @acquiredCollateralRequestLock = [fim].[LockResource] @objectKey = @parentRequestKey;
                    
                    IF(@acquiredCollateralRequestLock < 0)
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatNotAbleToObtainLockOnRequestKey](@parentRequestKey);
                        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                    END
                
                    -- now that we have a lock on this Request, get the current 
                    -- number of workflows that should be in the system.
                    SELECT @collateralWorkflowCount = [CollateralWorkflowCount]
                    FROM [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking]
                    WHERE [RequestKey] = @parentRequestKey;
                    
                    EXECUTE [fim].[CheckCollateralRequestsStatus]
                        @requestKey = @parentRequestKey,
                        @collateralWorkflowCount = @collateralWorkflowCount,
                        @collateralRequestProcessingStatus = @collateralRequestProcessingStatus OUTPUT,
                        @collateralRequestStatusFinalResult = @collateralRequestStatusFinalResult OUTPUT,
                        @requestStatusDetail = @requestStatusDetail OUTPUT;

                    SELECT @recordResultsForLocalLogging = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(448),N'CollateralRequestResults=' + @collateralRequestProcessingStatus + N'; ');

                    -- Diagnostics
                    UPDATE @collateralRequestTracking
                    SET [RecordResultsForLocalLogging] = @recordResultsForLocalLogging
                    WHERE [RequestKey] = @parentRequestKey;

                    -- if we have a final result
                    IF(@collateralRequestStatusFinalResult IS NOT NULL)
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @workflowResultsStatus = NULL;

                        -- need to check on the parent request workflows.
                        EXECUTE [fim].[AreWorkflowInstancesFinished]
                            @requestKey = @parentRequestKey,
                            @workflowTypeKey = @workflowTypeActionKey,
                            @workflowResultsStatus = @workflowResultsStatus OUTPUT;

                        SELECT @recordResultsForLocalLogging = @recordResultsForLocalLogging + N'ParentWorkflowResults=' + ISNULL(@workflowResultsStatus, [fim].WorkflowStatusRunning());

                        -- Diagnostics
                        UPDATE @collateralRequestTracking
                        SET [RecordResultsForLocalLogging] = @recordResultsForLocalLogging
                        WHERE [RequestKey] = @parentRequestKey;

                        IF (@workflowResultsStatus IS NOT NULL)
                        BEGIN
                        
                            -- if @mergedStatus returns NULL, DoUpdateRequest should not be called.
                            -- IMT 26502 tracks this issue
                            SELECT @mergedStatus = [fim].[DetermineFinalRequestStatusValue](NULL, @workflowResultsStatus, @collateralRequestStatusFinalResult);
                            SELECT @mergedStatusKey = [fim].[GetRequestStatusKey](@mergedStatus);
                            SELECT @reachedFinalResult = 1;
                            
                            IF(@mergedStatusKey = @requestStatusPostProcessingErrorKey)
                            BEGIN 
                                SELECT @failed = 1;
                            END
                         
                            -- Done, Update this row so it won't be picked up again.
                            -- Delete happens via [DoDeleteCacheRequest].
                            UPDATE [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking]
                            SET [TrackingStatus] = [fim].[CollateralRequestTrackingRequestCompleted]()
                            WHERE [RequestKey] = @parentRequestKey;
                          
                          
                            DECLARE @parentRequestStatus NVARCHAR(448);
                            
                            SELECT @parentRequestStatus = [ValueString] 
                            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString]
                            WHERE   [ObjectKey] = @parentRequestKey
                                AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @requestObjectTypeKey
                                AND [AttributeKey] = @requestStatusAttributeKey;
                            
                            -- update the RequestStatus to final state
                            IF([fim].[IsRequestStatusOfTypeProcessing](@parentRequestStatus) = 1)
                            BEGIN
                                EXECUTE [fim].[DoUpdateRequest]
                                    @requestKey = @parentRequestKey,
                                    @status = @mergedStatus,
                                    @causeKey = @parentRequestKey,
                                    @statusDetails = @requestStatusDetail,
                                    @failed = @failed;
                            END
                            
                            -- Diagnostics
                            UPDATE @collateralRequestTracking
                            SET [RecordResultsForLocalLogging] = @mergedStatus
                            WHERE [RequestKey] = @parentRequestKey;
                        END
                    END
                    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
                END TRY    
                BEGIN CATCH
                    IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
                    BEGIN
                        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                    END
               
                    SELECT @wasFailure = 1;
                    
                    --Diagnostics
                    INSERT @requestUpdateFailed
                    (
                        [RequestKey]
                    )
                    SELECT @parentRequestKey;
                    
                END CATCH

                -- If all work is not finished
                IF( @reachedFinalResult = 0)
                BEGIN
                    
                    --Diagnostics:  Update tracking
                    UPDATE @collateralRequestTracking
                    SET [RecordResultsForLocalLogging] = @recordResultsForLocalLogging
                    WHERE [RequestKey] = @parentRequestKey;

                    -- update the time based on the number of workflows and how much time has elapsed
                    -- since the Request was created so that we are not running this check too frequently
                    -- if an item has been processed 10 times without reaching a final status, then back
                    -- off checking for 1 hour.
                    -- The check times are defined as follows:
                    --   <= 10   0 secs (re-try next cycle)
                    --   11 - 100  60 secs (wait 1 minute)
                    --   101 - 1000  120 secs (wait 2 minutes)
                    --   1001 +      300 secs  (wait 5 minutes)
                    
                    DECLARE @elapsedTimeInSeconds INT,
                            @backOffFlag BIT;
                            
                    SELECT @elapsedTimeInSeconds = DATEDIFF(s, @addTime, @time);
                    
                    SELECT @backOffFlag = 
                    CASE
                        WHEN @collateralWorkflowCount <= 10 AND @elapsedTimeInSeconds > 100 THEN 1
                        WHEN @collateralWorkflowCount <= 100 AND @elapsedTimeInSeconds > 600 THEN 1
                        WHEN @collateralWorkflowCount <= 1000 AND @elapsedTimeInSeconds > 1200 THEN 1
                        WHEN @elapsedTimeInSeconds > 3000 THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                      
                    DECLARE @nextCheckTime DATETIME;
                     
                    SELECT @nextCheckTime = 
                    CASE
                        WHEN @backOffFlag = 1 THEN DATEADD(second, 3600, @time)
                        WHEN @collateralWorkflowCount <=10 THEN @time
                        WHEN @collateralWorkflowCount <=100 THEN DATEADD(second, 60, @time)
                        WHEN @collateralWorkflowCount <=1000 THEN DATEADD(second, 120, @time)
                        ELSE DATEADD(second, 300, @time)
                    END;
                     
                    UPDATE [fim].[CollateralRequestTracking]
                    SET 
                        [TrackingStatus] = @collateralRequestProcessingStatus,
                        [NextCheckTime] = @nextCheckTime
                    WHERE [RequestKey] = @parentRequestKey;
                END

                SELECT @recordsProcessed = @recordsProcessed +1;

            END
            CLOSE CollateralRequestTrackingCursor;
            DEALLOCATE CollateralRequestTrackingCursor; 
        END
         
        /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        * I. Send back result recordsets based on extendedOutput setting
        *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ 
        --Diagnostics
        IF(@extendedOutput > 0)
        BEGIN
            IF(@recordsProcessed >0)
            BEGIN
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([upd].[RequestKey]) AS [N'RequestIdentifier'], 
                    [WorkflowStatus] =
                    CASE 
                        WHEN [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusKeyOfTypeCompleted](WorkflowStatus) = 1 THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCompleted]()
                        WHEN [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusKeyOfTypeFailed](WorkflowStatus) = 1 THEN [fim].[RequestStatusPostProcessingError]()
                        WHEN [fim].[IsWorkflowStatusKeyOfTypeCanceled](WorkflowStatus) = 1 THEN [fim].[RequestStatusCanceledPostProcessing]()
                        ELSE NULL -- invalid
                    END
                FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance [upd]
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [fim].[HybridReportingRequestsLogged] [h] 
                                      WHERE [upd].[RequestKey] = [h].[RequestKey]);
                
                INSERT INTO [fim].[HybridReportingRequestsLogged]
                SELECT DISTINCT [upd].[RequestKey] 
                    FROM #updateRequestStatusForCompletedActionWorkflowsWorkflowInstance [upd]
                    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [fim].[HybridReportingRequestsLogged] [h] 
                                          WHERE [upd].[RequestKey] = [h].[RequestKey]);

                SELECT
                    [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([RequestKey]) AS [RequestWithCollateralRequestDependency],
                    [RecordResultsForLocalLogging]  AS [RequestProcessingStatus]
                FROM @collateralRequestTracking;

                IF(@wasFailure = 1)   
                BEGIN
                    SELECT [fim].[GetIdentifierFromObjectKey]([RequestKey]) AS [N'FailedRequestIdentifier'] FROM @requestUpdateFailed;
                END
            END
        END
        IF(@acquiredLock = 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockName,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH

        IF(@acquiredLock = 0)
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE  [sys].[sp_releaseapplock]
                @Resource = @lockName,
                @LockOwner = N'Session';
        END

        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH 
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[UpdateResource]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateResource]
    @requestKey         BIGINT,
    @resourceKey        BIGINT,
    @localeKey          SMALLINT,
    @time               DATETIME,
    @trace              BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE  
        @compositeObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @acquiredLock           SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag              BIT,
        @defaultLocaleKey       SMALLINT,
        @lockName               NVARCHAR(32),
        @mayRetry               BIT,
        @mayRetryInt            INT,
        @messageText            NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @retryCount             INT,
        @startTime              DATETIME,
        @trueFlag               BIT;
        
    SELECT         
        @acquiredLock   = -1, --Negative value indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
        @lockName       = N'UpdateResource',
        @falseFlag      = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag       = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    IF (@trace = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @startTime  = GETUTCDATE();
    END

    SELECT
        @compositeObjectTypeKey =   [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmCompositeType'),  
        @defaultLocaleKey   = [fim].[GetDefaultLocaleKey](),
        @mayRetry           = @falseFlag,
        @mayRetryInt        = 0,
        @retryCount         = 3;
        
RetryPoint: 

    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;
        
        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                        @Resource = @lockName,
                        @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                        @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
                        
        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
          
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueBinary] = [ro].[ValueBinary]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBinary] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                AND [ai].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
                AND [ov].[SequenceID] = 0
        )    
        BEGIN
            DELETE [ov]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueBinary] = [ro].[ValueBinary]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBinary] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                AND [ai].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
                AND [ov].[SequenceID] = 0;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueBinary] = [ro].[ValueBinary]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBinary] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                AND [ai].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
        )    
        BEGIN
            DELETE [ov]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueBinary] = [ro].[ValueBinary]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBinary] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
                AND [ai].[Multivalued] = @trueFlag
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBinary] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            ;WITH [NextSequenceIDs] ([ObjectKey], [AttributeKey], [MaxSequenceID]) AS
            (
                SELECT
                    [ov].[ObjectKey], 
                    [ov].[AttributeKey], 
                    MAX([ov].[SequenceID]) 
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] AS [ov]
                WHERE [ov].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                GROUP BY [ov].[ObjectKey], [ov].[AttributeKey]
            )
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueBinary],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[AttributeKey] 
                                   ORDER BY [ro].[AttributeKey]) 
                   + COALESCE([n].[MaxSequenceID], -1),
                [ro].[ValueBinary],
                [ai].[Multivalued] 
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBinary] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [NextSequenceIDs] AS [n]
                ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [n].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [n].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBinary] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueBoolean] = [ro].[ValueBoolean]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [ov]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueBoolean] = [ro].[ValueBoolean]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueBoolean]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                [ro].[ValueBoolean]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputBoolean] AS [ro]
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueBoolean] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] AS [ov]
                    WHERE [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                        AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                        AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                    );
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueDateTime] = [ro].[ValueDateTime]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [ov]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueDateTime] = [ro].[ValueDateTime]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            ;WITH [NextSequenceIDs] ([ObjectKey], [AttributeKey], [MaxSequenceID]) AS
            (
                SELECT
                    [ov].[ObjectKey], 
                    [ov].[AttributeKey], 
                    MAX([ov].[SequenceID]) 
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [ov]
                WHERE 
                        [ov].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                GROUP BY [ov].[ObjectKey], [ov].[AttributeKey]
            )
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueDateTime],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[AttributeKey] 
                                   ORDER BY [ro].[AttributeKey]) 
                   + COALESCE(n.[MaxSequenceID], -1),
                [ro].[ValueDateTime],
                [ai].[Multivalued]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputDateTime] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [NextSequenceIDs] AS [n]
                ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [n].[ObjectKey] 
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [n].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueDateTime] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueInteger] = [ro].[ValueInteger]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueInteger] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [ov]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueInteger] = [ro].[ValueInteger]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueInteger] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueInteger] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            ;WITH [NextSequenceIDs] ([ObjectKey], [AttributeKey], [MaxSequenceID]) AS
            (
                SELECT
                    [ov].[ObjectKey], 
                    [ov].[AttributeKey], 
                    MAX([ov].[SequenceID]) 
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] AS [ov]
                WHERE [ov].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                GROUP BY [ov].[ObjectKey], [ov].[AttributeKey]
            )
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueInteger],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[AttributeKey] 
                                   ORDER BY [ro].[AttributeKey]) 
                   + COALESCE(n.[MaxSequenceID], -1),
                [ro].[ValueInteger],
                [ai].[Multivalued]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputInteger] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [NextSequenceIDs] AS [n]
                ON [n].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [n].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueInteger] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueReference] = [ro].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [ov]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
                ON [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ov].[ValueReference] = [ro].[ValueReference]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueReference] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueReference] IS NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [fim].[RequestOutputReference]
            WHERE 
                    [RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ValueReference] IS NULL
                AND [Deleted] = @falseFlag
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#updateResourceReference') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                DROP TABLE #updateResourceReference;
            END
            
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey]        AS N'ObjectKey',
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]    AS N'ObjectTypeKey',
                [ro].[AttributeKey]     AS N'AttributeKey',
                [ro].[ValueReference]   AS N'ValueReference',
                [ai].[Multivalued]      AS N'Multivalued'
            INTO #updateResourceReference            
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputReference] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            WHERE 
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            ORDER BY
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                [ro].[ValueReference];
                
            CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_UpdateResourceReference]
            ON #updateResourceReference
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectTypeKey],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference]
            );   
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #updateResourceReference AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ValueReference] = [existing].[ValueReference]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM [candidate]
                FROM #updateResourceReference AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [existing]
                    ON  [candidate].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey] = [existing].[ObjectTypeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[AttributeKey] = [existing].[AttributeKey]
                    AND [candidate].[ValueReference] = [existing].[ValueReference]
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [candidate].[ObjectKey]
                FROM #updateResourceReference AS [candidate]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueReference]
                (   
                    [ObjectKey], 
                    [ObjectTypeKey], 
                    [AttributeKey],
                    [ValueReference],
                    [Multivalued]
                )
                SELECT
                    [candidate].[ObjectKey],
                    [candidate].[ObjectTypeKey],
                    [candidate].[AttributeKey],
                    [candidate].[ValueReference],
                    [candidate].[Multivalued]
                FROM #updateResourceReference AS [candidate]
            END
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
                ON  [ro].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ro].[ValueString] = [ov].[ValueString]
                AND [ro].[LocaleKey]  = [ov].[LocaleKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [ov]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
                ON  [ro].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ro].[ValueString] = [ov].[ValueString]
                AND [ro].[LocaleKey]  = [ov].[LocaleKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
        END
        
        -- CompositeType update requires correct NextSequenceID to insert all string values for all requests in a batch (SE 222232)
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            ;WITH [NextSequenceIDs] ([ObjectKey], [AttributeKey], [MaxSequenceID]) AS
            (
                SELECT
                    [ov].[ObjectKey],
                    [ov].[AttributeKey],
                    MAX([ov].[SequenceID])
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ov]
                WHERE
                        [ov].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey AND
                        [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] <> @compositeObjectTypeKey
                GROUP BY [ov].[ObjectKey], [ov].[AttributeKey]
                UNION ALL
                SELECT
                    [ov].[ObjectKey],
                    [ov].[AttributeKey],
                    MAX([ov].[SequenceID])
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [ov]
                WHERE  [ov].[ObjectKey] IN
                       (SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey]
                        FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] [ro]
                        JOIN [fim].[Request] [r] ON [ro].[RequestKey] = [r].[RequestKey]
                        WHERE
                                [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                            AND [r].[TargetObjectTypeKey] = @compositeObjectTypeKey
                       )
                GROUP BY [ov].[ObjectKey], [ov].[AttributeKey]
            )
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueString],
                [LocaleKey],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[AttributeKey] 
                                   ORDER BY [ro].[AttributeKey]) 
                   + COALESCE(n.[MaxSequenceID], -1),
                [ro].[ValueString],
                ISNULL ([ro].[LocaleKey], @defaultLocaleKey),
                [ai].[Multivalued]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputString] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [NextSequenceIDs] AS [n]
                ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [n].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [n].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE 
                  [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
              AND [ro].[ValueString] IS NOT NULL
              AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@defaultLocaleKey = 127));
        END
 
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
                ON  [ro].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ro].[ValueText] = [ov].[ValueText]
                AND [ro].[LocaleKey]  = [ov].[LocaleKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [ov]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
                ON  [ro].[ObjectKey] = [ov].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ro].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ov].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ov].[AttributeKey]
                AND [ro].[ValueText] = [ov].[ValueText]
                AND [ro].[LocaleKey]  = [ov].[LocaleKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[RequestKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            ;WITH [NextSequenceIDs] ([ObjectKey], [AttributeKey], [MaxSequenceID]) AS
            (
                SELECT
                    [ov].[ObjectKey], 
                    [ov].[AttributeKey], 
                    MAX([ov].[SequenceID]) 
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [ov]
                WHERE 
                        [ov].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                GROUP BY [ov].[ObjectKey], [ov].[AttributeKey]
            )
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueText] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueText],
                [LocaleKey],
                [Multivalued]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[AttributeKey] 
                                   ORDER BY [ro].[AttributeKey]) 
                   + COALESCE(n.[MaxSequenceID], -1),
                [ro].[ValueText],
                ISNULL ([ro].[LocaleKey], @defaultLocaleKey),
                [ai].[Multivalued]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputText] AS [ro]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
                ON [ro].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key] 
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [NextSequenceIDs] AS [n]
                ON [ro].[ObjectKey] = [n].[ObjectKey]  
                AND [ro].[AttributeKey] = [n].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE 
                  [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
              AND [ro].[ValueText] IS NOT NULL
              AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
            OPTION (OPTIMIZE FOR (@defaultLocaleKey = 127));
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ov].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputXml] AS [ro]
                ON  [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueXml] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [ov]
            FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] AS [ov]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestOutputXml] AS [ro]
                ON  [ov].[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey]
                AND [ov].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ro].[ObjectTypeKey]
                AND [ov].[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueXml] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @trueFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [ro].[ObjectKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputXml] AS [ro]
            WHERE
                    [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
                AND [ro].[ValueXml] IS NOT NULL
                AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            ;WITH [NextSequenceIDs] ([ObjectKey], [AttributeKey], [MaxSequenceID]) AS
            (
                SELECT
                    [ov].[ObjectKey], 
                    [ov].[AttributeKey], 
                    MAX([ov].[SequenceID]) 
                FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] AS [ov]
                WHERE [ov].[ObjectKey] = @resourceKey
                GROUP BY [ov].[ObjectKey], [ov].[AttributeKey]
            )
            INSERT INTO [fim].[ObjectValueXml] 
            (   
                [ObjectKey], 
                [ObjectTypeKey], 
                [AttributeKey],
                [SequenceID],
                [ValueXml]
            )
            SELECT
                [ro].[ObjectKey],
                [ro].[ObjectTypeKey],
                [ro].[AttributeKey],
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ro].[ObjectKey], [ro].[AttributeKey] 
                                   ORDER BY [ro].[AttributeKey]) 
                   + COALESCE(n.[MaxSequenceID], -1),
                [ro].[ValueXml]
            FROM [fim].[RequestOutputXml] AS [ro]
            LEFT OUTER JOIN [NextSequenceIDs] n
                ON n.[ObjectKey] = [ro].[ObjectKey] 
                AND n.[AttributeKey] = [ro].[AttributeKey]
            WHERE 
                  [ro].[RequestKey] = @requestKey
              AND [ro].[ValueXml] IS NOT NULL
              AND [ro].[Deleted] = @falseFlag;
        END
	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH 
        EXECUTE @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = @requestKey, 
            @stage      = N'UpdateResource';
    END
END
GO
