--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceControlMessage]
    @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @clearWorkflowControlMessage BIT = 0
AS
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        IF(@clearWorkflowControlMessage = 1)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            SET 
                [WorkflowControlMessage] = NULL,
                [MessageReason] = NULL
            WHERE [Identifier] = @identifier;
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceObject]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceObject]
    @workflowInstanceObjectKey BIGINT,
    @workflowStatusKey  TINYINT,
    @workflowStatusDetail  NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
-- Only called from other stored procedures
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON
    BEGIN TRY
    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;

        DECLARE @didUpdate BIT,
                @message NVARCHAR(MAX),
                @messageReason NVARCHAR(64),
                @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey SMALLINT,
                @workflowStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey SMALLINT,
                @workflowStatusName NVARCHAR(448);
         
        SELECT  @didUpdate = 0,
                @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowInstance'),
                @workflowStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowStatus'),             
                @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowStatusDetail'),
                @workflowStatusName = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusName](@workflowStatusKey);
 
        IF(@workflowStatusName IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @message = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'workflowStatusKey');
            RAISERROR(@message, 16, 1)
        END

        UPDATE [fim].ObjectValueString
        SET [ValueString] = @workflowStatusName
        WHERE
                [ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
            AND [ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey
            AND [AttributeKey] = @workflowStatusAttributeKey

        IF(@@ROWCOUNT = 1)
        BEGIN
           SELECT @didUpdate =1;
        END  

        --If we have a workflowStatusDetail, attempt to stamp it on the object as well
        --if it fails we ignore because it is not required.
        IF(@workflowStatusDetail IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            --DESIGN POINT: If we send a cancel message, an exception is thrown
            --so grab @messageReason to help with audit trail (e.g. Canceled by user, or by system)
            --If user then a GUID of the Cancel Request, if by System then a reason string.

            SELECT 
                @messageReason = [wi].[MessageReason]
            FROM [fim]. [WorkflowInstance] AS [wi]
            WHERE [wi].[ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey;

            IF(@messageReason IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @workflowStatusDetail = 'TERMINATE REASON: ' + @messageReason + '\r\n\r\n' + @workflowStatusDetail;
            END

            EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueText] 
                @objectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey,
                @attributeKey = @workflowStatusDetailAttributeKey, 
                @value = @workflowStatusDetail,
                @localeKey = NULL,
                @objectTypeKey = @workflowInstanceObjectTypeKey
         END
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
    
    RETURN @didUpdate;      
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceOwner]
    @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @serviceId SMALLINT

AS
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        --Update our record if a different Workflow Service Host is running this workflow
        --This could happen in a Multi-Server deployment.
        IF NOT EXISTS 
        (
            SELECT [ServiceId]
            FROM [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            WHERE 
                    [Identifier] = @identifier
                AND [ServiceId] = @serviceId
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            SET [ServiceId] = @serviceId
            WHERE [Identifier] = @identifier;            
        END
        
 
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH  
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatus]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatus]
    @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @workflowStatusKey  TINYINT,
    @workflowStatusDetail NVARCHAR(448) = NULL
AS
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION

        DECLARE @messageText NVARCHAR(MAX);        
        
        IF([fim].[GetWorkflowStatusName](@workflowStatusKey) IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidParameterException](N'workflowStatusKey');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        -- USE [fim].]UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusFinal] for final state updates
        IF([fim].[IsWorkflowStatusKeyOfTypeFinal](@workflowStatusKey) = 1)
        BEGIN
            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Setting status to a final state is not allowed by this procedure.  Failed to update workflow instance ' + CAST(@identifier AS NVARCHAR(36)) + '.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        -- USE [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusCreate] for Create state update
        IF([fim].[GetWorkflowStatusName](@workflowStatusKey) = [fim].[WorkflowStatusCreated]())
        BEGIN

            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Setting status to Created is not allowed by this procedure.  Failed to update workflow instance ' + CAST(@identifier AS NVARCHAR(36)) + '.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END

        DECLARE @workflowInstanceTypeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @workflowInstanceTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowInstance');

        DECLARE @workflowStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT;
        SELECT @workflowStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowStatus');

        DECLARE @workflowInstanceObjectKey BIGINT;
        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier] 
            @objectID = @identifier, 
            @objectTypeKey = @workflowInstanceTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey OUTPUT;

        --DESIGN POINT:  Workflows may hydrate and re-hydrate during execution so could be sending
        --status messages multiple times for the same state (e.g. Running)
        --Only do updates if the actual state of the object has changed from the previous state recorded
        --to eliminate unnecessary database updates.
        
        UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
        SET 
            [WorkflowStatus] = @workflowStatusKey
        WHERE 
                [ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
            AND [WorkflowStatus] != @workflowStatusKey     -- Must be a new status
            AND [Finished] = 0;                         -- Must not already be finished

        IF(@@ROWCOUNT = 1)
        BEGIN
            --Only update if the status changed.
            EXECUTE [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceObject]
                @workflowInstanceObjectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey,
                @workflowStatusKey = @workflowStatusKey,
                @workflowStatusDetail = @workflowStatusDetail
        END

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        EXEC [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH  
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusCreated]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusCreated]
    @identifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @serviceId  SMALLINT,
    @workflowDefinitionVersionKeyWithActiveEndpoints INT
AS
--Top level
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    BEGIN TRY    
        EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
        
        DECLARE 
            @acquiredLock INTEGER,
            @lockName NVARCHAR(64),
            @didUpdate BIT,
            @didUpdateInt INT,
            @messageText NVARCHAR(2000),    
            @OkToClearHostMessage BIT,                
            @statusCreatedKey TINYINT,
            @statusCreatedValue NVARCHAR(448),
            @statusPendingKey TINYINT,
            @workflowInstanceObjectKey BIGINT,
            @workflowInstanceTypeKey SMALLINT,
            @workflowStatusAttributeKey SMALLINT;
            
        SELECT  
            @acquiredLock = -1,  --Negative indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
            @didUpdate = 0,
            @didUpdateInt = 0,
            @lockName = N'UpdateWorkflowInstanceStatusCreated',
            @statusCreatedValue = [fim].[WorkflowStatusCreated](),
            @statusPendingKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey]([fim].[WorkflowStatusPending]()),
            @workflowInstanceTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowInstance'),
            @workflowStatusAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowStatus');

        EXECUTE [fim].[GetObjectKeyFromIdentifier] 
            @objectID = @identifier, 
            @objectTypeKey = @workflowInstanceTypeKey,
            @objectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey OUTPUT;

        SELECT  
            @OkToClearHostMessage = [fim].[OkToClearWorkflowInstanceHostMessage](@workflowInstanceObjectKey),
            @statusCreatedKey = [fim].[GetWorkflowStatusKey](@statusCreatedValue);

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            
            --DESIGN POINT: Determine if we can clear any pending HostMessage

            UPDATE [fim].[WorkflowInstance]
            SET 
             [WorkflowStatus] = @statusCreatedKey,
             [ServiceId] = @serviceId,
             [WorkflowControlMessage] = 
                 CASE
                      WHEN @OkToClearHostMessage = 1 THEN NULL
                      ELSE [WorkflowControlMessage] -- keep as is
                 END,
             [MessageReason] = 
                 CASE
                      WHEN @OkToClearHostMessage = 1 THEN NULL
                      ELSE [MessageReason] -- keep as is
                 END
            WHERE 
                    [ObjectKey] = @workflowInstanceObjectKey
                AND [WorkflowStatus] = @statusPendingKey;  -- Must be Pending

            IF( @@ROWCOUNT = 1)
            BEGIN
                --Only update if the status changed.
                EXECUTE @didUpdateInt = [fim].[UpdateWorkflowInstanceObject]
                    @workflowInstanceObjectKey = @workflowInstanceObjectKey,
                    @workflowStatusKey = @statusCreatedKey;

                SELECT @didUpdate = CAST(@didUpdateInt AS BIT);
            END

            IF(@didUpdate = 0)
            BEGIN
                SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Failed to update workflow instance ' + CAST(@identifier AS NVARCHAR(36)) + ' to a created state.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        /* DESIGN POINT:  The following table [fim].[ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints] is used to provide notice to all running FIMServices of any new Hosted Workflow that is created
        *  in the FIMService.  Each time a new WorkflowInstance for this type is created, this code will execute and has a chance to "register" it.  Registration of this Workflow Host
        *  will enable all FIMServices to create an instance of this WorkflowHost so they are able to receive an external WCF message at the endpoint and process it.
        *  e.g. Failure scenario
        *  FIMService 1 and FIMService 2 are running.
        *  FIMService 1 is asked to create a WorkflowInstance and it turns out it has a Receive Activity so needs to create a special WorkflowHost that can support the WCF message.
        *  it calls this procedure and registers this host.
        *  FIMService 2 sees this new host and immediately creates an instance of it as well.
        *  Now the response from the client can go to either FIMService 1 or 2 and be processed.
        *  If FIMService 1 fails to register this host AND the client message goes to FIMService 2,it will fail.
        *  Since this process is WorkflowInstance based, we get another try each time any WorkflowInstance is created.
        */
        IF(@workflowDefinitionVersionKeyWithActiveEndpoints IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 
                    [ahwdwe].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] 
                FROM [fim].[ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints] AS [ahwdwe]
                WHERE [ahwdwe].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKeyWithActiveEndpoints
            )
            BEGIN
            
                BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                    -- We only want a single instance of this running at a time so get an application lock.
                    EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                        @Resource = @lockName,
                        @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                        @LockTimeout = 30000;   -- wait 30 seconds before giving up.

                    IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
                    BEGIN
                        -- Assume another thread is updating the table.
                        -- Will not wait and assume that at some point this WorkflowHost will be registered in the future.
                        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
                        RETURN;
                    END      
                     
                     -- Check to make sure no other thread has already inserted the row now that this thread owns the lock
                    IF NOT EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT 
                            [ahwdwe].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] 
                        FROM [fim].[ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints] AS [ahwdwe]
                        WHERE [ahwdwe].[WorkflowDefinitionVersionKey] = @workflowDefinitionVersionKeyWithActiveEndpoints
                    )
                    BEGIN

                        INSERT [fim].[ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints]
                        SELECT @workflowDefinitionVersionKeyWithActiveEndpoints;

                        IF(@@ROWCOUNT !=1)
                        BEGIN
                            SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatWorkflowSqlOperationException](N'Failed to insert workflow definition version key ' + CAST(@workflowDefinitionVersionKeyWithActiveEndpoints AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' into table [ActiveHostedWorkflowDefinitionWithEndpoints].');
                            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
                        END
                    END
                
                COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            END
        END
        

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END
        
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[ValidateReportingJobIdentifier]
(
    @reportingJobIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @reportingJobObjectKey   BIGINT OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************    
    DECLARE @messageText                    NVARCHAR(2000),			
            @objectTypeFromJobIdentifier    SMALLINT,           
            @reportingJobObjectTypeKey      SMALLINT;
            

    SELECT 		
        @reportingJobObjectKey       = [fim].[ObjectKeyFromObjectIdentifier](@reportingJobIdentifier),
        @objectTypeFromJobIdentifier = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromObjectKey](@reportingJobObjectKey),
        @reportingJobObjectTypeKey   = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'msidmReportingJob');

    IF (
            (@reportingJobObjectKey IS NULL)         
         OR (@objectTypeFromJobIdentifier != @reportingJobObjectTypeKey)
       )
    BEGIN
        SET @messageText = [fim].[FormatInvalidReportingJobIdentifierException](@reportingJobIdentifier);
        RAISERROR(@messageText, 16, 1);
    END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [fim].[WaitForNotifications] 
    @timeoutInMilliseconds  INT =   -1
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @trueFlag   BIT;
    
    SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
	EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [setup].[AddStartSQLServerAgentJobs]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [setup].[AddStartSQLServerAgentJobs]
    @databaseName NVARCHAR(128)
AS
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  This script adds SQL Server Agent jobs:
 *  1. The Temporal Events
 *  2. Set Maintainance (disabled OOB)
 *  3. Group Maintainance (disabled OOB)
 *  4. Delete Expired System Objects
 *  5. Terminate Stuck Requests
 *  6. Truncate Export Log
 *  7. Reporting Incremental Synchronization
 *  8. Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *
 *  Note: Set Maintainance and Group Maintainance are shipped disabled since the work they are doing is done by The Temporal Events job (thus are redundant).
 *  If there is need to maintain the sets and groups more often they can be enabled. When enabling them make sure they do not intersect
 *  in time with execution of The Temporal events since this can create problems.
 *
 *  The schedules for these jobs over the course of the day are as follows:
 *
 *  00:00   Set maintenance
 *  00:00   Reporting Incremental Synchronization
 *  00:00   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  00:35   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  01:00   Temporal events
 *  01:10   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  01:45   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  02:00   Set maintenance
 *  02:20   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  02:55   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  03:00   Set maintenance
 *..03:30   Delete Expired System Objects
 *  03:30   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  04:00   Set maintenance
 *  04:05   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *..04:30   Terminate Stuck Requests 
 *  04:40   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  05:00   Set maintenance
 *  05:15   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *..05:30   Truncate export log
 *  05:50   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  06:00   Set maintenance
 *  06:25   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  07:00   Set maintenance
 *  07:00   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  07:35   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  08:00   Set maintenance
 *  08:00   Reporting Incremental Synchronization
 *  08:10   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  08:45   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  09:00   Group maintenance
 *  09:20   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  09:55   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  10:00   Set maintenance
 *  10:30   Evaluate Deferred Groups
 *  10:30   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  11:00   Set maintenance
 *  11:05   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  11:40   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  12:00   Set maintenance
 *  12:15   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  12:50   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  13:00   Set maintenance
 *  13:25   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  14:00   Set maintenance
 *  14:00   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  14:35   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  15:00   Set maintenance
 *  15:10   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  15:45   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  16:00   Set maintenance
 *  16:00   Reporting Incremental Synchronization
 *  16:20   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  16:55   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  17:00   Group maintenance
 *  17:30   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  18:00   Set maintenance
 *  18:05   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  18:40   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  19:00   Set maintenance
 *  19:15   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  19:50   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  20:00   Set maintenance
 *  20:25   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  21:00   Set maintenance
 *  21:00   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  21:35   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  22:00   Set maintenance
 *  22:10   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  22:30   Evaluate Deferred Groups
 *  22:45   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  23:00   Set maintenance
 *  23:20   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *  23:55   Check And Update Reporting Job Status
 *
 *  The temporal events job executes these stored procedures, in sequence:
 *  1.  TriggerTemporalEvents
 *  2.  MaintainSets
 *  3.  MaintainGroups
 *  4.  OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions
 *
 *  The set maintenance job executes this stored procedures:
 *      MaintainSets
 *
 *  The group maintenance job executes these stored procedures, in sequence:
 *  1.  MaintainSets
 *  2.  MaintainGroups
 *
 *  Thus, by default, the MaintainSets stored procedure is executed every 
 *  hour, throughout the day, the MaintainGroups procedure is executed 
 *  every eight hours, and the TriggerTemporalEvents stored procedure is 
 *  executed once per day.
 *
 *  The temporal events job has an extra step that executes the 
 *  TriggerTemporalEvents stored procedure.  That step is by-passed in the
 *  daily execution of the job, and provided solely so that this script can
 *  have the job execute that procedure in the background upon installation, 
 *  while installation continues.
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
BEGIN
        
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    DECLARE
        @engineEdition                                      BIGINT,
        @cancelStuckRequestsCommand                         NVARCHAR(256),
        @cancelStuckRequestsStep                            NVARCHAR(64),
        @categoryName                                       NVARCHAR(8),
        @checkAndUpdateReportingJobStatusCommand            NVARCHAR(256),
        @checkAndUpdateReportingJobStatusJobName            NVARCHAR(64),
        @checkAndUpdateReportingJobStatusStep               NVARCHAR(64),
        @commandTemplate                                    NVARCHAR(256),
        @deferredGroupEvaluationCommand                     NVARCHAR(256),
        @deferredGroupEvaluationJobName                     NVARCHAR(64),
        @deferredGroupEvaluationStep                        NVARCHAR(64),
        @deleteExpiredSystemObjectsCommand                  NVARCHAR(256),
        @deleteExpiredSystemObjectsJobName                  NVARCHAR(64),
        @deleteExpiredSystemObjectsStep                     NVARCHAR(64),
        @expireStuckRequestsCommand                         NVARCHAR(256),
        @expireStuckRequestsStep                            NVARCHAR(64),
        @groupMaintenanceCommand                            NVARCHAR(256),
        @groupMaintenanceJobName                            NVARCHAR(64),
        @groupMaintenanceStep                               NVARCHAR(64),
        @jobDescription                                     NVARCHAR(128),
        @jobName                                            NVARCHAR(64),
        @jobNameTemplate                                    NVARCHAR(64),
        @jobIdentifier                                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @returnCode                                         INT,
        @scheduleName                                       NVARCHAR(64),
        @scheduleNameTemplate                               NVARCHAR(64),
        @scheduleReportingIncrementalSynchronizationJobName NVARCHAR(64),
        @sendReportingJobStartNotificationCommand           NVARCHAR(256),
        @sendReportingJobStartNotificationStep              NVARCHAR(64),
        @setMaintenanceCommand                              NVARCHAR(256),
        @setMaintenanceJobName                              NVARCHAR(64),
        @setMaintenanceStep                                 NVARCHAR(64),
        @setPartitionCommand                                NVARCHAR(256),
        @setPartitionStep                                   NVARCHAR(64),
        @stepNameTemplate                                   NVARCHAR(64),
        @temporalEventsJobName                              NVARCHAR(64),
        @terminateStuckRequestsJobName                      NVARCHAR(64),
        @terminateStuckRequestsCommand                      NVARCHAR(256),
        @terminateStuckRequestsStep                         NVARCHAR(64),
        @triggerTemporalEventsCommand                       NVARCHAR(256),
        @triggerTemporalEventsStep                          NVARCHAR(64),
        @truncateExportLogCommand                           NVARCHAR(256),
        @truncateExportLogJobName                           NVARCHAR(64),
        @truncateExportLogStep                              NVARCHAR(64),
        @truncateInstanceDataCommand                        NVARCHAR(256),
        @truncateInstanceDataStep                           NVARCHAR(64),
		@validatePrimalReplicaCommand                       NVARCHAR(256),
		@validatePrimalReplicaStep                          NVARCHAR(64);

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *      If the version of SQL is NOT "Express" then add and schedule the 
 *      SQL Server Agent Jobs. 
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT @engineEdition = CONVERT(BIGINT,SERVERPROPERTY('EngineEdition'));
    IF (@engineEdition = 4)
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
        
    SELECT 
        @categoryName                   =   N'FIM',
        @commandTemplate                =   N'EXECUTE [fim].[{0}]{1}',
        @jobNameTemplate                =   N'FIM_{0}Job',
        @scheduleNameTemplate           =   N'FIM_{0}JobSchedule{1}',
        @stepNameTemplate               =   N'FIM_{0}Step';
        
    SELECT
        @cancelStuckRequestsCommand                             =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'CancelStuckRequests'),N'{1}',N''),
        @cancelStuckRequestsStep                                =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'CancelStuckRequests'),
        @checkAndUpdateReportingJobStatusCommand                =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'CheckAndUpdateReportingJobStatus'),N'{1}',N''),
        @checkAndUpdateReportingJobStatusStep                   =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'CheckAndUpdateReportingJobStatus'),
        @checkAndUpdateReportingJobStatusJobName                =   REPLACE(@jobNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'CheckAndUpdateReportingJobStatus'),
        @deferredGroupEvaluationCommand                         =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'CalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions'),N'{1}',N''),
        @deferredGroupEvaluationJobName                         =   REPLACE(@jobNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'CalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions'),
        @deferredGroupEvaluationStep                            =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'CalculateDeferredGroupMembershipTransitions'),
        @deleteExpiredSystemObjectsCommand                      =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'DeleteExpiredSystemObjects'),N'{1}',N''),
        @deleteExpiredSystemObjectsJobName                      =   REPLACE(@jobNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'DeleteExpiredSystemObjects'),
        @deleteExpiredSystemObjectsStep                         =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'DeleteExpiredSystemObjects'),
        @expireStuckRequestsCommand                             =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'ExpireStuckRequests'),N'{1}',N''),
        @expireStuckRequestsStep                                =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'ExpireStuckRequests'),
        @groupMaintenanceCommand                                =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'MaintainGroups'),N'{1}',N''),
        @groupMaintenanceJobName                                =   REPLACE(@jobNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'MaintainGroups'),
        @groupMaintenanceStep                                   =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'MaintainGroups'),
        @scheduleReportingIncrementalSynchronizationJobName     =   REPLACE(@jobNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'ScheduleReportingIncrementalSynchronization'),
        @sendReportingJobStartNotificationCommand               =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'SendReportingJobSchedulerMessage'),N'{1}',N''),
        @sendReportingJobStartNotificationStep                  =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'SendReportingJobStartNotificationMessage'),
        @setMaintenanceCommand                                  =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'MaintainSets'),N'{1}',N''),
        @setMaintenanceJobName                                  =   REPLACE(@jobNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'MaintainSets'),
        @setMaintenanceStep                                     =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'MaintainSets'),
        @setPartitionCommand                                    =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions'),N'{1}',N''),
        @setPartitionStep                                       =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'OptimizeSetMembershipConditionsUsingPartitions'),
        @temporalEventsJobName                                  =   REPLACE(@jobNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'TemporalEvents'),
        @terminateStuckRequestsCommand                          =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'TerminateStuckRequests'),N'{1}',N''),
        @terminateStuckRequestsJobName                          =   REPLACE(@jobNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'TerminateStuckRequests'),
        @terminateStuckRequestsStep                             =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'TerminateStuckRequests'),
        @triggerTemporalEventsCommand                           =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'TriggerTemporalEvents'),N'{1}',N' @extendedOutput = 0'),
        @triggerTemporalEventsStep                              =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'TriggerTemporalEvents'),
        @truncateExportLogCommand                               =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'TruncateExportLog'),N'{1}',N''),
        @truncateExportLogJobName                               =   REPLACE(@jobNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'TruncateExportLog'),
        @truncateExportLogStep                                  =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'TruncateExportLog'),
        @truncateInstanceDataCommand                            =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'TruncateInstanceData'),N'{1}',N''),
        @truncateInstanceDataStep                               =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'TruncateInstanceData'),
		@validatePrimalReplicaCommand                           =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@commandTemplate,N'{0}',N'ValidatePrimalReplica'),N'{1}',N''),
		@validatePrimalReplicaStep                              =   REPLACE(@stepNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'ValidatePrimalReplica');
      
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  A.  Add the category to which the jobs are to belong, if it does not 
 *      already exist.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        IF NOT EXISTS 
        (
            SELECT [c].[name]
            FROM [msdb].[dbo].[syscategories] AS [c]
            WHERE 
                    [c].[name] = @categoryName 
                AND [c].[category_class] = 1
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE @returnCode = msdb.dbo.sp_add_category 
                @class  =   'JOB', 
                @type   =   'LOCAL', 
                @name=@categoryName;
            IF @@ERROR <> 0 
            OR @returnCode <> 0
            BEGIN 
                GOTO QuitWithRollback;
            END
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  B.1.  Add the temporal events job.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
        SELECT 
            @jobDescription =   N'Forefront Identity Manager job to periodically evaluate temporal sets and policies, and maintain set and group memberships.',
            @jobName        =   @temporalEventsJobName,
            @scheduleName   =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@scheduleNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'TemporalEvents'),N'{1}',N'');
    
        IF  EXISTS 
        (
            SELECT [j].[job_id]
            FROM [msdb].[dbo].[sysjobs_view] AS [j] 
            WHERE    [j].[name] = @jobName
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_delete_job]
                @job_name               =   @jobName, 
                @delete_unused_schedule =   1;

            IF @@ERROR <> 0 
            OR @returnCode <> 0
            BEGIN
                GOTO QuitWithRollback;
            END
        END

        EXECUTE @returnCode =  [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_job] 
            @job_name               =   @jobName, 
            @enabled                =   1, 
            @notify_level_eventlog  =   0, 
            @notify_level_email     =   0, 
            @notify_level_netsend   =   0, 
            @notify_level_page      =   0, 
            @delete_level           =   0, 
            @description            =   @jobDescription, 
            @category_name          =   @categoryName, 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier OUTPUT;
            
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        OR @returnCode <> 0
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

		EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobstep] 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier, 
            @step_name              =   @validatePrimalReplicaStep, 
            @step_id                =   1, 
            @cmdexec_success_code   =   0, 
            @on_success_action      =   3,--Execute next step
            @on_success_step_id     =   2, 
            @on_fail_action         =   2,--Quit with failure 
            @on_fail_step_id        =   0, 
            @retry_attempts         =   0, 
            @retry_interval         =   0, 
            @os_run_priority        =   0, 
            @subsystem              =   N'TSQL', 
            @command                =   @validatePrimalReplicaCommand, 
            @database_name          =   @databaseName,
            @flags                  =   0;
        
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        OR @returnCode <> 0
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END
		
        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobstep] 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier, 
            @step_name              =   @triggerTemporalEventsStep, 
            @step_id                =   2, 
            @cmdexec_success_code   =   0, 
            @on_success_action      =   3,--Execute next step
            @on_success_step_id     =   3, 
            @on_fail_action         =   3,--Execute next step 
            @on_fail_step_id        =   3, 
            @retry_attempts         =   0, 
            @retry_interval         =   0, 
            @os_run_priority        =   0, 
            @subsystem              =   N'TSQL', 
            @command                =   @triggerTemporalEventsCommand, 
            @database_name          =   @databaseName,
            @flags                  =   0;
        
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        OR @returnCode <> 0
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END
        
        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobstep] 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier, 
            @step_name              =   @setMaintenanceStep, 
            @step_id                =   3, 
            @cmdexec_success_code   =   0, 
            @on_success_action      =   3,--Execute next step 
            @on_success_step_id     =   4, 
            @on_fail_action         =   2,--Quit with failure 
            @on_fail_step_id        =   0, 
            @retry_attempts         =   0, 
            @retry_interval         =   0, 
            @os_run_priority        =   0, 
            @subsystem              =   N'TSQL',

            @database_name          =   @databaseName,

        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        OR @returnCode <> 0
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END
        
        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobstep] 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier, 
            @step_name              =   @groupMaintenanceStep, 
            @step_id                =   4, 
            @cmdexec_success_code   =   0, 
            @on_success_action      =   3,--Execute next step
            @on_success_step_id     =   5, 
            @on_fail_action         =   2,--Quit with failure

        OR @returnCode <> 0

            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobserver]

        )
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

		EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobstep] 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier, 
            @step_name              =   @validatePrimalReplicaStep, 
            @step_id                =   1, 
            @cmdexec_success_code   =   0, 
            @on_success_action      =   3,--Execute next step
            @on_success_step_id     =   2, 
            @on_fail_action         =   2,--Quit with failure 
            @on_fail_step_id        =   0, 
            @retry_attempts         =   0, 
            @retry_interval         =   0, 
            @os_run_priority        =   0, 
            @subsystem              =   N'TSQL', 
            @command                =   @validatePrimalReplicaCommand, 
            @database_name          =   @databaseName,
            @flags                  =   0;
        
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        OR @returnCode <> 0
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END
		
        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobstep] 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier, 
            @step_name              =   @checkAndUpdateReportingJobStatusStep, 
            @step_id                =   2, 
            @cmdexec_success_code   =   0, 
            @on_success_action      =   1,-- Quit with success            
            @on_fail_action         =   2,-- Quit with failure             
            @retry_attempts         =   0, 
            @retry_interval         =   0, 
            @os_run_priority        =   0, 
            @subsystem              =   N'TSQL', 
            @command                =   @checkAndUpdateReportingJobStatusCommand, 
            @database_name          =   @databaseName,
            @flags                  =   0;
        
        IF 
        (
               @@ERROR <> 0 
            OR @returnCode <> 0
        )
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END      
        
        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_update_job] 
            @job_id         = @jobIdentifier, 
            @start_step_id  = 1
        
        IF 
        (
               @@ERROR <> 0 
            OR @returnCode <> 0
        )
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  I.2.  Schedule the check and update reporting job status job to run repeatedly every 35 minutes 
 *        starting at 12:00 am
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/              
        SELECT @scheduleName   =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@scheduleNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'CheckAndUpdateReportingJobStatus'),N'{1}',N'_1');
        IF  EXISTS 
        (
            SELECT [s].[schedule_id] 
            FROM [msdb].[dbo].[sysschedules] AS [s]
            WHERE [s].[name] = @scheduleName
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [msdb].[dbo].[sp_delete_schedule]
                @schedule_name  =   @scheduleName,
                @force_delete   =   1;
                
            IF @@ERROR <> 0 
            BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
            END
        END

        EXECUTE [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_schedule]
            @schedule_name        = @scheduleName,
            @freq_type            = 4, -- Run Daily
            @freq_interval        = 1, -- Run all days of the week
            @freq_subday_type     = 4, -- Run every few minutes
            @freq_subday_interval = 35, -- Interval between one run and another
            @active_start_time    = 000000; --12:00 am
        
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        BEGIN
        GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

        EXECUTE [msdb].[dbo].[sp_attach_schedule]
            @job_name       =   @jobName,
            @schedule_name  =   @scheduleName;
            
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  I.3.  Deploy the check and update reporting job status job onto the local server.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/              
        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobserver]
            @job_id = @jobIdentifier, 
            @server_name = N'(local)';
            
        IF
        (
                   @@ERROR <> 0 
            OR @returnCode <> 0
        )
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END  

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  J.1.  Add the deferred group evaluation job.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/            
        SELECT
            @jobDescription =   N'Forefront Identity Manager job to run evaluation of membership changes on the groups marked for deferred evaluation.',
            @jobIdentifier  =   NULL,
            @jobName        =   @deferredGroupEvaluationJobName;
    
        IF  EXISTS 
        (
            SELECT [j].[job_id]
            FROM [msdb].[dbo].[sysjobs_view] AS [j] 
            WHERE 
                    [j].[name] = @jobName
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_delete_job]
                @job_name               =   @jobName, 
                @delete_unused_schedule =   1;

            IF
                ( 
                       @@ERROR <> 0 
                OR @returnCode <> 0
                )
            BEGIN
                GOTO QuitWithRollback;
            END
        END

        EXECUTE @returnCode =  [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_job] 
            @job_name               =   @jobName, 
            @enabled                =   1, 
            @notify_level_eventlog  =   0, 
            @notify_level_email     =   0, 
            @notify_level_netsend   =   0, 
            @notify_level_page      =   0, 
            @delete_level           =   0, 
            @description            =   @jobDescription, 
            @category_name          =   @categoryName, 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier OUTPUT;
            
        IF 
        (
               @@ERROR <> 0 
            OR @returnCode <> 0
        )
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

		EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobstep] 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier, 
            @step_name              =   @validatePrimalReplicaStep, 
            @step_id                =   1, 
            @cmdexec_success_code   =   0, 
            @on_success_action      =   3,--Execute next step
            @on_success_step_id     =   2, 
            @on_fail_action         =   2,--Quit with failure 
            @on_fail_step_id        =   0, 
            @retry_attempts         =   0, 
            @retry_interval         =   0, 
            @os_run_priority        =   0, 
            @subsystem              =   N'TSQL', 
            @command                =   @validatePrimalReplicaCommand, 
            @database_name          =   @databaseName,
            @flags                  =   0;
        
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        OR @returnCode <> 0
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END
		
        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobstep] 
            @job_id                 =   @jobIdentifier, 
            @step_name              =   @deferredGroupEvaluationStep,
            @step_id                =   2, 
            @cmdexec_success_code   =   0, 
            @on_success_action      =   1,-- Quit with success            
            @on_fail_action         =   2,-- Quit with failure             
            @retry_attempts         =   0, 
            @retry_interval         =   0, 
            @os_run_priority        =   0, 
            @subsystem              =   N'TSQL', 
            @command                =   @deferredGroupEvaluationCommand, 
            @database_name          =   @databaseName,
            @flags                  =   0;
        
        IF 
        (
               @@ERROR <> 0 
            OR @returnCode <> 0
        )
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END      
        
        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_update_job] 
            @job_id         = @jobIdentifier, 
            @start_step_id  = 1
        
        IF 
        (
               @@ERROR <> 0 
            OR @returnCode <> 0
        )
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  J.2.  Schedule the deferred group evaluation job to run repeatedly every day 
 *      at 10:30 am, 10:30 pm
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/              
        SELECT @scheduleName   =   REPLACE(REPLACE(@scheduleNameTemplate,N'{0}',N'ScheduleDeferredGroupEvaluation'),N'{1}',N'_1');
        IF  EXISTS 
        (
            SELECT [s].[schedule_id] 
            FROM [msdb].[dbo].[sysschedules] AS [s]
            WHERE [s].[name] = @scheduleName
        )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [msdb].[dbo].[sp_delete_schedule]
                @schedule_name  =   @scheduleName,
                @force_delete   =   1;
                
            IF @@ERROR <> 0 
            BEGIN
                GOTO QuitWithRollback;
            END
        END

        EXECUTE [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_schedule]
            @schedule_name        = @scheduleName,
            @freq_type            = 4, -- Run Daily
            @freq_interval        = 1, -- Run all days of the week
            @freq_subday_type     = 8, -- Run every few hours
            @freq_subday_interval = 12,-- Interval between one run and another
            @active_start_time    = 103000; --10:30 am
        
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

        EXECUTE [msdb].[dbo].[sp_attach_schedule]
            @job_name       =   @jobName,
            @schedule_name  =   @scheduleName;
            
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  J.3.  Deploy the deferred group evaluation job onto the local server.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/              
        EXECUTE @returnCode = [msdb].[dbo].[sp_add_jobserver]
            @job_id = @jobIdentifier, 
            @server_name = N'(local)';
            
        IF
        (
                   @@ERROR <> 0 
            OR @returnCode <> 0
        )
        BEGIN
            GOTO QuitWithRollback;
        END

    COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
 GOTO EndSave
 
 QuitWithRollback:
    IF  @@TRANCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    END
    
    IF @@ERROR != 0
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR
            (
                'PostDeployment Script: AddStartSQLServerAgentJobs.sql failed to create or start the Forefront Identity Manager SQL Server Agent jobs.',
                16,
                1
            );
    END

    RETURN;

EndSave:

    IF @@ERROR <> 0 
    OR @returnCode <> 0
    BEGIN
        GOTO QuitWithRollback;
    END

END

RETURN 0
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [setup].[AdjustVersionText]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [setup].[AdjustVersionText]
    @oldVersion NVARCHAR(20),
    @newVersion NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;

    DECLARE 
        @activityInformationConfigurationObjectTypeKey  SMALLINT,
        @assemblyNameAttributeKey                       SMALLINT,
        @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey                SMALLINT,
        @xomlAttributeKey                               SMALLINT;
        
    SELECT 
        @activityInformationConfigurationObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'ActivityInformationConfiguration'),
        @assemblyNameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName] (N'AssemblyName'),
        @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'WorkflowDefinition'),
        @xomlAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'XOML');
        

    BEGIN TRANSACTION
        UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueString]
        SET [ValueString] = REPLACE([ValueString], @oldVersion, @newVersion)
        WHERE 
                [ObjectTypeKey] = @activityInformationConfigurationObjectTypeKey
            AND [AttributeKey] = @assemblyNameAttributeKey
            AND [ValueString] LIKE '%' + @oldVersion + '%';

        UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueText]
        SET [ValueText] = REPLACE([ValueText], @oldVersion, @newVersion)
        WHERE 
                [ObjectTypeKey] = @workflowDefinitionObjectTypeKey
            AND [AttributeKey]  = @xomlAttributeKey
            AND [ValueText] LIKE '%' + @oldVersion + '%';
            
        EXECUTE [fim].[DoRefreshWorkflowDefinitionCache];
    COMMIT TRANSACTION
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [setup].[ConfigureAdministrator]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [setup].[ConfigureAdministrator]
    @domainName         NVARCHAR(64),
    @accountName        NVARCHAR(256),
    @email              NVARCHAR(448),
    @securityIdentifier VARBINARY(85)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************


    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @domainConfigurationObjectKey   BIGINT;
    DECLARE @administratorObjectKey         BIGINT;

    DECLARE @accountNameAttributeKey        SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @displayNameAttributeKey        SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @domainAttributeKey             SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @emailAttributeKey              SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @mailNicknameAttributeKey       SMALLINT;
    DECLARE @objectSIDAttributeKey          SMALLINT;

    SET @accountNameAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'AccountName');
    SET @displayNameAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'DisplayName');
    SET @domainAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'Domain');
    SET @emailAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'Email');
    SET @mailNicknameAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'MailNickname');
    SET @objectSIDAttributeKey = [fim].AttributeKeyFromName(N'ObjectSID');

    SELECT @domainConfigurationObjectKey = [ovi].[ObjectKey] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
    WHERE [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] = CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,'1AFF46F4-5511-452D-BCBD-7F7B34B0FE14');

    SELECT @administratorObjectKey = [ovi].[ObjectKey] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [ovi]
    WHERE [ovi].[ValueIdentifier] = CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,'7fb2b853-24f0-4498-9534-4e10589723c4');    

    UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
    SET [ValueString] = @domainName
    WHERE 
    (
        [ObjectKey] = @domainConfigurationObjectKey
        AND
        (
            [AttributeKey] = @domainAttributeKey
            OR
            [AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
        )
    );

    UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
    SET [ValueString] = @accountName
    WHERE 
    (
        [ObjectKey] = @administratorObjectKey
        AND
        (
            [AttributeKey] = @accountNameAttributeKey
            OR
            [AttributeKey] = @displayNameAttributeKey
            OR
            [AttributeKey] = @mailNicknameAttributeKey
        )
    );

    UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
    SET [ValueString] = @domainName
    WHERE [ObjectKey] = @administratorObjectKey
    AND [AttributeKey] = @domainAttributeKey;

    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT AttributeID 
        FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
        WHERE 
                [ObjectKey] = @administratorObjectKey 
            AND [AttributeKey] = @emailAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueString] 
            SET [ValueString] = @email
        WHERE 
                [ObjectKey] = @administratorObjectKey
            AND [AttributeKey] = @emailAttributeKey;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[AddObjectValueString] 
            @objectKey      = @administratorObjectKey, 
            @attributeKey   = @emailAttributeKey, 
            @value          = @email;
    END


    UPDATE [fim].[ObjectValueBinary]  
    SET ValueBinary = @securityIdentifier
    WHERE [ObjectKey] = @administratorObjectKey
    AND [AttributeKey] = @objectSIDAttributeKey;

    INSERT INTO [fim].[UserSecurityIdentifiers]
    ( 
        UserObjectKey, 
        SecurityIdentifier 
    )
    VALUES
    ( 
        @administratorObjectKey, 
        @securityIdentifier 
    );
    
    INSERT INTO [fim].[DomainAndAccountName] 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [DomainAndAccountName] 
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @administratorObjectKey,
        @domainName + N'\' + @accountName 
    );
    
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [setup].[DeleteMembershipConditions]

    BEGIN TRY
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionStatementObject];
        DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestMembershipConditionObject];
        DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition_x_MembershipConditionStatement];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionDereferencedValue];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionNegativeStatement];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionObjectType];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionReferent];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementAttribute];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementString];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatementTruth];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartition];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[SetPartition];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionPartitioningStatement];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionStatement];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionIntegerValue];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionReferenceValue];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunctionStringValue];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionTabularFunction];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionFunctionValue];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[SetMembershipCondition];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[SetFilter];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionAttributeSignature];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipConditionImmutableAttribute];
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[MembershipCondition];    	
    	
	    DELETE FROM [fim].[Set]
	    WHERE
	    (
		    ([HasMembershipConditions] = 1)
	    );
	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [setup].[DeleteObject]
    @objectKey BIGINT 
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *

--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        EXECUTE [fim].[DeleteObject] @objectKey;

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [setup].[GetAllFilters]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [setup].[GetAllFilters]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    	
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [filter].[ObjectKey],
        [identifier].[ValueIdentifier],
        [filter].[ValueText]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] AS [filter]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [filterAttribute]
        ON [filter].[AttributeKey] = [filterAttribute].[Key]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [identifier]
        ON [filter].[ObjectKey] = [identifier].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE
            [filter].[SequenceID] = 0
        AND [filterAttribute].[Name] = N'Filter'
        AND [identifier].[AttributeKey] = 0
    ORDER BY [filter].[ObjectKey];
END
GO

AS

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [setup].[UpdateDatabaseVersion]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [setup].[UpdateDatabaseVersion]
    @Version INT,
    @BinaryVersion NVARCHAR(19) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE @currentVersion INT;
    
    SELECT TOP 1 @currentVersion = [Version]
    FROM [fim].[Version]
    ORDER BY [Version] DESC;

    IF @currentVersion IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [fim].[Version]
        SET [Version] = @Version,
            [BinaryVersion] = @BinaryVersion
        WHERE [Version]= @currentVersion
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [fim].[Version]
        (
            [Version],
            [BinaryVersion]
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @Version,
            @BinaryVersion
        );
    END
    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[AbortExportMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[AbortExportMessage]
    @messageIdentifier      NVARCHAR(448),
    @action                 NVARCHAR(448)
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey                          BIGINT,
        @exportMessageKey                   BIGINT,
        @mayRetry                           BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                        INT,
        @retryCount                         INT;   
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
        BEGIN TRANSACTION      
        
            SELECT @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();            
            SELECT @exportMessageKey = [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageKey](@exportKey, @messageIdentifier);
        
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoAbortExportMessage]
                @exportKey = @exportKey,
                @exportMessageKey = @exportMessageKey;
                
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[AbortExportUpdateMessage]
    @exportMessageKey       BIGINT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *

--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

        @retryCount                         INT;   
    
RetryPoint:

        BEGIN TRANSACTION      
        
            SELECT @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();
        
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoAbortExportMessage]
                @exportKey = @exportKey,
                @exportMessageKey = @exportMessageKey;

    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[AddExportRequest]
    @requestKey     BIGINT,
    @action         NVARCHAR(448)
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1; 
        
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey                  BIGINT,
        @exportMessageKey           BIGINT,
        @exportMessageTypeKey       SMALLINT,
        @messageIdentifier          NVARCHAR(448);
        
    SELECT @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();
    
    IF @exportKey IS NOT NULL

            INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportMessageRequest]
            (
                [ExportMessageKey],
                [RequestKey]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @exportMessageKey,
                @requestKey            
            );                
        END
    END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[ConcludeExport]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[ConcludeExport]
    @trace          BIT             = NULL
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0; 
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey                      BIGINT,
        @falseFlag                      BIT,
        @retryCount                     INT,
        @mayRetry                       BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                    INT,
        @startTime                      DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                       BIT;

    SELECT 
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    SELECT
        @mayRetry = @falseFlag,
        @mayRetryInt = 0,
        @retryCount = 3;        
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END        
        
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Initiate transaction
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        BEGIN TRANSACTION    
        
            SELECT @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();
            
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoConcludeExport]
                @exportKey = @exportKey;             
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Commit Transaction
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle exceptions
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    IF (@trace = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = 0, 
            @stage      = N'ConcludeExport';
    END

END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[CreateEvent]
    @exportKey      BIGINT  = NULL,
    @requestKey     BIGINT  = NULL,
    @eventKey       BIGINT  = NULL  OUTPUT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
   
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT @eventKey = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1; 
    
    
    IF
    (
            @exportKey IS NOT NULL
        OR  @requestKey IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [sync].[Event]
        DEFAULT VALUES;
        
        SELECT @eventKey = (SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY());
        
        IF @exportKey IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [sync].[EventExport]
            (
                [EventKey],
                [ExportKey]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @eventKey,
                @exportKey
            );
        END
        
        IF @requestKey IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [sync].[EventRequest]
            (
                [EventKey],
                [RequestKey]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @eventKey,
                @requestKey
            );
        END
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[CreateObject]
	@objectID			UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
	@objectTypeName		NVARCHAR(448)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0; 
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey                          BIGINT,
        @mayRetry                           BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                        INT,
        @objectKey                          BIGINT,
        @objectTypeKey                      SMALLINT,
        @retryCount                         INT;

    SELECT 
        @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey](),
        @objectTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](@objectTypeName);
         
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
        BEGIN TRANSACTION                
	         
            SELECT @objectKey = [fim].[ObjectKeyFromObjectIdentifier](@objectID);            

            IF (@objectKey IS NULL)
            BEGIN            
	           EXECUTE [fim].[AddObject]
                   @objectTypeKey = @objectTypeKey,
                   @objectID = @objectID OUTPUT,
                   @objectKey = @objectKey OUTPUT;                 
            END
     
            INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportNewObject]
            (
                [ExportKey],
                [ObjectKey]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @exportKey,
                @objectKey
            );
                
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DeleteObjectRequestLogByIdentifier]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DeleteObjectRequestLogByIdentifier]
	@requestLogIdentifier UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE 
        @deltaImportLogKey      BIGINT,
        @requestLogKey          BIGINT,
        @watermarkRequestLogKey BIGINT;
    
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey]
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportWatermark] AS [delta]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
            ON  [delta].[RequestLogKey] = [log].[RequestLogKey]
        WHERE   [delta].[RequestLogIdentifier] = @requestLogIdentifier
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT 
            @deltaImportLogKey = [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey],
            @watermarkRequestLogKey = [delta].[RequestLogKey]
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportWatermark] AS [delta]
        WHERE   [delta].[RequestLogIdentifier] = @requestLogIdentifier;
        
        SELECT @requestLogKey = MAX([delta].[RequestLogKey])
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportWatermark] AS [delta]
        WHERE       [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey] <= @deltaImportLogKey;
                
        DELETE [log]
        FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
        WHERE   
                [log].[RequestLogKey] <= @requestLogKey
            AND [log].[RequestLogKey] !=@watermarkRequestLogKey;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @requestLogKey = [log].[RequestLogKey] 
        FROM    [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
        WHERE   [log].[RequestLogIdentifier] = @requestLogIdentifier

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [log].[RequestLogKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
            WHERE   [log].[RequestLogKey] < @requestLogKey
        )    
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM [fim].[RequestLog]
            WHERE   [RequestLogKey] < @requestLogKey;
        END
    END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DeleteSynchronizationErrors]
    @trace                  BIT     = NULL
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0; 
    
    DECLARE 
        @falseFlag                      BIT,
        @retryCount                     INT,
        @mayRetry                       BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                    INT,
        @startTime                      DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                       BIT;

    SELECT 
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    SELECT
        @mayRetry = @falseFlag,
        @mayRetryInt = 0,
        @retryCount = 3;        
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END        
        
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Initiate transaction
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        BEGIN TRANSACTION    
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [error].[SynchronizationErrorKey]
                FROM [sync].[ObjectSynchronizationError] AS [error]

                DELETE FROM [sync].[ObjectSynchronizationError];
            END
            
            IF EXISTS

                SELECT [error].[SynchronizationErrorKey]
                FROM [sync].[SynchronizationError] AS [error]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM [sync].[SynchronizationError];
            END
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Commit Transaction
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle exceptions
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    IF (@trace = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = 0, 
            @stage      = N'RecordException';
    END
