/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DeltaImportGetNextObjects]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DeltaImportGetNextObjects]
    @requestLogIdentifier       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @maximumLogEntries          INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
    
    DECLARE 
        @defaultLocaleKey           INT,
        @offset                     BIGINT,
        @previousObjectKey          BIGINT,
        @requestLogStartKey         BIGINT,
        @requestLogEndKey           BIGINT,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;

    SELECT
        @defaultLocaleKey   = [fim].[GetDefaultLocaleKey](),
        @previousObjectKey  = -1,
        @trueFlag           = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    IF @maximumLogEntries IS NULL
    BEGIN 
        SELECT @maximumLogEntries = 1000;
    END
    
    -- Set the log window start point
    IF @requestLogIdentifier IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT 
            @requestLogStartKey = [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey],
            @previousObjectKey = [delta].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
        WHERE   [delta].[RequestLogIdentifier] = @requestLogIdentifier;
    END
    
    IF @requestLogStartKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @requestLogStartKey = MIN([delta].[DeltaImportLogKey]) 
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
        WHERE   [delta].[Export] = @trueFlag;
        
        SELECT @offset = 1;
    END    
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT @offset = 0;
    END

    -- If there is no starting point, there is nothing to do
    IF @requestLogStartKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RETURN; 
    END

    -- Determine the log window end point
    IF EXISTS 
    (
        SELECT [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey]
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
        WHERE 
                [delta].[Export] = @trueFlag
            AND [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey] = @requestLogStartKey + (@maximumLogEntries - @offset)
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @requestLogEndKey = @requestLogStartKey + (@maximumLogEntries - @offset);
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT @requestLogEndKey = MAX([delta].[DeltaImportLogKey]) 
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
        WHERE   [delta].[Export] = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    DECLARE @object TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]             [BIGINT]    NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey] ASC
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @objectLogEnd TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]             [BIGINT]    NOT NULL,
        [LastDeltaImportLogKey] [BIGINT]    NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey] ASC,
            [LastDeltaImportLogKey] ASC
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [log].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [log]
        WHERE
                [log].[Export] = @trueFlag
            AND [log].[DeltaImportLogKey] >= @requestLogStartKey
            AND [log].[DeltaImportLogKey] <= @requestLogEndKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @object
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [log].[ObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [log]
        WHERE
                [log].[Export] = @trueFlag
            AND [log].[DeltaImportLogKey] >= @requestLogStartKey
            AND [log].[DeltaImportLogKey] <= @requestLogEndKey;
      
        INSERT INTO @objectLogEnd
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [LastDeltaImportLogKey]
        )
        SELECT
            [log].[ObjectKey],
            MAX([log].[DeltaImportLogKey])
        FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [log]
        INNER JOIN @object AS [object]
            ON [log].[ObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
        GROUP BY
                [log].[ObjectKey];

        SELECT @requestLogEndKey = MAX([object].[LastDeltaImportLogKey])
        FROM @objectLogEnd AS [object]
        WHERE   
                [object].[ObjectKey] != @previousObjectKey
            AND [object].[LastDeltaImportLogKey] <= @requestLogEndKey;
        
        IF @requestLogEndKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT @requestLogEndKey = MIN([object].[LastDeltaImportLogKey])
            FROM @objectLogEnd AS [object]
            WHERE   [object].[ObjectKey] != @previousObjectKey;
        END
        
        IF @requestLogEndKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT @requestLogEndKey = MIN([object].[LastDeltaImportLogKey])
            FROM @objectLogEnd AS [object];
        END
    END
    
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey] ASC) AS [RequestLogSequence],   --Force sequential sequence values.
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey] DESC) AS [ReverseOrdering],     --Reverse order sequence supporting legacy MA code.    
        [delta].[RequestLogIdentifier],
        [delta].[RequestKey],
        [delta].[ObjectKey] as [Ordering],
        [delta].[ObjectKey],
        [delta].[ObjectID],
        [delta].[AttributeKey],
        [delta].[ValueBinary],
        [delta].[ValueBoolean],
        [delta].[ValueDateTime],
        [delta].[ValueInteger],
        [delta].[ValueReference] AS [ValueReferenceIdentifier],
        [delta].[ValueString],
        [delta].[ValueText],
        [delta].[ValueXML],
        @defaultLocaleKey AS [LocaleKey], --Provided to support callers 
        [delta].[EventTime],
        [delta].[Added],
        [delta].[Synchronized]
    FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
    WHERE 
            [delta].[Export] = @trueFlag
        AND [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey] >= @requestLogStartKey
        AND [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey] <= @requestLogEndKey
    ORDER BY 
            [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey];
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DeltaImportGetNextRequests]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DeltaImportGetNextRequests]
    @requestLogIdentifier       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @maximumLogEntries          INT = NULL
AS    
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
    
    DECLARE         
        @createdTimeKey             SMALLINT,
        @defaultLocaleKey           INT,
        @falseFlag                  BIT,
        @identifierAttributeKey     SMALLINT,        
        @requestLogBatchStartKey    BIGINT,
        @requestLogBatchEndKey      BIGINT,
        @requestLogStartKey         BIGINT;   

    SELECT                
        @createdTimeKey                 = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @defaultLocaleKey               = [fim].[GetDefaultLocaleKey](), 
        @falseFlag                      = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @identifierAttributeKey         = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @requestLogBatchStartKey        = NULL,
        @requestLogBatchEndKey          = NULL,
        @requestLogStartKey             = NULL;
        
    IF @maximumLogEntries IS NULL
    BEGIN 
        SELECT @maximumLogEntries = 1000;
    END    

    -- Set the log window start point
    IF @requestLogIdentifier IS NULL
    BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @requestLogStartKey = [log].[RequestLogKey],
            @requestLogIdentifier = [log].[RequestLogIdentifier] 
        FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
        ORDER BY [log].[RequestLogKey];
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT @requestLogStartKey = [log].[RequestLogKey] 
        FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
        WHERE [log].[RequestLogIdentifier] = @requestLogIdentifier;
    END

    -- If there is no starting point, there is nothing to do
    IF @requestLogStartKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RETURN; 
    END

    -- Setup Batch Parameters
    SELECT @requestLogBatchStartKey = @requestLogStartKey;

    -- Explicitly cache the request log window that we will work against.
    -- This is done for performance reasons.    
    DECLARE @requestLogWindow TABLE
    (       
        [RequestLogKey]             BIGINT,
        [Added]                     TINYINT,
        [AttributeKey]              SMALLINT,
        [ObjectKey]                 BIGINT,
        [ValueReference]            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER        
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [RequestLogKey]
        )
    );

    DECLARE @deletedRequestLogKeys  TABLE
    (
        [RequestLogKey]             BIGINT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [RequestLogKey]
        )
    );
    
    WHILE(1 = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @requestLogBatchEndKey = [log].[RequestLogKey]
        FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
        WHERE [log].[RequestLogKey] = @requestLogBatchStartKey + @maximumLogEntries - 1;

        IF @requestLogBatchEndKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @requestLogBatchEndKey = [log].[RequestLogKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
            ORDER BY [log].[RequestLogKey] DESC;
        END
      
        INSERT INTO @requestLogWindow
        (            
            [RequestLogKey],
            [Added],
            [AttributeKey],
            [ObjectKey],
            [ValueReference]            
        )
        SELECT             
            [log].[RequestLogKey],
            [log].[Added],
            [log].[AttributeKey],
            [log].[ObjectKey],
            [log].[ValueReference]            
        FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
        WHERE
                [log].[RequestLogKey] >= @requestLogBatchStartKey
            AND [log].[RequestLogKey] <= @requestLogBatchEndKey;

        INSERT INTO @deletedRequestLogKeys
        (
            [RequestLogKey]
        )
        SELECT [window].[RequestLogKey]
        FROM @requestLogWindow AS [window]         
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [createdTime]
            ON  [window].[ObjectKey] = [createdTime].[ObjectKey]              
            AND [createdTime].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeKey        
            AND [createdTime].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag                       -- created time attribute value is not multivalued, uses index defined on ObjectKey, AttributeKey
        WHERE [createdTime].[ObjectKey] IS NULL;

        -- Look for RequestLog.ValueReference = Deleted Object
        -- where RequestLog.RequestLogKey was not previously identified
        INSERT INTO @deletedRequestLogKeys
        (
            [RequestLogKey]
        )
        SELECT [window].[RequestLogKey]
        FROM @requestLogWindow AS [window]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueIdentifier] AS [o]
            ON [window].[ValueReference] = [o].[ValueIdentifier] 
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [createdTime]
            ON  [o].[ObjectKey] = [createdTime].[ObjectKey]             
            AND [createdTime].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeKey
            AND [createdTime].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag                       -- created time attribute value is not multivalued, uses index defined on ObjectKey, AttributeKey
        LEFT OUTER JOIN @deletedRequestLogKeys AS [deleted]
            ON [window].[RequestLogKey] = [deleted].[RequestLogKey] 
        WHERE
                [createdTime].[ObjectKey] IS NULL
            AND [deleted].[RequestLogKey] IS NULL;

        -- Look for deleted attributes
        INSERT INTO @deletedRequestLogKeys
        (
            [RequestLogKey]
        )
        SELECT [window].[RequestLogKey]
        FROM @requestLogWindow AS [window]          
        LEFT OUTER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [attributeInternal]
            ON  [window].[AttributeKey] = [attributeInternal].[Key] 
        LEFT OUTER JOIN @deletedRequestLogKeys AS [deleted]
            ON [window].[RequestLogKey] = [deleted].[RequestLogKey]              
        WHERE 
                [attributeInternal].[Key] IS NULL
            AND [deleted].[RequestLogKey] IS NULL;

        /*
        * The consumer of the output of this procedure expects two conditions to be met:
        *
        * 1. No rows should have [ValueReference] column values referring to deleted objects, except if the reference is the ObjectID attribute of the deleted object itself.  
        *    To satisfy this condition, the following code prunes the prospective results of references to deleted objects.  A deleted object is one with no CreatedTime attribute value.  
        *
        * 2. Returning only one row signifies that there are no more records in the [RequestLog] to be fetched.  
        *    To satisfy this condition, the following code ensures that, after pruning the prospective result of references to deleted objects, if only one row remains, then more 
        *    prospective results are retrieved, if there are any to be found.  
        */
        
        -- Delete all records from request log window that are already deleted        
        DELETE [window]
        FROM @requestLogWindow AS [window]
        INNER JOIN @deletedRequestLogKeys AS [deleted]
            ON [window].[RequestLogKey] = [deleted].[RequestLogKey]     
        WHERE
        (
                [window].[Added] = 1
            OR 
                (
                        [window].[AttributeKey] != @identifierAttributeKey      -- surface the object deletion
                    AND [window].[Added] = 0
                )
        )      
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [window].[RequestLogKey]
            FROM @requestLogWindow AS [window]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestLog] AS [rl]
                ON [window].[RequestLogKey] = [rl].[RequestLogKey]                       
            WHERE [window].[RequestLogKey] != @requestLogStartKey  -- not the watermark
        )
        BEGIN    
            BREAK; -- records found, come out of the loop
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- We need to examine the next batch of records in the log to determine if there are
            -- rows to be returned.
            -- Reset Temp tables
            DELETE @requestLogWindow
            WHERE [RequestLogKey] != @requestLogStartKey;  -- keep the original WaterMark.            
            DELETE @deletedRequestLogKeys;
                        
            -- Start next batch as the next record
            SELECT @requestLogBatchStartKey = NULL;
                        
            SELECT @requestLogBatchStartKey = [log].[RequestLogKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
            WHERE [log].[RequestLogKey] = @requestLogBatchEndKey + 1
            
            IF @requestLogBatchStartKey IS NULL
            BEGIN
                BREAK; -- end of records
            END            
            
            SELECT @requestLogBatchEndKey = NULL;            
        END
    END

    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [log].[RequestLogKey] ASC) AS [RequestLogSequence],   --Force sequential sequence values.
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [log].[RequestLogKey] DESC) AS [ReverseOrdering],     --Reverse order sequence supporting legacy MA code.    
        [log].[RequestLogIdentifier],
        [log].[RequestKey] as [Ordering],
        [log].[ObjectKey],
        [log].[ObjectID],
        [log].[AttributeKey],
        [log].[ValueBinary],
        [log].[ValueBoolean],
        [log].[ValueDateTime],
        [log].[ValueInteger],
        [log].[ValueReference] AS [ValueReferenceIdentifier],
        [log].[ValueString],
        [log].[ValueText],
        [log].[ValueXML],
        @defaultLocaleKey AS [LocaleKey], --Provided to support callers 
        [log].[EventTime],
        [log].[Added]
    FROM @requestLogWindow AS [window]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
        ON [window].[RequestLogKey] = [log].[RequestLogKey]   
    ORDER BY [log].[RequestLogKey];
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DetectInvalidExportMessageTargets]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DetectInvalidExportMessageTargets]
    @exportMessageKey       BIGINT,
    @action                 NVARCHAR(448),
    @retries                BIT = 0
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @mayRetry                           BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                        INT,
        @retryCount                         INT,
        @trueFlag                           BIT;   
        
    SELECT @trueFlag   = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
        BEGIN TRANSACTION      
        
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoDetectInvalidExportMessageTargets]
                @exportMessageKey           = @exportMessageKey,
                @action                     = @action,
                @retries                    = @retries;
                
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    
END

        @succeeded                  = @falseFlag,

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoClearExport]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoClearExport]
    @trace          BIT             = NULL
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1; 
    
    DECLARE 
        @falseFlag                      BIT,
        @startTime                      DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                       BIT;

    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END 
    
    DECLARE @eventExport TABLE
    (
        [EventKey]  BIGINT,
        [ExportKey] BIGINT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [EventKey],
            [ExportKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [eventExport].[EventKey]
        FROM [sync].[EventExport] AS [eventExport]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @eventExport
        (
            [EventKey],
            [ExportKey]
        )
        SELECT 
            [eventExport].[EventKey],
            [eventExport].[ExportKey]
        FROM [sync].[EventExport] AS [eventExport];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmission].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [transmission]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmission].[ExportMessageKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlation].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [correlation]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlation].[CorrelatedExportMessageKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlation].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [correlation]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlation].[ExportMessageKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlation].[RetriedExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [correlation]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlation].[RetriedExportMessageKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlation].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [correlation]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [correlation]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlation].[ExportMessageKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [itemMessage]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [target].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [target]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [target].[ExportMessageKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [request]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageRequest] AS [request]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [request].[ExportMessageKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [item].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportItemKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [itemMessage]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [item].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportItemKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completedMessage]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completedMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [completedMessage]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completedMessage]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completedMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
    END

    -- Delete any left over completed messages from previous export session which has no matching items in ExportMessage table
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [completedMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completedMessage]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [sync].[CompletedExportMessage];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sentMessage]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sentMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [sentMessage]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sentMessage]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [sentMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [message]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [message].[ExportKey]
    END
    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [buffer].[ExportKey]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [item].[ExportKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [completed].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completed]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
                ON  [completed].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
            INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
                ON  [item].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [completed]
            FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completed]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
                ON  [completed].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
            INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
                ON  [item].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [acknowledged]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
                ON  [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
            INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
                ON  [item].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [acknowledged]
            FROM [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [acknowledged]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
                ON  [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
            INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
                ON  [item].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [accepted].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [accepted]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
                ON  [accepted].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
            INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
                ON  [item].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [accepted]
            FROM [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [accepted]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
                ON  [accepted].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
            INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
                ON  [item].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
        END
    
        DELETE [item]
        FROM @eventExport AS [buffer]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
            ON  [buffer].[ExportKey] = [item].[ExportKey]
    END   
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [item].[ExportKey]
        FROM [sync].[SentExportItemAcknowledgement] AS [item]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [item].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
        
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [item]
        FROM [sync].[SentExportItemAcknowledgement] AS [item]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [item].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    END 
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [eventExport].[ExportKey]
        FROM [sync].[EventExport] AS [eventExport]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [eventExport].[EventKey] = [buffer].[EventKey]
            AND  [eventExport].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [eventExport]
        FROM [sync].[EventExport] AS [eventExport]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [eventExport].[EventKey] = [buffer].[EventKey]
            AND  [eventExport].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [object].[ExportKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportNewObject] AS [object]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [object].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [object]
        FROM [sync].[ExportNewObject] AS [object]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [object].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [export].[ExportKey]
        FROM [sync].[AbortedExport] AS [export]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [export].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [export]
        FROM [sync].[AbortedExport] AS [export]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [export].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [export].[ExportKey]
        FROM [sync].[ConcludedExport] AS [export]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [export].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [export]
        FROM [sync].[ConcludedExport] AS [export]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [export].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [export].[ExportKey]
        FROM [sync].[Export] AS [export]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [export].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [export]
        FROM [sync].[Export] AS [export]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [export].[ExportKey] = [buffer].[ExportKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [event].[EventKey]
        FROM [sync].[Event] AS [event]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [event].[EventKey] = [buffer].[EventKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [event]
        FROM [sync].[Event] AS [event]
        INNER JOIN @eventExport AS [buffer]
            ON  [event].[EventKey] = [buffer].[EventKey]
    END
   
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [error].[SynchronizationErrorKey]
        FROM [sync].[ObjectSynchronizationError] AS [error]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [sync].[ObjectSynchronizationError];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [error].[SynchronizationErrorKey]
        FROM [sync].[SynchronizationError] AS [error]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [sync].[SynchronizationError]
    END

    EXECUTE [sync].[ReseedExportMessage];
    EXECUTE [sync].[ReseedExportItem];
           
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = 0, 
            @stage      = N'DoClearExport';
    END

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoCorrelateExportMessages]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoCorrelateExportMessages]
    @messageIdentifiers             XML(CONTENT [fim].[StringSchemaCollection]),
    @correlatedMessageIdentifier    NVARCHAR(448),
    @correlatedMessageAction        NVARCHAR(448),
    @completes                      BIT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey              BIGINT,
        @correlatedMessageKey   BIGINT,
        @messageKey             BIGINT,
        @messageTypeKey         SMALLINT,
        @trueFlag               BIT;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    SELECT @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();
    
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageKey]
        @exportKey              = @exportKey,
        @messageIdentifier      = @correlatedMessageIdentifier,
        @action                 = @correlatedMessageAction,
        @exportMessageTypeKey   = @messageTypeKey OUTPUT,
        @exportMessageKey       = @correlatedMessageKey OUTPUT;
    
    DECLARE @messageIdentifier TABLE
    (
        [MessageIdentifier] NVARCHAR(448)   NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [MessageIdentifier]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @sourceMessage TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]  BIGINT          NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @item TABLE
    (
        [ExportItemKey]  BIGINT             NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @target TABLE
    (
        [TargetObjectKey]   BIGINT          NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
    )
    
    INSERT INTO @messageIdentifier
    (
        [MessageIdentifier]
    )
    SELECT [identifier].[value]('.[1]', 'NVARCHAR(448)') AS [item]
    FROM @messageIdentifiers.nodes('/v') Identifiers(identifier);
    
    INSERT INTO @sourceMessage
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
    INNER JOIN @messageIdentifier AS [identifier]
        ON  [message].[MessageIdentifier] = [identifier].[MessageIdentifier];    
        
    INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage]
    (
        [ExportMessageKey],
        [CorrelatedExportMessageKey]
    )       
    SELECT 
        [source].[ExportMessageKey],
        @correlatedMessageKey
    FROM    @sourceMessage AS [source];
    
        
    INSERT INTO @item
    (
        [ExportItemKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [item].[ExportItemKey]
    FROM @sourceMessage AS [source]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
        ON  [source].[ExportMessageKey] = [item].[ExportMessageKey];
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM @item AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [duplicate].[ExportItemKey]
        WHERE       [duplicate].[ExportMessageKey] = @correlatedMessageKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [item]
        FROM @item AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [duplicate].[ExportItemKey]
        WHERE       [duplicate].[ExportMessageKey] = @correlatedMessageKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM @item AS [item]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportItemMessage]
        (
            [ExportItemKey],
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [item].[ExportItemKey],
            @correlatedMessageKey
        FROM @item AS [item];
    END
    
    INSERT INTO @target
    (
        [TargetObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
    FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
    INNER JOIN @sourceMessage AS [source]
        ON  [target].[ExportMessageKey] = [source].[ExportMessageKey];
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [duplicate].[TargetObjectKey]
        WHERE       [duplicate].[ExportMessageKey] = @correlatedMessageKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [target]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [duplicate].[TargetObjectKey]
        WHERE       [duplicate].[ExportMessageKey] = @correlatedMessageKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @target AS [target]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportMessageTarget]
        (
            [ExportMessageKey],
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT
            @correlatedMessageKey,
            [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @target AS [target];
    END
    
    IF @completes = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [sync].[CompletedExportMessage]
        (
            [ExportMessageKey],
            [Succeeded],
            [SynchronizationErrorKey]
        )
        SELECT 
            [source].[ExportMessageKey],
            @trueFlag,
            NULL
        FROM @sourceMessage AS [source];
    END
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoDeleteExportMessageTransmission]
    @messageIdentifier                      NVARCHAR(448)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1; 
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [transmission].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [transmission].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       [message].[MessageIdentifier] = @messageIdentifier
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [transmission]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [transmission].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       [message].[MessageIdentifier] = @messageIdentifier;
    END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoDetectInvalidExportMessageTargets]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoDetectInvalidExportMessageTargets]
    @exportMessageKey       BIGINT,
    @action                 NVARCHAR(448),
    @retries                BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1; 
    
    DECLARE 
        @acquiredLock                   SMALLINT,
        @createdTimeAttributeKey        SMALLINT,
        @exportMessageTypeKey           SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                      BIT,
        @index                          BIGINT,
        @limit                          BIGINT,
        @messageIdentifier              NVARCHAR(448),
        @messageText                    NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @resourceName                   NVARCHAR(32),
        @trueFlag                       BIT;
    
    SELECT 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @exportMessageTypeKey = [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageTypeKey](@action),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @resourceName = N'ExportMessageCompletionLock',
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    DECLARE @target TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]	BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
    );

    DECLARE @result TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]	BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
    );

    DECLARE @item TABLE
    (
        [ExportItemKey]     BIGINT  NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
    );  
    
    DECLARE @failedMessage TABLE
    (
        [Index]             BIGINT          NOT NULL    IDENTITY(1,1),
        [ExportItemKey]     BIGINT          NOT NULL,
        [ExportMessageKey]  BIGINT          NOT NULL,
        [MessageIdentifier] NVARCHAR(448)   NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [Index]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @failedMessageKey TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]  BIGINT          NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @interimMessageKey TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]  BIGINT          NOT NULL,
        [TargetCount]       BIGINT          NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    ); 
    
    DECLARE @finalMessageKey TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]  BIGINT          NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    ); 
    
    IF EXISTS 
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
        WHERE       [target].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @target
        (
            [ObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
        WHERE       [target].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
    END

    IF @retries = @falseFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [target].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[ObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectkey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @result
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [target].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[ObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectkey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag;
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [message].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[ObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectkey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @finalMessageKey
            (
                [ExportMessageKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[ObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectkey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag;
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [target].[ExportMessageKey]
                FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
                INNER JOIN @finalMessageKey AS [final]
                    ON  [target].[ExportMessageKey] = [final].[ExportMessageKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @interimMessageKey
                (
                    [ExportMessageKey],
                    [TargetCount]
                    
                )
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    [target].[ExportMessageKey],
                    COUNT([target].[TargetObjectKey])
                FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
                INNER JOIN @finalMessageKey AS [final]
                    ON  [target].[ExportMessageKey] = [final].[ExportMessageKey] 
                GROUP BY        [target].[ExportMessageKey];
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
                FROM @interimMessageKey AS [candidate]
                WHERE       [candidate].[TargetCount] <= 1
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM @interimMessageKey AS [candidate]
                WHERE       [candidate].[TargetCount] <= 1;
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
                FROM @interimMessageKey AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [retry]
                    ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [retry].[ExportMessageKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [candidate]
                FROM @interimMessageKey AS [candidate]
                INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [retry]
                    ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [retry].[ExportMessageKey];
            END
            
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [final].[ExportMessageKey]
                FROM @finalMessageKey AS [final]
                INNER JOIN @interimMessageKey AS [interim]                
                    ON  [final].[ExportMessageKey] = [interim].[ExportMessageKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [final]
                FROM @finalMessageKey AS [final]
                INNER JOIN @interimMessageKey AS [interim]
                    ON  [final].[ExportMessageKey] = [interim].[ExportMessageKey]
            END
        END
    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [target].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[ObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectkey]
            INNER JOIN @finalMessageKey AS [final]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [final].[ExportMessageKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @result
            (
                [ObjectKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [target].[ObjectKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[ObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectkey]
            INNER JOIN @finalMessageKey AS [final]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [final].[ExportMessageKey];
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [result].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @result AS [result]
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                @Resource = @resourceName,
                @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
                
        IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @resourceName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
            RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [item].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
            WHERE       [item].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @item
            (
                [ExportItemKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [item].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
            WHERE       [item].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [completed].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM @item AS [item]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completed]
                ON      [item].[ExportItemKey] = [completed].[ExportItemKey] 
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [item]
            FROM @item AS [item]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completed]
                ON      [item].[ExportItemKey] = [completed].[ExportItemKey];
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [item].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
            INNER JOIN @item AS [base]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [base].[ExportItemKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
                ON  [item].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [target].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN @result AS [result]
                ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [result].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKey
                AND [item].[Primary] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @failedMessage
            (
                [ExportItemKey],
                [ExportMessageKey],
                [MessageIdentifier]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [item].[ExportItemKey],
                [message].[ExportMessageKey],
                [message].[MessageIdentifier]			
            FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
            INNER JOIN @item AS [base]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [base].[ExportItemKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
                ON  [item].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [target].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN @result AS [result]
                ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [result].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKey
                AND [item].[Primary] = @trueFlag;
                
            INSERT INTO @failedMessageKey
            (
                [ExportMessageKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT [failed].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @failedMessage AS [failed];
                
            INSERT INTO [sync].[CompletedExportItem]
            (
                [ExportItemKey],
                [MessageIdentifier]
            ) 
            SELECT 
                [item].[ExportItemKey],
                [item].[MessageIdentifier]
            FROM @failedMessage AS [item];
            
            UPDATE [sync].[CompletedExportMessage]
            SET [Succeeded] = @falseFlag
            FROM [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [message]
            INNER JOIN @failedMessageKey AS [failed]
                ON	[message].[ExportMessageKey] = [failed].[ExportMessageKey];
            
            SELECT @limit = MAX([failedMessage].[Index])
            FROM @failedMessage AS [failedMessage];
            
            SELECT @index = 1;
            WHILE(@index <= @limit)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageIdentifier = [failedMessage].[MessageIdentifier]
                FROM @failedMessage AS [failedMessage]
                WHERE   [failedMessage].[Index] = @index;
                
                EXECUTE [sync].[DoSendExportResponseMessage]
                    @messageIdentifier          =   @messageIdentifier,
                    @succeeded                  =   @falseFlag;
            
                SELECT @index = @index + 1;
            END
        END
        
        DELETE [message]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN @result AS [invalidTarget]
            ON  [message].[TargetObjectKey] = [invalidTarget].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE       [message].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey;
    END
    
    SELECT DISTINCT [object].[ObjectID]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
    INNER JOIN @result AS [result]
        ON  [object].[ObjectKey] = [result].[ObjectKey];
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoRecordExportItemAcknowledgement]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoRecordExportItemAcknowledgement]
    @exportSessionIdentifier    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @initialSequenceNumber      BIGINT,
    @finalSequenceNumber        BIGINT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @acquiredLock               SMALLINT,
        @exportKey                  BIGINT,
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @resourceName               NVARCHAR(64); 
        
    SELECT @exportKey = [export].[ExportKey]
    FROM [sync].[Export] AS [export]
    WHERE       [export].[ExportSessionIdentifier] = @exportSessionIdentifier;
    
    SELECT @resourceName = N'DoRecordExportItemAcknowledgement';
    
    EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                @Resource = @resourceName,
                @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
                
    IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @resourceName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
    
    DECLARE @item TABLE
    (
        [ExportItemKey]	BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        WHERE
                [item].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
            AND [item].[SequenceNumber] >= @initialSequenceNumber
            AND [item].[SequenceNumber] <= @finalSequenceNumber
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @item
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        WHERE
                [item].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
            AND [item].[SequenceNumber] >= @initialSequenceNumber
            AND [item].[SequenceNumber] <= @finalSequenceNumber;
    END
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM @item AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [duplicate].[ExportItemKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [item]
        FROM @item AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [duplicate].[ExportItemKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM @item AS [item]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem]
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
        SELECT [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM @item AS [item];
    END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoRecordExportMessage]
    @exportKey              BIGINT,
    @messageIdentifier      NVARCHAR(448),
    @action                 NVARCHAR(448),
    @message                XML,
    @exportMessageKey       BIGINT          = NULL  OUTPUT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @messageTypeKey   SMALLINT;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageKey]
        @exportKey              = @exportKey,
        @messageIdentifier      = @messageIdentifier,
        @action                 = @action,
        @exportMessageTypeKey   = @messageTypeKey OUTPUT,
        @exportMessageKey       = @exportMessageKey OUTPUT;
        
    EXECUTE [sync].[DoDeleteExportMessageTransmission] @messageIdentifier;
        
    INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] 
    (
        [ExportMessageKey],
        [Message]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @exportMessageKey,
        @message
    );
        
            
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoRecordExportMessageCompletion]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoRecordExportMessageCompletion]
    @messageIdentifier          NVARCHAR(448),
    @succeeded                  BIT,
    @synchronizationErrorKey    BIGINT = NULL
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @acquiredLock               SMALLINT,
        @exportKey                  BIGINT,
        @exportMessageKey           BIGINT,
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @resourceName               NVARCHAR(32),
        @trueFlag                   BIT;        
    
    SELECT 
        @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey](),
        @exportMessageKey = [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageKey](@exportKey,@messageIdentifier),
        @resourceName = N'ExportMessageCompletionLock',
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);

    IF 
            @exportMessageKey IS NULL
        OR  EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
                FROM [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                WHERE   [completed].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
            )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    INSERT INTO [sync].[CompletedExportMessage]
    (
        [ExportMessageKey],
        [Succeeded],
        [SynchronizationErrorKey]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @exportMessageKey,
        @succeeded,
        @synchronizationErrorKey
    );
        
    EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                @Resource = @resourceName,
                @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
                
    IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @resourceName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
        
    DECLARE @item TABLE
    (
        [ExportItemKey] BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @itemMessage TABLE
    (
        [ExportItemKey]     BIGINT NOT NULL,
        [ExportMessageKey]  BIGINT NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportItemKey],
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
        WHERE   [item].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
    )
    BEGIN    
        INSERT INTO @item
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
        WHERE   [item].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey;
        
        IF @succeeded = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @itemMessage
            (
                [ExportItemKey],
                [ExportMessageKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT 
                [message].[ExportItemKey],
                [message].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [message]
            INNER JOIN @item AS [item]
                ON  [message].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey];
                
            DELETE [message]
            FROM @itemMessage AS [message]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey];
                
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 [item].[ExportItemKey]
                FROM @item AS [item]
                INNER JOIN @itemMessage AS [incomplete]
                    ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [incomplete].[ExportItemKey]
            )
            BEGIN
                DELETE [item]
                FROM @item AS [item]
                INNER JOIN @itemMessage AS [incomplete]
                    ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [incomplete].[ExportItemKey];
            END
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 [item].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM @item AS [item]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [duplicate]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [duplicate].[ExportItemKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [item]
            FROM @item AS [item]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [duplicate]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [duplicate].[ExportItemKey];
        END
    END 
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM @item AS [item]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [sync].[CompletedExportItem]
        (
            [ExportItemKey],
            [MessageIdentifier]
        ) 
        SELECT 
            [item].[ExportItemKey],
            @messageIdentifier
        FROM @item AS [item];
    END   
END
