/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoRecoverExport]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoRecoverExport]
    @exportKey              BIGINT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @falseFlag          BIT,
        @index              BIGINT,
        @limit              BIGINT,
        @messageIdentifier  NVARCHAR(448),
        @trueFlag           BIT;        
        
    SELECT
        @falseFlag  =   CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag   =   CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    IF [sync].[HasExportAborted]() = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [sync].[DoClearExport];
        
        RETURN;
    END
    
    INSERT INTO [sync].[AbortedExport]
    (
        [ExportKey]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @exportKey
    );
    
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [concluded].[ExportKey]
        FROM [sync].[ConcludedExport] AS [concluded]
        WHERE       [concluded].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [sync].[DoConcludeExport] 
            @exportKey = @exportKey;
    END
    
--Find any messages that were never transmitted, 
--and report the failure of the Synchronization Service calls by which they were initiated. 
 
--There are two cases of such messages:
--1.    Messages that are neither transmitted themselves, nor correlated with messages that might have been transmitted.
--2.    Messages that are not correlated with messages that might have been transmitted.  

    DECLARE @incompleteMessage TABLE
    (
        [Index]                 BIGINT              IDENTITY(1,1),
        [ExportMessageKey]      BIGINT              NOT NULL,
        [MessageIdentifier]     NVARCHAR(448)       NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [Index],
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @incompleteItemMessage TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]      BIGINT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @incompleteCorrelatedMessage TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]      BIGINT
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
            ON  [message].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [accepted]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [accepted].[ExportItemKey]
        WHERE   [item].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @incompleteItemMessage
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )        
        SELECT DISTINCT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
            ON  [message].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [accepted]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [accepted].[ExportItemKey]
        WHERE   [item].[ExportKey] = @exportKey;
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @incompleteItemMessage AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
                ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmission].[ExportMessageKey]            
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM @incompleteItemMessage AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
                ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmission].[ExportMessageKey]     
        END
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @incompleteItemMessage AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlated]
                ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlated].[ExportMessageKey]            
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM @incompleteItemMessage AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlated]
                ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlated].[ExportMessageKey];
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlated]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlated].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE   [message].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @incompleteCorrelatedMessage
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )        
        SELECT DISTINCT [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlated]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlated].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE   [message].[ExportKey] = @exportKey;
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @incompleteCorrelatedMessage AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
                ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmission].[ExportMessageKey]            
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM @incompleteCorrelatedMessage AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
                ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmission].[ExportMessageKey]     
        END
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @incompleteCorrelatedMessage AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlated]
                ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlated].[ExportMessageKey]            
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [candidate]
            FROM @incompleteCorrelatedMessage AS [candidate]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage_x_ExportMessage] AS [correlated]
                ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [correlated].[ExportMessageKey];
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @incompleteItemMessage AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @incompleteMessage
        (
            [ExportMessageKey],
            [MessageIdentifier]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [candidate].[ExportMessageKey],
            [message].[MessageIdentifier]
        FROM @incompleteItemMessage AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @incompleteCorrelatedMessage AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN @incompleteMessage AS [duplicate]
            ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [duplicate].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [duplicate]
        FROM @incompleteMessage AS [duplicate]
        INNER JOIN @incompleteCorrelatedMessage AS [candidate]
            ON  [duplicate].[ExportMessageKey] = [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [candidate].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @incompleteCorrelatedMessage AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @incompleteMessage
        (
            [ExportMessageKey],
            [MessageIdentifier]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [candidate].[ExportMessageKey],
            [message].[MessageIdentifier]
        FROM @incompleteCorrelatedMessage AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [candidate].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [incomplete].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @incompleteMessage AS [incomplete]
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT @limit = MAX([incomplete].[Index])
        FROM @incompleteMessage AS [incomplete];
        
        SELECT @index = 1;
        
        WHILE @index <= @limit
        BEGIN
            SELECT @messageIdentifier = [incomplete].[MessageIdentifier]
            FROM @incompleteMessage AS [incomplete]
            WHERE   [incomplete].[Index] = @index;
            
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoRecordExportMessageCompletion]
                @messageIdentifier          =   @messageIdentifier,
                @succeeded                  =   @falseFlag,
                @synchronizationErrorKey    =   NULL;
            
            SELECT @index = @index + 1;
        END
    END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoRetryExportMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoRetryExportMessage]
    @exportMessageKey           BIGINT,
    @originalMessageIdentifier  NVARCHAR(448),
    @targetIdentifier           UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @acquiredLock                   SMALLINT,
        @exportKey                      BIGINT,
        @falseFlag                      BIT,
        @messageText                    NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @originalExportMessageKey       BIGINT,        
        @resourceName                   NVARCHAR(32),
        @trueFlag                       BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey](),
        @resourceName = N'ExportMessageCompletionLock',
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    SELECT @originalExportMessageKey = [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageKey](@exportKey, @originalMessageIdentifier); 
    
    EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                @Resource = @resourceName,
                @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
                
    IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @resourceName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
    
    DECLARE @candidateItem TABLE
    (
        [ExportItemKey]     BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @exportItem TABLE
    (
        [ExportItemKey]     BIGINT,
        [TargetObjectKey]   BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
        WHERE       [item].[ExportMessageKey] = @originalExportMessageKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @candidateItem
        (
            [ExportItemKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
        WHERE       [item].[ExportMessageKey] = @originalExportMessageKey;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [item].[ExportItemKey]
        FROM @candidateItem AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
            ON  [candidate].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
            ON  [item].[ExportMessageKey] = [target].[ExportMessageKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE        
                [item].[Primary] = @trueFlag
            AND [object].[ObjectID] = @targetIdentifier
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @exportItem
        (
            [ExportItemKey],
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [item].[ExportItemKey],
            [object].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @candidateItem AS [candidate]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
            ON  [candidate].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
            ON  [item].[ExportMessageKey] = [target].[ExportMessageKey]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [object].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE        
                [item].[Primary] = @trueFlag
            AND [object].[ObjectID] = @targetIdentifier;
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [item].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [item]
            INNER JOIN @exportItem AS [affected]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [affected].[ExportItemKey]         
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [item]
            FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [item]
            INNER JOIN @exportItem AS [affected]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [affected].[ExportItemKey]
        END
            
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [item].[ExportItemKey]
            FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
            INNER JOIN @exportItem AS [affected]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [affected].[ExportItemKey]
            WHERE       [item].[ExportMessageKey] = @originalExportMessageKey            
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [item]
            FROM [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [item]
            INNER JOIN @exportItem AS [affected]
                ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [affected].[ExportItemKey]
            WHERE       [item].[ExportMessageKey] = @originalExportMessageKey   
        END
        
        INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportItemMessage]
        (
            [ExportItemKey],
            [ExportMessageKey],
            [Primary]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [ExportItemKey],
            @exportMessageKey,
            @falseFlag
        FROM @exportItem AS [item];  
        
        INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportMessageTarget]
        (
            [ExportMessageKey],
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            @exportMessageKey,
            [object].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @exportItem AS [object];     
    END
    
    INSERT INTO [sync].[RetriedExportMessage]
    (
        [ExportMessageKey],
        [RetriedExportMessageKey]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @exportMessageKey,
        @originalExportMessageKey
    );
        
            
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoSendExportItemAcknowledgement]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoSendExportItemAcknowledgement]
    @exportKey                  BIGINT,
    @initialSequenceNumber      BIGINT,
    @finalSequenceNumber        BIGINT,
    @retries                    BIT         = 0
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @acquiredLock               SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                  BIT,
        @messageText                NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @resourceName               NVARCHAR(64),
        @trueFlag                   BIT; 
    
    SELECT 
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @resourceName = N'DoSendExportItemAcknowledgementLock',
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                @Resource = @resourceName,
                @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
                
    IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @resourceName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
    
    
    DECLARE @number TABLE
    (
        [SequenceNumber]	BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [SequenceNumber]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @target TABLE
    (
        [TargetObjectKey]	BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @error TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]	                BIGINT NOT NULL,
        [SynchronizationErrorKey]   BIGINT NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [SynchronizationErrorKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [item].[SequenceNumber]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        WHERE
                [item].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
            AND [item].[SequenceNumber] >= @initialSequenceNumber
            AND [item].[SequenceNumber] <= @finalSequenceNumber
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @number
        (
            [SequenceNumber]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [item].[SequenceNumber]
        FROM [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        WHERE
                [item].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
            AND [item].[SequenceNumber] >= @initialSequenceNumber
            AND [item].[SequenceNumber] <= @finalSequenceNumber;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [item].[SequenceNumber]
        FROM @number AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportItemAcknowledgement] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [item].[SequenceNumber] = [duplicate].[SequenceNumber]
        WHERE       [duplicate].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [item]
        FROM @number AS [item]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportItemAcknowledgement] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [item].[SequenceNumber] = [duplicate].[SequenceNumber]
        WHERE       [duplicate].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
    END 
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [number].[SequenceNumber]
        FROM @number AS [number]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
            ON  [number].[SequenceNumber] = [item].[SequenceNumber]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [message].[ExportItemKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [target].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       [message].[Primary] = @trueFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @target
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @number AS [number]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
            ON  [number].[SequenceNumber] = [item].[SequenceNumber]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [message].[ExportItemKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [target].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       [message].[Primary] = @trueFlag;
    END
    
    IF @retries = @falseFlag
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       
                    [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag
                AND [completed].[SynchronizationErrorKey] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @error
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [SynchronizationErrorKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [target].[TargetObjectKey],
                [completed].[SynchronizationErrorKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       
                    [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag
                AND [completed].[SynchronizationErrorKey] IS NOT NULL;
                    
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [retried]
                ON  [completed].[ExportMessageKey] = [retried].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       
                    [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag
                AND [completed].[SynchronizationErrorKey] IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @error
            (
                [ObjectKey],
                [SynchronizationErrorKey]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [target].[TargetObjectKey],
                [completed].[SynchronizationErrorKey]
            FROM @target AS [target]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
                ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
                ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [retried]
                ON  [completed].[ExportMessageKey] = [retried].[ExportMessageKey]
            WHERE       
                    [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag
                AND [completed].[SynchronizationErrorKey] IS NOT NULL;
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [error].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @error AS [error]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ObjectSynchronizationError] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [error].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            AND [error].[SynchronizationErrorKey] = [duplicate].[SynchronizationErrorKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [error]
        FROM @error AS [error]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ObjectSynchronizationError] AS [duplicate]
            ON  [error].[ObjectKey] = [duplicate].[ObjectKey]
            AND [error].[SynchronizationErrorKey] = [duplicate].[SynchronizationErrorKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 [error].[ObjectKey]
        FROM @error AS [error]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [sync].[ObjectSynchronizationError]
        (
            [ObjectKey],
            [SynchronizationErrorKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            [error].[ObjectKey],
            [error].[SynchronizationErrorKey]
        FROM @error AS [error];
    END    
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [item].[SequenceNumber]
        FROM @number AS [item]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [sync].[SentExportItemAcknowledgement]
        (
            [ExportKey],
            [SequenceNumber]
        )
        SELECT
            @exportKey,
            [item].[SequenceNumber]
        FROM @number AS [item];
    END
    
    SELECT [item].[SequenceNumber]
    FROM @number AS [item];
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoSendExportResponseMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoSendExportResponseMessage]
    @messageIdentifier          NVARCHAR(448),
    @succeeded                  BIT,
    @synchronizationErrorKey    BIGINT = NULL
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE    
        @conversationHandle                 UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @queuedMessage                      NVARCHAR(MAX);
                
    ;WITH XMLNAMESPACES
    (
        DEFAULT 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/2006/11/ResourceManagement'
    )
    SELECT @queuedMessage =
        ( 
            SELECT 
            N'',                    
            (
                SELECT
                    @messageIdentifier AS [ExportMessageIdentifier],
                    @succeeded AS [Succeeded],
                    @synchronizationErrorKey AS [SynchronizationErrorKey]
                FOR XML PATH (N'Acknowlegement'), TYPE
            )
            FOR XML PATH (N'ExportResponse')
        );  

    BEGIN DIALOG CONVERSATION @conversationHandle
        FROM SERVICE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/ExportResponseInitiator]
        TO SERVICE '//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/ExportResponseReceiver'
        ON CONTRACT [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Contract/ExportResponse]
        WITH ENCRYPTION = OFF;
    SEND ON CONVERSATION @conversationHandle
        MESSAGE TYPE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Message/ExportResponse]
        (@queuedMessage);
    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoSendExportUpdateMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoSendExportUpdateMessage]
    @exportKey                      BIGINT,
    @action                         NVARCHAR(448),
    @exportMessageKey               BIGINT,
    @pendingTargetCount             BIGINT  OUTPUT,
    @invalidTargetCount             BIGINT  OUTPUT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey        SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                      BIT;
    
    SELECT
        @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @pendingTargetCount = 0,
        @invalidTargetCount = 0;
    
    DECLARE @target TABLE
    (
        [TargetObjectKey]       BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @failedMessage TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]      BIGINT NOT NULL,
        [TargetObjectKey]       BIGINT NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey],
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @invalidTarget TABLE
    (
        [TargetObjectKey]       BIGINT NOT NULL
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
        WHERE       [target].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @target
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
        WHERE       [target].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @failedMessage
        (
            [TargetObjectKey],
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            [target].[TargetObjectKey],
            [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [message]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [message].[TargetObjectKey]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
            ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       [completed].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag;
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [failed].[ExportMessageKey]
            FROM @failedMessage AS [failed]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [retried]
                ON  [failed].[ExportMessageKey] = [retried].[RetriedExportMessageKey]
        )
        BEGIN
            DELETE [failed]
            FROM @failedMessage AS [failed]
            INNER JOIN [sync].[RetriedExportMessage] AS [retried]
                ON  [failed].[ExportMessageKey] = [retried].[RetriedExportMessageKey]
        END
    END
        
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [failed].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @failedMessage AS [failed]
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @invalidTarget
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [failed].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @failedMessage AS [failed]
        
        DELETE [target]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN @invalidTarget AS [invalid]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [invalid].[TargetObjectKey];
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [time]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [time].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE       [time].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE @target
        FROM @target AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [time]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [time].[ObjectKey]
        WHERE       [time].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey;
    END
    
    SELECT @invalidTargetCount = COUNT([target].[TargetObjectKey])
    FROM @invalidTarget AS [target]
    
    SELECT @pendingTargetCount = COUNT([target].[TargetObjectKey])
    FROM @target AS [target]
    
    SELECT 
        @invalidTargetCount = COALESCE(@invalidTargetCount,0),
        @pendingTargetCount = COALESCE(@pendingTargetCount,0);
    
    IF
    (
            @pendingTargetCount <= 0
        AND	@invalidTargetCount <= 0
    )
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [sync].[QueueExportMessage]
            @action = @action,
            @exportMessageKey = @exportMessageKey;
    END         
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[DoTrackExportItemMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[DoTrackExportItemMessage]
    @exportKey                          BIGINT,
    @targetIdentifier                   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @messageIdentifier                  NVARCHAR(448),
    @action                             NVARCHAR(448),
    @synchronizationSequenceIdentifier  NVARCHAR(448)
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportMessageKey   BIGINT,
        @messageTypeKey     SMALLINT,
        @trueFlag           BIT;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageKey]
        @exportKey              = @exportKey,
        @messageIdentifier      = @messageIdentifier,
        @action                 = @action,
        @exportMessageTypeKey   = @messageTypeKey OUTPUT,
        @exportMessageKey       = @exportMessageKey OUTPUT;
    
    INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportItemMessage]
    (
        [ExportItemKey],
        [ExportMessageKey],
        [Primary]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        [item].[ExportItemKey],
        @exportMessageKey,
        @trueFlag
    FROM [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
    WHERE   [item].[SynchronizationSequenceIdentifier] = @synchronizationSequenceIdentifier;
    
    INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportMessageTarget]
    (
        [ExportMessageKey],
        [TargetObjectKey]
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @exportMessageKey,
        [object].[ObjectKey]
    FROM [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
    WHERE       [object].[ObjectID] = @targetIdentifier;
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[FullImportGetNext]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[FullImportGetNext]
    @beginObjectKey BIGINT, 
    @maximumObjectKey BIGINT,
    @batchSize INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

    IF @batchSize IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @batchSize = 1;
    END

    DECLARE 
        @synchronizationFilterObjectKey BIGINT,
        @synchronizeObjectTypeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @createdTimeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @defaultLocaleKey INT;
	
    SELECT 
        @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @synchronizeObjectTypeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'SynchronizeObjectType'),
        @synchronizationFilterObjectKey = [fim].[GetSynchronizationFilterObjectKey](),
        @defaultLocaleKey = CONVERT(INT,[fim].[GetDefaultLocaleKey]()); --The query processor expects a 32-bit value.  
    
    DECLARE @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs TABLE(ObjectTypeID SMALLINT)

    INSERT INTO @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs
    (
        [ObjectTypeID]
    )
    SELECT [o].[Key]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectTypeInternal] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [v]
        ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [v].[ValueReference]
    WHERE 
            [v].[ObjectKey] = @synchronizationFilterObjectKey 
        AND [v].[AttributeKey]= @synchronizeObjectTypeAttributeKey;
   
    DECLARE @fullImportObjectIDs TABLE 
    (
        [Ordering] BIGINT, 
        [ReverseOrdering] BIGINT, 
        [ObjectKey] BIGINT PRIMARY KEY
    )

    DECLARE @rowCount INT;
    DECLARE @objectCount INT;
    SELECT  @objectCount = 0;

    WHILE ((@objectCount < @batchSize) AND (@beginObjectKey <= @maximumObjectKey))
    BEGIN
        -- Note that the following insert uses a query that inner joins on CreatedTime attribute.
        -- This is because we want to skip over deletes. If we didn't skip over them, we have batchSize N,
        -- and you have N deletes in a row, the sproc would return an empty result set.
        -- Upon seeing no rows returned, the MA would think that there are no more objects to import.
        INSERT INTO @fullImportObjectIDs
        (
            [Ordering],
            [ReverseOrdering],
            [ObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT TOP (@batchSize-@objectCount)
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY [o].[ObjectKey] ASC) AS [Ordering], 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY [o].[ObjectKey] DESC) AS [ReverseOrdering], 
            [o].ObjectKey 
        FROM [fim].[Objects] [o]
        INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] [ovdt]
            ON [o].[ObjectKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectKey]
            AND [o].[ObjectTypeKey] = [ovdt].[ObjectTypeKey]
            AND [ovdt].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
        WHERE   [o].[ObjectTypeKey] IN (SELECT [ObjectTypeID]
                                        FROM @synchronizeObjectTypeIDs)
            AND [o].[ObjectKey] > @beginObjectKey
            -- overscan to reduce the number of iterations (deleted objects and objects of non-sync type do not count)
            AND [o].[ObjectKey] <= @beginObjectKey + 10 * @batchSize 
            AND [o].[ObjectKey] <= @maximumObjectKey 
        ORDER BY [o].[ObjectKey] ASC;

        SELECT @rowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

        IF (@rowCount > 0)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @objectCount = @objectCount + @rowCount;
            SELECT @beginObjectKey = MAX([o].[ObjectKey])
            FROM @fullImportObjectIDs [o];
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @beginObjectKey = @beginObjectKey + 10 * @batchSize
        END
    END --WHILE
    
    DECLARE @fullImportResults TABLE
    (
        [ObjectKey]       BIGINT,
        [AttributeKey]    SMALLINT,
        [ValueBinary]     VARBINARY(MAX) NULL,
        [ValueBoolean]    BIT NULL,
        [ValueDateTime]   DATETIME NULL,
        [ValueInteger]    BIGINT NULL,
        [ValueReference]  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
        [ValueString]     NVARCHAR(448) NULL,
        [ValueText]       NVARCHAR(max) NULL,
        [ValueXml]        XML NULL,
        [Ordering]        BIGINT, 
        [ReverseOrdering] BIGINT
    );
 
        
    INSERT INTO @fullImportResults 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueText],
        [Ordering], 
        [ReverseOrdering]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ovt].[ObjectKey],
        [ovt].[AttributeKey],
        [ovt].[ValueText],
        [f].[Ordering], 
        [f].[ReverseOrdering]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueText] [ovt]
    INNER JOIN @fullImportObjectIDs [f]
        ON [ovt].[ObjectKey] = [f].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE [ovt].[LocaleKey] = @defaultLocaleKey;

    INSERT INTO @fullImportResults 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueBinary],
        [Ordering], 
        [ReverseOrdering]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ovb].[ObjectKey], 
        [ovb].[AttributeKey], 
        [ovb].[ValueBinary],
        [f].[Ordering], 
        [f].[ReverseOrdering]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBinary] [ovb]
    INNER JOIN @fullImportObjectIDs [f]
        ON [ovb].[ObjectKey] = [f].[ObjectKey];
        
    INSERT INTO @fullImportResults 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueBoolean],
        [Ordering], 
        [ReverseOrdering]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ovb].[ObjectKey], 
        [ovb].[AttributeKey],
        [ovb].[ValueBoolean],
        [f].[Ordering], 
        [f].[ReverseOrdering]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueBoolean] [ovb]
    INNER JOIN @fullImportObjectIDs [f]
        ON [ovb].[ObjectKey] = [f].[ObjectKey];
        
    INSERT INTO @fullImportResults 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueDateTime],
        [Ordering], 
        [ReverseOrdering]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ovdt].[ObjectKey],
        [ovdt].[AttributeKey],
        [ovdt].[ValueDateTime],
        [f].[Ordering], 
        [f].[ReverseOrdering] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] [ovdt]
    INNER JOIN @fullImportObjectIDs [f]
        ON [ovdt].[ObjectKey] = [f].[ObjectKey];
        
    INSERT INTO @fullImportResults 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueInteger],
        [Ordering], 
        [ReverseOrdering]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ovint].[ObjectKey],
        [ovint].[AttributeKey],
        [ovint].[ValueInteger],
        [f].[Ordering], 
        [f].[ReverseOrdering] 
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueInteger] [ovint]
    INNER JOIN @fullImportObjectIDs [f]
        ON [ovint].[ObjectKey] = [f].[ObjectKey];
        
    INSERT INTO @fullImportResults 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueReference],
        [Ordering], 
        [ReverseOrdering]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ovr].[ObjectKey],
        [ovr].[AttributeKey], 
        [fim].[ObjectIDFromObjectKey]([ovr].[ValueReference]),
        [f].[Ordering], 
        [f].[ReverseOrdering]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] [ovr]
    INNER JOIN @fullImportObjectIDs [f]
        ON [ovr].[ObjectKey] = [f].[ObjectKey];
   
    INSERT INTO @fullImportResults 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueString],
        [Ordering], 
        [ReverseOrdering]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ovs].[ObjectKey],
        [ovs].[AttributeKey],
        [ovs].[ValueString],
        [f].[Ordering], 
        [f].[ReverseOrdering]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueString] [ovs]
    INNER JOIN @fullImportObjectIDs [f]
        ON [ovs].[ObjectKey] = [f].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE [ovs].[LocaleKey] = @defaultLocaleKey;
        
    INSERT INTO @fullImportResults 
    (
        [ObjectKey],
        [AttributeKey],
        [ValueXml],
        [Ordering], 
        [ReverseOrdering]
    )
    SELECT 
        [ovx].[ObjectKey],
        [ovx].[AttributeKey],
        [ovx].[ValueXml],
        [f].[Ordering], 
        [f].[ReverseOrdering]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueXml] [ovx]  
    INNER JOIN @fullImportObjectIDs [f]
        ON [ovx].[ObjectKey] = [f].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE [ovx].[LocaleKey] = @defaultLocaleKey;
  
    SELECT 
        ([fim].[ObjectIDFromObjectKey](v.ObjectKey)) AS [ObjectIdentifier],
        [v].[ObjectKey],
        [v].[AttributeKey],
        [ai].[Name],
        [ai].[DataType],
        [v].[ValueBinary],
        [v].[ValueBoolean],
        [v].[ValueDateTime],
        [v].[ValueInteger],
        [v].[ValueReference] AS [ValueReferenceIdentifier],
        [v].[ValueString],
        [v].[ValueText],
        [v].[ValueXml],
        @defaultLocaleKey AS [LocaleKey],
        [v].[Ordering],
        [v].[ReverseOrdering]
    FROM @fullImportResults AS [v]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[AttributeInternal] AS [ai]
        ON [v].[AttributeKey] = [ai].[Key]
    ORDER BY [v].[ObjectKey] ASC;
       
 
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[GetExportAcknowledgementStatus]
    @currentExportSessionIdentifier             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    OUTPUT,
    @acceptedExportItemCount                    BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @acknowledgedExportItemCount                BIGINT              OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    DECLARE @currentExportKey               BIGINT;
        
    SELECT 
        @currentExportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey](),
        @currentExportSessionIdentifier = [sync].[GetExportIdentifier]();
        
    SELECT @acceptedExportItemCount = COUNT([accepted].[ExportItemKey])
    FROM [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [accepted]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        ON  [accepted].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
    WHERE       [item].[ExportKey] = @currentExportKey;
        
    SELECT @acknowledgedExportItemCount = COUNT([acknowledged].[ExportItemKey])
    FROM [sync].[AcknowledgedExportItem] AS [acknowledged]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        ON  [acknowledged].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
    WHERE       [item].[ExportKey] = @currentExportKey;       
    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[GetExportItemStatus]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[GetExportItemStatus]
    @createAction                               NVARCHAR(448),
    @deleteAction                               NVARCHAR(448),
    @updateAction                               NVARCHAR(448),
    @currentExportSessionIdentifier             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    OUTPUT,
    @pendingCreateItemCount                     BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingDeleteItemCount                     BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingUpdateItemCount                     BIGINT              OUTPUT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE
        @acceptedCount              BIGINT,
        @completedCount             BIGINT,
        @currentExportKey           BIGINT,
        @falseFlag                  BIT,
        @trueFlag                   BIT,
        @exportMessageTypeKeyCreate SMALLINT,
        @exportMessageTypeKeyDelete SMALLINT,
        @exportMessageTypeKeyUpdate SMALLINT;
        
    SELECT
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);   
        
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageTypeKey]
        @description = @createAction,
        @exportMessageTypeKey = @exportMessageTypeKeyCreate OUTPUT;        
         
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageTypeKey]
        @description = @deleteAction,
        @exportMessageTypeKey = @exportMessageTypeKeyDelete OUTPUT;
        
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageTypeKey]
        @description = @updateAction,
        @exportMessageTypeKey = @exportMessageTypeKeyUpdate OUTPUT;
         
    
    DECLARE @accepted TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageTypeKey]      SMALLINT,
        [Count]                     BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageTypeKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @completed TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageTypeKey]      SMALLINT,
        [Count]                     BIGINT,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageTypeKey]
        )
    );
    
    INSERT INTO @accepted
    (
        [ExportMessageTypeKey],
        [Count]
    )
    SELECT 
        [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey],
        COUNT([item].[ExportItemKey])
    FROM [sync].[AcceptedExportItem] AS [item]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
        ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportItemKey]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON  [itemMessage].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    WHERE       [itemMessage].[Primary] = @trueFlag            
    GROUP BY
        [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey];
        
    INSERT INTO @completed
    (
        [ExportMessageTypeKey],
        [Count]
    )
    SELECT 
         [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey],
        COUNT([item].[ExportItemKey])
    FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [item]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItemMessage] AS [itemMessage]
        ON  [item].[ExportItemKey] = [itemMessage].[ExportItemKey]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON  [itemMessage].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    WHERE       [itemMessage].[Primary] = @trueFlag
    GROUP BY
        [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey]; 
    
    SELECT 
        @currentExportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey](),
        @currentExportSessionIdentifier = [sync].[GetExportIdentifier]();
    
    SELECT @acceptedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @accepted AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKeyCreate;
    
    SELECT @completedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @completed AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKeyCreate;
    
    SELECT @pendingCreateItemCount = COALESCE(@acceptedCount - @completedCount,0);
    
    SELECT @acceptedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @accepted AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKeyDelete;
    
    SELECT @completedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @completed AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKeyDelete;
    
    SELECT @pendingDeleteItemCount = COALESCE(@acceptedCount - @completedCount,0);
    
    SELECT @acceptedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @accepted AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKeyUpdate;
    
    SELECT @completedCount = [count].[Count]
    FROM @completed AS [count]
    WHERE       [count].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKeyUpdate;
    
    SELECT @pendingUpdateItemCount = COALESCE(@acceptedCount - @completedCount,0);   
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[GetExportMessageKey]
    @exportKey              BIGINT,
    @messageIdentifier      NVARCHAR(448),
    @action                 NVARCHAR(448),
    @exportMessageTypeKey   SMALLINT        =   NULL    OUTPUT, 
    @exportMessageKey       BIGINT          =   NULL    OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    SELECT TOP 1
        @exportMessageKey = [message].[ExportMessageKey],
        @exportMessageTypeKey = [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey]
    FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
    WHERE       [message].[MessageIdentifier] = @messageIdentifier;
    
    IF @exportMessageKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageTypeKey] 
            @description = @action,
            @exportMessageTypeKey = @exportMessageTypeKey OUTPUT;
    
        INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportMessage]
        (
            [ExportKey],
            [ExportMessageTypeKey],
            [MessageIdentifier]
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @exportKey,
            @exportMessageTypeKey,
            @messageIdentifier
        ); 
        
        SELECT @exportMessageKey = (SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY());     
    END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[GetExportMessageTransmission]
    @exportMessageKey               BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0; 
    
    DECLARE @falseFlag  BIT;
    
    SELECT @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
    
    SELECT TOP 1 [message].[Message]
    FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [message]
    WHERE   
            [message].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
        AND [sync].[HasExportAborted]() = @falseFlag;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[GetExportMessageTransmissionByIdentifier]
    @messageIdentifier               NVARCHAR(448)
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0; 
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey          BIGINT,
        @exportMessageKey   BIGINT;
    
    SELECT @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();
    
    SELECT @exportMessageKey = [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageKey](@exportKey, @messageIdentifier);
    
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageTransmission] @exportMessageKey = @exportMessageKey;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[GetExportMessageTypeKey]
    @description                NVARCHAR(448),
    @exportMessageTypeKey       SMALLINT  = NULL  OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT @exportMessageTypeKey = [sync].[GetExistingExportMessageTypeKey](@description);
    
    IF @exportMessageTypeKey IS NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO [sync].[ExportMessageType]
        (
            [Description]
        )
        VALUES
        (
            @description
        );
        
        SELECT @exportMessageTypeKey = (SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY());
    END
    
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[GetExportSentMessageStatus]
    @createAction                               NVARCHAR(448),
    @deleteAction                               NVARCHAR(448),
    @putAction                                  NVARCHAR(448),
    @currentExportSessionIdentifier             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    OUTPUT,
    @completedSentMessageCount                  BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @sentMessageCount                           BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingCreateMessageCount                  BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingDeleteMessageCount                  BIGINT              OUTPUT,
    @pendingUpdateMessageCount                  BIGINT              OUTPUT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE 
        @currentExportKey   BIGINT,
        @falseFlag          BIT;
        
     SELECT 
        @currentExportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey](),
        @currentExportSessionIdentifier = [sync].[GetExportIdentifier](),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);        
    
    SELECT @pendingCreateMessageCount = [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress](@createAction,@falseFlag); 
    SELECT @pendingDeleteMessageCount = [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress](@deleteAction,@falseFlag); 
    SELECT @pendingUpdateMessageCount = [sync].[GetExportMessageProcessingProgress](@putAction,@falseFlag); 
    
    SELECT @sentMessageCount = COUNT([sent].[ExportMessageKey])
    FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    WHERE   [message].[ExportKey] = @currentExportKey;
    
    SELECT @completedSentMessageCount = COUNT([sent].[ExportMessageKey])
    FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completed]
        ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [completed].[ExportMessageKey]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON  [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
    WHERE   [message].[ExportKey] = @currentExportKey;
    
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[GetMatchingTargetPendingExportMessages]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[GetMatchingTargetPendingExportMessages]
    @messageIdentifier      NVARCHAR(448),
    @action                 NVARCHAR(448)        
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0; 
    
    DECLARE @exportMessageTypeKey SMALLINT;
    
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageTypeKey]
        @description = @action,
        @exportMessageTypeKey = @exportMessageTypeKey OUTPUT;
    
    DECLARE @target TABLE
    (
        [TargetObjectKey] BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
    );
    
    DECLARE @result TABLE
    (
        [ExportMessageKey] BIGINT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
    );
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [message].[MessageIdentifier]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        WHERE       
                [message].[MessageIdentifier] = @messageIdentifier
            AND [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKey
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @target
        (
            [TargetObjectKey]
        )
        SELECT [target].[TargetObjectKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
            ON  [target].[ExportMessageKey] = [message].[ExportMessageKey]
        WHERE       
                [message].[MessageIdentifier] = @messageIdentifier
            AND [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKey
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [target].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
            ON  [target].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmission].[ExportMessageKey]
        INNER JOIN @target AS [messageTarget]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [messageTarget].[TargetObjectKey]        
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @result
        (
            [ExportMessageKey]
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT [target].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[ExportMessageTarget] AS [target]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessageTransmission] AS [transmission]
            ON  [target].[ExportMessageKey] = [transmission].[ExportMessageKey]
        INNER JOIN @target AS [messageTarget]
            ON  [target].[TargetObjectKey] = [messageTarget].[TargetObjectKey]; 
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [result].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM @result AS [result]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            ON  [result].[ExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey]
    )
    BEGIN
        DELETE [result]
        FROM @result AS [result]
        INNER JOIN [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
            ON  [result].[ExportMessageKey] = [sent].[ExportMessageKey];
    END
    
    SELECT [result].[ExportMessageKey]
    FROM @result AS [result];        
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[GetSynchronizedObjectTypeNames]
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @synchronizationFilterTypeKey SMALLINT,
        @nameAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey SMALLINT;

    SELECT 
        @synchronizationFilterTypeKey  = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'SynchronizationFilter'),
        @nameAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Name'),
        @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey  = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName] (N'ObjectTypeDescription');

    SELECT [strings].[ValueString] AS [FilteredObjectName]
    FROM [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [references]
    INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueString] AS [strings]
        ON [references].[ValueReference] = [strings].[ObjectKey]
    WHERE 
            [references].[ObjectTypeKey] = @synchronizationFilterTypeKey 
        AND [strings].[ObjectTypeKey] = @objectTypeDescriptionTypeKey
        AND [strings].[AttributeKey] = @nameAttributeKey;
  
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[InitiateExport]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[InitiateExport]
    @exportSessionIdentifier    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @trace                      BIT     = NULL,
    @exportKey                  BIGINT  = NULL  OUTPUT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT @exportKey = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0; 
    
    DECLARE 
        @acceptedExportItemCount        BIGINT,
        @acknowledgedExportItemCount	BIGINT,
        @eventKey                       BIGINT,
        @falseFlag                      BIT,
        @identifier                     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @retryCount                     INT,
        @mayRetry                       BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                    INT,
        @startTime                      DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                       BIT;

    SELECT 
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1),
        @acceptedExportItemCount = 0,
        @acknowledgedExportItemCount = 0;
        
    SELECT
        @mayRetry = @falseFlag,
        @mayRetryInt = 0,
        @retryCount = 3;        
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END   
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Initiate transaction
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        BEGIN TRANSACTION 
        
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [export].[ExportSessionIdentifier]
                FROM [sync].[Export] AS [export]
                WHERE   [export].[ExportSessionIdentifier] = @exportSessionIdentifier
            )
            BEGIN
                EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportAcknowledgementStatus]
                    @currentExportSessionIdentifier             = @identifier                       OUTPUT,
                    @acceptedExportItemCount                    = @acceptedExportItemCount          OUTPUT,
                    @acknowledgedExportItemCount                = @acknowledgedExportItemCount      OUTPUT;
                    
            END
            
            IF @acknowledgedExportItemCount < @acceptedExportItemCount
            BEGIN
                SELECT @exportKey = [export].[ExportKey]
                FROM [sync].[Export] AS [export]
                WHERE   [export].[ExportSessionIdentifier] = @exportSessionIdentifier;
                
                EXECUTE [sync].[DoRecoverExport] 
                    @exportKey = @exportKey;
                    
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
            
                EXECUTE [sync].[DoClearExport]
                    @trace = @trace;
                
                INSERT INTO [sync].[Export]
                (
                    [ExportSessionIdentifier]
                )
                VALUES
                (
                    @exportSessionIdentifier
                );
                
                SELECT @exportKey = (SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY());
                
                EXECUTE [sync].[CreateEvent]
                    @exportKey = @exportKey, 
                    @eventKey = @eventKey OUTPUT;
            END
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Commit Transaction
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle exceptions
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    IF (@trace = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = 0, 
            @stage      = N'InitiateExport';
    END

END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[QueueExportMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[QueueExportMessage]
    @action                         NVARCHAR(448),
    @exportMessageKey               BIGINT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 1;
    
    DECLARE    
        @acquiredLock                       SMALLINT,
        @conversationHandle                 UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @messageText                        NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @queuedMessage                      NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @resourceName                       NVARCHAR(255);
    
    SELECT @resourceName = N'FIMExportMessage-' + CAST(@exportMessageKey AS NVARCHAR(19));
    
    EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                @Resource = @resourceName,
                @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
                
    IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
    BEGIN
        SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @resourceName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
        RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
    END
    
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT [sent].[ExportMessageKey]
        FROM [sync].[SentExportMessage] AS [sent]
        WHERE       [sent].[ExportMessageKey] = @exportMessageKey
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    ;WITH XMLNAMESPACES
    (
        DEFAULT 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/2006/11/ResourceManagement'
    )
    SELECT @queuedMessage =
        ( 
            SELECT 
            N'',                    
            (
                SELECT
                    @exportMessageKey AS [ExportMessageKey],
                    @action AS [Action]
                FOR XML PATH (N'Message'), TYPE
            )
            FOR XML PATH (N'Export')
        );  

    BEGIN DIALOG CONVERSATION @conversationHandle
        FROM SERVICE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/ExportInitiator]
        TO SERVICE '//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Service/ExportReceiver'
        ON CONTRACT [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Contract/Export]
        WITH ENCRYPTION = OFF;
    SEND ON CONVERSATION @conversationHandle
        MESSAGE TYPE [//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Message/Export]
        (@queuedMessage);
        
    INSERT INTO [sync].[SentExportMessage] 
    (
        [ExportMessageKey]
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @exportMessageKey
    );
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[ReadExportMessageCompletion]
    @messageIdentifier          NVARCHAR(448)
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        [item].[SequenceNumber],
        [item].[Operation]
    FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completedItem]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        ON  [completedItem].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
    WHERE       [completedItem].[MessageIdentifier] = @messageIdentifier
    ORDER BY 
            [item].[SequenceNumber];
END

GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[ReadExportMessageCompletionByMessageType]
    @action                  NVARCHAR(448)
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey                  BIGINT,
        @exportMessageTypeKey       SMALLINT,
        @trueFlag                   BIT;
    
    SELECT 
        @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey](),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageTypeKey]
        @description = @action,
        @exportMessageTypeKey = @exportMessageTypeKey OUTPUT;
    
    SELECT DISTINCT [item].[SequenceNumber]
    FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completedItem]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportItem] AS [item]
        ON  [completedItem].[ExportItemKey] = [item].[ExportItemKey]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[ExportMessage] AS [message]
        ON	[completedItem].[MessageIdentifier] = [message].[MessageIdentifier]
    INNER JOIN [sync].[CompletedExportMessage] AS [completedMessage]
        ON  [message].[ExportMessageKey] = [completedMessage].[ExportMessageKey]
    WHERE
            [message].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
        AND [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKey
        AND	[completedMessage].[Succeeded] = @trueFlag
    ORDER BY 
            [item].[SequenceNumber] ASC;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[ReadExportMessageFailureByMessageType]
    @action                  NVARCHAR(448)
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey                  BIGINT,
        @exportMessageTypeKey       SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                  BIT;
    
    SELECT 
        @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey](),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0);
        
    EXECUTE [sync].[GetExportMessageTypeKey]
        @description = @action,
        @exportMessageTypeKey = @exportMessageTypeKey OUTPUT;
    
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        [completedMessage].[SynchronizationErrorKey],
        [item].[SequenceNumber]
    FROM [sync].[CompletedExportItem] AS [completedItem]

    WHERE
            [message].[ExportKey] = @exportKey
        AND [message].[ExportMessageTypeKey] = @exportMessageTypeKey
        AND	[completedMessage].[Succeeded] = @falseFlag
    ORDER BY 
            [completedMessage].[SynchronizationErrorKey] ASC,
            [item].[SequenceNumber] ASC;

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[ReceiveExportMessage] 
    @timeoutInMilliseconds  INT =   -1
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    DECLARE @trueFlag   BIT,
			@ch UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
			@messagebody VARBINARY(MAX);
    
    SELECT @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
	EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = @trueFlag;	

	WAITFOR
    (
        RECEIVE TOP(1) @ch = conversation_handle,
					   @messagebody = message_body
		FROM [sync].[//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Queue/ExportReception]
    ), 
    TIMEOUT @timeoutInMilliseconds;	

	IF (@@ROWCOUNT > 0)
	  BEGIN		  
	  -- Return expected result set
	    SELECT @messagebody;
	  -- End the conversation on the target's side
	    END CONVERSATION @ch;
	  END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[ReceiveExportMessageOnInitiator]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[ReceiveExportMessageOnInitiator] 
AS
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

	DECLARE @ch					UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
			@messagetypename	NVARCHAR(256);

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
	
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN TRY 
		BEGIN TRANSACTION
			
			WAITFOR(
				RECEIVE TOP(1) @ch = conversation_handle,
							   @messagetypename = message_type_name
				FROM [sync].[//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Queue/ExportInitiation]
			), TIMEOUT 60000

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT = 0)
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
				BREAK
			END
			IF (@messagetypename =
			    N'http://schemas.microsoft.com/SQL/ServiceBroker/EndDialog'
				OR
				@messagetypename =
			    N'http://schemas.microsoft.com/SQL/ServiceBroker/Error')
			BEGIN
				END CONVERSATION @ch;
			END

		COMMIT TRANSACTION
	END TRY

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
	BEGIN CATCH
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[ReceiveExportResponseMessageOnInitiator]

BEGIN
--********************************************************

--********************************************************

    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
	
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN TRY 
		BEGIN TRANSACTION
			
			WAITFOR(
				RECEIVE TOP(1) @ch = conversation_handle,
							   @messagetypename = message_type_name
				FROM [sync].[//Microsoft/ResourceManagement/Queue/ExportResponseInitiation]
			), TIMEOUT 60000

			BEGIN
				END CONVERSATION @ch;
			END

		COMMIT TRANSACTION
	END TRY

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/    
	BEGIN CATCH
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

END
