/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[RecordSynchronizationError]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[RecordSynchronizationError]
    @errorText              XML,
    @trace                  BIT     = NULL,
    @errorKey               BIGINT  = NULL  OUTPUT
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
--Top level
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT @errorKey = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0; 
    
    DECLARE 
        @acquiredLock                   SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag                      BIT,
        @lockName                       NVARCHAR(32),
        @mayRetry                       BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                    INT,
        @messageText                    NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @retryCount                     INT,    
        @startTime                      DATETIME,
        @trueFlag                       BIT;

    SELECT 
        @acquiredLock   = -1, --Negative value indicates that the lock was not acquired according to sp_getapplock API
        @lockName       = N'RecordSynchronizationError',
        @falseFlag      = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag       = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    SELECT
        @mayRetry = @falseFlag,
        @mayRetryInt = 0,
        @retryCount = 3;        
        
    IF @trace = @trueFlag
    BEGIN
        SELECT @startTime = GETUTCDATE();
    END        
        
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Initiate transaction
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/     
        BEGIN TRANSACTION

            EXECUTE @acquiredLock = [sys].[sp_getapplock]
                        @Resource = @lockName,
                        @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
                        @LockOwner = N'Transaction';
                        
            IF(@acquiredLock < 0)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @messageText = [fim].[FormatRequestSqlOperationException](N'Not able to acquire a lock for ' + @lockName + ' because it is locked by another process.');
                RAISERROR(@messageText,16,1);
            END
        
            INSERT INTO [sync].[SynchronizationError]
            (
                [Error]
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @errorText
            );
            
            SELECT @errorKey = (SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY());
            
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Commit Transaction
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle exceptions
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    IF (@trace = @trueFlag)
    BEGIN
        EXECUTE [fim].[TraceDuration]
            @startTime  = @startTime,
            @requestKey = 0, 
            @stage      = N'RecordSynchronizationError';
    END

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[ReinitiateDeltaImport]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[ReinitiateDeltaImport]
    @requestLogIdentifier   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER        = NULL,
    @logIsEmpty             BIT             OUTPUT
AS EXECUTE AS USER='FIMServiceTruncateUser'
BEGIN
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @identifierAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @createdTimeAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @creatorAttributeKey SMALLINT,
        @falseFlag BIT,
        @requestLogEndKey BIGINT,
        @requestLogStartKey BIGINT,
        @requestTypeKey BIGINT,
        @synchronizationAccountObjectKey BIGINT,
        @trueFlag BIT;
        
    SELECT 
        @identifierAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'ObjectID'),
        @createdTimeAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'CreatedTime'),
        @creatorAttributeKey = [fim].[AttributeKeyFromName](N'Creator'),
        @requestTypeKey = [fim].[ObjectTypeKeyFromName](N'Request'),
        @synchronizationAccountObjectKey = [fim].[GetSynchronizationAccountObjectKey](),
        @falseFlag = CONVERT(BIT,0),
        @trueFlag = CONVERT(BIT,1);
        
    SELECT @logIsEmpty = @trueFlag;
        
    BEGIN TRANSACTION       
    
        IF @requestLogIdentifier IS NULL
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [delta].[RequestLogKey]
                FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
            )
            BEGIN
                SELECT @requestLogStartKey = MAX([delta].[RequestLogKey]) + 1
                FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta];
            END
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS
            (
                SELECT [log].[DeltaImportLogKey]
                FROM [sync].[DeltaImportWatermark] AS [log]
            )
            BEGIN
                TRUNCATE TABLE [sync].[DeltaImportWatermark];
            END
        
            SELECT @requestLogStartKey = [log].[RequestLogKey] + 1
            FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
            WHERE   [log].[RequestLogIdentifier] = @requestLogIdentifier;
        END
        
        IF @requestLogStartKey IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT @requestLogStartKey = 1;
        END
    
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [log].[DeltaImportLogKey]
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [log]
        )
        BEGIN
            TRUNCATE TABLE [sync].[DeltaImportLog];
        END

        SELECT @requestLogEndKey = MAX([log].[RequestLogKey])
        FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log];        

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [log].[RequestLogKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
            WHERE
                    [log].[RequestLogKey] >= @requestLogStartKey
                AND [log].[RequestLogKey] <= @requestLogEndKey
                AND NOT
                (
                        [log].[Added] = 0
                    AND [log].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                )
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [sync].[DeltaImportLog]
            (
                [RequestLogKey],
                [RequestKey],
                [RequestLogIdentifier],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectID],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueBinary],
	            [ValueBoolean],
	            [ValueDateTime],
	            [ValueInteger],
	            [ValueReference],
	            [ValueString],
	            [ValueText],
	            [ValueXML],
                [EventTime],
                [Added]
            )
            SELECT 
                [log].[RequestLogKey],
                [log].[RequestKey],
                [log].[RequestLogIdentifier],
                [log].[ObjectKey],
                [log].[ObjectID],
                [log].[AttributeKey],
                [log].[ValueBinary],
	            [log].[ValueBoolean],
	            [log].[ValueDateTime],
	            [log].[ValueInteger],
	            [log].[ValueReference],
                [log].[ValueString],
	            [log].[ValueText],
	            [log].[ValueXML],
                [log].[EventTime],
                [log].[Added]
            FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
            WHERE
                    [log].[RequestLogKey] >= @requestLogStartKey
                AND [log].[RequestLogKey] <= @requestLogEndKey
                AND NOT
                (
                        [log].[Added] = 0
                    AND [log].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                )
            ORDER BY 
                [log].[ObjectKey] ASC,
                [log].[EventTime] ASC;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey]
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [existing]
                ON  [delta].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    (
                            [delta].[ValueReference] IS NULL
                        OR  [delta].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                    )
                AND [existing].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND [existing].[SequenceID] = 0
                AND [existing].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
                
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sync].[DeltaImportLog]
            SET [Export] = @trueFlag
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [existing]
                ON  [delta].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    (
                            [delta].[ValueReference] IS NULL
                        OR  [delta].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                    )
                AND [existing].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND [existing].[SequenceID] = 0
                AND [existing].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey]
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                ON  [delta].[ValueReference] = [object].[ObjectID]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [existing]
                ON  [object].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [delta].[Export] IS NULL
                AND [existing].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND [existing].[SequenceID] = 0
                AND [existing].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sync].[DeltaImportLog]
            SET [Export] = @trueFlag
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[Objects] AS [object]
                ON  [delta].[ValueReference] = [object].[ObjectID]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueDateTime] AS [existing]
                ON  [object].[ObjectKey] = [existing].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [delta].[Export] IS NULL
                AND [existing].[AttributeKey] = @createdTimeAttributeKey
                AND [existing].[SequenceID] = 0
                AND [existing].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey]
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
            WHERE   [delta].[Export] IS NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sync].[DeltaImportLog]
            SET [Export] = @falseFlag
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
            WHERE   [delta].[Export] IS NULL;
        END

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [log].[RequestLogKey]
            FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
            WHERE
                    [log].[RequestLogKey] >= @requestLogStartKey
                AND [log].[RequestLogKey] <= @requestLogEndKey
                AND 
                (
                        [log].[Added] = 0
                    AND [log].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                )
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [sync].[DeltaImportLog]
            (
                [RequestLogKey],
                [RequestKey],
                [RequestLogIdentifier],
                [ObjectKey],
                [ObjectID],
                [AttributeKey],
                [ValueReference],
	            [EventTime],
                [Added],
                [Export]
            )
            SELECT 
                [log].[RequestLogKey],
                [log].[RequestKey],
                [log].[RequestLogIdentifier],
                [log].[ObjectKey],
                [log].[ObjectID],
                [log].[AttributeKey],
                [log].[ValueReference],
                [log].[EventTime],
                [log].[Added],
                @trueFlag
            FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
            WHERE
                    [log].[RequestLogKey] >= @requestLogStartKey
                AND [log].[RequestLogKey] <= @requestLogEndKey
                AND 
                (
                        [log].[Added] = 0
                    AND [log].[AttributeKey] = @identifierAttributeKey
                )
            ORDER BY
                [log].[ObjectKey] ASC, 
                [log].[EventTime] ASC;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [delta].[DeltaImportLogKey]
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [request]
                ON  [delta].[RequestKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestTypeKey
                AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                AND [request].[ValueReference] = @synchronizationAccountObjectKey
                AND [request].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag                
        )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE [sync].[DeltaImportLog]
            SET 
                [Synchronized] = @trueFlag,
                [Export] = @trueFlag
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [delta]
            INNER JOIN [fim].[ObjectValueReference] AS [request]
                ON  [delta].[RequestKey] = [request].[ObjectKey]
            WHERE
                    [request].[ObjectTypeKey] = @requestTypeKey
                AND [request].[AttributeKey] = @creatorAttributeKey
                AND [request].[ValueReference] = @synchronizationAccountObjectKey
                AND [request].[Multivalued] = @falseFlag;
        END
        
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT [log].[DeltaImportLogKey]
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [log]
            WHERE   [log].[Export] = @trueFlag
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [sync].[DeltaImportWatermark]
            (
                [DeltaImportLogKey],
                [RequestLogKey],
                [RequestLogIdentifier]
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT
                [log].[DeltaImportLogKey],
                [log].[RequestLogKey],
                [log].[RequestLogIdentifier]
            FROM [sync].[DeltaImportLog] AS [log]
            ORDER BY
                [log].[DeltaImportLogKey],
                [log].[RequestLogKey];
        
            SELECT @logIsEmpty = @falseFlag;
        END
        
    COMMIT TRANSACTION
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[RetryExportMessage]
    @messageIdentifier              NVARCHAR(448),
    @originalMessageIdentifier      NVARCHAR(448),
    @action                         NVARCHAR(448),
    @targetIdentifier               UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @message                        XML
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey                          BIGINT,
        @exportMessageKey                   BIGINT,
        @exportMessageTypeKey               SMALLINT,
        @mayRetry                           BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                        INT,
        @retryCount                         INT;   
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
        BEGIN TRANSACTION      
        
            SELECT @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();
            
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoRecordExportMessage]
                @exportKey = @exportKey,
                @messageIdentifier = @messageIdentifier,
                @action = @action,
                @message = @message,
                @exportMessageKey = @exportMessageKey OUTPUT;
                
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoRetryExportMessage]
                @exportMessageKey = @exportMessageKey,
                @originalMessageIdentifier = @originalMessageIdentifier,
                @targetIdentifier = @targetIdentifier;
                
            EXECUTE [sync].[QueueExportMessage]
                @action = @action,
                @exportMessageKey = @exportMessageKey;
                
                
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[SendExportResponseMessage]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[SendExportResponseMessage]
    @messageIdentifier          NVARCHAR(448),
    @succeeded                  BIT,
    @synchronizationErrorKey    BIGINT = NULL
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @mayRetry                           BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                        INT,
        @retryCount                         INT,
        @trueFlag                           BIT;   
        
    SELECT @trueFlag   = CONVERT(BIT,1);
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
        BEGIN TRANSACTION      
        
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoRecordExportMessageCompletion]
                @messageIdentifier          = @messageIdentifier,
                @succeeded                  = @succeeded,
                @synchronizationErrorKey    = @synchronizationErrorKey;
                
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoSendExportResponseMessage]
                @messageIdentifier          = @messageIdentifier,
                @succeeded                  = @succeeded,
                @synchronizationErrorKey    = @synchronizationErrorKey;
                
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = @trueFlag
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[SendExportUpdateMessage]
    @action                 NVARCHAR(448),
    @exportMessageKey       BIGINT,
    @pendingTargetCount     BIGINT          OUTPUT,
    @invalidTargetCount     BIGINT          OUTPUT   
AS
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    SELECT @pendingTargetCount = NULL, -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
           @invalidTargetCount = NULL; -- SET OUTPUT Parameter in all code paths SR0013
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey                          BIGINT,
        @mayRetry                           BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                        INT,
        @retryCount                         INT;   
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
        BEGIN TRANSACTION      
        
            SELECT @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();
            
            EXECUTE [sync].[DoSendExportUpdateMessage]
                @exportKey = @exportKey,
                @action = @action,
                @exportMessageKey = @exportMessageKey,
                @pendingTargetCount = @pendingTargetCount OUTPUT,
                @invalidTargetCount = @invalidTargetCount OUTPUT;
                
                
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
    END TRY
        
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Handle any errors that might have occured.  
 *---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/                
    BEGIN CATCH
        EXEC @mayRetryInt = [fim].[MayRetryTransaction] @retryCount OUTPUT;
        SELECT @mayRetry = CAST(@mayRetryInt AS BIT);
        IF @mayRetry = 1
        BEGIN
            GOTO RetryPoint;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END
            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];
        END
    END CATCH

    
END
GO

BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    DECLARE 
        @exportKey                          BIGINT,
        @mayRetry                           BIT,
        @mayRetryInt                        INT,
        @retryCount                         INT;   
    
RetryPoint: 
    BEGIN TRY 
        BEGIN TRANSACTION      
        
            SELECT @exportKey = [sync].[GetCurrentExportKey]();

                @exportKey = @exportKey,
                @targetIdentifier = @targetIdentifier,
                @messageIdentifier = @messageIdentifier,
                @action = @action,

        COMMIT TRANSACTION

        BEGIN
            IF (XACT_STATE() != 0)

                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

            EXECUTE [fim].[ReRaiseException];

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [sync].[TruncateRequestLog]    Script Date: 2. 9. 2026 17:08:19 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--********************************************************
--*                                                      *
--*   Copyright (C) Microsoft. All rights reserved.      *
--*                                                      *
--********************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [sync].[TruncateRequestLog] 
    @requestLogTruncationKey    BIGINT,
    @requestLogIdentifier       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER    OUTPUT
AS EXECUTE AS USER='FIMServiceTruncateUser'
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    EXECUTE [fim].[AssertTransactionalContext] @requireTransaction = 0;
    
    SELECT TOP 1 @requestLogIdentifier = [log].[RequestLogIdentifier]
    FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
    WHERE       [log].[RequestLogKey] = @requestLogTruncationKey;    
    
    IF NOT EXISTS 
    (
        SELECT [log].[RequestLogKey] 
        FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
        WHERE   [log].[RequestLogKey] > @requestLogTruncationKey
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
    
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#truncateRequestLogBuffer') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #truncateRequestLogBuffer;
        END

        SELECT  
	        [RequestLogKey] AS [RequestLogKey],
	        [RequestKey] AS [RequestKey],
	        [RequestLogIdentifier] AS [RequestLogIdentifier],
	        [ObjectKey] AS [ObjectKey],
	        [ObjectID] AS [ObjectID],
	        [AttributeKey] AS [AttributeKey],
	        [ValueBinary] AS [ValueBinary],
	        [ValueBoolean] AS [ValueBoolean],
	        [ValueDateTime] AS [ValueDateTime],
	        [ValueInteger] AS [ValueInteger],
	        [ValueReference] AS [ValueReference],
	        [ValueString] AS [ValueString],
	        [ValueText] AS [ValueText],
	        [ValueXML] AS [ValueXML],
	        [EventTime] AS [EventTime],
	        [Added] AS [Added]	
	    INTO #truncateRequestLogBuffer
        FROM [fim].[RequestLog] AS [log]
        WHERE       [log].[RequestLogKey] >= @requestLogTruncationKey
        ORDER BY 
            [log].[RequestLogKey] ASC;
            
        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_TruncateRequestLogBuffer]
        ON #truncateRequestLogBuffer
        (
            [RequestLogKey]
        );   	        
    	
	    TRUNCATE TABLE [fim].[RequestLog];
    	
	    SET IDENTITY_INSERT [fim].[RequestLog] ON

        INSERT INTO [fim].[RequestLog]
        (
            [RequestLogKey],
	        [RequestKey],
	        [RequestLogIdentifier],
	        [ObjectKey],
	        [ObjectID],
	        [AttributeKey],
	        [ValueBinary],
	        [ValueBoolean],
	        [ValueDateTime],
	        [ValueInteger],
	        [ValueReference],
	        [ValueString],
	        [ValueText],
	        [ValueXML],
	        [EventTime],
	        [Added]
	    )
        SELECT 
            [buffer].[RequestLogKey],
	        [buffer].[RequestKey],
	        [buffer].[RequestLogIdentifier],
	        [buffer].[ObjectKey],
	        [buffer].[ObjectID],
	        [buffer].[AttributeKey],
	        [buffer].[ValueBinary],
	        [buffer].[ValueBoolean],
	        [buffer].[ValueDateTime],
	        [buffer].[ValueInteger],
	        [buffer].[ValueReference],
	        [buffer].[ValueString],
	        [buffer].[ValueText],
	        [buffer].[ValueXML],
	        [buffer].[EventTime],
	        [buffer].[Added]	
        FROM #truncateRequestLogBuffer AS [buffer]
        ORDER BY 
            [buffer].[RequestLogKey] ASC;
            
        SET IDENTITY_INSERT [fim].[RequestLog] OFF
        
    COMMIT TRANSACTION

END
GO
